<script>
(function(){
  var side=document.getElementById('side'),b=document.getElementById('burger');
  b.addEventListener('click',function(){side.classList.toggle('mini');b.textContent=side.classList.contains('mini')?'››':'‹‹';});
  document.querySelectorAll('.navhead').forEach(function(h){
    h.addEventListener('click',function(){if(side.classList.contains('mini'))return;h.parentElement.classList.toggle('closed');});
  });
})();
document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(t){
  t.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var w=t.closest('.card');
    w.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('on');x.setAttribute('aria-selected','false');x.tabIndex=-1;});
    w.querySelectorAll('.tabpane').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('on')});
    t.classList.add('on');t.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');t.tabIndex=0;
    var p=document.getElementById('tab-'+t.dataset.tab); if(p)p.classList.add('on');
  });
});
document.querySelector('.tabs').addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  var tabs=Array.from(this.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]'));var i=tabs.indexOf(document.activeElement);if(i<0)return;
  var next=e.key==='ArrowRight'?(i+1)%tabs.length:e.key==='ArrowLeft'?(i+tabs.length-1)%tabs.length:e.key==='Home'?0:e.key==='End'?tabs.length-1:null;
  if(next!==null){e.preventDefault();tabs[next].focus();tabs[next].click();}
});
function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]});}

/* Keyed on the four statuses affiliate_referrals.status actually holds, mapped
   to client-readable words in the fetch block at the bottom of this file. An
   unknown status falls back to b-gray rather than emitting class="undefined",
   which is what the old map did for every row it did not recognise. */
var ST_CLS={'Referred':'b-info','Converted':'b-ok','Paid':'b-ok','Void':'b-alert'};
function stCls(k){return ST_CLS[k]||'b-gray'}
var PAY_CLS={'Accrued':'b-warn','Paid':'b-ok','—':'b-gray'};
function payCls(k){return PAY_CLS[k]||'b-gray'}

/* FH-AFFILIATE-COMMISSION-BEGIN */
/* COMMISSION IS READ FROM THE ROW. IT IS NEVER WORKED OUT IN THE BROWSER.

   This screen used to carry `var RATE=0.12` and multiply the basis by it. The
   real Tier 1 rate is 20%, owner-set 2026-08-24 and shipped in
   db/migrations/261_affiliate_tier1_20pct_20260824.sql. (CORRECTED 2026-09-20:
   LEADS and PAYOUTS ARE fetched and assigned now, at :1193 and :1207 inside
   load(). The sentences below that say otherwise are stale — left visible with
   this correction rather than quietly deleted, because a future reader who
   half-remembers them should find the correction and not the claim.) Nothing fetches LEADS
   yet, so nobody saw it — but the moment this table had a row in it every
   affiliate would have been shown a commission 40% short of what they are owed.

   A single constant in a web page cannot express the rate in the first place.
   The rate lives in affiliate_commission_rules, one row per rule, and it moves
   by tier (direct 20%, downline 5%), by product (funding pays on the deposit
   collected, repair on the enrolment fee) and by date (a rule is effective-dated
   and the version open on the day of the outcome governs the payout).

   convert() in src/affiliates/economics.mjs already does the sum once, writes
   the answer to affiliate_referrals.commission_due, and freezes the exact rule
   and rate that produced it in rule_snapshot. Doing it again here would let this
   screen and the ledger print two different numbers with nothing to say which
   one is true, and would make that snapshot mean nothing.

   commission_due is NULL when a referral converted while no rule was in force.
   NULL is UNKNOWN and it has to survive all the way to the screen as the dash.
   Never $0 — that reads as "you earned nothing", which this page cannot know —
   and never a figure this file invented. A real 0 that the ledger actually
   recorded is a measurement and prints as $0.00.

   Nothing in this block multiplies. Keep it that way. */

function money(n){return '$'+Number(n||0).toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2})}

/* commissionDue — the row's own figure, or null for unknown. A missing field,
   an empty string and a value that is not a number are all unknown. None of
   them become 0. */
function commissionDue(l){
  var v=l?l.commission_due:null;
  if(v===null||v===undefined||v==='') return null;
  var n=Number(v);
  return isFinite(n)?n:null;
}

/* commissionText — what the Commission cell prints for one row. */
function commissionText(l){
  var c=commissionDue(l);
  return c===null?'—':money(c);
}

/* commissionTotals — adds up the commissions that are KNOWN and says how many
   it could not add. A row with no rate set is left out of the sum rather than
   counted as zero, because counting it as zero would make the total read as
   the whole story when it is not. */
function commissionTotals(rows){
  var sum=0,counted=0,unknown=0;
  (rows||[]).forEach(function(l){
    var c=commissionDue(l);
    if(c===null){unknown++;return}
    sum=sum+c;counted++;
  });
  return {
    counted:counted,
    unknown:unknown,
    text:counted?money(sum):'—',
    label:'Total shown'+(unknown
      ?' · '+unknown+(unknown===1?' row with no rate set is not counted':' rows with no rate set are not counted')
      :'')
  };
}

if(typeof window!=='undefined'){
  window.FHAffiliateCommission={due:commissionDue,text:commissionText,totals:commissionTotals};
}

var PAYOUTS=[];
var PST_CLS={Paid:'b-ok',Held:'b-alert',Scheduled:'b-info',Processing:'b-info',Void:'b-gray'};
function pstCls(k){return PST_CLS[k]||'b-gray'}

function renderLeads(){
  var sf=document.getElementById('stFilter').value, q=document.getElementById('q').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var list=LEADS.filter(function(l){
    if(sf && l.st!==sf) return false;
    if(q && l.biz.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0) return false;
    return true;
  });
  document.getElementById('leadBody').innerHTML=list.map(function(l){
    return '<tr><td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+l.d+'</td>'+
      '<td style="font-weight:500">'+esc(l.biz)+'</td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge '+stCls(l.st)+'">'+l.st+'</span></td>'+
      '<td style="font-size:var(--fs-body);color:'+(l.prod?'inherit':'var(--gray2)')+'">'+esc(l.prod||'— none yet')+'</td>'+
      '<td class="money">'+(l.basis?money(l.basis):'—')+'</td>'+
      '<td class="money" style="text-align:right">'+commissionText(l)+'</td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge '+payCls(l.pay)+'">'+l.pay+'</span></td></tr>';
  }).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="7" class="empty">'+(LEADS.length?'No referrals match that filter.':'No referrals on file')+'</td></tr>';
  var tot=commissionTotals(list);
  document.getElementById('leadTotal').textContent=tot.text;
  var totLabel=document.getElementById('leadTotalLabel');
  if(totLabel) totLabel.textContent=tot.label;
}

function renderPayouts(){
  document.getElementById('payBody').innerHTML=PAYOUTS.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.d<b.d?1:-1}).map(function(p){
    return '<tr><td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+p.d+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray)">'+p.per+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+p.n+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+esc(p.m)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="money" style="text-align:right">'+money(p.amt)+'</td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge '+pstCls(p.st)+'">'+p.st+'</span>'+
      (p.st==='Held'?' <span style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray)">'+esc(p.why||'on hold')+'</span>':'')+'</td></tr>';
  }).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">No payout runs on file yet.</td></tr>';
}

/* REFERRED, CONVERTED, PAID and the AF-03 funnel used to be counted out of the
   empty LEADS and PAYOUTS arrays above and printed as "0", "0%" and "$0.00".
   Nothing fetches those arrays, so those were not measurements — and to an
   affiliate "PAID $0.00 lifetime" reads as "we have paid you nothing", which
   this page had no way to know. They then sat at the em dash the markup ships
   with, captioned where the real number would come from.

   T10-04: the numbers are real now. /api/read/affiliates returns
   referred_count, referred_untracked, converted_count, unrated_converted_count,
   clicks_count, clicks_30d, paid_total and paid_runs, and the block at the
   bottom of this file paints all four tiles and the funnel from them.

   THE STANDING RULE HAS NOT CHANGED: these are painted from that read and
   NEVER from LEADS or PAYOUTS. Those two arrays are still empty and still
   fetched by nothing; the tables they feed still say so in their own empty
   states. Do not wire a KPI to them. */

function copy(txt,btn,label){
  function done(){var o=btn.textContent;btn.textContent='Copied ✓';setTimeout(function(){btn.textContent=label},1400)}
  if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText){navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(done,done);}
  else{var ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=txt;document.body.appendChild(ta);ta.select();
       try{document.execCommand('copy')}catch(e){} document.body.removeChild(ta);done();}
}
/* paintOfferLinks — one row per offer: name, the link, Copy link. */
function paintOfferLinks(links){
  var box=document.getElementById('offerLinks');
  if(!box||!links||!links.length) return;
  box.innerHTML='';
  links.forEach(function(l){
    var row=document.createElement('div');row.className='offerrow';
    var nm=document.createElement('div');nm.className='offername';nm.textContent=l.name;
    var lr=document.createElement('div');lr.className='linkrow';
    var inp=document.createElement('input');inp.readOnly=true;inp.value=l.url;inp.setAttribute('aria-label',l.name+' link');
    var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='btn mono';b.textContent='Copy link';
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){copy(l.url,b,'Copy link')});
    lr.appendChild(inp);lr.appendChild(b);row.appendChild(nm);row.appendChild(lr);box.appendChild(row);
  });
}

<script defer src="data.js"></script>
<script>

/* Affiliate — real balances from /api/read/affiliates.
   Commission RATE: owner-set 2026-08-24 — Tier 1 20% / Tier 2 5% (migration 261).
   Accrued dollars still come from referral rows; a conversion with no matching
   rule keeps commission_due NULL (never COALESCE to 0). */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var set = function (id, v) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = v; };
  var usd = function (n) {
    // Two fraction digits always: toLocaleString's default drops a trailing
    // zero, so 1250.50 rendered as "$1,250.5" — wrong for money on screen.
    return "$" + Number(n || 0).toLocaleString("en-US",
      { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  };

  function applyCode(code) {
    var c = String(code || "").trim();
    var el = document.getElementById("affCode");
    /* The links themselves come from the portal read (paintOfferLinks). */
    if (!c) {
      if (el) el.textContent = "No code yet";
      return;
    }
    if (el) el.textContent = c;
  }

  /* num — a count the endpoint did not send is UNKNOWN, and unknown is null.
     Number(undefined) is NaN and Number(null) is 0; both would end up printed
     as a number that was never measured. Nothing here defaults a missing count
     to zero. */
  function num(v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined || v === "") return null;
    var n = Number(v);
    return isFinite(n) ? n : null;
  }

  /* paintFunnel — click → referred → converted, off the same read as the tiles.

     The card header says CLICK TO CONVERTED, not CLICK TO FUNDED: a conversion
     is the first qualifying paid product, which is a funded engagement OR a
     paid repair enrolment, so "funded" would name only half of it.

     A stage whose number cannot be known shows a dash and the reason under it.
     If NO stage is known the card keeps the empty state the markup ships with,
     rather than drawing three dashes and calling it a funnel.

     ONE CONVERSION RATE ON THIS SCREEN, NOT TWO. The Converted step divides by
     TRACKED referrals — the identical denominator the CONVERTED tile above uses
     — and names it in the caption. It used to divide by every referral, so this
     card and that tile printed two different percentages off one set of numbers
     and an affiliate had no way to tell which was true. A referral nobody is
     tracking has an UNKNOWN outcome; putting it in the denominator counts it as
     "did not convert", which drags the rate down and then states the result as
     a measured fact. Whoever changes one of these two must change both. */
  function paintFunnel(clicks, referred, converted, tracked) {
    var body = document.getElementById("funnelBody");
    if (!body) return;

    // Zero recorded clicks means nothing records clicks yet — see the CLICKS
    // note below. Treated as unknown here for the same reason.
    var clickN = (clicks === null || clicks === 0) ? null : clicks;

    // If there are referrals but none of them are tracked, the conversion count
    // is not a measurement of anything. Show the dash and the reason, the same
    // as the tile does, instead of a bar labelled 0.
    var convN = converted;
    var convWhy = "not available";
    if (converted !== null && tracked === 0 && referred) {
      convN = null;
      convWhy = "none of these are tracked yet";
    }

    var steps = [
      { label: "Clicks",    n: clickN,    why: "not recorded yet",
        sub: clickN === null ? "" : "recorded link clicks" },
      { label: "Referred",  n: referred,  why: "not available",
        sub: (referred !== null && clickN) ? Math.round((referred / clickN) * 100) + "% of clicks" : "" },
      { label: "Converted", n: convN,     why: convWhy,
        sub: (convN !== null && tracked) ? Math.round((convN / tracked) * 100) + "% of " + tracked + " tracked" : "" }
    ];

    var known = steps.filter(function (s) { return s.n !== null; }).length;
    if (!known) return;

    var shade = [1, 0.72, 0.46];
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="funnel">' + steps.map(function (s, i) {
      return '<div class="fstep">' +
               '<div class="fb" style="background:rgba(10,10,10,' + shade[i] + ');color:#fff">' +
                 (s.n === null ? "—" : String(s.n)) +
               '</div>' +
               '<div class="fl">' + s.label + '</div>' +
               '<div class="fp">' + (s.n === null ? s.why : s.sub) + '</div>' +
             '</div>';
    }).join("") + '</div>';
  }

  var meId = null;
  var lastRows = [];
  function paintMine() {
    var mine = meId
      ? lastRows.filter(function (r) { return String(r.id) === String(meId); })[0]
      : null;
    // A missing staff rollup row must not erase identity from the own-portal read.
    // These reads complete independently; clients cannot read the staff rollup.
    if (mine && mine.tracking_id) applyCode(mine.tracking_id);
    return mine;
  }
  var t;
  try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { t = ""; }
  fetch("/api/auth/session", { headers: t ? { authorization: "Bearer " + t } : {} })
    .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
    .then(function (d) {
      if (!(d && d.ok && d.staff)) return;
      meId = d.staff.affiliate_id || null;
      var name = String(d.staff.name || "").trim();
      var who = document.getElementById("affWho");
      var chip = document.getElementById("affWhoChip");
      if (name && who && chip) {
        who.textContent = name;
        chip.style.display = "";
      }
      paintMine();
    })
    .catch(function () {});

  // data.js carries `defer` (see its tag above), so FHData does not exist yet
  // while this script is being parsed — calling it here threw, and the throw
  // killed the rest of this function before the affiliate figures were ever
  // requested. Every deferred script runs before DOMContentLoaded, so the
  // first read waits for that event.
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  FHData.wire(FHData.affiliates({ limit: 200 }), "affiliate figures", function (data) {
    lastRows = data.items || [];
    var mine = paintMine();

    if (mine && mine.license_signed === false) {
      var banner = document.getElementById("licenseBanner");
      var chip = document.getElementById("affLicenseChip");
      if (banner) banner.style.display = "";
      if (chip) chip.style.display = "";
    }

    if (!lastRows.length) return "no affiliate rows · No code yet";
    if (!mine) return "affiliate roster loaded · no code for this session";

    var owed = Number(mine.balance_due || 0);
    set("kOwed", usd(owed));

    /* THE FOUR TILES (T10-04). Every number below comes from this row and from
       nothing else — never from LEADS or PAYOUTS, which are still empty arrays
       nothing fetches. Where a number genuinely cannot be known the tile keeps
       its dash and says why: a dash with a reason beats a zero that lies. */
    var referred  = num(mine.referred_count);
    var untracked = num(mine.referred_untracked);
    var converted = num(mine.converted_count);
    var unrated   = num(mine.unrated_converted_count);
    var clicks    = num(mine.clicks_count);
    var clicks30  = num(mine.clicks_30d);
    var paidTotal = num(mine.paid_total);
    var paidRuns  = num(mine.paid_runs);

    /* TRACKED — the referrals whose outcome is actually knowable. A tracked
       referral has a referral record, so the system can see whether that person
       ever paid. An UNTRACKED one is just a code left on the client's record by
       the live capture; nothing follows it, so nobody knows what happened.

       If either half is missing, TRACKED is unknown — deliberately null, not
       the full referred count. `num(...) || 0` used to sit on the line above:
       a missing untracked count became 0, every untracked referral silently
       looked tracked, and the denominator below quietly grew to include people
       whose outcome nobody knows. That is the zero-that-lies this file exists
       to stop, three lines under the comment forbidding it. */
    var tracked = (referred === null || untracked === null)
      ? null
      : referred - untracked;

    // REFERRED — both attribution sources, de-duplicated, counted server side.
    if (referred === null) {
      set("kRef", "—");
      set("kRefNote", "referral counting did not answer this time");
    } else {
      set("kRef", String(referred));
      set("kRefNote", (referred === 1 ? "lifetime lead" : "lifetime leads") +
                      " attributed to your code");
    }

    /* CONVERTED — referrals that paid a qualifying product.

       An UNRATED conversion is a real conversion whose money is not calculated:
       no commission rate is in force, so commission_due is NULL. It is counted
       here as converted and its money is counted nowhere. It is never a zero.

       UNTRACKED referrals are people the live capture recorded on the client
       record but who have no referral row, so nobody knows whether they
       converted. They are excluded from the rate and named, rather than
       silently treated as "did not convert".

       THE ZERO THAT WAS NOT A MEASUREMENT. When every referral is untracked,
       the count of conversions is 0 for the only reason it could be: nothing is
       watching. Printing that 0 in the big number told an affiliate "nobody you
       sent has paid", which this screen has no way to know and which is often
       simply false. So that case shows a dash and says, in plain words, that
       nobody is tracking those referrals. A dash with a reason beats a zero
       that lies. Do not put a number back here. */
    if (converted === null || referred === null) {
      set("kConv", "—");
      set("kConvRate", "referrals that paid a qualifying product");
    } else if (referred === 0) {
      // A true zero: there is nothing yet that could have converted.
      set("kConv", "0");
      set("kConvRate", "no referrals yet");
    } else if (tracked === null) {
      // The count is real; the share it represents is not knowable right now.
      set("kConv", String(converted));
      set("kConvRate", "we cannot work out what share of your referrals this is right now");
    } else if (tracked === 0) {
      set("kConv", "—");
      set("kConvRate", "we cannot tell yet · none of your " + referred +
                       (referred === 1 ? " referral is" : " referrals are") +
                       " being tracked, so nobody knows who paid");
    } else {
      set("kConv", String(converted));
      // The SAME denominator paintFunnel uses. Change one, change both.
      var note = Math.round((converted / tracked) * 100) + "% of " + tracked +
                 (tracked === 1 ? " tracked referral" : " tracked referrals");
      if (untracked > 0) {
        note += " · " + untracked + " more not tracked here";
      }
      if (unrated !== null && unrated > 0) {
        note += " · " + unrated + " with no rate set";
      }
      set("kConvRate", note);
    }

    // OWED — 033's rollup. It skips unrated conversions entirely, so say so
    // rather than letting the number look like the whole story. If the unrated
    // count itself did not arrive, the tile keeps its plain caption: an unknown
    // is not evidence that every conversion has a rate.
    if (unrated !== null && unrated > 0) {
      set("kOwedNote", "accrued, not yet paid · " + unrated +
                       (unrated === 1 ? " conversion has" : " conversions have") +
                       " no rate set, so nothing accrued for " +
                       (unrated === 1 ? "it" : "them"));
    }

    /* PAID — settled payout runs only. This one IS a real zero when it is zero:
       payout lines carry a NOT NULL amount, so the total is always computable.
       paid_runs is what lets the tile say WHY the zero is a zero. */
    if (paidTotal === null || paidRuns === null) {
      set("kPaid", "—");
      set("kPaidNote", "payout history did not answer this time");
    } else if (paidRuns === 0) {
      set("kPaid", usd(0));
      set("kPaidNote", "no payout run has settled yet");
    } else {
      set("kPaid", usd(paidTotal));
      set("kPaidNote", "lifetime · " + paidRuns +
                       (paidRuns === 1 ? " settled payout run" : " settled payout runs"));
    }

    /* CLICKS 30D — still honestly empty, and here is why.

       Clicks are recorded by /api/public/affiliate-click, and the only thing
       that would call it is public/start.html, which today writes the code to
       localStorage and redirects to apply.fundhub.ai without touching a server.
       That one line is a board request and is not in this change. So zero
       recorded clicks means "nothing records clicks", NOT "nobody clicked", and
       printing 0 would be the same lie this screen just stopped telling.
       The moment a real click lands, the number appears. */
    if (clicks !== null && clicks > 0) {
      set("affClicks", String(clicks30 === null ? clicks : clicks30));
      set("affClicksNote", "last 30 days · " + clicks + " lifetime");
    }

    paintFunnel(clicks, referred, converted, tracked);

    return "live affiliate code · " + (mine.tracking_id || "No code yet") +
           " · " + usd(owed) + " accrued";
  });
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var form = document.getElementById("brainForm");
  if (!form) return;
  var esc = function (v) {
    return String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;" }[c]; });
  };
  function token() { try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; } }
  function isDemo() { try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_demo") === "1"; } catch (e) { return false; } }
  form.addEventListener("submit", function (ev) {
    ev.preventDefault();
    var q = String(document.getElementById("brainQ").value || "").trim();
    var status = document.getElementById("brainStatus");
    var answer = document.getElementById("brainAnswer");
    var sources = document.getElementById("brainSources");
    var btn = document.getElementById("brainBtn");
    if (!q) { status.textContent = "Type a question first."; return; }
    if (isDemo()) { status.textContent = "Demo session — partner docs not loaded."; return; }
    btn.disabled = true;
    status.textContent = "Searching approved docs…";
    answer.style.display = "none";
    sources.textContent = "";
    var t = token();
    fetch("/api/read/company-brain-affiliate", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "content-type": "application/json",
        accept: "application/json",
        authorization: t ? ("Bearer " + t) : ""
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ question: q })
    }).then(function (res) {
      return res.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (j) {
        j._status = res.status; return j;
      });
    }).then(function (j) {
      btn.disabled = false;
      if (!j.ok) {
        status.textContent = "Could not answer — " + (j.error || ("HTTP " + j._status));
        return;
      }
      status.textContent = "Answer ready (allowlist only)";
      answer.style.display = "";
      answer.textContent = (j.answer && j.answer.text) || "";
      var list = j.sources || [];
      sources.innerHTML = list.length
        ? list.map(function (s) {
            var link = s.webViewLink
              ? ('<a href="' + esc(s.webViewLink) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a>')
              : "";
            return '<div style="padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)">[' +
              esc(s.n) + "] " + esc(s.fileName) + (link ? (" · " + link) : "") + "</div>";
          }).join("")
        : "No approved partner docs matched.";
    }).catch(function (e) {
      btn.disabled = false;
      status.textContent = "Offline — " + ((e && e.message) || "error");
    });
  });
})();

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var btn = document.getElementById("blasterBtn");
  if (!btn) return;
  var status = document.getElementById("blasterStatus");
  function token() { try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; } }
  function isDemo() { try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_demo") === "1"; } catch (e) { return false; } }
  btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (isDemo()) { if (status) status.textContent = "Demo session — download not available."; return; }
    var t = token();
    if (!t) { if (status) status.textContent = "Sign in to download."; return; }
    btn.disabled = true;
    if (status) status.textContent = "Preparing download…";
    fetch("/api/gifts/message-blaster", {
      headers: { authorization: "Bearer " + t, accept: "application/x-apple-diskimage" }
    }).then(function (res) {
      if (!res.ok) {
        return res.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (j) {
          throw new Error(j.error || ("HTTP " + res.status));
        });
      }
      return res.blob();
    }).then(function (blob) {
      var a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = "MessageBlaster.dmg";
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      if (status) status.textContent = "Download started — open the file on your Mac.";
    }).catch(function (e) {
      if (status) status.textContent = "Could not download — " + ((e && e.message) || "error");
    }).finally(function () { btn.disabled = false; });
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   THE REFERRALS AND PAYOUTS TABLES, FILLED IN AT LAST.

   `var LEADS=[]` (further up this file) and `var PAYOUTS=[]` were declared when
   this screen was written and assigned by nothing, so both tables have read "No
   referrals on file" for every affiliate since the day they shipped. No endpoint
   returned affiliate_referrals or affiliate_payouts rows to the person they
   belong to — /api/read/affiliates answers STAFF with per-affiliate counts,
   which is a different question with a different gate.

   /api/read/affiliate-portal is the read those two arrays were waiting for. It
   returns ONE affiliate's own rows and pins a non-staff caller to themselves.

   IT RUNS FOR TWO KINDS OF PERSON. An affiliate, and a CLIENT who pressed
   "Refer a friend" in their portal and became a light affiliate — owner-set,
   ops/workflows/portal-rebuild-plan.md section 4. Both hold an account session
   token in localStorage, so both are served by the same request.

   IT IS DELIBERATELY SEPARATE FROM THE BLOCK ABOVE. That one reads
   /api/read/affiliates through FHData for the four KPI tiles and needs a staff
   session; this one needs the caller's own token and must keep working when
   that block finds no session at all. Neither depends on the other having run.

   NOTHING HERE COMPUTES MONEY. commissionText() further up already refuses to
   multiply, and the rule it states holds for this block too: a commission the
   ledger has not calculated arrives as null and prints as a dash, never $0.00.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var byId = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var setText = function (id, v) { var el = byId(id); if (el) el.textContent = v; };

  function token() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; }
  }

  /* A date for a table cell. Null survives as an empty cell — never today's
     date, never a dash that looks like a value. */
  function day(iso) {
    if (!iso) return "";
    var d = new Date(iso);
    return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? "" : d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }

  /* affiliate_referrals.status → the word an affiliate reads. Four values, and
     they are the four the CHECK constraint allows (033_affiliates.sql:340-343),
     so there is no fifth case to invent a label for.
       attributed — credited, the person has not paid for anything yet
       converted  — they paid; commission_due is set if a rule was in force
       paid       — settled by a payout run
       void       — disqualified or clawed back */
  var STATUS_WORD = {
    attributed: "Referred",
    converted: "Converted",
    paid: "Paid",
    void: "Void"
  };

  /* Whether THIS row's money has been settled. Deliberately three states and not
     two: a row that has not converted has no commission to be accrued or paid,
     and calling that "Accrued" would put a number in a column that has none. */
  function payState(r) {
    if (r.status === "paid") return "Paid";
    if (r.status === "void") return "—";
    if (r.commissionDue === null || r.commissionDue === undefined) return "—";
    return "Accrued";
  }

  /* affiliate_payouts.status → the word on the badge. */
  var PAYOUT_WORD = {
    pending: "Scheduled",
    held: "Held",
    processing: "Processing",
    paid: "Paid",
    void: "Void"
  };

  function paintRate(rates) {
    var r = rates && rates.direct;
    if (!r || !r.rules || !r.rules.length) {
      setText("affRate", "—");
      setText("affRateNote", "no live rate is set for your account");
      return;
    }
    /* ONE NUMBER ONLY WHEN THERE IS ONE. The endpoint fills in `percent` only
       when every live rule for the tier agrees; when two products pay different
       rates it sends the spread instead and this shows the spread. Picking one
       of them would be this page inventing a rate, which is the exact thing the
       old hardcoded "Per agreement" string was replaced to stop. */
    if (r.percent !== null && r.percent !== undefined) {
      setText("affRate", r.percent + "%");
    } else if (r.percentMin !== null && r.percentMax !== null) {
      setText("affRate", r.percentMin + "–" + r.percentMax + "%");
    } else {
      setText("affRate", "—");
      setText("affRateNote", "your rate is not a single percentage");
      return;
    }
    var down = rates.downline;
    var note = "on people you refer directly";
    if (down && down.percent !== null && down.percent !== undefined) {
      note += " · " + down.percent + "% on their referrals";
    }
    setText("affRateNote", note);
  }

  function paintGates(gates) {
    if (!gates) return;

    var lic = byId("licenseBanner");
    var licBody = byId("licenseBannerBody");
    var chip = byId("affLicenseChip");
    if (gates.license && gates.license.signed === false) {
      if (lic) lic.style.display = "";
      if (chip) chip.style.display = "";
      if (licBody) {
        licBody.textContent = gates.license.documentRef
          ? "Anything you earn stays on file until the license is signed. Your license is on record as "
            + gates.license.documentRef + " — ask us and we will send it over to sign."
          : "Anything you earn stays on file until the license is signed. We do not have a copy of your license on record, so ask us and we will send one.";
      }
    } else if (lic) {
      lic.style.display = "none";
      if (chip) chip.style.display = "none";
    }

    /* THE TAX GATE SAYS "NO RECORD", NOT "YOU DID NOT SEND IT".
       affiliates.tax_form_received_at is new and nothing writes it yet, so it is
       null for everybody today. Somebody who posted a form last year is in that
       same state, and this page has no way to tell the two apart — so it does
       not claim to. */
    var tax = byId("taxBanner");
    if (gates.tax && gates.tax.onFile === false) {
      if (tax) tax.style.display = "";
    } else if (tax) {
      tax.style.display = "none";
    }
  }

  function paintIdentity(aff) {
    if (!aff) return;
    if (aff.code) {
      setText("affCode", aff.code);
      /* The links come from the server, one per offer. This page does not
         assemble one — a link built here could drift from the one that credits. */
      paintOfferLinks(aff.offerLinks);
    }
    var name = String(aff.name || "").trim();
    var who = byId("affWho");
    var whoChip = byId("affWhoChip");
    if (name && who && whoChip) {
      who.textContent = name;
      whoChip.style.display = "";
    }
  }

  function load() {
    var t = token();
    var status = byId("affiliateLoadStatus");
    var retry = byId("affiliateRetry");
    if (retry) retry.hidden = true;
    if (!t) { status.textContent = "Sign in to see your own referrals and payouts."; return; }
    status.textContent = "Loading your referral dashboard…";

    fetch("/api/read/affiliate-portal", {
      headers: { authorization: "Bearer " + t, accept: "application/json" },
      credentials: "same-origin"
    }).then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
      return r.json();
    }).then(function (d) {
      if (!d || d.ok !== true) throw new Error("Dashboard unavailable");

      if (d.enrolled === false) {
        /* Signed in, but holding no affiliate code. A client who has not pressed
           "Refer a friend" lands here. The tables keep their empty states and the
           rate tile says why, rather than showing a rate for a programme this
           person is not in. */
        status.textContent = "You are not enrolled yet. Refer a friend from your client portal to get started.";
        setText("affRate", "—");
        setText("affRateNote", "you are not enrolled as a referrer yet");
        return;
      }

      status.textContent = "Your referral dashboard is up to date.";
      paintIdentity(d.affiliate);
      paintRate(d.rates);
      paintGates(d.gates);

      /* THE TWO ASSIGNMENTS THIS WHOLE BLOCK EXISTS FOR. */
      window.LEADS = (d.referrals || []).map(function (r) {
        return {
          d: day(r.attributedAt),
          biz: r.name || "—",
          st: STATUS_WORD[r.status] || r.status || "Referred",
          prod: r.product || "",
          basis: r.basisAmount,
          // Passed through untouched. null means the ledger has not worked this
          // one out, and commissionText() prints a dash for it.
          commission_due: r.commissionDue,
          pay: payState(r)
        };
      });

      window.PAYOUTS = (d.payouts || []).map(function (p) {
        return {
          d: day(p.paidAt || p.periodEnd),
          per: day(p.periodStart) + " → " + day(p.periodEnd),
          n: p.lineCount,
          m: p.method || "—",
          amt: p.amount,
          st: PAYOUT_WORD[p.status] || p.status,
          why: p.holdReason || ""
        };
      });

      if (typeof renderLeads === "function") renderLeads();
      if (typeof renderPayouts === "function") renderPayouts();
    }).catch(function () {
      status.textContent = "We could not load your dashboard. Referral and payout figures are unavailable; try again.";
      if (retry) retry.hidden = false;
    });
  }

  byId("affiliateRetry").addEventListener("click", load);
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", load);
  } else {
    load();
  }
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>

function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]});}

var EVENTS=['entry.captured','survey.submitted','payment.received','payment.failed','diagnostic.paid','deposit.paid',
  'sale.closed','analysis.completed','decision.rendered','message.inbound','call.completed','mail.response','booking.created'];

function A(o){
  return Object.assign({
    chan:'SMS',cls:'Client-facing',owner:'',mode:'shadow',
    triggers:[],prompt:'',guard:'',esc:'',escAfter:'1 hour',escWhen:'',
    disc:0,msgcap:3,pay:false,contract:false,book:false,pull:false,
    g:{noamount:false,noscore:false,attorney:false,quiet:false},
    gSet:{noamount:false,noscore:false,attorney:false,quiet:false},
    runs:0,breaches:0,log:[]
  },o);
}

// AGENTS is populated from /api/read/agents by loadAgents() below. Prompt and
// guardrails come back on the read so a Save that wrote them can be painted
// after a reload. triggers / authority / flag switches live inside the
// guardrails jsonb; runs/breaches have no table yet and stay at 0 without
// blocking promote.
var AGENTS=[];

function channelLabel(ch){
  var s=String(ch||'').toLowerCase();
  if(s==='sms') return 'SMS';
  if(s==='email') return 'Email';
  if(s==='sms_email') return 'SMS';
  if(s==='voice') return 'Voice';
  return 'Internal';
}
function channelValue(label){
  var s=String(label||'').toLowerCase();
  if(s==='sms'||s==='text') return 'sms';
  if(s==='email') return 'email';
  if(s==='voice') return 'voice';
  return 'internal';
}
function classValue(label){
  return String(label||'').toLowerCase().indexOf('ops')===0 ? 'ops' : 'client_facing';
}
function guardFromRow(g){
  g = g && typeof g === 'object' ? g : {};
  var flags = g.flags || g.g || {};
  var auth = g.authority || {};
  var esc = g.escalation || {};
  return {
    block: typeof g.block === 'string' ? g.block : (typeof g.text === 'string' ? g.text : ''),
    triggers: Array.isArray(g.triggers) ? g.triggers.slice() : [],
    esc: esc.path || g.esc || '',
    escAfter: esc.after || g.escAfter || '3',
    escWhen: esc.when || g.escWhen || '',
    disc: auth.disc != null ? Number(auth.disc) : (g.disc != null ? Number(g.disc) : 0),
    msgcap: auth.msgcap != null ? Number(auth.msgcap) : (g.msgcap != null ? Number(g.msgcap) : 3),
    pay: !!(auth.pay != null ? auth.pay : g.pay),
    contract: !!(auth.contract != null ? auth.contract : g.contract),
    book: !!(auth.book != null ? auth.book : g.book),
    pull: !!(auth.pull != null ? auth.pull : g.pull),
    /* Only a stored true is on. `!== false` used to paint all four switches on
       for an agent with nothing stored, which read as "guarded" when the row
       held no guardrails at all. Unset is unset — gSet says which ones the
       database actually holds so the screen can label the rest NOT SET. */
    g: {
      noamount: flags.noamount === true,
      noscore: flags.noscore === true,
      attorney: flags.attorney === true,
      quiet: flags.quiet === true
    },
    gSet: {
      noamount: typeof flags.noamount === 'boolean',
      noscore: typeof flags.noscore === 'boolean',
      attorney: typeof flags.attorney === 'boolean',
      quiet: typeof flags.quiet === 'boolean'
    }
  };
}
function guardrailsPayload(a){
  return {
    block: a.guard || '',
    triggers: (a.triggers || []).slice(),
    escalation: { path: a.esc || '', after: a.escAfter || '', when: a.escWhen || '' },
    authority: {
      disc: a.disc || 0, msgcap: a.msgcap || 0,
      pay: !!a.pay, contract: !!a.contract, book: !!a.book, pull: !!a.pull
    },
    flags: a.g || {}
  };
}

function agentFromRow(real){
  var g = guardFromRow(real.guardrails);
  return A({
    id: real.code,
    name: real.name || real.code,
    chan: channelLabel(real.channel),
    cls: real.agent_class === 'ops' ? 'Ops' : 'Client-facing',
    owner: real.owner_label || '',
    /* 'retired' used to fall through to 'draft', so the eight CRM
       agents cancelled on 2026-08-15 painted as editable drafts and were
       counted as drafts in the header. api/agents.mjs:191-196 answers 409 for
       every one of them, so the screen was offering an edit the server always
       refuses. */
    mode: real.status === 'live' ? 'live'
        : real.status === 'shadow' ? 'shadow'
        : real.status === 'retired' ? 'retired' : 'draft',
    runtime: real.runtime || null,
    runtimeRef: real.runtime_ref || null,
    runtimeNotes: real.runtime_notes || '',
    /* Two stores hold triggers and neither was authoritative: the editor writes
       guardrails.triggers, while 114_ghl_agent_seed.sql wrote agents.trigger_events
       and no screen ever read it. Prefer what the editor wrote; fall back to the
       seeded column so a row with real triggers stops reporting "no trig". */
    triggerEvents: Array.isArray(real.trigger_events) ? real.trigger_events.slice() : [],
    prompt: real.prompt || '',
    guard: g.block,
    triggers: g.triggers,
    esc: g.esc, escAfter: g.escAfter, escWhen: g.escWhen,
    disc: g.disc, msgcap: g.msgcap,
    pay: g.pay, contract: g.contract, book: g.book, pull: g.pull,
    g: g.g,
    gSet: g.gSet,
    promptMissing: !!real.prompt_missing,
    guardMissing: !!real.guardrails_missing,
    // No agent_runs table yet — do not invent counters or block promote on them.
    runsTracked: false,
    runs: 0,
    breaches: 0,
    log: []
  });
}

var cur=null, dirty=false, SAVED={};
function cloneAgent(a){ return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(a)); }
function rememberSaved(a){ if(a && a.id) SAVED[a.id]=cloneAgent(a); }

/* ══ LIST ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function modeDot(m){
  if(m==='live') return 'var(--ok)';
  if(m==='retired') return 'var(--gray2)';
  return 'var(--accent)';
}
/* What this agent is actually woken by, from whichever store holds it. */
function effTriggers(a){
  var t=(a&&a.triggers)||[];
  if(t.length) return t;
  return (a&&a.triggerEvents)||[];
}
function renderList(){
  var groups=[['Client-facing','AE-A / CLIENT-FACING'],['Ops','AE-B / OPS']];
  document.getElementById('alist').innerHTML=groups.map(function(g){
    var items=AGENTS.filter(function(a){return a.cls===g[0]});
    return '<div class="agrp">'+g[1]+'</div>'+items.map(function(a){
      /* name, mode and trigger count — the three facts you scan the list for.
         The agent code moves to the row's hover title; it is on the Identity
         card inside the config. */
      var n=effTriggers(a).length;
      return '<div class="aitem '+(cur&&a.id===cur.id?'on':'')+'" data-a="'+a.id+'" title="'+a.id+'">'+
        '<span class="dot" style="background:'+modeDot(a.mode)+'"></span>'+
        '<span class="an">'+esc(a.name)+'</span>'+
        '<span class="ast '+a.mode+'">'+a.mode+'</span>'+
        '<span class="atr'+(n?'':' none')+'">'+(n?n+' trig':'no trig')+'</span></div>';
    }).join('');
  }).join('');
  document.querySelectorAll('.aitem').forEach(function(el){
    el.addEventListener('click',function(){
      if(dirty && !confirm('You have unsaved changes on '+cur.name+'. Discard them?')) return;
      select(el.dataset.a);
    });
  });
}

/* ══ FORM ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderEvents(){
  document.getElementById('evGrid').innerHTML=EVENTS.map(function(e){
    var on=cur.triggers.indexOf(e)>=0;
    return '<button class="ev '+(on?'on':'')+'" data-e="'+e+'"><span class="box">✓</span><span class="en">'+e+'</span></button>';
  }).join('');
  document.querySelectorAll('.ev').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var e=b.dataset.e, i=cur.triggers.indexOf(e);
      if(i>=0) cur.triggers.splice(i,1); else cur.triggers.push(e);
      markDirty(); renderEvents(); renderGate();
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('trigCount').textContent=cur.triggers.length+' SELECTED';
}
function setSw(id,on){document.getElementById(id).classList.toggle('on',!!on)}
function getSw(id){return document.getElementById(id).classList.contains('on')}
/* Label every guardrail flag the database does not hold. Off-and-NOT-SET means
   nobody has decided; off with no tag means a human turned it off and saved.
   THE TAG SAYS "ON BY DEFAULT" BECAUSE THAT IS WHAT HAPPENS. This screen paints
   an unset flag as off (guardFromRow, `=== true`) so it does not claim a guard
   nobody chose. The engine that enforces it reads the same unset flag as ON
   (src/agents/guardrails.mjs:60-64, `!== false`) so an unwritten rule still
   protects the client. Both are the safe choice on their own side; showing a
   plain "NOT SET" next to an off switch let a human conclude the rule was not
   being applied, when for text replies it is. */
function setUnset(gSet){
  var s=gSet||{};
  ['noamount','noscore','attorney','quiet'].forEach(function(k){
    var el=document.getElementById('u_'+k);
    if(el) el.classList.toggle('show', s[k]!==true);
  });
}

function renderLog(){
  var l=cur.log||[];
  document.getElementById('shadowLog').innerHTML=l.length?l.map(function(r){
    var blocked=/^BLOCKED|^HELD/.test(r.o);
    return '<div class="srun"><span class="st">'+r.t+'</span><div class="sb">'+
      '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap"><strong style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+esc(r.c)+'</strong>'+
      (blocked?'<span class="badge b-alert">Guardrail</span>':(cur.mode==='live'?'<span class="badge b-ok">Sent</span>':'<span class="badge b-accent">Shadow</span>'))+'</div>'+
      '<div class="so">'+esc(r.o)+'</div></div></div>';
  }).join(''):'<div style="padding:22px 16px;text-align:center;color:var(--gray2);font-size:var(--fs-body)">No runs recorded yet.</div>';
}

/* promotion gate — a real checklist that blocks */
function gateChecks(){
  var checks=[
    {t:'Has at least one trigger event',      ok:effTriggers(cur).length>0, v:effTriggers(cur).length+' selected'},
    {t:'Prompt is written',                   ok:cur.prompt.trim().length>=60, v:cur.prompt.trim().length+' chars · 60 min'},
    {t:'Guardrail block is not empty',        ok:cur.guard.trim().length>=20, v:cur.guard.trim().length+' chars · 20 min'},
    {t:'Escalation path is set',              ok:!!cur.esc, v:cur.esc||'none'}
  ];
  // Shadow-run counters have no source in the database yet. Show them as
  // informational, never as a hard block — inventing a pass/fail from zero
  // would either lock every agent forever or lie that sample numbers are real.
  if(cur.runsTracked){
    checks.push(
      {t:'At least 25 shadow runs',           ok:cur.runs>=25, v:cur.runs+' runs'},
      {t:'Zero guardrail breaches in shadow', ok:cur.breaches===0, v:cur.breaches+' breaches'}
    );
  }else{
    checks.push(
      {t:'Shadow-run counter', ok:true, v:'no source yet · not blocking'},
      {t:'Breach counter',     ok:true, v:'no source yet · not blocking'}
    );
  }
  return checks;
}
function renderGate(){
  var live=cur.mode==='live', retired=cur.mode==='retired';
  var card=document.getElementById('modeCard');
  card.className='mode '+(live?'live':'shadow');
  document.getElementById('modeTitle').textContent=
    retired?'RETIRED':(live?'LIVE':(cur.mode==='shadow'?'SHADOW':'DRAFT'));

  /* WHAT THIS AGENT CAN ACTUALLY DO, IN THE WORDS OF THE THING THAT WOULD DO IT.
     A green LIVE badge over "acting on real clients" was true of nothing: AG-04
     and AG-09 were seeded live in July with no prompt and have never spoken to
     anyone. The two sentences below are the only ones this screen can honestly
     print, and which one it prints is decided by the same rules the runtime uses.

       - runtime 'bland' is a PHONE agent. src/agents/select.mjs:34 excludes it
         from the text-reply runtime on purpose (owner-set, 144_agent_runtime.sql).
         It can only ever act through a call placed at /api/agent-call.
       - runtime 'ghl' was cancelled by the owner on 2026-08-15. */
  var sub;
  if(retired){
    sub='Retired. It cannot be edited, promoted or run. Kept as a record of what it used to say.';
  }else if(cur.runtime==='ghl'){
    sub='The CRM was cancelled on 15 August 2026. This agent cannot run.';
  }else if(cur.runtime==='bland'){
    sub=live
      ? 'Live on the phone. It only speaks when someone starts a call for it — it never answers texts or email.'
      : 'A phone agent. It cannot run until it is promoted, and it never answers texts or email.';
  }else if(cur.id==='OP-06' && live){
    sub='Staff can start a drill on this page. It does not talk to buyers.';
  }else if(live){
    sub='Acting on real clients on '+cur.chan+'. '+cur.runs.toLocaleString()+' runs.';
  }else if(cur.mode==='shadow'){
    sub='Runs on every trigger and logs what it would send. Nothing leaves the building.';
  }else{
    sub='A draft. It does not run. Write its prompt and guardrails, then promote it.';
  }
  document.getElementById('modeSub').textContent=sub;
  var checks=gateChecks(), allOk=checks.every(function(c){return c.ok});
  document.getElementById('gateBox').innerHTML=
    '<div class="eyebrow" style="margin-bottom:8px">PROMOTION GATE</div>'+
    checks.map(function(c){
      return '<div class="gaterow '+(c.ok?'pass':'fail')+'"><span class="gi">'+(c.ok?'●':'○')+'</span>'+
        '<span class="gt">'+esc(c.t)+'</span><span class="gv">'+esc(c.v)+'</span></div>';
    }).join('')+
    (allOk?'':'<div style="margin-top:9px;font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:#6E2A22">Promotion is blocked until every check passes.</div>');
  var pb=document.getElementById('promoteBtn'), db=document.getElementById('demoteBtn');
  /* Retired hides BOTH. api/agents.mjs:191-196 answers 409 'retired' for save,
     promote and demote alike, so every one of these buttons could only ever
     produce an error alert. A control that cannot succeed does not render. */
  pb.style.display=(live||retired)?'none':''; db.style.display=(live&&!retired)?'':'none';
  pb.disabled=!allOk;
  var sb=document.getElementById('saveBtn');
  if(sb){ sb.disabled=retired; sb.title=retired?'Retired agents cannot be edited.':''; }
  renderStats();
  renderDrill();
}
function renderStats(){
  document.getElementById('kAll').textContent=AGENTS.length;
  var lv=AGENTS.filter(function(a){return a.mode==='live'}).length;
  /* Count shadow as shadow, not "everything not live" — a draft counted there
     would claim an agent is running when it is not, and would contradict the
     banner and the list on the same screen. */
  var sh=AGENTS.filter(function(a){return a.mode==='shadow'}).length;
  /* Retired counted separately. It used to fall into `dr` because dr was
     "everything left over", so eight cancelled agents were reported as drafts
     somebody could still pick up. */
  var rt=AGENTS.filter(function(a){return a.mode==='retired'}).length;
  var dr=AGENTS.length-lv-sh-rt;
  var cf=AGENTS.filter(function(a){return a.cls==='Client-facing'}).length;
  document.getElementById('kAllSub').textContent=
    AGENTS.length ? (cf+' client-facing · '+(AGENTS.length-cf)+' ops') : 'registry is empty';
  document.getElementById('kLive').textContent=lv;
  document.getElementById('kShadow').textContent=sh;
  document.getElementById('kBreach').textContent=AGENTS.reduce(function(a,x){return a+x.breaches},0);
  document.getElementById('liveTxt').textContent=
    lv+' live · '+sh+' shadow'+(dr?' · '+dr+' draft':'')+(rt?' · '+rt+' retired':'');
}

/* switching agents refolds the secondary sections — the config opens on what
   this agent may do, not on wherever the last agent was left scrolled */
function foldSections(){ document.querySelectorAll('details.card').forEach(function(d){d.open=false}); }

/* Select helpers: stored guardrails may use codes ("owner", "3") that are not
   options in the UI. Setting .value to a missing option clears the control in
   the browser; collect() then blanked the model and blocked Promote with no
   useful signal. Snap to the first option and keep the model in sync. */
function setSelectOrFirst(id, val){
  var el=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!el) return '';
  el.value=val==null?'':String(val);
  if(el.options && el.options.length && el.value!==String(val||'')){
    el.selectedIndex=0;
  }
  return el.value;
}

function select(id){
  cur=AGENTS.filter(function(a){return a.id===id})[0];
  foldSections();
  document.getElementById('a_name').value=cur.name;
  document.getElementById('a_chan').value=cur.chan;
  document.getElementById('a_class').value=cur.cls;
  cur.owner=setSelectOrFirst('a_owner', cur.owner);
  document.getElementById('a_code').value=cur.id;
  var rt=document.getElementById('a_runtime');
  if(rt){
    var RT={bland:'Bland (phone)',ghl:'The CRM — cancelled',internal:'Fundhub itself',
            vercel:'Vercel',inngest:'Inngest',netlify:'Netlify'};
    rt.value=cur.runtime
      ? (RT[cur.runtime]||cur.runtime)+(cur.runtimeRef?' · '+cur.runtimeRef:'')
      : 'Not deployed anywhere';
    rt.title=cur.runtimeNotes||'';
  }
  document.getElementById('a_prompt').value=cur.prompt;
  document.getElementById('a_guard').value=cur.guard;
  cur.esc=setSelectOrFirst('a_esc', cur.esc);
  cur.escAfter=setSelectOrFirst('a_escafter', cur.escAfter);
  document.getElementById('a_escwhen').value=cur.escWhen;
  document.getElementById('a_disc').value=cur.disc;
  document.getElementById('a_msgcap').value=cur.msgcap;
  setSw('l_pay',cur.pay); setSw('l_contract',cur.contract); setSw('l_book',cur.book); setSw('l_pull',cur.pull);
  setSw('g_noamount',cur.g.noamount); setSw('g_noscore',cur.g.noscore);
  setSw('g_attorney',cur.g.attorney); setSw('g_quiet',cur.g.quiet);
  setUnset(cur.gSet);
  dirty=false; document.getElementById('saveNote').textContent='';
  renderList(); renderEvents(); renderGate(); renderLog(); syncLens();
  loadShadowLog(cur.id);
  resetDrill();
}
function loadShadowLog(code){
  if(typeof FHData === 'undefined' || !FHData.read){ renderLog(); return; }
  FHData.read('agent-shadow-log', { code: code, limit: 40 }).then(function(res){
    if(!cur || cur.id !== code) return;
    if(res && res.ok && res.data){
      cur.log = res.data.log || [];
      cur.runs = (res.data.rows || []).length;
      cur.runsTracked = true;
    } else {
      cur.log = [];
    }
    renderLog();
  });
}
function markDirty(){dirty=true;document.getElementById('saveNote').textContent='UNSAVED CHANGES'}
function syncLens(){
  document.getElementById('promptLen').textContent=document.getElementById('a_prompt').value.length+' CHARS';
  var g=document.getElementById('a_guard').value.trim().length;
  var gs=document.getElementById('guardState');
  gs.textContent=g>=20?'SET':'REQUIRED';
  gs.className='badge '+(g>=20?'b-ok':'b-alert');
}

/* read form back into the model */
function collect(){
  cur.name=document.getElementById('a_name').value.trim()||cur.name;
  cur.chan=document.getElementById('a_chan').value;
  cur.cls=document.getElementById('a_class').value;
  cur.owner=document.getElementById('a_owner').value;
  cur.prompt=document.getElementById('a_prompt').value;
  cur.guard=document.getElementById('a_guard').value;
  cur.esc=document.getElementById('a_esc').value;
  cur.escAfter=document.getElementById('a_escafter').value;
  cur.escWhen=document.getElementById('a_escwhen').value;
  cur.disc=parseFloat(document.getElementById('a_disc').value)||0;
  cur.msgcap=parseInt(document.getElementById('a_msgcap').value,10)||0;
  cur.pay=getSw('l_pay'); cur.contract=getSw('l_contract'); cur.book=getSw('l_book'); cur.pull=getSw('l_pull');
  cur.g={noamount:getSw('g_noamount'),noscore:getSw('g_noscore'),attorney:getSw('g_attorney'),quiet:getSw('g_quiet')};
}

['a_name','a_prompt','a_guard','a_escwhen','a_disc','a_msgcap'].forEach(function(id){
  document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('input',function(){collect();markDirty();syncLens();renderGate();renderList()});
});
['a_chan','a_class','a_owner','a_esc','a_escafter'].forEach(function(id){
  document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change',function(){collect();markDirty();renderGate();renderList()});
});
document.querySelectorAll('.sw').forEach(function(s){
  s.addEventListener('click',function(){
    s.classList.toggle('on');
    // Clicking the switch is the decision — drop the NOT SET tag on that flag.
    if(cur && cur.gSet && s.id.indexOf('g_')===0){ cur.gSet[s.id.slice(2)]=true; setUnset(cur.gSet); }
    collect();markDirty();renderGate();
  });
});

function saveNote(msg){ document.getElementById('saveNote').textContent=msg||''; }
function writeFail(res, what){
  var msg=(res && (res.error || (res.data && res.data.message))) || 'request failed';
  saveNote('NOT SAVED');
  alert((what||'Could not save')+': '+msg);
}

var DRILL={turns:[], busy:false, code:null};
function canDrill(a){
  if(!a) return false;
  if(a.id==='AG-04' || a.id==='AG-09') return false;
  if(a.id!=='OP-06') return false;
  return a.mode==='live' || a.mode==='shadow';
}
function resetDrill(){
  DRILL={turns:[], busy:false, code:cur && cur.id};
  renderDrill();
}
function renderDrill(){
  var card=document.getElementById('drillCard');
  if(!card) return;
  var on=canDrill(cur);
  card.style.display=on?'':'none';
  if(!on) return;
  var log=document.getElementById('drillLog');
  var send=document.getElementById('drillSend');
  if(send) send.disabled=!!DRILL.busy;
  if(!log) return;
  if(!DRILL.turns.length){
    log.innerHTML='<div class="mono" style="color:var(--gray)">No turns yet. Send “Start D1” to begin.</div>';
    return;
  }
  log.innerHTML=DRILL.turns.map(function(t){
    return '<div class="drill-turn'+(t.role==='user'?' me':'')+'"><div class="eyebrow">'+(t.role==='user'?'YOU':'COACH')+'</div>'+esc(t.text)+'</div>';
  }).join('');
  log.scrollTop=log.scrollHeight;
}
function sendDrill(){
  if(!canDrill(cur) || DRILL.busy) return;
  var box=document.getElementById('drillIn');
  var note=document.getElementById('drillNote');
  var text=box && box.value ? String(box.value).trim() : '';
  if(!text){ if(note) note.textContent='Type something first.'; return; }
  DRILL.busy=true;
  DRILL.turns.push({role:'user', text:text});
  if(box) box.value='';
  if(note) note.textContent='Coach is answering…';
  renderDrill();
  var history=DRILL.turns.slice(0,-1);
  FHData.write('/api/agents', {
    action:'run', code:cur.id, message:text, history:history
  }).then(function(res){
    DRILL.busy=false;
    if(!res || !res.ok){
      if(note) note.textContent=(res && (res.data && res.data.message || res.error)) || 'The coach could not answer.';
      renderDrill();
      return;
    }
    var reply=(res.data && res.data.reply) || '';
    DRILL.turns.push({role:'assistant', text:reply});
    var extra='';
    if(res.data && res.data.call_samples){
      extra=' Logged calls in this turn: '+
        (res.data.call_samples.easy||0)+' easy, '+
        (res.data.call_samples.hard||0)+' hard.';
    }
    if(note) note.textContent=(res.data && res.data.banned_line) ? ('A banned line showed up. This drill is a fail.'+extra) : extra.trim();
    renderDrill();
  });
}

document.getElementById('promoteBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
  collect();
  var checks=gateChecks();
  if(!checks.every(function(c){return c.ok})){alert('Promotion blocked — not every gate check passes.');return}
  var promoteWarn = (cur.id==='OP-06')
    ? 'Staff can start drills with it on this page. It does not talk to buyers.'
    : 'It will start acting on real clients over '+cur.chan+' immediately. Its guardrail block becomes the only thing between it and a client.';
  if(!confirm('Promote '+cur.name+' to live?\n\n'+promoteWarn)) return;
  // Persist the form first so promote judges the words on screen, not a stale row.
  saveNote('SAVING…');
  FHData.write('/api/agents', {
    action:'save', code:cur.id, name:cur.name,
    channel:channelValue(cur.chan), agent_class:classValue(cur.cls),
    owner_label:cur.owner, prompt:cur.prompt, guardrails:guardrailsPayload(cur)
  }).then(function(saveRes){
    if(!saveRes || !saveRes.ok){ writeFail(saveRes, 'Could not save before promote'); return; }
    return FHData.write('/api/agents', { action:'promote', code:cur.id }).then(function(res){
      if(!res || !res.ok){ writeFail(res, 'Could not promote'); return; }
      var agent = res.data && res.data.agent;
      if(agent){
        var idx=AGENTS.indexOf(cur);
        var next=agentFromRow(agent);
        AGENTS[idx]=next; cur=next; rememberSaved(next);
      }else{ cur.mode='live'; rememberSaved(cur); }
      dirty=false; saveNote('PROMOTED');
      renderGate(); renderList(); renderLog();
      setTimeout(function(){if(!dirty)saveNote('');},2200);
    });
  });
});
document.getElementById('demoteBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
  // Taking an agent off real clients is a destructive change to live behavior:
  // name what stops before it stops. Promote already confirms; this now matches.
  if(!confirm('Return '+cur.name+' to shadow?\n\nIt stops acting on real clients over '+cur.chan+' immediately. From then on it only logs what it would have sent — nothing leaves the building.')) return;
  FHData.write('/api/agents', { action:'demote', code:cur.id }).then(function(res){
    if(!res || !res.ok){ writeFail(res, 'Could not demote'); return; }
    var agent = res.data && res.data.agent;
    if(agent){
      var idx=AGENTS.indexOf(cur);
      var next=agentFromRow(agent);
      AGENTS[idx]=next; cur=next; rememberSaved(next);
    }else{ cur.mode='shadow'; rememberSaved(cur); }
    dirty=false; saveNote('DEMOTED');
    renderGate(); renderList(); renderLog();
    setTimeout(function(){if(!dirty)saveNote('');},2200);
  });
});
document.getElementById('saveBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
  collect();
  if(!cur.name){alert('Agent name is required.');return}
  saveNote('SAVING…');
  FHData.write('/api/agents', {
    action:'save', code:cur.id, name:cur.name,
    channel:channelValue(cur.chan), agent_class:classValue(cur.cls),
    owner_label:cur.owner, prompt:cur.prompt, guardrails:guardrailsPayload(cur)
  }).then(function(res){
    if(!res || !res.ok){ writeFail(res, 'Could not save'); return; }
    var agent = res.data && res.data.agent;
    if(agent){
      var idx=AGENTS.indexOf(cur);
      var next=agentFromRow(agent);
      AGENTS[idx]=next; cur=next; rememberSaved(next); select(cur.id);
    }
    dirty=false; saveNote('SAVED');
    renderList(); renderGate();
    setTimeout(function(){if(!dirty)saveNote('');},2200);
  });
});
document.getElementById('revertBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
  if(!cur) return;
  var snap=SAVED[cur.id];
  if(snap){
    var next=cloneAgent(snap);
    var idx=-1;
    for(var i=0;i<AGENTS.length;i++){ if(AGENTS[i].id===cur.id){ idx=i; break; } }
    if(idx>=0) AGENTS[idx]=next;
    cur=next;
  }
  select(cur.id);
});
document.getElementById('drillSend').addEventListener('click', sendDrill);
document.getElementById('drillReset').addEventListener('click', resetDrill);
document.getElementById('drillIn').addEventListener('keydown', function(ev){
  if(ev.key==='Enter' && !ev.shiftKey){ ev.preventDefault(); sendDrill(); }
});
document.getElementById('newBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
  var name = window.prompt('Name this agent');
  if (!name || !String(name).trim()) return;
  saveNote('CREATING…');
  FHData.write('/api/agents', {
    action:'create', name:String(name).trim(), channel:'internal', agent_class:'client_facing'
  }).then(function(res){
    if(!res || !res.ok){ writeFail(res, 'Could not create agent'); return; }
    var agent = res.data && res.data.agent;
    if(!agent){ writeFail({error:'no agent in response'}, 'Could not create agent'); return; }
    var a=agentFromRow(agent);
    AGENTS.push(a); rememberSaved(a); hideEmpty(); select(a.id);
    document.querySelectorAll('details.card').forEach(function(d){d.open=true});
    document.getElementById('a_name').focus();
    dirty=false; saveNote('CREATED');
    setTimeout(function(){if(!dirty)saveNote('');},2200);
  });
});

function showEmpty(msg){
  document.getElementById('layoutRoot').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('emptyStateMsg').textContent=msg;
  document.getElementById('emptyState').style.display='';
}
function hideEmpty(){
  document.getElementById('layoutRoot').style.display='';
  document.getElementById('emptyState').style.display='none';
}

<script defer src="data.js"></script>
<script>

/* Agent Editor's list is the registry, full stop — no sample agents padded
   in alongside it. AGENTS starts empty (see agentFromRow() above) and is
   populated only from what /api/read/agents actually returns; a registry
   with two rows shows two rows, and a registry with zero rows shows the
   empty state, not built-in sample markup. */

// data.js carries `defer` (see its tag above), so FHData does not exist yet
// while this script is being parsed — calling it here threw, and the throw
// killed the rest of this block before the staff pickers or the agent registry
// were ever requested. Every deferred script runs before DOMContentLoaded, so
// this whole block waits for that event; nothing in it needs to run sooner.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  "use strict";
  if (typeof AGENTS === "undefined" || typeof renderList !== "function") return;

  var ROLE_LABEL = {
    owner: "Owner", admin: "Admin", closer: "Closer",
    sales_manager: "Sales Manager", funding_advisor: "Funding Advisor",
    inquiry_specialist: "Inquiry Remover", setter: "Setter"
  };
  function roleLabel(r) {
    return ROLE_LABEL[r] || String(r || "").replace(/_/g, " ");
  }
  function fillPeople(rows) {
    var owner = document.getElementById("a_owner");
    var escSel = document.getElementById("a_esc");
    var ownerHtml = '<option value="">Pick a person</option>';
    var escHtml = '<option value="">Pick a person</option>';
    (rows || []).forEach(function (s) {
      var name = String(s.name || s.email || "").trim();
      if (!name) return;
      ownerHtml += '<option value="' + esc(name) + '">' + esc(name) + "</option>";
      var lab = name + " · " + roleLabel(s.role);
      escHtml += '<option value="' + esc(lab) + '">' + esc(lab) + "</option>";
    });
    if (owner) owner.innerHTML = ownerHtml;
    if (escSel) escSel.innerHTML = escHtml;
    if (typeof cur !== "undefined" && cur && typeof setSelectOrFirst === "function") {
      cur.owner = setSelectOrFirst("a_owner", cur.owner);
      cur.esc = setSelectOrFirst("a_esc", cur.esc);
    }
  }
  FHData.wire(FHData.staff({ limit: 200 }), "agent owners", function (data) {
    var rows = data.items || [];
    fillPeople(rows);
    return rows.length ? ("live staff · " + rows.length) : "no staff rows · Pick a person";
  });

  FHData.read("agents", { limit: 200 }).then(function (res) {
    if (res && res.ok) {
      var rows = (res.data && res.data.items) || [];
      AGENTS = rows.map(agentFromRow);
      AGENTS.forEach(rememberSaved);
      if (!AGENTS.length) {
        showEmpty("No agents in the registry yet.");
        FHData.banner("sample", "no agent registry rows yet", "agents");
      } else {
        hideEmpty();
        select(AGENTS[0].id);
        var live = AGENTS.filter(function (a) { return a.mode === "live"; }).length;
        var undefined_ = AGENTS.filter(function (a) {
          return (a.mode === "live" || a.mode === "shadow") &&
                 (a.promptMissing || a.guardMissing); }).length;
        FHData.banner("real", AGENTS.length + " agents · " + live + " live" +
          (undefined_ ? " · " + undefined_ + " running with no stored prompt/guardrails" : ""), "agents");
      }
    } else {
      AGENTS = [];
      showEmpty("Could not load the agent registry.");
      FHData.explain(res, "agents");
    }
    renderStats();
  });
});
</script>
