<script>
/* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Automations — wired to GET /api/read/workflows, which introspects the real
   Inngest registry (src/workflows/index.mjs's `functions` array). No row on
   this screen is hand-authored: rail, name, trigger and status all come from
   that response.

   WHAT THIS SCREEN IS ALLOWED TO SAY. It shows what STARTS a job. It cannot
   show whether a job finished, because the record of a job running lives
   inside Inngest and nothing copies it back here. Every wording choice below
   follows from that one limit.

   It used to say the opposite. The old version printed "Engine is on. 49 of 51
   workflows..." off the back of a single setting being present, and called a
   workflow "LIVE" as soon as one row existed in the events table. On
   2026-08-18 auditors fired five test events by hand and that number climbed
   from 44 to 49. Nothing had run. If you are about to add a green tick here,
   check first that something real can see the thing it is ticking.
   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
(function(){
  var main = document.getElementById('wfMain'),
      sel  = document.getElementById('rail-select'),
      attnBar = document.getElementById('attnBar'),
      footerCount = document.getElementById('wfFooterCount');

  function sum(k){ return document.querySelector('[data-sum="'+k+'"]'); }
  function esc(s){
    return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c){
      return { '&':'&amp;', '<':'&lt;', '>':'&gt;', '"':'&quot;', "'":'&#39;' }[c];
    });
  }

  function token(){
    try { return localStorage.getItem('fh_token') || ''; } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }

  function timeAgo(iso){
    if(!iso) return null;
    var ms = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();
    if(!isFinite(ms) || ms < 0) return null;
    var m = Math.floor(ms / 60000);
    if(m < 1) return 'just now';
    if(m < 60) return m + 'm ago';
    var h = Math.floor(m / 60);
    if(h < 24) return h + 'h ago';
    var dt = new Date(iso);
    if(!isFinite(dt.getTime())) return null;
    /* Arizona, not UTC — same reason as messaging.html's shortWhen. After 5pm
       here it is already tomorrow in UTC, so this dated a run a day late. */
    return dt.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', timeZone: 'America/Phoenix' });
  }

  /* Four states, and they are four different facts. None of them says a job
     worked, because nothing here can tell you that.

       scheduled          a clock job. It runs on a timer and never writes a
                          start signal, so asking when it last started is the
                          wrong question. These two used to show as "NEVER
                          TRIGGERED" forever while working fine.
       trigger_seen       a start signal was recorded at least once. That is
                          all it means.
       trigger_never_seen something can send the start signal, but none has
                          ever been recorded.
       emitter_unknown    nobody has recorded how this start signal is sent.
                          A gap in our notes, NOT a claim the job is broken.
       no_emitter         nothing in the system can send this start signal, so
                          the job can never begin. */
  function statusBadge(row){
    if(row.status === 'scheduled'){
      var when = row.schedule_plain || (row.crons || []).join(', ');
      return '<span class="toggle on" title="This job runs on a timer (' + esc(when) +
        '). Timer jobs do not leave a start signal, so this screen cannot tell you when it last ran.">' +
        '<span class="dot"></span>ON A TIMER</span>';
    }
    if(row.status === 'trigger_seen'){
      return '<span class="toggle on" title="The signal that starts this job has been recorded at least once. ' +
        'That is not the same as the job running. This screen cannot see whether it ran.">' +
        '<span class="dot"></span>SIGNAL SEEN</span>';
    }
    if(row.status === 'trigger_never_seen'){
      return '<span class="toggle off" title="Something can send the signal that starts this job, but no signal has ever been recorded.">' +
        '<span class="dot"></span>NEVER STARTED</span>';
    }
    /* An event nobody has written down is NOT an event nothing sends. Falling
       through to "NOTHING STARTS IT" would state the absolute, which is the
       same conflation this screen was rewritten to stop making. */
    if(row.status === 'emitter_unknown'){
      return '<span class="toggle paused" title="Nobody has written down how this job\'s start signal gets sent, ' +
        'so this screen cannot say. That is a gap in our notes, not proof the job is broken.">' +
        '<span class="dot"></span>NOT CHECKED</span>';
    }
    return '<span class="toggle paused" title="Nothing in the system can send the signal that starts this job.">' +
      '<span class="dot"></span>NOTHING STARTS IT</span>';
  }

  /* ── FETCH ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function load(){
    var t = token();
    var headers = t ? { accept: 'application/json', authorization: 'Bearer ' + t }
                    : { accept: 'application/json' };
    fetch('/api/read/workflows?limit=200', { headers: headers })
      .then(function(r){ return r.json().then(function(d){ return { status: r.status, body: d }; }); })
      .then(function(res){
        if(res.status === 401 || res.status === 403){
          renderError('Not signed in — sign back in to see live workflow status.');
          return;
        }
        if(!res.body || res.body.ok !== true){
          renderError('Could not load the workflow registry (' +
            ((res.body && res.body.error) || ('HTTP ' + res.status)) + ').');
          return;
        }
        render(res.body.items || [], !!res.body.hasMore);
      })
      .catch(function(e){
        renderError('Could not reach the server (' + (e && e.message ? e.message : 'network error') + ').');
      });
  }

  function renderError(msg){
    main.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-row" style="padding:14px 4px;color:var(--red);">' + esc(msg) + '</div>';
    footerCount.textContent = 'load failed';
    attnBar.className = 'attn-bar bad';
    attnBar.innerHTML = '<span class="ab-ic">⚠</span><span>' + esc(msg) + '</span>';
  }

  /* ── RENDER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function render(items, hasMore){
    var seenCount    = items.filter(function(r){ return r.status === 'trigger_seen'; }).length;
    var blockedCount = items.filter(function(r){ return r.can_start_today === false; }).length;

    sum('total').textContent = String(items.length);
    sum('blocked').innerHTML = blockedCount + '<span class="of"> of ' + items.length + '</span>';
    document.querySelector('.sum-tile.attn').classList.toggle('clear', blockedCount === 0);
    sum('live').innerHTML = seenCount + '<span class="of"> of ' + items.length + '</span>';

    footerCount.textContent = items.length + ' workflows · ' + blockedCount + " can't start" +
      (hasMore ? ' · more on the next page' : '');

    /* THE ONE SENTENCE. It is on the screen every time, in both the good and
       the bad state, because the whole point of this fix is that the owner
       stopped being told a job worked by a screen that cannot know. */
    var LIMIT_LINE = 'This page shows what STARTS a job, not whether it finished.';

    if(blockedCount){
      attnBar.className = 'attn-bar bad';
      attnBar.innerHTML = '<span class="ab-ic">⚠</span><span><b>' + blockedCount +
        ' of these ' + items.length + ' jobs cannot start at all right now.</b> ' +
        'Something they need is switched off. Open a row to see what. ' + LIMIT_LINE + '</span>';
    } else if(!seenCount){
      attnBar.className = 'attn-bar bad';
      attnBar.innerHTML = '<span class="ab-ic">⚠</span><span>No job here has ever had its start ' +
        'signal recorded. ' + LIMIT_LINE + '</span>';
    } else {
      attnBar.className = 'attn-bar good';
      attnBar.innerHTML = '<span class="ab-ic">✓</span><span>' + seenCount + ' of ' + items.length +
        ' jobs have had their start signal recorded at least once. ' + LIMIT_LINE + '</span>';
    }

    var byCategory = {};
    var order = [];
    items.forEach(function(row){
      if(!byCategory[row.category]){ byCategory[row.category] = []; order.push(row.category); }
      byCategory[row.category].push(row);
    });
    order.sort();

    main.innerHTML = '';
    if(!items.length){
      main.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-row" style="padding:14px 4px;">No workflows in the registry.</div>';
      return;
    }

    order.forEach(function(cat){
      var rows = byCategory[cat];
      var group = document.createElement('div');
      group.className = 'rail-group';
      group.dataset.rail = cat;

      var head = document.createElement('div');
      head.className = 'rail-group-head';
      head.innerHTML = '<div class="rail-group-title">' + esc(cat) + '</div>' +
        '<div class="rail-group-meta">' + rows.length + (rows.length === 1 ? ' workflow' : ' workflows') + '</div>';
      group.appendChild(head);

      var table = document.createElement('table');
      table.className = 'wf';
      table.innerHTML = '<tr><th style="width:32%;">Workflow</th><th style="width:36%;">What starts it</th>' +
        '<th style="width:16%;" title="When the signal that starts this job was last recorded. It does not mean the job itself ran.">Start Signal Last Seen</th>' +
        '<th style="width:16%;">Status</th></tr>';

      rows.forEach(function(row){
        var tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.dataset.wf = '1';
        tr.tabIndex = 0;
        tr.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

        var triggerText = row.events.length ? 'on ' + row.events.join(', ')
          : (row.crons.length ? (row.schedule_plain || ('cron ' + row.crons.join(', '))) : 'no trigger declared');
        var lastFired = timeAgo(row.last_triggered_at);

        /* A clock job leaves no start signal, so "—" in that column would read
           as "dead" when it means "wrong question". Say so instead. */
        var lastCell = row.status === 'scheduled'
          ? '<span class="wf-run-ok">runs on a timer</span>'
          : (lastFired ? '<span class="wf-run-ok">' + esc(lastFired) + '</span>' : '<span class="wf-run-ok">—</span>');

        /* The blocked line is a second fact, not a replacement for the status:
           a job can have had a start signal months ago AND be unable to get
           another one today. Both belong on the row. */
        var blockedLine = row.can_start_today === false && row.blocked_reason
          ? '<span class="wf-run-fail-detail">' + esc(row.blocked_reason) + '</span>'
          : '';

        tr.innerHTML =
          '<td class="wf-name"><span class="wfchev">▸</span>' + esc(row.name) +
            '<div class="wf-owner mono">' + esc(row.id) + '</div></td>' +
          '<td class="wf-trigger mono">' + esc(triggerText) + blockedLine + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + lastCell + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + statusBadge(row) + '</td>';
        if(row.can_start_today === false) tr.classList.add('failed');

        var steps = document.createElement('tr');
        steps.className = 'wf-steps';
        steps.hidden = true;
        var stepsTd = document.createElement('td');
        stepsTd.colSpan = 4;
        /* The open panel answers one question: what would have to happen for
           this job to start? Each way in is one line, with the switch it needs
           and whether that switch is on. This replaces a line that printed
           "engine_active — yes", which told the owner the automations were
           working and was reading one setting to say it. */
        var ways = (row.emitters || []).filter(function(e){ return e.how; });
        var waysHtml = '';
        if(row.status === 'scheduled'){
          waysHtml = '<div class="step-line"><span class="sn">1</span><span class="sb">' +
            'A timer starts it, <b>' + esc(row.schedule_plain || row.crons.join(', ')) + '</b>. ' +
            'Nobody has to do anything. A timer job leaves no record here, so this page cannot ' +
            'tell you when it last ran.</span></div>';
        } else if(!ways.length){
          waysHtml = '<div class="step-line halt"><span class="sn">✕</span><span class="sb">' +
            'Nothing in the system can start this job.</span></div>';
        } else {
          /* Four of the funding jobs listen for round.started, round.submitted,
             round.approved and round.funded, and all four share the same two
             ways in. Listing them per event printed the same two sentences
             eight times. De-duplicate on the wording, and gather the signal
             names that share it. */
          var seen = {}, uniq = [];
          ways.forEach(function(e){
            var k = e.how + '|' + (e.gate || '');
            if(seen[k]){ seen[k].events.push(e.event); return; }
            seen[k] = { how: e.how, gate: e.gate, gate_set: e.gate_set, note: e.note, events: [e.event] };
            uniq.push(seen[k]);
          });
          var notesShown = {};
          uniq.forEach(function(e, i){
            var off = e.gate_set === false;
            var note = (e.note && !notesShown[e.note]) ? (notesShown[e.note] = 1, e.note) : null;
            waysHtml += '<div class="step-line' + (off ? ' halt' : '') + '">' +
              '<span class="sn">' + (i + 1) + '</span><span class="sb">' + esc(e.how) +
              (e.gate
                ? ' <b>' + (off ? 'This one is switched off' : 'Switched on') + '</b> (setting ' + esc(e.gate) + ').'
                : ' <b>Nothing switches this one off.</b>') +
              '<br><span class="mono" style="color:var(--text-faint);">sends ' + esc(e.events.join(', ')) + '</span>' +
              (note ? '<br>' + esc(note) : '') +
              '</span></div>';
          });
        }

        stepsTd.innerHTML =
          '<div class="steps">' +
            '<div class="steps-h">What would start this job</div>' +
            waysHtml +
            '<div class="steps-h" style="margin-top:10px;">What this page cannot tell you</div>' +
            '<div class="step-line"><span class="sb">' +
              esc(row.run_records_note || 'This page shows what starts a job, not whether it finished.') +
              '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="steps-h" style="margin-top:10px;">Raw registry</div>' +
            '<div class="step-line"><span class="sb"><b>id</b> — ' + esc(row.id) + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="step-line"><span class="sb"><b>start signals it listens for</b> — ' +
              (row.events.length ? esc(row.events.join(', ')) : 'none') + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="step-line"><span class="sb"><b>timer</b> — ' +
              (row.crons.length ? esc(row.crons.join(', ')) : 'none') + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="step-line"><span class="sb"><b>start signal last recorded</b> — ' +
              (row.status === 'scheduled'
                ? 'does not apply, this job runs on a timer'
                : esc(row.last_triggered_at || 'never')) + '</span></div>' +
            '<div class="step-line"><span class="sb"><b>ways in last checked by a person</b> — ' +
              esc(row.emitters_verified_on || 'unknown') + '</span></div>' +
          '</div>';
        steps.appendChild(stepsTd);

        function toggle(){
          var open = tr.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
          tr.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'false' : 'true');
          steps.hidden = open;
        }
        tr.addEventListener('click', toggle);
        tr.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
          if(e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' '){ e.preventDefault(); toggle(); }
        });

        table.appendChild(tr);
        table.appendChild(steps);
      });

      group.appendChild(table);
      main.appendChild(group);
    });

    /* ── FILTER BY RAIL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    var ALL = 'All rails';
    sel.innerHTML = '';
    [ALL].concat(order).forEach(function(r){
      var o = document.createElement('option');
      o.value = r; o.textContent = r;
      sel.appendChild(o);
    });
    sel.onchange = function(){
      var pick = sel.value;
      [].slice.call(main.querySelectorAll('.rail-group')).forEach(function(g){
        g.hidden = !(pick === ALL || g.dataset.rail === pick);
      });
    };
  }

  load();
})();
</script>
<script>
function tickClock() {
  var el = document.querySelector(".clock");
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", {
    weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit",
    timeZone: "America/Phoenix", timeZoneName: "short"
  });
}
tickClock();
setInterval(tickClock, 1000);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
(function(){
  var KEY = "fh_org_brand";
  var FONT_LINK = document.getElementById("fontLink");

  /* Mode: org CRM (default for staff) vs partner funnel (?partner_id= or
     partner session). See docs/specs/BRAND-THEMING-SPEC.md. */
  var partnerId = null;
  try {
    var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    partnerId = params.get("partner_id");
    var acct = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("fh_account") || "null");
    if (!partnerId && acct && acct.partnerId) partnerId = acct.partnerId;
  } catch (e) {}
  /* Login never writes fh_account. A partner session carries partner_id on
     GET /api/auth/session — adopt it so Brand Studio opens in partner mode
     without a staff person pasting ?partner_id=. */
  if (!partnerId) {
    try {
      var tok = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || "";
      if (tok && tok !== "demo") {
        fetch("/api/auth/session", {
          headers: { accept: "application/json", authorization: "Bearer " + tok }
        }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return {}; }); })
          .then(function (d) {
            var id = d && d.staff && (d.staff.partner_id || d.staff.partnerId);
            if (!id) return;
            var u = new URL(location.href);
            if (u.searchParams.get("partner_id") === String(id)) return;
            u.searchParams.set("partner_id", String(id));
            location.replace(u.pathname + u.search + u.hash);
          }).catch(function () {});
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  var MODE = partnerId ? "partner" : "org";
  KEY = MODE === "partner" ? "fh_partner_brand" : "fh_org_brand";

  var FUNNELS = [
    {id:"apply",   n:"Application funnel",   d:"Hero, process, engine, options, apply form. The fundhub.ai control."},
    {id:"diag",    n:"Diagnostic funnel",    d:"Straight to the assessment offer. Lowest friction entry."},
    {id:"edu",     n:"Education funnel",     d:"Two-program structure with curriculum and enrollment."},
    {id:"aff",     n:"Affiliate recruit",    d:"Two-track partner page. Recruits under your brand."},
    {id:"book",    n:"Booking funnel",       d:"Straight to calendar. For warm and referral traffic."}
  ];

  var PRESETS = [
    ["#F2A69B","#F5CE8F","#F2E39B","#A8D8B0","#A9C6E8","#C4B3E5"],
    ["#2563EB","#3B82F6","#60A5FA","#93C5FD","#BFDBFE","#DBEAFE"],
    ["#065F46","#047857","#059669","#10B981","#34D399","#6EE7B7"],
    ["#7C2D12","#9A3412","#C2410C","#EA580C","#F97316","#FB923C"],
    ["#4C1D95","#5B21B6","#6D28D9","#7C3AED","#8B5CF6","#A78BFA"],
    ["#111827","#374151","#4B5563","#6B7280","#9CA3AF","#D1D5DB"]
  ];
  var presetIx = 0;

  var D = {
    name:"", entity:"", addr:"", email:"", logo:"",
    ink:"#0A0A0A", paper:"#FCFCFC",
    ramp:PRESETS[0].slice(),
    display:"Inter", mono:"JetBrains Mono", voice:"plain",
    domain:"", verified:false, funnels:["apply"], status:"draft"
  };

  function $(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }
  function slug(s){ return (s||"yourbrand").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"-").replace(/^-|-$/g,"").slice(0,32) || "yourbrand"; }
  function rampCss(a){ return "linear-gradient(90deg,"+a.map(function(c,i){return c+" "+Math.round(i*100/(a.length-1))+"%";}).join(",")+")"; }
  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c];}); }

  function load(){
    try { var v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||"null"); if(v) Object.assign(D, v); } catch(e){}
    /* Approval state belongs to the server alone (partner_brand.approval_status)
       and is only ever set by __fhBrandHydrateFromServer. A locally stored
       "submitted" used to survive reloads and keep the topbar chip reading
       "In review" when nothing had ever been submitted. */
    D.status = "draft";
  }
  function save(){ localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(D)); }

  function loadFonts(){
    var fams = [D.display, D.mono].map(function(f){ return f.replace(/ /g,"+")+":wght@400;500;600;700;800"; });
    FONT_LINK.href = "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family="+fams.join("&family=")+"&display=swap";
  }

  /* Org mode: write the REAL CRM variables so the sidebar and chrome update
     live. Partner mode: preview-only --p-* vars so a partner edit cannot
     recolor Fundhub staff chrome (BRAND-THEMING-SPEC.md). */
  function applyTokens(){
    var r = document.documentElement.style;
    r.setProperty("--p-ink", D.ink);
    r.setProperty("--p-paper", D.paper);
    r.setProperty("--p-ramp", rampCss(D.ramp));
    r.setProperty("--p-display", "'"+D.display+"', system-ui, sans-serif");
    r.setProperty("--p-mono", "'"+D.mono+"', ui-monospace, monospace");
    r.setProperty("--p-body", "'"+D.display+"', system-ui, sans-serif");

    if (MODE === "org" && typeof window.FHApplyBrand === "function") {
      window.FHApplyBrand({
        ink: D.ink,
        paper: D.paper,
        ramp: D.ramp,
        display_face: D.display,
        mono_face: D.mono,
        wordmark_url: D.logo || null,
        entity_name: D.entity || D.name || null
      });
    }
  }

  function renderFunnels(){
    $("funGrid").innerHTML = FUNNELS.map(function(f){
      var on = D.funnels.indexOf(f.id) !== -1;
      return '<div class="funnel'+(on?' on':'')+'" data-f="'+f.id+'"><span class="fx">'+(on?'✓':'')+'</span><b>'+esc(f.n)+'</b><span>'+esc(f.d)+'</span></div>';
    }).join("");
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll("[data-f]"), function(el){
      el.addEventListener("click", function(){
        var id = el.getAttribute("data-f");
        var i = D.funnels.indexOf(id);
        if (i === -1) D.funnels.push(id); else D.funnels.splice(i,1);
        renderFunnels(); paint();
      });
    });
  }

  function paint(){
    var name = D.name || "Your Brand";
    var entity = D.entity || "Your Entity LLC";
    var host = D.domain && D.verified
      ? D.domain
      : (MODE === "partner" && partnerId ? ("fundhub.ai/sites/" + partnerId) : (D.domain || "fundhub.ai"));

    $("pvWm").innerHTML = D.logo
      ? '<img src="'+D.logo+'" alt="" style="height:22px;display:block;filter:invert(1)">'
      : esc(name);
    $("pvUrl").textContent = MODE === "org" ? "CRM · internal" : host;
    $("pvLegal").textContent = "© 2026 "+entity+". Not a direct lender. All financing decisions, amounts, and terms are determined by funding partners.";
    $("entEcho").textContent = entity;
    $("subPrev").textContent = MODE === "partner" && partnerId
      ? ("/sites/" + partnerId + "/apply")
      : "fundhub.ai";
    $("rampPrev").style.background = rampCss(D.ramp);

    /* "Use text" clears an uploaded wordmark. With no file chosen there is
       nothing to clear, so the click did nothing while the button looked
       live. Enabled only when there is a logo. */
    var cl = $("clearLogo");
    if (cl) {
      cl.disabled = !D.logo;
      cl.title = D.logo ? "" : "No wordmark uploaded — your brand name already renders as text.";
    }

    $("kBrand").textContent = D.name ? (D.logo ? "Logo set" : "Text mark") : "—";
    /* Walkthrough-4 defect 6: a verified TXT record is not a live, secure site.
       Nothing here issues a certificate (api/partner-brand/verify-domain.mjs is a
       DNS lookup), so the tile and the chip say what was actually checked. */
    $("kDomain").textContent = D.domain ? (D.verified ? "DNS verified" : "Pending") : "—";
    $("kDomainSd").textContent = D.domain ? (D.verified ? D.domain : "awaiting DNS") : "not connected";
    $("kFun").textContent = D.funnels.length;

    var dc = $("dnsChip"), dt = $("dnsTxt");
    dc.className = "chip " + (D.verified ? "on" : (D.domain ? "wip" : ""));
    dt.textContent = D.verified ? "DNS verified · SSL not issued here" : (D.domain ? "Awaiting DNS" : "Not connected");
    $("dnsBox").style.display = D.domain ? "block" : "none";
    $("dnsC").textContent = partnerId
      ? ("fundhub-site-verify=" + partnerId)
      : ("fundhub-site-verify=" + slug(D.name || "brand"));

    var ac = $("approvalChip");
    ac.className = "chip " + (D.status==="approved" ? "on" : D.status==="submitted" ? "wip" : "");
    $("approvalTxt").textContent = D.status==="approved" ? "Approved · live" : D.status==="submitted" ? "In review" : "Draft";

    $("pvMode").textContent = MODE === "org" ? "Internal CRM" : "Your site";
    $("pvHint").textContent = MODE === "org"
      ? "These tokens theme the CRM you are looking at — sidebar, type, logo."
      : "These tokens theme this partner's funnels only — not the Fundhub CRM.";
    if (LIVE_PAGES && LIVE_PAGES.length) paintPagePreview(LIVE_PAGES);
  }

  function paintPagePreview(items) {
    var h1 = $("pvH1");
    var sub = $("pvSub");
    if (!h1) return;
    var page = items && items[0];
    var sections = page && page.body_json && page.body_json.sections;
    var hero = null;
    if (Array.isArray(sections)) {
      for (var i = 0; i < sections.length; i++) {
        if (sections[i] && (sections[i].id === "hero" || sections[i].type === "hero")) {
          hero = sections[i];
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (hero && hero.headline) {
      h1.textContent = hero.headline;
      if (sub && hero.sub) sub.textContent = hero.sub;
    }
  }

  function hash(s){ var h=0; for (var i=0;i<s.length;i++){ h=(h<<5)-h+s.charCodeAt(i); h|=0; } return h; }

  function bindColor(hexId, colorId, key){
    var c = $(colorId), h = $(hexId);
    c.addEventListener("input", function(){ D[key]=c.value; h.value=c.value.toUpperCase(); applyTokens(); paint(); });
    h.addEventListener("change", function(){
      var v = h.value.trim(); if(!/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(v)){ h.value = D[key]; return; }
      D[key]=v; c.value=v; applyTokens(); paint();
    });
  }

  function hydrate(){
    $("bName").value=D.name; $("bEntity").value=D.entity; $("bAddr").value=D.addr; $("bEmail").value=D.email;
    $("cInk").value=D.ink; $("cInkHex").value=D.ink.toUpperCase();
    $("cPaper").value=D.paper; $("cPaperHex").value=D.paper.toUpperCase();
    D.ramp.forEach(function(c,i){ $("r"+i).value=c; });
    $("fDisplay").value=D.display; $("fMono").value=D.mono; $("bVoice").value=D.voice;
    $("bDomain").value=D.domain;
  }

  /* Partner-only cards stay visible in partner mode; hide in org CRM mode so
     domain / funnel / approval UX does not pretend to save into org_brand. */
  if (MODE === "org") {
    ["submitBtn"].forEach(function(id){ var el=$(id); if(el) el.style.display="none"; });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".card"), function(card){
      var eye = card.querySelector(".eyebrow");
      if (!eye) return;
      var t = eye.textContent || "";
      if (/BS-03|BS-04|BS-05|BS-06/.test(t)) card.style.display = "none";
    });
  }

  /* BS-03 "Verify" POSTs /api/partner-brand/verify-domain, which is requireAuth
     (staff sessions) followed by requireRole owner/admin
     (api/partner-brand/verify-domain.mjs:5-20). The partner role is excluded on
     both arms, so for a partner the button can only ever refuse. Remove it for
     every role that cannot use it rather than show a control that 401s — the
     same idiom as the Demo Mode panel in ops-admin.html. Unknown role removes
     it too: a control is shown only when the role is known to be admitted. */
  var viewerRole = "";
  try { viewerRole = String(localStorage.getItem("fh_role") || "").trim().toLowerCase(); } catch (e) { viewerRole = ""; }
  var verifyBtn = $("verifyBtn");
  if (verifyBtn && viewerRole !== "owner" && viewerRole !== "admin") {
    verifyBtn.parentNode.removeChild(verifyBtn);
    verifyBtn = null;
  }

  load(); hydrate(); loadFonts(); applyTokens(); renderFunnels(); paint();

  /* True as soon as someone types in the Business address box on this page
     load. The server read finishes after the page is already interactive, so
     the mapping below uses this to leave a half-typed address alone. */
  var addrTyped = false;

  ["bName","bEntity","bAddr","bEmail"].forEach(function(id){
    $(id).addEventListener("input", function(){
      D[{bName:"name",bEntity:"entity",bAddr:"addr",bEmail:"email"}[id]] = $(id).value;
      if (id === "bAddr") addrTyped = true;
      paint();
      if (MODE === "org") applyTokens();
    });
  });
  bindColor("cInkHex","cInk","ink");
  bindColor("cPaperHex","cPaper","paper");
  [0,1,2,3,4,5].forEach(function(i){
    $("r"+i).addEventListener("input", function(){ D.ramp[i]=$("r"+i).value; applyTokens(); paint(); });
  });
  $("rampPreset").addEventListener("click", function(){
    presetIx = (presetIx+1) % PRESETS.length;
    D.ramp = PRESETS[presetIx].slice();
    D.ramp.forEach(function(c,i){ $("r"+i).value=c; });
    applyTokens(); paint();
  });
  $("fDisplay").addEventListener("change", function(){ D.display=$("fDisplay").value; loadFonts(); applyTokens(); paint(); });
  $("fMono").addEventListener("change", function(){ D.mono=$("fMono").value; loadFonts(); applyTokens(); paint(); });
  $("bVoice").addEventListener("change", function(){ D.voice=$("bVoice").value; });

  $("bLogo").addEventListener("change", function(e){
    var f = e.target.files && e.target.files[0]; if(!f) return;
    if (f.size > 400*1024) { $("saveMsg").textContent = "Logo must be under 400KB."; return; }
    var fr = new FileReader();
    fr.onload = function(){ D.logo = fr.result; applyTokens(); paint(); $("saveMsg").textContent="Wordmark loaded — Save & apply to keep it."; };
    fr.readAsDataURL(f);
  });
  $("clearLogo").addEventListener("click", function(){ D.logo=""; $("bLogo").value=""; applyTokens(); paint(); });

  $("bDomain").addEventListener("input", function(){
    D.domain = $("bDomain").value.trim().replace(/^https?:\/\//,"").replace(/\/.*$/,"");
    D.verified = false; paint();
  });
  if (verifyBtn) verifyBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
    if(!D.domain){ $("saveMsg").textContent="Enter a domain first."; return; }
    if (MODE !== "partner" || !partnerId) {
      $("saveMsg").textContent = "Open with ?partner_id= to verify a partner domain.";
      return;
    }
    $("verifyBtn").disabled = true; $("verifyBtn").textContent = "Checking…";
    fetch("/api/partner-brand/verify-domain", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: authHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ partner_id: partnerId })
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        $("verifyBtn").disabled = false; $("verifyBtn").textContent = "Verify";
        if (res.ok && res.verified) {
          D.verified = true; save(); paint();
          $("saveMsg").textContent = "DNS verified for " + D.domain + ". Add the domain in Netlify for SSL, then publish pages.";
        } else {
          D.verified = false; paint();
          // res.message is written for a person ("Add a TXT record at ..."). The
          // fallback used to be the raw code, e.g. "Not verified: txt_mismatch".
          $("saveMsg").textContent = res.message
            || "Not verified. We could not check that domain just now. Try again in a moment.";
        }
      }).catch(function () {
        $("verifyBtn").disabled = false; $("verifyBtn").textContent = "Verify";
        $("saveMsg").textContent = "Verify request failed.";
      });
  });

  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".copyb"), function(b){
    b.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var v = b.id==="copyTxt" ? $("dnsC").textContent : b.getAttribute("data-c");
      navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText(v);
      var t=b.textContent; b.textContent="copied"; setTimeout(function(){b.textContent=t;},1100);
    });
  });

  $("saveBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
    if(MODE === "partner" && !D.entity){ $("saveMsg").textContent="Legal entity is required — it goes into every disclosure."; return; }
    save(); applyTokens();
    /* This used to print "Saved." here, before the PUT ran. In the audit run
       the write failed and the screen showed "Saved. Tokens apply to this
       partner's funnels." beside the button while the bottom strip read
       "saved LOCALLY only" — two contradictory answers at once. Say only what
       is true right now; persist() writes the final answer once the server
       has replied, success or failure. */
    $("saveMsg").textContent = "Saving…";
    if (typeof window.__fhBrandPersist === "function") {
      window.__fhBrandPersist();
    } else {
      $("saveMsg").textContent = "Not saved to the server — your changes are kept in this browser only.";
    }
  });

  function authHeaders() {
    var t = "";
    try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { t = ""; }
    var h = { accept: "application/json", "content-type": "application/json" };
    if (t && t !== "demo") h.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
    return h;
  }

  var LIVE_PAGES = [];
  var SUITE = { enabled: false, remaining: null, cap: null, used: null };

  function suiteMsg(t) {
    var el = $("genMsg");
    if (el) el.textContent = t || "";
  }

  function paintSuite() {
    var chip = $("suiteChip");
    var txt = $("suiteTxt");
    if (txt) txt.textContent = SUITE.enabled ? "On" : "Off";
    if (chip) chip.className = "chip " + (SUITE.enabled ? "on" : "");
    var tok = $("kTokens");
    if (tok) {
      tok.textContent = SUITE.remaining == null ? "—" : String(SUITE.remaining);
    }
    var off = $("suiteOffMsg");
    var tools = $("suiteOnTools");
    if (off) off.style.display = SUITE.enabled ? "none" : "block";
    if (tools) tools.style.display = SUITE.enabled ? "block" : "none";
    var ownerRow = $("suiteOwnerRow");
    if (ownerRow) ownerRow.style.display = viewerRole === "owner" && MODE === "partner" ? "flex" : "none";
    var onBtn = $("suiteOnBtn");
    var offBtn = $("suiteOffBtn");
    if (onBtn) onBtn.style.display = SUITE.enabled ? "none" : "";
    if (offBtn) offBtn.style.display = SUITE.enabled ? "" : "none";
  }

  function refreshSuite() {
    if (MODE !== "partner" || !partnerId) {
      SUITE = { enabled: false, remaining: null, cap: null, used: null };
      paintSuite();
      return;
    }
    fetch("/api/partner-marketing/usage?partner_id=" + encodeURIComponent(partnerId), { headers: authHeaders() })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok) {
          suiteMsg(res.message || "Could not load writing budget. Try again in a moment.");
          return;
        }
        SUITE = {
          enabled: !!res.enabled,
          remaining: res.remaining,
          cap: res.cap,
          used: res.used
        };
        paintSuite();
      });
  }

  function fillHistorySelects() {
    var pageSel = $("histPage");
    var secSel = $("histSection");
    if (!pageSel) return;
    pageSel.innerHTML = LIVE_PAGES.length
      ? LIVE_PAGES.map(function (p) {
          return '<option value="' + p.id + '">' + (p.title || p.funnel_key) + "</option>";
        }).join("")
      : '<option value="">No pages yet</option>';
    fillHistorySections();
  }

  function fillHistorySections() {
    var pageSel = $("histPage");
    var secSel = $("histSection");
    if (!secSel) return;
    var page = LIVE_PAGES.filter(function (p) { return p.id === (pageSel && pageSel.value); })[0];
    var sections = page && page.body_json && page.body_json.sections ? page.body_json.sections : [];
    var unlocked = sections.filter(function (s) { return !s.locked; });
    secSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">All unlocked blocks</option>' +
      unlocked.map(function (s) {
        return '<option value="' + (s.id || "") + '">' + (s.headline || s.type || s.id) + "</option>";
      }).join("");
    loadHistory();
  }

  function loadHistory() {
    var list = $("histList");
    var pageSel = $("histPage");
    var secSel = $("histSection");
    if (!list || !pageSel || !pageSel.value) {
      if (list) list.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }
    var url = "/api/partner-marketing/copy-history?page_id=" + encodeURIComponent(pageSel.value);
    if (secSel && secSel.value) url += "&section_id=" + encodeURIComponent(secSel.value);
    fetch(url, { headers: authHeaders() })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        var items = (res && res.items) || [];
        if (!items.length) {
          list.innerHTML = '<div class="hint">No earlier versions yet. Write copy to start a history.</div>';
          return;
        }
        list.innerHTML = items.map(function (v) {
          var when = v.created_at ? String(v.created_at).slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ") : "";
          return '<div class="funnel on" style="cursor:default;margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center">' +
            "<div><b>" + (v.section_id || "") + "</b><span>" + when + "</span></div>" +
            '<button type="button" class="btn mono" data-restore="' + v.id + '">Use this version</button></div>';
        }).join("");
        list.querySelectorAll("[data-restore]").forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            suiteMsg("Restoring…");
            fetch("/api/partner-marketing/copy-history", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: authHeaders(),
              body: JSON.stringify({ page_id: pageSel.value, version_id: btn.getAttribute("data-restore") })
            }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
              .then(function (res) {
                suiteMsg(res.ok ? "Restored that version."
                  : (res.message || "That version was not put back. Nothing changed."));
                refreshPages();
                refreshSuite();
              });
          });
        });
      });
  }

  function refreshPages() {
    var list = $("pagesList");
    var msg = $("pagesMsg");
    if (!list) return;
    if (MODE !== "partner" || !partnerId) {
      list.innerHTML = '<div class="hint">Open with ?partner_id=&lt;uuid&gt; to create and list funnel pages.</div>';
      return;

      .then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok) {
          list.innerHTML = '<div class="hint">Could not load your pages just now. Try again in a moment.</div>';
          return;
        }
        var items = res.items || [];
        LIVE_PAGES = items;
        var liveN = items.filter(function (p) { return p.status === "published"; }).length;
        var kLive = $("kLive");
        if (kLive) kLive.textContent = String(liveN);
        fillHistorySelects();
        paintPagePreview(items);
        if (!items.length) {
          list.innerHTML = '<div class="hint">No page drafts yet. Select funnels above, then Create pages.</div>';
          return;
        }
        list.innerHTML = items.map(function (p) {
          var live = p.live_path
            ? ' · <a href="' + p.live_path + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + p.live_path + "</a>"
            : "";
          return '<div class="funnel on" style="cursor:default;margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center">' +
            '<div><b>' + (p.title || p.funnel_key) + '</b>' +
            '<span>/' + (p.slug || "") + ' · ' + (p.status || "draft") + ' · ' + (p.funnel_key || "") + live + "</span></div>" +
            (p.status !== "published"
              ? '<button type="button" class="btn mono" data-pub="' + p.id + '">Publish</button>'
              : '<button type="button" class="btn mono" data-unpub="' + p.id + '">Unpublish</button>') +
            "</div>";
        }).join("");
        if (msg) msg.textContent = items.length + " page(s) on file.";
        list.querySelectorAll("[data-pub]").forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            fetch("/api/partner-pages", {
              method: "PATCH",
              headers: authHeaders(),
              body: JSON.stringify({ id: btn.getAttribute("data-pub"), status: "published" })
            }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
              .then(function (res) {
                if (msg) msg.textContent = res.ok
                  ? "Published. Live at /sites/" + partnerId + "/" + ((res.page && res.page.slug) || "")
                  : (res.message || "That page was not published. Nothing changed — try again in a moment.");
                refreshPages();
              });
          });
        });
        list.querySelectorAll("[data-unpub]").forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            fetch("/api/partner-pages", {
              method: "PATCH",
              headers: authHeaders(),
              body: JSON.stringify({ id: btn.getAttribute("data-unpub"), status: "draft" })
            }).then(function () { refreshPages(); });
          });
        });
      });
  }

  var createBtn = $("createPagesBtn");
  if (createBtn) {
    createBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var msg = $("pagesMsg");
      if (MODE !== "partner" || !partnerId) {
        if (msg) msg.textContent = "Partner mode only — open with ?partner_id=.";
        return;
      }
      var keys = (D.funnels || []).filter(function (k) {
        return ["apply", "diag", "edu", "aff", "book"].indexOf(k) !== -1;
      });
      if (!keys.length) {
        if (msg) msg.textContent = "Select at least one supported funnel (apply/diag/edu/aff/book).";
        return;
      }
      if (msg) msg.textContent = "Creating " + keys.length + " page(s)…";
      var chain = Promise.resolve();
      keys.forEach(function (key) {
        chain = chain.then(function () {
          return fetch("/api/partner-pages", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: authHeaders(),
            body: JSON.stringify({ partner_id: partnerId, funnel_key: key })
          }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); });
        });
      });
      chain.then(function () {
        if (msg) msg.textContent = "Page drafts created.";
        refreshPages();
      }).catch(function () {
        if (msg) msg.textContent = "Create failed.";
      });
    });
  }
  refreshPages();
  refreshSuite();
  var histPage = $("histPage");
  var histSection = $("histSection");
  if (histPage) histPage.addEventListener("change", fillHistorySections);
  if (histSection) histSection.addEventListener("change", loadHistory);
  function setSuite(on) {
    suiteMsg(on ? "Turning on…" : "Turning off…");
    fetch("/api/partner-marketing/enable", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: authHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ partner_id: partnerId, enabled: on })
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        suiteMsg(res.ok ? (on ? "On for this partner." : "Off for this partner.")
          : (res.message || "That setting was not changed. Nothing changed — try again in a moment."));
        refreshSuite();
      });
  }
  if ($("suiteOnBtn")) $("suiteOnBtn").addEventListener("click", function () { setSuite(true); });
  if ($("suiteOffBtn")) $("suiteOffBtn").addEventListener("click", function () { setSuite(false); });
  if ($("genCopyBtn")) $("genCopyBtn").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var pageSel = $("histPage");
    if (!pageSel || !pageSel.value) { suiteMsg("Create a page first."); return; }
    suiteMsg("Writing copy…");
    fetch("/api/partner-marketing/generate-copy", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: authHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ page_id: pageSel.value, section_id: ($("histSection") && $("histSection").value) || null })
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        suiteMsg(res.ok ? "Copy written. Locked legal blocks were left alone."
          : (res.message || "Nothing was written. Your page is unchanged — try again in a moment."));
        refreshPages();
        refreshSuite();
      });
  });
  if ($("genLogoBtn")) $("genLogoBtn").addEventListener("click", function () {
    suiteMsg("Making wordmark…");
    fetch("/api/partner-marketing/generate-logo", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: authHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ partner_id: partnerId, name: D.entity || D.name })
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok) {
          suiteMsg(res.message || (res.error === "not_found"
            ? "That partner is not on file."
            : "The wordmark was not made. Nothing changed — try again in a moment."));
          return;
        }
        if (res.brand && res.brand.wordmark_url) {
          D.logo = res.brand.wordmark_url;
          paint();
        }
        suiteMsg("Wordmark saved from the brand name.");
        refreshSuite();
      });
  });
  /* FH-B4-SUBMIT-REVIEW — the line beside the button and the bottom status
     strip are two views of one answer, so every branch writes both. Same rule
     the persistence block below states at its own setSaveMsg().

     THE FLAG: the brand read in the block below writes this same line when it
     lands. A partner who pressed "Submit for approval" before the read returned
     got their answer wiped by "Loaded your saved brand." a moment later, and was
     told nothing about what their press did. Once a press has been answered this
     line belongs to the press, so the read stands down. The read's own outcome
     is not lost — it still writes the bottom status strip either way. */
  function reviewMsg(kind, strip, beside){
    window.__fhBrandAnswered = true;
    $("saveMsg").textContent = beside;
    if (window.FHData && window.FHData.banner) window.FHData.banner(kind, strip, "brand");
  }

  $("submitBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
    /* COMPLIANCE — approval flow. This button was inert: it printed "brand
       review is not set up yet" because no route could move the brand into
       review. api/brand/review.mjs is now that route, and it is the ONLY writer
       of partner_brand.approval_status — api/partner-brand.mjs still lists the
       column in FORBIDDEN (line 74-75), so a partner saving their brand still
       cannot hand themselves an approval. D.status is never guessed here: the
       server answers with the new status and that is what gets painted.
       FH-B4-SUBMIT-REVIEW */
    if (MODE !== "partner" || !partnerId) {
      reviewMsg("error", "not sent — no partner",
        "Nothing was sent — this screen was opened without a partner, so there is no brand to send.");
      return;
    }
    if (!D.entity) {
      reviewMsg("error", "not sent — no legal entity",
        "Add the legal entity first — it goes into every disclosure.");
      return;
    }
    var btn = $("submitBtn");
    btn.disabled = true;
    window.__fhBrandAnswered = true;   // "Sending…" is an answer too — see reviewMsg
    $("saveMsg").textContent = "Sending…";
    var status = 0;
    fetch("/api/brand/review", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: authHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ partner_id: partnerId, action: "submit" })
    }).then(function(r){ status = r.status; return r.json().catch(function(){ return { ok:false }; }); })
      .then(function(res){
        btn.disabled = false;
        if (res && res.ok) {
          D.status = res.approval_status === "review" ? "submitted" : (res.approval_status || D.status);
          paint();
          reviewMsg("real", "brand sent for review",
            "Sent for review. Fundhub checks it before it goes live. Nothing on your funnels changes until then.");
          return;
        }
        /* BRANCH ON THE HTTP STATUS. NEVER ECHO res.error. Two refusals carry no
           plain-words message, and this line used to print their machine code
           straight at the partner: requirePrincipal answers 401 with
           {error:"unauthorized"} and 503 with {error:"auth_unavailable"}. A
           partner read the word "unauthorized" and could do nothing with it.
           Every other refusal from api/brand/review.mjs carries a `message`
           written for this line, and it is already a whole sentence — used as it
           stands, not glued onto a prefix, which used to double the opening
           words. The last fallback is a sentence too, so no branch can print a
           code. */
        var why = status === 401
          ? "Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again and try once more."
          : status === 503
            ? "We could not reach the system just now. Your brand is still a draft — try again in a few minutes."
            : ((res && res.message)
               || "Nothing was sent — the change was refused. Your brand is still a draft.");
        reviewMsg("error", "not sent", why);
      })
      .catch(function(){
        btn.disabled = false;
        reviewMsg("error", "not sent — server unreachable",
          "Nothing was sent — we could not reach the server. Your brand stays a draft. Try again in a moment.");
      });
  });
  $("resetBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
    /* The confirm used to say "Reset brand to fundhub defaults?" — but this
       handler only drops the local draft key and reloads. Nothing is sent to
       /api/partner-brand or /api/org-brand, and there is no route that resets
       a saved brand (adding one is not this fix). On reload the saved brand is
       re-hydrated from the server, so for anyone whose brand is saved the
       confirmed "reset" visibly did nothing. Name the consequence that
       actually happens. */
    if(!confirm("Discard unsaved brand changes in this browser?\n\nYour saved brand is not changed — this only clears edits that were never written to the server.")) return;
    localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
    location.reload();
  });

  // Persistence bridge — the server script below reads these.
  window.D = D;
  window.save = save;
  window.__fhBrandMode = MODE;
  window.__fhBrandPartnerId = partnerId;
  window.__fhBrandApply = applyTokens;
  window.__fhBrandHydrateFromServer = function(b){
    if (!b) return;
    if (b.ink) D.ink = b.ink;
    if (b.paper) D.paper = b.paper;
    if (Array.isArray(b.ramp) && b.ramp.length === 6) D.ramp = b.ramp.slice();
    if (b.display_face) D.display = b.display_face;
    if (b.mono_face) D.mono = b.mono_face;
    if (b.wordmark_url) D.logo = b.wordmark_url;
    if (b.entity_name) D.entity = b.entity_name;
    /* entity_address was never mapped, so the Business address box came back
       empty on every reload even after a save that worked. The column has
       existed since 043 and the endpoint has always accepted it; migration 236
       adds it to v_partner_brand_effective so there is finally something here
       to map.

       KEY PRESENCE, NOT TRUTHINESS. Every other line here writes only when the
       server value is truthy. That reads fine until an address is DELETED: the
       stored browser draft is merged over the defaults first, and an empty
       value from the server could never overwrite it, so the old address stayed
       in the box and the partner had no way to tell what the server actually
       holds. When the server answered about this field, the server wins —
       including when its answer is "nothing on file". The one exception is an
       address being typed right now, which is not the server's to erase. */
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b, "entity_address") && !addrTyped) {
      D.addr = b.entity_address == null ? "" : String(b.entity_address);
    }
    if (b.voice) D.voice = b.voice;
    if (b.support_email) D.email = b.support_email;
    if (b.domain) D.domain = b.domain;
    if (b.domain_verified) D.verified = !!b.domain_verified;
    if (Array.isArray(b.selected_funnels)) D.funnels = b.selected_funnels.slice();
    if (b.approval_status) D.status = b.approval_status === "review" ? "submitted" : b.approval_status;
    if (!D.name && b.entity_name) D.name = b.entity_name;
    /* renderFunnels() must run here. This replaces D.funnels with the server's
       list, but the funnel cards were drawn once at load from the default
       ["apply"] and never redrawn — so a partner with no funnels on file saw a
       ticked "Application funnel" card while the FUNNELS LIVE tile read 0 and
       "Create pages" answered "Select at least one supported funnel". Three
       answers to one question, two of them wrong. */
    hydrate(); loadFonts(); applyTokens(); renderFunnels(); paint();
  };
})();

<script>

/* Brand Studio — persistence to /api/org-brand (CRM) or /api/partner-brand
   (funnel). Mode is set by the screen script above. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var MODE = window.__fhBrandMode || "org";
  var partnerId = window.__fhBrandPartnerId || null;

  function token() {
    return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || "";
  }

  function banner(kind, msg) {
    if (typeof FHData !== "undefined" && FHData.banner) FHData.banner(kind, msg, "brand");
  }

  /* The line beside the Save button is the answer the partner reads. It must
     never disagree with the bottom status strip, so every branch below writes
     to both. */
  function setSaveMsg(text) {
    var el = document.getElementById("saveMsg");
    if (el) el.textContent = text;
  }

  function bodyFromDraft() {
    var D = window.D || {};
    if (MODE === "org") {
      return {
        ink: D.ink,
        paper: D.paper,
        ramp: D.ramp,
        display_face: D.display,
        mono_face: D.mono,
        entity_name: D.entity || D.name || null,
        wordmark_url: D.logo || null
      };
    }
    return {
      partner_id: partnerId,
      ink: D.ink,
      paper: D.paper,
      ramp: D.ramp,
      display_face: D.display,
      mono_face: D.mono,
      voice: D.voice,
      entity_name: D.entity,
      /* The Business address box has been on this screen since it shipped and
         its value was never put in the body, so the field on the form wrote
         nowhere. entity_address has always been in WRITABLE in
         api/partner-brand.mjs — nothing ever sent it. */
      entity_address: D.addr || null,
      support_email: D.email,
      domain: D.domain,
      selected_funnels: D.funnels,
      wordmark_url: D.logo || null
    };
  }

  function persist() {
    var url = MODE === "org" ? "/api/org-brand" : "/api/partner-brand";
    var body = bodyFromDraft();
    if (MODE === "partner" && !partnerId) {
      banner("error", "saved LOCALLY only — no partner id");
      setSaveMsg("Not saved — this screen was opened without a partner, so there is nothing to save to. Your changes are kept in this browser only.");
      return;
    }
    fetch(url, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: {
        "content-type": "application/json",
        authorization: "Bearer " + token(),
        accept: "application/json"
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (d) { return { status: r.status, d: d }; }); })
      .then(function (x) {
        var d = x.d;
        if (d && d.ok) {
          banner("real", MODE === "org" ? "CRM brand saved" : "partner brand saved");
          setSaveMsg(MODE === "org"
            ? "Saved. Applied across the CRM."
            : "Saved. Tokens apply to this partner's funnels.");
        } else {
          // d.message is a sentence the server wrote for this line. d.error is a
          // machine code ("write_failed", "forbidden") and must never reach here.
          var why = (d && d.problems ? d.problems.join("; ") : d && d.message)
            || "the change was refused";
          banner("error", "saved LOCALLY only — " + why);
          setSaveMsg("Not saved — the server refused the change (" + why +
            "). Your changes are kept in this browser only.");
        }
      }).catch(function () {
        banner("error", "saved LOCALLY only — server unreachable");
        setSaveMsg("Not saved — we could not reach the server. Your changes are kept in this browser only.");
      });
  }

  window.__fhBrandPersist = persist;

  /* WHY THE READ WAITS — T11-01.
     data.js carries `defer` (its tag is the one directly above this script), so
     it has NOT run while this script is being parsed and FHData does not exist
     yet. This block used to ask for the saved brand right here, during parse:
     org mode hit a `typeof FHData === "undefined"` guard and quit without a
     word, partner mode had no guard and threw "FHData is not defined", and that
     throw killed the rest of this script element as well (the status-bar block
     below it never ran, so the sticky save bar sat under the bottom strip).
     Either way __fhBrandHydrateFromServer never ran: every text box kept its
     grey example text, the colour, ramp and font controls showed hard-coded
     defaults that LOOK like a real palette, and Save then answered "Legal
     entity is required" for a value the server had on file all along.
     Every deferred script runs before DOMContentLoaded, so the read waits for
     that event — the same shape as public/app/client-control-panel.html and the
     re-entry guard in campaign-manager.html / creative-factory.html. */
  function loadBrandFromServer() {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", loadBrandFromServer, { once: true });
      return;
    }

    /* If the read cannot even start, say so. What is on screen at this moment is
       a set of defaults, not this brand, and defaults that look real are exactly
       how a saved brand gets overwritten by one press of Save.

       NO banner() CALL HERE, ON PURPOSE. banner() only writes the bottom status
       strip when FHData is loaded, and this is the one branch that runs BECAUSE
       FHData is not loaded — so the call did nothing and made the branch look
       safer than it was. The line beside Save is written by hand and does not
       depend on FHData, so it is the whole warning in this case. */
    if (typeof window.FHData === "undefined" || typeof FHData.wire !== "function") {
      setSaveMsg("We could not load your saved brand, so the boxes below are examples, not your real brand. Reload the page before you save anything.");
      return;
    }

    if (MODE === "partner" && !partnerId) {
      FHData.banner("sample",
        "sample palette — sign in as a partner, or open with ?partner_id=<id>", "brand");
      setSaveMsg("No partner is open, so these are example colours, not a real brand. Sign in as a partner to see yours.");
      return;
    }

    var isOrg = MODE === "org";
    var read = isOrg ? FHData.orgBrand() : FHData.brand(partnerId);

    FHData.wire(read, "brand", function (data) {
      var b = data && data.brand;
      if (!b) return null;
      if (typeof window.__fhBrandHydrateFromServer === "function") {
        window.__fhBrandHydrateFromServer(b);
      }
      return isOrg
        ? "CRM brand · " + (b.entity_name || "unnamed")
        : "partner brand · " + (b.entity_name || "unnamed") + " · " + b.approval_status;
    });

    /* wire() writes the bottom status strip. The line beside Save is the answer
       the partner actually reads, and the two must never disagree, so the same
       three outcomes — loaded / nothing saved yet / read failed — are answered
       here too, in the same words. Attached after wire(), so hydration has
       already run by the time this handler is called. */
    read.then(function (res) {
      /* A press beats a page load. If the partner has already pressed "Submit
         for approval", this line is the answer to that press — see reviewMsg
         above — and overwriting it left them with no idea what their press did.
         The read's own outcome still reaches the bottom status strip via wire()
         either way, so nothing is hidden by standing down here. */
      if (window.__fhBrandAnswered) return;
      if (!res || !res.ok) {
        /* NO PARENTHETICAL, EVER. This line used to append the read's own
           `error` string, and FHData's reader puts engineer text in it on
           several paths — "/api/* not deployed", "response was not JSON",
           "no such record" — so a partner read those words and could do
           nothing with them. The rest of the sentence already says what is on
           screen and what to do about it, which is the whole job. This is now
           word-for-word the two sibling branches at the FHData guard and the
           .catch below, so the same failure always reads the same way. */
        setSaveMsg("We could not load your saved brand, so the boxes below are examples, not your real brand. Reload the page before you save anything.");
        return;
      }
      if (!res.data || !res.data.brand) {
        setSaveMsg("Nothing is saved for this brand yet. Fill in the boxes and press Save & apply.");
        return;
      }
      setSaveMsg("Loaded your saved brand.");
    }).catch(function () {
      if (window.__fhBrandAnswered) return;   // same reason as above
      setSaveMsg("We could not load your saved brand, so the boxes below are examples, not your real brand. Reload the page before you save anything.");
    });
  }

  loadBrandFromServer();
})();

/* Keep the sticky save bar clear of data.js's fixed bottom status strip.
   The strip (#fh-data-banner) is created lazily, can carry several sources at
   once and wraps to two lines, so its height is measured rather than guessed.
   Nothing outside this screen is touched: the bar moves up, the strip stays. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var watched = null;
  var ro = window.ResizeObserver ? new ResizeObserver(sync) : null;

  function sync() {
    root.style.setProperty("--fh-statusbar", (watched ? watched.offsetHeight : 0) + "px");
  }
  function check() {
    var el = document.getElementById("fh-data-banner");
    if (el !== watched) {
      if (ro && watched) ro.unobserve(watched);
      watched = el;
      if (ro && el) ro.observe(el);
    }
    sync();
  }

  check();
  if (window.MutationObserver) {
    new MutationObserver(check).observe(document.body, { childList: true });
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", check);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  /* ---------- THE ONE ESCAPE HATCH — UI-STANDARDS.md §12.7 -----------------
     fundhub-brand.css:184-186 sets `font-size:inherit !important` on every
     element inside .app, so a plain px size written here paints NOTHING. This
     screen carried 58 of those and every one of them was dead: the calendar has
     been rendering as one flat 16px wall, labels the same size as the values
     they label, which is §3 with no hierarchy left in it.
     Two things follow, and both are done rather than fought:
       1. the three section headings now all carry .eyebrow, so the brand file
          gives them 13px caps-mono for free — no rule of ours needed;
       2. the names below are this screen's own classes for labels, timestamps,
          status pills and secondary meta. They are captions, and this is the
          ONE rule that says so. Row content — .evt-client, .evt-time, .ws-dnum,
          .then-name, .cov-name, .un-client, .un-bullet — is deliberately absent:
          it stays at body size so the caption sits UNDER something.
     SHARED CHROME IS NOT OURS TO SIZE, and this rule is strong enough to take
     it by accident. `.app :is(...)` is specificity (0,3,1) — the `.errbar .acts
     span` argument sets it — so it beats an `!important` rule written as a bare
     class, even one the shell injects at runtime. `.clock` and `.live-pill`
     were in this list and are now out:
       .clock     — shell.js:1863-1875 injects #fh-shell-clock-css to give every
                    clock on every screen 12px. Its selector is `.clock`, (0,1,0).
                    Ours won, and the calendar became the only staff screen whose
                    top-bar clock was 13px and 17px wider than everywhere else.
       .live-pill — the LIVE indicator is top-bar chrome on eight screens and no
                    screen sizes it, so it is 16px everywhere. Sizing it here
                    alone would make the calendar the odd one out the same way.
     Anything the shell owns or injects stays off this list. */
  .app :is(.stat .l,.errbar .acts span,
    .ws-dname,.ws-dtoday,.ws-count,.ws-chip,.ws-more,.ws-empty,
    .hour-label,.evt-meta,.evt-outcome,.who-name,.evt-fix span,.nowline .lbl,.open-slot,
    .un-minlbl,.un-when,.un-meta,.un-sec,.un-check,.un-doc,.un-alt,
    .row-btn,.row-msg,.nodate-sub,.nodate-note,
    .then-time,.then-sub,.cov-role,.cov-load){
    font-size:var(--fs-caption)!important;
  }
