<script>
(function () {
"use strict";

var DAYS = ["Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat"];
var FULL = ["Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday"];
var MONTHS = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"];
var MONTHS_SHORT = ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"];
var UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

var datedTasks = [];
/* WORK THE CALENDAR CANNOT DRAW. Tasks with no due date come back from the same
   read and used to be thrown away here, which made them invisible on this
   screen forever. They are kept, counted and listed in the rail instead. */
var undatedTasks = [];
/* The queue read stops at 200 rows per half. When it comes back full, there may
   be more undated work than is being shown, and the screen says "at least".  */
var queueCapped = false;
var QUEUE_LIMIT = 200;
/* The last thing a person pressed, and what came back — keyed by task id so the
   answer paints on the row they pressed. {text, bad} */
var rowMsgs = Object.create(null);
/* The task whose button is mid-save. Its buttons are disabled while it is. */
var busyTaskId = null;
var selectedDate = startOfDay(new Date());
var selectedId = null;
var view = "day";
var loaded = false;
/* loaded says the schedule came back. loadFailed says it came back bad, or
   never went out at all. Without the second one every "nothing booked" on
   this screen is a claim the page has no right to make. */
var loadFailed = false;

/* THE SCHEDULE IS TWO READS, NOT ONE, AND EITHER ONE CAN FAIL ON ITS OWN.
   The page asks for still-open work and for finished work separately. Round 1
   only noticed a problem when BOTH came back bad, so the worst case on this
   whole screen slipped straight through: the open read fell over, the finished
   read answered "nothing", and the calendar painted a clean, mint-green,
   completely empty week that a person had no way to doubt.

   A HALF-ANSWER IS A FAILURE. These two flags say which half, because the two
   halves break different things and a person needs different words for each:

     openFailed — the still-open work never came back. The body of the calendar
                  is unreliable; nothing on it can be shown, and it is treated
                  exactly like a total failure.
     doneFailed — the finished calls never came back. What is still open is
                  right and worth showing, but anything counting finished work
                  ("Booked", "Done", "Show rate") is quietly too small, so those
                  numbers become dashes instead of wrong numbers. */
var openFailed = false;
var doneFailed = false;

/* The read has been out for a long time and has not answered either way. NOT a
   failure — see the note on SLOW_AFTER_MS below. It only changes the wording so
   nobody is left staring at "Loading" wondering if anything is still happening. */
var readSlow = false;

/* One sentence for the four places that used to say "nothing booked" before
   the schedule had ever come back. Empty and unread are different facts and
   the screen has to be able to tell a person which one it is looking at. */
function pendingNote() {
  if (loadFailed) return "Schedule did not load.";
  if (readSlow) return "Still loading the schedule\u2026 it is taking longer than usual.";
  return "Loading the schedule\u2026";
}

/* Wording for the two places that count BOTH open and finished work — the day
   timeline and the week strip. Three different facts hide behind an empty list
   and this is where the screen picks the true one:
     the read has not answered / failed  -> pendingNote()
     only the open half answered         -> say the finished half is missing
     both halves answered, nothing there -> the honest empty day */
function emptyNoteAll() {
  if (!loaded) return pendingNote();
  if (doneFailed) return "Nothing still open. Completed calls did not load.";
  return "Nothing booked.";
}

function esc(v) {
  return String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
    return { "&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;" }[c];
  });
}
function isUuid(v) {
  return UUID_RE.test(String(v || "").trim());
}
function startOfDay(d) {
  var x = new Date(d.getTime());
  x.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return x;
}
function sameDay(a, b) {
  return a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() &&
    a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate();
}
function sundayOf(d) {
  var x = startOfDay(d);
  x.setDate(x.getDate() - x.getDay());
  return x;
}
function ymd(d) {
  var m = d.getMonth() + 1, day = d.getDate();
  return d.getFullYear() + "-" + (m < 10 ? "0" + m : m) + "-" + (day < 10 ? "0" + day : day);
}
function parseYmd(s) {
  var p = String(s).split("-");
  return startOfDay(new Date(Number(p[0]), Number(p[1]) - 1, Number(p[2])));
}
function hourLabel(d) {
  return d.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", {
    hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit",
    timeZone: "America/Phoenix"
  }).replace(/:\d{2}/, ":00");
}
function clockTime(d) {
  return d.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", {
    hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit",
    timeZone: "America/Phoenix"
  }).replace(/\s*[AP]M$/i, "");
}
function thenTimeLabel(due) {
  var clock = clockTime(due);
  if (Math.abs(due.getTime() - Date.now()) <= 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) return clock;
  return due.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    month: "short", day: "numeric",
    timeZone: "America/Phoenix"
  }) + " " + clock;
}
function initials(name) {
  var parts = String(name || "").trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (!parts.length) return "??";
  return (parts[0][0] + (parts[1] ? parts[1][0] : "")).toUpperCase();
}
function displayName(t) {
  var n = String(t.client_name || "").trim();
  if (n && !isUuid(n)) return n;
  var title = String(t.title || "").trim();
  if (title && !isUuid(title)) return title;
  return "Booked work";
}
function briefingText(t) {
  var title = String(t && t.title || "").trim();
  if (title && !isUuid(title)) return title;
  return "No briefing on file.";
}
function meetingUrl(t) {
  return (t && (t.meeting_url || t.join_url)) || "";
}
/* ── THE TWO WRITES THIS SCREEN NOW OFFERS ───────────────────────────────────
   PATCH /api/tasks { id, claim:true } and { id, done:true } have existed since
   the queue shipped; nothing on the calendar ever called them, so every row
   said "unclaimed" with no way to change it.

   Both writes need the person to be on a shift (owners excepted) — that gate is
   api/tasks.mjs's, not this screen's, and its refusal is turned into plain
   words below rather than a status code. FHData.write is POST-only, so this
   uses fetch directly with the same bearer token every other read here sends. */
function taskAuthHeaders() {
  var t = "";
  try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) {}
  var h = { accept: "application/json", "content-type": "application/json" };
  if (t) h.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
  return h;
}

/* What went wrong, in the words of the person it happened to. Never a number,
   never a raw error name. */
function writeFailureText(status, body) {
  var err = String((body && body.error) || "");
  if (status === 401) return "You are signed out. Sign in again, then try once more.";
  if (err === "no_active_shift") return "Clock in first. Work can only be claimed or closed on a shift.";
  if (err === "already_claimed") return "Somebody else took this one first.";
  if (status === 403) return "You are not allowed to change this task.";
  if (status === 404) return "That task is gone. Reload the page.";
  if (status === 503) return "The database is not reachable right now. Try again in a moment.";
  return "That did not save. Try again in a moment.";
}

function withId(id, patch) {
  var body = { id: id };
  for (var k in patch) {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(patch, k)) body[k] = patch[k];
  }
  return body;
}

function patchTask(id, patch) {
  var started;
  try {
    started = fetch("/api/tasks", {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: taskAuthHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify(withId(id, patch))
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, text: "Could not reach the server. Try again in a moment." });
  }
  return Promise.resolve(started).then(function (r) {
    return r.json().catch(function () { return null; }).then(function (body) {
      if (r.status >= 200 && r.status < 300 && body && body.ok === true) return { ok: true };
      return { ok: false, text: writeFailureText(r.status, body) };
    });
  }, function () {
    return { ok: false, text: "Could not reach the server. Try again in a moment." };
  });
}

/* Press → the row says what is happening → the queue is read again → the row
   shows what is true. The list is re-read rather than edited in place: a claim
   fills in a person's NAME, which only the server knows, and guessing it here
   would be the screen inventing a fact (CLAUDE.md §12). */
function runTaskAction(id, patch, workingText, doneText) {
  if (!id || busyTaskId) return;
  busyTaskId = id;
  rowMsgs[id] = { text: workingText, bad: false };
  paintAll();
  patchTask(id, patch).then(function (res) {
    busyTaskId = null;
    if (!res.ok) {
      rowMsgs[id] = { text: res.text, bad: true };
      paintAll();
      return;
    }
    rowMsgs[id] = { text: doneText, bad: false };
    refreshTasks().then(function () {
      paintAll();
      /* The row itself now shows what changed — the Claim button is gone, or
         the task is ticked off — so the sentence has done its job and goes.
         A failure message stays put until the person does something about it. */
      setTimeout(function () {
        if (rowMsgs[id] && !rowMsgs[id].bad) { delete rowMsgs[id]; paintAll(); }
      }, 4000);
    });
  });
}

/* Read the queue again after a write. A read that fails leaves what is on
   screen alone — the write itself already succeeded, and blanking the day would
   say something worse and less true. */
function refreshTasks() {
  return loadDatedTasks().then(function (res) {
    if (!res || !res.ok || !res.data) return false;
    takeTasks(res.data.tasks || []);
    return true;
  }, function () { return false; });
}

/* One place that splits a queue answer into what the calendar can draw and what
   it cannot, so the two never drift apart. */
function takeTasks(tasks) {
  var all = Array.isArray(tasks) ? tasks : [];
  datedTasks = all.filter(function (t) { return t && t.due_at; });
  datedTasks.sort(function (a, b) { return new Date(a.due_at) - new Date(b.due_at); });
  undatedTasks = all.filter(function (t) { return t && !t.due_at && !t.done; });
}

function tasksOn(day) {
  return datedTasks.filter(function (t) {
    return sameDay(new Date(t.due_at), day);
  }).sort(function (a, b) {
    return new Date(a.due_at) - new Date(b.due_at);
  });
}

function tickClock() {
  var el = document.querySelector(".clock");
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", {
    weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit",
    timeZone: "America/Phoenix", timeZoneName: "short"
  });
}
function dateLabelText(d) {
  return FULL[d.getDay()] + ", " + MONTHS[d.getMonth()] + " " + d.getDate();
}
function weekRangeLabel(sun) {
  var sat = new Date(sun.getTime());
  sat.setDate(sat.getDate() + 6);
  return MONTHS_SHORT[sun.getMonth()] + " " + sun.getDate() +
    " – " + MONTHS_SHORT[sat.getMonth()] + " " + sat.getDate();
}

function setView(v) {
  view = v;
  [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#seg span")).forEach(function (x) {
    x.classList.toggle("active", x.getAttribute("data-v") === v);
  });
  document.body.classList.toggle("week-view", v === "week");
  paintDateLabel();
  paintFooter();
}

function paintDateLabel() {
  var el = document.querySelector(".datelabel");
  if (!el) return;
  if (view === "week") el.textContent = "Week of " + weekRangeLabel(sundayOf(selectedDate));
  else el.textContent = dateLabelText(selectedDate);
}

/* ── THE TWO BUTTONS, DRAWN THE SAME WAY WHEREVER A TASK IS SHOWN ───────────
   Claim only appears on work nobody has taken; Mark done only on work that is
   not finished. A button that could not do anything is not drawn (§5). */
function actionsHtml(t) {
  if (!t || !t.id) return "";
  var busy = busyTaskId && String(busyTaskId) === String(t.id);
  var dis = busy ? " disabled" : "";
  var html = '<div class="row-acts">';
  if (!t.assignee_staff_id && !t.assignee_name) {
    html += '<button type="button" class="row-btn" data-act="claim" data-task-id="' +
      esc(t.id) + '"' + dis + ">Claim</button>";
  }
  if (!t.done) {
    html += '<button type="button" class="row-btn" data-act="done" data-task-id="' +
      esc(t.id) + '"' + dis + ">Mark done</button>";
  }
  return html + "</div>";
}

/* What happened to the last press, on the row it was pressed. */
function rowMsgHtml(t) {
  var m = t && t.id ? rowMsgs[t.id] : null;
  if (!m) return "";
  return '<div class="row-msg' + (m.bad ? " bad" : "") + '">' + esc(m.text) + "</div>";
}

/* HOW MUCH WORK HAS NO DATE ON IT. Hidden when there is none, and hidden before
   the queue has answered — an unread queue is not a claim that everything has a
   date. A "+" means the read hit its 200-row limit and there may be more. */
function paintNoDateTile() {
  var tile = document.getElementById("statNoDateTile");
  var v = document.getElementById("statNoDate");
  if (!tile || !v) return;
  if (!loaded || !undatedTasks.length) {
    tile.hidden = true;
    v.textContent = "—";
    return;
  }
  tile.hidden = false;
  v.textContent = String(undatedTasks.length) + (queueCapped ? "+" : "");
  tile.title = queueCapped
    ? "Open tasks with no due date. The queue read stops at 200 rows, so there may be more."
    : "Open tasks with no due date. They are listed in the rail on the right.";
}

function paintNoDateList() {
  var title = document.getElementById("noDateTitle");
  var list = document.getElementById("noDateList");
  if (!title || !list) return;
  if (!loaded || !undatedTasks.length) {
    title.hidden = true;
    list.hidden = true;
    list.innerHTML = "";
    return;
  }
  title.hidden = false;
  list.hidden = false;
  var n = undatedTasks.length;
  var note = n === 1
    ? "1 open task has no date on it, so it cannot sit on a day."
    : n + " open tasks have no date on them, so they cannot sit on a day.";
  if (queueCapped) note += " The queue is read 200 rows at a time, so there may be more than this.";
  var html = '<div class="nodate-note">' + esc(note) + "</div>";
  undatedTasks.slice(0, 12).forEach(function (t) {
    html += '<div class="nodate-row">' +
      '<div class="nodate-main">' +
        '<div class="nodate-name">' + esc(displayName(t)) + "</div>" +
        '<div class="nodate-sub">' + esc(briefingText(t)) +
          (t.assignee_name ? " · " + esc(t.assignee_name) : " · unclaimed") + "</div>" +
        rowMsgHtml(t) +
      "</div>" +
      actionsHtml(t) +
    "</div>";
  });
  if (n > 12) {
    html += '<div class="nodate-note">' + (n - 12) + " more are not shown here.</div>";
  }
  list.innerHTML = html;
}

function paintStats() {
  var bookedEl = document.getElementById("statBooked");
  var doneEl = document.getElementById("statDone");
  var noEl = document.getElementById("statNoshow");
  var showEl = document.getElementById("statShow");
  var leftEl = document.getElementById("statLeft");
  var leftLabelEl = document.getElementById("statLeftLabel");
  /* "LEFT TODAY" WAS NOT TODAY. Every tile here counts the day you have
     selected, so on any other day this said "Left today" over a number that had
     nothing to do with today. The number was right; the word was wrong. */
  if (leftLabelEl) {
    leftLabelEl.textContent = sameDay(selectedDate, startOfDay(new Date()))
      ? "Left today"
      : "Left " + MONTHS_SHORT[selectedDate.getMonth()] + " " + selectedDate.getDate();
  }
  /* No-show and Show rate have no source on this screen — see the note on the
     tiles themselves. They stay a dash and stay hidden, rather than sitting in
     two of the five best tiles on the page saying nothing. */
  if (noEl) { noEl.textContent = "—"; noEl.className = "v"; }
  if (showEl) { showEl.textContent = "—"; showEl.className = "v"; }
  paintNoDateTile();
  if (!loaded) {
    if (bookedEl) bookedEl.textContent = "—";
    if (bookedEl && bookedEl.closest(".stat")) bookedEl.closest(".stat").hidden = false;
    if (doneEl) doneEl.textContent = "—";
    if (leftEl) leftEl.textContent = "—";
    return;
  }
  var dayTasks = tasksOn(selectedDate);
  var doneN = dayTasks.filter(function (t) { return t.done; }).length;
  var leftN = dayTasks.filter(function (t) { return !t.done; }).length;
  /* "Booked" and "Done" both count finished calls. If the finished-calls read
     did not come back, both are too small — and a number that is quietly wrong
     is worse than no number at all, because nobody knows to doubt it. Dash.
     "Left today" only counts still-open work, which did come back, so it
     stays a real number. */
  if (bookedEl) {
    bookedEl.textContent = doneFailed ? "\u2014" : String(dayTasks.length);
    if (bookedEl.closest(".stat")) bookedEl.closest(".stat").hidden = !doneFailed && dayTasks.length === 0;
  }
  if (doneEl) doneEl.textContent = doneFailed ? "\u2014" : String(doneN);
  if (leftEl) leftEl.textContent = String(leftN);
}

function paintWeekStrip() {
  var grid = document.getElementById("wsGrid");
  var title = document.getElementById("wsTitle");
  var sun = sundayOf(selectedDate);
  var today = startOfDay(new Date());
  /* "THIS WEEK" ONLY WHEN IT IS THIS WEEK. The strip follows whatever day you
     have selected, so this heading sat over a week three months away and still
     said "This week". */
  var thisWeek = sameDay(sundayOf(today), sun);
  if (title) {
    title.textContent = (thisWeek ? "This week · " : "Week of ") + weekRangeLabel(sun);
  }
  if (!grid) return;
  var html = "";
  for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
    var d = new Date(sun.getTime());
    d.setDate(sun.getDate() + i);
    var items = tasksOn(d);
    var isToday = sameDay(d, today);
    var isSel = sameDay(d, selectedDate);
    var empty = items.length === 0;
    var cls = "ws-day" + (isSel ? " sel" : "") + (isToday ? " is-today" : "") + (empty ? " empty" : "");
    var count = "—";
    if (loaded) {
      if (!items.length) count = "—";
      else if (doneFailed) {
        /* Only the still-open half came back, so "3 booked" would be a number
           the page cannot stand behind. Say what the 3 really is. */
        count = items.length + " open · done not loaded";
      } else {
        count = items.length + " booked";
        var left = items.filter(function (t) { return !t.done; }).length;
        if (isToday && left) count += " · " + left + " left";
      }
    }
    html += '<div class="' + cls + '" data-ymd="' + ymd(d) + '" role="button" tabindex="0">';
    /* The word, not just the coloured edge — a one-hue white-label brand paints
       every border on this strip the same colour (UI-STANDARDS §12.6). */
    html += '<div class="ws-dtop"><span class="ws-dname">' + DAYS[d.getDay()] + "</span>" +
      (isToday ? '<span class="ws-dtoday">today</span>' : "") +
      '<span class="ws-dnum">' + d.getDate() + "</span></div>";
    html += '<div class="ws-count">' + esc(count) + "</div>";
    if (items.length) {
      items.slice(0, 2).forEach(function (t) {
        html += '<div class="ws-chip"><span class="t">' + esc(clockTime(new Date(t.due_at))) +
          "</span>" + esc(displayName(t)) + "</div>";
      });
      if (items.length > 2) html += '<div class="ws-more">+' + (items.length - 2) + " more</div>";
    } else {
      html += '<div class="ws-empty">' + esc(emptyNoteAll()) + '</div>';
    }
    html += "</div>";
  }
  grid.innerHTML = html;
}

function paintDay() {
  var wrap = document.querySelector(".day-wrap");
  if (!wrap) return;
  var today = startOfDay(new Date());
  var isToday = sameDay(selectedDate, today);
  var label = (isToday ? "Today — " : "") + dateLabelText(selectedDate);
  var html = '<div class="day-title eyebrow">' + esc(label) + "</div>";
  if (!loaded) {
    /* The read has not answered. Saying "Nothing booked." here is the exact lie
       this screen used to tell all day long. */
    html += '<div class="hour"><div class="hour-label">—</div><div class="hour-body">' +
      '<div class="open-slot">' + esc(pendingNote()) +
      (loadFailed ? ' See the message at the bottom of the screen.' : '') +
      '</div></div></div>';
    wrap.innerHTML = html;
    return;
  }
  /* Half a schedule, drawn where the eye already is. The banner at the foot of
     the screen says this too, but the timeline is what a person reads, and a
     timeline missing every finished call must not look like a normal one. */
  if (doneFailed) {
    html += '<div class="hour"><div class="hour-label">—</div><div class="hour-body">' +
      '<div class="open-slot" style="border-color:var(--alert-line);' +
      'background:var(--alert-bg);color:var(--ink2);font-weight:600">' +
      'Completed calls did not load. What is still open is below and is right \u2014 ' +
      'anything already finished may be missing, so the Booked and Done counts ' +
      'show a dash. Reload the page.</div></div></div>';
  }
  var items = tasksOn(selectedDate);
  if (!items.length) {
    html += '<div class="hour"><div class="hour-label">—</div><div class="hour-body">' +
      '<div class="open-slot">' + esc(emptyNoteAll()) + '</div></div></div>';
    wrap.innerHTML = html;
    return;
  }
  var byHour = [];
  items.forEach(function (t) {
    var due = new Date(t.due_at);
    var key = hourLabel(due);
    var slot = byHour.filter(function (s) { return s.key === key; })[0];
    if (!slot) { slot = { key: key, items: [] }; byHour.push(slot); }
    slot.items.push({ t: t, d: due });
  });
  var now = new Date();
  var nowHour = hourLabel(now);
  var nowLineDrawn = false;
  byHour.forEach(function (slot) {
    html += '<div class="hour"><div class="hour-label">' + esc(slot.key) + "</div>" +
      '<div class="hour-body">';
    slot.items.forEach(function (it) {
      if (isToday && !nowLineDrawn && it.d > now) {
        html += '<div class="nowline"><span class="lbl">' + esc(clockTime(now)) +
          '</span><span class="ln"></span></div>';
        nowLineDrawn = true;
      }
      var who = it.t.assignee_name || "";
      var done = !!it.t.done;
      var isNext = selectedId && it.t.id === selectedId;
      var cls = "evt" + (done ? " done past" : "") + (isNext ? " next" : "");
      html += '<div class="' + cls + '" data-task-id="' + esc(it.t.id) + '">' +
        '<div class="evt-time">' + esc(clockTime(it.d)) + "</div>" +
        '<div class="evt-main">' +
          '<div class="evt-client">' + esc(displayName(it.t)) + "</div>" +
          '<div class="evt-meta">' + esc(briefingText(it.t)) +
            (it.t.assignee_role
              ? ' <span class="rail-tag">' + esc(String(it.t.assignee_role).toUpperCase()) + "</span>"
              : "") +
          "</div>" +
          rowMsgHtml(it.t) +
        "</div>" +
        '<div class="evt-right">' +
          (who
            ? '<div class="who"><span class="av human">' + esc(initials(who)) +
              '</span><span class="who-name">' + esc(who) + "</span></div>"
            : '<div class="who"><span class="who-name">unclaimed</span></div>') +
          (done ? '<span class="tag done">Done</span>' : "") +
          /* Claim it, or tick it off, without leaving the screen you plan your
             day on. Both buttons write through PATCH /api/tasks. */
          actionsHtml(it.t) +
        "</div></div>";
    });
    if (isToday && !nowLineDrawn && slot.key === nowHour) {
      html += '<div class="nowline"><span class="lbl">' + esc(clockTime(now)) +
        '</span><span class="ln"></span></div>';
      nowLineDrawn = true;
    }
    html += "</div></div>";
  });
  wrap.innerHTML = html;
}

function defaultUpNext(dayTasks) {
  var now = Date.now();
  var open = dayTasks.filter(function (t) { return !t.done; });
  var upcoming = open.filter(function (t) { return new Date(t.due_at).getTime() >= now; });
  if (upcoming.length) return upcoming[0];
  if (open.length) return open[0];
  return dayTasks[0] || null;
}

function paintRail() {
  var dayTasks = tasksOn(selectedDate);
  var current = null;
  if (selectedId) {
    current = datedTasks.filter(function (t) { return String(t.id) === String(selectedId); })[0] || null;
  }
  if (!current) current = defaultUpNext(dayTasks);

  var joinBtn = document.getElementById("unJoin");
  var fileBtn = document.getElementById("unFile");
  var minsEl = document.getElementById("unMins");
  var lblEl = document.getElementById("unMinLbl");
  var whenEl = document.getElementById("unWhen");
  var clientEl = document.getElementById("unClient");
  var metaEl = document.getElementById("unMeta");
  var bodyEl = document.getElementById("unBody");

  if (!current) {
    if (minsEl) minsEl.textContent = "—";
    if (lblEl) lblEl.textContent = "no call linked";
    if (whenEl) whenEl.textContent = "";
    if (clientEl) clientEl.textContent = loaded ? "Nothing up next" : pendingNote();
    if (metaEl) metaEl.textContent = loaded
      ? "Dated work from the task queue paints here when one is due."
      : (loadFailed
        ? "This is not a real empty day \u2014 the read failed. See the message at the bottom of the screen."
        : "Waiting on the task queue.");
    if (bodyEl) bodyEl.textContent = "No briefing on file.";
    if (fileBtn) {
      fileBtn.disabled = true;
      delete fileBtn.dataset.clientId;
      fileBtn.title = "No client linked";
    }
    if (joinBtn) {
      joinBtn.disabled = true;
      delete joinBtn.dataset.joinUrl;
      joinBtn.title = "No call link on this appointment";
    }
  } else {
    selectedId = current.id;
    var nd = new Date(current.due_at);
    var mins = Math.round((nd.getTime() - Date.now()) / 60000);
    if (minsEl) minsEl.textContent = String(Math.abs(mins));
    if (lblEl) lblEl.textContent = mins >= 0 ? "minutes out" : "minutes overdue";
    if (whenEl) whenEl.textContent = clockTime(nd);
    if (clientEl) clientEl.textContent = displayName(current);
    if (metaEl) {
      metaEl.textContent = (current.assignee_name ? current.assignee_name + " · " : "") +
        briefingText(current);
    }
    if (bodyEl) bodyEl.textContent = briefingText(current);
    if (fileBtn) {
      if (current.client_id) {
        fileBtn.disabled = false;
        fileBtn.dataset.clientId = current.client_id;
        fileBtn.removeAttribute("title");
      } else {
        fileBtn.disabled = true;
        delete fileBtn.dataset.clientId;
        fileBtn.title = "No client linked to this task";
      }
    }
    if (joinBtn) {
      var url = meetingUrl(current);
      if (url) {
        joinBtn.disabled = false;
        joinBtn.dataset.joinUrl = url;
        joinBtn.removeAttribute("title");
      } else {
        joinBtn.disabled = true;
        delete joinBtn.dataset.joinUrl;
        joinBtn.title = "No call link on this appointment";
      }
    }
  }

  var then = document.getElementById("thenList");
  if (then) {
    var nowMs = Date.now();
    var rest = datedTasks.filter(function (t) {
      return t.id && (!current || String(t.id) !== String(current.id))
        && new Date(t.due_at).getTime() > nowMs;
    }).sort(function (a, b) {
      return new Date(a.due_at) - new Date(b.due_at);
    }).slice(0, 8);
    if (!rest.length) {
      then.innerHTML = '<div class="then-row"><div class="then-name" style="color:var(--ink2)">' +
        esc(loaded ? "Nothing else dated after Up Next." : pendingNote()) + '</div></div>';
    } else {
      then.innerHTML = rest.map(function (t) {
        var due = new Date(t.due_at);
        return '<div class="then-row" data-task-id="' + esc(t.id) + '" role="button" tabindex="0">' +
          '<div class="then-time">' + esc(thenTimeLabel(due)) + "</div>" +
          '<div class="then-name">' + esc(displayName(t)) +
          '<div class="then-sub">' + esc(briefingText(t)) + "</div></div></div>";
      }).join("");
    }
  }
}

function paintFooter() {
  var foot = document.getElementById("footView");
  if (!foot) return;
  if (view === "week") {
    foot.textContent = "week of " + weekRangeLabel(sundayOf(selectedDate)).toLowerCase();
    return;
  }
  var when = dateLabelText(selectedDate).toLowerCase();
  if (!loaded) { foot.textContent = when; return; }
  var items = tasksOn(selectedDate);
  var left = items.filter(function (t) { return !t.done; }).length;
  if (doneFailed) {
    foot.textContent = when + " · " + left + " open · done not loaded";
    return;
  }
  foot.textContent = when + " · " + items.length + " booked · " + left + " left";
}

/* The chip in the top right said LIVE, in green, with a pulsing dot, no matter
   what had actually happened. On the failure this fix is about it was the last
   thing telling a person the screen could be trusted. It now says which of the
   four states the schedule is really in. */
function paintLiveChip() {
  var pill = document.querySelector(".live-pill");
  if (!pill) return;
  var label = "LIVE", colour = "";
  if (loadFailed) { label = "NOT LOADED"; colour = "#F2A69B"; }
  else if (doneFailed) { label = "PARTIAL"; colour = "#F5CE8F"; }
  else if (!loaded) { label = "LOADING"; colour = "#F5CE8F"; }
  pill.innerHTML = '<span class="live-dot"></span>' + esc(label);
  var dot = pill.querySelector(".live-dot");
  if (dot && colour) {
    dot.style.background = colour;
    dot.style.animation = "none";
    dot.style.boxShadow = "none";
  }
}

function paintAll() {
  paintDateLabel();
  paintStats();
  paintWeekStrip();
  paintDay();
  paintRail();
  paintNoDateList();
  paintFooter();
  paintLiveChip();
}

/* One handler for both places a task can be acted on. The button carries the
   task id, so the row it belongs to is never guessed from position. */
function wireTaskButtons(root) {
  if (!root) return;
  root.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".row-btn");
    if (!btn || !btn.dataset.taskId) return;
    // Stop the row's own click — pressing a button must not also re-select the
    // row underneath it and scroll the rail somewhere else.
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (btn.disabled) return;
    var id = btn.dataset.taskId;
    if (btn.dataset.act === "claim") {
      runTaskAction(id, { claim: true }, "Claiming…", "Claimed by you.");
    } else if (btn.dataset.act === "done") {
      runTaskAction(id, { done: true }, "Marking done…", "Marked done.");
    }
  });
}

[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#seg span")).forEach(function (x) {
  x.addEventListener("click", function () { setView(x.getAttribute("data-v")); });
});

var strip = document.querySelector(".weekstrip");
function pickDay(el) {
  if (!el || !el.dataset.ymd) return;
  selectedDate = parseYmd(el.dataset.ymd);
  selectedId = null;
  setView("day");
  paintAll();
}
if (strip) {
  strip.addEventListener("click", function (e) { pickDay(e.target.closest(".ws-day")); });
  strip.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key !== "Enter" && e.key !== " ") return;
    e.preventDefault();
    pickDay(e.target.closest(".ws-day"));
  });
}

var navs = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".navbtn"));
function step(dir) {
  var x = new Date(selectedDate.getTime());
  x.setDate(x.getDate() + (view === "week" ? dir * 7 : dir));
  selectedDate = startOfDay(x);
  selectedId = null;
  paintAll();
}
if (navs[0]) navs[0].addEventListener("click", function () { step(-1); });
if (navs[1]) navs[1].addEventListener("click", function () { step(1); });
var todayBtn = document.querySelector(".today-btn");
if (todayBtn) {
  todayBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    selectedDate = startOfDay(new Date());
    selectedId = null;
    paintAll();
  });
}

var thenList = document.getElementById("thenList");
if (thenList) {
  thenList.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var row = e.target.closest(".then-row");
    if (!row || !row.dataset.taskId) return;
    selectedId = row.dataset.taskId;
    var t = datedTasks.filter(function (x) { return String(x.id) === String(selectedId); })[0];
    if (t && t.due_at) selectedDate = startOfDay(new Date(t.due_at));
    paintAll();
  });
}

wireTaskButtons(document.querySelector(".day-wrap"));
wireTaskButtons(document.getElementById("noDateList"));

var dayWrap = document.querySelector(".day-wrap");
if (dayWrap) {
  dayWrap.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".row-btn")) return;
    var eventBlock = e.target.closest(".evt");
    if (!eventBlock || !eventBlock.dataset.taskId) return;
    selectedId = eventBlock.dataset.taskId;
    paintAll();
  });
}

function loadDatedTasks() {
  if (typeof FHData === "undefined" || !FHData.taskQueue) {
    return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, source: "offline", error: "data layer missing" });
  }
  return Promise.all([
    FHData.taskQueue({ done: false, limit: 200 }),
    FHData.taskQueue({ done: true, limit: 200 })
  ]).then(function (parts) {
    var open = parts[0], closed = parts[1];

    /* ══ THE FIX ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       This line used to read:

           if ((!open || !open.ok) && (!closed || !closed.ok)) return open || closed;

       — failure only when BOTH reads failed. So if the still-open read fell
       over and the finished read answered "nothing", this function handed back
       { ok:true, tasks:[] }. Every honest-empty guard on this screen then did
       its job perfectly on a fact that was not true, and a person saw a calm,
       green, totally empty week with nothing anywhere to doubt.

       A HALF-ANSWER IS A FAILURE. Which half decides what the screen says. */
    openFailed = !open || !open.ok;
    doneFailed = !closed || !closed.ok;

    /* The still-open read is the calendar. Without it there is no honest way to
       draw a day, so this is reported as a failed read even when the finished
       half answered — better an empty screen that says it is broken than a
       half-empty one that says it is fine. `closed` is used as the reason only
       when `open` gave none. */
    if (openFailed) return open || closed;

    var seen = Object.create(null);
    var tasks = [];
    /* UNDATED WORK IS KEPT. It used to be dropped on this line (`if (!t.due_at)
       return;`), which is why three of the walk client's five tasks could not
       be seen anywhere on this screen. The calendar still only DRAWS dated work
       — a task with no date has no place on a day — but the rail lists it and
       the tiles count it, so it is not invisible. */
    function take(res) {
      if (!res || !res.ok || !res.data) return;
      var rows = res.data.tasks || [];
      // The read stops at 200 rows. A full answer may have been cut short, and
      // the count on screen has to say so rather than claim a total.
      if (rows.length >= QUEUE_LIMIT) queueCapped = true;
      rows.forEach(function (t) {
        if (!t) return;
        var key = t.id || (String(t.due_at || "no-date") + ":" + String(t.title || ""));
        if (seen[key]) return;
        seen[key] = true;
        tasks.push(t);
      });
    }
    queueCapped = false;
    take(open);
    take(closed);
    return { ok: true, source: "api", data: { tasks: tasks }, error: null };
  });
}

/* data.js carries `defer` (see its tag above), so FHData does not exist yet
   while this script is being parsed. The guard below used to be a bare
   `typeof` test sitting at the top level: it failed every single time, the
   schedule was never asked for, and the calendar painted a convincing empty
   week forever with nothing on screen to say so. Every deferred script runs
   before DOMContentLoaded, so the first read waits for that event. The
   coverage read moves in with it, so both rail reads fire once the page and
   the data layer are both really there.

   The guard stays — but it can no longer fail quietly. If the data layer is
   genuinely missing, the screen says so out loud. An empty calendar and a
   calendar that was never asked must never look the same. */
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  if (typeof FHData !== "undefined" && FHData.wire) {
    var read = loadDatedTasks();

    /* NO TIMEOUT IS PUT ON THE READ ITSELF, ON PURPOSE. Cutting a slow but
       perfectly healthy read short would turn "your connection is slow" into
       "the schedule failed" — the same kind of lie as the bug above, just
       pointing the other way. What this timer does is change the WORDING, so a
       read that never answers stops looking like one that is about to. Nothing
       is marked failed, no number is invented, and if the read does come back
       the page paints normally and this wording disappears on its own. */
    var SLOW_AFTER_MS = 15000;
    setTimeout(function () {
      if (loaded || loadFailed) return;
      readSlow = true;
      paintAll();
      if (FHData.banner) {
        FHData.banner("sample", "Still waiting on your appointments \u2014 the schedule " +
          "has not come back yet. This screen is not empty, it is unanswered. If it stays " +
          "like this, reload the page.", "appointments");
      }
    }, SLOW_AFTER_MS);

    var wired = FHData.wire(read, "appointments", function (data) {
      takeTasks(data.tasks || []);
      loaded = true;
      selectedId = null;
      paintAll();
      var todayStart = startOfDay(new Date());
      var todayN = tasksOn(todayStart).length;
      var nowMs = Date.now();
      var later = datedTasks.filter(function (t) {
        return new Date(t.due_at).getTime() > nowMs && !sameDay(new Date(t.due_at), todayStart);
      }).length;
      /* Even the note that rides on the banner has to be honest. If only half
         the schedule came back, this must not say "live schedule" — the tone is
         corrected to a warning just below, and if that ever failed to run, the
         words alone still stop a person trusting the screen. */
      if (doneFailed) {
        return "schedule incomplete \u2014 completed calls did not load" +
          (todayN ? " \u00b7 " + todayN + " still open today" : "");
      }
      return "live schedule" + (todayN ? " · " + todayN + " today" : "") +
        (later > 0 ? " · " + later + " dated later" : "");
    });

    /* THE PARTIAL FAILURE, SAID OUT LOUD. wire() has just painted a mint-green
       "these are database rows" banner, because from where it stands the read
       succeeded. It did not — half of it did. Chaining off wire()'s own promise
       (rather than off `read`) guarantees this runs after that banner exists, so
       it replaces it rather than racing it. Same key, so it is one message, not
       two contradictory ones. */
    wired.then(function () {
      if (!doneFailed || loadFailed) return;
      if (FHData.banner) {
        FHData.banner("error", "Some of your completed calls could not be loaded, so this " +
          "week is incomplete. What is still open is right. Anything already finished may be " +
          "missing, which is why Booked, Done and Show rate show a dash instead of a number. " +
          "Reload the page, and tell your advisor if it keeps happening.", "appointments");
      }
    });
    /* wire() puts the reason on screen, but it does not hand this file back a
       pass/fail, and the tiles and the timeline would otherwise sit on their
       "still loading" wording with no way to know it was final. Watch the same
       promise so a failed read reads as failed, not as a quiet empty day. */
    read.then(function (res) {
      if (!res || !res.ok) { loadFailed = true; paintAll(); }
    }).catch(function () { loadFailed = true; paintAll(); });
  } else {
    dataLayerMissing();
  }

  loadCoverage();
});

function loadCoverage() {
  var cov = document.getElementById("covList");
  if (!cov) return;
  var t = "";
  try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) {}
  fetch("/api/shifts?roster=1", {
    headers: t ? { accept: "application/json", authorization: "Bearer " + t }
               : { accept: "application/json" }
  }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (body) {
    var rows = (body && body.roster) || [];
    if (!rows.length) {
      cov.innerHTML = '<div class="cov-row"><span class="cov-name" style="color:var(--ink2)">Nobody clocked in right now.</span></div>';
      return;
    }
    cov.innerHTML = rows.map(function (p) {
      var name = p.name || p.email || "Staff";
      var role = p.role ? String(p.role).replace(/_/g, " ") : "";
      var started = p.started_at ? new Date(p.started_at) : null;
      var since = started ? started.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", {
        hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit",
        timeZone: "America/Phoenix"
      }) : "";
      return '<div class="cov-row"><span class="cov-name">' + esc(name) +
        '</span><span class="cov-role">' + esc(role) +
        (since ? " · since " + esc(since) : "") + "</span></div>";
    }).join("");
  }).catch(function () {
    cov.innerHTML = '<div class="cov-row"><span class="cov-name" style="color:var(--ink2)">Coverage unavailable — clock in on Staff &amp; Teams.</span></div>';
  });
}

/* The one failure FHData cannot report, because reporting is FHData's job:
   the data layer itself never arrived. Say it in the same place a data
   problem is always said — the strip across the bottom of the screen — and in
   the same words a person can act on. */
function dataLayerMissing() {
  loadFailed = true;
  paintAll();
  var el = document.getElementById("fh-data-banner");
  if (!el) {
    el = document.createElement("div");
    el.id = "fh-data-banner";
    el.setAttribute("role", "status");
    document.body.appendChild(el);
  }
  /* App chrome, not a colour block — owner call 2026-08-28, no coloured bars
     anywhere in the CRM. Same ink as the top bar, sentence in the brand's
     alert colour, which shell.js repaints per company. The message is
     unchanged: a calendar that never loaded still has to say so. */
  el.style.cssText =
    "position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:2147482000;padding:7px 14px;" +
    "background:#0A0A0A;color:var(--alert,#F2A69B);border-top:1px solid #26262B;" +
    "font:600 11px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.05em;text-align:center";
  el.textContent = "We could not load your schedule — the page did not finish loading, " +
    "so nothing was ever asked for. This calendar is not empty, it is unread. " +
    "Reload the page, and tell your advisor if it keeps happening.";
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--fh-statusbar", (el.offsetHeight || 32) + "px");
}

var fileBtn0 = document.getElementById("unFile");

  joinBtn0.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var url = joinBtn0.dataset.joinUrl;
    if (!url) return;
    window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener");
  });
}
if (fileBtn0) {
  fileBtn0.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var cid = fileBtn0.dataset.clientId;
    if (!cid) return;
    location.href = "client-control-panel.html?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(cid);
  });
}
})();
</script>

          Blank spend means no day was reported for those ads. A blank hook rate means there was no
          video to measure — a photo ad has no hook rate and never will have one.

        <div class="cap">
          <b>Hook rate</b> is how many people kept watching past the opening, out of everyone the ad
          was put in front of. <b>Hold rate</b> is how many of those got three quarters of the way
          through. Meta counts "past the opening" at two seconds of watching. It does not publish a
          three-second count at all, so this is close to but <b>not the same number</b> Meta's own Ads
          Manager shows next to the words "hook rate". <b>Cost per booked person</b> is spend divided by the people who booked — on a sample
          too small to divide it is not worked out at all, and the reason is printed in the cell
          instead of a made-up number. <b>Ads</b> counts every ad that label has ever had; the money
          covers only the window above, which is why each row also says how many of those ads reported
          inside it.
        </div>

             POST /api/campaigns/link-asset, routed since 2026-09-08

             written it, which is why v_ad_label_spine shows NULL labels for
             every ad and the panel above it reads empty.

             THE AD'S OWN ID IS NEVER TYPED. The endpoint needs ads.id, a long
             random string that appears on no screen. The Label button in each
             row carries it in a data attribute, taken from the row the table
             already drew (f.ad_id), so the person only ever picks a row.

             IT ONLY EVER SETS. There is no "unlink" here on purpose: the
             endpoint treats a blank string as an instruction to CLEAR, and
             clearing asset_id turns an ad's labels back off with no error
             anywhere. So a field left empty is left OUT of the request
             entirely, which is the endpoint's one way of saying "leave it
             alone" (api/campaigns/link-asset.mjs:44-54). -->

<script>

function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]});}

/* ══ FORMATTERS ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MONEY CARRIES NO SYMBOL. There is no currency column in any of the module
   tables — Meta decimal strings and TikTok whole units are both stored as
   integer cents in the ad account's own currency — so a '$' would be a claim
   the schema cannot back. Cents are shown divided by 100, two decimals.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var NBSP = '—';
function cents(v){
  if(v===null||v===undefined) return '<span class="nul">'+NBSP+'</span>';
  return (Number(v)/100).toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});
}
function int(v){ return v===null||v===undefined ? '<span class="nul">'+NBSP+'</span>' : Number(v).toLocaleString('en-US'); }
function dec(v,p){ return v===null||v===undefined ? '<span class="nul">'+NBSP+'</span>' : Number(v).toFixed(p===undefined?2:p); }
/* ctr is stored in the platform's own units and compared against floor_pct as a
   bare number — percent. Never multiplied by 100 here. */
function pctv(v){ return v===null||v===undefined ? '<span class="nul">'+NBSP+'</span>' : Number(v).toFixed(2)+'%'; }
function nul(){ return '<span class="nul">'+NBSP+'</span>'; }
var MON = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
function dt(iso,withTime){
  if(!iso) return nul();
  var d = new Date(iso);
  if(isNaN(d)) return nul();
  var s = MON[d.getUTCMonth()]+' '+String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0')+', '+d.getUTCFullYear();
  if(withTime) s += ' ' + String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
  return s;
}
function day(iso){ if(!iso) return nul(); var d=new Date(iso+'T00:00:00Z'); return MON[d.getUTCMonth()]+' '+String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0'); }
function jsonline(o){ try{ return JSON.stringify(o); }catch(e){ return '{}'; } }

/* TODAY — the AD ACCOUNT's today. Meta dates every daily row in the ad
   account's zone, America/Phoenix (measured 2026-10-05), and the endpoints now
   count "yesterday" and "last N days" the same way (src/lib/ad-account-day.mjs).
   It was UTC, which put the "partial" marker on tomorrow from 5pm to midnight
   Arizona time and left today's real partial row unmarked. It was a frozen
   string ('2026-07-30') before that, until the sample data was removed. */
var TODAY = (function(){
  try { return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'America/Phoenix'}).format(new Date()); }
  catch(e){ return new Date(Date.now() - 7*3600000).toISOString().slice(0,10); }
})();

/* ══ NO SAMPLE DATA ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   These start EMPTY and are only ever filled by a read that answered. There is
   no built-in partner, no built-in campaign, no built-in ceiling and no
   generated metric series: UI-STANDARDS §6 forbids sample data presented as
   real, and a screen whose reads were rejected must say so rather than paint a
   book that does not exist.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var CONNECTIONS = [];   /* GET /api/campaigns/connections → items[] */
var CAMPAIGNS   = [];   /* GET /api/campaigns/list        → items[] */
var AD_SETS     = {};   /* campaign_id → ad_sets[]; only /detail returns these */
var CEILINGS    = [];   /* GET /api/campaigns/spend       → items[] */
var FATIGUE     = [];   /* GET /api/campaigns/fatigue     → items[] */
var ACTIONS     = [];   /* GET /api/campaigns/action-log  → items[] */
var ADBOOKS     = null; /* GET /api/read/ad-books → the whole response body, or null while unread */
var FUNNEL_PAGES = [];  /* GET /api/read/funnel-pages → pages[] */
var FUNNEL_CONN  = null;/* GET /api/read/funnel-pages → connection, or null when nothing is connected */
var SPINE        = null;/* GET /api/read/ad-spine → the whole response body, or null while unread */

/* GET /api/campaigns/spend → items[] over v_partner_spend_vs_ceiling.
   ACTIVE ceilings only — the view filters on sc.active, so an inactive ceiling
   is absent from this list entirely rather than shown as "off". */
function ceil_(o){
  o.headroom_cents = Math.max(Number(o.daily_limit_cents) - Number(o.spend_today_cents), 0);
  o.pct_of_ceiling = Number(o.daily_limit_cents) === 0 ? null
    : Math.round(100 * o.spend_today_cents / o.daily_limit_cents * 100) / 100;
  o.breached = o.breached_at !== null;
  o.exhausted = o.headroom_cents === 0;
  o.approaching_ceiling = o.pct_of_ceiling !== null && o.pct_of_ceiling >= 80;
  return o;
}

/* ══ PANEL READ FAILURES ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
   panel key → one plain sentence saying what failed, or absent when the read
   answered. A panel with an entry here shows that sentence instead of an empty
   state: "no rows" and "we could not read the rows" are different answers and
   the screen must not give the first when the second is true.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var PANEL_MSG = {};
/* One sentence when this panel has no answer yet — because the read failed, or
   because it has not come back. Null once it HAS answered, however few rows it
   returned. A zero printed while a read is still in flight is the same false
   all-clear as a zero printed after one was rejected. */
function panelUnread(key){
  if(PANEL_MSG[key]) return PANEL_MSG[key];
  var s = SRC && SRC[key];
  return (!s || s.source === '…') ? 'Reading…' : null;
}
function panelRow(cols, key, emptyHtml){
  var m = panelUnread(key);
  return '<tr><td colspan="'+cols+'"><div class="empty">'+(m ? esc(m) : emptyHtml)+'</div></td></tr>';
}
/* The partner_id in the address, or null. A STAFF session must put one there.
   A PARTNER session has none and does not need one — resolvePartnerId pins it
   to its own book server-side — so null here does not mean "no partner". */
function partnerParam(){
  var qp = (window.FHData && FHData.param) ? FHData.param('partner_id') : null;
  if(qp) return qp;
  try { return new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('partner_id'); } catch(e){ return null; }
}
/* Does this screen have a partner at all? Either the address names one, or a
   read has already answered — which only happens once the server has resolved
   one. Used to gate the write controls: a write must never be sent when the
   answer is no, and must NOT be blocked for a partner login just because the
   address is bare. */
function hasPartnerScope(){
  if(partnerParam()) return true;
  if(!PANELS || !SRC) return false;
  return PANELS.some(function(p){ return SRC[p.key] && SRC[p.key].source === 'api'; });
}

/* ══ DERIVED LOOKUPS ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var CAMP_BY_ID = {}, ADSET_BY_ID = {}, CONN_BY_ID = {};
function reindex(){
  CAMP_BY_ID = {}; ADSET_BY_ID = {}; CONN_BY_ID = {};
  CAMPAIGNS.forEach(function(c){ CAMP_BY_ID[c.id] = c; });
  CONNECTIONS.forEach(function(c){ CONN_BY_ID[c.id] = c; });
  Object.keys(AD_SETS).forEach(function(cid){
    AD_SETS[cid].forEach(function(s){ ADSET_BY_ID[s.id] = { set:s, campaign_id:cid }; });
  });
}
reindex();

function outcomeOf(a){
  if(a.undone_at)        return { k:'reverted',  cls:'b-accent', t:'undone' };
  if(a.execute_error)    return { k:'failed',    cls:'b-alert',  t:'failed' };
  if(!a.executed_at)     return { k:'unexecuted',cls:'b-warn',   t:'written down · never carried out' };
  return { k:'executed', cls:'b-ok', t:'done' };
}
var APPROVAL_TONE = { draft:'b-gray', awaiting_approval:'b-warn', approved:'b-info', live:'b-ok', paused:'b-warn', archived:'b-gray' };
var CONNSTATE_TONE = { pending:'b-warn', active:'b-ok', expired:'b-alert', revoked:'b-alert', needs_verification:'b-warn' };
/* The database's own words, in plain English. The STORED value never changes and
   is still what every filter sends — this is only what the reader sees. Anything
   not listed falls back to the same word with its underscores opened up, so a new
   state is never swallowed and never has to be invented here. */
var WORDS = {
  awaiting_approval:'awaiting approval',
  credit_cards:'credit cards',
  credit_repair:'credit repair',
  needs_verification:'needs verification',
  ad_set:'ad set',
  creative_asset:'creative',
  social_post:'social post',
  scale_winner:'scale winner',
  cpa_over_target:'cost per sale too high',
  cpa_recovering:'cost per sale recovering',
  frequency_bands:'shown too often',
  ctr_below_floor:'click rate too low',
  kill_no_conversions:'no sales',
  kill_switch_ceiling:'daily limit hit',
  learning_phase:'still learning',
  connection_not_active:'connection not active',
  verify_business:'verify the business',
  link_croa_disclosure:'attach the credit repair disclosure',
  /* The three rule keys that can reach action_log and had no entry here. Without
     them the fallback prints "roas primary", "spend tier refresh" and "social
     publish" — readable, but not what any of them means.
       roas_primary       048_campaign_config.sql:200 — the policy the other rules defer to
       spend_tier_refresh 048_campaign_config.sql:231 — shipped inactive, tiers deliberately unset
       social_publish     src/social/scheduler.mjs — the only rule key organic posting writes */
  roas_primary:'return on ad spend comes first',
  spend_tier_refresh:'refresh creative as spending rises',
  social_publish:'posted to social media'
};
function words(v){
  if(v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return v;
  return WORDS[v] || String(v).replace(/_/g, ' ');
}
var VERIF_TONE = { unverified:'b-gray', submitted:'b-warn', approved:'b-ok', rejected:'b-alert' };
var REC_TONE = { refresh:'b-alert', queue:'b-warn', ok:'b-ok', unconfigured:'b-gray' };

/* ══ FILTER STATE ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var UI = {
  spendState:'all',
  campState:'all', campPlatform:'all', campOffer:'all', campLimit:50, campOffset:0,
  fatState:'all', fatDays:7,
  connState:'all',
  logState:'all', logTarget:'all', logRule:'all',
  adBooksGroupBy:'lane',
  /* CM-11. Angle first: it is the question Chris asks first — which idea is
     working — and hook is one click away on the same rail. */
  spineGroupBy:'angle', spineDays:30
};

/* the five ?state= allowlists, verbatim from the endpoints */
var CAMP_STATES = ['all','draft','awaiting_approval','approved','live','paused','archived'];
var SPEND_STATES = ['all','breached','ok'];
var FAT_STATES = ['all','refresh','queue','ok','unconfigured'];
var CONN_STATES = ['all','pending','active','expired','revoked','needs_verification'];
var LOG_STATES = ['all','agent','human','revertible','failed'];
/* GROUPS in api/read/ad-books.mjs, verbatim. Not a state filter over rows
   already in memory — each choice is a different server query, like fDays
   above, so onPick below re-reads rather than re-rendering in place. */
var AD_BOOKS_GROUPS = ['lane','ad_id','variant','gate','entry','primary_offer','secondary_offer'];
/* GROUPS in api/read/ad-spine.mjs, verbatim (LABELS at :219-225). Same as
   AD_BOOKS_GROUPS above, each choice is a different server query, so picking
   one re-reads rather than re-rendering rows already in memory. */
var SPINE_GROUPS = ['angle','hook','lane','offer','script_type'];
/* Which spine read is the current one. Both pickers — the label rail and the
   window select — fire a fresh SERVER read, so two answers can be in flight at
   once and the slower one can land last, putting the wrong rows under the right
   heading. Same hazard as the drawer's, so the same guard: loadDetail's DW.seq
   at :2076/:2081 is the pattern this copies. */
var SPINE_SEQ = 0;

function rail(host, values, current, counts, onPick){
  host.innerHTML = values.map(function(v){
    var n = counts && counts[v] !== undefined ? '<span class="n">'+counts[v]+'</span>' : '';
    return '<button type="button" data-v="'+esc(v)+'"'+(v===current?' class="on"':'')+
           ' aria-pressed="'+(v===current)+'">'+esc(words(v))+n+'</button>';
  }).join('');
  host.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){ onPick(b.dataset.v); });
  });
}

/* ══ CM-03 · SPEND vs CEILINGS ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
function spendFiltered(){
  return CEILINGS.filter(function(c){
    if(UI.spendState==='breached') return c.breached;
    if(UI.spendState==='ok') return !c.breached;
    return true;
  }).slice().sort(function(a,b){
    if(a.scope !== b.scope) return a.scope < b.scope ? -1 : 1;
    var ap = a.pct_of_ceiling, bp = b.pct_of_ceiling;
    if(ap === null && bp === null) return 0;
    if(ap === null) return 1; if(bp === null) return -1;
    return bp - ap;
  });
}
function renderSpend(){
  /* one sentence when this panel has no answer — a count printed beside a filter
     is as much a claim as a count printed in a tile, so the filter chips carry no
     numbers until the read has answered (UI-STANDARDS §6). */
  var unread = panelUnread('spend');
  var counts = { all:CEILINGS.length,
    breached:CEILINGS.filter(function(c){return c.breached;}).length,
    ok:CEILINGS.filter(function(c){return !c.breached;}).length };
  rail(document.getElementById('spendRail'), SPEND_STATES, UI.spendState, unread ? null : counts,
       function(v){ UI.spendState=v; renderSpend(); });

  var rows = spendFiltered();
  document.getElementById('spendRows').innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.map(function(c){
    var pct = c.pct_of_ceiling;
    var tone = c.breached ? 'bad' : (c.approaching_ceiling || c.exhausted) ? 'warn' : '';
    var stripe = c.breached ? 'stripe-bad' : (c.approaching_ceiling || c.exhausted) ? 'stripe-warn' : 'stripe-ok';
    var flags = [];
    /* breach_reason is a real spend_ceilings column, but v_partner_spend_vs_ceiling
       does not project it and /api/campaigns/spend does not select it — so there is
       no reason string to show here. The same sentence is on the kill_switch_ceiling
       row in CM-08, where action_log.reason does carry it. */
    if(c.breached) flags.push('<span class="badge b-alert mono" title="The kill switch stopped spending when this limit was hit. It reads the ad platform directly, not our copy. The reason is on the kill switch row in the action log.">breached</span>');
    if(c.exhausted) flags.push('<span class="badge b-warn mono">exhausted</span>');
    if(c.approaching_ceiling) flags.push('<span class="badge b-warn mono">approaching</span>');
    if(!flags.length) flags.push('<span class="badge b-ok mono">ok</span>');
    var bar = pct === null ? '<span class="nul mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption)">limit is 0</span>'
      : '<div class="meter '+tone+'"><i style="width:'+Math.min(100, pct)+'%"></i><span class="mark" style="left:80%"></span></div>';
    return '<tr class="'+stripe+'">'+
      '<td><b>'+esc(c.scope)+'</b>'+(c.breached_at?'<span class="sub">breached '+dt(c.breached_at,true)+'</span>':'')+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+(c.campaign_name ? esc(c.campaign_name) : nul())+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono">'+(c.platform ? esc(c.platform) : nul())+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+cents(c.daily_limit_cents)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum"><b>'+cents(c.spend_today_cents)+'</b></td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+cents(c.headroom_cents)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+bar+'<span class="mnum" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+(pct===null?nul():dec(pct,2)+'%')+'</span></td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+c.max_daily_increase_pct+'%</td>'+
      '<td><div style="display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap">'+flags.join('')+'</div></td>'+
    '</tr>';
  }).join('') : panelRow(9, 'spend', 'No daily limit matches this filter.');

  document.getElementById('spendFoot').textContent = unread ? unread :
    rows.length + ' of ' + CEILINGS.length + ' daily limits in use · closest to the limit first';

  /* which campaigns have no campaign-scope ceiling of their own */
  var covered = {};
  CEILINGS.forEach(function(c){ if(c.scope==='campaign' && c.campaign_id) covered[c.campaign_id] = 1; });
  var without = CAMPAIGNS.filter(function(c){ return !covered[c.id]; }).length;
  /* the count is a claim about two reads; it may only be printed when both
     answered, otherwise "0 of 0" reads as "every campaign is covered". */
  document.getElementById('spendGapCap').innerHTML =
    (panelUnread('spend') || panelUnread('list'))
      ? '<b>This count needs two panels. One did not load.</b>'
      : '<b>' + without + ' of ' + CAMPAIGNS.length + ' campaigns have no limit of their own.</b> ' +
        'Partner and platform limits still cover them.';

  /* topbar chip — the screen's headline status, and the only thing on the page
     that can raise an alarm on its own. It is a claim about ceilings, so it may
     only EXIST when the ceiling read actually answered. Rejected, or still in
     flight: the pill does not render at all, because an all-clear and an alarm
     are both inventions then. (It read "1 CEILING BREACHED" off built-in rows
     while the read was being rejected — UI-STANDARDS §6.) The panel below says
     what failed and what to do next; the headline does not guess. */
  var chip = document.getElementById('ceilChip');
  var txt = document.getElementById('ceilTxt');
  if(unread){
    chip.style.display = 'none';
    txt.textContent = '';
  } else if(!CEILINGS.length){
    chip.style.display = '';
    chip.className = 'chip';
    txt.textContent = 'no ceilings set';
  } else {
    chip.style.display = '';
    var breached = CEILINGS.filter(function(c){return c.breached;}).length;
    var near = CEILINGS.filter(function(c){return !c.breached && (c.approaching_ceiling || c.exhausted);}).length;
    chip.className = 'chip ' + (breached ? 'bad' : near ? 'wip' : 'on');
    txt.textContent =
      breached ? breached + ' ceiling breached' : near ? near + ' ceiling near limit' : 'ceilings clear';
  }
}

/* ══ CM-00 · STAT TILES ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Nothing here is a metric the backend cannot produce, and nothing sums two
   overlapping spend limits.

   Each tile used to carry a "how this is derived" strip printing the SQL
   behind it, and the tiles were buttons whose only job was to switch which
   SQL was on show. That is a spec page, not an owner's tool (UI-STANDARDS
   §1/§9), so the strip is gone and the tiles are plain readouts. The one
   thing that strip carried for a reader — what the number is measured
   against — stays, in words, on each tile's sub-label.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function partnerCeiling(){ return CEILINGS.filter(function(c){ return c.scope==='partner'; })[0] || null; }
function tiles(){
  var pc = partnerCeiling();
  var yest = CAMPAIGNS.reduce(function(n,c){ return n + Number(c.spend_yesterday_cents||0); }, 0);
  var live = CAMPAIGNS.filter(function(c){ return c.approval_state==='live'; }).length;
  var withRoas = CAMPAIGNS.filter(function(c){ return c.roas_7d !== null && c.roas_7d !== undefined; });
  var roasMean = withRoas.length ? withRoas.reduce(function(n,c){ return n + Number(c.roas_7d); },0) / withRoas.length : null;
  /* A tile whose read did not answer shows nothing and says why. A zero, a
     total or a "0 / 0" would each be a health-shaped answer to a question the
     screen never got an answer to — UI-STANDARDS §6. */
  var spendBad = panelUnread('spend');
  var listBad  = panelUnread('list');
  /* the plain amount, with no nul() markup, for use inside an escaped caption */
  var plain = function(v){ return v===null||v===undefined ? null : (Number(v)/100).toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}); };
  return [
    { eyebrow:'SPEND TODAY',
      value: spendBad || !pc ? nul() : cents(pc.spend_today_cents),
      /* .sd is escaped on render, so it must be text — dec() returns the nul SPAN
         when pct_of_ceiling is null (a limit of 0), and that would print as
         visible markup.
         §7 comparison: spend measured against the partner's own daily limit,
         which comes back on the same read. */
      sd: spendBad ? spendBad
        : !pc ? 'no daily limit set for this partner'
        : pc.pct_of_ceiling === null ? 'the daily limit is 0'
        : dec(pc.pct_of_ceiling,2)+'% of this partner’s daily limit' },
    { eyebrow:'HEADROOM TODAY',
      value: spendBad || !pc ? nul() : cents(pc.headroom_cents),
      /* §7 comparison: the daily limit this headroom is left out of. Same read,
         same row — nothing here is fetched or assumed to say it. */
      sd: spendBad ? spendBad
        : !pc ? 'no daily limit set for this partner'
        : plain(pc.daily_limit_cents) === null ? ''
        : 'left of a ' + plain(pc.daily_limit_cents) + ' daily limit' },
    { eyebrow:'SPEND YESTERDAY',
      value: listBad ? nul() : cents(yest),
      sd: listBad ? listBad : 'yesterday, across ' + CAMPAIGNS.length + ' campaigns' },
    { eyebrow:'LIVE CAMPAIGNS',
      value: listBad ? nul() : live + ' / ' + CAMPAIGNS.length,
      sd: listBad ? listBad : 'running right now, out of every campaign' },
    { eyebrow:'ROAS 7D',
      value: listBad || roasMean===null ? nul() : dec(roasMean,2),
      sd: listBad ? listBad
        : 'return on ad spend · average of ' + withRoas.length + ' campaigns, last 7 days' }
  ];
}
function renderTiles(){
  document.getElementById('statRow').innerHTML = tiles().map(function(t){
    return '<div class="stat">'+
      '<span class="eyebrow">'+esc(t.eyebrow)+'</span>'+
      '<div class="sv'+(t.value.length>9?' small':'')+'">'+t.value+'</div>'+
      '<div class="sd">'+esc(t.sd)+'</div></div>';
  }).join('');
}

/* ══ CM-02 · NEEDS ATTENTION ═════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function attention(){
  var breached = CEILINGS.filter(function(c){ return c.breached; });
  var failed = ACTIONS.filter(function(a){ return a.execute_error !== null || a.executed_at === null; });
  var stuck = CONNECTIONS.filter(function(c){ return !c.can_launch || (c.blockers && c.blockers.length); });
  var errs = CAMPAIGNS.filter(function(c){ return !!c.last_error; });
  /* `p` names the read each count comes from. A count of 0 from a read that
     never answered is a false all-clear, so those tiles show an em dash and the
     reason instead of a number — UI-STANDARDS §6. */
  return [
    { n:breached.length, p:'spend', t:'Daily limits already hit', d:'The kill switch stopped spending on these',
      sev: breached.length ? 'bad' : 'ok', go:function(){ UI.spendState='breached'; renderSpend(); jump('secSpend'); } },
    { n:failed.length, p:'log', t:'Changes that did not go through', d:'Written down but never carried out, or the ad platform refused them',
      sev: failed.length ? 'bad' : 'ok', go:function(){ UI.logState='failed'; renderLog(); jump('secLog'); } },
    { n:stuck.length, p:'conn', t:'Connections that cannot go live', d:'Something has to be fixed before a campaign on them can run',
      sev: stuck.length ? 'warn' : 'ok', go:function(){ UI.connState='all'; renderConn(); jump('secConn'); } },
    { n:errs.length, p:'list', t:'Campaigns with an error on them', d:'The ad platform sent back an error, in its own words',
      sev: errs.length ? 'warn' : 'ok', go:function(){ UI.campState='all'; UI.campOffset=0; renderCampaigns(true); jump('secCampaigns'); } }
  ];
}
function jump(id){ var el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'}); }
function renderAttention(){
  var a = attention();
  var host = document.getElementById('attnRow');
  host.innerHTML = a.map(function(x,i){
    var bad = panelUnread(x.p);
    return '<button type="button"'+(bad ? '' : ' class="sev-'+x.sev+'"')+' data-i="'+i+'">'+
      '<div class="an">'+(bad ? NBSP : x.n)+'</div><div class="at">'+esc(x.t)+'</div>'+
      '<div class="ad">'+esc(bad || x.d)+'</div></button>';
  }).join('');
  host.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){ a[Number(b.dataset.i)].go(); });
  });
}
/* ══ CM-04 · CAMPAIGN LIST ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function campMatch(c){
  if(UI.campState !== 'all' && c.approval_state !== UI.campState) return false;
  if(UI.campPlatform !== 'all' && c.platform !== UI.campPlatform) return false;
  if(UI.campOffer !== 'all' && c.offer_type !== UI.campOffer) return false;
  return true;
}
function renderCampaigns(reset){
  if(reset) UI.campOffset = 0;
  var unread = panelUnread('list');
  var counts = {}; CAMP_STATES.forEach(function(s){
    counts[s] = s==='all' ? CAMPAIGNS.length : CAMPAIGNS.filter(function(c){ return c.approval_state===s; }).length;
  });
  rail(document.getElementById('campRail'), CAMP_STATES, UI.campState, unread ? null : counts,
       function(v){ UI.campState=v; renderCampaigns(true); });

  var all = CAMPAIGNS.filter(campMatch);   /* ORDER BY created_at DESC — the array is already in that order */
  var page = all.slice(UI.campOffset, UI.campOffset + UI.campLimit);
  var hasMore = UI.campOffset + UI.campLimit < all.length;

  document.getElementById('campRows').innerHTML = page.length ? page.map(function(c){
    var stripe = c.last_error ? 'stripe-bad' : c.approval_state === 'live' ? 'stripe-ok' : '';
    var dimmed = (c.approval_state === 'archived') ? ' dim' : '';
    var disc = c.offer_type === 'credit_repair'
      ? (c.has_disclosure_asset
          ? '<span class="badge b-ok mono">linked</span>'
          : '<span class="badge b-alert mono" title="A credit repair campaign cannot go live until its disclosure is attached.">not linked</span>')
      : (c.has_disclosure_asset ? '<span class="badge b-ok mono">linked</span>' : '<span class="badge b-gray mono">n/a</span>');
    return '<tr class="rowbtn '+stripe+dimmed+'" data-c="'+esc(c.id)+'" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">'+
      '<td><span class="chev">▸</span><b>'+esc(c.name)+'</b>'+
        (c.last_error ? '<span class="sub" style="color:#6E2A22">error from the ad platform · '+esc(c.last_error.slice(0,72))+(c.last_error.length>72?'…':'')+'</span>' : '')+
        '<span class="sub">created '+dt(c.created_at)+(c.approved_at?' · approved '+dt(c.approved_at):' · not approved')+'</span></td>'+
      '<td class="mono">'+esc(c.platform)+
        (c.platform==='google'?'<span class="sub" title="Google campaigns can be read here but not changed from here.">cannot be changed here</span>':'')+
        (c.special_ad_category?'<span class="sub">cat '+esc(c.special_ad_category)+'</span>':'')+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(words(c.offer_type))+'</td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge '+(APPROVAL_TONE[c.approval_state]||'b-gray')+'">'+esc(words(c.approval_state))+'</span></td>'+
      '<td>'+(c.strategy_key ? esc(words(c.strategy_key)) : nul())+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+cents(c.budget_cents)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+cents(c.spend_yesterday_cents)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+(c.roas_7d===null?nul():dec(c.roas_7d,2))+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+c.ad_set_count+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+c.ad_count+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+disc+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono">'+(c.status ? esc(c.status) : nul())+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono">'+(c.synced_at ? dt(c.synced_at,true) : nul())+'</td>'+
    '</tr>';
  }).join('') : panelRow(13, 'list', CAMPAIGNS.length
      ? 'No campaign matches this filter.'
      : 'No campaigns yet. Press <b>Sync Meta now</b> to pull them in.');

  document.getElementById('campRows').querySelectorAll('tr.rowbtn').forEach(function(tr){
    function open(){ openDrawer(tr.dataset.c); }
    tr.addEventListener('click', open);
    tr.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); open(); } });
  });

  var from = all.length ? UI.campOffset + 1 : 0;
  document.getElementById('campPager').innerHTML =
    /* NOT the endpoint's limit/offset/hasMore envelope — these are client-side
       slice bounds over the single ?limit=200 read wireAll makes. Named
       differently so the row cannot be misread as API paging. A read that did
       not answer has no slice to describe: "0–0 of 0" would read as an empty
       book rather than an unread one. */
    (unread ? '<span>' + esc(unread) + '</span>' :
      '<span>showing ' + from + '–' + (UI.campOffset + page.length) + ' of ' + all.length + '</span>') +
    '<span class="spacer" style="flex:1"></span>' +
    '<button class="btn sm mono" id="cPrev"'+(UI.campOffset<=0?' disabled':'')+'>‹ prev</button>' +
    '<button class="btn sm mono" id="cNext"'+(hasMore?'':' disabled')+'>next ›</button>';
  var p = document.getElementById('cPrev'), n = document.getElementById('cNext');
  if(p) p.addEventListener('click', function(){ UI.campOffset = Math.max(0, UI.campOffset - UI.campLimit); renderCampaigns(); });
  if(n) n.addEventListener('click', function(){ UI.campOffset += UI.campLimit; renderCampaigns(); });
}

/* ══ CM-09 · AD PERFORMANCE — which ad booked a call ═════════════════════
   groups is already sorted books desc, leads desc, key asc by the endpoint
   (api/read/ad-books.mjs foldGroups) — nothing here re-sorts it.
   unknown_ad_ids is only ever populated when UI.adBooksGroupBy is gate, entry,
   primary_offer or secondary_offer — foldGroups skips resolve() entirely for
   lane/ad_id/variant, so an empty list under those three means "not checked",
   not "every ad is named". The cap line below says nothing at all then, rather
   than claim a zero the read never verified. */
function renderAdBooks(){
  var unread = panelUnread('adbooks');
  rail(document.getElementById('adBooksRail'), AD_BOOKS_GROUPS, UI.adBooksGroupBy, null,
       function(v){ UI.adBooksGroupBy = v; readAdBooks(); });

  var groups = (ADBOOKS && ADBOOKS.groups) || [];
  document.getElementById('adBooksRows').innerHTML = groups.length ? groups.map(function(g){
    var rate = g.leads > 0 ? dec(100 * g.books / g.leads, 2) + '%' : nul();
    return '<tr>'+
      '<td><b>'+(g.key==='(none)' ? nul() : esc(words(g.key)))+'</b></td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+int(g.leads)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum"><b>'+int(g.books)+'</b></td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+rate+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono">'+(g.first_book_at?dt(g.first_book_at,true):nul())+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono">'+(g.last_book_at?dt(g.last_book_at,true):nul())+'</td>'+
    '</tr>';
  }).join('') : panelRow(6, 'adbooks',
      'No booked calls attributed to an ad yet, grouped by ' + esc(words(UI.adBooksGroupBy)) + '.');

  document.getElementById('adBooksFoot').textContent = unread ? unread :
    groups.length + ' ' + words(UI.adBooksGroupBy) + (groups.length===1?' group':' groups') +
    ' · ' + ADBOOKS.total_leads + ' leads · ' + ADBOOKS.total_books +
    ' booked calls total · most booked calls first';

  var unk = (ADBOOKS && ADBOOKS.unknown_ad_ids) || [];
  var cap = document.getElementById('adBooksCap');
  if(cap) cap.textContent = unk.length
    ? unk.length + ' ad id' + (unk.length===1?' has':'s have') + ' never been named.'
    : '';
