/* ══ CM-10 · FUNNEL PAGES — ClickFunnels page performance ════════════════
   GET /api/read/funnel-pages → { ok, pages:[{funnel_name,page_name,stat_date,
   views,conversions}], connection:{state,last_synced_at,last_error} or null }.
   Org-wide, staff-only — SRC.funnelPages follows the same shape as CM-09's
   SRC.adbooks above: not one of the five partner-scoped PANELS, not part of
   the "X of 5 panels loaded" count or the loadWarn banner. */
function renderFunnelPages(){
  var unread = panelUnread('funnelPages');
  var cap = document.getElementById('funnelConnCap');
  if(cap){
    /* Silent while the read is still in flight — connection state is a claim
       about a row this screen has not seen yet. Filled in only once the read
       has answered, same rule as spendGapCap. */
    if(unread){
      cap.textContent = '';
    } else if(!FUNNEL_CONN || FUNNEL_CONN.state !== 'active'){
      cap.innerHTML = '<b>Not connected yet — see Connections below.</b>' +
        (FUNNEL_CONN && FUNNEL_CONN.last_error ? ' ' + esc(FUNNEL_CONN.last_error) : '');
    } else {
      cap.innerHTML = 'Connected · last synced ' +
        (FUNNEL_CONN.last_synced_at ? dt(FUNNEL_CONN.last_synced_at, true) : nul());
    }
  }

  document.getElementById('funnelPagesRows').innerHTML = FUNNEL_PAGES.length ? FUNNEL_PAGES.map(function(p){
    return '<tr>'+
      '<td><b>'+(p.funnel_name ? esc(p.funnel_name) : nul())+'</b></td>'+
      '<td>'+(p.page_name ? esc(p.page_name) : nul())+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono">'+(p.stat_date ? day(p.stat_date) : nul())+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+int(p.views)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+int(p.conversions)+'</td>'+
    '</tr>';
  }).join('') : panelRow(5, 'funnelPages', 'No funnel page stats yet.');

  document.getElementById('funnelPagesFoot').textContent = unread ? unread :
    FUNNEL_PAGES.length + ' page' + (FUNNEL_PAGES.length===1?'':'s') + ' · most recent first';
}

function readFunnelPages(){
  return apiGet('/api/read/funnel-pages').then(function(res){
    var s = SRC.funnelPages;
    if(res.ok){
      delete PANEL_MSG.funnelPages;
      s.source = 'api'; s.note = '';
      var pages = (res.data && res.data.pages) || [];
      s.rows = pages.length;
      try {
        FUNNEL_PAGES = pages;
        FUNNEL_CONN = (res.data && res.data.connection) || null;
        renderFunnelPages();
      } catch(e){
        PANEL_MSG.funnelPages = 'This could not be shown. Press Reload to try again.';
        s.source = 'error'; s.note = PANEL_MSG.funnelPages; s.rows = null;
        try { FUNNEL_PAGES = []; FUNNEL_CONN = null; renderFunnelPages(); } catch(e2){}
      }
    } else {
      PANEL_MSG.funnelPages = readFailureText(res);
      s.source = res.source; s.note = PANEL_MSG.funnelPages; s.rows = null;
      try { FUNNEL_PAGES = []; FUNNEL_CONN = null; renderFunnelPages(); } catch(e){}
    }
    renderSources();
    return res;
  });
}

/* ══ CM-11 · WHICH ANGLE AND WHICH HOOK ARE WORKING ══════════════════════
   GET /api/read/ad-spine?group_by=…&days=… → one row per label, with what that
   label cost and what it brought. Items arrive already sorted most ads first,
   then key (api/read/ad-spine.mjs:459) — nothing here re-sorts them.

   THE ONE RULE THIS PANEL EXISTS TO KEEP: A BLANK IS NOT A ZERO.
   The endpoint hands back null for "nobody told us" and a real number for a real
   zero, deliberately and throughout (api/read/ad-spine.mjs:106-127). So every
   cell below asks "did the server say null?" BEFORE it formats anything. A null
   paints a grey dash carrying the endpoint's own plain sentence on hover; a real
   zero paints as 0 in ink. Nothing here coalesces one into the other, and nothing
   here invents a number the read refused to give.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* A grey dash that can say why. cents()/int()/dec() already paint a bare dash for
   null; this one is for the cells where the endpoint ALSO handed back a reason,
   so the reason is not thrown away on the way to the screen. */
function unknownCell(why){
  return '<span class="nul" title="' + esc(why) + '">' + NBSP + '</span>';
}

/* MEASURED → the rate as a percent, INCLUDING a real 0.0%. Anything else → the
   dash plus watchRate()'s own sentence (src/ops/meta-marketing.mjs:89), which
   already separates "there was no video at all" from "too few to divide". */
function rateCell(r){
  if(r && r.status === 'MEASURED' && r.rate !== null && r.rate !== undefined){
    return (Number(r.rate) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';
  }
  return unknownCell((r && r.note) || 'Not reported. This is not a zero.');
}

/* The label's name, its key, and the honest version of either being absent.
   A NULL KEY is the group of ads nobody has labelled. It is counted, never
   dropped (api/read/ad-spine.mjs:98-104), because "how many ads nobody has
   labelled" is one of the numbers worth seeing.
   A NULL NAME ON A LANE IS NOT A GAP: lane is a fixed list in the database and
   has no dictionary row to find (api/read/ad-spine.mjs:219-225), so no "no name
   yet" line is printed for it. */
function spineName(g){
  var kind = words(UI.spineGroupBy);
  if(g.key === null || g.key === undefined || g.key === ''){
    return '<b>No ' + esc(kind) + ' set</b><span class="sub">nobody has said yet</span>';
  }
  if(g.name) return '<b>' + esc(g.name) + '</b><span class="sub">' + esc(g.key) + '</span>';
  if(UI.spineGroupBy === 'lane') return '<b>' + esc(words(g.key)) + '</b>';
  return '<b>' + esc(words(g.key)) + '</b><span class="sub">no name written down for it yet</span>';
}

/* THE EMPTY STATE IS THE NORMAL STATE TODAY, so it says why rather than looking
   like a fault. Zero groups means zero ads on file AT ALL: the view returns one
   row per ad and an unlabelled ad still lands in the null-key group, so "no
   groups" can never mean "ads exist but nobody labelled them". */
function spineEmptyMsg(){
  return 'No ads on file yet, so there is nothing to group. ' +
    'Ads arrive when you press <b>Sync Meta now</b> further down this page. ' +
    'Angles and hooks arrive after that: write a script with its labels, make a creative from ' +
    'that script, then say which creative runs on which ad.';
}

function renderAdSpine(){
  var unread = panelUnread('adspine');
  rail(document.getElementById('spineRail'), SPINE_GROUPS, UI.spineGroupBy, null,
       function(v){ UI.spineGroupBy = v; readAdSpine(); });

  var items = (SPINE && SPINE.items) || [];
  document.getElementById('spineRows').innerHTML = items.length ? items.map(function(g){
    var spend = (g.spend_cents === null || g.spend_cents === undefined)
      ? unknownCell('No day of spend was reported for these ads in this window. That is not the same as spending nothing.')
      : cents(g.spend_cents);
    var noMatch = 'No ad in this group has our ad number on it, so nobody could be matched to it even in principle. That is not the same as nobody arriving.';
    var people = (g.people === null || g.people === undefined) ? unknownCell(noMatch) : int(g.people);
    var booked = (g.people_booked === null || g.people_booked === undefined)
      ? unknownCell(noMatch)
      : '<b>' + int(g.people_booked) + '</b>';
    /* THE REFUSAL IS SHOWN, NOT HIDDEN. Under the sample size costPerBooked()
       will divide on, it returns no cost and a plain sentence saying how many are
       needed and how many there are (src/ops/meta-marketing.mjs:17). That
       sentence is printed. A blank here, or a made-up number, would both be
       worse than the refusal. */
    /* THE CELL IS NOT nowrap AND THE NUMBER IS. .mnum sets white-space:nowrap
       (:158), and the printed sentence below inherits it, so a 48-character
       refusal was forced onto one line and pushed hook rate and hold rate off
       the right edge — in the state every group is in today. So the column
       carries no class and only the figure wears .mnum.
       The reason is said ONCE: printed under the dash when there is one to
       print, on hover when there is not. */
    var c = g.cost_per_booked_person || {};
    var cost = (c.status === 'MEASURED' && c.cost_cents !== null && c.cost_cents !== undefined)
      ? '<span class="mnum"><b>' + cents(c.cost_cents) + '</b></span>'
      : (c.note
          ? '<span class="nul">' + NBSP + '</span><span class="sub">' + esc(c.note) + '</span>'
          : unknownCell('Not worked out.'));
    return '<tr>' +
      '<td>' + spineName(g) + '</td>' +
      /* Same reason as the cost cell in this row: the sentence under the count is
         held on one line by .mnum's nowrap unless the CELL is free of it.
         Measured in a 1200px card with both cells fixed, the table lands at
         exactly 1200px and hook rate and hold rate are on screen; with the
         classes on the cells it needed 1434px. */
      '<td><span class="mnum"><b>' + int(g.ads) + '</b></span>' +
        '<span class="sub">' + int(g.ads_reported_in_window) + ' reported in this window</span></td>' +
      '<td class="mnum">' + spend + '</td>' +
      '<td class="mnum">' + people + '</td>' +
      '<td class="mnum">' + booked + '</td>' +
      '<td>' + cost + '</td>' +
      '<td class="mnum">' + rateCell(g.hook_rate) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="mnum">' + rateCell(g.hold_rate) + '</td>' +
    '</tr>';
  }).join('') : panelRow(8, 'adspine', spineEmptyMsg());

  var w = (SPINE && SPINE.window) || null;
  document.getElementById('spineFoot').textContent = unread ? unread :
    items.length + ' ' + words(UI.spineGroupBy) + (items.length === 1 ? ' group' : ' groups') +
    (w ? ' · money covers ' + w.from + ' to ' + w.to : '') +
    ' · most ads first' +
    (SPINE && SPINE.hasMore ? ' · only the first ' + SPINE.limit + ' are shown' : '');

  /* Two sentences that only appear when they are true, and both are about
     whether a zero below can be believed. Silent while the read is in flight —
     a claim about rows this screen has not seen yet is the same false all-clear
     as a zero printed before a read answered. */
  var cap = document.getElementById('spineCap');
  if(cap){
    var notes = [];
    /* Both notes are about how to read a NUMBER IN THE TABLE, so neither is
       said when there is no table — the empty state above already explains
       itself and does not need a warning about columns that are not there. */
    if(!unread && items.length){
      /* people_rows_in_window is the whole-company sanity check the endpoint
         carries for exactly this purpose (api/read/ad-spine.mjs:560-579). */
      if(SPINE && SPINE.people_rows_in_window === 0){
        notes.push('<b>Nobody was recorded arriving from any ad in these days.</b> If calls were still ' +
                   'coming in, arrivals are not being recorded — so do not read the people columns as a real zero.');
      }
      var anyDay = items.some(function(g){ return Number(g.ad_days_reported) > 0; });
      if(!anyDay){
        notes.push('<b>No ad spend has been reported for these days</b>, so every money column is blank ' +
                   'rather than zero. Spend arrives once a Meta ad account is connected below and ' +
                   '<b>Sync Meta now</b> has been pressed.');
      }
    }
    cap.innerHTML = notes.join('<br>');
    cap.style.display = notes.length ? '' : 'none';
  }
}

/* GET /api/read/ad-spine. Reproduces wirePanel's outcome contract by hand for the
   same reason readAdBooks does: the response is { ok, items, window, … }, not
   { ok, data:{ items } }, so wirePanel's items-only unwrap does not fit it. Not
   run through scoped() — the endpoint takes no partner_id, org comes off the
   session — so this never sends partner_id even when one is picked above. */
function readAdSpine(){
  var seq = ++SPINE_SEQ;
  /* Back to "Reading…" before the new read goes out. The group and the window
     are both SERVER queries, so leaving the old rows up would put last window's
     numbers under this window's heading. */
  delete PANEL_MSG.adspine;
  SRC.adspine = { source:'…', note:'', rows:null };
  try { SPINE = null; renderAdSpine(); } catch(e){}

  return apiGet('/api/read/ad-spine?group_by=' + encodeURIComponent(UI.spineGroupBy) +
                '&days=' + encodeURIComponent(UI.spineDays) + '&limit=200').then(function(res){
    if(seq !== SPINE_SEQ) return res;                /* a newer pick won */
    var s = SRC.adspine;
    if(res.ok){
      delete PANEL_MSG.adspine;
      s.source = 'api';
      s.note = '';
      s.rows = (res.data && res.data.items) ? res.data.items.length : 0;
      try { SPINE = res.data; renderAdSpine(); }
      catch(e){
        PANEL_MSG.adspine = 'This could not be shown. Press Reload to try again.';
        s.source = 'error'; s.note = PANEL_MSG.adspine; s.rows = null;
        try { SPINE = null; renderAdSpine(); } catch(e2){}
      }
    } else {
      /* readFailureText's badrequest branch says "pick a partner", which is the
         wrong sentence here — this endpoint is org-wide and never takes one. */
      PANEL_MSG.adspine = res.source === 'badrequest'
        ? 'This report could not be read with those settings. Press Reload to try again.'
        : readFailureText(res);
      s.source = res.source;
      s.note = PANEL_MSG.adspine;
      s.rows = null;
      try { SPINE = null; renderAdSpine(); } catch(e){}
    }
    return res;
  });
}

/* ══ CM-07 · CONNECTIONS ═════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderConn(){
  var unread = panelUnread('conn');
  var counts = {}; CONN_STATES.forEach(function(s){
    counts[s] = s==='all' ? CONNECTIONS.length : CONNECTIONS.filter(function(c){ return c.connection_state===s; }).length;
  });
  rail(document.getElementById('connRail'), CONN_STATES, UI.connState, unread ? null : counts,
       function(v){ UI.connState=v; renderConn(); });

  var rows = CONNECTIONS.filter(function(c){ return UI.connState==='all' || c.connection_state===UI.connState; });
  document.getElementById('connRows').innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.map(function(c){
    var stripe = (!c.can_launch) ? 'stripe-bad' : (c.blockers && c.blockers.length) ? 'stripe-warn' : 'stripe-ok';
    var tok = c.has_access_token
      ? (c.token_expired
          ? '<span class="badge b-alert mono">expired</span>'

                 '<div class="sub" style="margin-top:3px;letter-spacing:0;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--gray)">'+esc(b.title)+' — '+esc(b.detail)+'</div></div>';
        }).join('')
      : '<span class="badge b-ok mono">none</span>';
    return '<tr class="'+stripe+'">'+
      '<td><b class="mono">'+esc(c.platform)+'</b>'+
        (c.platform==='google'?'<span class="sub">cannot be changed here</span>':'')+

        '<span class="sub">'+(c.external_business_id?'biz '+esc(c.external_business_id):'no business id')+'</span>'+
        '</td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge '+(CONNSTATE_TONE[c.connection_state]||'b-gray')+'">'+esc(words(c.connection_state))+'</span></td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge '+(VERIF_TONE[c.platform_verification_state]||'b-gray')+'">'+esc(words(c.platform_verification_state))+'</span></td>'+
      '<td>'+tok+'<span class="sub">expires '+(c.token_expires_at?dt(c.token_expires_at,true):'—  (unknown, not “forever”)')+'</span>'+
        '<span class="sub">renewal key '+(c.has_refresh_token?'stored':'not stored')+'</span>'+
        '<span class="sub">last synced '+(c.last_synced_at?dt(c.last_synced_at,true):'never')+'</span></td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+c.campaign_count+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+(c.can_launch?'<span class="badge b-ok mono">yes</span>':'<span class="badge b-alert mono">no</span>')+'</td>'+

/* ══ CM-08 · ACTION LOG ══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function targetLabel(a){
  /* The endpoint returns target_id and target_type — no name. Resolved here
     against rows this screen already holds; anything it has not loaded stays
     an id rather than being invented. */
  if(a.target_type === 'campaign' && CAMP_BY_ID[a.target_id]) return CAMP_BY_ID[a.target_id].name;
  if(a.target_type === 'ad_set' && ADSET_BY_ID[a.target_id]){
    var e = ADSET_BY_ID[a.target_id];
    return e.set.name + ' · ' + (CAMP_BY_ID[e.campaign_id] ? CAMP_BY_ID[e.campaign_id].name : '');
  }
  if(a.target_type === 'connection' && CONN_BY_ID[a.target_id]){
    var c = CONN_BY_ID[a.target_id];
    return c.platform + ' · ' + c.external_ad_account_id;
  }
  return a.target_id ? a.target_id : null;
}
function diffCell(a){
  var b = a.before || {}, af = a.after || {};
  var keys = Object.keys(af).length ? Object.keys(af) : Object.keys(b);
  if(!keys.length) return nul();
  return keys.map(function(k){
    var was = b[k], now = af[k];
    var fmt = function(v){
      if(v === undefined) return NBSP;
      if(v === null) return 'null';
      if(typeof v === 'boolean') return String(v);
      if(k.indexOf('cents') !== -1 && typeof v === 'number') return (v/100).toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});
      return String(v);
    };
    return '<span class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption)">'+esc(k)+'</span><br>'+
           '<span class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--gray2)">'+esc(fmt(was))+'</span>'+
           '<span class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--gray2)"> → </span>'+
           '<span class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body);font-weight:600">'+esc(fmt(now))+'</span>';
  }).join('<div style="height:4px"></div>');
}
function logMatch(a){
  if(UI.logState==='agent' && a.actor!=='agent') return false;
  if(UI.logState==='human' && a.actor!=='human') return false;
  if(UI.logState==='revertible' && !a.revertible) return false;
  if(UI.logState==='failed' && !(a.execute_error !== null || a.executed_at === null)) return false;
  if(UI.logTarget!=='all' && a.target_type!==UI.logTarget) return false;
  if(UI.logRule!=='all' && a.rule_key!==UI.logRule) return false;
  return true;
}
function renderLog(){
  var unread = panelUnread('log');
  var counts = {
    all: ACTIONS.length,
    agent: ACTIONS.filter(function(a){return a.actor==='agent';}).length,
    human: ACTIONS.filter(function(a){return a.actor==='human';}).length,
    revertible: ACTIONS.filter(function(a){return a.revertible;}).length,
    failed: ACTIONS.filter(function(a){return a.execute_error!==null || a.executed_at===null;}).length
  };
  rail(document.getElementById('logRail'), LOG_STATES, UI.logState, unread ? null : counts,
       function(v){ UI.logState=v; renderLog(); });

  var rows = ACTIONS.filter(logMatch);
  document.getElementById('logRows').innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.map(function(a,i){
    var o = outcomeOf(a);
    var stripe = o.k==='failed' ? 'stripe-bad' : o.k==='unexecuted' ? 'stripe-warn' : o.k==='reverted' ? '' : 'stripe-ok';
    var who = a.actor==='agent'
      ? '<span class="badge b-accent mono">agent</span><span class="sub">'+(a.agent_name?esc(a.agent_name):'no name recorded')+'</span>'
      : '<span class="badge b-info mono">human</span><span class="sub">'+(a.user_name?esc(a.user_name):'no name recorded')+'</span>';
    var lbl = targetLabel(a);
    return '<tr class="rowbtn '+stripe+'" data-a="'+i+'" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">'+
      '<td class="mono"><span class="chev">▸</span>'+dt(a.created_at,true)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+who+'</td>'+
      '<td><span style="font-size:var(--fs-caption)">'+esc(words(a.target_type))+'</span>'+
        '<span class="sub" style="letter-spacing:0;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--ink)">'+(lbl?esc(lbl):'<span class="nul">nothing recorded</span>')+'</span></td>'+
      '<td>'+(a.rule_key?esc(words(a.rule_key)):nul())+'</td>'+
      '<td style="max-width:280px">'+esc(a.reason)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+diffCell(a)+'</td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge '+o.cls+' mono">'+esc(o.t)+'</span></td>'+
      '<td>'+(a.revertible
        ? '<span class="badge b-accent mono" title="A flag only. Nothing on this screen can undo it.">revertible</span>'
        : '<span class="badge b-gray mono">no</span>')+'</td>'+
    '</tr>';
  }).join('') : panelRow(8, 'log',
      ((UI.logRule==='cpa_over_target' || UI.logRule==='cpa_recovering')
        ? 'Nothing here until someone sets a target cost per sale.'
        : (UI.logRule==='learning_phase'
            ? 'Nothing here. This rule only ever leaves ad sets alone.'
            : (ACTIONS.length
                ? 'No action matches this filter.'
                : 'Nothing has been done to these campaigns yet.'))));

  document.getElementById('logRows').querySelectorAll('tr.rowbtn').forEach(function(tr){
    function toggle(){
      var open = tr.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      if(open){ tr.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); if(tr._d){ tr._d.remove(); tr._d = null; } return; }
      var a = rows[Number(tr.dataset.a)];
      var det = document.createElement('tr');
      det.className = 'det';
      var td = document.createElement('td');
      td.colSpan = 8;
      td.innerHTML = '<div class="detwrap">' +
        '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">reference</div><div class="dv mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+esc(a.id)+'</div></div>' +
        '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">carried out</div><div class="dv mono">'+(a.executed_at?dt(a.executed_at,true):'<span class="nul">never</span>')+'</div></div>' +
        '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">undone</div><div class="dv mono">'+(a.undone_at?dt(a.undone_at,true):'<span class="nul">no</span>')+'</div></div>' +
        '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">what it changed</div><div class="dv mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+(a.target_id?esc(a.target_id):'<span class="nul">nothing recorded</span>')+'</div></div>' +
        '<div class="detcol" style="flex:1;min-width:240px"><div class="dk">the numbers at the time</div>' +
          '<div class="jsonbox">'+esc(JSON.stringify(a.metrics_snapshot, null, 1))+'</div></div>' +
        '<div class="detcol" style="flex:1;min-width:200px"><div class="dk">before → after</div>' +
          '<div class="jsonbox">'+esc(jsonline(a.before))+'\n→\n'+esc(jsonline(a.after))+'</div></div>' +
        (a.execute_error ? '<div class="detcol" style="flex:1;min-width:260px"><div class="dk">what the ad platform said</div>' +
          '<div class="errbox">'+esc(a.execute_error)+'</div></div>' : '') +
      '</div>';
      det.appendChild(td);
      tr.parentNode.insertBefore(det, tr.nextSibling);
      tr._d = det;
      tr.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    }
    tr.addEventListener('click', toggle);
    tr.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); toggle(); } });
  });

  document.getElementById('logFoot').textContent = unread ? unread :
    rows.length + ' of ' + ACTIONS.length + ' actions · newest first · nothing here can be edited or deleted';
}
/* ══ CM-05 · CAMPAIGN DETAIL DRAWER ══════════════════════════════════════
   THIS PANEL IS ITS OWN READ. /api/campaigns/detail is the only endpoint that
   returns `targeting`, the ad sets, the daily series and the campaign's own
   action history — none of that is on the list row — so the drawer cannot be
   rendered from the list and claim to be the detail endpoint. It opens on the
   list row already in memory, then fills in when the read answers.
   DW.detail null means the detail read has not answered: the ad sets, the daily
   series and the campaign's own action history are shown as empty rather than
   guessed at, and CM-01's detail row says what happened.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var DW = { id:null, days:30, metric:'spend_cents', detail:null, seq:0 };

/* metrics_daily comes back with `date` as a full timestamp once it has been
   through JSON, and every sum()/avg() as a numeric STRING. The formatters all
   Number() their input; only the date needs narrowing back to a day. */
function normalizeSeries(rows){
  return (rows || []).map(function(r){
    var o = {}, k;
    for(k in r){ if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r,k)) o[k] = r[k]; }
    o.date = String(r.date).slice(0,10);
    return o;
  });
}
var METRICS = [
  { k:'spend_cents',  label:'spend',       agg:'SUM', fmt:function(v){return cents(v);},  kind:'bar' },
  { k:'impressions',  label:'impressions', agg:'SUM', fmt:function(v){return int(v);},    kind:'bar' },
  { k:'clicks',       label:'clicks',      agg:'SUM', fmt:function(v){return int(v);},    kind:'bar' },
  { k:'conversions',  label:'conversions', agg:'SUM', fmt:function(v){return int(v);},    kind:'bar' },
  { k:'frequency',    label:'frequency',   agg:'AVG', fmt:function(v){return dec(v,2);},  kind:'line' },
  { k:'ctr',          label:'ctr',         agg:'AVG', fmt:function(v){return pctv(v);},   kind:'line' },
  { k:'cpa_cents',    label:'cpa',         agg:'AVG', fmt:function(v){return cents(v);},  kind:'line' },
  { k:'roas',         label:'roas',        agg:'AVG', fmt:function(v){return dec(v,2);},  kind:'line' }
];
function metricDef(k){ return METRICS.filter(function(m){ return m.k===k; })[0] || METRICS[0]; }

/* One series, one hue. Counts get bars anchored at zero with 4px rounded ends
   and a 2px gap; rates get a 2px line. Both axes start at zero — a truncated
   baseline on a ratio is the oldest lie in charting. No second y-axis, ever. */
function chartSVG(series, mk){
  var m = metricDef(mk);
  var vals = series.map(function(d){ var v = d[mk]; return v===null||v===undefined ? null : Number(v); });
  var known = vals.filter(function(v){ return v !== null; });
  if(!known.length) return '<div class="empty">Nothing was recorded for '+esc(m.label)+' in this window.</div>';
  var max = Math.max.apply(null, known);
  if(max <= 0) max = 1;
  var top = max * 1.10;
  var W = 720, H = 190, L = 52, R = 14, T = 14, B = 28;
  var pw = W - L - R, ph = H - T - B;
  var n = series.length;
  var x = function(i){ return L + (n === 1 ? pw/2 : (pw * i / (n - 1))); };
  var xb = function(i){ return L + pw * i / n; };
  var y = function(v){ return T + ph - (v / top) * ph; };
  var s = ['<svg viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" role="img" aria-label="'+esc(m.label)+' by day, '+n+' days, maximum '+esc(String(max))+'">'];
  /* recessive gridlines + axis labels */
  for(var g=0; g<=3; g++){
    var gv = top * g / 3, gy = y(gv);
    s.push('<line class="gl" x1="'+L+'" y1="'+gy.toFixed(1)+'" x2="'+(W-R)+'" y2="'+gy.toFixed(1)+'"/>');
    s.push('<text class="ax" x="'+(L-7)+'" y="'+(gy+3).toFixed(1)+'" text-anchor="end">'+
           esc(String(m.k.indexOf('cents')!==-1 ? (gv/100).toFixed(0) : (top<12 ? gv.toFixed(1) : Math.round(gv).toLocaleString('en-US'))))+'</text>');
  }
  var useBars = m.kind === 'bar' && n <= 60;
  if(useBars){
    var bw = Math.max(1, pw/n - (n > 40 ? 1 : 2));
    series.forEach(function(d,i){
      var v = vals[i]; if(v === null) return;
      var h = Math.max(1, T + ph - y(v));
      s.push('<rect x="'+xb(i).toFixed(1)+'" y="'+y(v).toFixed(1)+'" width="'+bw.toFixed(1)+'" height="'+h.toFixed(1)+
             '" rx="2" fill="#A9C6E8"/>');
    });
  } else {
    var pts = [], area = [];
    series.forEach(function(d,i){ var v = vals[i]; if(v===null) return; pts.push(x(i).toFixed(1)+','+y(v).toFixed(1)); });
    if(pts.length){
      s.push('<polyline points="'+pts.join(' ')+'" fill="none" stroke="#A9C6E8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>');
      if(n <= 45) series.forEach(function(d,i){
        var v = vals[i]; if(v===null) return;
        s.push('<circle cx="'+x(i).toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+y(v).toFixed(1)+'" r="2.6" fill="#A9C6E8" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2"/>');
      });
    }
  }
  /* one direct label — the peak. Never a number on every point. */
  var mi = vals.indexOf(max);
  if(mi >= 0){
    var lx = useBars ? xb(mi) + (pw/n)/2 : x(mi);
    s.push('<text class="lbl" x="'+Math.min(W-R-4, Math.max(L+4, lx)).toFixed(1)+'" y="'+Math.max(T+9, y(max)-6).toFixed(1)+
           '" text-anchor="middle">'+esc(String(m.k.indexOf('cents')!==-1 ? (max/100).toFixed(0) : (max<12? max.toFixed(2) : Math.round(max).toLocaleString('en-US'))))+'</text>');
  }
  /* x axis — first, middle, last only */
  [0, Math.floor((n-1)/2), n-1].filter(function(v,i,a){ return a.indexOf(v)===i && v>=0; }).forEach(function(i){
    var px = useBars ? xb(i) + (pw/n)/2 : x(i);
    s.push('<text class="ax" x="'+px.toFixed(1)+'" y="'+(H-9)+'" text-anchor="'+(i===0?'start':i===n-1?'end':'middle')+'">'+
           esc(series[i].date.slice(5))+'</text>');
  });
  s.push('<line class="cursorline" id="dwCursor" x1="0" y1="'+T+'" x2="0" y2="'+(T+ph)+'" style="opacity:0"/>');
  s.push('</svg>');
  return s.join('');
}

function renderDrawerBody(){
  /* the /detail body when it answered, otherwise the list row this screen holds.
     Named `det`, not `d`: the callbacks below already bind `d` to a series row. */
  var det = DW.detail;
  var c = det || CAMP_BY_ID[DW.id];
  var host = document.getElementById('dwBody');
  var sub = document.getElementById('dwSub');
  if(sub) sub.textContent = 'last ' + DW.days + ' days' +
    (det ? '' : c ? ' · still loading' : '');
  if(!c){
    host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">This campaign could not be shown.</div>';
    return;
  }
  /* Until /detail answers there are NO ad sets and NO daily series to show. They
     used to be filled from a built-in sample book and a client-side generator;
     both were invented numbers on a real campaign's page (UI-STANDARDS §6). */
  var sets   = det ? (det.ad_sets || []) : (AD_SETS[c.id] || []);
  var series = det ? normalizeSeries(det.metrics_daily) : [];
  var m = metricDef(DW.metric);
  /* a write must never be sent when this screen has no partner at all */
  var canWrite = hasPartnerScope();
  var cwHint = canWrite
    ? 'These change the real ad account on Meta. You confirm first.'
    : 'Pick a partner first. These need one ad account.';

  var sum = function(k){ return series.reduce(function(n,d){ return n + Number(d[k]||0); }, 0); };
  var avg = function(k){
    var v = series.map(function(d){ return d[k]; }).filter(function(x){ return x!==null && x!==undefined; });
    return v.length ? v.reduce(function(n,x){ return n + Number(x); },0)/v.length : null;
  };

  /* Plain labels, and the two at the bottom now show what the record actually
     holds. They were hardcoded to "null" with a note saying nothing writes them;
     Sync Meta now does write both, so the hardcoded null had become a claim the
     record could contradict (UI-STANDARDS §6). */

    ['Approval', '<span class="badge '+(APPROVAL_TONE[c.approval_state]||'b-gray')+'">'+esc(words(c.approval_state))+'</span>'],
    ['Ad platform', '<span class="mono">'+esc(c.platform)+'</span>'],
    ['Offer', esc(words(c.offer_type))],
    ['Special ad category', c.special_ad_category
        ? '<span class="mono">'+esc(c.special_ad_category)+'</span>'
        : '<span class="nul mono">none</span><span class="sub">Meta only — blank is correct here.</span>'],
    ['Objective', c.objective ? '<span class="mono">'+esc(c.objective)+'</span>' : '<span class="nul mono">none</span>'],
    ['Daily budget', '<span class="mono">'+cents(c.budget_cents)+'</span>'],
    ['Approved', c.approved_at ? '<span class="mono">'+dt(c.approved_at,true)+'</span>' : '<span class="nul mono">not approved</span>'],
    ['Disclosure attached', c.has_disclosure_asset
        ? '<span class="badge b-ok mono">yes</span>'

    ['Strategy', c.strategy_key ? esc(words(c.strategy_key)) : '<span class="nul mono">none</span>'],
    ['Status on the ad platform', c.status ? '<span class="mono">'+esc(c.status)+'</span>' : '<span class="nul mono">not known</span><span class="sub">fills in after Sync Meta now</span>'],
    ['Last synced', c.synced_at ? '<span class="mono">'+dt(c.synced_at,true)+'</span>' : '<span class="nul mono">never</span>'],
    ['Created', '<span class="mono">'+dt(c.created_at,true)+'</span>']
  ];

  var setRows = sets.length ? sets.map(function(s){
    return '<tr class="'+(s.in_learning_phase?'stripe-warn':'')+'">'+
      '<td><b>'+esc(s.name)+'</b></td>'+
      /* Through words(), and no mono, so this reads the same as the campaign
         table's Approval column at :960 and the drawer's own Approval row two

  var acts = det ? (det.recent_actions || []) : ACTIONS.filter(function(a){

  }).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty">' +
      (det ? 'No action has ever touched this campaign or its ad sets.'
           : (panelUnread('log') ? esc(panelUnread('log'))
                                 : 'No action has ever touched this campaign or its ad sets.')) +

  var tail = series.slice(-14).reverse();

  host.innerHTML =
    '<div class="dw-sec"><div class="eyebrow" style="margin-bottom:8px">HEADER</div>' +
      '<div class="kv">' + kv.map(function(p){ return '<div><div class="k">'+esc(p[0])+'</div><div class="v">'+p[1]+'</div></div>'; }).join('') + '</div>' +
      '<div style="margin-top:14px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--wash,#fafafa)">' +
        '<div class="eyebrow" style="margin-bottom:8px">CHANGE THIS CAMPAIGN ON META</div>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:end">' +
          '<button type="button" class="btn mono" data-cw="pause"'+(canWrite?'':' disabled')+'>Stop spending</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="btn mono" data-cw="resume"'+(canWrite?'':' disabled')+'>Start spending again</button>' +
          '<div class="selwrap"><label for="cwBudget">New daily budget, in cents</label>' +
            '<input id="cwBudget" class="inp mono" type="number" min="100" step="100" value="' +
              esc(c.budget_cents != null ? c.budget_cents : '') + '" style="width:140px"'+(canWrite?'':' disabled')+'></div>' +
          '<button type="button" class="btn dark mono" data-cw="update_budget"'+(canWrite?'':' disabled')+'>Change daily budget</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="hint mono" id="cwMsg" style="margin-top:8px;font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray2)">' + esc(cwHint) + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +

        ? '<div style="margin-top:10px"><div class="k mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:4px">What the ad platform said</div>' +
          '<div class="errbox">'+esc(c.last_error)+'</div>' +
          '<p class="note" style="margin-top:6px">Only the latest one is kept here. Earlier ones are in the action list below.</p></div>'
        : '') +
      '<div style="margin-top:10px"><div class="k mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:4px">Who this campaign targets</div>' +
        '<div class="jsonbox">'+esc(JSON.stringify(c.targeting || {}, null, 1))+'</div></div>' +
    '</div>' +

    '<div class="dw-sec"><div class="eyebrow" style="margin-bottom:8px">AD SETS</div>' +

      '</div>' +
      '<div class="metricrail rail" id="dwMetrics">' + METRICS.map(function(x){
          return '<button type="button" data-m="'+x.k+'"'+(DW.metric===x.k?' class="on"':'')+'>'+esc(x.label)+'<span class="n">'+x.agg+'</span></button>';

      (series.length
        ? '<div class="chartwrap" id="dwChart">'+chartSVG(series, DW.metric)+'<div class="tip" id="dwTip"></div></div>'

      (series.length
        ? '<div class="kv" style="margin-top:11px;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))">' +

            '<div><div class="k">conversions · total</div><div class="v mono">'+int(sum('conversions'))+'</div></div>' +
            '<div><div class="k">times per person · average</div><div class="v mono">'+dec(avg('frequency'),2)+'</div></div>' +
