       Chris, on the live screen: "this is janky and not clear."
       The same four rows are now a real list under the step that says to remove
       them, so keeping this was duplication in the worse of the two formats.
       The count tile beside it still answers "how many". */
    if (names) { names.textContent = ""; names.hidden = true; }
    paintNextInquiries(found.rows, sample);
  }

  /* WHY A REMOVAL CASE SAYS BLOCKED, AND WHERE IT GETS UNBLOCKED.
     "Blocked" was printed on its own, with no reason and no route out. There is
     exactly one thing that sets it: the send gate refuses because the identity
     packet is not complete (src/inquiry-ops/send.mjs:153-176, using
     checkDocPacket in src/inquiry-ops/doc-gate.mjs). So the reason is known and
     can be said outright. */
  function paintInquiryCaseHelp(irc) {
    var why = $("ccp-ir-why");
    var link = $("ccp-ir-unblock");
    var blocked = false;
    try { blocked = String((irc && irc.case_status) || "").trim().toLowerCase() === "blocked"; }
    catch (e) { blocked = false; }
    if (why) {
      why.textContent = blocked
        ? "Blocked means the identity packet is not finished. We will not post a dispute "
          + "letter without a government photo ID, proof of address and a signed authorization. "
          + "Add whichever is missing and the case moves on by itself."
        : "";
      why.hidden = !blocked;
    }
    if (link) link.hidden = !blocked;
  }

  function tickClock() {
    var node = $("ccp-clock");
    if (!node) return;
    node.textContent = new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", {
      weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric",
      hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit",
      timeZone: "America/Phoenix", timeZoneName: "short"
    });
  }
  tickClock();
  setInterval(tickClock, 1000);

  /* Where this screen's numbers came from. It used to be a full-width butter,
     mint or rose bar pinned over the bottom of the page. Owner call,
     2026-08-27: no coloured bars anywhere on the CRM. Same sentence, written
     into the status strip that was already at the foot of this screen, so
     nothing that was being said is lost. A failed read is the one case that
     still gets a colour, and it is text, not a bar. */
  function source(tone, text) {
    var node = $("ccp-source");
    if (!node) return;
    node.textContent = text;
    node.className = "sb-source" + (tone === "error" ? " is-bad" : "");
  }

  function paintBlockers(blockers, holdReason) {
    var list = $("ccp-blocker-list");
    var why = $("ccp-why-label");
    if (!list) return;
    list.textContent = "";
    var rows = Array.isArray(blockers) ? blockers.slice() : [];
    if (holdReason && !rows.some(function (b) {
      return String(b.detail || "") === String(holdReason);
    })) {
      rows.unshift({ label: "On hold", detail: holdReason });
    }
    if (why) why.hidden = rows.length === 0;
    rows.forEach(function (b) {
      var card = document.createElement("div");
      card.className = "blocker-card";
      var reason = document.createElement("div");
      reason.className = "blocker-reason";
      reason.textContent = dash(b.label);
      card.appendChild(reason);
      if (b.detail) {
        var detail = document.createElement("div");
        detail.className = "blocker-detail";
        detail.textContent = String(b.detail);
        card.appendChild(detail);
      }
      list.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  /* ── CONTROL PANEL ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     Read and display only. Nothing here writes, and nothing here decides
     anything: the answer is worked out on the server by
     src/fulfillment/next-action.mjs and this code only paints what it sent.

     THE FALLBACK RULE, which is the whole point of the wrapping below: a
     value we were given gets shown; a value we were NOT given falls back to
     exactly what this page showed before this block existed. Never a blank,
     never a stuck spinner, never a thrown error. */

  /* Reads the derived answer off the client payload without trusting its
     shape. Returns null in two cases, and both mean the same thing here —
     fall back to what this page showed before:
       1. the read layer did not send one at all (older payloads do not carry
          it, and that is not an error), or
       2. what it sent is not the shape the contract promises. A reply we
          cannot read is NOT the same as a reply saying "nothing to do", so it
          is refused rather than read as an answer. */
  function obj(v) { return v && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v); }
  function slot(v) { return v == null || obj(v); }
  function fulfillment(d) {
    try {
      if (!d || typeof d !== "object") return null;
      var f = d.fulfillment;
      if (!obj(f)) {
        if (!("next_action" in d) && !("active_blockers" in d)) return null;
        /* GET /api/dashboard/client sends these four at the top level
           (api/dashboard/client.mjs), and spells the last one
           next_action_degraded there. Both spellings are accepted so this
           block cannot go blind if the key is ever renamed. */
        f = {
          next_action: d.next_action,
          active_blockers: d.active_blockers,
          funding_round: d.funding_round,
          degraded: d.next_action_degraded != null ? d.next_action_degraded : d.degraded
        };
      }
      if (!slot(f.next_action)) return null;
      if (!slot(f.funding_round)) return null;
      if (f.active_blockers != null && !Array.isArray(f.active_blockers)) return null;
      if (f.degraded != null && typeof f.degraded !== "boolean") return null;
      return {
        next_action: obj(f.next_action) ? f.next_action : null,
        active_blockers: Array.isArray(f.active_blockers) ? f.active_blockers : [],
        funding_round: obj(f.funding_round) ? f.funding_round : null,
        degraded: f.degraded === true
      };
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /* The one sentence a fraud alert must always carry. Nothing in this system
     ever takes the alert off, so no screen may imply that someone or
     something will. Phase 0 findings, row 1. */
  var FRAUD_NEVER_CLEARS =
    "Nothing in this system takes a fraud alert off. A person has to clear it with the credit bureau, " +
    "then update this file by hand.";

  /* Paints the big slot and the quiet saved-value line under it. Used by BOTH
     the panel at the top of this page and the control panel below it, so the
     two can never disagree.

     COMPLIANCE GATE A. The big slot only ever carries a step the system
     worked out — never custom_fields.employee_next_action, which is written
     without any consent check and can say "Pull CRS". The rule and the reason
     are in the FH-CCP block at the top of this script.

     Returns the { main, saved } pair so the caller can word its own reason
     line around it. Never throws. */
  function paintNextAction(mainId, savedId, fx, cf) {
    var a;
    try {
      a = FHCP.nextAction(fx, cf);
    } catch (e) {
      a = { main: FHCP.NOT_WORKED_OUT, saved: "" };
    }
    setText(mainId, a.main);
    var el = $(savedId);
    if (el) {
      el.textContent = a.saved;
      el.hidden = !a.saved;
    }
    return a;
  }

  function cpBlockerCard(b) {
    var card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "blocker-card" + (b && b.severity === "high" ? " is-high" : "");
    var reason = document.createElement("div");
    reason.className = "blocker-reason";
    reason.textContent = dash(b && (b.label || b.key));
    card.appendChild(reason);
    if (b && b.detail) {
      var detail = document.createElement("div");
      detail.className = "blocker-detail";
      detail.textContent = String(b.detail);
      card.appendChild(detail);
    }
    if (b && (b.key === "fraud_alert" || b.kind === "fraud_alert")) {
      var flag = document.createElement("div");
      flag.className = "blocker-flag";
      flag.textContent = FRAUD_NEVER_CLEARS;
      card.appendChild(flag);
    }
    return card;
  }

  function paintControlPanelInner(fx, d, cf) {
    var list = $("ccp-cp-blockers");
    var why = $("ccp-cp-why");
    var note = $("ccp-cp-note");
    var count = $("ccp-cp-blocker-count");
    var derived = fx ? fx.next_action : null;

    // 1. Next action — the loudest line in the block. It only ever carries a
    //    step the system worked out; anything saved on the record goes in the
    //    quiet line under it, labelled. GATE A — see paintNextAction above.
    var act = paintNextAction("ccp-cp-action", "ccp-cp-saved", fx, cf);
    if (why) {
      var line = "";
      if (derived && derived.why) line = String(derived.why);
      else if (!fx) line = "We did not work out a next step for this file.";
      else if (fx.degraded) line = "Part of this file could not be read, so we did not work out the next step.";
      else line = "No step on the list applies to this file right now.";
      /* THE SCREEN NO LONGER EXPLAINS ITS OWN DISAGREEMENT — owner-set
         2026-09-06. This used to append "Nothing here is telling anyone to do
         the saved value below", because the stale value saved on the record sat
         directly underneath. It does not sit there any more; it is filed under
         Details with the other reference facts. One step is named, once. */
      why.textContent = line;
      why.hidden = !line;
    }

    // 2. Active blockers. An answer we were given is used as given, empty
    //    included — an empty list means none, not "not read". With no answer
    //    at all we show today's list instead.
    var rows = [];
    if (fx) rows = fx.active_blockers.slice();
    else if (d && Array.isArray(d.open_blockers)) rows = d.open_blockers.slice();
    if (list) {
      list.textContent = "";
      if (!rows.length) {
        var none = document.createElement("p");
        none.className = "cp-empty";
        none.textContent = "Nothing is blocking this file.";
        list.appendChild(none);
      } else {
        rows.forEach(function (b) { list.appendChild(cpBlockerCard(b)); });
      }
    }
    if (count) count.textContent = rows.length ? String(rows.length) : "";

    // The fraud sentence normally rides on the fraud blocker card. If the
    // next step is to clear the alert and no such card came through, it goes
    // under the big line instead, so it is never missing from a fraud file.
    if (note) {
      var sawFraud = rows.some(function (b) {
        return b && (b.key === "fraud_alert" || b.kind === "fraud_alert");
      });
      var needNote = !!(derived && derived.key === "clear_fraud_alert") && !sawFraud;
      note.textContent = needNote ? FRAUD_NEVER_CLEARS : "";
      note.hidden = !needNote;
    }

    /* 3. Funding round, with its finalized state beside it.
          COMPLIANCE GATE B. Only the WORKED-OUT round is painted here. The raw
          newest row is never read, and that is the whole point: the raw row
          carries funding money for anybody who has a row at all, including a
          REPAIR_ONLY client who never bought funding. The tier whitelist that
          refuses a funding chip — fundingChipsAllowed() in
          src/fulfillment/next-action.mjs, the same three tiers from
          src/config/product-path.mjs — now also decides whether a round comes
          back at all, so a repair-only file gets null here and shows nothing.
          Reading the raw row as a fallback would walk straight around that
          gate, so there is no fallback.
          With no worked-out round these stay dashes rather than being guessed.
          The round number, status and hold reason a client does have are still
          on this page in the tiles that always showed them. */
    var round = fx ? fx.funding_round : null;
    var num = null, status = null, hold = null, amount = null, finalized = null, opened = null;
    if (round) {
      num = round.number;
      status = round.status;
      hold = round.hold_reason;
      amount = round.approved_amount;
      opened = round.started_at;
      finalized = round.finalized === true ? true : round.finalized === false ? false : null;
    }
    setText("ccp-cp-round-number", num == null || num === "" ? "" : "Round " + num);
    setText("ccp-cp-round-status", status);
    setText("ccp-cp-round-hold", hold);
    setText("ccp-cp-round-amount", roundMoney(amount));
    setText("ccp-cp-round-final", finalized === true ? "Yes" : finalized === false ? "No" : "");
    /* HOW LONG IT HAS BEEN OPEN. Everything else in this block is a state, and
       none of them is a clock: an approval waiting on a figure since June read
       exactly like one from this morning. A round with no date on it stays a
       dash — ageOf() never guesses "today" from a missing timestamp. */
    setText("ccp-cp-round-opened", ageOf(opened));
    /* Everything above is the CURRENT round. This names the others, and it is
       passed the gated answer so it paints nothing when that gate said no. */
    paintEveryRound(round, d);
  }

  /* ── EVERY ROUND ON THE FILE ─────────────────────────────────────────────
     One line, in words, naming each round with what it approved and what it
     funded. It exists because the grid above shows one round and says nothing
     about the ones it is not showing, so a second funded round was simply
     invisible.

     GATE B IS NOT WEAKENED. `gatedRound` is the worked-out round from
     src/fulfillment/next-action.mjs. When that came back null — a repair-only
     client who never bought funding — this paints nothing and reads no rows at
     all. The raw rows are only ever read once the gate has already said yes.

     ONE NUMBER, ONE LOOK. Money here is roundMoney (FHCP.money) — the SAME
     renderer as the "Approved this round" box directly above this line. It has
     to be: the two sit a centimetre apart and show the same figure for the
     current round. tileMoney, which this line used at first, prints a recorded
     zero as a dash while the box above prints "$0", so the identical number
     read two different ways in one panel. Unknown is still a dash in both;
     a RECORDED zero is a fact and now reads "$0" in both. */
  function everyRoundLine(r) {
    var bits = ["Round " + (r && r.round_number != null ? r.round_number : "?")];
    var st = r && r.status ? String(r.status).trim() : "";
    if (st) bits.push(st);
    bits.push("approved " + roundMoney(r ? r.approved_amount : null));
    bits.push("funded " + roundMoney(r ? r.funded_amount : null));
    return bits.join(" · ");
  }

  function paintEveryRound(gatedRound, d) {
    var el = $("ccp-cp-rounds-all");
    if (!el) return;
    el.hidden = true;
    el.textContent = "";
    if (!gatedRound) return;
    var rows = [];
    try { if (d && Array.isArray(d.funding_rounds)) rows = d.funding_rounds; } catch (e) { rows = []; }
    if (rows.length < 2) return;
    var lines = rows.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      return (Number(a && a.round_number) || 0) - (Number(b && b.round_number) || 0);
    }).map(everyRoundLine);
    el.textContent = "Every round on this file — " + lines.join("   |   ")
      + ". The boxes above are the current round only.";
    el.hidden = false;
  }

  function paintControlPanel(fx, d, cf) {
    try {
      paintControlPanelInner(fx, d, cf);
    } catch (e) {
      // Last resort. Still not a blank — and still not the saved value in the
      // big line: painting it here was the same GATE A leak as the main path.
      // Passing null for the worked-out answer is the honest thing to say,
      // because nothing was worked out.
      try {
        paintNextAction("ccp-cp-action", "ccp-cp-saved", null, cf);
        var why = $("ccp-cp-why");
        if (why) {
          /* Same change as the main path above: one step, said once. The value
             saved on the record is filed under Details, so there is nothing
             "below" here to warn anybody off. */
          why.textContent = "This block could not be worked out, so no step is being suggested.";
          why.hidden = false;
        }
        var note = $("ccp-cp-note");
        if (note) { note.textContent = ""; note.hidden = true; }
        var list = $("ccp-cp-blockers");
        if (list) list.textContent = "";
      } catch (e2) { /* nothing left to do; the page keeps its dashes */ }
    }
  }

  function wireLinks(id) {
    if (!id) return;
    var q = encodeURIComponent(id);
    function href(nid, url) {
      var a = $(nid);
      if (!a) return;
      a.setAttribute("href", url);
      /* shell.js gateLinks() rebuilds every href from data-fh-href, the copy
         it took of the ORIGINAL href on its first pass. When that pass ran
         before this one, its second pass put the bare "lenders.html" back and
         Open Funding Matrix lost this client (e2e/controls-persist.spec.mjs,
         2026-10-05). Keeping its copy in step makes the client survive. */
      a.setAttribute("data-fh-href", url);
    }
    href("ccp-link-present", "present.html?contact=" + q);
    href("ccp-link-present2", "present.html?contact=" + q);
    href("ccp-link-messaging", "messaging.html?client_id=" + q);
    href("ccp-link-lenders", "lenders.html?client_id=" + q);
    href("ccp-link-ir", "inquiry-remover.html");
    href("ccp-consent-link", "consent-capture.html?client_id=" + q);
  }

  /* Open FinanceOS — the client's money page on this client, for owner, admin
     and sales_manager (ROLE_SETS.FINANCE in src/http/read-api.mjs, the gate on
     /api/money/*). Every other role, and a page with no client open, keeps the
     row hidden. The role is the one shell.js caches at sign-in, the same read
     wirePortalLink() does; the endpoints stay the authority either way.
     data-fh-href is kept in step for the same reason as wireLinks() above. */
  function wireFinanceOsLink(id) {
    var a = $("ccp-link-financeos");
    if (!a) return;
    var role = "";
    try { role = String(localStorage.getItem("fh_role") || "").trim().toLowerCase(); }
    catch (e) { role = ""; }
    var may = role === "owner" || role === "admin" || role === "sales_manager" || role === "closer";
    if (!id || !may) { a.hidden = true; return; }
    var url = "financeos.html?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(id);
    a.setAttribute("href", url);
    a.setAttribute("data-fh-href", url);
    a.hidden = false;
  }

  function paintBusinesses(state, rows, errMsg) {
    var box = $("ccp-biz-list");
    if (!box) return;
    box.textContent = "";
    if (state === "loading") {
      var loading = document.createElement("p");
      loading.className = "cp-empty";
      loading.textContent = "Loading businesses…";
      box.appendChild(loading);
      return;
    }
    if (state === "error") {
      var err = document.createElement("p");
      err.className = "cp-empty";
      err.textContent = errMsg || "Could not load businesses.";
      box.appendChild(err);
      return;
    }
    var list = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
    if (!list.length) {
      var empty = document.createElement("p");
      empty.className = "cp-empty";
      empty.textContent = "No businesses on file";
      box.appendChild(empty);
      return;
    }
    list.forEach(function (row, i) {
      var card = document.createElement("div");
      card.className = "cp-sec";
      var title = document.createElement("div");
      title.className = "cp-sec-title";
      title.textContent = row.name || "Business";
      card.appendChild(title);
      var grid = document.createElement("div");
      grid.className = "kv-grid";
      function kv(label, value, mono) {
        var wrap = document.createElement("div");
        wrap.className = "kv";
        var k = document.createElement("div");
        k.className = "kv-label";
        k.textContent = label;
        var v = document.createElement("div");
        v.className = mono ? "kv-value mono" : "kv-value";
        v.textContent = value == null || value === "" ? "—" : String(value);
        wrap.appendChild(k);
        wrap.appendChild(v);
        grid.appendChild(wrap);
      }
      kv("State", row.state);
      kv("EIN", row.ein, true);
      kv("Incorporated", row.incorporated_date);
      kv("Age (months)", row.age_months);
      kv("Address", row.address);
      kv("Extra owner", row.extra_owner_name);
      card.appendChild(grid);
      var birth = document.createElement("div");
      birth.style.marginTop = "10px";
      var birthLab = document.createElement("label");
      birthLab.setAttribute("for", "ccp-inc-" + i);
      birthLab.textContent = "When was this business incorporated?";
      var birthIn = document.createElement("input");
      birthIn.id = "ccp-inc-" + i;
      birthIn.type = "month";
      birthIn.value = row.incorporated_date ? String(row.incorporated_date).slice(0, 7) : "";
      var birthBtn = document.createElement("button");
      birthBtn.type = "button";
      birthBtn.className = "action-btn";
      birthBtn.style.marginTop = "8px";
      birthBtn.textContent = "Save month / year";
      var birthMsg = document.createElement("p");
      birthMsg.style.fontSize = "var(--fs-caption)";
      birthMsg.style.margin = "6px 0 0";
      birthBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (!id || !row.name) {
          birthMsg.textContent = "Open a client file first.";
          return;
        }
        if (!birthIn.value) {
          birthMsg.textContent = "Enter the month and year.";
          return;
        }
        if (!window.FHData || typeof FHData.write !== "function") {
          birthMsg.textContent = "Could not save.";
          return;
        }
        birthBtn.disabled = true;
        birthMsg.textContent = "Saving…";
        FHData.write("/api/soft-pull-approve", {
          action: "stamp_incorporated",
          client_id: id,
          business_name: row.name,
          incorporated_date: birthIn.value
        }).then(function (res) {
          birthBtn.disabled = false;
          if (!res || !res.ok) {
            birthMsg.textContent = (res && (res.error || res.message)) || "Could not save.";
            return;
          }
          birthMsg.textContent = "Saved.";
          FHData.client(id).then(function (again) {
            if (again && again.ok) render(again.data);
          });
        });
      });
      birth.appendChild(birthLab);
      birth.appendChild(birthIn);
      birth.appendChild(birthBtn);
      birth.appendChild(birthMsg);
      card.appendChild(birth);
      if (row.extra_owners_warning) {
        var flag = document.createElement("p");
        flag.className = "blocker-flag";
        flag.textContent = "Extra owners — funding is slower and harder";
        card.appendChild(flag);
      }
      box.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  function render(d) {
    var c = (d && d.client) || {};
    var cf = c.custom_fields || {};
    /* The Capital Blueprint group reads its two saved flags off this record. */
    try { document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("ccp:client", { detail: c })); } catch (e) {}
    var name = [c.first_name, c.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
    setText("ccp-name", name);
    setText("ccp-key", c.email || c.id);
    setText("ccp-email", c.email);
    setText("ccp-phone", c.phone);
    /* A Tier or a Prequal set by the decision on a sample report says so —
       live hole N12. See sampleDecision(). */
    var sampleDec = FHCP.sampleDecision(d.crs_results);
    var sampleTier = !!sampleDec && sampleDec.tier !== null && !!c.outcome_tier &&
      String(c.outcome_tier) === sampleDec.tier;
    setText("ccp-tier", sampleTier ? c.outcome_tier + " · sample" : c.outcome_tier);
    setText("ccp-path", cf.analyzer_path || cf.product_path);

    var status = c.funded ? "Funded"
      : cf.lifecycle_status ? cf.lifecycle_status
      : cf.sale_closed ? "Sale closed"
      : cf.deposit_paid ? "Deposit paid"
      : cf.crs_paid ? "Diagnostic paid"
      : "";

    var prequal = cf.analyzer_prequal_amount || cf.total_funding_estimate;
    setText("ccp-prequal", money(prequal));
    var samplePrequal = !!sampleDec && sampleDec.prequal !== null &&
      money(prequal) !== "—" && Number(prequal) === sampleDec.prequal;
    var prequalNote = $("ccp-prequal-sample");
    if (prequalNote) {
      prequalNote.textContent = samplePrequal ? FHCP.SAMPLE_FIGURE_NOTE : "";
      prequalNote.hidden = !samplePrequal;
    }
    /* THE APPROVED TILE IS NOT PAINTED FROM HERE ANY MORE, and that is the fix.
       It used to be:

         var approved = money(c.funded_amount);
         setText("ccp-approved", approved === "—" ? money(prequal) : approved);

       — the FUNDED amount under a label that said Approved, falling back to the
       analyzer's PRE-APPROVAL GUESS, which is the number in the tile
       immediately to its left. It never showed an approved amount at all, and
       since the 2026-08-30 fee decision (the success fee is a percent of
       CONFIRMED approvals — src/funding/success-fee.mjs,
       docs/finance/CLOSEOUT-FEE-BASIS.md) it also contradicted the invoice.

       It is now painted from the application rows, by the funding block at the
       foot of this file, which is the one place that reads them. Same read as
       the headline count, so the two can never disagree. The funded amount is
       not lost: it is on the Funded line in System Facts below. */

    var irc = d.inquiry_removal_case;
    /* THE TILE COUNTS THE CREDIT FILE, NOT THE REMOVAL CASE — owner-set
       2026-09-06. It used to print irc.open_inquiry_count, which is rows in
       inquiry_log for one case and reads 0 or 1 on a file the removal desk has
       not touched. See fileInquiries() above for what replaced it and why. */
    paintInquiries(d.crs_results);
    paintInquiryCaseHelp(irc);
    if (irc && (irc.case_status || irc.master_call_state)) {
      var irBits = [];
      if (irc.case_status) irBits.push(irc.case_status);
      if (irc.master_call_state) irBits.push(String(irc.master_call_state).replace(/_/g, " "));
      /* The case's own staged count keeps a home, on the tile it belongs to and
         labelled as what it is. It is NOT the credit file's inquiry count — that
         is the tile to the left — and printing it under that name is the defect
         this pass fixed. */
      if (irc.open_inquiry_count != null) {
        irBits.push(String(irc.open_inquiry_count) + " staged");
      }
      setText("ccp-ir", irBits.join(" · "));
    } else {
      setText("ccp-ir", "");
    }

    var tm = d.tri_merge || {};
    var scores = scoreLine(tm);
    /* Sample scores say they are a sample — live hole 23. See isSampleReport(). */
    var sampleScores = FHCP.isSampleReport(d.crs_results, tm.asOf);
    setText("ccp-card-use", cardUse(d.utilisation));
    /* Card Use off a sample report says so — live hole N12. utilisation.asOf
       is the created_at of the report the figure came off (utilisation() in
       src/http/client-detail.mjs); null when it came from anywhere else, and
       null never adds the note. */
    var sampleCardUse = FHCP.isSampleReport(d.crs_results, d.utilisation && d.utilisation.asOf);
    var cardUseNote = $("ccp-card-use-sample");
    if (cardUseNote) {
      cardUseNote.textContent = sampleCardUse ? FHCP.SAMPLE_FIGURE_NOTE : "";
      cardUseNote.hidden = !sampleCardUse;
    }
    setText("ccp-scores", scores);
    setText("ccp-facts-scores", sampleScores ? scores + " · sample" : scores);
    var sampleNote = $("ccp-scores-sample");
    if (sampleNote) {
      sampleNote.textContent = sampleScores ? FHCP.SAMPLE_NOTE : "";
      sampleNote.hidden = !sampleScores;
    }

    var rounds = d.funding_rounds || [];
    var latestRound = rounds[0];
    var roundText = latestRound
      ? ("Round " + latestRound.round_number + (latestRound.status ? " · " + latestRound.status : ""))
      : "";
    setText("ccp-round", roundText);
    setText("ccp-facts-round", roundText);
    /* The funded amount lived on the tile that said "Total Approved" and was
       the reason that tile was a lie. It is a real fact, so it stays on the
       screen — here, under the word Funded, where it is what it says it is.
       tileMoney leaves an unknown or a zero as a dash, so "Yes" on its own
       still means funded with no amount recorded. */
    var fundedMoney = c.funded === true ? money(c.funded_amount) : "—";
    setText("ccp-facts-funded",
      c.funded === true ? ("Yes" + (fundedMoney === "—" ? "" : " · " + fundedMoney))
        : c.funded === false ? "No" : "");
    /* A sample report is not a pull, so it is never printed as the last one. */
    setText("ccp-last-pull", sampleScores
      ? "Sample report loaded " + when(tm.asOf) + " — not a real credit pull"
      : when(tm.asOf || (d.crs_results && d.crs_results[0] && d.crs_results[0].created_at)));

    /* The worked-out step drives this slot, and only ever the worked-out step,
       so this line and the control panel below can never say different things.
       With nothing sent, or only a partial answer, it says so in plain words
       and the value saved on the record goes in the quiet line under it.
       GATE A — see paintNextAction. */
    var fx = fulfillment(d);
    if (fx) {
      try {
        fx.scores_on_file = tm.experian != null || tm.equifax != null || tm.transunion != null;
      } catch (e) { fx.scores_on_file = false; }
    }
    setText("ccp-status", FHCP.displayStatus(status, fx));
    paintNextAction("ccp-next-action", "ccp-saved", fx, cf);
    var hold = FHCP.displayHold(cf.round_hold_reason || (latestRound && latestRound.hold_reason) || "", fx);
    setText("ccp-hold-reason", hold);
    setText("ccp-credit-status", cf.crs_status || cf.analyzer_status);
    var inc = d.income_estimates || {};
    /* Income estimates off a sample report say so — live hole N12. inc.asOf is
       the created_at of the report both came off (incomeEstimates() in
       src/http/client-detail.mjs). A dash stays a dash. */
    var sampleIncome = FHCP.isSampleReport(d.crs_results, inc.asOf);
    function incomeLine(row) {
      var v = moneyYr(row);
      return sampleIncome && v !== "—" ? v + " · sample" : v;
    }
    setText("ccp-income-ex", incomeLine(inc.experian));
    setText("ccp-income-eq", incomeLine(inc.equifax));

    paintBlockers(d.open_blockers, hold);
    paintControlPanel(fx, d, cf);
    var bizCredit = d.business_credit || {};
    paintBusinesses("full", bizCredit.businesses || []);

    /* A file is open, so the tile row is about something and stops standing
       back. The card only turns coral when something is actually stuck — see
       .na-group.is-blocked. */
    var head = $("ccp-record-head");
    if (head) head.classList.remove("is-empty");
    // The tile row moved out of the header and into the main column, so the
    // "nothing picked yet" fade moved with it.
    var facts = $("ccp-facts-group");
    if (facts) facts.classList.remove("is-empty");
    /* Counted off the cards the two paints above actually drew, not off the
       payload: the panel goes coral when the reader can see a blocker in it
       and stays neutral otherwise. Reading the array a third time here would
       be a third route past the endpoint's sanitizer — see
       src/http/client-panel-screen.test.mjs. */
    /* THREE COLOURS, ONE MEANING EACH — owner-set 2026-09-06.
       This edge used to go red the moment ANY blocker card was drawn. Walk1
       Funding is a clean file with five ordinary open tasks on it, so it painted
       red and read as a file in trouble. Red now means a hard stop: something
       wrong with the file itself. On this screen that is exactly the
       high-severity set — fraud alert on the report, no written permission on
       record, permission record unreadable (src/fulfillment/next-action.mjs).
       Anything else still open is yellow, and green is kept for a file with
       nothing open at all — green means go, and a blocker is the thing that
       stops you going. */
    var panel = $("ccp-blockers-panel");
    if (panel) {
      panel.classList.remove("is-empty");
      var shown = 0;
      var hard = 0;
      try {
        shown = panel.querySelectorAll(".blocker-card").length;
        hard = panel.querySelectorAll(".blocker-card.is-high").length;
      } catch (e) { shown = 0; hard = 0; }
      panel.classList.toggle("is-blocked", hard > 0);
      panel.classList.toggle("is-open-work", hard === 0 && shown > 0);
      panel.classList.toggle("is-clear", shown === 0);
    }
    var bizCredit = d.business_credit || {};
    paintBusinesses("full", bizCredit.businesses || []);

    setText("ccp-footer-org", c.org_id ? ("ORG: " + c.org_id) : "ORG: —");
    setText("ccp-footer-id", c.id);

    var ta = $("notes");
    if (ta) ta.value = cf.notes || cf.staff_notes || "";

    source("real", "live file · " + (d.transactions || []).length + " payments · " +
      (d.messages || []).length + " messages");
  }

  var id = FHData.param("id") || FHData.param("client_id") || FHData.param("client") || FHData.param("contact");
  wireLinks(id);
  wireFinanceOsLink(id);
  /* Nothing picked is not the same as nothing known. It used to print a dash
     where the client's name goes, next to nine more dashes, which reads as a
     screen that failed rather than one waiting to be pointed at a file. */
  if (!id) {
    setText("ccp-name", "No client open");
    setText("ccp-key", "Pick a client to open their file.");
  }

  (function wireNotes() {
    var notes = $("notes");
    var save = $("notes-save");
    var status = $("notes-status");
    var text = status && status.querySelector(".stxt");
    function say(message, state) {
      if (!status) return;
      status.className = "notes-status " + (state || "is-idle");
      if (text) text.textContent = message;
    }
    if (!notes || !save) return;
    if (!id) {
      notes.disabled = true;
      save.disabled = true;
      say("Open a client file before adding notes.", "is-idle");
      return;
    }
    say("Notes are saved only when you press Save notes.", "is-idle");
    save.addEventListener("click", function () {
      save.disabled = true;
      say("Saving…", "is-idle");
      FHData.write("/api/client-notes", { client_id: id, notes: notes.value }).then(function (res) {
        save.disabled = false;
        if (!res || !res.ok) {
          say((res && res.error) || "Notes did not save. Try again.", "is-error");
          return;
        }
        say("Saved to this client file.", "is-saved");
      });
    });
  })();

  (function wireBankInbox() {
    var open = $("ccp-bank-inbox-open");
    var box = $("ccp-bank-inbox");
    var loadedInbox = false;
    if (!open || !box) return;
    if (!id) {
      open.hidden = true;
      return;
    }
    open.addEventListener("click", function () {
      box.hidden = !box.hidden;
      if (box.hidden || loadedInbox) return;
      box.textContent = "Loading bank messages…";
      FHData.read("bank-inbox", { client_id: id, limit: 100 }).then(function (res) {
        box.textContent = "";
        if (!res || !res.ok) {
          box.textContent = "Bank messages could not be loaded.";
          return;
        }
        var items = (res.data && res.data.items) || [];
        loadedInbox = true;
        if (!items.length) {
          box.textContent = "No bank messages for this client.";
          return;
        }
        var list = document.createElement("div");
        list.className = "facts-list";
        items.forEach(function (item) {
          var row = document.createElement("div");
          row.className = "fact-row";
          var key = document.createElement("span");
          key.className = "k";
          key.textContent = item.subject || item.from_address || "Bank message";
          var value = document.createElement("span");
          value.className = "v";
          value.textContent = item.body_preview || item.classification || item.received_at || "Received";
          row.appendChild(key);
          row.appendChild(value);
          list.appendChild(row);
        });
        box.appendChild(list);
      });
    });
  })();

  (function mountClientPicker() {
    var sel = $("ccp-pick");
    if (!sel || !window.FHData || typeof FHData.clients !== "function") return;
    sel.addEventListener("change", function () {
      if (!sel.value) return;
      location.href = "client-control-panel.html?id=" + encodeURIComponent(sel.value);
    });
    FHData.clients(200).then(function (res) {
      if (!res || !res.ok || !res.data || !Array.isArray(res.data.clients)) {
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">the client list could not be read</option>';
        return;
      }
      var list = res.data.clients;
      if (!list.length) {
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">No clients on file</option>';
        return;
      }
      var html = ['<option value="">Choose a client</option>'];
      list.forEach(function (c) {
        if (!c || !c.id) return;
        var n = [c.first_name, c.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" ").trim();
        var label = n || c.email || c.id;
        /* The list usually lands seconds before the full file. When it names
           the open client, put that name in the header now instead of leaving
           "Loading…" beside a picker that already says who it is (hole 5).
           Only over "Loading…": a name render() painted, or a failure line,
           is never overwritten. render() repaints it from the full record. */
        var head = $("ccp-name");
        if (c.id === id && n && head && head.textContent === "Loading…") setText("ccp-name", n);
        html.push('<option value="' + String(c.id).replace(/"/g, "") + '"' +
          (c.id === id ? " selected" : "") + ">" +
          String(label).replace(/[&<>]/g, function (ch) {
            return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;" }[ch];
          }) + "</option>");
      });
      sel.innerHTML = html.join("");
    });
  })();

  (function loadNeedAction() {
    var box = $("ccp-need-action");
    if (!box || !window.FHData || typeof FHData.inquiryCases !== "function") {
      if (box) box.textContent = "Could not load the action list.";
      return;
    }
    FHData.inquiryCases().then(function (res) {
      if (!res || !res.ok) {
        box.textContent = "Could not load the action list.";
        return;
      }
      var cases = (res.data && res.data.cases) || [];
      if (!cases.length) {
        box.textContent = "No open inquiry removal cases.";
        return;
      }

      /* ONE ROW PER CLIENT, AND NEVER A ROW BACK TO THIS PAGE.
         Owner-set 2026-09-06, TODO §35. This list is one row per CASE, and a
         client can have several — Walk1 Funding has three, so the same person
         was listed three times, and all three links opened the file already on
         screen. The list is here to send you somewhere else, so a row that goes
         nowhere is worse than no row.
         The cases are still counted, on the one row, so nothing is hidden. */
      var byClient = [];
      var index = {};
      for (var i = 0; i < cases.length; i++) {
        var c = cases[i];
        if (!c || !c.client_id) continue;
        var key = String(c.client_id);
        if (key === String(id || "")) continue;   // this is the file you are on
        if (index[key] === undefined) {
          index[key] = byClient.length;
          byClient.push({
            client_id: key,
            name: c.client_name || c.client_email || "Client",
            count: 1,
            status: c.case_status || ""
          });
        } else {
          byClient[index[key]].count += 1;
        }
      }

      if (!byClient.length) {
        box.textContent = "No other client has an open inquiry removal case.";
        return;
      }

      box.textContent = "";
      byClient.slice(0, 12).forEach(function (row) {
        var a = document.createElement("a");
        a.className = "need-row";
        a.href = "client-control-panel.html?id=" + encodeURIComponent(row.client_id);
        var name = document.createElement("span");
        name.className = "need-name";
        name.textContent = row.name;
        var meta = document.createElement("span");
        meta.className = "need-meta";
        meta.textContent = [
          row.status,
          row.count === 1 ? "1 case" : row.count + " cases"
        ].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
        a.appendChild(name);
        a.appendChild(meta);
        box.appendChild(a);
      });
    });
  })();

  (function wireDeskActions() {
    /* TWO ANSWER LINES, NOT ONE — owner-set 2026-09-06, TODO §34.
       Every button in this card used to print into the single line under "Issue
       Inquiry Removal", so a bureau pull reported itself under the removal
       button and looked like the removal had run. `say` is the bureau pulls'
       line, directly under the three pull buttons; `sayIr` is the removal
       button's own line, directly under it. UI-STANDARDS §5: the answer appears
       where the user is looking. */
    var pullStatus = $("ccp-pull-status");
    var status = $("ccp-issue-ir-status");
    function say(t) { if (pullStatus) pullStatus.textContent = t || ""; }
    function sayIr(t) { if (status) status.textContent = t || ""; }
    var pullBtns = [
      { id: "ccp-pull-tu", bureau: "TU", label: "TransUnion" },
      { id: "ccp-pull-ex", bureau: "EX", label: "Experian" },
      { id: "ccp-pull-eq", bureau: "EQ", label: "Equifax" }
    ];
    function tokenHeaders() {
      var headers = { accept: "application/json", "content-type": "application/json" };
      try {
        var t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || "";
        if (t) headers.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
      } catch (e) {}
      return headers;
    }

    /* ── CONSENT, BEFORE THE TAP ──────────────────────────────────────────────
       The gate itself lives in src/finance/soft-pulls.mjs:288-314 and is read
       fresh on every request; nothing here relaxes it. What this adds is the
       SAME read, shown early, so a closer can see whether a pull can succeed
       instead of finding out by ordering one.

       THREE STATES, NOT TWO. Allowed, blocked, and "could not check". The third
       leaves the buttons exactly as they were: a check that failed is not
       evidence of a missing consent, and disabling on it would block a
       legitimate pull for a fault that is ours. Unknown is not no.

       The words match consent-capture.html so the two screens cannot tell a
       closer two different stories about the same client. */
    var CONSENT_WORDS = {
      valid: "Consent is on file. A bureau pull can go ahead.",
      none_on_file: "No consent on file. This client has to agree before a bureau can be asked.",
      revoked: "This client took their permission back. Do not pull. A new consent has to be recorded first.",
      expired: "The consent on file has run out. Record a new one before pulling.",
      not_yet_effective: "The consent on file starts at a later date, so a pull is not allowed yet.",
      no_org_scope: "Your session has no company attached, so consent cannot be checked. Sign out and back in.",
      bad_input: "This screen was opened without a valid client, so consent cannot be checked."
    };
    var UNKNOWN_CONSENT =
      "Could not check consent from this screen. The buttons are left on — the pull itself still refuses if consent is missing.";
    var consentLine = $("ccp-consent-state");
    var consentLink = $("ccp-consent-link");

    function setConsentLine(text, tone) {
      if (!consentLine) return;
      consentLine.textContent = text;
      consentLine.className = "consent-state" + (tone ? " is-" + tone : "");
    }

    /* A disabled button with no visible reason is the failure this whole block
       exists to fix, so the sentence goes on the control as well as above it. */
    function setPullsEnabled(on, why) {
      pullBtns.forEach(function (spec) {
        var b = $(spec.id);
        if (!b) return;
        b.disabled = !on;
        if (why) b.title = why; else b.removeAttribute("title");
      });
    }

    /* ── THE SECOND LOCK, AND THE HANDOFF ────────────────────────────────────
       A bureau pull has TWO gates and they refuse with two different codes:
       consent first (403 consent_required), then identity (422
       identity_required). The line above only ever spoke about the first one,
       so a closer with a good consent and no identity on file still found out
       the only way there was — by ordering a pull and reading a code.

       WHAT A CLOSER DOES ABOUT EITHER GATE IS THE SAME THING: hand the client
       the signed link. The client agrees and types their own details into it.
       Nobody on this side types a Social Security number — owner decision,
       2026-08-19 — and there is deliberately no field on this screen that would
       let them. The link comes from GET /api/consent/capture, freshly signed on
       every load, and that endpoint answers identity with a boolean and nothing
       else, so no part of the number can reach this page even by accident.

       THE PULL BUTTONS ARE NOT DISABLED WHEN IDENTITY IS MISSING, deliberately.
       src/finance/crs-pull.mjs:548 loads a real identity ONLY when the bureau
       host is the production one; on the sandbox host the vendor's own test
       people are used and no client identity is needed at all. Disabling here
       would block a pull that works. Consent has no such exemption, which is
       why the block above still disables on that one. */
    var IDENTITY_WORDS = {
      on_file: "Identity is on file for this client.",
      missing:
        "No identity on file. A bureau pull will refuse until this client's legal name, date of " +
        "birth, address and Social Security number are on record. They type those in themselves " +
        "on the link below — the number never reaches this screen."
    };

    var HANDOFF_WHAT = {
      both: "Send this link to the client. They agree to the pull and enter their own details on it.",
      consent: "Send this link to the client. They read the authorization and agree to it themselves.",
      identity:
        "Send this link to the client. They enter their own details on it, including the Social " +
        "Security number, which never reaches this screen."
    };

    var identityLine = $("ccp-identity-state");
    var approveBox = $("ccp-approve");
    var approveWhat = $("ccp-approve-what");
    var approveNoLink = $("ccp-approve-nolink");
    var approveRow = $("ccp-approve-row");
    var approveUrl = $("ccp-approve-url");
    var approveCopy = $("ccp-approve-copy");
    var approveExp = $("ccp-approve-exp");

    function hideHandoff() {
      if (identityLine) identityLine.hidden = true;
      if (approveBox) approveBox.hidden = true;
    }

    /* "3:42 PM", not an ISO timestamp. A closer reads a clock. */
    function clockTime(iso) {
      var d = new Date(iso);
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
      try {
        return d.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "America/Phoenix" });
      } catch (e) {
        return d.toTimeString().slice(0, 5);
      }
    }

    function renderHandoff(body) {
      var st = (body && body.status) || {};
      var identity = body && body.identity;       // { on_file } — or null if not asked
      var link = body && body.approval_link;      // { url, expires_at, unavailable_reason }

      /* REVOKED MEANS STOP. The consent block above hides its "record consent"
         shortcut for exactly this reason; offering a link that re-collects a
         permission the client took back would be the same mistake with an extra
         step in front of it. Nothing is offered here either. */
      if (st.reason === "revoked") { hideHandoff(); return; }

      // `null` identity means the question was not asked, which is not the same
      // as "we hold nothing". Only a hard false is reported as missing.
      var identityMissing = !!identity && identity.on_file === false;
      if (identity && identityLine) {
        identityLine.hidden = false;
        identityLine.textContent = identity.on_file ? IDENTITY_WORDS.on_file : IDENTITY_WORDS.missing;
        identityLine.className = "consent-state" + (identity.on_file ? " is-ok" : " is-blocked");
      } else if (identityLine) {
        identityLine.hidden = true;
      }

      var consentMissing = !st.valid;
      if (!approveBox) return;
      if (!consentMissing && !identityMissing) { approveBox.hidden = true; return; }

      approveBox.hidden = false;
      if (approveWhat) {
        approveWhat.textContent = consentMissing && identityMissing ? HANDOFF_WHAT.both
          : consentMissing ? HANDOFF_WHAT.consent
          : HANDOFF_WHAT.identity;
      }

      /* No link is a state with a cause, not an empty box. The endpoint hands
         back a sentence saying why — a missing signing key is the one that
         happens — so show that INSTEAD of the copy control, not beside it. */
      var url = link && link.url;
      if (approveRow) approveRow.hidden = !url;
      if (approveNoLink) {
        approveNoLink.hidden = !!url;
        approveNoLink.textContent = url ? ""
          : ((link && link.unavailable_reason) ||
             "No approval link could be made for this client. Pass it to the desk.");
      }
      if (approveUrl) approveUrl.value = url || "";
      if (approveCopy) approveCopy.textContent = "Copy link";
      if (approveExp) {
        var at = url && link.expires_at ? clockTime(link.expires_at) : null;
        approveExp.hidden = !at;
        approveExp.textContent = at
          ? "This link stops working at " + at + ". Reload this screen for a fresh one."
          : "";
      }
    }

    if (approveCopy) {
      approveCopy.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var url = approveUrl ? approveUrl.value : "";
        if (!url) return;
        function done(label, ms) {
          approveCopy.textContent = label;
          setTimeout(function () { approveCopy.textContent = "Copy link"; }, ms);
        }
        /* Clipboard access can be refused by the browser, and does not exist at
           all on an insecure origin. Selecting the box so the closer can copy it
           by hand is a working answer; a button that silently does nothing is
           the failure this whole screen keeps being fixed for. */
        function selectInstead() {
          if (!approveUrl) return;
          approveUrl.focus();
          approveUrl.select();
          done("Press Ctrl+C", 3000);
        }
        try {
          if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(function () { done("Copied", 2000); }, selectInstead);
          } else {
            selectInstead();
          }
        } catch (e) {
          selectInstead();
        }
      });
    }

    function checkConsent() {
      if (!id) {
        setConsentLine("Open a client file to see whether a bureau pull is allowed.", null);
        hideHandoff();
        return;
      }
      setConsentLine("Checking consent…", null);
      fetch("/api/consent/capture?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(id) +
            "&kind=soft_pull_consent", { headers: tokenHeaders() })
        .then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (d) { return { status: r.status, data: d }; }); })
        .then(function (out) {
          var body = out.data || {};
          if (out.status !== 200 || !body.ok || !body.status) {
            setConsentLine(UNKNOWN_CONSENT, null);
            if (consentLink) consentLink.hidden = true;
            // Unknown is not no — and it is not a reason to offer a link off the
            // back of an answer we did not get.
            hideHandoff();
            return;
          }
          var st = body.status;
          if (st.valid) {
            setConsentLine(CONSENT_WORDS.valid, "ok");
            setPullsEnabled(true, null);
            if (consentLink) consentLink.hidden = true;
            // Consent is only the first lock. The second one still has to be
            // said out loud, and it may still need the link.
            renderHandoff(body);
            return;
          }
          var why = CONSENT_WORDS[st.reason] || "There is no usable consent on file for this client.";
          setConsentLine(why, "blocked");
          setPullsEnabled(false, why);
          // Revoked means stop, so do not offer a shortcut to re-collect it.
          if (consentLink) consentLink.hidden = st.reason === "revoked";
          renderHandoff(body);
        })
        .catch(function () {
          setConsentLine(UNKNOWN_CONSENT, null);
          if (consentLink) consentLink.hidden = true;
          hideHandoff();
        });
    }

    /* ── WHY A PULL FAILED, IN WORDS ──────────────────────────────────────────
       A refusal carries a sentence AND a machine code — see the 422 built in
       api/finance/crs-pull.mjs:116-121 and the 403 thrown at
       src/finance/soft-pulls.mjs:309-313. This screen read `d.error` only,
       which flattened "this client never agreed" and "we hold no identity for
       this person" into one grey line. Those are two problems with two
       different owners and two different next steps.

       The code picks the sentence; the code itself is kept in brackets so it
       can be quoted verbatim when somebody reports the screen. */
    var PULL_FAILURE = {
      consent_required: "No consent — this client has to agree before a bureau can be asked.",
      identity_required: "No identity on file for this client (legal name, date of birth, address, SSN). A bureau cannot be asked without one.",
      not_configured: "The credit bureau connection is not set up on this system. Nothing to do with this client — raise it with the desk.",
      no_reports: "The bureau was asked and sent nothing back.",
      provider_result_id_required: "The bureau answered without a reference number, so the report was not saved.",
      not_stored: "The bureau answered but the report could not be saved.",
      failed: "The bureau pull did not finish.",
      forbidden: "Your login is not allowed to order a bureau pull."
    };
    function pullFailure(out, label) {
      var d = (out && out.data) || {};
      var code = d.code ? String(d.code) : "";
      // A one-word `error` is a code wearing a message's clothes ("forbidden"),
      // not something to show a person. Same test consent-capture.html uses.
      var said = typeof d.error === "string" && /\s/.test(d.error) ? d.error : "";
      var plain = PULL_FAILURE[code];
      if (plain && code === "consent_required" && said) {
        // consentRefusal() (src/finance/soft-pulls.mjs:242) tells revoked from
        // expired from never-given, and those three lead somewhere different.
        plain = "No consent — " + said;
      }
      if (!plain && out && out.status === 403) plain = PULL_FAILURE.forbidden;
      if (!plain) plain = said || ("Could not pull " + label + ".");
      return plain + (code ? " [" + code + "]" : "");
    }

    pullBtns.forEach(function (spec) {
      var btn = $(spec.id);
      if (!btn) return;
      if (!id) btn.disabled = true;
    });
    /* One listener on the document, not on each button. A later paint that
       rebuilds the Actions group used to leave enabled buttons with no click
       handler, so Pull looked live and posted nothing. Identity / consent
       gates still run on the server. This post never sends simulate. */
    document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      var btn = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest("button[id]") : null;
      if (!btn) return;
      var spec = null;
      for (var i = 0; i < pullBtns.length; i++) {
        if (pullBtns[i].id === btn.id) { spec = pullBtns[i]; break; }
      }
      if (!spec || !id || btn.disabled) return;
      btn.disabled = true;
      say("Pulling " + spec.label + "…");
      fetch("/api/finance/crs-pull", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: tokenHeaders(),
        body: JSON.stringify({ client_id: id, bureau: spec.bureau })
      }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (d) { return { status: r.status, data: d }; }); })
        .then(function (out) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          var d = out.data || {};
          if (!d.ok) {
            say(pullFailure(out, spec.label));
            if (d.code === "consent_required") checkConsent();
            return;
          }
          say(spec.label + " pull finished. Refresh the file to see the stored report.");
        })
        .catch(function () {
          btn.disabled = false;
          say("Could not reach the pull service.");
        });
    });
    checkConsent();

    /* GENERATE APPS IS GONE — owner-set 2026-09-06, TODO §7. Its handler lived
       here and did one thing: re-read the lender match list and print "apps
       ready". No application row was ever created by it; that only happens on
       Bank yes / Bank no. The lender list already loads when the page opens, so
       the button and this handler both go. */
    var btn = $("ccp-issue-ir");
    if (!btn) return;
    if (!id) {
      btn.disabled = true;
      sayIr("Pick a client first.");
      return;
    }
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (!window.FHData || typeof FHData.write !== "function") {
        sayIr("Not available — the data layer has not loaded.");
        return;
      }
      btn.disabled = true;
      sayIr("Opening a removal case…");
      FHData.write("/api/inquiry-cases", {
        action: "create",
        client_id: id,
        request_source: "client_control_panel"
      }).then(function (res) {
        if (!res || !res.ok) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          sayIr((res && (res.error || res.message)) || "Could not open a case.");
          return;
        }
        sayIr("Case opened. Going to Inquiry Remover…");
        location.href = "inquiry-remover.html";
      });
    });
  })();

  /* ── SEND THE CLIENT THEIR PORTAL SIGN-IN LINK ─────────────────────────────
     Every client who buys is given an active portal account with a password
     hash nobody holds, and the reset screen they land on tells them, in those
     words, to ask an owner or admin for a link. Nothing in the CRM could send
     one, so the only instruction the product gave a stuck client was impossible
     to follow (walk finding F31, 2026-09-03). POST /api/auth/send-portal-link
     is that press, and this is the place to press it.

     THE BUTTON DISCIPLINE IS F24'S, AND IT IS HALF THE REASON THIS EXISTS.
     Chris, 2026-09-03: "I press it like three or four times, and then all of a
     sudden the client gets like four or five text messages." Two pay-link
     emails carrying two DIFFERENT checkout links went out of the deck that
     way. A sign-in link is a bearer credential, so four of them is four live
     doors into one person's file — a worse version of the same defect. So:
     pressed the instant it is clicked, disabled while the request is in flight,
     no second press for a few seconds after a success, and a "Sent at 3:04 PM"
     line that STAYS under the button. A toast that vanishes is exactly what
     left the closer guessing.

     A FAILURE IS NEVER REPORTED AS A SEND, and never locks the button. The
     endpoint answers in finished sentences a non-engineer can act on — "This
     client has no email address on file, so there is nowhere to send a link",
     "A link was already sent to this client a moment ago" — and FHData.write
     hands those through, so they are printed rather than rewritten here. Only
     the server knows which of them applies.

     `sent:false` ON AN OK REPLY IS ALSO NOT A SEND. It means the link was made
     but the email never reached the queue, which is the one case where saying
     "Sent" would be a straight lie. */
  (function wirePortalLink() {
    /* Owner's number on the deck for the same control: three to five seconds. */
    var SEND_COOLDOWN_MS = 4000;
    var LABEL = "Send portal sign-in link";
    var wrap = $("ccp-portal-link-wrap");
    var btn = $("ccp-portal-link");
    var label = $("ccp-portal-link-label");
    var status = $("ccp-portal-link-status");
    if (!wrap || !btn || !label) return;

    /* The role shell.js caches at sign-in — the same read every other gated
       screen in this suite does. It decides ONE thing: whether the control
       renders at all. An unrecognised role renders nothing, which is the safe
       direction, and the endpoint refuses either way. */
    var viewerRole = "";
    try { viewerRole = String(localStorage.getItem("fh_role") || "").trim().toLowerCase(); }
    catch (e) { viewerRole = ""; }
    if (viewerRole !== "owner" && viewerRole !== "admin") return;
    wrap.hidden = false;

    function say(message) { if (status) status.textContent = message || ""; }
    function clockTime(d) {
      try { return d.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "America/Phoenix" }); }
      catch (e) { return d.getHours() + ":" + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0"); }
    }
    /* Back to pressable, with the sent line left alone — a later failure must
       not erase the record of an earlier real send. */
    function release() {
      btn.disabled = false;
      label.textContent = LABEL;
    }

    if (!id) {
      btn.disabled = true;
      say("Open a client file before sending a sign-in link.");
      return;
    }

    var sentCount = 0;
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (btn.disabled) return;
      if (!window.FHData || typeof FHData.write !== "function") {
        say("Not available — the data layer has not loaded.");
        return;
      }
      btn.disabled = true;
      label.textContent = "Sending…";
      FHData.write("/api/auth/send-portal-link", { client_id: id }).then(function (res) {
        if (!res || !res.ok) {
          release();
          say((res && res.error) || "The sign-in link was not sent. Try again.");
          return;
        }
        if (!res.data || res.data.sent !== true) {
          release();
          say("A link was made but no email went out. Try again, and tell the desk if it keeps happening.");
          return;
        }
        sentCount += 1;
        say("Sent at " + clockTime(new Date()) +
          (sentCount > 1 ? " · sent " + sentCount + " times" : ""));
        label.textContent = "Sent — hold on";
        setTimeout(release, SEND_COOLDOWN_MS);
      });
    });
  })();

  /* Who else can open this file. Owner and admin only. Hidden for everyone else. */
  (function wireAuthorizedRep() {
    var wrap = $("ccp-rep-wrap");
    var now = $("ccp-rep-now");
    var name = $("ccp-rep-name");
    var email = $("ccp-rep-email");
    var phone = $("ccp-rep-phone");
    var add = $("ccp-rep-add");
    var addLabel = $("ccp-rep-add-label");
    var remove = $("ccp-rep-remove");
    var status = $("ccp-rep-status");
    var urlBox = $("ccp-rep-url");
    if (!wrap || !add || !name || !email || !phone) return;

    var viewerRole = "";
    try { viewerRole = String(localStorage.getItem("fh_role") || "").trim().toLowerCase(); }
    catch (e) { viewerRole = ""; }
    if (viewerRole !== "owner" && viewerRole !== "admin") return;
    wrap.hidden = false;

    function say(message) { if (status) status.textContent = message || ""; }
    function paint(rep) {
      if (!now) return;
      if (!rep) {
        now.textContent = "Nobody else can open this file.";
        if (remove) remove.hidden = true;
        return;
      }
      now.textContent = (rep.name || "This person") + " can open this file. Texts and emails go to " + (rep.email || "them") + ".";
      if (remove) remove.hidden = false;
    }
    function authHeaders() {
      var t = "";
      try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) {}
      var h = { accept: "application/json" };
      if (t) h.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
      return h;
    }
    function load() {
      if (!id) { paint(null); return; }
      fetch("/api/auth/authorized-rep?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(id), {
        headers: authHeaders(),
        credentials: "same-origin"
      }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (body) {
        paint(body && body.ok ? body.rep : null);
      }, function () { paint(null); });
    }
    if (!id) {
      add.disabled = true;
      say("Open a client file first.");
      return;
    }
    load();

    add.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (add.disabled) return;
      if (!window.FHData || typeof FHData.write !== "function") {
        say("Not available — the data layer has not loaded.");
        return;
      }
      add.disabled = true;
      if (addLabel) addLabel.textContent = "Adding…";
      FHData.write("/api/auth/authorized-rep", {
        client_id: id,
        name: name.value,
        email: email.value,
        phone: phone.value
      }).then(function (res) {
        add.disabled = false;
        if (addLabel) addLabel.textContent = "Add this person to the file";
        if (!res || !res.ok) {
          say((res && res.error) || "Could not add them.");
          return;
        }
        var link = res.data && res.data.url;
        say(res.data && res.data.sent ? "Added. The sign-in email is queued." : "Added. The sign-in email did not queue. Use the link.");
        if (urlBox && link) {
          urlBox.hidden = false;
          urlBox.value = link;
        }
        load();
      });
    });

    if (remove) {
      remove.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (!window.confirm("Take them off this file? They will not be able to open it.")) return;
        remove.disabled = true;
        FHData.write("/api/auth/authorized-rep", { client_id: id, remove: true }).then(function (res) {
          remove.disabled = false;
          if (!res || !res.ok) {
            say((res && res.error) || "Could not take them off.");
            return;
          }
          if (urlBox) { urlBox.hidden = true; urlBox.value = ""; }
          say("Taken off this file.");
          load();
        });
      });
    }
  })();

  /* ── CAPITAL BLUEPRINT (staff) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
     Reads GET /api/read/blueprint-combined-approval and posts to
     POST /api/blueprint/staff-actions. Field names are the handler's own
     (api/blueprint/staff-actions.mjs): create_credit_partner takes first_name,
     last_name, email, phone; set_next_sequence_date takes ready_date;
     offer_bank_tracker takes offered; add_bank_todo takes bank_key,
     account_kind, notes; list_bank_todos takes nothing more.

     A raw fetch and not FHData.write on purpose: write() flattens every 403
     into "not signed in, or not allowed", and the one 403 this block must say
     out loud is not_blueprint_buyer (the client did not buy the Blueprint). */
  (function wireBlueprint() {
    var group = $("bp-group");
    if (!group) return;
    var el = {
      combined: $("bp-combined"), combinedNote: $("bp-combined-note"),
      primary: $("bp-primary"), primaryLabel: $("bp-primary-label"),
      partnerRow: $("bp-partner-row"), partner: $("bp-partner"), partnerLabel: $("bp-partner-label"),
      partnerNow: $("bp-partner-now"), partnerOpen: $("bp-partner-open"), partnerConsent: $("bp-partner-consent"),
      partnerForm: $("bp-partner-form"), first: $("bp-first"), last: $("bp-last"), email: $("bp-email"),
      phone: $("bp-phone"), partnerAdd: $("bp-partner-add"), partnerAddLabel: $("bp-partner-add-label"),
      partnerStatus: $("bp-partner-status"),
      dateNow: $("bp-date-now"), date: $("bp-date"), dateSave: $("bp-date-save"),
      dateSaveLabel: $("bp-date-save-label"), dateStatus: $("bp-date-status"),
      offerNow: $("bp-offer-now"), offer: $("bp-offer"), offerLabel: $("bp-offer-label"),
      unoffer: $("bp-unoffer"), offerStatus: $("bp-offer-status"),
      todoForm: $("bp-todo-form"), bank: $("bp-bank"), kind: $("bp-kind"), notes: $("bp-notes"),
      todoAdd: $("bp-todo-add"), todoAddLabel: $("bp-todo-add-label"), todoStatus: $("bp-todo-status"),
      todos: $("bp-todos")
    };
    var offered = false;

    function say(node, message) { if (node) node.textContent = message || ""; }
    function allButtons(disabled) {
      [el.partnerAdd, el.dateSave, el.offer, el.unoffer, el.todoAdd].forEach(function (b) {
        if (b) b.disabled = disabled;
      });
    }

    if (!id) {
      say(el.partnerNow, "Open a client file first.");
      say(el.combinedNote, "Open a client file first.");
      say(el.dateNow, "Open a client file first.");
      say(el.offerNow, "Open a client file first.");
      say(el.todos, "Open a client file first.");
      allButtons(true);
      [el.first, el.last, el.email, el.phone, el.date, el.bank, el.kind, el.notes].forEach(function (i) {
        if (i) i.disabled = true;
      });
      return;
    }

    /* Same session the rest of the staff screens use: Bearer token when there
       is one, same-origin cookie otherwise. A demo token is not a credential. */
    function api(method, path, body) {
      var headers = { accept: "application/json" };
      try {
        var t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || "";
        if (t && t !== "demo" && t !== "demo-token") headers.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
      } catch (e) {}
      var init = { method: method, headers: headers, credentials: "same-origin" };
      if (body !== undefined) {
        headers["content-type"] = "application/json";
        init.body = JSON.stringify(body);
      }
      return fetch(path, init).then(
        function (r) {
          return r.json().then(
            function (b) { return { status: r.status, body: b }; },
            function () { return { status: r.status, body: null }; }
          );
        },
        function () { return { status: 0, body: null, transport: true }; }
      );
    }
    function act(action, fields) {
      var body = { action: action, client_id: id };
      for (var k in fields) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(fields, k)) body[k] = fields[k];
      return api("POST", "/api/blueprint/staff-actions", body);
    }
    function ok(res) { return res.status === 200 && res.body && res.body.ok === true; }

    /* What went wrong, in the words of the person at the desk. Never a code. */
    function problem(res) {
      var err = String((res.body && res.body.error) || "");
      if (res.transport || res.status === 0) return "Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.";
      if (res.status === 401) return "You are signed out. Sign in and open this page again.";
      if (err === "not_blueprint_buyer") return "This client has not paid for the Capital Blueprint, so this is not available for them.";
      if (err === "partner_name_and_email_required") return "Type a first name, a last name and a real email for the partner.";
      if (err === "invalid_ready_date") return "Pick a date first.";
      if (err === "bank_tracker_not_offered") return "Offer the bank tracker to this client first. Then you can add banks.";
      if (err === "bank_key_required") return "Type the bank's name.";
      if (err === "invalid_account_kind") return "Pick personal or business.";
      if (err === "primary_not_found" || res.status === 404) return "That client file was not found. Reload the page.";
      if (res.status === 403) return "Your account is not allowed to do that.";
      if (res.status === 503) return "The database is not reachable right now. Try again in a moment.";
      return "That did not work. Try again in a moment.";
    }

    function day(ymd) {
      var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(String(ymd || ""));
      if (!m) return "";
      var d = new Date(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]));
      try { return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }); }
      catch (e) { return ymd; }
    }

    /* ── the two flags saved on the client record ── */
    function paintDate(ymd) {
      if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(ymd || ""))) {
        el.date.value = ymd;
        say(el.dateNow, "Ready on " + day(ymd) + ".");
      } else {
        say(el.dateNow, "No ready date is set yet.");
      }
    }
    function paintOffered(on) {
      offered = !!on;
      say(el.offerNow, offered ? "Offered to this client. Add the banks below." : "Not offered to this client yet.");
      el.offer.hidden = offered;
      el.unoffer.hidden = !offered;
      el.todoForm.hidden = !offered;
    }
    paintOffered(false);
    document.addEventListener("ccp:client", function (ev) {
      var c = (ev && ev.detail) || {};
      var cf = c.custom_fields || {};
      paintDate(cf.blueprint_next_sequence_ready_date);
      paintOffered(cf.blueprint_bank_tracker_offered === true ||
        String(cf.blueprint_bank_tracker_offered || "").toLowerCase() === "true");
    });

    /* ── combined prequal, and who the partner is ── */
    function paintCombined(b) {
      var none = "Not worked out yet";
      var hasPartner = !!b.partnerClientId;
      say(el.combined, b.combinedPrequalDisplay || "—");
      say(el.primaryLabel, (b.primary && b.primary.name) ? b.primary.name + " (primary)" : "Primary");
      say(el.primary, b.primaryPrequalDisplay || none);
      el.partnerRow.hidden = !hasPartner;
      if (hasPartner) {
        say(el.partnerLabel, (b.partner && b.partner.name) ? b.partner.name + " (partner)" : "Partner");
        say(el.partner, b.partnerPrequalDisplay || none);
      }
      if (b.combinedPrequal == null) {
        say(el.combinedNote, "No prequal number is worked out for this file yet.");
      } else if (hasPartner && b.partnerPrequal == null) {
        say(el.combinedNote, "The partner's number is not worked out yet, so this counts the primary file only.");
      } else if (hasPartner) {
        say(el.combinedNote, "The primary number plus the partner's number.");
      } else {
        say(el.combinedNote, "No credit partner on this file, so this is the primary file alone.");
      }
      if (hasPartner) {
        say(el.partnerNow, (b.partner && b.partner.name ? b.partner.name : "A credit partner") +
          " is on this file. One partner is included.");
        el.partnerOpen.href = "client-control-panel.html?id=" + encodeURIComponent(b.partnerClientId);
        el.partnerConsent.href = "consent-capture.html?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(b.partnerClientId);
        el.partnerOpen.hidden = false;
        el.partnerConsent.hidden = false;
        el.partnerForm.hidden = true;
      } else {
        say(el.partnerNow, "No credit partner yet. One partner is included with the Blueprint.");
        el.partnerOpen.hidden = true;
        el.partnerConsent.hidden = true;
        el.partnerForm.hidden = false;
      }
    }
    function loadCombined() {
      return api("GET", "/api/read/blueprint-combined-approval?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(id)).then(function (res) {
        if (!ok(res)) {
          say(el.combined, "—");
          say(el.combinedNote, "The combined number did not load. " + problem(res));
          say(el.partnerNow, "Could not check for a credit partner.");
          el.partnerForm.hidden = true;
          return;
        }
        paintCombined(res.body);
      });
    }

    /* ── credit partner ── */
    el.partnerAdd.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (el.partnerAdd.disabled) return;
      el.partnerAdd.disabled = true;
      say(el.partnerAddLabel, "Adding…");
      say(el.partnerStatus, "");
      act("create_credit_partner", {
        first_name: el.first.value.trim(),
        last_name: el.last.value.trim(),
        email: el.email.value.trim(),
        phone: el.phone.value.trim() || null
      }).then(function (res) {
        el.partnerAdd.disabled = false;
        say(el.partnerAddLabel, "Add credit partner");
        if (!ok(res)) { say(el.partnerStatus, problem(res)); return; }
        if (res.body.skipped === "already_linked") {
          say(el.partnerStatus, "This client already has a credit partner.");
        } else {
          say(el.partnerStatus, "Partner added. They must record their own credit check consent before any pull. Their checklist starts after that.");
        }
        el.first.value = ""; el.last.value = ""; el.email.value = ""; el.phone.value = "";
        loadCombined();
      });
    });

    /* ── next funding sequence date ── */
    el.dateSave.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (el.dateSave.disabled) return;
      if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(el.date.value)) {
        say(el.dateStatus, "Pick a date first.");
        return;
      }
      el.dateSave.disabled = true;
      say(el.dateSaveLabel, "Saving…");
      say(el.dateStatus, "");
      act("set_next_sequence_date", { ready_date: el.date.value }).then(function (res) {
        el.dateSave.disabled = false;
        say(el.dateSaveLabel, "Save ready date");
        if (!ok(res)) { say(el.dateStatus, problem(res)); return; }
        paintDate(res.body.readyDate);
        say(el.dateStatus, "Saved. The closer gets a task on that day.");
      });
    });

    /* ── bank tracker ── */
    function setOffer(on) {
      var btn = on ? el.offer : el.unoffer;
      btn.disabled = true;
      if (on) say(el.offerLabel, "Offering…");
      say(el.offerStatus, "");
      act("offer_bank_tracker", { offered: on }).then(function (res) {
        btn.disabled = false;
        say(el.offerLabel, "Offer bank tracker");
        if (!ok(res)) { say(el.offerStatus, problem(res)); return; }
        paintOffered(res.body.offered);
        say(el.offerStatus, res.body.offered ? "Saved. The bank tracker is offered." : "Saved. The offer is taken back.");
      });
    }
    el.offer.addEventListener("click", function () { if (!el.offer.disabled) setOffer(true); });
    el.unoffer.addEventListener("click", function () { if (!el.unoffer.disabled) setOffer(false); });

    var STATE_WORD = { open: "Open", done: "Done", skipped: "Skipped" };
    function paintTodos(rows) {
      el.todos.textContent = "";
      if (!rows.length) {
        var empty = document.createElement("p");
        empty.className = "fact-note";
        empty.textContent = "No banks on the list yet. Offer the tracker, then add the first bank.";
        el.todos.appendChild(empty);
        return;
      }
      var list = document.createElement("div");
      list.className = "facts-list";
      rows.forEach(function (t) {
        var row = document.createElement("div");
        row.className = "fact-row";
        var k = document.createElement("span");
        k.className = "k";
        k.textContent = (t.bank_key || "Unnamed bank") + " · " + (t.account_kind === "business" ? "Business" : "Personal");
        var v = document.createElement("span");
        v.className = "v";
        v.textContent = STATE_WORD[t.state] || String(t.state || "");
        row.appendChild(k);
        row.appendChild(v);
        list.appendChild(row);
        /* Done / Skipped. The open row offers both; a closed one offers a way
           back to open. The server (update_bank_todo_state) takes open, done
           or skipped, and the list is re-read after so the screen shows what
           the database holds. */
        var acts = document.createElement("div");
        acts.className = "bp-todo-acts";
        var opts = t.state === "open" || !t.state
          ? [["done", "Done"], ["skipped", "Skipped"]]
          : [["open", "Put back on the list"]];
        opts.forEach(function (o) {
          var b = document.createElement("button");
          b.type = "button";
          b.className = "link-btn";
          b.textContent = o[1];
          b.addEventListener("click", function () {
            if (b.disabled) return;
