            [].slice.call(acts.querySelectorAll("button")).forEach(function (x) { x.disabled = true; });
            act("update_bank_todo_state", { todo_id: t.id, state: o[0] }).then(function (res) {
              if (!ok(res)) {
                [].slice.call(acts.querySelectorAll("button")).forEach(function (x) { x.disabled = false; });
                say(el.todoStatus, problem(res));
                return;
              }
              say(el.todoStatus, "");
              loadTodos();
            });
          });
          acts.appendChild(b);
        });
        list.appendChild(acts);
        if (t.notes) {
          var n = document.createElement("div");
          n.className = "fact-note";
          n.textContent = t.notes;
          list.appendChild(n);
        }
      });
      el.todos.appendChild(list);
    }
    function loadTodos() {
      return act("list_bank_todos", {}).then(function (res) {
        if (!ok(res)) {
          el.todos.textContent = "";
          var bad = document.createElement("p");
          bad.className = "fact-note";
          bad.textContent = "The bank list did not load. " + problem(res);
          el.todos.appendChild(bad);
          return;
        }
        paintTodos(res.body.todos || []);
      });
    }
    el.todoAdd.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (el.todoAdd.disabled) return;
      if (!el.bank.value.trim()) { say(el.todoStatus, "Type the bank's name."); el.bank.focus(); return; }
      el.todoAdd.disabled = true;
      say(el.todoAddLabel, "Adding…");
      say(el.todoStatus, "");
      act("add_bank_todo", {
        bank_key: el.bank.value.trim(),
        account_kind: el.kind.value,
        notes: el.notes.value.trim() || null
      }).then(function (res) {
        el.todoAdd.disabled = false;
        say(el.todoAddLabel, "Add bank to the list");
        if (!ok(res)) {
          if (res.body && res.body.error === "bank_tracker_not_offered") paintOffered(false);
          say(el.todoStatus, problem(res));
          return;
        }
        say(el.todoStatus, "Added to the list.");
        el.bank.value = ""; el.notes.value = "";
        loadTodos();
      });
    });

    loadCombined();
    loadTodos();
  })();

  /* ── THE ROUND'S THREE MOVES ───────────────────────────────────────────────
     Every stage move used to happen on the Pipeline board and every dollar
     amount used to be typed on this screen, so finishing one round meant
     bouncing between two screens four or more times — twenty to forty times a
     day across a book.

     NOTHING NEW DECIDES ANYTHING. These post to POST /api/pipeline-cards, the
     endpoint the board's own drag already posts to, with the same
     moveCardToStage() and the same guards deciding whether the move is allowed.
     The refusals a person will actually meet are the interesting part and each
     one is said in plain words below:

       approval_amounts_missing  a bank yes on this round has no dollar amount,
                                 so it could never be invoiced. The server names
                                 the banks; we print them. This is the same fact
                                 the count at the top of the screen is about.
       funded_amount_required    Funded needs money that actually landed.
       funding_gate_closed       a document or a new negative is holding funding.
       shift_required            whoever is signed in has not clocked on.

     A MOVE CAN CREATE A CARD. moveCardToStage inserts one when this client has
     no card on the card-stacking rail, and the reply says so — so we say so
     too, rather than letting a person find out later that the board grew a row.

     The funded amount is typed into a box on the page. window.prompt cannot
     show the parser's refusal beside the box, cannot be corrected, and vanishes
     if the window loses focus. */
  (function wireRoundMoves() {
    var CARD_STACKING = "funding_card_stacking";
    var submit = $("ccp-round-submit");
    var fund = $("ccp-round-fund");
    var close = $("ccp-round-close");
    var box = $("ccp-round-amount-box");
    var amount = $("ccp-round-funded");
    var go = $("ccp-round-fund-go");
    var cancel = $("ccp-round-fund-cancel");
    var note = $("ccp-round-note");
    if (!submit || !fund || !close || !box || !amount || !go || !cancel || !note) return;

    function say(text, state) {
      note.className = "round-note" + (state ? " " + state : "");
      note.textContent = text;
    }
    function busy(on) {
      submit.disabled = on || !id;
      fund.disabled = on || !id;
      close.disabled = on || !id;
      go.disabled = on;
    }

    if (!id) {
      say("Open a client file to move its round.");
      return;
    }
    say("Moving a round here does the same thing as dragging its card on Pipeline.");
    busy(false);

    function afterMove(res, what) {
      if (!res || !res.ok) {
        // FHData.write already turned the server's own message into a sentence
        // (userFacing in data.js). Never rewrite it here — the server is the
        // only thing that knows WHICH banks are blank.
        say("Could not " + what + ". " + ((res && res.error) || "The move was not saved."), "is-bad");
        busy(false);
        return;
      }
      var made = res.data && res.data.created === true;
      say("Saved — " + what + "."
        + (made ? " This client had no card on the Card Stacking board, so one was made." : ""),
        "is-done");
      box.hidden = true;
      amount.value = "";
      // Repaint from the record rather than from what we hoped happened.
      FHData.client(id).then(function (again) {
        busy(false);
        if (again && again.ok) render(again.data);
      });
      if (typeof window.fhRefreshFundingApply === "function") window.fhRefreshFundingApply();
    }

    function move(stageKey, what, extra) {
      if (!window.FHData || typeof FHData.write !== "function") {
        say("Could not " + what + ". The data layer has not loaded.", "is-bad");
        return;
      }
      var body = {
        action: "move",
        client_id: id,
        pipeline_key: CARD_STACKING,
        stage_key: stageKey
      };
      if (extra) { for (var k in extra) { if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(extra, k)) body[k] = extra[k]; } }
      busy(true);
      say("Saving…");
      FHData.write("/api/pipeline-cards", body).then(function (res) { afterMove(res, what); });
    }

    submit.addEventListener("click", function () { move("round_submitted", "mark the round submitted"); });
    close.addEventListener("click", function () { move("closed", "close the round"); });

    fund.addEventListener("click", function () {
      box.hidden = false;
      say("Type the money that actually reached the account. This is not the approved amount, and empty is not zero.");
      amount.focus();
    });
    cancel.addEventListener("click", function () {
      box.hidden = true;
      amount.value = "";
      say("Nothing was changed.");
    });
    go.addEventListener("click", function () {
      /* BLANK IS NOT ZERO, and a typo is not an unknown. The shared parser
         refuses both and says which — public/app/money-input.js, the same rule
         the board's Funded drag uses. */
      if (!window.FHMoneyInput || !window.FHMoneyInput.parseAmount) {
        say("The amount box could not load. Nothing was saved.", "is-bad");
        return;
      }
      var parsed = window.FHMoneyInput.parseAmount(amount.value);
      if (!parsed.ok) {
        say(parsed.message, "is-bad");
        amount.focus();
        return;
      }
      move("funded", "mark the round funded", { funded_amount: parsed.dollars });
    });
  })();

  if (!id) paintBusinesses("empty");
  FHData.client(id).then(function (res) {
    /* The file answered, one way or another. The loading state ends here,
       before any branch, so every branch below paints its own honest words
       and no skeleton outlives the read (see FH-CCP-OPENING in <head>). */
    document.documentElement.classList.remove("ccp-opening");
    if (res.ok) { render(res.data); return; }
    /* Say it where the reader is already looking, in words, instead of a dash
       where the name goes and the real answer in a bar at the other end of
       the screen. */
    if (res.source === "nodata") {
      setText("ccp-name", "No client open");
      setText("ccp-key", "Pick a client to open their file.");
      source("empty", "no client open — pick a client from the list");
      paintBusinesses("empty");
    } else if (res.source === "demo") {
      setText("ccp-name", "No live file");
      setText("ccp-key", "Demo session — this screen did not query a live file.");
      source("empty", "demo mode — this screen did not query a live file");
      paintBusinesses("empty");
    } else if (res.source === "notfound") {
      setText("ccp-name", "No client with that id");
      setText("ccp-key", "Pick a client from the list.");
      source("empty", "no client with that id");
      paintBusinesses("empty");
    } else if (res.source === "badrequest") {
      setText("ccp-name", "That is not a valid client id");
      setText("ccp-key", "Pick a client from the list.");
      source("empty", "that id is not a valid client id");
      paintBusinesses("empty");
    } else {
      setText("ccp-name", "Could not load this file");
      setText("ccp-key", "The read did not answer. Nothing below has been filled in.");
      source("error", "could not load this file (" + res.source + ")");
      paintBusinesses("error", null, "Could not load businesses.");
    }
  });

  (function loadAgentContext() {
    var pre = $("agent-context-pre");
    if (!pre || !id) return;
    FHData.read("agent-context", { client_id: id }).then(function (res) {
      if (res && res.ok && res.data && res.data.context) {
        var block = res.data.context.as_prompt_block
          || JSON.stringify(res.data.context, null, 2);
        pre.textContent = block;
      } else if (res && res.source === "notfound") {
        pre.textContent = "Client not found.";
      } else if (!res || !res.ok) {
        pre.textContent = "Could not load agent context"
          + (res && res.error ? " (" + res.error + ")" : "") + ".";
      }
    });
  })();
});
</script>

<!-- ══ STAFF UPLOAD — upload on this client's behalf ═══════════════════════
     Posts to the same /api/documents-upload endpoint the client portal uses;
     a staff session is what makes it a "staff upload" server-side. Needs a
     real client id in the URL (?id=<uuid>). Without one, the drop zone says so. -->
<script>
// Same reason as the block above: data.js is deferred, so reading the client id
// off FHData while this script parses threw and left the drop zone unwired.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  "use strict";
  var zone   = document.getElementById("staff-dropzone"),
      input  = document.getElementById("staff-file-input"),
      list   = document.getElementById("staff-filelist"),
      status = document.getElementById("staff-upload-status"),
      clientId = FHData.param("id") || FHData.param("client_id") || FHData.param("client") || FHData.param("contact");

  if (!zone) return;

  function say(text, isErr) {
    status.textContent = text;
    status.className = "dz-status" + (isErr ? " err" : "");
  }

  function size(b) {
    if (b < 1024) return b + " B";
    if (b < 1024 * 1024) return (b / 1024).toFixed(0) + " KB";
    return (b / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1) + " MB";
  }

  if (!clientId) {
    say("no client open — pick a client on Pipeline to upload for them", false);
    zone.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
  }

  function addRow(filename, bytes) {
    var row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "dz-file";
    var fn = document.createElement("span"); fn.className = "fn"; fn.textContent = filename;
    var fs = document.createElement("span"); fs.className = "fs"; fs.textContent = size(bytes);
    row.appendChild(fn); row.appendChild(fs);
    list.appendChild(row);
    return { row: row, fn: fn };
  }

  function upload(files) {
    if (!clientId || !files || !files.length) return;
    say("uploading " + files.length + " " + (files.length === 1 ? "file" : "files") + "…", false);
    var rows = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < files.length; i++) rows.push(addRow(files[i].name, files[i].size));

    FHData.uploadFiles("/api/documents-upload", files, { client_id: clientId }).then(function (res) {
      if (!res.ok) {
        say("upload failed — " + (res.error || "try again"), true);
        return;
      }
      var docs = (res.data && res.data.documents) || [];
      rows.forEach(function (r, i) {
        r.row.classList.add("sent");
        var d = docs[i];
        if (d && d.download && d.download.url) {
          var a = document.createElement("a");
          a.href = d.download.url; a.target = "_blank"; a.rel = "noopener";
          a.className = "fn"; a.textContent = r.fn.textContent;
          r.row.replaceChild(a, r.fn);
        }
      });
      say(docs.length + " " + (docs.length === 1 ? "file" : "files") + " sent", false);
    });
  }

  zone.addEventListener("click", function () { if (clientId) input.click(); });
  zone.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (clientId && (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ")) { e.preventDefault(); input.click(); }
  });
  input.addEventListener("change", function () { upload(input.files); input.value = ""; });

  ["dragenter", "dragover"].forEach(function (ev) {
    zone.addEventListener(ev, function (e) { e.preventDefault(); if (clientId) zone.classList.add("drag"); });
  });
  ["dragleave", "drop"].forEach(function (ev) {
    zone.addEventListener(ev, function (e) { e.preventDefault(); zone.classList.remove("drag"); });
  });
  zone.addEventListener("drop", function (e) {
    if (clientId && e.dataTransfer && e.dataTransfer.files.length) upload(e.dataTransfer.files);
  });
});
</script>
<script>
/* Funding Apply — load matching lenders and wire the residential proxy door.

   IT WAITS FOR THE PAGE NOW. data.js carries `defer`, so while this file is
   being parsed FHData does not exist yet — this block used to read the address
   bar directly as a fallback and get the same answer, which is why nothing
   looked wrong, and it is why this screen was on the known-unfixed list in
   src/http/calendar-paint.test.mjs. It matters now: the count this block paints
   leads the screen, and it has to be able to tell a failed read from an empty
   file. Only FHData can tell those apart (see FHData.applications), so the
   block waits for DOMContentLoaded — which every deferred script runs before —
   exactly as the main block above it already does. */
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  "use strict";
  var clientId = (typeof FHData !== "undefined" && FHData.param)
    ? (FHData.param("id") || FHData.param("client_id") || FHData.param("client") || FHData.param("contact") || "")
    : (function (p) {
        return p.get("id") || p.get("client_id") || p.get("client") || p.get("contact") || "";
      })(new URLSearchParams(location.search));
  var statusEl = document.getElementById("fh-funding-apply-status");
  var listEl = document.getElementById("fh-funding-apply-list");
  var waitEl = document.getElementById("fh-funding-amounts-waiting");
  var hintEl = document.getElementById("fh-bank-amount-hint");
  var moreEl = document.getElementById("fh-funding-apply-more");
  if (!statusEl || !listEl) return;

  /* The token and headers every read and write in this block uses. Hoisted out
     of loadMatches on 2026-08-30 because the applications read no longer hangs
     off the lender-match read — see refreshSaved below. */
  var t = "";
  try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { t = ""; }
  var headers = { accept: "application/json" };
  if (t) headers.authorization = "Bearer " + t;

  /* HOW MANY LENDER ROWS ARE DRAWN. It was 12, silently: a funding advisor
     applying in waves has more banks than that on a file and rows 13 and up
     simply were not there. 25 is the house page size, and whatever is over it
     is now SAID rather than dropped in silence — see paintMore(). */
  var ROW_CAP = 25;

  /* ── APPROVAL AND AMOUNT ARE TWO SEPARATE MOMENTS ────────────────────────
     Owner-set 2026-08-29. When a bank comes back, the fulfillment team often
     does not know the limit yet — they have to ask the client, or wait for the
     bank's approval email to land in this client's inbox. So a "Bank yes" with
     an empty amount box SAVES, and applications.approved_amount keeps its NULL.

     NULL IS UNKNOWN AND MUST SURVIVE. Nothing on this screen ever sends a 0 for
     an amount nobody typed: an empty box sends no approved_amount key at all,
     so the column is not written. A zero would be a claim that the bank
     approved nothing, and it would flow into a success-fee invoice looking
     perfectly legitimate (docs/finance/CLOSEOUT-FEE-BASIS.md).

     BUT AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT CANNOT BE ALLOWED TO ROT. Until the dollars are in,
     that approval is missing from the round's lender breakdown, so the client
     is never billed for it. So every approval still waiting on an amount is
     marked on its own row AND counted in one sentence at the top of this block.

     THE FUNDED COLUMN IS UNAFFECTED and stays strictly gated — a card still
     cannot reach Funded without a dollar amount. Two moments, two rules. */
  var AMOUNT_WAITING_CHIP = "Amount needed";

  /* THE DEFINITION LIVES IN ONE PLACE AND THIS IS NOT IT.
     "Approved, nobody has recorded a usable dollar amount, and nobody has
     marked it as not counting" is the same question the biller asks
     (unpricedApprovalConditions, src/funding/success-fee.mjs) and the board
     asks (api/dashboard/pipeline.mjs). It used to be written out a third time
     right here, slightly differently — this copy did not treat a recorded zero
     as unpriced, so the screen called an approval finished that the Funded move
     then refused.
     It now comes from the FH-CCP block at the top of this file, which is pure,
     has no DOM, and is proved against the SQL string by
     src/http/client-panel-screen.test.mjs. */
  var CP = window.FHClientPanel;
  var isExcluded = CP.isExcluded;
  var isWaitingOnAmount = CP.isWaitingOnAmount;

  /* The saved dollars, as a person should see them in the box they type into.
     Anything unreadable comes back empty rather than guessed. */
  function amountForBox(app) {
    if (!app) return "";
    var a = app.approved_amount;
    if (a === null || a === undefined) return "";
    var s = String(a).trim();
    if (!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(s)) return "";
    return s;
  }

  function paintWaiting(count) {
    if (!waitEl) return;
    if (!count) { waitEl.hidden = true; waitEl.textContent = ""; return; }
    waitEl.textContent = (count === 1
      ? "1 bank approval is still waiting on its dollar amount."
      : count + " bank approvals are still waiting on their dollar amount.")
      + " Type it in the Approved $ box and press Bank yes."
      + " Until then this round cannot be marked Funded, because an approval with no"
      + " amount is never billed. If one was withdrawn or never used, press"
      + " “Doesn’t count” on its row.";
    waitEl.hidden = false;
  }

  /* ── THE HEADLINE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     The one number the advisor came for, top-left, at metric size
     (UI-STANDARDS §12 rule 1), plus the confirmed dollars beside it as the
     comparison §7 asks for.

     FOUR STATES AND ALL FOUR ARE WRITTEN, because this slot is the first thing
     read and a wrong impression here is the expensive one:

       a count      "3" + "bank answers need a dollar amount"
       nothing      "Nothing waiting on this file." — in WORDS. A bare 0 in a
                    box is how a zero standing in for unknown gets believed, and
                    this zero is real: there are no such rows.
       could not    "Could not check what is waiting." The read failed, so the
                    honest answer is that we do not know. This screen used to
                    leave the previous sentence exactly as it was on a failed
                    read, which made a network hiccup look like an all-clear.
       no client    "Pick a client to see what is waiting on you." (the markup's
                    own starting text, left alone when there is no client id)

     THE APPROVED TILE IS PAINTED FROM THE SAME ANSWER, deliberately: one read,
     so the tile and the headline cannot say different things. */
  var headEl = document.getElementById("ccp-waiting");
  var countEl = document.getElementById("ccp-waiting-count");
  var whatEl = document.getElementById("ccp-waiting-what");
  var cmpEl = document.getElementById("ccp-waiting-compare");
  var approvedTile = document.getElementById("ccp-approved");

  function paintHeadline(summary) {
    if (!whatEl) return;
    var known = !!summary;
    var waiting = known ? summary.waiting : null;

    if (countEl) {
      countEl.hidden = !known || waiting === 0;
      countEl.textContent = known && waiting > 0 ? String(waiting) : "";
    }
    if (headEl) headEl.classList.toggle("is-waiting", known && waiting > 0);

    if (!known) {
      whatEl.textContent = "Could not check what is waiting.";
    } else if (waiting === 0) {
      whatEl.textContent = "Nothing waiting on this file.";
    } else {
      whatEl.textContent = waiting === 1
        ? "bank answer needs a dollar amount"
        : "bank answers need a dollar amount";
    }

    if (cmpEl) {
      if (!known) {
        cmpEl.textContent = "The confirmed total could not be read either.";
      } else if (summary.confirmed > 0) {
        /* "on this file" is doing real work. This counts every bank yes on the
           client, across every round; the Funding round box below counts one
           round. Two right numbers that differ read as one wrong number unless
           each one says what it is counting. */
        cmpEl.textContent = CP.money(summary.confirmed_dollars) + " confirmed across "
          + summary.confirmed + (summary.confirmed === 1 ? " bank yes" : " bank yeses")
          + " on this file.";
      } else {
        cmpEl.textContent = "No bank yes on this file carries a dollar amount yet.";
      }
    }

    /* The tile that used to say "Total Approved" and show the FUNDED amount,
       or failing that a pre-approval GUESS. Unknown is a dash in words, never a
       zero and never the guess. */
    if (approvedTile) {
      approvedTile.textContent = !known ? "could not check"
        : summary.confirmed > 0 ? CP.money(summary.confirmed_dollars)
        : "not recorded";
    }
  }

  /* Said out loud rather than left to be discovered: the row list is capped. */
  function paintMore(total, shown) {
    if (!moreEl) return;
    var hidden = total - shown;
    if (!(hidden > 0)) { moreEl.hidden = true; moreEl.textContent = ""; return; }
    moreEl.textContent = hidden + (hidden === 1 ? " more lender fits" : " more lenders fit")
      + " this file and " + (hidden === 1 ? "is" : "are") + " not shown. The count at the top"
      + " of the screen still covers every bank answer on the file, including banks"
      + " with no row here.";
    moreEl.hidden = false;
  }

  /* ── WHAT THE BANK'S EMAIL ALREADY SAID ──────────────────────────────────
     Added 2026-08-30. The bank emails this client its decision, that email
     lands in the client's Fundhub inbox, and the classifier has always read a
     dollar figure out of it — then dropped the figure and kept only a yes/no.
     So a funding advisor retyped, from the same email, a number the system
     already had. When they forgot, the approval carried no amount and the round
     could not be billed (docs/finance/CLOSEOUT-FEE-BASIS.md).

     THREE RULES, AND THEY ARE THE WHOLE DESIGN:

     1. IT IS A SUGGESTION. Clicking a button puts the figure in the Approved $
        box. It does not save anything. Nothing here ever writes
        approved_amount by itself — a wrong number saved quietly is worse than
        an empty box, because an empty box is visibly waiting and a wrong number
        looks finished.
     2. WE DO NOT PICK. A bank email states a credit limit, an APR, an annual
        fee and a minimum payment in one paragraph. When the email held more
        than one figure, the sentence below SAYS SO and every figure is offered.
        It never quietly nominates one as "the" amount.
     3. NO FIGURE MEANS NO SUGGESTION. Never a zero. An email with nothing in it
        paints nothing and the boxes stay exactly as they were.

     A denial offers nothing at all — the server does not even scan a DENIED
     email, because the number in a denial letter is the limit it is refusing,
     which is the most dangerous figure in the mailbox. */
  var bankAmounts = null;   // { amounts: ["5000.00"], found: 2, subject: "…", when: "…" }
  var bankAmountsAsked = false;

  /* "5000.00" -> "$5,000" / "$5,000.50". The saved box wants the raw string;
     a person reading a button wants the money. Anything unreadable comes back
     empty and is not offered — never guessed at. */
  function moneyLabel(dollars) {
    var s = String(dollars == null ? "" : dollars).trim();
    var m = /^(\d+)(?:\.(\d{1,2}))?$/.exec(s);
    if (!m) return "";
    var whole = m[1].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
    var cents = m[2] === undefined ? "00" : (m[2].length === 1 ? m[2] + "0" : m[2]);
    return "$" + whole + (cents === "00" ? "" : "." + cents);
  }

  function shortSubject(text) {
    var s = String(text == null ? "" : text).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    if (!s) return "";
    return s.length > 60 ? s.slice(0, 60) + "…" : s;
  }

  /* The newest bank email on this file that actually stated a figure. Newest
     only, deliberately: stacking the figures from six different emails into one
     row is noise, and the subject line is printed so a person can see WHICH
     email is being quoted before they accept anything from it. */
  function pickBankAmounts(items) {
    for (var i = 0; i < (items || []).length; i++) {
      var it = items[i] || {};
      var list = it.amount_candidates;
      if (!Array.isArray(list) || !list.length) continue;
      var clean = [];
      for (var j = 0; j < list.length; j++) {
        if (moneyLabel(list[j])) clean.push(String(list[j]).trim());
      }
      if (!clean.length) continue;
      var found = Number(it.amount_candidates_found);
      return {
        amounts: clean,
        found: (isFinite(found) && found >= clean.length) ? found : clean.length,
        subject: shortSubject(it.subject),
        classification: String(it.classification || "")
      };
    }
    return null;
  }

  function paintBankHint() {
    if (!hintEl) return;
    if (!bankAmounts) { hintEl.hidden = true; hintEl.textContent = ""; return; }
    var from = bankAmounts.subject ? ' “' + bankAmounts.subject + '”' : "";
    hintEl.textContent = bankAmounts.found === 1
      ? ("The bank's email" + from + " says " + moneyLabel(bankAmounts.amounts[0])
         + ". Tap it beside the right lender to fill the Approved $ box. Nothing is saved until you press Bank yes.")
      : ("The bank's email" + from + " lists " + bankAmounts.found
         + " dollar amounts and we cannot tell which one is the approval."
         + " Tap the right one beside the right lender. Nothing is saved until you press Bank yes.");
    hintEl.hidden = false;
  }

  /* One button per figure, sitting immediately after that row's Approved $ box.
     Clicking fills THAT row's box and focuses it, so the next thing a person
     does is read the number they just accepted. */
  /* ONE ROW'S BUTTONS, and the box they belong to is a PARAMETER.
     It has to be. This screen is written in `var`, and a handler that closed
     over a `var box` from the surrounding loop would hold whichever row the
     loop finished on — so every button on every row would have filled the last
     lender's box. Passing it in gives each row its own. */
  function fillSlot(slot, box) {
    var lead = document.createElement("span");
    /* Literal colours, like the "Amount needed" chip above and for the same
       reason: a tenant's brand ramp overwrites the shared colour variables, so
       anything painted from them goes the same blue as everything else. */
    lead.style.cssText = "font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:#52525B";
    lead.textContent = bankAmounts.found === 1 ? "Bank email:" : "Bank email lists:";
    slot.appendChild(lead);
    bankAmounts.amounts.forEach(function (dollars) {
      var label = moneyLabel(dollars);
      var b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button";
      b.className = "fh-bank-amount-suggestion";
      b.textContent = label;
      b.title = "Put " + label + " in the Approved $ box. It is not saved until you press Bank yes.";
      b.setAttribute("aria-label", "Use " + label + " from the bank email");
      /* Dashed on purpose: it reads as an offer, not as a saved value. */
      b.style.cssText = "padding:2px 8px;font-size:var(--fs-caption);border-radius:999px;"
        + "border:1px dashed #A1A1AA;background:transparent;color:#3F3F46;cursor:pointer";
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        box.value = dollars;
        box.focus();
      });
      slot.appendChild(b);
    });
    slot.hidden = false;
  }

  function paintRowButtons() {
    var slots = listEl.querySelectorAll("[data-amount-suggest-lender-id]");
    for (var i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) {
      var slot = slots[i];
      slot.textContent = "";
      slot.hidden = true;
      if (!bankAmounts) continue;
      var lenderId = slot.getAttribute("data-amount-suggest-lender-id");
      var box = listEl.querySelector('input[data-amount-lender-id="' + lenderId + '"]');
      if (box) fillSlot(slot, box);
    }
  }

  /* Read once per screen load. A failure paints nothing rather than an excuse:
     the Approved $ box works exactly as it did before, so a bank inbox that
     cannot be read costs the suggestion, not the screen. */
  function loadBankAmounts() {
    if (bankAmountsAsked) { paintBankHint(); paintRowButtons(); return Promise.resolve(bankAmounts); }
    bankAmountsAsked = true;
    var t = "";
    try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) {}
    var h = { accept: "application/json" };
    if (t) h.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
    return fetch("/api/read/bank-inbox?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(clientId) + "&limit=50", { headers: h })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        bankAmounts = (d && d.ok) ? pickBankAmounts(d.items) : null;
        paintBankHint();
        paintRowButtons();
        return bankAmounts;
      })
      .catch(function () {
        bankAmounts = null;
        paintBankHint();
        paintRowButtons();
        return null;
      });
  }

  /* ── WHAT IS ALREADY SAVED ON THIS FILE ───────────────────────────────────
     Three jobs, one read of GET /api/applications:

       * the play name and the approved amount go back into the boxes they were
         typed into, so the amount box is where somebody returns to add a dollar
         figure they did not have the first time;
       * every approval still waiting on an amount is chipped on its row and
         named in the amber block above the rows;
       * the headline count and the confirmed total at the top of the screen.

     IT NO LONGER HANGS OFF THE LENDER-MATCH READ. This function used to be
     declared INSIDE the lender-matches .then, so if that read failed — or if
     this client matched no lenders at all — the approvals on the file were
     never counted and the screen said nothing about them. It is the whole
     file's answer, so it is asked for on its own.

     A FAILED READ SAYS SO. It used to `return null` and deliberately leave the
     previous sentence exactly as it was, which is indistinguishable on screen
     from a file with nothing waiting — a silent all-clear. Now the headline
     says "could not check" and FHData.explain puts the house wording for
     whatever actually went wrong in the status strip. Never our own sentence
     for a failure the data layer already has words for. */
  function refreshSaved() {
    /* No client picked is NOT "we could not check" — nobody asked us to check
       anything yet. The markup's own opening line already says so, and it is
       left exactly as it is. */
    if (!clientId) return Promise.resolve(null);
    if (!window.FHData || typeof FHData.applications !== "function") {
      paintHeadline(null);
      return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    return FHData.applications(clientId).then(function (res) {
      if (!res || !res.ok) {
        paintHeadline(null);
        paintWaiting(0);
        try { FHData.explain(res, "the bank answers on this file"); } catch (e) { /* strip only */ }
        return null;
      }
      var pack = res.data || {};
      var seen = {};
      ((pack && pack.decisions) || []).forEach(function (dec) {
        if (!dec.lender_id || !dec.play_name || seen[dec.lender_id]) return;
        seen[dec.lender_id] = true;
        var inp = listEl.querySelector('input[data-lender-id="' + dec.lender_id + '"]');
        if (inp && !inp.value) inp.value = dec.play_name;
      });

      /* Newest application per lender wins — listClientApplications orders by
         updated_at DESC, so the first row seen for a lender is the current one.
         summariseApprovals() in the FH-CCP block applies exactly this rule to
         the counting half, so the rows and the headline cannot disagree. */
      var done = {};
      ((pack && pack.applications) || []).forEach(function (app) {
        if (!app || !app.lender_id || done[app.lender_id]) return;
        done[app.lender_id] = true;
        var box = listEl.querySelector('input[data-amount-lender-id="' + app.lender_id + '"]');
        var chip = listEl.querySelector('[data-amount-needed-lender-id="' + app.lender_id + '"]');
        var saved = amountForBox(app);
        // Never overwrite something a person is part-way through typing.
        if (box && !box.value && saved) box.value = saved;
        if (chip) chip.hidden = !isWaitingOnAmount(app);

        /* The "doesn't count" button shows only where it can help: on an
           approval still missing its amount, and on one already excluded so the
           decision can be undone. Never on a denial, and never on an approval
           that is already priced. */
        var skipBtn = listEl.querySelector('[data-approval-skip-lender-id="' + app.lender_id + '"]');
        if (skipBtn) {
          var off = isExcluded(app);
          var show = off || isWaitingOnAmount(app);
          skipBtn.hidden = !show;
          skipBtn.setAttribute("data-application-id", app.id || "");
          skipBtn.setAttribute("data-excluded", off ? "1" : "");
          skipBtn.textContent = off ? "Not counted — undo" : "Doesn't count";
          skipBtn.title = off
            ? ("Marked as not counting"
              + (app.approval_excluded_by ? (" by " + app.approval_excluded_by) : "")
              + (app.approval_exclusion_reason ? (" — " + app.approval_exclusion_reason) : "")
              + ". Press to make it count again.")
            : "The bank said yes but there is no amount. Press if it was withdrawn or never used.";
        }
      });

      /* Counted across the WHOLE file, not just the lenders showing — an
         approval from a bank that has dropped off the match list, or one
         imported with only a bank name and no lender row at all, is exactly the
         one that would otherwise rot unnoticed. So the count can legitimately
         be larger than the number of rows on screen, and paintMore() says so. */
      var summary = CP.summariseApprovals((pack && pack.applications) || []);
      paintWaiting(summary.waiting);
      paintHeadline(summary);
      return summary.waiting;
    });
  }

  function loadMatches(readyCopy) {
    if (!clientId) {
      statusEl.textContent = "Pick a client first.";
      return Promise.resolve("Pick a client first.");
    }
    statusEl.textContent = "Loading matching lenders…";
    return fetch("/api/read/lender-matches?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(clientId), { headers: headers })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        if (!d || !d.ok) {
          statusEl.textContent = "Could not load lender matches.";
          return "Could not load lender matches.";
        }
        var n = d.match_count || 0;
        if (n === 0) {
          var empty = (d.summary && d.summary.lender_count === 0)
            ? "Lender list is empty — import CSV on Lenders."
            : "No lenders fit this client's state / inquiry profile.";
          statusEl.textContent = empty;
          listEl.innerHTML = "";
          paintMore(0, 0);
          /* No lender rows to chip, but approvals on this file can still be
             waiting on a dollar amount — and one nobody can see is the one that
             rots. The count sentence is painted either way. */
          return refreshSaved().then(function () { return empty; });
        }
        statusEl.textContent = readyCopy || (n + " fit. Click Apply to verify exit IP, then open the bank URL.");
        listEl.innerHTML = "";
        var all = d.matches || [];
        paintMore(all.length, Math.min(all.length, ROW_CAP));
        /* ── THE BANK ROW ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
           REBUILT 2026-09-06, owner-set. Chris, walking the live file: "There's
           no bank logo, the Apply button is massive, what's play name."

           Three things were wrong and all three were in this loop:

           1. NO LOGO. 244 logo files ship in public/assets/lenders/ and the
              matcher does return `logo_path` on every match row
              (src/lenders/match.mjs) — this screen simply never drew one. It
              draws one now, and falls back to the shared placeholder file that
              lenders.html already uses, so the names stay on one left edge
              instead of going ragged. A logo that 404s hides itself.
           2. THE APPLY BUTTON WAS THE WIDEST THING ON THE ROW. `.action-btn` is
              `width:100%`, and in a space-between flex that left the bank name
              about 90 pixels — "Bank of / America" wrapped onto two lines while
              the button stretched the rest. The name and logo lead now, and the
              button is `width:auto` (see .lender-row .apply-btn in the CSS).
           3. "No URL" WAS AN ABSENCE WITH NO EXPLANATION. It says what it means
              now: we hold no online application address for that bank, and those
              banks are applied to in a branch or over the phone.

           Layout moved out of inline cssText and into named classes at the top
           of this file. No font-size is written in either place — a px size
           inside .app is discarded before it paints (UI-STANDARDS §12.7). */
        all.slice(0, ROW_CAP).forEach(function (m) {
          var row = document.createElement("div");
          row.className = "lender-row";

          var top = document.createElement("div");
          top.className = "lender-top";

          var idBox = document.createElement("div");
          idBox.className = "lender-id";

          var logo = document.createElement("img");
          logo.className = "lender-logo";
          logo.alt = "";
          logo.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
          logo.src = m.logo_path ? String(m.logo_path) : "/assets/lenders/placeholder.svg";
          /* A logo file that is missing must not leave a broken-image box in the
             row. Hide it and let the name stand on its own. */
          logo.addEventListener("error", function () { logo.style.display = "none"; });
          idBox.appendChild(logo);

          var label = document.createElement("span");
          label.className = "lender-name";
          /* FULL LEGAL NAMES, exactly as the lender table holds them — owner
             rule. "American Express", never "Amex". Nothing here shortens. */
          label.textContent = m.name || "Bank name missing";
          label.title = m.name || "";
          idBox.appendChild(label);

          if (m.bureaus_pulled) {
            var bureau = document.createElement("span");
            bureau.className = "lender-sub";
            bureau.textContent = "pulls " + m.bureaus_pulled;
            idBox.appendChild(bureau);
          }
          top.appendChild(idBox);

          if (m.id && m.application_url && window.FHProxyApply) {
            var btn = document.createElement("button");
            btn.type = "button";
            btn.className = "action-btn apply-btn";
            btn.textContent = "Apply";
            btn.setAttribute("data-fh-apply", "1");
            btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
              window.FHProxyApply.applyToLender({
                clientId: clientId,
                lenderId: m.id,
                lenderName: m.name || "Lender"
              });
            });
            top.appendChild(btn);
          } else {
            var miss = document.createElement("span");
            miss.className = "lender-nourl";
            miss.textContent = "No online application on file — this bank is applied to in a branch or by phone.";
            top.appendChild(miss);
          }
          row.appendChild(top);

          var playRow = document.createElement("div");
          playRow.className = "lender-fields";

          /* "HOW DID YOU APPLY?" IS GONE — owner-set 2026-09-06.
             Chris: "the system already knows the way that it should be applied,
             so that's a useless option."

             He is right twice over. The lender row already carries the apply
             method from the lender record, so asking a human to re-type it was
             asking for something we hold. And nothing ever read the answer back:
             the value landed in application_decisions.play_name, and the only
             caller of listOutcomesForLaterPlays (src/plays/outcomes.mjs) is a
             test file. No screen, no report, no workflow. A required-looking box
             on the busiest row of the busiest screen, feeding nothing.

             The column and its write path stay — play_name is nullable, "Empty
             is allowed" per 261_application_decision_play.sql, and the read
             function is there for whenever a screen wants it. This removes the
             asking, not the ability. */

          /* HOW MUCH the bank approved — OPTIONAL, and filled in whenever the
             team learns it. It is the column the Funded move on the Pipeline
             board reads back to suggest the funded amount
             (src/funding/card-stacking-rounds.mjs sumApprovedApplications).
             Dollars, matching the numeric(14,2) column. Only "Bank yes" sends
             it; a denial has no approved amount.

             THIS IS ALSO WHERE AN AMOUNT IS ADDED LATER. The box is filled back
             in from the saved approval below, so the same box that took the
             first "Bank yes" is the box someone comes back to when the bank
             finally says how much. Type it, press Bank yes again, and the SAME
             application row is updated — logBankDecision finds the existing row
             by client + lender, so there is no second approval. */
          var amtWrap = document.createElement("div");
          amtWrap.className = "lender-field amount";
          var amtLab = document.createElement("label");
          amtLab.textContent = "Approved $";
          var amt = document.createElement("input");
          amt.type = "text";
          amt.inputMode = "decimal";
          amt.placeholder = "leave empty if unknown";
          if (m.id) {
            amt.setAttribute("data-amount-lender-id", m.id);
            amt.id = "fh-approved-" + m.id;
            amtLab.setAttribute("for", amt.id);
          }
          amtWrap.appendChild(amtLab);
          amtWrap.appendChild(amt);
          playRow.appendChild(amtWrap);

          /* The answer buttons and the row's own flags sit together at the end
             of the row, so the two boxes above read as one thing to fill in and
             the two buttons read as one thing to press. */
          var answer = document.createElement("div");
          answer.className = "lender-answer";
          playRow.appendChild(answer);

          /* The row's own marker for "this bank said yes and we still do not
             know for how much". Plain amber, written literally rather than from
             the brand ramp, because a tenant's brand colours overwrite the
             --alert/--warn/--info variables and this warning would go the same
             blue as everything else. */
          var needChip = document.createElement("span");
          needChip.className = "fh-amount-needed";
          needChip.textContent = AMOUNT_WAITING_CHIP;
          needChip.hidden = true;
          if (m.id) needChip.setAttribute("data-amount-needed-lender-id", m.id);
          needChip.style.cssText = "font-size:var(--fs-caption);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;"
            + "background:#FEF3C7;color:#92400E;border:1px solid #FCD34D;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:600";
          answer.appendChild(needChip);

          /* ── THE WAY OUT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
             A round cannot be moved to Funded while any bank yes on it has no
             dollar amount, because we bill a percent of the approvals that
             carry an amount and a blank one is never invoiced
             (guardFundedAmount, src/funding/card-stacking-rounds.mjs).

             Some approvals are never going to have an amount: the bank said
             yes and the client never used the card, or the approval was pulled.
             Without this button one dead row would hold the round open for
             good, and a revenue guard would become a support ticket.

             IT IS NOT A "BANK NO". The bank's yes is left exactly as it is, so
             the approval rate still counts it. This records the separate thing
             — that WE are not billing for it — against the name of whoever
             said so. A reason is required; cancelling changes nothing. */
          var skip = document.createElement("button");
          skip.type = "button";
          skip.hidden = true;
          if (m.id) skip.setAttribute("data-approval-skip-lender-id", m.id);
          skip.style.cssText = "padding:4px 8px;font-size:var(--fs-caption)";
          skip.addEventListener("click", function () {
            var appId = skip.getAttribute("data-application-id");
            if (!appId) return;
            var undo = skip.getAttribute("data-excluded") === "1";
            var payload = {
              action: undo ? "reinstate_approval" : "exclude_approval",
              application_id: appId
            };
            if (!undo) {
              var why = window.prompt(
                "This approval will stop counting toward the round, so it will not "
                + "be billed.\n\nThe bank's yes is not changed.\n\n"
                + "Why does it not count? (for example: client never used it, "
                + "or the bank withdrew it)",
                ""
              );
              if (why === null || !String(why).trim()) {
                statusEl.textContent = "No reason given, so nothing was changed.";
                return;
              }
              payload.reason = String(why).trim();
            }
            var hh = { accept: "application/json", "content-type": "application/json" };
            if (t) hh.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
            fetch("/api/applications", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: hh,
              body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (res) {
              if (res && res.ok) {
                statusEl.textContent = undo
                  ? "That approval counts again. It needs a dollar amount before the round can be funded."
                  : "Marked as not counting. This round can be funded without it.";
                return refreshSaved();
              }
              statusEl.textContent = (res && (res.message || res.error))
                || "Could not change whether that approval counts.";
            }).catch(function () {
              statusEl.textContent = "Could not change whether that approval counts.";
            });
          });
          answer.appendChild(skip);
          /* Where the bank's own figure is offered — immediately beside the box
             it goes into, one click to accept. Filled in by paintRowButtons()
             once the bank inbox has been read; empty and hidden when this
             client has no bank email stating an amount, which is most rows most
             of the time. See the block above bankAmounts. */
          var suggest = document.createElement("span");
          suggest.hidden = true;
          /* Layout lives in .amount-suggest, not here. An inline `display`
             outranks every stylesheet rule, so a slot styled from JS could
             never be hidden by the `hidden` attribute on the line above. */
          suggest.className = "amount-suggest";
          if (m.id) suggest.setAttribute("data-amount-suggest-lender-id", m.id);
          answer.appendChild(suggest);

          /* The three words, spelled once. The buttons, the saved line and the
             already-saved line all read from here, so they cannot drift. Keys
             are the stored values; applications_status_ck allows all three. */
          var WORD_FOR = { Approved: "Approved", Denied: "Declined", Applied: "Pending" };

          function logBank(status) {
            var payload = {
              client_id: clientId,
              lender_id: m.id,
              status: status
            };
            /* play_name is no longer sent. The column stays nullable and the
               write path still accepts it; nothing asks a human for it now. */
            /* AN EMPTY BOX IS ALLOWED ON A YES. "Approved, amount unknown" is a
               real state, so a blank box sends no approved_amount at all and the
               column keeps its NULL. Blank is never 0.

               A box with something WRONG in it still refuses, because that is a
               typo, not an unknown — and saving a typo silently would be worse
               than either. */
            var typed = String(amt.value == null ? "" : amt.value).trim();
            if (status === "Approved" && typed !== "") {
              if (!window.FHMoneyInput || !window.FHMoneyInput.parseAmount) {
                statusEl.textContent = "The amount box could not load. Nothing was saved.";
                return Promise.resolve();
              }
              var parsed = window.FHMoneyInput.parseAmount(typed);
              if (!parsed.ok) {
                statusEl.textContent = parsed.message;
                amt.focus();
                return Promise.resolve();
              }
              payload.approved_amount = parsed.dollars;
            }
            var h = { accept: "application/json", "content-type": "application/json" };
            if (t) h.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
            return fetch("/api/applications", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: h,
              body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (res) {
              if (res && res.ok) {
                var waitingNow = (status === "Approved" && !payload.approved_amount);
                needChip.hidden = !waitingNow;
                statusEl.textContent = WORD_FOR[status]
                  + (payload.approved_amount ? (" · $" + payload.approved_amount) : "")
                  + " saved."
                  + (waitingNow ? " Add the dollar amount here as soon as the bank tells you." : "");
                // Re-count what is still waiting across every lender on the file.
                return refreshSaved();
              }
              statusEl.textContent = (res && (res.message || res.error)) || "Could not save bank yes/no.";
            }).catch(function () {
              statusEl.textContent = "Could not save bank yes/no.";
            });
          }
          /* APPROVED / DECLINED / PENDING — owner-set 2026-09-06.
             Chris: "the words btw are Approved / Declined / Pending right?
             cause when we apply it goes either to approved / declined or
             pending."

             The buttons said "Bank yes" and "Bank no", and there was no third
             one — so an application that had gone in and was waiting on the bank
             had nowhere to be recorded. It sat looking untouched, which is why
             the apply door says out loud that applications still out with a bank
             "are not recorded anywhere".

             The stored values do not change: Approved stays "Approved",
             Declined writes "Denied" and Pending writes "Applied", all three
             already allowed by applications_status_ck. The words on screen are
             now Chris's words, and WORD_FOR is the one place they are spelled,
             so the buttons and the saved-confirmation line cannot drift apart
             the way "Bank yes" and "Approved" already had. */
          [["Approved", "Approved"], ["Declined", "Denied"], ["Pending", "Applied"]]
            .forEach(function (pair) {
              var b = document.createElement("button");
              b.type = "button";
              b.textContent = pair[0];
              b.style.cssText = "padding:4px 8px;font-size:var(--fs-caption)";
              b.addEventListener("click", function () { logBank(pair[1]); });
              answer.appendChild(b);
            });
          row.appendChild(playRow);
          listEl.appendChild(row);
        });
        /* The rows exist now, so the bank email's figures have somewhere to
           land. Deliberately NOT awaited: a slow or failed inbox read must not
           hold up the lender list or the saved-amount repaint below. */
        loadBankAmounts();
        /* The fh-play-names datalist that fed "How did you apply?" is gone with
           the field it filled. Nothing else referenced it. */
        return refreshSaved().then(function () {
          return readyCopy || (n + " lenders ready.");
        });
      })
      .catch(function () {
        statusEl.textContent = "Could not load lender matches.";
        return "Could not load lender matches.";
      });
  }
  window.fhRefreshFundingApply = loadMatches;
  loadMatches();
  /* Asked for on its own, and not awaited behind the lender list. The headline
     is about every bank answer on the file; the lender list is about which
     banks currently fit it. A file can have approvals waiting and match no
     lenders at all, and that is exactly the file that rots. */
  refreshSaved();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!-- ══ THE DEMO PORTAL GETS PAST THE SIGN-IN BOUNCE ═══════════════════════════
     shell.js asks /api/auth/session and, with no session, sends the visitor to
     /portal-login.html before this page paints anything. So ?demo=1 measured as
     a sign-in form, not a portal (live, 2026-09-25).

     IT USES THE DEMO SESSION THE SHELL ALREADY HAS. shell.js getSession() falls
     back to `fh_demo_staff` in localStorage when the real session read fails —
     that is the app's own demo mode, and public/login.html's demo buttons write
     the same key. So this writes it too, for the owner role, which is the one
     role deliberately allowed to open a client's portal (shell.js, ADMIN_BLOCKED).
     Nothing here signs anybody in: the key is a local hint, the server is never
     told, and every read on this screen is skipped in demo mode anyway.

     UNDEFERRED AND ABOVE shell.js ON PURPOSE. shell.js carries `defer`, so this
     has to have run before its session promise is built.

     `fh_role` IS DELIBERATELY NOT WRITTEN. It is the cached staff hint the rest
     of this page branches on, and a demo visit must not make the next real
     screen think a staff member is signed in. -->
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  try {
    var q = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (q.get("demo") !== "1") return;
    if (localStorage.getItem("fh_demo_staff")) return;
    localStorage.setItem("fh_demo_staff", JSON.stringify({
      id: "demo-owner", role: "owner", name: "DEMO Owner", email: "owner@demo.fundhub.local"
    }));
  } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>

<script>
/* Client-only presentation: keep the original progress link and every stage.
   Staff keeps the original open list, copy, link position and identity. */
(function () {
  var started = false;
  function enhance() {
    if (!document.body.hasAttribute("data-client-ios")) return;
    var details = document.querySelector(".cp-progress-disclosure");
    if (!started && details) { details.open = false; started = true; }
    var hero = document.getElementById(document.body.classList.contains("no-funding") ? "portal-status-pre" : "portal-status-funded");
    var link = document.getElementById("prog-link");
    if (hero && link && link.parentNode !== hero) hero.appendChild(link);
    var caption = document.querySelector(".cp-current-stage");
    var text = caption ? caption.getAttribute("data-stage-label") || "Status updating" : "";
    if (caption && caption.textContent !== text) caption.textContent = text;
    var a = link && link.querySelector("a");
    if (a && a.textContent !== "View progress →") a.textContent = "View progress →";
  }
  new MutationObserver(enhance).observe(document.body, { attributes: true, childList: true, subtree: true, attributeFilter: ["class", "data-client-ios"] });
  enhance();
})();
</script>

           is in no role's tab list. screenOf() used to call it a screen anyway,
           which meant gateLinks() hid whatever card it was in AND the
           capture-phase click interceptor cancelled the click — measured in
           Chromium on 2026-09-05: pressing it did nothing, the address bar
           never changed. screenOf() now returns "" for an absolute href that is
           not under /app/, so both gates leave this link alone.
           e2e/progress-page.spec.mjs clicks it and asserts the address bar
           moved; a visibility check cannot see that failure. -->
      <div class="prog-link" id="prog-link">
        <a href="/progress.html">See exactly where your file stands →</a>

/* ── modal plumbing ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
(function(){
  var scrim = document.getElementById('scrim'),
      unlockM = document.getElementById('unlock-modal'),
      bookM = document.getElementById('book-modal'),
      lastFocus = null;

  function openM(m){
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    scrim.classList.add('on'); m.classList.add('on');
    var f = m.querySelector('button'); if(f) f.focus();
  }
  function closeAll(){
    scrim.classList.remove('on');
    unlockM.classList.remove('on'); bookM.classList.remove('on');
    if(lastFocus && lastFocus.focus) lastFocus.focus();
  }
  scrim.addEventListener('click', closeAll);
  document.getElementById('um-x').addEventListener('click', closeAll);
  document.getElementById('bm-x').addEventListener('click', closeAll);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key === 'Escape') closeAll(); });

  /* ── unlock modal ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function openUnlock(key){
    var p = PRODUCTS[key]; if(!p) return;
    document.getElementById('um-title').textContent = p.name;
    document.getElementById('um-desc').textContent  = p.desc;
    document.getElementById('um-price').textContent = p.price;
    /* Only offer the pay button when there is something to pay through. Every
       product in PRODUCTS is currently closer-priced with no checkout link, so
       in practice this stays hidden and "Ask an advisor about this" is the
       action. If a checkout link is added later it becomes the pay button
       again, with no other change. */
    var go   = document.getElementById('um-go');
    var talk = document.getElementById('um-talk');
    var canCheckout = !!p.checkoutUrl;
    go.hidden = !canCheckout;
    go.disabled = false;
    go.dataset.statusClose = '';
    go.textContent = 'Unlock — ' + p.price;
    go.dataset.product = canCheckout ? key : '';
    talk.dataset.book = p.name;
    talk.textContent = canCheckout ? 'Talk to an advisor first' : 'Ask an advisor about this';
    var msg = document.getElementById('um-pay-msg');
    if (msg) {
      msg.textContent = 'Online checkout is not available yet. Ask an advisor in chat and we will send you a payment link.';
      msg.hidden = canCheckout;
    }
    openM(unlockM);
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var statusBtn = e.target.closest('[data-status]');
    if (statusBtn) {
      var sk = statusBtn.dataset.status;
      var sp = PRODUCTS[sk];
      if (!sp) return;
      document.getElementById('um-title').textContent = sp.name;
      document.getElementById('um-desc').textContent =
        'This is included on your account. Progress updates will show here when they are available.';
      document.getElementById('um-price').textContent = 'Included';
      document.getElementById('um-go').hidden = false;
      document.getElementById('um-go').textContent = 'Close';
      document.getElementById('um-go').disabled = false;
      document.getElementById('um-go').dataset.product = '';
      document.getElementById('um-go').dataset.statusClose = '1';
      document.getElementById('um-talk').dataset.book = sp.name;
      document.getElementById('um-talk').textContent = 'Ask an advisor about this';
      var sm = document.getElementById('um-pay-msg');
      if (sm) sm.hidden = true;
      openM(unlockM);
      return;
    }
    var t = e.target.closest('[data-unlock]');
    if(t) openUnlock(t.dataset.unlock);
  });
  document.getElementById('um-go').addEventListener('click', function(){
    if (this.dataset.statusClose === '1') {
      this.dataset.statusClose = '';
      closeAll();
      return;
    }
    var key = this.dataset.product;
    var p = key && PRODUCTS[key];
    var checkout = p && p.checkoutUrl;
    var msg = document.getElementById('um-pay-msg');
    if (!checkout) {
      this.disabled = true;
      this.textContent = 'Checkout not available';
      if (msg) {
        msg.hidden = false;
        msg.textContent = 'Online checkout is not available yet. Talk to an advisor and we will send you a payment link.';
      }
      var talk = document.getElementById('um-talk');
      if (talk) talk.focus();
      return;
    }
    this.textContent = 'Opening secure checkout…';
    this.disabled = true;
    window.location.href = checkout;
  });
  document.getElementById('um-talk').addEventListener('click', function(){
    closeAll();
    setTimeout(function(){ openBook(document.getElementById('um-talk').dataset.book); }, 180);
  });

  /* ── asking for a call ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     AUDIT 2026-08-17 §5/§10. "Book a call", the six "Talk to an advisor" links
     and "Talk to an advisor first" all opened a modal whose only message was
     that it could not help — no times, and a permanently disabled "Pick a
     time". Nothing on this page can book a call; there is no booking system
     behind it and none was added here. Chat does reach staff, so that is where
     these buttons go, with the topic filled in for the client. The modal is
     kept for the one case where it has something true to say: a call already
     on file. ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var bmDone  = document.getElementById('bm-done');

  function openChatAbout(about){
    var fab   = document.getElementById('fh-chat-fab');
    var panel = document.getElementById('fh-chat-panel');
    if (!fab || !panel) return false;
    if (!panel.classList.contains('open')) fab.click();
    var input = document.getElementById('fh-chat-input');
    if (input) {
      if (!input.value) input.value = 'I would like a call about: ' + about;
      input.focus();
    }
    return true;
  }

  function showBookingOnFile(about, live){
    document.getElementById('bm-title').textContent = 'Your call';
    document.getElementById('bm-desc').textContent = live
      ? ((live.title || 'Booked call') + ' — ' + live.when +
         (live.status ? ' (' + live.status + ')' : '') + '. About: ' + about + '.')
      : ('Nothing is booked yet. Use the chat button to ask for a call. About: ' + about + '.');
    if (bmDone) {
      bmDone.hidden = false;
      var doneD = document.getElementById('bm-done-d');
      if (doneD) {
        doneD.textContent = live
          ? ('On file: ' + (live.title || 'Booked call') + ' — ' + live.when + '.')
          : 'No booking is on file.';
      }
      var head = bmDone.querySelector('.bk-t');
      if (head) head.textContent = live ? 'Booking on file' : 'No booking yet';
    }
    openM(bookM);
  }

  function openBook(topic){
    var about = topic || 'More funding';
    var live = window.__portalBooking || null;
    if (live && live.when) { showBookingOnFile(about, live); return; }
    /* No call on file — go straight to the one contact action that works.
       The modal is only the fallback for a browser where chat never mounted. */
    if (openChatAbout(about)) return;
    showBookingOnFile(about, null);
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var t = e.target.closest('[data-book]');
    if(t && t.id !== 'um-talk') openBook(t.dataset.book);
  });

  window.__openBook = openBook;
})();

/* ── welcome video ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   THIS USED TO ASK NOBODY ANYTHING. The block here removed a play button that
   had already been deleted from the markup and re-wrote the empty-state line at
   :378 with the identical string — three statements, all no-ops — so the hero
   said "Welcome video is not available" whether or not one existed. It could
   not have said anything else: until GET /api/content/welcome-video there was
   no way for a client's browser to reach an uploaded video at all.

   THE EMPTY STATE IS STILL THE DEFAULT AND STILL HONEST. The markup ships the
   "not available" line, and it is only ever replaced by a video that really
   resolved. A failed read, a 401, an org with nothing mapped and a database one
   migration behind all leave the page exactly as it loaded. Do not pretend a
   video played.

   NO TIMER. The clock is the browser's own timeupdate event on a real <video>.
   src/http/crm-html.test.mjs bans repeating timers in this file outright — and
   it scans the comments too, so do not name one here — because a clock ticking
   with no video behind it is the exact fake this card used to be. */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
  var player = document.getElementById('player');
  var empty  = document.getElementById('video-empty');
  if (!player || !empty) return;

  var t = '';
  try { t = localStorage.getItem('fh_token') || ''; } catch (e) {}

  /* A client is their session — the endpoint refuses to read client_id from the
     query string for a client principal. The param is forwarded only so a staff
     member walking a client's portal with ?id= sees that client's video. */
  var q = '';
  try {
    var p = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    var forId = p.get('id') || p.get('client_id');
    if (forId) q = '?client_id=' + encodeURIComponent(forId);
  } catch (e) {}

  fetch('/api/content/welcome-video' + q, {
    headers: t ? { authorization: 'Bearer ' + t } : {},
    credentials: 'same-origin'
  }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); }).then(function(d){
    /* stream is an OBJECT — { url, expiresAt, expiresAtIso } — not a string.
       Assigning it straight to src stringifies to "[object Object]", which the
       browser resolves against this page and 404s, and the card silently falls
       back to "not available": the same picture as no video at all. Read .url. */
    var v = d && d.ok && d.video;
    var src = v && v.stream && v.stream.url;
    if (!src) return;                       // nothing mapped — leave the empty state

    var el = document.createElement('video');
    el.src = src;
    el.controls = true;
    el.preload = 'metadata';
    el.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
    el.className = 'video-el';
    el.setAttribute('aria-label', v.title || 'Welcome video');

    /* The frame opens to full height as soon as a link exists. iOS Safari does
       not fetch metadata until the viewer taps play, so waiting for
       loadedmetadata left the player at the 56px empty height: a thin black bar
       with nothing to tap. */
    var ghost = player.querySelector('.ghost');
    empty.hidden = true;
    if (ghost) ghost.hidden = true;

    var loaded = false;
    var retried = false;
    el.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function(){
      loaded = true;
      retried = false;
      var title = document.getElementById('video-title');
      if (title && v.title) title.textContent = v.title;
      var now = document.getElementById('vnow');
      if (now && v.duration_label) now.textContent = v.duration_label;
    });
    el.addEventListener('error', function(){
      /* The signed link lives 15 minutes. After it lapses a seek or a resumed
         range request fails even though the file is fine, so mint one fresh
         link and pick up where the viewer was before giving up. */
      if (!retried) {
        retried = true;
        var at = el.currentTime || 0;
        fetch('/api/content/welcome-video' + q, {
          headers: t ? { authorization: 'Bearer ' + t } : {},
          credentials: 'same-origin'
        }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); }).then(function(d2){
          var s2 = d2 && d2.ok && d2.video && d2.video.stream && d2.video.stream.url;
          if (!s2) return giveUp();
          el.src = s2;
          if (at) el.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function(){ el.currentTime = at; }, { once: true });
          el.load();
        }, giveUp);
        return;
      }
      giveUp();
    });
    function giveUp(){
      /* A video that already played stays on screen with its own controls.
         Only a file that never loaded says it is not available. */
      if (loaded) return;
      if (el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
      if (ghost) ghost.hidden = false;
      empty.hidden = false;
      empty.textContent = 'Welcome video is not available';
    }

    var now2 = document.getElementById('vnow');
    if (now2) {
      el.addEventListener('timeupdate', function(){
        var s = Math.floor(el.currentTime || 0);
        var m = Math.floor(s / 60);
        now2.textContent = m + ':' + String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0');
      });
    }

    player.appendChild(el);
  }, function(){ /* offline or refused — the empty state already says so */ });
});

/* ── document upload doors — stamp kind per door ── */
(function(){
  var root = document.getElementById("upload-doors"); if (!root) return;
  function clientId(){
    try { var q=new URLSearchParams(location.search); var id=q.get("id")||q.get("client_id"); if(id) return id; } catch(e){}
    try { var a=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("fh_account")||"null"); return a&&(a.clientId||a.client_id)||null; } catch(e){ return null; }
  }
  [].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".upload-door")).forEach(function(door){
    var btn=door.querySelector("[data-upload-btn]"), input=door.querySelector("[data-file-input]"), kind=door.getAttribute("data-kind")||"client_upload", typeSel=door.querySelector("[data-subtype]"), picked=[];
    if(!btn||!input) return;
    var msg=door.querySelector("[data-door-msg]"), idleLabel=btn.textContent;
    function say(text){ if(!msg) return; msg.textContent=text||""; msg.hidden=!text; }
    btn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      if(!picked.length){ input.click(); return; }
      var id=clientId();
      if(!window.FHData||!id){ btn.textContent="Uploads are off"; return; }
      say("");
      btn.textContent="Sending…";
      /* subtype is what checkDocPacket() matches on. Left unset the server
         defaults it to "other", which is exactly the old behaviour — so an
         unanswered picker is no worse than before, and an answered one is what
         finally lets a portal upload complete the identity packet. */
      var fields = { client_id: id, kind: kind };
      var sub = typeSel && typeSel.value ? typeSel.value : "";
      if (sub) fields.subtype = sub;
      FHData.uploadFiles("/api/documents-upload", picked, fields).then(function(res){
        if(res.ok){ btn.textContent="Sent"; picked=[]; return; }
        /* CP-06: say WHY. The server already writes a plain sentence for a
           refused file (wrong type, too big, empty) and FHData hands it back as
           res.error when source is "badrequest" (or "server" / "nodb").
           Every other source carries a developer string ("Failed to fetch",
           "/api/* not deployed"), so those get one fixed line instead. */
        var theirs = res.source==="badrequest" || res.source==="server" || res.source==="nodb";
        if(res.source==="badrequest"){
          /* The file itself was refused, so sending the same file again can
             only fail the same way. Clear it and give the button back its
             first job: open the picker. */
          picked=[];
          btn.textContent=idleLabel;
          say((res.error || "That file did not send.") + " Pick a different file.");
          return;
        }
        btn.textContent="Try again";
        say(theirs && res.error ? res.error : "The file did not send. Check your connection and try again.");
      });
    });
    input.addEventListener("change", function(){ picked=[].slice.call(input.files||[]); input.value=""; say(""); btn.textContent="Send "+picked.length+" file"+(picked.length===1?"":"s"); });
  });
})();

/* ── account & history tabs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
   The drawer holds four lists. Only one is ever on screen — a drawer that
   opens onto four stacked lists is the same wall of data, just delayed. */
(function(){
  var tabs = document.getElementById('acct-tabs');
  if(!tabs) return;
  tabs.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var b = e.target.closest('.tab'); if(!b) return;
    tabs.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(t){
      var on = t === b;
      t.classList.toggle('on', on);
      t.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#acct .tabpane').forEach(function(p){
      p.classList.toggle('on', p.dataset.pane === b.dataset.tab);
    });
  });
})();

/* Client Portal — the tiles lock and unlock from real entitlements (032).
