     to download yet". The course has no document to hand over; it plays in its
     own Unlock More card (owner decision 2026-08-21). So its row names it and
     opens that card. Same code as MAP.FUNDING_MASTERY — keep the two in step. */
  var COURSE_CODE = "funding-mastery-course";
  var COURSE_TILE = "FUNDING_MASTERY";

  /* ── WHAT EACH READ LEARNED ────────────────────────────────────────────────
     Entitlements and portal-summary are two independent requests and either can
     land first. Three things on this screen need an answer from BOTH of them —
     which downloads exist (entitlement + document), whether the soft-pull tile
     is still an offer (entitlement + pull actually run), and which identity
     documents are still missing (open case + documents on file). So each read
     records what it learned and asks for a repaint, instead of painting once
     and being overwritten by whichever answer arrived second. */
  var entActive = null;      // entitlements: active code -> row
  var softPullDone = false;  // portal-summary: the pull has really run
  var docsOnFile = [];       // portal-summary: the client's real documents
  /* THE SLO ROADMAP ORDER IS THE CAPITAL BLUEPRINT PACK. It sells on product
     'diagnostic', which grants only credit-analysis-report, so the Blueprint
     tile stayed locked for a buyer holding every Blueprint file (live,
     2026-09-25). portal-summary's `slo_paid` is the paid order itself. It opens
     the Blueprint tile and its five pack rows in What You Own — nothing else:
     no door, no other tile, no funding view. */
  var sloPaid = false;       // portal-summary: a paid, non-demo SLO roadmap order
  /* True only for the demo portal below (?demo=1 / fh_demo). It never reads a
     real file, so no real client's screen can take a demo branch. */
  var demoMode = false;
  var SLO_PACK = [
    { code: "credit-analysis-report", name: "Credit Analysis Report" },
    { code: "credit-optimization-roadmap", name: "Credit Optimization Roadmap" },
    { code: "funding-snapshot", name: "Funding Snapshot" },
    { code: "bank-lender-match-list", name: "Bank and Lender Match List" },
    { code: "metro2-letter-pack", name: "Dispute Letter Pack" }
  ];
  function withSloPack(active) {
    var out = {};
    var k;
    for (k in (active || {})) out[k] = active[k];
    for (k = 0; k < SLO_PACK.length; k++) {
      if (!out[SLO_PACK[k].code]) out[SLO_PACK[k].code] = { entitlement_name: SLO_PACK[k].name };
    }
    return out;
  }
  // Whether an inquiry-removal case is open is already tracked, one screenful
  // down, as `inquiryCaseOpen` — the doors read it and so does the note below.

  var STAFF_ROLES = {
    owner: 1, admin: 1, sales_manager: 1, closer: 1,
    funding_advisor: 1, inquiry_specialist: 1, setter: 1
  };

  /* The role the server gave, once this page has asked. Set only when no role
     was saved — see "NO SAVED ROLE" below. Once set it wins over the saved hint
     so every branch on this screen takes the same side for the whole load. */
  var sessionRole = "";
  function roleHint() {
    if (sessionRole) return sessionRole;
    try { return String(localStorage.getItem("fh_role") || "").toLowerCase(); }
    catch (e) { return ""; }
  }

  function setFundingVisible(hasFunding) {
    document.body.classList.toggle("no-funding", !hasFunding);
  }
  /* TWO READS OPEN THESE DOORS AND EITHER CAN LAND FIRST.
     Entitlements say which paid lanes this client holds. portal-summary says
     whether an inquiry case is open on their file. Both drive the same three
     doors, so each records what it learned and asks for one repaint instead of
     overwriting the other's answer. */
  var doorLanes = { funding: false, inquiry: false, bureau_response: false };
  var inquiryCaseOpen = false;

  function applyDoors() {
    var f = doorLanes.funding;
    var i = doorLanes.inquiry || inquiryCaseOpen;
    var b = doorLanes.bureau_response;
    document.body.classList.toggle("no-funding-door", !f);
    document.body.classList.toggle("no-inquiry-door", !i);
    document.body.classList.toggle("no-bureau-door", !b);
    document.body.classList.toggle("no-upload-doors", !(f||i||b));
    /* The whole "Send a file" card hides with the last door — an empty card
       titled "Use the door that matches what you have" is worse than none. */
    document.body.classList.toggle("no-docs", !(f||i||b));
    /* Which doors are open decides which one the missing-document note may
       point at, so the note is redrawn every time they change. */
    paintDocNote();
  }
  function setUploadDoors(active) {
    doorLanes = {
      funding: !!(active && active.funding),
      inquiry: !!(active && active.inquiry),
      bureau_response: !!(active && active.bureau_response)
    };
    applyDoors();
  }
  /* AN OPEN INQUIRY CASE IS ITS OWN KEY TO THE INQUIRY DOOR.
     The inquiry-removal product grants no entitlement on purpose
     (db/migrations/180_product_entitlements_seed.sql), so gating this door on
     entitlements alone left every inquiry client reading "0 unlocked" with
     nowhere to send the ID, proof of address and authorization DOC-01 had just
     asked them for. */
  function setInquiryCaseOpen(open) {
    inquiryCaseOpen = !!open;
    applyDoors();
  }
  /* Mirrors activeUploadDoors() in src/repair/upload-doors.mjs — keep the two
     in step. The `funding` door is the IDENTITY door: it is the only one that
     carries photo ID and proof of address, and a repair client cannot start
     their program without sending both. Gating it on funding-snapshot alone
     left every repair-trial client (metro2-letter-pack) with nowhere to put
     their ID. No price belongs in this file, not even inside a comment —
     src/http/crm-html.test.mjs greps the whole page for one. */
  function doorsFromEntitlementCodes(codes) {
    var set={}; (codes||[]).forEach(function(c){set[String(c||"").toLowerCase()]=1;});
    var funding=!!set["funding-snapshot"], repair=!!set["metro2-letter-pack"];
    var inquiry=funding || !!set["credit-analysis-report"];
    return { funding: funding || repair, inquiry: inquiry, bureau_response: repair };
  }

  function setOwnVisible(hasOwn) {
    document.body.classList.toggle("no-own", !hasOwn);
  }

  /* THE NEWEST REAL DOCUMENT BEHIND A DELIVERABLE, or null.
     portal-summary's `documents` are already ordered newest first and already
     carry `download` — a signed, client-authorized link, or null when the
     document has expired. Matching is on `subtype`, which is the documents
     table's own name for the thing (src/documents/kinds.mjs), not on the title
     a human typed. */
  function ownedDocument(subtype) {
    for (var i = 0; i < docsOnFile.length; i++) {
      var d = docsOnFile[i];
      if (d && d.subtype === subtype) return d;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /* THE CAPITAL BLUEPRINT'S LETTER PACK, ON THE FUNDING PATH.
     Live look 2026-09-17, hole 2: client 029964c5 bought the Blueprint and her
     "Metro 2 Dispute Letter Pack" row said "Not ready yet" — forever. It waits
     for a metro2_dispute_letter_pack document, and none is ever saved for a
     funding-path buyer, on purpose: HARD RULE 1 in ds-02-diy-letters.mjs and
     test F41 in src/sales/closer-deck.test.mjs.

     What the Blueprint sells is a "Dispute Letter Pack" — the words are copied
     from UWIQ_DELIVERABLES_CONTENTS in src/config/offers.mjs. On the funding
     path that pack is the funding letters the deliverables package saves:
     inquiry removal and personal info (closer-deck.mjs education branch →
     persistFundingLetterFiles). So when ALL of these are true —
       · the client holds the Blueprint's own grant, credit-optimization-roadmap
         (only the Blueprint grants it — migrations 383 and 384),
       · no real Metro 2 pack document is on file,
       · funding letters are on file —
     the row takes the Blueprint's name, says it is ready, and the letters it
     counts are listed right under it, each with its own Download.
     Anything else keeps the Metro 2 row exactly as it was. A real Metro 2 file
     always wins, and a repair client never holds the roadmap. */
  var BLUEPRINT_LETTER_PACK = "Dispute Letter Pack";
  var FUNDING_LETTER_SUBTYPES = { funding_inquiry_removal: 1, funding_personal_info: 1 };

  function fundingLettersOnFile() {
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < docsOnFile.length; i++) {
      var d = docsOnFile[i];
      if (d && d.kind === "deliverable" && FUNDING_LETTER_SUBTYPES[d.subtype]) out.push(d);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /* THE ROWS THIS LIST IS MADE OF — the union of two true sources.
     MEASURED ON PRODUCTION, 2026-09-17. Client 029964c5 paid in full for the
     Capital Blueprint and ELEVEN deliverables were saved against her file two
     minutes later: the Credit Analysis Report, the Funding Snapshot, the Bank
     and Lender Match List, the Credit Optimization Roadmap, the Capital
     Readiness Summary and six dispute letters. This list showed ONE row —
     "Metro 2 Dispute Letter Pack … not built yet" — because it was built only
     from the five entitlement codes in OWN_CODES and she holds exactly one of
     them. Every real file she had was reachable only inside the collapsed
     "Account & history" drawer, several clicks away, under a tab.

     Owner rule, 2026-09-17: what a client paid for is unlocked, and the
     materials already created for them are immediately reachable. So:

       1. THE PACKAGE SHE IS ENTITLED TO. Unchanged — this is what keeps the
          honest "owned but not built yet" row, the thing a package promises
          before it exists. The display name prefers `entitlement_name`, which
          /api/read/entitlements already returns from entitlement_catalog, so
          the words follow the catalog rather than this file.

       2. EVERY DELIVERABLE ACTUALLY ON HER FILE that step 1 did not already
          claim, named by its own stored title and linked with the signed URL
          portal-summary already minted for it.

     NO PRODUCT CODE AND NO ENTITLEMENT CODE IS HARDCODED IN STEP 2. A grant
     corrected anywhere else flows straight through, and a client whose grant is
     still wrong can still reach the work we already did for her.

     `kind === "deliverable"` is the whole filter. Her own uploads and her signed
     agreements are hers too and both already have their own tab; repeating them
     here would bury the package under photographs of a driving licence.

     ORDER. Entitlement rows first, in OWN_CODES order, then the documents in
     the order portal-summary gave them — newest first, the same order the
     Documents tab uses. Nothing is re-ranked, so the two lists cannot disagree
     about which file is the newest. */
  function ownRows(active) {
    var rows = [];
    var claimed = {};
    var i;
    for (i = 0; i < OWN_CODES.length; i++) {
      var entry = OWN_CODES[i];
      var granted = active && active[entry.code];
      if (!granted) continue;
      var doc = ownedDocument(entry.subtype);
      var letters = (entry.code === "metro2-letter-pack" && !doc &&
        active["credit-optimization-roadmap"]) ? fundingLettersOnFile() : [];
      if (letters.length) {
        rows.push({ name: BLUEPRINT_LETTER_PACK, letters: letters.length });
        for (var j = 0; j < letters.length; j++) {
          rows.push({ name: letters[j].title || letters[j].subtype || "Document", doc: letters[j] });
          if (letters[j].id) claimed[letters[j].id] = 1;
        }
        continue;
      }
      rows.push({ name: granted.entitlement_name || entry.name, doc: doc });
      if (doc && doc.id) claimed[doc.id] = 1;
    }
    var course = active && active[COURSE_CODE];
    if (course) rows.push({ name: course.entitlement_name || "Capital Academy", course: COURSE_TILE });
    for (i = 0; i < docsOnFile.length; i++) {
      var d = docsOnFile[i];
      if (!d || d.kind !== "deliverable") continue;
      if (d.id && claimed[d.id]) continue;
      /* A document with no usable title still gets a row rather than being
         dropped — the file is hers. `subtype` is the documents table's own
         name for the thing and is the honest fallback; nothing is invented. */
      rows.push({ name: d.title || d.subtype || "Document", doc: d });
    }
    return rows;
  }

  /* WHAT YOU OWN — and whether you can actually have it.
     Walk finding 19, 2026-09-06: this list promised "always downloadable" and
     then offered a Funding Snapshot with no link and no button, under a line
     telling the client to ask an advisor — on a page whose advisor card says
     nobody is assigned. Three dead ends in one row.

     So each row says which of the THREE true states it is in:
       · the document exists and we can hand it over  → a Download link
       · the document exists and carries no link      → said plainly
       · it is owned but not built yet                → said plainly, no chase
     Neither of the last two asks the client to go and find a person, and
     nothing invents a link.

     THE MIDDLE STATE USED TO BE FOLDED INTO "not built yet", which was the
     wrong sentence for a file that exists. portal-summary returns a null
     `download` for exactly two reasons (api/read/portal-summary.mjs:82-91 and
     :604-608): the document's own `expires_at` has passed, or
     DOCUMENT_URL_SECRET is not configured and nothing could be signed. The copy
     therefore states what is certainly true — the file is on her file and this
     copy cannot be downloaded — and promises nothing about how to get it, since
     only one of those two causes is fixed by trying again.

     ENTITLEMENTS MAY BE NULL HERE. This read and portal-summary race, and this
     function used to return early when entitlements had not landed — so an
     empty or failed entitlements read hid documents that were sitting right
     there in the payload. Documents alone are now enough to paint. */
  function paintOwn(active) {
    var list = document.getElementById("own-list");
    if (!list) return;
    var rows = ownRows(sloPaid ? withSloPack(active) : active);
    if (!rows.length) {
      setOwnVisible(false);
      return;
    }
    setOwnVisible(true);
    list.innerHTML = rows.map(function (r) {
      /* A pack of several letters has no single file to hand over. Its letters
         are the rows directly below it (ownRows), each in its own state. */
      if (r.letters) {
        return '<div class="own own-real"><div><div class="on-t">' + esc(r.name) +
          '</div><div class="on-d">Ready. Your ' + r.letters +
          (r.letters === 1 ? ' letter is' : ' letters are') + ' listed just below.</div></div>' +
          '<div class="own-actions"><span class="dr-s have">Ready</span></div></div>';
      }
      if (r.course) {
        return '<div class="own own-real"><div><div class="on-t">' + esc(r.name) +
          '</div><div class="on-d">Yours. It is a course, not a file — it opens in ' +
          'the Capital Academy card below.</div></div>' +
          '<div class="own-actions"><button class="btn-unlock" type="button" data-own-course="' +
          esc(r.course) + '">Open course</button></div></div>';
      }
      var doc = r.doc;
      var url = doc && doc.download && doc.download.url;
      if (url) {
        return '<div class="own own-real"><div><div class="on-t">' + esc(r.name) +
          '</div><div class="on-d">Ready. It is yours to keep.</div></div>' +
          '<div class="own-actions"><a class="dr-s have" href="' + esc(url) +
          '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Download</a></div></div>';
      }
      if (doc) {
        return '<div class="own own-real"><div><div class="on-t">' + esc(r.name) +
          '</div><div class="on-d">On your file. This copy cannot be downloaded ' +
          'right now.</div></div>' +
          '<div class="own-actions"><span class="dr-s want">Not available</span></div></div>';
      }
      return '<div class="own own-real"><div><div class="on-t">' + esc(r.name) +
        '</div><div class="on-d">Part of your package. It is not built yet — ' +
        'it appears here, ready to download, as soon as it is.</div></div>' +
        '<div class="own-actions"><span class="dr-s want">Not ready yet</span></div></div>';
    }).join("");
  }

  /* ══ NAME THE DOCUMENT THAT IS MISSING ═══════════════════════════════════
     Walk finding 20, 2026-09-06: two document requests had gone out to this
     client and the portal never said WHICH document. She got three generic
     boxes and a dropdown of every document type we have ever asked anybody
     for. The slot for naming it — #doc-agent-note — was built and only ever
     filled in one narrow case: a file she had already sent that the checking
     agent turned down.

     THE ANSWER WAS ALREADY IN THIS PAGE'S OWN PAYLOAD. An open inquiry-removal
     case needs an identity packet, and portal-summary returns both the open
     case (`inquiry_open`) and every document on her file with its `kind` and
     `subtype`. So which items are outstanding is a subtraction this page can
     already do, with no new endpoint and no new field.

     THE RULE IS MIRRORED FROM checkDocPacket() in src/inquiry-ops/doc-gate.mjs
     — keep the two in step. Same three kinds count (a client upload, an
     authorization, or a file sent through the inquiry door), and proof of
     address is satisfied by a bank statement, exactly as it is there.

     TWO DELIBERATE NARROWINGS, so this never asks for something wrong:
       · The SSN card is not mentioned. doc-gate only requires it when the
         dispute touches SSN data, and this page cannot see that.
       · The signed authorization is not mentioned. It is not something she can
         put through an upload door, and pointing her at one would send her
         somewhere that cannot finish the job.
     Both stay silent rather than guess. If the only outstanding item is one of
     those two, this note does not appear — the same as before this change.

     A REAL MESSAGE ALWAYS WINS. doc_agent_message is a specific human-readable
     reason a specific file was turned down ("Need a clearer ID photo"). That
     beats a computed list every time, so it is checked first. */
  var PACKET_KINDS = { client_upload: 1, authorization: 1, inquiry_doc: 1 };

  function missingPacketItems() {
    var seen = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < docsOnFile.length; i++) {
      var d = docsOnFile[i] || {};
      if (PACKET_KINDS[d.kind] && d.subtype) seen[d.subtype] = 1;
    }
    var out = [];
    if (!seen.id_document) out.push("a photo ID");
    if (!seen.proof_of_address && !seen.bank_statement) {
      out.push("proof of your address — a bank statement counts");
    }
    return out;
  }

  /* The message, once it is known, kept so the note can be repainted.
     Which door to point at depends on the entitlements read and the words
     depend on the summary read, and those two race — so this is stored and the
     note is drawn again whenever either answer changes. Sending somebody to a
     door that is not on their screen is worse than not naming one. */
  var docAgentMessage = null;

  function paintDocNote(agentMessage) {
    if (agentMessage !== undefined) docAgentMessage = agentMessage || null;
    var note = document.getElementById("doc-agent-note");
    if (!note) return;
    if (docAgentMessage) {
      note.hidden = false;
      note.textContent = docAgentMessage;
      return;
    }
    var missing = inquiryCaseOpen ? missingPacketItems() : [];
    if (!missing.length) {
      note.hidden = true;
      note.textContent = "";
      return;
    }
    var list = missing.length === 1
      ? missing[0]
      : missing.slice(0, -1).join(", ") + " and " + missing[missing.length - 1];
    var door = doorLanes.funding
      ? "the ID and personal documents door below"
      : "the inquiry documents door below";
    note.hidden = false;
    note.textContent = "We still need " + list + ". Send them through " + door + ".";
  }

  function setCourseOpen(tile, open) {
    var panel = tile.querySelector(".tile-course");
    var btn = tile.querySelector("[data-course-toggle]");
    if (open) {
      tile.classList.add("is-open");
      if (panel) panel.hidden = false;
      if (btn) btn.textContent = "Close";
    } else {
      tile.classList.remove("is-open");
      if (panel) {
        panel.hidden = true;
        var mods = panel.querySelectorAll("details.tc-mod");
        for (var i = 0; i < mods.length; i++) mods[i].open = false;
      }
      if (btn) btn.textContent = "Open";
    }
  }

  /* THE PRICE LINE IS PART OF THE LOCK, and it was the half nobody repainted.
     paintTile flipped the badge to "Included" and left the price reading "On
     your call" underneath it — so a client who had already bought Capital
     Academy saw their own product priced as a thing to ask an advisor about.
     Walk finding F37, 2026-09-03. The original price is kept on the element so
     the tile can go back to being an upsell if a grant is ever revoked. */
  function setTilePrice(tile, included, priceWords) {
    var el = tile.querySelector(".tp");
    if (!el) return;
    if (!el.hasAttribute("data-price")) el.setAttribute("data-price", el.textContent);
    el.textContent = included
      ? (priceWords || "Included — you own this")
      : el.getAttribute("data-price");
  }

  function paintTile(tile, included, words) {
    var lockrow = tile.querySelector(".lockrow");
    var unlockBtn = tile.querySelector("[data-unlock], [data-status], [data-course-toggle]");
    var key = tile.getAttribute("data-tile");
    var canBuy = !!(key && PRODUCTS[key] && PRODUCTS[key].checkoutUrl);
    var isCourse = !!(key && COURSE_TILES[key]);
    setTilePrice(tile, included, words && words.price);
    if (included) {
      tile.classList.remove("locked");
      if (lockrow) lockrow.textContent = (words && words.badge) || (isCourse ? "Unlocked" : "Included");
      if (unlockBtn && key) {
        if (isCourse) {
          unlockBtn.textContent = tile.classList.contains("is-open") ? "Close" : "Open";
          unlockBtn.removeAttribute("data-unlock");
          unlockBtn.removeAttribute("data-status");
          unlockBtn.setAttribute("data-course-toggle", key);
          unlockBtn.classList.remove("btn-advise");
          unlockBtn.classList.add("btn-unlock");
          unlockBtn.hidden = false;
          tile.classList.add("is-course");
        } else {
          unlockBtn.textContent = "View status";
          unlockBtn.removeAttribute("data-unlock");
          unlockBtn.removeAttribute("data-course-toggle");
          unlockBtn.setAttribute("data-status", key);
          unlockBtn.classList.remove("btn-unlock");
          unlockBtn.classList.add("btn-advise");
          unlockBtn.hidden = false;
          tile.classList.remove("is-course", "is-open");
          setCourseOpen(tile, false);
        }
      }
    } else {
      tile.classList.add("locked");
      tile.classList.remove("is-course", "is-open");
      setCourseOpen(tile, false);
      if (lockrow) lockrow.innerHTML = '<span class="lk">🔒</span> Locked';
      if (unlockBtn && key) {
        unlockBtn.textContent = "Unlock";
        unlockBtn.removeAttribute("data-status");
        unlockBtn.removeAttribute("data-course-toggle");
        unlockBtn.setAttribute("data-unlock", key);
        unlockBtn.classList.add("btn-unlock");
        unlockBtn.classList.remove("btn-advise");
        /* No checkoutUrl on any product today. A buy button that cannot
           complete must not render. Talk-to-an-advisor stays. */
        unlockBtn.hidden = !canBuy;
      }
    }
  }

  /* ══ NOTHING SHE ALREADY HAS IS EVER SOLD TO HER AGAIN ═══════════════════
     Walk finding 18, 2026-09-06: the portal offered a $32 soft-pull assessment,
     locked, with an Unlock button — a few inches under the three credit scores
     that very pull produced. It is the worst thing this screen can do: it tells
     a paying client we do not know what we have already done for her.

     WHY THE TILE DID NOT KNOW. It was painted from ENTITLEMENTS alone, and the
     soft pull grants none of the five deliverable codes on its own. The fact
     that the pull ran lives somewhere else entirely — portal-summary's
     `soft_pull_complete`, which is true when the payment flag is set, when the
     analyzer finished, OR when a real crs_results row exists. That last one is
     the same row the scores above are drawn from, so if she can see a score,
     this tile can see the pull.

     Owner rule: anything already owned must never appear as locked. So a
     completed pull unlocks the tile whether or not an entitlement was written,
     and it says "Done" rather than "Included", because "included" would be a
     claim about her package and "done" is a claim about her file — and it is
     the file we can prove.

     REPAINTABLE ON PURPOSE. Entitlements and portal-summary race, so this runs
     again whenever either answer changes; painting once would let the loser of
     the race decide. */
  function repaintTiles() {
    var out = { unlocked: 0, locked: 0 };
    if (!entActive) return out;
    var tiles = document.querySelectorAll("[data-tile]");
    for (var i = 0; i < tiles.length; i++) {
      var key = tiles[i].getAttribute("data-tile");
      var code = MAP[key];
      var owned = !!(code && entActive[code]);
      var words = null;
      if (key === "SOFT_PULL" && !owned && softPullDone) {
        owned = true;
        words = { badge: "Done", price: "Already run — this is where your scores came from" };
      }
      if (key === "UWIQ_DELIVERABLES" && !owned && sloPaid) owned = true;
      paintTile(tiles[i], owned, words);
      if (owned) out.unlocked++; else out.locked++;
    }
    /* Not on the demo: the demo exists so every card can be looked at, and
       hiding the test run because the demo also holds the letter pack is the
       one rule that would empty a card Chris asked to see. */
    if (!demoMode && entActive["metro2-letter-pack"]) {
      var trial = document.querySelector('[data-tile="REPAIR_TRIAL"]');
      if (trial) trial.classList.add("hidden");
    }
    if (softPullDone) {
      var note = document.getElementById("unlock-note");
      if (note) note.textContent = "Everything here — book a call for pricing";
    }
    return out;
  }

  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    /* What You Own's course row: open that course's own card and go to it. */
    var ownCourse = e.target.closest("[data-own-course]");
    if (ownCourse) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var courseTile = document.querySelector('[data-tile="' + ownCourse.getAttribute("data-own-course") + '"]');
      if (courseTile && !courseTile.classList.contains("locked")) {
        setCourseOpen(courseTile, true);
        courseTile.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      }
      return;
    }
    var courseBtn = e.target.closest("[data-course-toggle]");
    if (courseBtn) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var fromBtn = courseBtn.closest("article.tile");
      if (fromBtn && !fromBtn.classList.contains("locked")) {
        setCourseOpen(fromBtn, !fromBtn.classList.contains("is-open"));
      }
      return;
    }
    var courseTileTap = e.target.closest("article.tile.is-course:not(.locked)");
    if (!courseTileTap) return;
    if (e.target.closest("[data-book], .btn-advise, a, details, summary, .tile-course")) return;
    setCourseOpen(courseTileTap, !courseTileTap.classList.contains("is-open"));
  });

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c];
    });
  }
  function initials(name) {
    var parts = String(name || "").trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (!parts.length) return "—";
    return parts.slice(0, 2).map(function (p) { return p.charAt(0).toUpperCase(); }).join("");
  }
  function setText(id, v) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.textContent = v;
  }
  function fmtWhen(iso) {
    if (!iso) return "";
    var d = new Date(iso);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(iso);
    return d.toLocaleString();
  }
  /* PAYMENTS TAB (launch pass R20 / CP-02). The paid list used to print the raw
     database text, so a person read "147.00succeeded". fmtPayAmount puts the
     dollar sign and the cents on it; fmtPayWhen is fmtWhen without the seconds.
     Both stay on the Payments tab — the other fmtWhen callers are unchanged.
     A value that already carries a "$" (the demo portal's sample) is left alone,
     and a value that is not a number prints as it arrived, never as a guess. */
  function fmtPayAmount(v) {
    if (v == null || v === "") return "—";
    var raw = String(v).trim();
    if (raw.charAt(0) === "$") return raw;
    var n = Number(raw.replace(/,/g, ""));
    if (!isFinite(n)) return raw;
    var body = Math.abs(n).toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
    return (n < 0 ? "-$" : "$") + body;
  }
  function fmtPayWhen(iso) {
    if (!iso) return "";
    var d = new Date(iso);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(iso);
    return d.toLocaleString(undefined, {
      year: "numeric", month: "numeric", day: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit"
    });
  }
  function scoreText(n) {
    return n == null || n === "" ? "—" : String(n);
  }
  function paintPortalScores(scores) {

    var has = scores && (
      scores.experian != null
      || scores.equifax != null
      || scores.transunion != null
      || scores.experian_business != null
    );
    if (card) card.hidden = !has;
    if (!has) return;
    setText("sb-score-ex", scoreText(scores.experian));
    setText("sb-score-eq", scoreText(scores.equifax));
    setText("sb-score-tu", scoreText(scores.transunion));
    setText("sb-score-ex-biz", scoreText(scores.experian_business));
    /* A sample report says it is a sample (live hole 23). Only a true from

    if (sampleNote) {
      sampleNote.textContent = scores.sample === true ? "Sample scores. Not a real credit pull." : "";
      sampleNote.hidden = scores.sample !== true;
    }
  }
  /* ONE AMOUNT, BOTH CARDS (walk finding 16, 2026-09-06).
     The pre-call card and the funding card each carry a "Pre-qualified for"
     row, and only one of the two is ever on screen — .precall-only and

  function paintPrequal(amt) {

      ["sb-prequal-row", "sb-prequal-amt"],

    }
  }

  /* A SIGNED-OUT VISITOR GETS A DOOR, NOT JUST A SENTENCE ABOUT ONE.

  function showSignInDoor() {
    // Staff reach this same refusal by opening the page with no ?id=. Their door

    a.style.textDecoration = "none";
    wrap.appendChild(a);
    host.parentNode.insertBefore(wrap, host.nextSibling);
  }

      button.disabled = false;

  function paintAgreements(items) {

      }).join("");

    if (list) list.innerHTML = html;
    if (pane) pane.innerHTML = html;
  }
  function paintDocs(items) {

  function paintMessages(rows) {
    var pane = document.getElementById("tp-msg");
    if (!pane) return;
    var live = (rows || []).slice(0, 20);
    if (!live.length) {
      pane.innerHTML = '<div class="timeline-item"><span class="td">—</span><span>No messages yet.</span></div>';
      return;
    }
    pane.innerHTML = live.map(function (m) {
      var when = m.created_at ? fmtWhen(m.created_at) : "—";
      var body = m.rendered_body || m.template_key || "Message";
      return '<div class="timeline-item"><span class="td">' + esc(when) +
        "</span><span>" + esc(body) + "</span></div>";
