  /* A CHECKOUT LINK IS ONLY OPENED IF IT IS A WEB ADDRESS. The server hands
     back whatever is stored on the payment_links row; anything that is not
     http(s) is treated as no link at all rather than rendered. Same guard as
     public/progress.html safeUrl(). */
  function payHref(u) {
    var raw = String(u == null ? "" : u).trim();
    if (!raw) return null;
    var parsed;
    try { parsed = new URL(raw, window.location.origin); } catch (e) { return null; }
    if (parsed.protocol !== "http:" && parsed.protocol !== "https:") return null;
    return parsed.href;
  }
  /**
   * paintPays(rows, invoiceDue) — what she owes, then what she has paid.
   *
   * WHY BOTH ARGUMENTS CAN BE null AND WHY THAT IS NOT THE SAME AS EMPTY.
   * /api/read/portal-summary fails every one of its reads soft: null means the
   * table would not answer. An empty list means it answered and there is
   * nothing. Printing "No payments yet" over a read that failed tells a client
   * her money vanished, so the two cases get different sentences.
   *
   * `undefined` is a third thing again: the caller did not have that answer to
   * give. The staff read (/api/dashboard/client) passes transactions only, so
   * it leaves the invoice out rather than claiming there is none; staff get the
   * bill from portal-summary through paintStaffPays below.
   */
  function paintPays(rows, invoiceDue) {
    var pane = document.getElementById("tp-pay");
    if (!pane) return;
    var html = "";
    var anything = false;

    // ── WHAT IS STILL OWED, and the link that pays it. The link is the one the
    //    server found on the invoice; this screen never mints one.
    if (invoiceDue === null) {
      html += '<div class="pay-row"><div><div class="pn">We could not check what you owe</div>' +
        '<div class="pd">Reload in a moment, or ask your advisor</div></div><div class="pv">—</div></div>';
      anything = true;
    } else if (invoiceDue && Array.isArray(invoiceDue.items)) {
      invoiceDue.items.forEach(function (it) {
        var href = payHref(it.pay_url);
        var note = [it.kind, it.reference].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
        html += '<div class="pay-row"><div><div class="pn">Due now</div>' +
          '<div class="pd">' + esc(note || "Invoice") + '</div></div>' +
          '<div class="pv">' + esc(it.amount_display || "—") +
          (href ? ' <a class="btn-unlock" href="' + esc(href) +
            '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Pay now</a>' : "") +
          '</div></div>';
        anything = true;
      });
    }

    // ── WHAT HAS ALREADY BEEN PAID. Unchanged row shape: /api/dashboard/client
    //    and /api/read/portal-summary select the same columns for this list.
    if (rows === null) {
      html += '<div class="pay-row"><div><div class="pn">We could not check your payments</div>' +
        '<div class="pd">Reload in a moment, or ask your advisor</div></div><div class="pv">—</div></div>';
      anything = true;
    } else if (Array.isArray(rows)) {
      html += rows.map(function (t) {
        var name = esc(t.product_name || "Payment");
        var when = t.created_at ? fmtPayWhen(t.created_at) : "—";
        var amt = fmtPayAmount(t.amount_paid);
        var st = t.status ? String(t.status) : "—";
        return '<div class="pay-row"><div><div class="pn">' + name +
          '</div><div class="pd">' + esc(when) + "</div></div>" +
          '<div class="pv">' + esc(amt) + ' <span class="paid-pill">' + esc(st) + '</span></div></div>';
      }).join("");
      if (rows.length) anything = true;
    }

    if (!anything) {
      html = '<div class="pay-row"><div><div class="pn">No payments yet</div>' +
        '<div class="pd">They show here after you pay</div></div><div class="pv">—</div></div>';
    }
    pane.innerHTML = html;
  }
  /* STAFF SEE THE BILL TOO (hole 9, live 2026-09-18). Staff paint the paid list
     from /api/dashboard/client, which carries no bill, so #8's sent success-fee
     invoice never showed on the staff view while Ops AR and portal-summary both
     had it (amounts stay out of this file — see the note in #tp-pay). The bill
     now comes from portal-summary's invoice_due. Two reads, and either can land
     first, so each one records its half and the pane is painted from both —
     same screen in either order, no race.
     Held back only when it would print a false "No payments yet": the paid list
     has not answered and nothing is owed (or the bill read failed). */
  var staffPay = { rows: undefined, due: undefined };
  function paintStaffPays(part, value) {
    staffPay[part] = value;
    if (staffPay.rows === undefined && !(staffPay.due && staffPay.due.count > 0)) return;
    paintPays(staffPay.rows, staffPay.due);
  }
  /* ONE SESSION READ, SHARED BY BOTH THINGS THAT NEED IT. Two questions on this
     screen have the same answer: what is this person called, and which client
     file is theirs. A client signed in by an emailed link has no other source
     for either — no ?id= in the bar and, before portal-login.html was fixed, no
     fh_account. Asking twice would be two round trips for one answer, so the
     promise is made once and both callers wait on the same one. It never
     rejects: a failed read is an empty answer, exactly as before. */
  var sessionPromise = null;
  function session() {
    if (sessionPromise) return sessionPromise;
    var t = "";
    try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) {}
    sessionPromise = fetch("/api/auth/session", {
      headers: t ? { authorization: "Bearer " + t } : {},
      credentials: "same-origin"
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      return (d && d.ok) ? d : null;
    }, function () { return null; });
    return sessionPromise;
  }
  /* ══ FINANCEOS SIDE-SELL (FinanceOS wave 5, unit W5) ════════════════════
     Owner 2026-10-06: FinanceOS is a side sell to the Capital Blueprint. A
     client who has the Blueprint but not FinanceOS sees the FinanceOS card
     point at FinanceOS setup (/app/financeos.html#setup) instead. The answer
     is `offers` on GET /api/money/ready-to-fund (src/finance/ready-to-fund.mjs:
     a paid Capital Blueprint, and an active finance-os subscription). Any
     other answer — no Blueprint, FinanceOS already on, a staff role outside
     FINANCE (403), offline — leaves the card exactly as it ships. Not awaited:
     nothing else on this screen waits on it. data-fh-href too, because
     gateLinks() rebuilds every href from it. */
  function paintFinanceOsSideSell(forClientId, asStaff) {
    var card = document.getElementById("money-link");
    if (!card) return;
    var t = "";
    try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) {}
    var q = asStaff && forClientId ? "?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(forClientId) : "";
    fetch("/api/money/ready-to-fund" + q, {
      headers: t ? { accept: "application/json", authorization: "Bearer " + t } : { accept: "application/json" },
      credentials: "same-origin"
    }).then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; }).then(function (d) {
      var o = d && d.ok && d.offers;
      if (!o || !o.blueprint || o.blueprint.owned !== true || !o.financeos || o.financeos.entitled !== false) return;
      var href = "/app/financeos.html" + q + "#setup";
      card.setAttribute("href", href);
      card.setAttribute("data-fh-href", href);
      var desc = card.querySelector(".fb-d");
      if (desc) desc.textContent = "Add FinanceOS to your Capital Blueprint: your bank accounts, cards, bills, and business credit in one place.";
      var go = card.querySelector(".fb-go");
      if (go) go.textContent = "Set up FinanceOS";
    }, function () {});
  }

  function nameFromSession() {
    return session().then(function (d) {
      var s = d && d.staff;
      return (s && s.name) ? String(s.name) : "";
    });
  }
  /* The client's OWN id, off the session they already hold. api/auth/session.mjs
     projects it as staff.client_id for a client principal and leaves it absent
     for staff, who reach this screen with ?id= instead — so this can never hand
     a staff member somebody's file by accident. */
  function clientIdFromSession() {
    return session().then(function (d) {
      var s = d && d.staff;
      return (s && s.client_id) ? String(s.client_id) : "";
    });
  }

  /* ══ THE DEMO PORTAL ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Owner ask 2026-09-25: "for the demo portal please make sure they are all
     unlocked so daddy can see whats going on, please put sample data in as
     well." So ONE URL — /app/client-portal.html?demo=1 — paints this screen
     with every card unlocked and every list full of obviously fake content.

     IT TALKS TO NOTHING. No entitlements read, no portal-summary, no session:
     the sample below is the whole payload. That is the same shape the rest of
     this app's demo mode already has — public/portal-login.html says of the
     `fh_demo` key, "while it is set NOTHING in the app contacts the real
     backend" — and it is what makes this safe in both directions. A real
     client cannot land here, and the demo cannot read a real client.

     THE `fh_demo` KEY OPENS THE SAME VIEW, because four app screens already
     read it (documents.html, inquiry-remover.html, staff-teams.html,
     hiring.html) and a second switch for one idea is how two demo modes drift.

     NOTHING HERE IS A REAL PERSON. Names come from the demo furniture already
     in src/demo/seed-ui-coverage.mjs (Harborwick, Quillcrest) on the same rule
     as src/auth/demo-roster.mjs: every demo name starts with DEMO so it reads
     as demo at a glance. No real client, no real address, no credit file. The
     scores are the simulated set from src/demo/simulate-client.mjs and they
     paint with `sample: true`, which is what puts "Sample scores. Not a real
     credit pull." under them. */
  function isDemoPortal() {
    try {
      if (FHData.param("demo") === "1") return true;
      return localStorage.getItem("fh_demo") === "1";
    } catch (e) { return false; }
  }

  /* A SAMPLE FILE THAT REALLY OPENS, and that no server had to invent. The
     deliverables in the demo need a working Download or the row is a dead
     link, so each one is built here as a blob in the browser — same origin,
     opens in a tab, gone when the tab closes, and impossible to confuse with a
     client's document because the first thing on it says so. */
  function demoSampleFile(title, lines) {
    var body = lines.map(function (l) { return "<p>" + esc(l) + "</p>"; }).join("");
    var html = '<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><title>' + esc(title) +
      ' — SAMPLE</title><style>body{font:16px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif;max-width:40em;' +
      'margin:3em auto;padding:0 1.5em;color:#111}h1{font-size:1.5em}.s{background:#ffe9e9;' +
      'border:1px solid #c33;color:#900;padding:.7em 1em;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700}' +
      '</style><p class="s">SAMPLE — demo portal. Not a real client and not a real credit file.</p>' +
      '<h1>' + esc(title) + '</h1>' + body;
    try {
      return URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html], { type: "text/html" }));
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  function demoDocuments() {
    var day = 0;
    function doc(subtype, title, lines) {
      day += 3;
      var url = demoSampleFile(title, lines);
      return {
        id: "demo-" + subtype,
        kind: "deliverable",
        subtype: subtype,
        title: title,
        mime_type: "text/html",
        created_at: new Date(Date.now() - day * 86400000).toISOString(),
        download: url ? { url: url } : null
      };
    }
    return [
      doc("credit_analysis_report", "Credit Analysis Report", [
        "Sample file for DEMO Client of Harborwick Supply Co.",
        "Three bureaus read. Sample scores 718 / 724 / 731.",
        "Four sample accounts reviewed, two sample reporting errors flagged."
      ]),
      doc("credit_optimization_roadmap", "Credit Optimization Roadmap", [
        "Sample roadmap, in order, for DEMO Client.",
        "Step 1 — bring the sample revolving balance under 30% of its limit.",
        "Step 2 — dispute the two sample reporting errors from the report.",
        "Step 3 — leave the sample oldest account open."
      ]),
      doc("funding_snapshot", "Funding Snapshot", [
        "Sample snapshot for Harborwick Supply Co.",
        "Sample pre-qualified range: $85,000.",
        "Sample readiness: business entity on file, sample bank history 14 months."
      ]),
      doc("bank_lender_match_list", "Bank and Lender Match List", [
        "Sample match list. These are placeholder names, not real banks.",
        "Sample match 1 — Quillcrest Community Bank.",
        "Sample match 2 — Harborwick Credit Union.",
        "Sample match 3 — Northgate Business Lending."
      ]),
      doc("metro2_dispute_letter_pack", "Metro 2 Dispute Letter Pack", [
        "Sample letter pack for DEMO Client.",
        "Two sample letters, one per sample reporting error.",
        "Nothing here is addressed and nothing here will be mailed."
      ])
    ];
  }

  function paintDemoPortal() {
    demoMode = true;
    /* Nothing downstream may wait on a client id that is never coming — the
       dispute card in the next script tag awaits this promise. */
    window.__fhClientId = Promise.resolve(null);

    entActive = {};
    var CODES = [
      ["credit-analysis-report", "Credit Analysis Report"],
      ["credit-optimization-roadmap", "Credit Optimization Roadmap"],
      ["funding-snapshot", "Funding Snapshot"],
      ["bank-lender-match-list", "Bank and Lender Match List"],
      ["metro2-letter-pack", "Metro 2 Dispute Letter Pack"],
      ["funding-mastery-course", "Funding Mastery course (A to Z)"]
    ];
    for (var i = 0; i < CODES.length; i++) {
      entActive[CODES[i][0]] = {
        entitlement_code: CODES[i][0], entitlement_name: CODES[i][1], active: true
      };
    }
    /* Both of these are true for the demo on purpose: every offer card and
       every deliverable is unlocked, which is the whole point of the ask. */
    softPullDone = true;
    sloPaid = true;
    docsOnFile = demoDocuments();
    stage = { key: "paid" };

    paintIdentity("DEMO Client", "DEMO Advisor");
    paintPortalScores({
      experian: 718, equifax: 724, transunion: 731, experian_business: 62, sample: true
    });
    paintPrequal("$85,000");
    setFundingVisible(true);
    setUploadDoors({ funding: true, inquiry: true, bureau_response: true });
    setInquiryCaseOpen(false);
    paintOwn(entActive);
    repaintTiles();
    paintDocs(docsOnFile);
    paintAgreements([{
      title: "Capital Blueprint Agreement (SAMPLE)",
      sent_at: new Date(Date.now() - 20 * 86400000).toISOString(),
      status: "signed"
    }]);
    paintPays([{
      product_name: "Capital Blueprint (SAMPLE)",
      created_at: new Date(Date.now() - 20 * 86400000).toISOString(),
      amount_paid: "$297.00",
      status: "paid"
    }], { items: [] });
    paintMessages([
      { created_at: new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 86400000).toISOString(),
        rendered_body: "SAMPLE — Your roadmap is ready in your portal." },
      { created_at: new Date(Date.now() - 19 * 86400000).toISOString(),
        rendered_body: "SAMPLE — Thanks for your order. Your credit pull is running." }
    ]);
    paintStage();
    FHData.banner("sample",
      "Demo portal — every card is unlocked and everything on this page is sample data. No real client.");
  }

  if (isDemoPortal()) {
    paintDemoPortal();
    return;
  }

  async function paintRepFiles() {
    if (typeof isDemoPortal === "function" && isDemoPortal()) return;
    var box = document.getElementById("rep-files");
    if (!box) return;
    var d = await session();
    var s = d && d.staff;
    if (!s || s.authorized_rep !== true) return;
    var t = "";
    try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) {}
    var headers = { accept: "application/json" };
    if (t) headers.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
    var res = await fetch("/api/auth/authorized-rep-file", {
      headers: headers,
      credentials: "same-origin"
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }, function () { return null; });
    var files = res && res.ok && res.files ? res.files : [];
    if (files.length < 2) return;
    box.hidden = false;
    box.textContent = "";
    files.forEach(function (f) {
      var b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button";
      b.textContent = f.name || "File";
      if (f.client_id === res.active_client_id) b.setAttribute("aria-current", "true");
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (f.client_id === res.active_client_id || b.disabled) return;
        b.disabled = true;
        fetch("/api/auth/authorized-rep-file", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            accept: "application/json",
            "content-type": "application/json",
            authorization: t ? "Bearer " + t : ""
          },
          credentials: "same-origin",
          body: JSON.stringify({ client_id: f.client_id })
        }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (out) {
          if (out && out.ok) location.reload();
          else b.disabled = false;
        }, function () { b.disabled = false; });
      });
      box.appendChild(b);
    });
  }

  var clientId = null;
  try {
    if (window.FHData && typeof FHData.param === "function") {
      clientId = FHData.param("id") || FHData.param("client_id");
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  try {
    var acct = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("fh_account") || "null");
    if (!clientId && acct && (acct.clientId || acct.client_id)) {
      clientId = acct.clientId || acct.client_id;
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  /* PUBLISHED FOR THE DISPUTE CARD FURTHER DOWN, which is a separate script tag
     and so cannot see anything in here. It needs the same id and must not ask
     for it a second time — the round trip is the cost, not the endpoint. A
     promise, not a value, because the answer may not exist yet. */
  window.__fhClientId = clientId
    ? Promise.resolve(clientId)
    : clientIdFromSession();

  /* THE THIRD SOURCE, AND WHY IT COMES LAST. ?id= is the staff walk and
     fh_account is a password sign-in; both answer instantly, so neither is made
     to wait on a network call. Only when both are empty — which is every client
     who signed in by clicking an emailed link — does this screen ask the session
     who it is talking to. The refusal below used to fire here, synchronously,
     BEFORE that question could be answered, and taking its `return` skipped
     every read on the rest of this screen: agreements, pre-qual, documents and
     entitlements were never requested at all. It now fires only once the answer
     is known. */
  if (!clientId) {
    clientId = await window.__fhClientId;
  }

  /* The file he is looking at lives on the session, not in the saved account.
     The saved account still names the first file after he switches.
     Only a client login can be an authorized representative, so a saved STAFF
     role skips this read: hole 13 (2026-09-18) promises staff with a saved role
     an answer with no wait on the session, and this read, added for
     representatives on 2026-09-27, had quietly put that wait back. */
  var savedStaffRole = (function () { var r = roleHint(); return !!r && r !== "client"; })();
  var repSession = savedStaffRole ? null : await session();
  if (repSession && repSession.staff && repSession.staff.authorized_rep && repSession.staff.client_id) {
    clientId = String(repSession.staff.client_id);
    window.__fhClientId = Promise.resolve(clientId);
    try {
      var saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("fh_account") || "{}");
      saved.clientId = clientId;
      saved.client_id = clientId;
      localStorage.setItem("fh_account", JSON.stringify(saved));
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  if (!savedStaffRole) await paintRepFiles();

  if (!clientId) {
    paintEmptyIdentity();
    setFundingVisible(false);
    document.body.classList.add("no-docs");
    setOwnVisible(false);
    paintDocs([]);
    paintAgreements([]);
    paintMessages([]);
    paintPays([]);
    showSignInDoor();
    FHData.banner("sample", "We could not load your file. Use the link we sent you, or ask for a new one.");
    return;
  }

  /* NO SAVED ROLE — ASK THE SESSION BEFORE CHOOSING STAFF OR CLIENT (hole 13,
     live 2026-09-18). The saved role (fh_role) is written by the sign-in pages
     and by shell.js once its own session read lands. A browser that holds the
     staff cookie but no saved role — storage cleared, a fresh tab after a wipe
     — read "" here, took the CLIENT branch, and greeted the person signed in:
     "Welcome back, Chris" on #11's file, 4 of 4 first loads. A reload said Sim
     only because shell.js had saved the role in between.
     So with no saved role this waits on the same session read the name and the
     client id already use (one request, shared) and takes its role. A client's
     session says "client" and nothing changes for them; a stranger's says
     nothing, so they stay on the client branch and shell.js still sends them
     to sign in. A saved role still answers instantly, with no wait. */
  if (!roleHint()) {
    var who = await session();
    var whoRole = who && who.staff && who.staff.role;
    if (whoRole) sessionRole = String(whoRole).trim().toLowerCase();
  }

  /* ══ THE PROGRESS LINK HAS TO SAY WHOSE FILE IT MEANS ════════════════════
     Walk finding 15, 2026-09-06: "See exactly where your file stands" opened a
     page that said "We could not load your file just now. Please refresh in a
     moment." and never recovered. It is the customer's main "where am I" link
     and it was dead for everyone on staff.

     WHY. /progress.html sends whatever token is in localStorage under
     `fh_token`, and staff and clients share that key (public/login.html:230 and
     public/portal-login.html:147 both write it). For a CLIENT the server pins
     the file to the session and the page works. For STAFF the server has no way
     to know which client is meant, so it answers 400 client_id_required — and
     the page lumped that in with every other failure and told them to refresh.
     No amount of refreshing supplies a client id.

     So a staff viewer's link carries the id they are already looking at. A
     client's link is left exactly as it ships: a client principal is pinned to
     their own file and the server never reads client_id from them, so adding
     one would be noise on the URL that changes nothing. */
  if (STAFF_ROLES[roleHint()]) {
    var progA = document.querySelector("#prog-link a");
    if (progA) {
      progA.setAttribute("href", "/progress.html?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(clientId));
    }
    /* Same reason for the FinanceOS card: api/money/* needs ?client_id= from
       staff. shell.js STAFF_MONEY keeps the card on for owner, admin and
       sales_manager; gateLinks() hides it for everyone else. data-fh-href too:
       gateLinks() rebuilds every href from it on each pass. */
    var moneyA = document.getElementById("money-link");
    if (moneyA && clientId) {
      var moneyHref = "/app/financeos.html?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(clientId);
      moneyA.setAttribute("href", moneyHref);
      moneyA.setAttribute("data-fh-href", moneyHref);
    }
  }

  /* FinanceOS side-sell for a Capital Blueprint client — see paintFinanceOsSideSell. */
  paintFinanceOsSideSell(clientId, !!STAFF_ROLES[roleHint()]);

  setFundingVisible(false);
  /* Doors stay hidden via body.no-upload-doors until entitlements paint.
     Do not force no-docs here — that hid Send a file even after unlock. */
  setOwnVisible(false);

  /* GET /api/dashboard/client is staff-only. A client calling it always
     fails and the page used to look unsigned-in. Staff keep the read.
     Clients take their name from the session and skip the call. */
  if (STAFF_ROLES[roleHint()]) {
    FHData.client(clientId).then(function (res) {
      if (res.ok && res.data && res.data.client) {
        var c = res.data.client;
        var name = [c.first_name, c.last_name].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
        paintIdentity(name, advisorFromClient(c));
        paintBooking(res.data.latest_booking);
        paintMessages(res.data.messages);
        paintStaffPays("rows", res.data.transactions);
        return;
      }
      paintIdentity("", "");
      if (res.source === "unauthorized") {
        nameFromSession().then(function (nm) {
          paintIdentity(nm, "");
        });
        return;
      }
      /* No file at this id — none given, none found, or not an id at all. Say
         so (hole N14): the line under the greeting no longer STARTS as the
         refusal, so this is the only place a wrong or stale link learns it. */
      if (res.source === "nodata" || res.source === "notfound" || res.source === "badrequest") {
        paintEmptyIdentity();
      }
    });
  } else if (repSession && repSession.staff && repSession.staff.authorized_rep) {
    var activeFile = document.querySelector("#rep-files button[aria-current='true']");
    var fileName = activeFile ? activeFile.textContent : "";
    paintIdentity(fileName || (repSession.staff.name || ""), "");
  } else {
    nameFromSession().then(function (nm) {
      paintIdentity(nm, "");
    });
  }

  FHData.wire(FHData.portalContracts(clientId ? { client_id: clientId } : {}),
    "agreements", function (data) {
      var items = data.items || [];
      paintAgreements(items);
      if (!items.length) return "live agreements · none yet";
      var pending = items.filter(function (a) { return a.needs_signature; }).length;
      return "live agreements · " + items.length + " on file" + (pending ? " · " + pending + " to sign" : "");
    });

  var callSummary = FHData.portalSummary(clientId ? { client_id: clientId } : {});
  callSummary.then(function (res) {
    if (!res || !res.ok) paintCallConfirm({ unavailable: true });
  }).catch(function () { paintCallConfirm({ unavailable: true }); });
  FHData.wire(callSummary,
    "portal-summary", function (data) {
      paintCallConfirm(data.upcoming_call);
      docsOnFile = Array.isArray(data.documents) ? data.documents : [];
      softPullDone = data.soft_pull_complete === true;
      sloPaid = data.slo_paid === true;
      if (!STAFF_ROLES[roleHint()]) paintDocs(docsOnFile);
      /* THE PAYMENTS TAB, FOR THE PERSON WHOSE MONEY IT IS. Staff already have
         the richer list from /api/dashboard/client above — painting twice would
         race and the later answer would win at random — so this only runs for a
         client, who never gets that staff-gated read and therefore, before this
         line, never saw a payment or an invoice at all (GAP 7). Both fields are
         passed straight through: null stays null so the pane can say it could
         not check rather than printing a false empty. */
      if (!STAFF_ROLES[roleHint()]) {
        paintPays(
          Array.isArray(data.payments) || data.payments === null ? data.payments : undefined,
          data.invoice_due === undefined ? undefined : data.invoice_due
        );
      } else {
        // Staff keep their paid list; this read adds the bill. See paintStaffPays.
        paintStaffPays("due", data.invoice_due);
      }
      setInquiryCaseOpen(data.inquiry_open);
      stage = data.stage || null;
      paintStage();
      /* THIS READ CHANGES THREE THINGS THE OTHER READ ALREADY PAINTED.
         Which deliverables can be handed over, whether the soft-pull tile is
         still an offer, and which identity documents are still missing. If
         entitlements landed first, repaint with what we now know; if they land
         second, their own handler runs these. Either order, same screen. */
      paintOwn(entActive);
      repaintTiles();
      setAdvisorFromFile(data.advisor || null);
      /* THE DISPUTE CARD OPENS FOR REPAIR AND FOR THE FUNDING OFFER, AND FOR
         NOBODY ELSE (F35, owner-set 2026-09-03). Absent or false keeps it shut,
         which is why the test is `!== true` and not truthiness: an older deploy
         of this endpoint answers with no such field, and a missing answer must
         not open a consent form.

         IT READS `dispute_consent`, NOT `repair_path`. The two are different
         questions and they disagree for every funding customer: a funding client
         is not on the repair path and still has dispute letters in their pack.
         The server decides which is which — src/consent/dispute-consent.mjs —
         and api/consent/capture.mjs refuses a signature by the same rule, so
         this class only hides a form that would be refused anyway. */
      document.body.classList.toggle("no-dispute-consent", data.dispute_consent !== true);
      paintDocNote(data.doc_agent_message);
      var amt = data.prequal_display;
      paintPortalScores(data.scores || {});
      paintPrequal(amt);
      if (!amt) return "live pre-qual · none yet";
      var preMain = document.getElementById("sb-pre-main");
      if (preMain) {
        preMain.textContent = "Your soft-pull assessment is in. You're pre-qualified for approximately " + amt + ".";
      }
      return "live pre-qual · " + amt;
    });

  /* Clients get their own document metadata from portal-summary above. Staff
     use the one master Documents home instead of a duplicate portal list. */
  if (STAFF_ROLES[roleHint()]) paintStaffDocsLink(clientId);

  FHData.wire(FHData.entitlements({ client_id: clientId, limit: 200 }),
    "entitlements", function (data) {
      var rows = data.items || [];
      var active = {};
      rows.forEach(function (e) { if (e.active) active[e.entitlement_code] = e; });

      entActive = active;
      setFundingVisible(!!active[FUNDING_CODE]);
      setUploadDoors(doorsFromEntitlementCodes(Object.keys(active)));
      paintOwn(active);
      if (active[FUNDING_CODE]) {
        var sbLive = document.getElementById("sb-main");
        if (sbLive) {
          sbLive.textContent = "Your funding file is open. We will update this as your round moves.";
        }
      }

      var counts = repaintTiles();
      if (!counts.unlocked && !counts.locked) return null;
      return "live entitlements · " + counts.unlocked + " unlocked · " + counts.locked + " locked";
    });
});
</script>
<script>
/* Dispute-letter authorization. Same capture as consent-capture.html with
   kind=dispute_authorization and capture_method signature. The legal paragraph
   is not in this file — GET /api/consent/capture returns it. The drawing is a
   client-side gate; POST sends name + method, not a new upload. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var KIND = "dispute_authorization";
  var card = document.getElementById("dispute-auth-card");
  var canvas = document.getElementById("cpSignPad");
  if (!card || !canvas) return;

  var padState = { sized: false, ink: false, drawing: false, last: null, dist: 0 };
  var disclosureVersion = null;
  var busy = false;

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }

  /* THE PAD AND THE BUTTON ARE DEAD UNTIL THE WORDING IS ON SCREEN (CP-07).
     A signature is a yes to specific words. When the wording never loaded, the
     card used to say "You can still draw your signature", the POST went out
     with consent_version null, and the server filled in the CURRENT version —
     so the client was recorded as agreeing to words this page never showed
     them. Now the pad takes no ink and the button does nothing until the server
     has handed over BOTH the text and its version. Starts locked; load()
     unlocks it only on a full answer. api/consent/capture.mjs refuses a client
     signature with no version too, so a stale copy of this page cannot get
     around it. */
  function lockSigning(locked) {
    $("cpSignSubmit").disabled = locked;
    canvas.style.pointerEvents = locked ? "none" : "";
    card.classList.toggle("is-locked", locked);
  }
  lockSigning(true);

  function resolveClientId() {
    var id = null;
    try {
      var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
      id = q.get("id") || q.get("client_id");
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      var acct = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("fh_account") || "null");
      if (!id && acct && (acct.clientId || acct.client_id)) id = acct.clientId || acct.client_id;
    } catch (e) {}
    return id;
  }

  var clientId = resolveClientId();

  /* THE ID MAY NOT BE KNOWABLE YET. ?id= and fh_account answer straight away —
     the staff walk and a password sign-in — but a client who arrived by emailed
     link has neither, and their id only comes back with /api/auth/session. The
     portal script above already asks once and publishes the answer, so this
     waits on that promise rather than asking again. Unlike the reads on this
     screen, this card CANNOT skip the id: api/consent/capture.mjs requires a
     uuid on both the GET and the POST and checks it against the session before
     it will answer. Without this the card tells a client who IS signed in to
     "Sign in to load the legal wording", and the signature can never be taken. */
  function whenClientId(done) {
    var p = window.__fhClientId;
    if (clientId || !p || typeof p.then !== "function") { done(); return; }
    p.then(function (id) { if (id) clientId = id; done(); }, function () { done(); });
  }

  function say(kindOfMsg, text) {
    var el = $("cpSignMsg");
    el.className = "sign-auth-msg show " + kindOfMsg;
    el.textContent = text;
  }

  /* AUDIT 2026-08-17 §5/§6 — COMPLIANCE (consent capture).
     This helper sent only credentials:"same-origin" and no Authorization
     header, so every call from this card arrived with no credential and came
     back 401: the disclosure text never loaded and the signature could never
     be recorded. A client account login stores its token in localStorage
     (public/portal-login.html) and gets no fundhub_session cookie — that
     cookie is set for staff only (api/auth/login.mjs) — which is why the
     cookie alone was never going to work. The endpoint already admits a client
     principal (api/consent/capture.mjs) and only ever lets that client act on
     themself, so nothing here widens a gate, adds a route or grants a
     permission: it sends the same bearer token the rest of this page already
     sends (see nameFromSession above, and data.js). */
  function sessionToken() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; }
  }

  function api(path, options) {
    var init = options || {};
    init.headers = init.headers || {};
    init.headers["accept"] = "application/json";
    var authToken = sessionToken();
    if (authToken) init.headers["authorization"] = "Bearer " + authToken;
    if (init.body !== undefined) {
      init.headers["content-type"] = "application/json";
      init.body = JSON.stringify(init.body);
    }
    init.credentials = "same-origin";
    return fetch(path, init).then(
      function (r) {
        return r.json().then(
          function (b) { return { status: r.status, body: b }; },
          function () { return { status: r.status, body: null }; }
        );
      },
      function (e) { return { status: 0, body: null, transport: (e && e.message) || "network error" }; }
    );
  }

  function padPos(e) {
    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
  }

  function padCtx() { return canvas.getContext("2d"); }

  function fillPadPaper() {
    var ctx = padCtx();
    var w = canvas.clientWidth || 640;
    var h = canvas.clientHeight || 160;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#1a1a1a";
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.25;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.lineJoin = "round";
  }

  function ensurePadSized() {
    if (padState.sized) return;
    var cssW = Math.max(canvas.clientWidth, 280);
    var cssH = Math.max(canvas.clientHeight, 96);
    var ratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    canvas.width = Math.floor(cssW * ratio);
    canvas.height = Math.floor(cssH * ratio);
    canvas.style.width = cssW + "px";
    canvas.style.height = cssH + "px";
    var ctx = padCtx();
    ctx.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
    fillPadPaper();
    padState.sized = true;
  }

  function clearPad() {
    padState.ink = false;
    padState.drawing = false;
    padState.last = null;
    padState.dist = 0;
    if (!padState.sized) ensurePadSized();
    else fillPadPaper();
  }

  function canvasHasInk() {
    if (!padState.sized) return false;
    var ctx = padCtx();
    var img;
    try { img = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); }
    catch (e) { return padState.ink && padState.dist > 12; }
    var d = img.data;
    var dark = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) {
      if (d[i + 3] < 30) continue;
      if (d[i] < 240 || d[i + 1] < 240 || d[i + 2] < 240) {
        dark++;
        if (dark > 8) return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function markSigned() {
    card.classList.add("is-signed");
    $("dispute-auth-title").textContent = "You already signed";
    say("ok", "You already signed. We can prepare dispute letters. This is not a credit pull.");
  }

  function load() {
    if (!clientId) {
      $("cpDisclosure").textContent =
        "Sign in to load the legal wording and record your signature.";
      ensurePadSized();
      return;
    }
    api("/api/consent/capture?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(clientId) +
        "&kind=" + encodeURIComponent(KIND)).then(function (res) {
      if (res.status !== 200 || !res.body || !res.body.ok) {
        $("cpDisclosure").textContent =
          "The legal wording did not load, so you cannot sign yet. Reload this page to try again.";
        ensurePadSized();
        return;
      }
      var d = res.body.disclosure;
      if (d && d.text && d.version) {
        disclosureVersion = String(d.version);
        $("cpDisclosure").textContent = d.text;
        lockSigning(false);
      } else {
        disclosureVersion = null;
        $("cpDisclosure").textContent = "The consent wording is unavailable — do not record a consent.";
      }
      if (res.body.status && res.body.status.valid) markSigned();
      else ensurePadSized();
    });
  }

  function submit() {
    if (busy) return;
    if (!clientId) {
      say("err", "Sign in to record your signature.");
      return;
    }
    if (!disclosureVersion) {
      say("err", "The legal wording is not on this page, so your signature cannot be recorded. Reload this page and try again.");
      return;
    }
    var name = $("cpSignName").value.trim();
    if (!name) {
      say("err", "Type your legal name. This is required when you sign.");
      return;
    }
    if (!canvasHasInk()) {
      say("err", "Draw your signature in the box. An empty box does not count.");
      return;
    }
    busy = true;
    $("cpSignSubmit").disabled = true;
    var body = {
      client_id: clientId,
      kind: KIND,
      action: "grant",
      capture_method: "signature",
      granted_name: name,
      consent_version: disclosureVersion
    };
    api("/api/consent/capture", { method: "POST", body: body }).then(function (res) {
      busy = false;
      $("cpSignSubmit").disabled = !disclosureVersion;
      if (res.status !== 200 || !res.body || !res.body.ok) {
        var msg = (res.body && (res.body.message || res.body.error)) ||
          (res.status === 401 ? "You are signed out. Sign in and try again." :
           res.status === 0 ? "Could not reach the server. Try again." :
           "That signature could not be recorded. Try again.");
        say("err", String(msg));
        return;
      }
      $("cpSignName").value = "";
      clearPad();
      markSigned();
      say("ok", "Signature recorded. We can prepare dispute letters. This is not a credit pull.");
    });
  }

  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) {
    if (!disclosureVersion) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    ensurePadSized();
    canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    padState.drawing = true;
    padState.last = padPos(e);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) {
    if (!padState.drawing || !padState.last) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var p = padPos(e);
    var ctx = padCtx();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padState.last.x, padState.last.y);
    ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.stroke();
    var dx = p.x - padState.last.x;
    var dy = p.y - padState.last.y;
    padState.dist += Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (padState.dist > 12) padState.ink = true;
    padState.last = p;
  });
  function stopDraw(e) {
    padState.drawing = false;
    padState.last = null;
    try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
  }
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", stopDraw);
  canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", stopDraw);
  $("cpSignClear").addEventListener("click", function () { clearPad(); });
  $("cpSignSubmit").addEventListener("click", submit);

  /* load() waits on the id. Fired before it, this card shows an empty pad and
     tells a signed-in client to sign in — the wording never arrives and the
     signature can never be recorded. */
  whenClientId(load);
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   THE ACTIVITY TAB, WHICH HAS NEVER SHOWN ANYTHING.

   #tp-act ships one row reading "No activity recorded on this file yet" and no
   code in this file has ever touched it. Every other tab on this card has a
   painter — paintMessages, paintPays, paintDocs — and this one was left out, so
   the sentence was not an empty state, it was the only state.

   IT IS PAINTED FROM /api/read/client-progress, whose `timeline` field is
   described in ops/workflows/portal-progress-contract.md. Those rows come from
   repair_decision_log through TIMELINE_SQL and are already rendered into plain
   English for a client by timelineLine() (src/repair/lens.mjs:206) — written,
   tested, and staff-only until now. Nothing new is being written here; a read
   that existed is being pointed at a tab that existed.

   THE ENDPOINT MAY NOT BE THERE YET. It is built by a separate lane against the
   same written contract, and until that lane merges this read 404s.

   WHAT A FAILED READ SAYS, AND WHY IT CHANGED. It used to leave the shipped
   sentence — "No activity recorded on this file yet." — standing. That sentence
   is a STATEMENT ABOUT THE FILE, and a read that never answered proves nothing
   about the file. A client with a year of history would have been told nothing
   had happened. So a failed read now says the read failed, in those words, and
   the "nothing yet" sentence is kept for the one case that earns it: the
   endpoint answered, and answered with an empty list.

   IT DOES NOT CLAIM A COMPLAINT WAS LODGED. The text comes from the server and
   is printed as given; this block adds no words of its own. That matters because
   nothing in this system records whether a CFPB or state attorney general
   complaint was ever actually submitted (src/metro2/letters/catalog.mjs:57-65).

   SEPARATE FROM THE BLOCK ABOVE ON PURPOSE. That one goes through FHData and the
   screen's own client-id resolution; this one asks a single endpoint that pins a
   client to their own file, so it needs neither and cannot break either.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function escape2(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c];
    });
  }

  var MONTHS = ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"];
  function when(iso) {
    if (!iso) return null;
    var d = new Date(iso);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
    return d.getUTCDate() + " " + MONTHS[d.getUTCMonth()];
  }

  /* ONE DATE PER ROW. timeline[].text ALREADY BEGINS WITH A DATE — timelineLine()
     (src/repair/lens.mjs:206) returns "Mar 3 · letters mailed to all three
     bureaus", formatted in America/Los_Angeles — and this tab was printing its
     own UTC date beside it. Two dates on every row, disagreeing by a day
     whenever the event was stored near midnight (the endpoint lane watched `at`
     say 2026-03-04T00:00:00.000Z against a text of "Mar 3").

     `at` owns the date, because it is the authoritative field and because the
     progress page at /progress.html formats the same event from the same field.
     The duplicate is stripped off the words. If the prefix is not in the shape
     expected, or `at` is unusable, this adds no date of its own and the string
     keeps whatever it carries — so exactly one date reaches the client either
     way. Kept deliberately identical to timelineParts() in public/progress.html;
     these two files share no script and each carries its own copy. */
  var TL_DATE_PREFIX = /^[A-Za-z]{3,9}\.?\s+\d{1,2}\s*·\s*/;

  function parts(e) {
    e = e || {};
    var raw = String(e.text == null ? "" : e.text);
    var d = when(e.at);
    if (d && TL_DATE_PREFIX.test(raw)) {
      var words = raw.replace(TL_DATE_PREFIX, "");
      if (words) return { when: d, words: words };
    }
    return { when: TL_DATE_PREFIX.test(raw) ? null : d, words: raw };
  }

  function token() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; }
  }

  function row(dateText, words) {
    return '<div class="timeline-item"><span class="td">' + escape2(dateText || "—") +
           "</span><span>" + escape2(words) + "</span></div>";
  }

  function paint(rows) {
    var pane = document.getElementById("tp-act");
    if (!pane) return;
    if (!rows.length) return;               // answered, and empty: the shipped sentence is true
    pane.innerHTML = rows.slice(0, 40).map(function (e) {
      var p = parts(e);
      return row(p.when, p.words);
    }).join("");
  }

  /* THE READ DID NOT ANSWER. Say that, and only that. This must never leave
     "No activity recorded on this file yet." on screen, because that sentence
     claims something about the file that a failed read cannot know. */
  function unavailable() {
    var pane = document.getElementById("tp-act");
    if (!pane) return;
    pane.innerHTML = row(null,
      "We could not load your activity just now. Nothing is wrong with your file — " +
      "this list did not load. Try again in a few minutes, and if it is still empty " +
      "say so in chat and we will look.");
  }

  /* ══ WHOSE ACTIVITY ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Walk finding 17, 2026-09-06: this tab said "We could not load your activity
     just now." permanently. Same cause as the dead progress page beside it —
     /api/read/client-progress pins a CLIENT to their own file and requires
     STAFF to name a client, and this read named nobody. So for a client it
     worked and for anyone on staff it was a permanent failure message sitting
     on the client's own screen.

     Staff are the only ones who reach this page with an id in the address bar,
     and the server ignores the parameter for a client principal, so passing it
     when it is there is both necessary and harmless. */
  function progressPath() {
    var id = "";
    try {
      var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
      id = q.get("id") || q.get("client_id") || "";
    } catch (e) { id = ""; }
    return "/api/read/client-progress" +
      (id ? "?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(id) : "");
  }

  function load() {
    var t = token();
    if (!t) return;                          // signed out: not this block's message to write
    fetch(progressPath(), {
      headers: { authorization: "Bearer " + t, accept: "application/json" },
      credentials: "same-origin"
    }).then(function (r) {
      return r.ok ? r.json() : null;
    }).then(function (d) {
      if (!d || d.ok !== true || !Array.isArray(d.timeline)) return unavailable();
      paint(d.timeline);
    }).catch(function () { unavailable(); });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", load);
  } else {
    load();
  }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* ══ INSTALL + NOTIFICATIONS ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * Two jobs, and they are separate on purpose.
 *
 *   INSTALL      register the service worker so this page can be added to a
 *                home screen and opened with no browser bar. Runs on load.
 *   NOTIFICATIONS ask for permission and register the device. Runs ONLY after
 *                a deliberate tap.
 *
 * WHY THE PERMISSION ASK IS NEVER ON LOAD. A browser gives a site ONE
 * notification prompt, ever. Refuse it and there is no second ask — not next
 * week, not after a reinstall. The prompt is a one-shot resource, so it is spent
 * only when the client has read what it is for and pressed the button.
 *
 * WHY IPHONE IS ITS OWN BRANCH. On iPhone, web push works only on iOS 16.4 and
 * newer AND only after the page has been added to the home screen. Calling
 * Notification.requestPermission() in Safari before that THROWS. So an iPhone in
 * Safari is shown the add-to-home-screen steps and no button at all — offering a
 * button that throws would look like our bug and would teach the client the
 * feature is broken.
 *
 * AND THE VERSION IS READ BEFORE ANYTHING IS ASKED OF ANYBODY. An iPhone on
 * 16.0 to 16.3 is too old for push but new enough to look modern, and it used to
 * be handed the three add-to-home-screen steps and then, once it had done them,
 * an empty space where the card had been. Every iPhone this page cannot serve is
 * told so up front, in one sentence, whether it is installed or not.
 *
 * THE KILL SWITCH LIVES HERE TOO. Loading this page with ?push=off unregisters
 * every service worker on this origin and empties their caches. The other half
 * is KILL_SWITCH in client-portal-sw.js, which does the same thing from a single
 * deploy without anyone having to visit a URL.
 */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var SW_URL = "/app/client-portal-sw.js";
  /* SCOPE IS ONE PAGE, NOT THE WHOLE /app/ FOLDER, AND THAT IS THE SAFETY
     PROPERTY. Everything under /app/ is a staff CRM screen except this file. A
     worker scoped to "/app/" would sit in front of the entire CRM, and a bad one
     could not be fixed by deploying — the stale worker serves the page that
     would load the fix. Scoped to this one URL it can never touch a staff
     screen, and it can never see a request to /api/, because /api/ is not
     inside the scope. */
  var SW_SCOPE = "/app/client-portal.html";

  var card = document.getElementById("push-card");
  var copy = document.getElementById("push-copy");
  var steps = document.getElementById("push-steps");
  var btn = document.getElementById("push-btn");
  var statusEl = document.getElementById("push-status");
  var marketing = document.getElementById("push-marketing");
  var marketingLoading = document.getElementById("push-marketing-loading");
  var marketingCopy = document.getElementById("push-marketing-copy");
  var marketingBtn = document.getElementById("push-marketing-btn");
  if (!card || !btn) return;

  function say(text) { if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = text || ""; }
  function show(el, on) { if (el) el.hidden = !on; }

  function token() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; }
  }

  function api(path, options) {
    var init = options || {};
    init.headers = init.headers || {};
    init.headers["accept"] = "application/json";
    var t = token();
    if (t) init.headers["authorization"] = "Bearer " + t;
    if (init.body !== undefined) {
      init.headers["content-type"] = "application/json";
      init.body = JSON.stringify(init.body);
    }
    init.credentials = "same-origin";
    return fetch(path, init).then(function (r) {
      return r.json().then(
        function (b) { return { status: r.status, body: b }; },
        function () { return { status: r.status, body: null }; }
      );
    }, function () { return { status: 0, body: null }; });
  }

  var marketingDesired = null;
  function paintMarketing(state, detail) {
    show(marketing, true);
    show(marketingLoading, state === "loading");
    show(marketingCopy, state !== "loading");
    show(marketingBtn, state !== "loading");
    if (state === "empty") {
      marketingCopy.textContent = "Marketing updates are off. Turn them on for a few useful offers and call-prep notes. Email and text settings do not change.";
      marketingBtn.textContent = "Turn marketing updates on";
      marketingBtn.setAttribute("data-mode", "on");
    } else if (state === "full") {
      marketingCopy.textContent = "Marketing updates are on for this account. They reach only phones where you turned on Fundhub notifications. Email and text settings do not change.";
      marketingBtn.textContent = "Turn marketing updates off";
      marketingBtn.setAttribute("data-mode", "off");
    } else if (state === "error") {
      marketingCopy.textContent = detail || "We could not check your marketing updates. Please try again.";
      marketingBtn.textContent = "Try again";
      marketingBtn.setAttribute("data-mode", marketingDesired === null ? "retry-load" : "retry-save");
    }
  }

  function loadMarketingPreference() {
    marketingDesired = null;
    paintMarketing("loading");
    return api("/api/push/preferences").then(function (res) {
      if (res.status !== 200 || !res.body || res.body.ok !== true ||
          typeof res.body.marketing_push_enabled !== "boolean") {
        paintMarketing("error", (res.body && res.body.message) || null);
        return;
      }
      paintMarketing(res.body.marketing_push_enabled ? "full" : "empty");
    });
  }

  function saveMarketingPreference(enabled) {
    marketingDesired = enabled;
    paintMarketing("loading");
    return api("/api/push/preferences", {
      method: "PUT", body: { marketing_push_enabled: enabled }
    }).then(function (res) {
      if (res.status !== 200 || !res.body || res.body.ok !== true ||
          res.body.marketing_push_enabled !== enabled) {
        paintMarketing("error", (res.body && res.body.message) || "We could not save your choice. Please try again.");
        return;
      }
      marketingDesired = null;
      paintMarketing(enabled ? "full" : "empty");
    });
  }

  if (marketingBtn) {
    marketingBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var mode = marketingBtn.getAttribute("data-mode");
      marketingBtn.disabled = true;
      var job = mode === "retry-load" ? loadMarketingPreference()
        : saveMarketingPreference(mode === "retry-save" ? marketingDesired : mode === "on");
      Promise.resolve(job).then(function () { marketingBtn.disabled = false; });
    });
  }

  /* ── what kind of machine is this ───────────────────────────────────────── */
  var ua = navigator.userAgent || "";
  var isIOS = /iP(hone|od|ad)/.test(ua)
    /* An iPad on iPadOS 13+ reports itself as a Mac. The touch-point count is
       the only reliable way to tell it apart, and getting it wrong means an iPad
       user is offered a button that cannot work. */
    || (/Macintosh/.test(ua) && typeof navigator.maxTouchPoints === "number" && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);

  /* iOS 16.4 is the first version with web push at all. Below it the feature
     does not exist, home screen or not, and telling somebody to add an icon
     first is sending them on an errand that cannot work. */
  var PUSH_MIN = { major: 16, minor: 4 };

  function iosVersion() {
    /* Only an honest iOS user agent carries a version worth reading. An iPad on
       iPadOS 13+ says "Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7", and taking the 10 out
       of that would tell a current iPad it is nine years out of date. */
    if (!/iP(hone|od|ad)/.test(ua)) return null;
    var m = /OS (\d+)[._](\d+)/.exec(ua);
    return m ? { major: Number(m[1]), minor: Number(m[2]) } : null;
  }

  /* True only when we KNOW the version and know it is too old. An unreadable
     version is not a reason to tell somebody their phone is out of date. */
  function iosTooOldForPush() {
    if (!isIOS) return false;
    var v = iosVersion();
    if (!v) return false;
    return v.major < PUSH_MIN.major || (v.major === PUSH_MIN.major && v.minor < PUSH_MIN.minor);
  }

  function installed() {
    if (navigator.standalone === true) return true;           // iPhone / iPad
    try { return window.matchMedia("(display-mode: standalone)").matches; }
    catch (e) { return false; }
  }

  function deviceLabel() {
    if (/iPhone|iPod/.test(ua)) return "iphone";
    if (/iPad/.test(ua) || (isIOS && !/iPhone|iPod/.test(ua))) return "ipad";
    if (/Android/.test(ua)) return "android";
    return "desktop";
  }

  /* Browsers hand the VAPID key back as base64url text and want raw bytes. */
  function keyBytes(base64url) {
    var pad = "=".repeat((4 - (base64url.length % 4)) % 4);
    var b64 = (base64url + pad).replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
    var raw = atob(b64);
    var out = new Uint8Array(raw.length);
    for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) out[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
    return out;
  }

  /* ── the kill switch: /app/client-portal.html?push=off ───────────────────── */
  function killSwitchRequested() {
    try { return new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("push") === "off"; }
    catch (e) { return false; }
  }

  function tearEverythingDown() {
    var jobs = [];
    if ("serviceWorker" in navigator) {
      jobs.push(navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().then(function (regs) {
        return Promise.all(regs.map(function (r) { return r.unregister(); }));
      }).catch(function () {}));
    }
    if (window.caches && caches.keys) {
      jobs.push(caches.keys().then(function (names) {
        return Promise.all(names.map(function (n) { return caches.delete(n); }));
      }).catch(function () {}));
    }
    return Promise.all(jobs);
  }

  /* ── register the worker (install), separately from any permission ask ──── */
  function ensureWorker() {
    if (!("serviceWorker" in navigator)) return Promise.resolve(null);
    return navigator.serviceWorker.register(SW_URL, { scope: SW_SCOPE }).then(function (reg) {
      /* Ask the browser to re-check the worker file on every load. Without this
         a replaced worker — including the kill-switch version — can sit unnoticed
         behind the browser's own 24-hour check. */
      try { reg.update(); } catch (e) {}
      return reg;
    }).catch(function () { return null; });
  }

  /* ── paint ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function supported() {
    return ("serviceWorker" in navigator) && ("PushManager" in window) && ("Notification" in window);
  }

  /* THE OLD-IPHONE MESSAGE, AND WHY IT COMES FIRST.
     An iPhone on 16.0 to 16.3 used to be shown the three add-to-home-screen
     steps, because the only version check was "below 16". The client did the
     three taps, the page reloaded as an installed app, and the whole card then
     vanished with no message at all — because the installed path needs
     PushManager, which does not exist before 16.4. Three taps for nothing, then
     silence. So the version is checked BEFORE anybody is asked to do anything,
     and it is checked whether or not the app is already installed. */
  function paintIphoneTooOld() {
    show(card, true);
    show(btn, false);
    show(steps, false);
    // Honest and specific. "Your browser can't" would send them looking for a
    // different browser, and on iPhone every browser is Safari underneath.
    copy.textContent = "Notifications need iPhone software version 16.4 or newer. "
      + "This phone is on an older version, so it cannot show them yet. "
      + "Updating the phone's software is all it takes.";
    say("");
  }

  /* An iPhone new enough for push, in Safari, not yet on the home screen. */
  function paintIphoneNotInstalled() {
    show(card, true);
    show(btn, false);
    show(steps, true);
    copy.textContent = "iPhone only allows notifications once FundHub is on your home screen. "
      + "Three taps and you are done:";
  }

  /* Last resort on an iPhone: new enough by its user agent, installed, and the
     browser still has no push. Better a sentence than an empty space where a
     card was — the client has already been told to expect one. */
  function paintIphoneUnavailable() {
    show(card, true);
    show(btn, false);
    show(steps, false);
    copy.textContent = "This iPhone cannot show notifications yet. "
      + "They need iPhone software version 16.4 or newer, with FundHub opened from your home screen.";
    say("");
  }

  function paintReady(reg) {
    show(card, true);
    show(steps, false);
    copy.textContent = "Get a nudge when something on your file needs you. "
      + "No amounts, no card names — just a tap through to this page.";

    if (Notification.permission === "denied") {
      // Permanent from our side. Say so plainly rather than offering a button
      // that silently does nothing.
      show(btn, false);
      say("Notifications are blocked for this site. You can turn them back on in your browser's settings for fundhub.");
      return;
    }

    return reg.pushManager.getSubscription().then(function (sub) {
      if (sub) {
        btn.textContent = "Turn notifications off";
        btn.setAttribute("data-mode", "off");
        show(btn, true);
        say("Notifications are on for this device.");
      } else {
        btn.textContent = "Turn on notifications";
        btn.setAttribute("data-mode", "on");
        show(btn, true);
        say("");
      }
    });
  }

  /* ── the two actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function turnOn(reg) {
    say("Checking…");
    return api("/api/push/key").then(function (res) {
      if (res.status !== 200 || !res.body || res.body.ok !== true) {
        say("We could not switch notifications on just now. Please try again in a few minutes.");
        return null;
      }
      if (res.body.configured !== true || !res.body.public_key) {
        // Configuration is missing on the server. Do NOT spend the permission
        // prompt on a subscription we would then refuse to store.
        show(btn, false);
        say("Notifications are not switched on for this site yet.");
        return null;
      }
      return Notification.requestPermission().then(function (permission) {
        if (permission !== "granted") {
          say("You said no to notifications. Your browser will not ask again, so you would need to allow them in its settings.");
          return null;
        }
        return reg.pushManager.subscribe({
          // Required by every browser: a push must always show something the
          // person can see. Silent pushes are refused at subscribe time.
          userVisibleOnly: true,
          applicationServerKey: keyBytes(res.body.public_key)
        });
      });
    }).then(function (sub) {
      if (!sub) return;
      return api("/api/push/subscribe", {
        method: "POST",
        body: { subscription: sub.toJSON(), device_label: deviceLabel() }
      }).then(function (saved) {
        if (saved.status !== 200 && saved.status !== 201) {
          // Roll the browser side back so the two sides cannot disagree: a
          // subscription the phone holds and the server does not is a phone we
          // will never send to and a client who thinks we will.
          return sub.unsubscribe().catch(function () {}).then(function () {
            say((saved.body && saved.body.message) || "We could not switch notifications on just now.");
          });
        }
        btn.textContent = "Turn notifications off";
        btn.setAttribute("data-mode", "off");
        say("Notifications are on for this device.");
      });
    }).catch(function () {
      say("We could not switch notifications on just now. Please try again in a few minutes.");
    });
  }

  function turnOff(reg) {
    say("Turning off…");
    return reg.pushManager.getSubscription().then(function (sub) {
      var endpoint = sub ? sub.endpoint : "";
      var stop = sub ? sub.unsubscribe().catch(function () { return false; }) : Promise.resolve(true);
      return stop.then(function () {
        return api("/api/push/unsubscribe", {
          method: "POST",
          body: endpoint ? { endpoint: endpoint } : { all: true }
        });
      });
    }).then(function () {
      btn.textContent = "Turn on notifications";
      btn.setAttribute("data-mode", "on");
      say("Notifications are off for this device.");
    }).catch(function () {
      say("We could not switch notifications off just now. Please try again in a few minutes.");
    });
  }

  /* ── start ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function start() {
    if (killSwitchRequested()) {
      return tearEverythingDown().then(function () {
        show(card, true);
        show(btn, false);
        show(steps, false);
        copy.textContent = "Notifications and the offline copy of this page have been removed from this device.";
        say("");
      });
    }

    // Signed out: this card has nothing true to say, and registering a worker
    // for somebody who is not signed in gains nothing.
    if (!token()) return Promise.resolve();

    // This account-wide choice is separate from the current device's push
    // permission. It is off until the client deliberately turns it on.
    loadMarketingPreference();

    /* Version first. An iPhone that cannot do this at any point must never be
       sent to do the three taps, and must not be left with a blank space after
       it has done them. */
    if (iosTooOldForPush()) { paintIphoneTooOld(); return Promise.resolve(); }

    if (isIOS && !installed()) { paintIphoneNotInstalled(); return Promise.resolve(); }

    // Everything else, iPhone included once it is on the home screen.
    if (!supported()) {
      /* On a laptop or an Android with no push there is nothing the person can
         do about it, so the card stays away rather than showing a dead end. On
         an iPhone there is: it is a software update, and they have already read
         the card once. */
      if (isIOS) paintIphoneUnavailable();
      return Promise.resolve();
    }

    return ensureWorker().then(function (reg) {
      if (!reg) return;
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        btn.disabled = true;
        var mode = btn.getAttribute("data-mode");
        var job = mode === "off" ? turnOff(reg) : turnOn(reg);
        Promise.resolve(job).then(function () { btn.disabled = false; });
      });
      return paintReady(reg);
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", start);
  } else {
    start();
  }
})();
</script>

<!-- ══ REFER A FRIEND ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Reads /api/read/affiliate-portal on load, which answers
     {ok:true, enrolled:false, ...} with a 200 for a client who has never
     pressed the button (api/read/affiliate-portal.mjs:243-251) — so one read
     decides which half of the card to show, and a client who already has a
     link never sees a button that would do nothing.

     The press posts to /api/affiliates/refer. That endpoint is idempotent
     three ways over, so a double click, a retry, or the same person having
     already pressed the copy on /progress.html all return the SAME code.
     ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var READ_PATH  = "/api/read/affiliate-portal";
  var JOIN_PATH  = "/api/affiliates/refer";

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function show(el, on) { if (el) { if (on) el.removeAttribute("hidden"); else el.setAttribute("hidden", ""); } }

  /* Same key and same header shape as every other read on this page. */
  function token() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; }
  }

  function esc(v) {
    return String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c];
    });
  }

  /* THE READ DID NOT ANSWER. Say that and nothing else — never a link, never
     a count. A number here that came from a failed read is a number about
     somebody's money. */
  function failed(msg) {
    var card = $("ref-card"), err = $("ref-err");
    show($("ref-join"), false);
    show($("ref-have"), false);
    if (err) err.textContent = msg;
    show(err, true);
    show(card, true);
  }

  function paintRates(rates) {
    var el = $("ref-rates");
    if (!el || !rates) return;
    /* shapeTier returns null when no rule matches, and a min/max spread when
       the live rules disagree (affiliate-portal.mjs:178-206). Print only a
       single agreed percent; anything else prints nothing rather than picking
       a number out of a range. */
    function pct(t) {
      if (!t || typeof t.percent !== "number") return null;
      return t.percent;
    }
    var d = pct(rates.direct), n = pct(rates.downline);
    if (d == null && n == null) { el.textContent = ""; return; }
    var parts = [];
    if (d != null) parts.push(esc(d) + "% on anyone you send");
    if (n != null) parts.push(esc(n) + "% on anyone they send");
    el.textContent = parts.join(" \u00b7 ");
  }

  function paintEnrolled(d) {
    var a = d.affiliate || {};
    if (!a.shareUrl) {
      /* Enrolled, but the row carries no code. That is a broken join, not an
         empty state, and a blank box the client could copy is worse than a
         sentence saying so. */
      return failed("Your link is not ready yet. Say so in chat and we will sort it out.");
    }
    var url = $("ref-url");
    if (url) url.textContent = a.shareUrl;

    var refs = Array.isArray(d.referrals) ? d.referrals : [];
    /* Their own numbers count the DIRECT tier only. A downline row on this
       list was earned by somebody they recruited, and putting it under
       "People sent" would be claiming they sent someone they did not. */
    var direct = refs.filter(function (r) { return r && r.tier === "direct" && r.status !== "void"; });
    var signed = direct.filter(function (r) { return r.status === "converted" || r.status === "paid"; });
    if (direct.length) {
      var ns = $("ref-n-sent"), nc = $("ref-n-conv");
      if (ns) ns.textContent = String(direct.length);
      if (nc) nc.textContent = String(signed.length);
      show($("ref-stats"), true);
    }

    paintRates(d.rates);
    show($("ref-err"), false);
    show($("ref-join"), false);
    show($("ref-have"), true);
    show($("ref-card"), true);
  }

  function paintJoin() {
    show($("ref-err"), false);
    show($("ref-have"), false);
    show($("ref-join"), true);
    show($("ref-card"), true);
  }

  function load() {
    var t = token();
    if (!t) return;                      // signed out: not this card's message to write
    fetch(READ_PATH, {
      headers: { authorization: "Bearer " + t, accept: "application/json" },
      credentials: "same-origin"
    }).then(function (r) {
      return r.ok ? r.json() : null;
    }).then(function (d) {
      if (!d || d.ok !== true) {
        return failed("We could not load your referral link just now. Nothing is wrong with your "
                    + "account — this box did not load. Try again in a few minutes.");
      }
      return d.enrolled ? paintEnrolled(d) : paintJoin();
    }).catch(function () {
      failed("We could not load your referral link just now. Nothing is wrong with your "
           + "account — this box did not load. Try again in a few minutes.");
    });
  }

  function join() {
    var btn = $("ref-go");
    var t = token();
    if (!btn || !t) return;
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = "Getting your link\u2026";
    fetch(JOIN_PATH, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { authorization: "Bearer " + t, accept: "application/json" },
      credentials: "same-origin"
    }).then(function (r) {
      return r.ok ? r.json().catch(function () { return null; }) : null;
    }).then(function (d) {
      if (!d || d.ok !== true || !d.shareUrl) {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = "Get my link";
        var err = $("ref-err");
        if (err) {
          err.textContent = "That did not go through. Try once more, and if it still will not "
                          + "work say so in chat.";
          show(err, true);
        }
        return;
      }
      /* Re-read rather than painting from the POST. The POST knows the link;
         only the read knows the rates and the counts, and one painter for one
         card is one thing to keep right. */
      btn.textContent = "Get my link";
      btn.disabled = false;
      load();
      if (window.FHClientIOS && window.FHClientIOS.refreshAffiliate) window.FHClientIOS.refreshAffiliate();
    }).catch(function () {
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.textContent = "Get my link";
    });
  }

  function copy() {
    var url = $("ref-url"), btn = $("ref-copy");
    if (!url || !btn) return;
    var text = url.textContent || "";
    if (!text || text === "\u2014") return;

    function done() {
      btn.textContent = "Copied";
      setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = "Copy"; }, 1600);
    }

    /* navigator.clipboard is absent on an insecure origin and can be refused
       even on a secure one. The selection fallback is what makes this button
       work on an older phone browser instead of doing nothing silently. */
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(select);
      return;
    }
    select();

    function select() {
      try {
        var r = document.createRange();
        r.selectNodeContents(url);
        var sel = window.getSelection();
        sel.removeAllRanges();
        sel.addRange(r);
        btn.textContent = "Press copy";
        setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = "Copy"; }, 2400);
      } catch (e) { /* nothing left to try — the link is on screen to read */ }
    }
  }

  function start() {
    var go = $("ref-go"), cp = $("ref-copy");
    if (go) go.addEventListener("click", join);
    if (cp) cp.addEventListener("click", copy);
    load();
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", start);
  } else {
    start();
  }
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

     on the brand file's shadow list (fundhub-brand.css:130-137), so the

     `.app` the computed box-shadow was still
     `rgba(10,10,10,.04) 0 1px 2px, rgba(10,10,10,.06) 0 2px 8px` — the exact
     floating-smudge state §12.4 forbids, with the file claiming it was fixed.

     order decides. `.cockpit-main .panel` on line 344 is the same shape and is
     why that one has worked all along. */

        the dead px values are gone so the next reader is not misled.
