<script>


/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DEAL CALCULATORS  (deal-funding 1a + deal-math 1b)
   Formulas per fundhub-docs/sources/closer-dashboard-calculators.md.
   Card data is read from the table so the markup stays the single source.

   THIS BLOCK IS NOW THE FALLBACK, NOT THE ANSWER. Unchanged except for one
   guard at the top of recompute(). When the wiring below has real tradelines
   it sets window.__fhCloserLive and every number on the funding side comes
   from GET /api/read/tradelines — i.e. from src/calculators/deal-funding.mjs,
   the same calculator this block re-implements against the sample table. Two
   implementations of one waterfall that can disagree is the whole reason the
   endpoint returns `funding`. With no client id, no session, or no backend,
   this runs exactly as it always did and the screen still demonstrates itself.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function(){
"use strict";
var $=function(id){return document.getElementById(id);};
var num=function(t){var m=String(t).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'');return m?parseFloat(m):0;};
var usd=function(n){return '$'+Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US');};

/* ---- the five funding sources, straight out of the waterfall table ---- */
var CARDS=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('table.deal tr'))
  .filter(function(tr){return tr.querySelector('.apr-tag');})
  .map(function(tr,i){
    var td=tr.querySelectorAll('td');
    return {name:td[0].childNodes[0].textContent.trim(),
            apr:num(tr.querySelector('.apr-tag').textContent),
            limit:num(td[1].textContent), bal:num(td[2].textContent),
            head:num(td[3].textContent), drawCell:$('d'+i), minCell:$('p'+i), row:tr};
  });

var TOTAL_HEAD  = CARDS.reduce(function(a,c){return a+c.head;},0);   // 47,100
var TOTAL_LIMIT = CARDS.reduce(function(a,c){return a+c.limit;},0);  // 76,000
var TOTAL_BAL   = CARDS.reduce(function(a,c){return a+c.bal;},0);    // 28,900

/* ---- waterfall: lowest APR first until the request is filled ---- */
function allocate(draw){
  var order=CARDS.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.apr-b.apr;});
  var rem=draw, out=[];
  order.forEach(function(c){
    var d=Math.max(0,Math.min(c.head,rem)); rem-=d;
    out.push({card:c,draw:d});
  });
  return out;
}

/* ---- cliff: first month the balance exceeds the original draw when the
        client pays only the minimum (minPct of the current balance). It only
        happens on cards whose APR/12 outruns minPct. ---- */
function cliffMonth(alloc,draw,minPct){
  var bal=alloc.map(function(a){return a.draw;});
  if(draw<=0) return null;
  for(var n=1;n<=360;n++){
    var tot=0;
    for(var i=0;i<alloc.length;i++){
      var r=alloc[i].card.apr/100/12;
      bal[i]=bal[i]*(1+r)-bal[i]*(minPct/100);
      if(bal[i]<0) bal[i]=0;
      tot+=bal[i];
    }
    if(tot>draw) return n;
  }
  return null;
}

/* ---- total interest paid under minimum-only, over N months ---- */
function minInterest(alloc,minPct,months){
  var total=0;
  alloc.forEach(function(a){
    var b=a.draw, r=a.card.apr/100/12;
    for(var n=0;n<months;n++){
      var i=b*r; total+=i;
      b=b+i-b*(minPct/100);
      if(b<0.01){b=0;break;}
    }
  });
  return total;
}

function recompute(){
  /* Live data is on screen: leave it alone. The listeners below still fire —
     they keep the draw box and the slider in step — but the sample math must
     not overwrite an API answer with numbers scraped out of the sample table. */
  if(window.__fhCloserLive) return;
  if(!CARDS.length) return;
  var draw    = Math.max(0,Math.min(TOTAL_HEAD, num($('iDraw').value)));
  var guard   = Math.max(1,num($('iGuard').value)||30);
  var deposit = num($('iDeposit').value);
  var feePct  = num($('iFee').value);
  var debts   = num($('iDebts').value);
  var minPct  = Math.max(0.25,num($('iMin').value)||3);

  var alloc=allocate(draw);
  var drawn=alloc.reduce(function(a,x){return a+x.draw;},0);

  /* ---------- 1a: waterfall ---------- */
  alloc.forEach(function(a){
    a.card.drawCell.textContent = a.draw ? Math.round(a.draw).toLocaleString('en-US') : '—';
    a.card.row.classList.toggle('unused', a.draw===0);
    a.card.minCell.textContent = a.draw ? usd(a.draw*minPct/100) : '—';
  });
  $('oCredit').textContent = usd(TOTAL_HEAD);
  $('oDrawn').textContent  = Math.round(drawn).toLocaleString('en-US');
  $('oLeft').textContent   = 'Total drawn · '+usd(TOTAL_HEAD-drawn)+' headroom left';

  /* ---------- utilisation + guardrail ---------- */
  var util = TOTAL_LIMIT ? (TOTAL_BAL+drawn)/TOTAL_LIMIT*100 : 0;
  $('oUtil').innerHTML = 'Utilisation after draw <b>'+util.toFixed(0)+'%</b> of '+
    usd(TOTAL_LIMIT)+' total limit · threshold '+guard.toFixed(0)+'%';
  var gb=$('guardBox');
  if(util>guard){
    gb.className='alert-box';
    $('guardTitle').textContent='⛔ Pre-Approval Guardrail — Hard Stop';
    $('guardBody').innerHTML='This draw pushes <b>'+util.toFixed(0)+'%</b> of their total credit line, above the '+
      guard.toFixed(0)+'% threshold. That’s enough to drop their score and jeopardize <b>Round 2</b>. '+
      'Draw less, or tell them what this does to their score before they sign.';
  }else{
    gb.className='alert-box clear';
    $('guardTitle').textContent='✓ Pre-Approval Guardrail — Clear';
    $('guardBody').innerHTML='This draw sits at <b>'+util.toFixed(0)+'%</b> utilisation, under the '+
      guard.toFixed(0)+'% threshold. Round 2 is not at risk from this draw.';
  }

  /* ---------- pay-method comparison ---------- */
  var blended = drawn ? alloc.reduce(function(a,x){return a+x.draw*x.card.apr;},0)/drawn : 0;
  [12,24,36].forEach(function(mo){
    $('m'+mo).textContent = usd(minInterest(alloc,minPct,mo));
    $('i'+mo).textContent = usd(drawn*blended/100*(mo/12)) + (mo===36?' + balloon':'');
  });

  /* ---------- 1b: net cash + monthly ---------- */
  var fees = deposit + drawn*feePct/100;
  $('oFunded').textContent = usd(drawn);
  $('oFeeLabel').textContent = 'Deposit + '+(feePct%1?feePct:feePct.toFixed(0))+'% Success Fee';
  $('oFees').textContent  = '−'+usd(fees);
  $('oDebts').textContent = '−'+usd(debts);
  $('oNet').textContent   = usd(drawn-fees-debts);

  var monthly = drawn*minPct/100;
  $('oMonthly').textContent = usd(monthly)+' / mo';

  /* ---------- cliff ---------- */
  var cm=cliffMonth(alloc,drawn,minPct), cb=$('cliffBox');
  if(cm===null){
    cb.className='alert-box clear';
    $('cliffTitle').textContent='✓ No Negative-Amortization Cliff';
    $('cliffBody').innerHTML='At <b>'+minPct+'%</b> minimum payments ('+usd(monthly)+'/mo) every drawn card '+
      'amortises down — the minimum covers the interest on all five. Their balance never exceeds the '+
      usd(drawn)+' they drew. Blended APR '+blended.toFixed(2)+'%.';
  }else{
    var inside = cm<=18;
    cb.className = inside?'alert-box':'alert-box warn';
    $('cliffTitle').textContent='⚠ Negative-Amortization Cliff Flagged';
    $('cliffBody').innerHTML='At minimum-only payments of <b>'+minPct+'%</b> ('+usd(monthly)+'/mo), their '+
      'outstanding balance exceeds the original draw by <b>Month '+cm+'</b>'+
      (inside?' — inside the 18-month flag threshold':' — outside the 18-month flag threshold')+
      '. Change the plan, or tell them now — not after the money lands. This is the number that prevents '+
      'a refund request six months from now.';
  }
}

/* draw box and slider stay in step */
$('iDraw').addEventListener('input',function(){ $('iDrawRange').value=$('iDraw').value; recompute(); });
$('iDrawRange').addEventListener('input',function(){ $('iDraw').value=$('iDrawRange').value; recompute(); });
['iGuard','iDeposit','iFee','iDebts','iMin'].forEach(function(id){
  $(id).addEventListener('input',recompute);
});
if(CARDS.length){
  $('iDrawRange').max=TOTAL_HEAD;
  recompute();
}
})();
</script>

<script defer src="data.js"></script>
<script>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   VIEW MODEL — a VERBATIM COPY of src/http/closer-dashboard-view.mjs.

   There is no bundler in this repo and a <script> cannot import from src/, so
   the page carries its own copy. It is not on trust: src/http/
   closer-dashboard-view.test.mjs extracts everything between the two markers
   below, runs it in a vm, and pushes the same fixtures through both this copy
   and the module, asserting deep-equal output. Edit one, edit the other, or the
   suite goes red. Every comment explaining WHY a rule is what it is lives in
   the module; this copy is deliberately kept thin.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
/* FH-VIEW-BEGIN */
window.FHCloserView = (function () {
  "use strict";

  function num(v) {
    if (v == null || v === "") return null;
    var n = typeof v === "number" ? v : Number(v);
    return isFinite(n) ? n : null;
  }

  function round2(n) {
    return n == null ? null : Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
  }

  function esc(v) {
    return String(v == null ? "" : v)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
  }

  /* NULL MEANS UNKNOWN AND MUST NOT BECOME $0. */
  function usd(v) {
    var n = num(v);
    return n == null ? "—" : "$" + Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US");
  }

  function numText(v) {
    var n = num(v);
    return n == null ? "—" : Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US");
  }

  /* A FRACTION (0.1499) as a percentage ("14.99%") — the one place APR stops
     being a fraction. */
  function pctText(v, dp) {
    var n = num(v);
    return n == null ? "—" : (n * 100).toFixed(dp == null ? 0 : dp) + "%";
  }

  function classify(res, opts) {
    var o = opts || {};
    var clientId = o.clientId;
    var S = "deal calculators — ";

    if (!clientId) {
      return { mode: "sample", tone: "sample",
        text: S + "open this screen with ?client_id=<uuid> to load a real client" };
    }

    if (!res || res.ok !== true) {
      var source = (res && res.source) || "unknown";
      var detail = (res && res.error) || "no detail";
      if (source === "demo") {
        return { mode: "sample", tone: "sample", text: S + "demo session, the backend was not queried" };
      }
      if (source === "unauthorized") {
        return { mode: "sample", tone: "error",
          text: S + "not signed in (401) — sign in to load this client's tradelines. The backend is up." };
      }
      if (source === "offline") {
        return { mode: "sample", tone: "error",
          text: S + "GET /api/read/tradelines did not answer (" + detail +
                ") — the endpoint is not deployed or not routed. This is not a sign-in problem." };
      }
      if (source === "nodb") {
        return { mode: "sample", tone: "error",
          text: S + "the API answered but the database did not (" + detail + ")" };
      }
      if (source === "notfound") {
        return { mode: "sample", tone: "sample",
          text: S + "the backend is up and has no client with that id" };
      }
      if (source === "badrequest") {
        return { mode: "sample", tone: "sample",
          text: S + "the request was rejected (" + detail + ")" };
      }
      if (source === "nodata") {
        return { mode: "sample", tone: "sample", text: S + "no client id to ask about" };
      }
      return { mode: "sample", tone: "error",
        text: S + "the tradeline read failed (" + source + ": " + detail + ")" };
    }

    var body = res.data || {};
    var rows = Array.isArray(body.data) ? body.data : [];
    if (!rows.length) {
      return { mode: "empty", tone: "sample",
        text: "no tradelines on file for this client — funding numbers stay dashes" };
    }

    var funding = body.funding || {};
    var alloc = funding.allocation || null;
    var drawable = alloc && Array.isArray(alloc.draws) ? alloc.draws.length : null;
    if (drawable === 0) {
      return { mode: "empty", tone: "sample",
        text: rows.length + " tradeline(s) on file for this client, none of them drawable " +
              "(installment, closed, or no credit limit recorded) — funding numbers stay dashes" };
    }

    return { mode: "live", tone: "real", text: null };
  }

  function buildView(payload) {
    var body = payload || {};
    var stored = Array.isArray(body.data) ? body.data : [];
    var funding = body.funding || {};
    var alloc = funding.allocation || null;
    var guard = funding.guardrail || null;
    var pm = funding.payMethodComparison || null;
    var draws = alloc && Array.isArray(alloc.draws) ? alloc.draws : [];

    var rows = draws.map(function (d) {
      var apr = num(d.apr);
      var draw = num(d.draw);
      var drawn = draw != null && draw > 0;
      return {
        lender: d.lender == null || d.lender === "" ? "(no lender recorded)" : String(d.lender),
        /* An unpriced card is NOT a 0% card. */
        aprText: apr == null ? "APR not on file" : pctText(apr, 2) + " APR",
        aprOnly: apr == null ? "—" : pctText(apr, 2),
        limitText: numText(d.creditLimit),
        balanceText: numText(d.currentBalance),
        headroomText: numText(d.availableHeadroom),
        drawText: drawn ? numText(draw) : "—",
        unused: !drawn,
        minPaymentText: "—"
      };
    });

    var totalAvailable = num(funding.totalAvailableCredit);
    var totalDrawn = alloc ? num(alloc.totalDrawn) : null;
    var requested = alloc ? num(alloc.requestedAmount) : null;
    var shortfall = alloc ? num(alloc.shortfall) : null;
    var headroomLeft = (totalAvailable != null && totalDrawn != null)
      ? round2(totalAvailable - totalDrawn) : null;

    var totalLimit = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < draws.length; i++) {
      var lim = num(draws[i].creditLimit);
      if (lim != null) totalLimit = (totalLimit == null ? 0 : totalLimit) + lim;
    }

    var utilizationHtml = guard
      ? "Utilisation after draw <b>" + pctText(guard.aggregateUtilization, 0) + "</b> of " +
        usd(round2(totalLimit)) + " total limit · threshold " + pctText(guard.threshold, 0)
      : "Utilisation not computed — the response carried no guardrail";

    var guardrail = null;
    if (guard) {
      if (guard.hardStop) {
        guardrail = {
          cls: "alert-box",
          title: "⛔ Pre-Approval Guardrail — Hard Stop",
          bodyHtml: guard.message
            ? esc(guard.message)
            : "This draw crosses the " + pctText(guard.threshold, 0) + " utilisation threshold."
        };
      } else if (guard.message) {
        guardrail = {
          cls: "alert-box warn",
          title: "⚠ Pre-Approval Guardrail — Pre-Existing Utilisation",
          bodyHtml: esc(guard.message)
        };
      } else {
        guardrail = {
          cls: "alert-box clear",
          title: "✓ Pre-Approval Guardrail — Clear",
          bodyHtml: "This draw sits at <b>" + pctText(guard.aggregateUtilization, 0) +
            "</b> utilisation, under the " + pctText(guard.threshold, 0) +
            " threshold. Round 2 is not at risk from this draw."
        };
      }
    }

    var payMethods = null;
    if (pm && Array.isArray(pm.horizons)) {
      payMethods = {};
      pm.horizons.forEach(function (h) {
        var months = num(h && h.months);
        if (months == null) return;
        var io = usd(h.interestOnly && h.interestOnly.totalInterest);
        payMethods[months] = {
          lump: usd(h.lumpSum && h.lumpSum.totalInterest),
          min: usd(h.minPayments && h.minPayments.totalInterest),
          io: months === 36 && io !== "—" ? io + " + balloon" : io
        };
      });
    }

    var cardCount = stored.length;
    var drawableCount = draws.length;

    return {
      cardCount: cardCount,
      drawableCount: drawableCount,
      excludedCount: Math.max(0, cardCount - drawableCount),
      totalAvailable: totalAvailable,
      totalAvailableText: usd(totalAvailable),
      /* Two forms of one number, never two numbers. */
      totalDrawnText: numText(totalDrawn),
      totalDrawnUsd: usd(totalDrawn),
      requestedText: requested == null ? null : usd(requested),
      shortfall: shortfall,
      shortfallText: usd(shortfall),
      fullyFunded: alloc ? alloc.fullyFunded === true : null,
      headroomLeftLabel: "Total drawn · " + usd(headroomLeft) + " headroom left",
      rows: rows,
      utilizationHtml: utilizationHtml,
      guardrail: guardrail,
      payMethods: payMethods,
      drawMax: totalAvailable
    };
  }

  /* Everything on this screen GET /api/read/tradelines cannot answer. Named in
     the banner, because a sample number beside live ones is indistinguishable
     from a real one. Same treatment as "Worked" on inquiry-remover. */
  /* "today's pipeline" and "the shift stats" were in this sentence until
     2026-08-30. Both tiles were cut from the screen on 2026-08-17 and the
     honesty test now forbids their return, so naming them read as a promise. */
  var NOT_SOURCED =
    "not sourced yet: the Deal Math panel " +
    "(net cash, monthly obligation, negative-amortization cliff) and the per-card minimums";

  function bannerText(view) {
    var v = view || {};
    var bits = ["live tradelines · " + v.cardCount + (v.cardCount === 1 ? " line" : " lines") + " on file"];
    if (v.excludedCount > 0) {
      bits.push(v.excludedCount + " not drawable (installment, closed or no limit on file)");
    }
    bits.push(v.totalAvailableText + " available");
    if (v.requestedText) bits.push("requested " + v.requestedText + " · allocated " + v.totalDrawnUsd);
    if (v.shortfall != null && v.shortfall > 0) bits.push("shortfall " + v.shortfallText);
    bits.push(NOT_SOURCED);
    return bits.join(" · ");
  }

  return {
    esc: esc, usd: usd, numText: numText, pctText: pctText,
    classify: classify, buildView: buildView, bannerText: bannerText,
    NOT_SOURCED: NOT_SOURCED
  };
})();
/* FH-VIEW-END */
</script>

<script>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   WIRING — GET /api/read/tradelines?client_id=<uuid> becomes the funding side
   of this screen. DOM writes only; every decision above this line is in
   FHCloserView, which is unit-tested.

   THREE RULES, IN THE ORDER THEY MATTER:

   1. NO CLIENT ID IS HONEST EMPTY. The calculators stay hidden and the screen
      says "Open from a client." It does not keep a sample person on the page.
   2. A LIVE SCREEN NEVER REVERTS. Once real figures are painted, a failed
      refresh keeps them and reports the failure. The last audit found seven
      screens that fell back to sample on the first keystroke under a green
      badge; that is worse than not wiring them.
   3. NOTHING IS INVENTED. Deal math, per-card minimums, today's pipeline and
      the shift stats have no source here. They stay dashes, not fake dollars.

   AND WHY THE WHOLE BLOCK WAITS FOR DOMContentLoaded:

   data.js carries `defer` (its tag is right above this one), so window.FHData
   does not exist yet while this inline block is being PARSED. The guard a few
   lines down — `if (!window.FHData || !window.FHCloserView) return;` — therefore
   fired on every single load and returned before anything asked the server for
   this client's figures. Proven live 2026-08-18: the five result boxes read
   "—" and the screen made four requests, none of them for deal data.

   Every deferred script runs BEFORE DOMContentLoaded, so waiting for that event
   is what lets the guard see the loaded FHData instead of an empty window. Same
   fix and same reason as public/app/client-control-panel.html:669-675. Do not
   remove `defer` and do not add a loader — the ordering is already guaranteed.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  "use strict";

  function tickClock() {
    var el = document.querySelector(".clock");
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", {
      weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric",
      hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit",
      timeZone: "America/Phoenix", timeZoneName: "short"
    });
  }
  tickClock();
  setInterval(tickClock, 1000);

  if (!window.FHData || !window.FHCloserView) return;

  var V = window.FHCloserView;
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  // client_id is what the endpoint calls it; ?id=, ?client= and ?contact= are
  // accepted too, so a link copied from any other screen still lands here.
  var clientId = FHData.param("client_id") || FHData.param("id") ||
    FHData.param("client") || FHData.param("contact");

  var panels = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".calc-panel"));
  var dealTable = document.querySelector("table.deal");
  var seq = 0, timer = null, live = false, marked = false, lastDrawn = 0;

  function busy(on) {
    panels.forEach(function (p) {
      if (on) p.setAttribute("data-fh-busy", "1"); else p.removeAttribute("data-fh-busy");
    });
  }

  function cell(text, id) {
    var td = document.createElement("td");
    td.textContent = text;          // lender names are record data, never markup
    if (id) td.id = id;
    return td;
  }

  function tableByFirstHeader(want) {
    var ts = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("table.pm"));
    for (var i = 0; i < ts.length; i++) {
      var th = ts[i].querySelector("th");
      if (th && th.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() === want) return ts[i];
    }
    return null;
  }

  function subHeading(tag) {
    var subs = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".bd-sub"));
    for (var i = 0; i < subs.length; i++) {
      if (subs[i].textContent.indexOf(tag) === 0) return subs[i];
    }
    return null;
  }

  /* CD-02a. Rebuilt from funding.allocation.draws — lender, limit, balance,
     headroom and draw all arrive computed, in the calculator's own draw order.
     The sample rows are dropped; the header and the totals row are not. */
  function renderWaterfall(view) {
    if (!dealTable) return;
    var totalRow = dealTable.querySelector("tr.total");
    if (!totalRow) return;
    var parent = totalRow.parentNode;
    [].slice.call(dealTable.querySelectorAll("tr")).forEach(function (tr) {
      if (tr.hasAttribute("data-fh-row") || tr.querySelector(".apr-tag")) tr.remove();
    });

    if (!view.rows.length) {
      var er = document.createElement("tr");
      er.setAttribute("data-fh-row", "");
      var td = document.createElement("td");
      td.colSpan = 5;
      var sp = document.createElement("span");
      sp.className = "empty-slot";
      sp.textContent = "No drawable credit lines on file for this client.";
      td.appendChild(sp);
      er.appendChild(td);
      parent.insertBefore(er, totalRow);
      return;
    }

    view.rows.forEach(function (r, i) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.setAttribute("data-fh-row", "");
      if (r.unused) tr.className = "unused";
      var first = document.createElement("td");
      first.appendChild(document.createTextNode(r.lender + " "));
      var tag = document.createElement("span");
      tag.className = "apr-tag";
      tag.textContent = r.aprText;
      first.appendChild(tag);
      tr.appendChild(first);
      tr.appendChild(cell(r.limitText));
      tr.appendChild(cell(r.balanceText));
      tr.appendChild(cell(r.headroomText));
      tr.appendChild(cell(r.drawText, "d" + i));
      parent.insertBefore(tr, totalRow);
    });
  }

  /* CD-03. Minimum-payment and interest-only cells carry ids; the lump-sum row
     does not, so it is found by its own label rather than by position. */
  function renderPayMethods(view) {
    var lumpRow = null;
    var t = tableByFirstHeader("method");
    if (t) {
      var trs = [].slice.call(t.querySelectorAll("tr"));
      for (var i = 0; i < trs.length; i++) {
        var td = trs[i].querySelector("td");
        if (td && td.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() === "lump sum") { lumpRow = trs[i]; break; }
      }
    }
    [12, 24, 36].forEach(function (m, idx) {
      var v = view.payMethods ? view.payMethods[m] : null;
      var minCell = $("m" + m), ioCell = $("i" + m);
      if (minCell) minCell.textContent = v ? v.min : "—";
      if (ioCell) ioCell.textContent = v ? v.io : "—";
      if (lumpRow) {
        var cells = lumpRow.querySelectorAll("td");
        if (cells[idx + 1]) cells[idx + 1].textContent = v ? v.lump : "—";
      }
    });
  }

  /* D-04. Lender and APR are real; the minimum payment is NOT — the endpoint
     takes no minimum-payment percentage, so nothing in the response is that
     number. Blanked rather than carried over from a sample row belonging to a
     different card, which is the precedent the unmapped status pills on
     inquiry-remover set. */
  function renderMinTable(view) {
    var t = tableByFirstHeader("card");
    if (!t) return;
    var head = t.querySelector("tr");
    var host = (head && head.parentNode) || t;
    [].slice.call(t.querySelectorAll("tr")).forEach(function (tr) {
      if (tr.hasAttribute("data-fh-row") || tr.querySelector("td")) tr.remove();
    });
    view.rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.setAttribute("data-fh-row", "");
      tr.appendChild(cell(r.lender));
      tr.appendChild(cell(r.aprOnly));
      tr.appendChild(cell(r.minPaymentText));
      host.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  /* Rule 3, in the UI rather than in a code comment. Runs once, the first time
     real figures land, because that is the moment a sample number beside them
     starts reading as real. */
  function markUnsourced() {
    if (marked) return;
    marked = true;

    // Tradelines are not a client record. Do not invent a name for this file.
    var titles = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".section-title"));
    for (var i = 0; i < titles.length; i++) {
      if (titles[i].textContent.indexOf("Deal Calculators") >= 0) {
        titles[i].textContent = "Deal Calculators";
      }
    }

    var note = document.querySelector(".res-note");
    if (note) {
      note.textContent = "Net cash and monthly use the deposit, fee, debts, and minimum you type, plus the drawn amount from this file.";
    }
    var d03 = subHeading("D-03b");
    if (d03) d03.textContent = "D-03b / How the net cash is arrived at";
    var d04 = subHeading("D-04");
    if (d04) d04.textContent = "D-04 / Minimum payment, card by card — the minimum has no API source";

    var cliffBox = $("cliffBox");
    if (cliffBox) cliffBox.className = "alert-box warn";
    var cliffTitle = $("cliffTitle");
    if (cliffTitle) cliffTitle.textContent = "⚠ Negative-Amortization Cliff — not computed";
    var cliffBody = $("cliffBody");
    if (cliffBody) {
      cliffBody.textContent = "Not computed for this client. No endpoint returns deal math.";
    }
  }

  function renderLenderMatches(payload) {
    var el = $("oLenderMatches");
    var note = $("oLenderMatchesNote");
    if (!el) return;
    if (!payload || payload.ok !== true) {
      el.textContent = "—";
      if (note) note.textContent = "Could not load lender matches";
      return;
    }
    var n = payload.match_count;
    el.textContent = (n == null ? "—" : String(n));
    if (note) {
      if (n === 0) {
        note.textContent = payload.summary && payload.summary.lender_count === 0
          ? "Lender list is empty — import CSV on Lenders"
          : "No lenders fit this client's state / inquiry profile";
      } else {
        note.textContent = n + " lender" + (n === 1 ? "" : "s") +
          " fit (state + inquiry sensitivity + bureau rotation)";
      }
    }
  }

  function loadLenderMatches() {
    if (!clientId || !window.FHData || typeof FHData.read !== "function") return Promise.resolve();
    return FHData.read("lender-matches", { client_id: clientId }).then(function (res) {
      renderLenderMatches(res && res.data ? res.data : res);
    }).catch(function () {
      renderLenderMatches(null);
    });
  }

  function render(view) {
    var credit = $("oCredit");
    if (credit) credit.textContent = view.totalAvailableText;
    renderWaterfall(view);
    var drawn = $("oDrawn");
    if (drawn) drawn.textContent = view.totalDrawnText;
    var left = $("oLeft");
    if (left) left.textContent = view.headroomLeftLabel;
    // Digits and symbols only — see buildView; no record data reaches innerHTML.
    var util = $("oUtil");
    if (util) util.innerHTML = view.utilizationHtml;
    if (view.guardrail) {
      var box = $("guardBox"), title = $("guardTitle"), body = $("guardBody");
      if (box) box.className = view.guardrail.cls;
      if (title) title.textContent = view.guardrail.title;
      if (body) body.innerHTML = view.guardrail.bodyHtml;
    }
    renderPayMethods(view);
    renderMinTable(view);
    var range = $("iDrawRange");
    if (range && view.drawMax != null) range.max = Math.round(view.drawMax);
    var drawnN = Number(String(view.totalDrawnText || "").replace(/,/g, ""));
    lastDrawn = Number.isFinite(drawnN) ? drawnN : 0;
    markUnsourced();
    askDealMath();
  }

  function requestParams() {
    var p = { client_id: clientId };
    var draw = Number($("iDraw").value);
    var guard = Number($("iGuard").value);
    if (isFinite(draw) && draw >= 0) p.requested_amount = draw;
    // The API wants a FRACTION (0.30); the box is a percentage, per the design.
    if (isFinite(guard) && guard > 0) p.utilization_threshold = guard / 100;
    return p;
  }

  function failed(res, decision) {
    if (live) {
      FHData.banner("error", "these are the last figures that loaded — the refresh failed (" +
        ((res && res.source) || "unknown") + "), so the boxes above no longer describe them",
        "tradelines");
      return;
    }
    FHData.banner(decision.tone, decision.text, "tradelines");
  }

  function load(isRefresh) {
    var mine = ++seq;
    busy(true);
    if (!isRefresh) {
      FHData.banner("sample", "loading tradelines for client " + clientId + " …", "tradelines");
    }
    return FHData.read("tradelines", requestParams()).then(function (res) {
      if (mine !== seq) return;   // a later keystroke already asked; that answer wins
      busy(false);
      var decision = V.classify(res, { clientId: clientId });
      if (decision.mode !== "live") { failed(res, decision); return; }
      var view = V.buildView(res.data);
      render(view);
      live = true;
      window.__fhCloserLive = true;   // stands the sample calculators down
      FHData.banner("real", V.bannerText(view), "tradelines");
      loadLenderMatches();
    }).catch(function (e) {
      // FHData never rejects, but the contract holding is not the same as this
      // screen surviving if it stops holding.
      if (mine !== seq) return;
      busy(false);
      failed({ source: "render", error: (e && e.message) || "read failed" },
        { tone: "error", text: "deal calculators — the tradeline read threw (" +
          ((e && e.message) || "unknown") + ")" });
    });
  }

  function moneyDeal(n) {
    if (n == null || !Number.isFinite(Number(n))) return "—";
    var sign = n < 0 ? "−" : "";
    return sign + "$" + Math.abs(Math.round(n)).toLocaleString("en-US");
  }

  function askDealMath() {
    if (!window.FHData || !clientId) return;
    var deposit = Number($("iDeposit") && $("iDeposit").value);
    var fee = Number($("iFee") && $("iFee").value);
    var debts = Number($("iDebts") && $("iDebts").value);
    var min = Number($("iMin") && $("iMin").value);
    FHData.read("deal-math", {
      deposit: isFinite(deposit) ? deposit : 0,
      fee: isFinite(fee) ? fee : 0,
      debts: isFinite(debts) ? debts : 0,
      min: isFinite(min) && min > 0 ? min : 3,
      drawn: lastDrawn
    }).then(function (res) {
      if (!res || !res.ok || !res.data) return;
      var d = res.data;
      if ($("oNet")) $("oNet").textContent = moneyDeal(d.net);
      if ($("oMonthly")) $("oMonthly").textContent = moneyDeal(d.monthly) + " / mo";
      if ($("oFunded")) $("oFunded").textContent = moneyDeal(d.drawn);
      if ($("oFees")) $("oFees").textContent = "−" + moneyDeal(d.fees).replace(/^−/, "");
      if ($("oDebts")) $("oDebts").textContent = "−" + moneyDeal(d.debts).replace(/^−/, "");
      var note = document.querySelector(".res-note");
      if (note) {
        note.textContent = "Net cash and monthly use the deposit, fee, debts, and minimum you type, plus the drawn amount from this file.";
      }
    });
  }

  if (!clientId) {
    var gate = document.getElementById("calcGate");
    var grid = document.getElementById("calcGrid");
    var br = document.getElementById("breakdown");
    if (gate) gate.hidden = false;
    if (grid) grid.hidden = true;
    if (br) br.hidden = true;
    FHData.banner("sample", "Open from a client.", "tradelines");
    return;
  }

  /* A new draw or threshold is a new question for the calculator, not a new
     browser computation: re-ask the endpoint, debounced. */
  function schedule() {
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(function () { timer = null; load(true); }, 300);
  }
  ["iDraw", "iDrawRange", "iGuard"].forEach(function (id) {
    var el = $(id);
    if (el) el.addEventListener("input", schedule);
  });
  ["iDeposit", "iFee", "iDebts", "iMin"].forEach(function (id) {
    var el = $(id);
    if (el) el.addEventListener("input", askDealMath);
  });
  askDealMath();

  load(false);
  loadLenderMatches();
});
</script>
<script src="contract-send.js"></script>
<script src="closer-call.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

            accept=".pdf,.txt,.md,.docx,.xlsx,.pptx,application/pdf,text/plain,text/markdown,application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document,application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet,application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation">

  if(side&&b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){side.classList.toggle('mini');b.textContent=side.classList.contains('mini')?'››':'‹‹';});}

<script defer src="data.js"></script>
<script src="ramp-quizzes.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ── escaping ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     Every value that comes back from the API goes through esc() before it
     touches innerHTML. No exceptions. */
  var esc = function (v) {
    return String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;" }[c]; });
  };

  var chatEl      = document.getElementById("chat");
  var railEl      = document.getElementById("rail");
  var threadList  = document.getElementById("threadList");
  var msgsEl      = document.getElementById("msgs");
  var chatTitle   = document.getElementById("chatTitle");
  var rolePill    = document.getElementById("rolePill");
  var docsEl      = document.getElementById("docs");
  var docList     = document.getElementById("docList");
  var reviewPanel = document.getElementById("reviewPanel");
  var reviewList  = document.getElementById("reviewList");
  var pendPill    = document.getElementById("pendPill");
  var pendPill2   = document.getElementById("pendPill2");
  var ta          = document.getElementById("q");
  var askBtn      = document.getElementById("askBtn");
  var attachBtn   = document.getElementById("attachBtn");
  var fileInput   = document.getElementById("fileInput");

  /* ── session, exactly as this screen already did it ─────────────────── */
  function token() { try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; } }
  function isDemo() { try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_demo") === "1"; } catch (e) { return false; } }
  function role() {
    try {
      var cached = localStorage.getItem("fh_role");
      if (cached) return cached;
      var s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("fh_session") || "null");
      return (s && (s.role || (s.staff && s.staff.role))) || "";
    } catch (e) { return ""; }
  }

  var myRole = String(role() || "").toLowerCase();
  if (rolePill) rolePill.textContent = myRole || "staff";
  var isOwner = myRole === "owner";

  /* ── plain-English errors. A person never sees a status code. ───────── */
  var WORDS = {
    forbidden_role: "Your role is not allowed to use Company Brain.",
    no_org_scope: "Your account is not tied to a company yet, so there is nothing to search.",
    method_not_allowed: "That action is not allowed here.",
    no_file: "No file was picked.",
    empty_file: "That file has nothing in it.",
    file_too_large: "That file is too big. Files have to be under 25 MB.",
    unsupported_file_type: "Company Brain cannot read that kind of file. Use a PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or a plain text file.",
    embed_failed: "The file went up, but Company Brain could not read it. Try again in a minute.",
    invalid_thread_id: "That chat link is broken.",
    thread_not_found: "That chat is gone.",
    not_found: "We could not find that.",
    not_pending: "Someone already decided on this one."
  };
  function friendly(j) {
    if (j && j.demo) return "Demo mode is on, so Company Brain is not answering. Turn demo mode off to use it.";
    var e = j && j.error;
    if (e && WORDS[e]) return WORDS[e];
    var s = j && j._status;
    if (s === 401) return "You are signed out. Sign in again and try once more.";
    if (s === 403) return "Your role is not allowed to do that.";
    if (s === 404) return "This part of Company Brain is not switched on yet.";
    if (s === 413) return "That file is too big. Files have to be under 25 MB.";
    if (s === 409) return "Someone already decided on this one.";
    if (s && s >= 500) return "Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a minute.";
    if (j && j.offline) return "We could not reach the server. Check your internet and try again.";
    return "Something went wrong. Try again.";
  }

  function readBody(res) {
    return res.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (j) {
      j = j || {}; j._status = res.status; return j;
    });
  }
  function apiGet(path) {
    if (isDemo()) return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, demo: true });
    var t = token();
    return fetch(path, { headers: { accept: "application/json", authorization: t ? ("Bearer " + t) : "" } })
      .then(readBody)
      .catch(function () { return { ok: false, offline: true }; });
  }
  function apiPost(path, body) {
    if (isDemo()) return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, demo: true });
    var t = token();
    return fetch(path, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", accept: "application/json", authorization: t ? ("Bearer " + t) : "" },
      body: JSON.stringify(body || {})
    }).then(readBody).catch(function () { return { ok: false, offline: true }; });
  }
  function apiUpload(path, form) {
    if (isDemo()) return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, demo: true });
    var t = token();
    /* No content-type header on purpose — the browser has to set the
       multipart boundary itself or the server cannot split the parts. */
    return fetch(path, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { accept: "application/json", authorization: t ? ("Bearer " + t) : "" },
      body: form
    }).then(readBody).catch(function () { return { ok: false, offline: true }; });
  }

  /* ── small helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function when(iso) {
    if (!iso) return "";
    var t = new Date(iso);
    if (isNaN(t.getTime())) return "";
    var diff = Date.now() - t.getTime();
    if (diff < 0) diff = 0;
    if (diff < 60000) return "just now";
    if (diff < 3600000) return Math.floor(diff / 60000) + "m ago";
    if (diff < 86400000) return Math.floor(diff / 3600000) + "h ago";
    return t.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "America/Phoenix" }) + ", " +
      t.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "America/Phoenix" });
  }
  function fullTime(iso) {
    if (!iso) return "";
    var t = new Date(iso);
    return isNaN(t.getTime()) ? "" : t.toLocaleString();
  }
  function sizeWords(bytes) {
    var n = Number(bytes);
    if (!isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return "";
    if (n < 1024) return n + " bytes";
    if (n < 1048576) return Math.round(n / 1024) + " KB";
    return (n / 1048576).toFixed(1) + " MB";
  }

  /* ── state ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var state = {
    threadId: null,
    title: "New chat",
    messages: [],
    loadingThread: false,
    threadError: "",
    busy: false,
    threads: [],
    threadsState: "loading",
    threadsError: "",
    uploads: [],
    pendingCount: 0,
    uploadsState: "loading",
    uploadsError: "",
    reviews: [],
    reviewsState: "loading",
    reviewsError: ""
  };

  /* ── conversation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function setTitle(t) {
    state.title = t || "New chat";
    chatTitle.textContent = state.title;
    chatTitle.title = state.title;
  }

  function sourcesHtml(list) {
    if (!list || !list.length) return "";
    var rows = list.map(function (s) {
      var bits = [];
      if (s.accessTier) bits.push('<span class="badge b-gray">' + esc(s.accessTier) + "</span>");
      /* An uploaded file has no Drive link. Show the name on its own —
         never the word "null". */
      if (s.webViewLink) {
        bits.push('<a class="lnk" href="' + esc(s.webViewLink) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in Drive</a>');
      }
      if (s.clientId) {
        bits.push('<a class="lnk" href="client-control-panel.html?client_id=' +
          esc(encodeURIComponent(s.clientId)) + '">Client record</a>');
      }
      if (s.mimeType && /^(audio|video)\//.test(String(s.mimeType))) {
        bits.push('<span class="badge b-butter">recording</span>');
      }
      var num = (s.n === 0 || s.n) ? "[" + esc(s.n) + "] " : "";
      return '<div class="src">' +
        '<div class="sname">' + num + esc(s.fileName || "Untitled file") + "</div>" +
        (bits.length ? '<div class="smeta mono">' + bits.join("") + "</div>" : "") +
        (s.excerpt ? '<div class="sexc">' + esc(s.excerpt) + "</div>" : "") +
        "</div>";
    }).join("");
    return '<div class="srcs"><div class="srchd mono">Files used · ' + esc(list.length) + "</div>" + rows + "</div>";
  }

  function thinWords(m) {
    if (!m.thin) return "";
    if (m.answerSource === "none") return "Nothing in your files matched this question.";
    return "This is copied straight out of the files. No writing helper was used.";
  }

  function turnHtml(m) {
    if (m.kind === "user") {
      return '<div class="turn user"><div class="measure"><div class="bubble">' + esc(m.text) + "</div></div></div>";
    }
    if (m.kind === "pending") {
      return '<div class="turn assistant"><div class="measure">' +
        '<div class="eyebrow">Company Brain</div>' +
        '<div class="thinline"><span class="pulse"></span><span>Reading your files…</span></div>' +
        "</div></div>";
    }
    if (m.kind === "note") {
      return '<div class="turn sysnote"><div class="measure"><div class="notebox' + (m.bad ? " bad" : "") + '">' +
        esc(m.text) + "</div></div></div>";
    }
    var tw = thinWords(m);
    return '<div class="turn assistant"><div class="measure">' +
      '<div class="eyebrow">Company Brain</div>' +
      '<div class="answer">' + esc(m.text || "") + "</div>" +
      (tw ? '<div class="thinnote mono">' + esc(tw) + "</div>" : "") +
      sourcesHtml(m.sources) +
      "</div></div>";
  }

  function emptyHtml() {
    return '<div class="measure emptywrap">' +
      '<div class="eyebrow">Company Brain</div>' +
      "<h2>Ask about your company files</h2>" +
      "<p>Type a question below. The answer comes from files your role is allowed to open, and every answer lists the files it used.</p>" +
      "<p>Add a file with the + button. An owner has to approve it before it can be used in answers.</p>" +
      "<p>Nothing has been asked in this chat yet.</p>" +
      "</div>";
  }

  function renderMessages() {
    if (state.loadingThread) {
      msgsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="measure"><div class="sk"></div><div class="sk"></div><div class="sk short"></div></div>';
      return;
    }
    if (state.threadError) {
      msgsEl.innerHTML = '<div class="measure"><div class="notebox bad">' + esc(state.threadError) + "</div></div>";
      return;
    }
    if (!state.messages.length) { msgsEl.innerHTML = emptyHtml(); return; }
    msgsEl.innerHTML = state.messages.map(turnHtml).join("");
    scrollToEnd();
  }

  function scrollToEnd() {
    /* Straight away first. requestAnimationFrame on its own was not enough:
       a throttled or hidden tab never fires it, so a chat opened in a tab the
       user switches to later sat at the top of the history instead of on the
       newest turn. Reading scrollHeight right after the innerHTML write already
       forces layout, so the direct set is correct on its own. The frame callback
       is only a second pass for fonts and late layout. */
    msgsEl.scrollTop = msgsEl.scrollHeight;
    window.requestAnimationFrame(function () { msgsEl.scrollTop = msgsEl.scrollHeight; });
  }

  function setBusy(v) {
    state.busy = !!v;
    askBtn.disabled = state.busy;
    attachBtn.disabled = state.busy;
    askBtn.textContent = state.busy ? "Sending…" : "Send";
  }

  function dropPending() {
    state.messages = state.messages.filter(function (m) { return m.kind !== "pending"; });
  }

  function send() {
    if (state.busy) return;
    var text = String(ta.value || "").trim();
    if (!text) { ta.focus(); return; }
    var firstTurn = !state.messages.length;
    state.messages.push({ kind: "user", text: text });
    state.messages.push({ kind: "pending" });
    ta.value = "";
    grow();
    setBusy(true);
    renderMessages();

    var body = { question: text };
    if (state.threadId) body.thread_id = state.threadId;

    apiPost("/api/read/company-brain", body).then(function (j) {
      setBusy(false);
      dropPending();
      if (!j || !j.ok) {
        state.messages.push({ kind: "note", bad: true, text: friendly(j) });
        renderMessages();
        return;
      }
      if (j.thread_id) state.threadId = j.thread_id;
      state.messages.push({
        kind: "assistant",
        text: (j.answer && j.answer.text) || "",
        sources: j.sources || [],
        answerSource: (j.answer && j.answer.source) || "",
        thin: !!(j.answer && j.answer.thin)
      });
      if (j.history_saved === false) {
        state.messages.push({ kind: "note", text: "This chat was not saved to your history." });
      }
      if (j.role) { rolePill.textContent = j.role; }
      if (firstTurn) setTitle(text.length > 60 ? text.slice(0, 60) : text);
      renderMessages();
      loadThreads();
    });
  }

  /* ── composer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function grow() {
    ta.style.height = "auto";
    ta.style.height = Math.min(ta.scrollHeight, 200) + "px";
  }
  ta.addEventListener("input", grow);
  ta.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
    if (ev.key === "Enter" && !ev.shiftKey) { ev.preventDefault(); send(); }
  });
  document.getElementById("composer").addEventListener("submit", function (ev) {
    ev.preventDefault(); send();
  });

  /* ── upload ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  attachBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { if (!state.busy) fileInput.click(); });
  fileInput.addEventListener("change", function () {
    var f = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
    fileInput.value = "";
    if (f) doUpload(f);
  });

  function doUpload(file) {
    if (state.busy) return;
    var form = new FormData();
    form.append("file", file);
    if (state.threadId) form.append("thread_id", state.threadId);
    setBusy(true);
    state.messages.push({ kind: "note", up: true, text: "Sending " + file.name + "…" });
    renderMessages();

    apiUpload("/api/company-brain/upload", form).then(function (j) {
      setBusy(false);
      state.messages = state.messages.filter(function (m) { return !m.up; });
      if (!j || !j.ok) {
        state.messages.push({ kind: "note", bad: true, text: friendly(j) });
        renderMessages();
        return;
      }
      var f = j.file || {};
      var name = f.name || file.name;
      var msg = f.approvalStatus === "approved"
        ? "Uploaded " + name + ". It is approved, so it can be used in answers now."
        : "Uploaded " + name + ". An owner has to approve it before it can be used in answers.";
      state.messages.push({ kind: "note", text: msg });
      renderMessages();
      loadUploads();
      if (isOwner) loadReviews();
      openDocs(true);
    });
  }

  /* ── left rail: past chats ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function renderThreads() {
    if (state.threadsState === "loading") {
      threadList.innerHTML = '<div class="rail-msg"><div class="sk"></div><div class="sk"></div><div class="sk short"></div></div>';
      return;
    }
    if (state.threadsState === "error") {
      threadList.innerHTML = '<div class="rail-msg">' + esc(state.threadsError) + "</div>";
      return;
    }
    if (!state.threads.length) {
      threadList.innerHTML = '<div class="rail-msg">No past chats yet. Ask your first question and it will show up here.</div>';
      return;
    }
    threadList.innerHTML = state.threads.map(function (t) {
      var count = Number(t.messageCount);
      var meta = (isFinite(count) && count > 0 ? (count + (count === 1 ? " message" : " messages")) : "no messages");
      var stamp = when(t.updatedAt || t.createdAt);
      if (stamp) meta += " · " + stamp;
      return '<button class="threadbtn' + (t.id === state.threadId ? " on" : "") + '" type="button" data-thread="' +
        esc(t.id) + '" title="' + esc(fullTime(t.updatedAt || t.createdAt)) + '">' +
        '<div class="tt">' + esc(t.title || "Untitled chat") + "</div>" +
        '<div class="tm mono">' + esc(meta) + "</div></button>";
    }).join("");
  }

  function loadThreads() {
    if (state.threadsState !== "ok") { state.threadsState = "loading"; renderThreads(); }
    apiGet("/api/company-brain/threads").then(function (j) {
      if (!j || !j.ok) {
        state.threadsState = "error";
        state.threadsError = friendly(j);
        renderThreads();
        return;
      }
      state.threads = j.threads || [];
      state.threadsState = "ok";
      renderThreads();
    });
  }

  threadList.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
    var btn = ev.target.closest("[data-thread]");
    if (!btn) return;
    openThread(btn.getAttribute("data-thread"));
    if (window.innerWidth <= 900) chatEl.classList.remove("rail-open");
  });

  function openThread(id) {
    if (!id) return;
    state.threadId = id;
    state.messages = [];
    state.threadError = "";
    state.loadingThread = true;
    setTitle("Loading…");
    renderThreads();
    renderMessages();
    apiGet("/api/company-brain/threads?thread_id=" + encodeURIComponent(id)).then(function (j) {
      state.loadingThread = false;
      if (!j || !j.ok) {
        state.threadError = friendly(j);
        setTitle("Chat");
        renderMessages();
        return;
      }
      setTitle((j.thread && j.thread.title) || "Chat");
      state.messages = (j.messages || []).map(function (m) {
        if (m.role === "user") return { kind: "user", text: m.text || "" };
        return {
          kind: "assistant",
          text: m.text || "",
          sources: m.sources || [],
          answerSource: m.answerSource || "",
          thin: !!m.thin
        };
      });
      renderMessages();
    });
  }

  document.getElementById("newChat").addEventListener("click", function () {
    state.threadId = null;
    state.messages = [];
    state.threadError = "";
    state.loadingThread = false;
    setTitle("New chat");
    renderThreads();
    renderMessages();
    if (window.innerWidth <= 900) chatEl.classList.remove("rail-open");
    ta.focus();
  });

  document.getElementById("railToggle").addEventListener("click", function () {
    chatEl.classList.toggle("rail-open");
  });

  /* ── right panel: uploaded files + owner approvals ──────────────────── */
  function openDocs(v) {
    if (v) chatEl.classList.add("docs-open");
    else chatEl.classList.remove("docs-open");
  }
  document.getElementById("docsBtn").addEventListener("click", function () {
    chatEl.classList.toggle("docs-open");
  });
  document.getElementById("docsClose").addEventListener("click", function () { openDocs(false); });
  document.getElementById("refreshDocs").addEventListener("click", loadUploads);

  function setPending(n) {
    var count = Number(n) || 0;
    state.pendingCount = count;
    [pendPill, pendPill2].forEach(function (el) {
      if (!el) return;
      el.textContent = String(count) + " waiting";
      el.hidden = count === 0;
    });
  }

  var APPROVAL = {
    pending: { badge: "b-warn", word: "waiting", say: "An owner has to approve this before it can be used in answers." },
    approved: { badge: "b-ok", word: "approved", say: "Company Brain can use this in answers." },
    rejected: { badge: "b-alert", word: "turned down", say: "This will not be used in answers." }
  };

  function reviewIdForUpload(u) {
    var uid = String((u && u.id) || "");
    if (!uid) return "";
    for (var i = 0; i < state.reviews.length; i++) {
      var r = state.reviews[i];
      if (String(r.file_id || r.fileId || "") === uid) return r.id;
    }
    return u.pendingReviewId || u.reviewId || "";
  }

  function renderUploads() {
    if (state.uploadsState === "loading") {
      docList.innerHTML = '<div class="sk"></div><div class="sk"></div><div class="sk short"></div>';
      return;
    }
    if (state.uploadsState === "error") {
      docList.innerHTML = '<div class="notebox bad">' + esc(state.uploadsError) + "</div>";
      return;
    }
    if (!state.uploads.length) {
      docList.innerHTML = '<div class="muted">No files added yet. Use the + button next to the message box.</div>';
      return;
    }
    docList.innerHTML = state.uploads.map(function (u) {
      var key = String(u.approvalStatus || "").toLowerCase();
      var look = APPROVAL[key] || { badge: "b-gray", word: "unknown", say: "" };
      var meta = [];
      var sz = sizeWords(u.sizeBytes);
      if (sz) meta.push(sz);
      if (u.accessTier) meta.push("seen by " + u.accessTier);
      if (u.uploadedByName) meta.push("added by " + u.uploadedByName);
      var stamp = when(u.uploadedAt);
      if (stamp) meta.push(stamp);
      var actions = "";
      if (isOwner && key === "pending") {
        var rid = reviewIdForUpload(u);
        if (rid) {
          actions = '<div class="drow">' +
            '<button class="btn sm dark" type="button" data-decide="approve" data-id="' + esc(rid) + '">Approve</button>' +
            '<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-decide="reject" data-id="' + esc(rid) + '">Turn down</button>' +
            "</div>";
        }
      }
      return '<div class="docrow" title="' + esc(fullTime(u.uploadedAt)) + '">' +
        '<div class="dn">' + esc(u.name || "Untitled file") + "</div>" +
        '<div class="drow"><span class="badge ' + look.badge + '">' + esc(look.word) + "</span></div>" +
        (meta.length ? '<div class="dm mono">' + esc(meta.join(" · ")) + "</div>" : "") +
        (look.say ? '<div class="dsay mono">' + esc(look.say) + "</div>" : "") +
        actions +
        "</div>";
    }).join("");
  }

  function loadUploads() {
    if (state.uploadsState !== "ok") { state.uploadsState = "loading"; renderUploads(); }
    apiGet("/api/company-brain/upload").then(function (j) {
      if (!j || !j.ok) {
        state.uploadsState = "error";
        state.uploadsError = friendly(j);
        setPending(0);
        renderUploads();
        return;
      }
      state.uploads = j.uploads || [];
      state.uploadsState = "ok";
      setPending(j.pendingCount);
      renderUploads();
    });
  }

  /* Owner-only approval queue — same endpoint and same shape this screen
     already used, moved into the documents panel. */
  function renderReviews() {
    if (state.reviewsState === "loading") {
      reviewList.innerHTML = '<div class="sk"></div><div class="sk short"></div>';
      return;
    }
    if (state.reviewsState === "error") {
      reviewList.innerHTML = '<div class="notebox bad">' + esc(state.reviewsError) + "</div>";
      return;
    }
    if (!state.reviews.length) {
      reviewList.innerHTML = '<div class="muted">Nothing is waiting for you.</div>';
      return;
    }
    reviewList.innerHTML = state.reviews.map(function (row) {
      var open = row.web_view_link
        ? ('<a class="lnk" href="' + esc(row.web_view_link) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in Drive</a>') : "";
      return '<div class="docrow">' +
        '<div class="dn">' + esc(row.file_name || row.drive_file_id || "Untitled file") + "</div>" +
        '<div class="dm mono">asked for ' + esc(row.proposed_tier) + " · now " + esc(row.access_tier) +
          (open ? " · " : "") + open + "</div>" +
        (row.rationale ? '<div class="dsay">' + esc(row.rationale) + "</div>" : "") +
        '<div class="drow">' +
          '<button class="btn sm dark" type="button" data-decide="approve" data-id="' + esc(row.id) + '">Approve</button>' +
          '<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-decide="reject" data-id="' + esc(row.id) + '">Turn down</button>' +
        "</div></div>";
    }).join("");
  }

  function loadReviews() {
    if (!isOwner) return;
    if (state.reviewsState !== "ok") { state.reviewsState = "loading"; renderReviews(); }
    apiGet("/api/company-brain/reviews").then(function (j) {
      if (!j || !j.ok) {
        state.reviewsState = "error";
        state.reviewsError = friendly(j);
        renderReviews();
        return;
      }
      state.reviews = j.reviews || [];
      state.reviewsState = "ok";
      renderReviews();
      renderUploads();
    });
  }

  function decideFromButton(btn) {
    btn.disabled = true;
    apiPost("/api/company-brain/reviews", {
      review_id: btn.getAttribute("data-id"),
      decision: btn.getAttribute("data-decide")
    }).then(function (j) {
      if (!j || !j.ok) {
        btn.disabled = false;
        state.reviewsState = "error";
        state.reviewsError = friendly(j);
        renderReviews();
        renderUploads();
        return;
      }
      loadReviews();
      loadUploads();
    });
  }
  function onDecideClick(ev) {
    var btn = ev.target.closest("[data-decide]");
    if (!btn) return;
    decideFromButton(btn);
  }
  reviewList.addEventListener("click", onDecideClick);
  docList.addEventListener("click", onDecideClick);
  document.getElementById("refreshReviews").addEventListener("click", loadReviews);

  /* ── class quizzes (Documents panel) ────────────────────────────────── */
  var quizPick = document.getElementById("quizPick");
  var quizBox = document.getElementById("quizBox");
  var quizList = (typeof quizzesForRole === "function")
    ? quizzesForRole(myRole)
    : (rootQuizzes());
  function rootQuizzes() {
    return (typeof FH_RAMP_QUIZZES !== "undefined" && FH_RAMP_QUIZZES) ? FH_RAMP_QUIZZES : [];
  }
  if (quizPick) {
    quizPick.innerHTML = quizList.map(function (q) {
      return '<option value="' + esc(q.id) + '">' + esc(q.title) + "</option>";
    }).join("");
    quizPick.addEventListener("change", function () { paintQuiz(quizPick.value); });
    if (quizList.length) paintQuiz(quizList[0].id);
    else if (quizBox) quizBox.innerHTML = '<div class="muted">No class quizzes loaded.</div>';
  }
  function findQuiz(id) {
    for (var i = 0; i < quizList.length; i++) if (quizList[i].id === id) return quizList[i];
    return null;
  }
  function paintQuiz(id) {
    var quiz = findQuiz(id);
    if (!quiz || !quizBox) return;
    quizBox.innerHTML = '<form id="quizForm">' +
      quiz.questions.map(function (item, i) {
        return '<div class="qitem docrow" style="margin-top:8px">' +
          '<label for="qa-' + i + '">' + (i + 1) + ". " + esc(item.q) + "</label>" +
          '<textarea id="qa-' + i + '" data-qi="' + i + '"></textarea>' +
          '<div class="qmark mono" id="qm-' + i + '"></div></div>';
      }).join("") +
      '<div class="drow" style="margin-top:12px">' +
        '<button class="btn sm dark" type="submit">Check answers</button>' +
      '</div><div class="dsay" id="quizResult" style="margin-top:8px"></div></form>';
    document.getElementById("quizForm").addEventListener("submit", function (ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      var answers = quiz.questions.map(function (_, i) {
        var el = document.getElementById("qa-" + i);
        return el ? el.value : "";
      });
      var out = scoreRampQuiz(quiz, answers);
      out.results.forEach(function (row, i) {
        var mark = document.getElementById("qm-" + i);
        if (!mark) return;
        mark.className = "qmark mono " + (row.ok ? "qok" : "qbad");
        mark.textContent = row.empty ? "Write an answer." : (row.ok ? "Right" : "Wrong");
      });
      var box = document.getElementById("quizResult");
      if (!box) return;
      if (out.mustMissZero) {
        box.textContent = out.passed
          ? ("Pass. You got every question right (" + out.correct + " of " + out.total + ").")
          : ("Fail. Day 5 must miss zero. You got " + out.correct + " of " + out.total + " right.");
      } else {
        box.textContent = "You got " + out.correct + " of " + out.total + " right.";
      }
    });
  }

  /* ── start ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  if (isOwner && reviewPanel) reviewPanel.hidden = false;
  setTitle("New chat");
  renderMessages();
  grow();
  loadThreads();
  loadUploads();
  if (isOwner) loadReviews();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

          </span>

        <div class="cc-card" id="ccCaptureCard">
          <h2>Record a new consent</h2>
          <p class="hint">
            Read the wording below to the client, or let them read it themselves. Then record how they agreed.
          </p>

          <div class="cc-disclosure" id="ccDisclosure">Loading the consent wording…</div>

          <div class="cc-field">
            <label>How did they agree?</label>
            <div class="cc-methods" id="ccMethods">
              <button type="button" class="cc-method on" data-method="typed">
                <span class="m-name">They typed their name</span>
                <span class="m-why">Strongest record. Use in the portal or on a shared screen.</span>
              </button>
              <button type="button" class="cc-method" data-method="checkbox">
                <span class="m-name">They ticked a box</span>
                <span class="m-why">Use when they clicked to agree and typed nothing.</span>
              </button>
              <button type="button" class="cc-method" data-method="signature">
                <span class="m-name">They signed</span>
                <span class="m-why">Draw in the box below. A typed name alone is not a signature.</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="cc-field" id="ccNameField">
            <label for="ccName">Name they typed or signed <span class="sub">— required for typed and signed</span></label>
            <input class="cc-input" id="ccName" type="text" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Their full name, exactly as they gave it">

          <div class="cc-field" id="ccSignField" hidden>
            <label for="ccSignPad">Draw your signature</label>
            <canvas id="ccSignPad" data-testid="ccSignPad" width="640" height="160" aria-label="Signature pad"></canvas>
            <div class="cc-sign-row">
              <button class="btn ghost" id="ccSignClear" data-testid="ccSignClear" type="button">Clear</button>
              <span class="cc-empty">Draw your signature. An empty box does not count.</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="cc-field">
            <label for="ccExpires">Expires <span class="sub">— optional. Leave empty if it does not expire.</span></label>
            <input class="cc-input" id="ccExpires" type="date">
          </div>

          <div class="cc-actions">
            <button class="btn" id="ccSubmit" type="button">Record consent</button>
            <span class="cc-empty" id="ccSubmitHint">Nothing is sent to a credit bureau by this button.</span>
          </div>
          <div class="cc-msg" id="ccMsg"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="cc-card">
          <h2>History</h2>
          <p class="hint">
            Every consent this client has given, including any they took back. Withdrawn consents stay on the list on purpose.
          </p>
          <div id="ccHistory"><p class="cc-empty">Loading…</p></div>
        </div>

        <p class="cc-note">
          Open this screen with a client in the address bar — <code>consent-capture.html?client_id=&lt;id&gt;</code>.
          To authorize dispute letters, add <code>&amp;kind=dispute_authorization</code>.
          For a recorded client call, <code>&amp;kind=call_recording</code>, and to use what they
          said in an advert, <code>&amp;kind=marketing_use</code> — those two are asked separately
          on purpose, because agreeing to be recorded is not agreeing to be advertised.
        </p>

    <div class="foot"><span class="pulse"></span><span>systems nominal · fundhub.ai</span></div>
