/* ══ CF-01 · PARTNER SCOPE ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderScope(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('partnerSel');
  var p = currentPartner();
  if (p) sel.value = String(S.partner);
  /* The partner's NAME, not the id. This line used to print the raw id — a long
     string of letters and numbers that means nothing to the person reading it and
     is not something they can act on. The name is already on the same object. */
  document.getElementById('scopePid').textContent = p ? (p.name || p.slug || 'Unnamed partner') : 'No partner selected';
  document.getElementById('scopeChipTxt').textContent = p ? (p.name || p.slug || 'Unnamed partner') : 'no partner selected';
  document.getElementById('scopeOffers').innerHTML = '';
  document.getElementById('scopeHow').innerHTML = p
    ? 'Showing <b>' + esc(p.name || p.slug || 'Unnamed partner') + '</b> only.'
    : 'Nothing is loaded. Pick a partner to show jobs, creatives, or brand kits.';
  setWriteControls(canWriteCreative());
}

function canWriteCreative(){
  return Boolean(currentPartner() && CF_SUITE.loaded && CF_SUITE.enabled);
}

function loadPartnerPicker(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('partnerSel');
  if(!sel) return;
  if(!window.FHData || typeof FHData.partners !== 'function'){
    if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadPartnerPicker, { once: true });
      return;
    }
    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Could not load partners</option>';
    sel.disabled = true;
    renderAll();
    loadCfUsage();
    return;
  }
  FHData.partners({ limit: 200 }).then(function(res){
    if(!res.ok){
      PARTNERS = [];
      sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Could not load partners</option>';
      sel.disabled = true;
      renderAll();
      loadCfUsage();
      return;
    }
    var items = (res.data && res.data.items) || [];
    PARTNERS = items;
    if(!items.length){
      sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">No partners on file</option>';
      sel.disabled = true;
      renderAll();
      loadCfUsage();
      return;
    }
    var cur = '';
    try { cur = new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('partner_id') || ''; } catch(e){}
    var idx = 0;
    if (cur) {
      for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) if (items[i].id === cur) idx = i;
    }
    S.partner = idx;
    sel.disabled = false;
    sel.innerHTML = items.map(function(p, i){
      return '<option value="'+i+'">'+esc(p.name || p.slug || '')+'</option>';
    }).join('');
    sel.value = String(idx);
    renderAll();
    wireCreative();
    loadCfUsage();
  });
}

function loadCfUsage(){
  var body = document.getElementById('cfUseBody');
  var badge = document.getElementById('cfUseBadge');
  var pid = currentPartnerId();
  CF_SUITE = { enabled: false, remaining: null, cap: null, used: null, loaded: false, error: null };
  if (!body) return;
  if (!pid) {
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="unwired"><div class="uh"><span>◉</span><span>Pick a partner to see their monthly writing allowance.</span></div></div>';
    if (badge) badge.textContent = 'no partner';
    setWriteControls(false);
    return;
  }
  body.innerHTML = '<div class="unwired"><div class="uh"><span>◉</span><span>Loading the allowance…</span></div></div>';
  setWriteControls(false);
  var tok = '';
  try { tok = localStorage.getItem('fh_token') || ''; } catch (e) { tok = ''; }
  fetch('/api/partner-marketing/usage?partner_id=' + encodeURIComponent(pid), {
    headers: tok ? { accept: 'application/json', authorization: 'Bearer ' + tok } : { accept: 'application/json' }
  }).then(function (r) {
    return r.json().then(function (d) { return { status: r.status, d: d }; })
      .catch(function () { return { status: r.status, d: {} }; });
  }).then(function (pack) {
    var d = pack.d || {};
    if (pack.status === 403) {
      CF_SUITE.error = 'Only the owner or this partner can see this allowance.';
      body.innerHTML = '<div class="unwired"><div class="uh"><span>◉</span><span>' + CF_SUITE.error + '</span></div></div>';
      if (badge) badge.textContent = 'owner / partner';
      setWriteControls(false);
      return;
    }
    if (!d.ok) {
      CF_SUITE.error = d.message || 'Could not load the allowance.';
      body.innerHTML = '<div class="unwired"><div class="uh"><span>⚠</span><span>' + esc(CF_SUITE.error) + '</span></div></div>';
      if (badge) badge.textContent = 'error';
      setWriteControls(false);
      return;
    }
    CF_SUITE = { enabled: !!d.enabled, remaining: d.remaining, cap: d.cap, used: d.used, loaded: true, error: null };
    if (badge) badge.textContent = d.enabled ? 'on' : 'off';
    body.innerHTML =
      '<div class="stats">' +
        '<div class="stat"><div class="eyebrow">On?</div><div class="sv">' + (d.enabled ? 'Yes' : 'No') + '</div></div>' +
        '<div class="stat"><div class="eyebrow">Used this month</div><div class="sv">' + (d.used == null ? '—' : d.used) + '</div></div>' +
        '<div class="stat"><div class="eyebrow">Left</div><div class="sv">' + (d.remaining == null ? '—' : d.remaining) + '</div></div>' +
        '<div class="stat"><div class="eyebrow">Monthly limit</div><div class="sv">' + (d.cap == null ? '—' : d.cap) + '</div></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      (d.enabled ? '' : '<p class="note">The owner has not turned this on for this partner. Generate stays off so you do not hit a wall. The switch is on the <a href="brand-studio.html">Brand Studio</a> screen — owner-only.</p>');
    setWriteControls(canWriteCreative());
  }).catch(function () {
    CF_SUITE.error = 'Could not reach the allowance.';
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="unwired"><div class="uh"><span>⚠</span><span>' + CF_SUITE.error + '</span></div></div>';
    if (badge) badge.textContent = 'error';
    setWriteControls(false);
  });
}

/* §5/§6 — a write control never fires against a partner that was not named,
   and never sits live when the owner has not turned this partner on. */
function setWriteControls(enabled){
  var ids = ['genBtn','runJobsBtn'];
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-cact]').forEach(function(b){ b.disabled = !enabled; });
  ids.forEach(function(id){ var b = document.getElementById(id); if(b) b.disabled = !enabled; });
  var chipTxt = document.getElementById('cfWriteChipTxt');
  var chipDot = document.getElementById('cfWriteDot');
  if (chipTxt) chipTxt.textContent = enabled ? 'Writes on' : 'Read only';
  if (chipDot) chipDot.style.background = enabled ? 'var(--ok)' : 'var(--gray2)';
  if(enabled) {
    ['genMsg','actMsg'].forEach(function(id){
      var m = document.getElementById(id);
      /* Clears the "why the buttons are off" line once they come on. The words
         matched here must stay in step with the reason ladder below, or a stale
         reason sits under a working button. */
      if (m && /allowance has loaded|No partner selected|has not turned this on/i.test(m.textContent || '')) {
        m.textContent = '';
      }
    });
    return;
  }
  var reason = !currentPartner()
    ? 'No partner selected.'
    : (CF_SUITE.error
      ? CF_SUITE.error
      : (CF_SUITE.loaded && !CF_SUITE.enabled
        ? 'The owner has not turned this on for this partner. It turns on in Brand Studio, owner-only.'
        : 'These buttons stay off until the allowance has loaded.'));
  ['genMsg','actMsg'].forEach(function(id){ var m = document.getElementById(id); if(m) m.textContent = reason; });
}

/* ══ CF-00 · STAT TILES + DERIVATION ═════════════════════════════════════
   FIVE SEPARATE READS, EACH AT limit=200. None of these four endpoints returns a
   total — read-api.mjs derives hasMore by selecting limit+1 rows instead of running
   a count query (:78-95), on purpose — so a tile can only ever count the rows one
   response carried. Counting the CF-02/CF-04/CF-06 pages would make every tile move
   when someone changed a limit dropdown, so the tiles issue their own reads at
   MAX_LIMIT (200) and the numbers below are the row counts of those responses:
   exact while hasMore is false, saturating at 200 above it. That is stated on every
   derivation strip rather than implied.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function statModel(){
  var jobs = byPartner(JOBS), assets = byPartner(ASSETS), kits = byPartner(KITS);
  /* campaign rows come from the approvals read's own campaign branch — there is no
     campaign list in this file to count instead. */
  var camps = (APPROVALS_LIVE || []).filter(function(r){ return r.item_type === 'campaign'; });
  var queued = jobs.filter(function(j){ return j.status==='queued'; });
  var running = jobs.filter(function(j){ return j.status==='running'; });
  var failed = jobs.filter(function(j){ return j.status==='failed'; });
  var retrying = queued.filter(function(j){ return j.attempt > 0; });
  var live = assets.filter(function(a){ return !a.archived_at; });
  var blocked = live.filter(function(a){ return a.compliance_state==='blocked'; });
  var pending = live.filter(function(a){ return a.compliance_state==='pending'; });
  var active = kits.filter(function(k){ return k.status==='active'; });
  return {jobs:jobs, assets:assets, kits:kits, camps:camps, queued:queued, running:running,
          failed:failed, retrying:retrying, live:live, blocked:blocked, pending:pending, active:active};
}

/* One message per distinct reason, so "no partner" does not print four times. */
function blockersFor(keys){
  var out = [];
  keys.forEach(function(k){
    var s = panelState(k);
    if(s && out.indexOf(s) < 0) out.push(s);
  });
  return out;
}

function renderStats(){
  /* §6 — the strip is fed by all four reads. If any of them did not answer, the
     totals would be wrong, so the strip says so instead of printing numbers. */
  var blockers = blockersFor(['jobs','assets','approvals','kits']);
  if(blockers.length){
    document.getElementById('stats').innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">' + blockers.join('<br>') + '</div>';
    return;
  }
  var m = statModel();
  var tiles = [
    {k:'flight',  label:'JOBS IN FLIGHT', v:(m.queued.length + m.running.length),
     d:m.running.length + ' running · ' + m.queued.length + ' queued', cls:''},
    {k:'failed',  label:'FAILED JOBS', v:m.failed.length,
     d:'all carry a reason', cls:m.failed.length ? 'bad' : ''},
    {k:'review',  label:'AWAITING REVIEW', v:(m.pending.length + m.blocked.length + m.camps.length),
     d:m.blocked.length + ' blocked · ' + m.camps.length + ' campaigns', cls:m.blocked.length ? 'warn' : ''},
    {k:'library', label:'LIBRARY ASSETS', v:m.live.length, d:'not archived', cls:''},
    {k:'kits',    label:'ACTIVE BRAND KITS', v:m.active.length, d:'of ' + m.kits.length + ' total', cls:''}
  ];
  /* Plain tiles, not buttons: the derivation strip they used to open is gone, and
     §5 does not allow a control that does nothing. */
  document.getElementById('stats').innerHTML = tiles.map(function(t){
    return '<div class="stat">' +
      '<div class="eyebrow">' + t.label + '</div>' +
      '<div class="sv ' + t.cls + '">' + t.v + '</div>' +
      '<div class="sd">' + esc(t.d) + '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

/* ══ PAGER — prev/next off limit, offset and hasMore. No page numbers. ════ */
function renderPager(el, pg, onMove){
  var host = document.getElementById(el);
  host.innerHTML =
    '<button class="btn sm mono" data-mv="-1"' + (pg.offset<=0?' disabled':'') + '>‹ prev</button>' +
    '<button class="btn sm mono" data-mv="1"' + (pg.hasMore?'':' disabled') + '>next ›</button>' +
    '<span>Showing ' + pg.count + '</span>';
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-mv]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){ onMove(parseInt(b.dataset.mv,10)); });
  });
}

/* ══ CF-02 · GENERATION JOBS ═════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function jobStateParam(){ return S.jobStates.length ? S.jobStates.join(',') : 'all'; }

function renderJobRail(){
  var jobs = byPartner(JOBS);
  var host = document.getElementById('jobRail');
  /* a chip count is a claim about the response — none is shown until there is one */
  var blocked = panelState('jobs');
  var cnt = function(n){ return blocked ? '' : '<span class="n">' + n + '</span>'; };
  var html = '<span class="rl">State</span>' +
    '<button data-js="" class="' + (S.jobStates.length?'':'on') + '">all' + cnt(jobs.length) + '</button>';
  html += JOB_STATES.map(function(st){
    var n = jobs.filter(function(j){ return j.status===st; }).length;
    return '<button data-js="' + st + '" class="' + (S.jobStates.indexOf(st)>=0?'on':'') + '">' +
      st + cnt(n) + '</button>';
  }).join('');
  host.innerHTML = html;
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-js]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var st = b.dataset.js;
      if(!st){ S.jobStates = []; }
      else {
        var i = S.jobStates.indexOf(st);
        if(i>=0) S.jobStates.splice(i,1); else S.jobStates.push(st);
      }
      S.jobOffset = 0; renderJobs();
    });
  });
}

function renderJobs(){
  renderJobRail();
  var rows = byPartner(JOBS).filter(function(j){
    return !S.jobStates.length || S.jobStates.indexOf(j.status) >= 0;
  });
  var pg = page(rows, S.jobLimit, S.jobOffset);
  var body = document.getElementById('jobBody');

  var blocked = panelState('jobs');
  if(blocked){
    body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10"><div class="empty">' + blocked + '</div></td></tr>';
  } else if(!pg.items.length){
    body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10"><div class="empty">No jobs match this filter for this partner.</div></td></tr>';
  } else {
    body.innerHTML = pg.items.map(function(j){
      var retry = j.status==='queued' && j.attempt > 0;
      var stripe = 'stripe-' + JOB_TONE[j.status];
      return '<tr class="rowbtn ' + stripe + '" data-job="' + esc(j.id) + '" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">' +
        '<td><span class="chev">▸</span><span class="mono">' + esc(shortId(j.id)) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="sub">' + esc(j.idempotency_key) + '</span></td>' +
        '<td><span class="badge ' + JOB_BADGE[j.status] + '">' + esc(j.status) + '</span>' +
          (retry ? '<span class="sub">retrying · attempt ' + j.attempt + '</span>' : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td><span class="mono">' + esc(j.asset_kind) + '</span>' +
          (j.asset_kind==='resize' ? '<span class="sub">a new shape of an existing creative</span>' : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mono">' + (j.formats ? esc(j.formats.join(' ')) : nul('—')) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mnum">' + (j.variants==null ? nul('—') : j.variants) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mnum">' + j.attempt + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mnum">' + j.asset_count + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mono">' + (j.provider ? esc(j.provider) : nul('—')) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mono">' + esc(fmt(j.created_at)) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mono">' + (j.finished_at ? esc(fmt(j.finished_at)) : nul('—')) + '</td>' +
      '</tr>';
    }).join('');
    wireExpand(body, '[data-job]', jobDetail, function(tr){ return jobById(tr.dataset.job); });
  }

  renderPager('jobPager', pg, function(d){
    S.jobOffset = Math.max(0, S.jobOffset + d * S.jobLimit); renderJobs();
  });
}
function jobById(id){ for(var i=0;i<JOBS.length;i++){ if(JOBS[i].id===id) return JOBS[i]; } return null; }

function jobDetail(j){
  var cols = [
    ['Job reference', j.id, 1], ['Batch name', j.idempotency_key, 1],
    ['Brand kit', kitName(j.brand_kit_id) || '—', 0],
    ['Started', fmt(j.started_at) || '—', 1], ['Finished', fmt(j.finished_at) || '—', 1],
    ['Creatives made', String(j.asset_count), 0]
  ];
  var out = '<div class="detwrap">' + cols.map(function(c){
    return '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">' + esc(c[0]) + '</div><div class="dv' + (c[2]?' mono':'') + '">' + esc(c[1]) + '</div></div>';
  }).join('');

  if(j.error){
    out += '<div class="detfull" style="margin-top:4px"><div class="dk" style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:var(--fs-caption);letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:5px">What went wrong</div>' +
      '<div class="errbox">' + esc(plainJobError(j.error)) + '</div></div>';
  }
  out += '<div class="detfull"><p class="note" style="margin-top:6px">' + jobExplain(j) + '</p></div>';
  return out + '</div>';
}

/* The stored failure reason, in words the owner reads.

   generation_jobs.error holds the engineer's sentence verbatim (src/creative/
   generate.mjs:283), and the commonest one tells the reader to "insert a
   creative_providers row" — a database table name, printed to a person who does
   not write code. This box used to show it unchanged.

   Only the three sentences that actually exist in the code are translated. Every
   one of them is matched on the same words jobExplain() below matches on, so the
   box and the line under it can never disagree. Anything else gets a neutral
   sentence: a wrong plain-English guess about an unknown failure is worse than
   admitting the detail is not shown here. */
function plainJobError(err){
  var t = String(err || '');
  if(/no active provider configured/i.test(t))
    return 'No ad-making service is switched on for this account, so there was nothing to make the work. Trying again will not help.';
  if(/has no module/i.test(t))
    return 'The ad-making service on file is one this system does not know how to use. Trying again will not help.';
  if(/returned zero assets/i.test(t))
    return 'The ad-making service answered, but sent nothing back.';
  return 'The job stopped with an error that this screen cannot put into plain words. Nothing was made.';
}

function jobExplain(j){
  if(j.status==='succeeded')
    return '<b>Succeeded.</b> ' + j.asset_count + ' asset' + (j.asset_count===1?'':'s') + ' stored.';
  if(j.status==='running')
    return '<b>Running.</b> Attempt ' + j.attempt + '. No progress bar or wait time is available.';
  if(j.status==='queued' && j.attempt > 0)
    return '<b>Retrying.</b> Tried ' + j.attempt + ' time' + (j.attempt===1?'':'s') + '. Failed after three tries.';
  if(j.status==='queued')
    return '<b>Waiting to start.</b>';
  if(/no active provider configured/.test(j.error||''))
    return '<b>Failed.</b> No vendor is switched on. Trying again will not help.';
  if(j.error==='provider returned zero assets')
    return '<b>Failed.</b> The vendor returned nothing.';
  return '<b>Failed.</b> Stopped after three tries.';
}

/* generic expand/collapse for a table body */
function wireExpand(body, sel, detailFn, lookup){
  body.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(function(tr){
    function toggle(){
      if(tr.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true'){
        tr.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        if(tr._d){ tr._d.remove(); tr._d = null; }
        return;
      }
      var rec = lookup(tr);
      if(!rec) return;
      var d = document.createElement('tr');
      d.className = 'det';
      var td = document.createElement('td');
      td.colSpan = tr.cells.length;
      td.innerHTML = detailFn(rec);
      d.appendChild(td);
      tr.parentNode.insertBefore(d, tr.nextSibling);
      tr._d = d;
      tr.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    }
    tr.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      if(e.target.closest('button,a')) return;
      toggle();
    });
    tr.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); toggle(); }
    });
  });
}

/* ══ CF-03 · JOB STATE LEGEND ════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderLegend(){
  var blocked = panelState('jobs');
  if(blocked){
    /* §6 — five zeros would read as "no jobs in any state", which is a different
       claim from "the jobs list was not read". */
    document.getElementById('stateLegend').innerHTML =
      '<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">' + blocked + '</div>';
    return;
  }
  var jobs = byPartner(JOBS);
  var n = function(f){ return jobs.filter(f).length; };
  var cards = [
    {sev:'info', n:n(function(j){return j.status==='queued'&&j.attempt===0;}), t:'Queued',
     d:'Waiting to start.'},
    {sev:'warn', n:n(function(j){return j.status==='queued'&&j.attempt>0;}), t:'Retrying',
     d:'Tried before and waiting to try again. Up to three tries.'},
    {sev:'warn', n:n(function(j){return j.status==='running';}), t:'Running',
     d:'In progress now.'},
    {sev:'ok', n:n(function(j){return j.status==='succeeded';}), t:'Succeeded',
     d:'At least one creative was stored.'},
    {sev:'bad', n:n(function(j){return j.status==='failed';}), t:'Failed',
     d:'Stopped. Always has a reason.'}
  ];
  document.getElementById('stateLegend').innerHTML = cards.map(function(c){
    return '<button type="button" class="sev-' + c.sev + '">' +
      '<div class="an">' + c.n + '</div>' +
      '<div class="at">' + esc(c.t) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="ad">' + esc(c.d) + '</div>' +
    '</button>';
  }).join('');
}

/* ══ CF-04 · CREATIVE LIBRARY ════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function libRows(){
  return byPartner(ASSETS).filter(function(a){
    if(S.libArchived !== '1' && a.archived_at) return false;
    if(S.libState !== 'all' && a.compliance_state !== S.libState) return false;
    if(S.libKind && a.kind !== S.libKind) return false;
    if(S.libFormat && a.format !== S.libFormat) return false;
    if(S.libKit && a.brand_kit_id !== S.libKit) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

function railHtml(label, param, values, current, counts){
  return '<span class="rl">' + label + '</span>' + values.map(function(v){
    var c = counts ? counts(v.k) : null;
    return '<button data-' + param + '="' + esc(v.k) + '" class="' + (current===v.k?'on':'') + '">' +
      esc(v.t) + (c==null?'':'<span class="n">'+c+'</span>') + '</button>';
  }).join('');
}

function renderLibFilters(){
  var all = byPartner(ASSETS).filter(function(a){ return S.libArchived==='1' || !a.archived_at; });
  /* counts are omitted, not zeroed, while the library read has not answered */
  var off = !!panelState('assets');

  document.getElementById('libStateRail').innerHTML = railHtml('State', 'ls',
    [{k:'all',t:'all'}].concat(LIB_STATES.map(function(s){ return {k:s,t:s}; })),
    S.libState,
    off ? null : function(k){ return k==='all' ? all.length : all.filter(function(a){ return a.compliance_state===k; }).length; });

  document.getElementById('libKindRail').innerHTML = railHtml('Kind', 'lk',
    [{k:'',t:'any'}].concat(ASSET_KINDS.map(function(s){ return {k:s,t:s}; })),
    S.libKind,
    off ? null : function(k){ return k==='' ? all.length : all.filter(function(a){ return a.kind===k; }).length; });

  document.getElementById('libFormatRail').innerHTML = railHtml('Format', 'lf',
    [{k:'',t:'any'}].concat(FORMATS.map(function(s){ return {k:s,t:s}; })),
    S.libFormat,
    off ? null : function(k){ return k==='' ? all.length : all.filter(function(a){ return a.format===k; }).length; });

  document.getElementById('libStateRail').querySelectorAll('[data-ls]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){ S.libState = b.dataset.ls; S.libOffset=0; renderLibrary(); });
  });
  document.getElementById('libKindRail').querySelectorAll('[data-lk]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){ S.libKind = b.dataset.lk; S.libOffset=0; renderLibrary(); });
  });
  document.getElementById('libFormatRail').querySelectorAll('[data-lf]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){ S.libFormat = b.dataset.lf; S.libOffset=0; renderLibrary(); });
  });

  var kitSel = document.getElementById('libKit');
  kitSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">any</option>' + byPartner(KITS).map(function(k){
    return '<option value="' + esc(k.id) + '"' + (S.libKit===k.id?' selected':'') + '>' + esc(k.name) + '</option>';
  }).join('');
}

var RATIO = {'1x1':'1 / 1', '4x5':'4 / 5', '9x16':'9 / 16', '16x9':'16 / 9'};

/* One tile shape, because the endpoint gives the screen no way to tell a stored
   object from a missing one — redact() strips has_storage_key. The second line is
   derived from `kind`, which IS returned. */
function assetCard(a){
  /* Copy has no file, so it has no preview image — it has the words
     themselves. a.copy_text is null only while a job is still running or
     when it was never written, which is genuinely "not ready yet", not a
     UI bug, so the placeholder line only shows then. */
  var body = a.kind==='copy'
    ? (a.copy_text ? '<div class="copy-snippet">' + esc(a.copy_text) + '</div>' : '<span class="np">no words saved yet</span>')
    : '<span class="np">no preview available<br>no file on this screen</span>';
  var tile = '<div class="tile none" style="aspect-ratio:' + RATIO[a.format] + '">' +
      body +
      '<span class="fmt" style="background:var(--soft);color:var(--gray);border:1px solid var(--line)">' + esc(a.format) + '</span>' +
      (a.duration_sec ? '<span class="dur" style="background:var(--soft);color:var(--gray);border:1px solid var(--line)">' + esc(a.duration_sec) + 's</span>' : '') +
    '</div>';
  var flags = '';
  if(a.ai_generated) flags += '<span class="flag ai">AI-generated</span>';
  else flags += '<span class="flag">not AI</span>';
  if(a.synthetic_performer) flags += '<span class="flag synth">Synthetic performer</span>';
  if(a.parent_asset_id) flags += '<span class="flag derived">derived</span>';

  return '<button type="button" class="acard st-' + a.compliance_state + '" data-asset="' + esc(a.id) + '">' +
    tile +
    '<div class="ameta">' +
      '<div class="an">' + esc(a.kind) + ' · ' + esc(a.provider) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="ak">' + esc(kitName(a.brand_kit_id) || 'no brand kit') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="aflags">' +
        '<span class="badge ' + LIB_BADGE[a.compliance_state] + '" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);padding:2px 5px">' + esc(a.compliance_state) + '</span>' +
        flags +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="ak mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray2);margin-top:6px">' + esc(fmt(a.created_at)) + ' · ' + esc(shortId(a.id)) + '</div>' +
    '</div>' +
  '</button>';
}

function renderLibrary(){
  renderLibFilters();
  var rows = libRows();
  var pg = page(rows, S.libLimit, S.libOffset);
  var grid = document.getElementById('libGrid');

  var blocked = panelState('assets');
  if(blocked){
    grid.innerHTML = '<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">' + blocked + '</div>';
  } else if(!pg.items.length){
    grid.innerHTML = '<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">' + libEmptyMsg() + '</div>';
  } else {
    grid.innerHTML = pg.items.map(assetCard).join('');
    grid.querySelectorAll('[data-asset]').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click', function(){ openAsset(assetById(b.dataset.asset)); });
    });
  }
  document.getElementById('libCount').textContent = blocked ? 'not loaded' : pg.count + ' on this page';
  renderPager('libPager', pg, function(d){
    S.libOffset = Math.max(0, S.libOffset + d * S.libLimit); renderLibrary();
  });
  renderActionPicker();
}

/* §5/§8 — approve / reject / archive act on a creative chosen from the library
   this screen already read, never on a uuid a human retyped. No extra read: the
   options are the rows already in hand, so an unread library offers none. */
function renderActionPicker(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('actAsset');
  if(!sel) return;
  var keep = sel.value;
  var rows = panelState('assets') ? [] : byPartner(ASSETS);
  if(!rows.length){
    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">No creatives loaded for this partner</option>';
    return;
  }
  sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Choose a creative…</option>' + rows.map(function(a){
    var label = a.kind + ' · ' + a.format + ' · ' + a.compliance_state +
      (a.archived_at ? ' · archived' : '') + ' · ' + shortId(a.id);
    return '<option value="' + esc(a.id) + '"' + (keep===a.id?' selected':'') + '>' + esc(label) + '</option>';
  }).join('');
}

/* The exact consequence of each write, named before it is sent. */
var ACTION_CONFIRM = {
  approve: 'Approve this creative? It will be marked approved for this partner.',
  reject: 'Reject this creative? It will be marked blocked and cannot be used.',
  archive: 'Archive this creative? It will be hidden from the library unless archived items are shown.'
};

function libEmptyMsg(){
  return 'No assets match this filter for this partner.';
}

/* ══ CF-06 · REVIEW &amp; APPROVAL QUEUE ══════════════════════════════════ */

/* WHAT EACH ROW IS, IN WORDS. api/creative/approvals.mjs returns three item_type
   values and all three are database words. 'partner_brand' is the NAME OF A
   TABLE, and it was being printed straight into the first column, so the person
   reading the queue literally saw "partner_brand". Nothing here prints the raw
   value — an item_type this map does not know reads as a neutral word instead. */
var ITEM_WORDS = {
  creative_asset: 'Creative',
  campaign:       'Campaign',
  partner_brand:  'Brand'
};
function itemWord(t){ return ITEM_WORDS[t] || 'Item'; }

function apprRows(){
  var want = S.apprState;
  if(APPROVALS_LIVE){
    return APPROVALS_LIVE.filter(function(r){
      if(want==='all') return true;
      /* Brands belong under this filter too. approvals.mjs sets wantBrands for
         'awaiting_approval' (line 33) and returns them, so keeping them out here
         threw away rows the server had already sent — the count on the button
         and the queue below it both read low. */
      if(want==='awaiting_approval') return r.item_type==='campaign' || r.item_type==='partner_brand';
      return r.item_type==='creative_asset' && r.state===want;
    }).slice().sort(function(a,b){ return a.updated_at < b.updated_at ? 1 : a.updated_at > b.updated_at ? -1 : 0; });
  }
  var out = [];
  if(want==='all' || want==='blocked' || want==='pending'){
    byPartner(ASSETS).forEach(function(a){
      if(a.archived_at) return;
      if(a.compliance_state!=='pending' && a.compliance_state!=='blocked') return;
      if(want!=='all' && a.compliance_state!==want) return;
      out.push({item_type:'creative_asset', id:a.id, state:a.compliance_state,
        subtype:a.kind, detail:a.format, reasons:a.blocked_reasons,
        budget_cents:null, offer_type:null, platform:null,
        /* updated_at, not created_at: the asset branch of approvals.mjs selects
           a.updated_at and no created_at at all, and the whole UNION is ordered
           q.updated_at DESC (approvals.mjs:51). On every generated asset it is
           strictly later than created_at — storeAsset() UPDATEs the row it just
           inserted, under the set_updated_at trigger. */
        ai_generated:a.ai_generated, synthetic_performer:a.synthetic_performer,
        updated_at:a.updated_at, _asset:a});
    });
  }
  /* The campaign branch of this queue exists only in the approvals response. With
     that read unavailable there are no campaign rows to show — and none to invent. */
  out.sort(function(a,b){ return a.updated_at < b.updated_at ? 1 : a.updated_at > b.updated_at ? -1 : 0; });
  return out;
}

function renderApprRail(){
  var host = document.getElementById('apprRail');
  var opts = [{k:'all',t:'all'},{k:'blocked',t:'blocked'},{k:'pending',t:'pending'},{k:'awaiting_approval',t:'awaiting_approval'}];
  var off = !!panelState('approvals');
  host.innerHTML = '<span class="rl">State</span>' + opts.map(function(o){
    var saved = S.apprState; S.apprState = o.k;
    var n = apprRows().length; S.apprState = saved;
    return '<button data-as="' + o.k + '" class="' + (S.apprState===o.k?'on':'') + '">' + o.t +
      (off ? '' : '<span class="n">' + n + '</span>') + '</button>';
  }).join('');
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-as]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){ S.apprState = b.dataset.as; S.apprOffset=0; renderApprovals(); });
  });
}

function renderApprovals(){
  renderApprRail();
  var rows = apprRows();
  var pg = page(rows, S.apprLimit, S.apprOffset);
  var body = document.getElementById('apprBody');

  var blocked = panelState('approvals');
  if(blocked){
    body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10"><div class="empty">' + blocked + '</div></td></tr>';
  } else if(!pg.items.length){
    body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10"><div class="empty">Nothing in the queue for this filter.</div></td></tr>';
  } else {
    body.innerHTML = pg.items.map(function(r){
      var isAsset = r.item_type==='creative_asset';
      var stripe = r.state==='blocked' ? 'stripe-bad' : (r.state==='pending' ? 'stripe-warn' : 'stripe-info');
      var badge = r.state==='blocked' ? 'b-alert' : (r.state==='pending' ? 'b-warn' : 'b-info');
      var flags = isAsset
        ? (r.ai_generated ? '<span class="flag ai">AI</span>' : '<span class="flag">not AI</span>') +
          (r.synthetic_performer ? '<span class="flag synth">synthetic</span>' : '')
        : '';
      var nReasons = (r.reasons||[]).length;
      return '<tr class="rowbtn ' + stripe + '" data-appr="' + esc(r.id) + '" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">' +
        '<td><span class="chev">▸</span><span>' + esc(itemWord(r.item_type)) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="sub">' + esc(shortId(r.id)) + '</span></td>' +
        '<td><span class="badge ' + badge + '">' + esc(r.state) + '</span></td>' +
        '<td class="mono">' + (r.subtype ? esc(r.subtype) : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.detail) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mnum">' + (nReasons ? nReasons + (isAsset ? ' reason' : ' screening') + (nReasons===1?'':'s') : '<span class="nul">none</span>') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mnum">' + (r.budget_cents==null ? '' : esc(money(r.budget_cents))) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mono">' + (r.offer_type ? esc(r.offer_type) : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mono">' + (r.platform ? esc(r.platform) : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td><div class="aflags" style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap">' + flags + '</div></td>' +
        '<td class="mono">' + esc(fmt(r.updated_at)) + '</td>' +
      '</tr>';
    }).join('');
    wireExpand(body, '[data-appr]', apprDetail, function(tr){
      var id = tr.dataset.appr;
      for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){ if(rows[i].id===id) return rows[i]; }
      return null;
    });
  }

  renderPager('apprPager', pg, function(d){
    S.apprOffset = Math.max(0, S.apprOffset + d * S.apprLimit); renderApprovals();
  });
}

/* One reason, in plain words. The statute behind it is NOT shown here — it lives
   in docs/rules/compliance/creative-block-reasons.md. The reason code stays as a small
   muted reference so a person can look the reason up in that file. */
function reasonCard(rz){
  var cls = 'rz' + (rz.rule_set==='approval' ? ' set-approval' : (rz.rule_set==='engine' ? ' set-engine' : ''));
  return '<div class="' + cls + '">' +
    '<div class="rzm">' + esc(rz.message) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="rzq">reference: ' + esc(rz.code) + '</div>' +
    (rz.detail ? '<div class="rzd">More detail: ' + esc(rz.detail) + '</div>' : '') +
  '</div>';
}

var SCREEN_STATE_WORDS = {
  blocked: 'Stopped',
  needs_approval: 'Waiting for a person',
  passed: 'Cleared'
};

function apprDetail(r){
  var isCampaign = r.item_type === 'campaign';
  var isBrand    = r.item_type === 'partner_brand';
  var out = '<div class="detwrap">';
  out += '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">Item</div><div class="dv">' +
    esc(itemWord(r.item_type)) + '</div></div>';

  /* A BRAND GETS ITS OWN BRANCH. It is not a creative and not a campaign: it
     carries no compliance reasons, no budget, no offer, no platform and no AI
     labels, because approvals.mjs selects NULL for every one of those columns on
     this arm. Without this branch it fell through to the creative branch and
     rendered a row of empty boxes plus an "Open the full creative" button that
     points at something that is not a creative. */
  if(isBrand){
    out += '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">Business name</div><div class="dv">' +
      (r.detail ? esc(r.detail) : nul('not filled in')) + '</div></div>';
    out += '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">In the queue since</div><div class="dv mono">' +
      esc(fmt(r.updated_at)) + '</div></div>';
    out += '<div class="detfull"><p class="note" style="margin-top:6px">' +
      '<b>A partner sent their own brand in to be checked.</b> That is their logo, colours, wording and ' +
      'business details — not an advert. The advert rules have not been run on it, so there is nothing ' +
      'flagged to show and no reason list.</p></div>';
    /* THE TWO BUTTONS, AND THE PARTNER THEY ACT ON.
       api/brand/review.mjs wants a partner_id. r.id is NOT it — the brand arm of
       api/creative/approvals.mjs selects b.id, the brand row's own id. The
       partner is the one this whole screen is scoped to: that arm reads
       WHERE b.partner_id = the partner_id in the request, so any brand row on
       screen belongs to exactly that partner. tagPartner() stamps that partner's
       index onto every row, so it is read back off the row rather than off
       whatever happens to be selected when the button is pressed. */
    var bpid = null;
    try { if(PARTNERS[r.partner]) bpid = PARTNERS[r.partner].id; } catch(e){}
    if(!bpid) bpid = currentPartnerId();

    /* WHO SEES THE BUTTONS. approve and reject are owner/admin only, refused on
       the server before any row is read (api/brand/review.mjs). Partners reach
       this screen too — shell.js lists creative-factory.html in ROLE_TABS.partner
       as well as in OWNER_ADMIN_ONLY, and OWNER_ADMIN_ONLY is subtracted inside
       staffTabs() only, so it hides the row from non-owner STAFF and says nothing
       about partners. Hiding a control is not a gate; the server is the gate.
       This only stops a partner being shown a button that can only refuse. Same
       idiom, and the same cached role, as brand-studio.html's Verify button. */
    var vrole = '';
    try { vrole = String(localStorage.getItem('fh_role') || '').trim().toLowerCase(); } catch(e){}
    var canReview = (vrole === 'owner' || vrole === 'admin');

    if(canReview){
      out += '<div class="detfull" data-brand-box style="margin-top:6px">' +
        '<p class="note">Approve it if the logo, colours and business details look right to go out under ' +
        'the Fundhub name. Send it back if something needs changing — that puts it back to a draft the ' +
        'partner can edit and send in again.</p>' +
        '<div class="field" style="max-width:520px;margin:6px 0">' +
          '<label for="brNote-' + esc(r.id) + '">Reason for sending it back</label>' +
          '<input id="brNote-' + esc(r.id) + '" data-brand-note maxlength="2000" ' +
            'placeholder="What needs changing before this can be approved">' +
        '</div>' +
        /* THE REASON IS SAVED, NOT DELIVERED. It is written to the brand record,
           and nothing shows it to the partner — brand-studio.html never reads it
           back (grep: review_note appears in no screen file). Saying "the partner
           reads this" here would be the reassuring kind of lie. */
        '<p class="note" style="color:var(--gray2)">The reason is kept with the brand. It is not sent to ' +
        'the partner, and their own Brand Studio screen does not show it yet, so tell them separately.</p>' +
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px">' +
          '<button class="btn dark sm mono" type="button" data-brand-act="approve" ' +
            'data-brand-partner="' + esc(bpid || '') + '">Approve this brand</button>' +
          '<button class="btn sm mono" type="button" data-brand-act="reject" ' +
            'data-brand-partner="' + esc(bpid || '') + '">Send it back</button>' +
          '<span class="hint mono" data-brand-msg style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray2)"></span>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    } else {
      out += '<div class="detfull"><p class="note" style="color:var(--gray2)">' +
        'Only a Fundhub owner or admin can approve a brand or send it back, so there are no buttons here ' +
        'for this sign-in. This queue shows you that a brand is waiting.</p></div>';
    }
    return out + '</div>';
  }

  out += '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">Reference</div><div class="dv mono">' + esc(r.id) + '</div></div>';
  out += '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">' + (isCampaign ? 'Strategy' : 'Kind') + '</div><div class="dv mono">' +
    (r.subtype ? esc(r.subtype) : nul('—')) + '</div></div>';
  out += '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">' + (isCampaign ? 'Name' : 'Shape') + '</div><div class="dv">' +
    esc(r.detail) + '</div></div>';

  if(isCampaign){
    out += '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">Budget</div><div class="dv mono">' +
      (r.budget_cents==null ? nul('—') : esc(money(r.budget_cents))) + '</div></div>';
    out += '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">Offer</div><div class="dv mono">' + esc(r.offer_type) + '</div></div>';
    out += '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">Where it runs</div><div class="dv mono">' +
      (r.platform ? esc(r.platform) : nul('anywhere')) + '</div></div>';
    out += '<div class="detfull"><p class="note" style="margin:8px 0 4px"><b>Every check this campaign has been through</b>, newest last.</p>';
    out += (r.reasons||[]).map(function(s){
      var inner = (s.message||[]);
      return '<div style="margin-bottom:8px">' +
        '<div class="badge ' + (s.code==='blocked'?'b-alert':(s.code==='needs_approval'?'b-info':'b-ok')) + '" style="margin-bottom:6px">' +
          esc(SCREEN_STATE_WORDS[s.code] || s.code) + '</div>' +
        (inner.length ? '<div class="reasons">' + inner.map(reasonCard).join('') + '</div>'
                      : '<div class="note">Nothing was flagged in this check.</div>') +
      '</div>';
    }).join('') || '<div class="note">This campaign has not been checked yet.</div>';
    out += '</div>';
    if(r.offer_type==='credit_repair'){
      out += '<div class="detfull"><p class="note"><b>This one cannot be waved through.</b> A credit-repair ' +
        'campaign needs a named person to approve it before it can go live, and it cannot go live at all ' +
        'until the required consumer-rights notice is attached to it.</p></div>';
    }
  } else {
    out += '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">AI-generated</div><div class="dv">' + (r.ai_generated ? 'Yes' : 'No') + '</div></div>';
    out += '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">Synthetic performer</div><div class="dv">' + (r.synthetic_performer ? 'Yes' : 'No') + '</div></div>';
    out += '<div class="detfull" style="margin-top:6px">';
    out += (r.reasons||[]).length
      ? '<div class="reasons">' + r.reasons.map(reasonCard).join('') + '</div>'
      : '<p class="note">Nothing is flagged on this creative. It is waiting to be checked — it is not ' +
        'stopped, and it is not ready to use either.</p>';
    out += '</div>';
    out += '<div class="detfull"><button class="btn sm mono" data-open-asset="' + esc(r.id) + '">Open the full creative</button></div>';
  }
  out += '<div class="detfull"><p class="note" style="color:var(--gray2)">' +
    (isCampaign
      ? 'A campaign carries no AI labels — those belong to a single creative.'
      : 'A creative carries no budget, offer or platform — those belong to a campaign.') +
    '</p></div>';
  return out + '</div>';
}

/* ══ WHY CREATIVE GETS STOPPED ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Plain words only. No statute numbers, no rule-set names, no match type and no
   severity column — that table now lives in docs/rules/compliance/creative-block-reasons.md.
   Every message below is still verbatim from the code that enforces it. */
var OFFER_WORDS    = { credit_repair:'Credit repair', credit_cards:'Credit cards', funding:'Funding' };
var PLATFORM_WORDS = { tiktok:'TikTok', meta:'Meta ads', google:'Google ads' };

function appliesTo(r){
  var who = r.offers.length
    ? r.offers.map(function(o){ return OFFER_WORDS[o] || o; }).join(', ')
    : 'Any offer';
  if(r.platforms.length){
    who += ' · ' + r.platforms.map(function(p){ return PLATFORM_WORDS[p] || p; }).join(', ');
  }
  return who;
}

function whoSetsIt(r){
  if(r.src === 'seeded')    return 'Set by us — can be changed';
  if(r.src === 'targeting') return "Meta's own rule — cannot be changed";
  return 'Built in — cannot be changed';
}

function renderRules(){
  document.getElementById('ruleBody').innerHTML = RULES.map(function(r){
    /* The stripe follows the answer the code actually produces: two of these hold
       the work for a person, the other twenty-seven stop it. */
    var holds = r.verdict === 'needs_approval';
    return '<tr class="' + (holds ? 'stripe-info' : 'stripe-bad') + '">' +
      '<td>' + esc(appliesTo(r)) + '</td>' +
      '<td>' + esc(r.message) +
        (holds ? '<span class="sub">Holds the work for a person. Does not stop it.</span>' : '') +
        '<span class="sub">' + esc(r.code) + '</span></td>' +
      '<td>' + esc(whoSetsIt(r)) + '</td>' +
    '</tr>';
  }).join('');
}

/* ══ CF-08 · BRAND KITS ══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function isColor(v){ return typeof v === 'string' && /^#[0-9a-f]{3,8}$/i.test(v); }
function swatches(palette){
  var out = [];
  Object.keys(palette||{}).forEach(function(k){
    var v = palette[k];
    if(isColor(v)) out.push({k:k, v:v});
    else if(Array.isArray(v)) v.forEach(function(x,i){ if(isColor(x)) out.push({k:k+'['+i+']', v:x}); });
  });
  return out;
}
function renderKits(){
  var host = document.getElementById('kitRail');
  var mine = byPartner(KITS);
  var off = !!panelState('kits');
  host.innerHTML = '<span class="rl">State</span>' + ['all'].concat(KIT_STATES).map(function(s){
    var n = s==='all' ? mine.length : mine.filter(function(k){ return k.status===s; }).length;
    return '<button data-ks="' + s + '" class="' + (S.kitState===s?'on':'') + '">' + s +
      (off ? '' : '<span class="n">' + n + '</span>') + '</button>';
  }).join('');
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-ks]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){ S.kitState = b.dataset.ks; S.kitOffset=0; renderKits(); });
  });

  var rows = mine.filter(function(k){ return S.kitState==='all' || k.status===S.kitState; });
  var pg = page(rows, S.kitLimit, S.kitOffset);
  var grid = document.getElementById('kitGrid');

  var blocked = panelState('kits');
  if(blocked){
    grid.innerHTML = '<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">' + blocked + '</div>';
  } else if(!pg.items.length){
    grid.innerHTML = '<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">No brand kits match this filter for this partner.</div>';
  } else {
    grid.innerHTML = pg.items.map(function(k){
      var sw = swatches(k.palette);
      var fontKeys = Object.keys(k.fonts||{});
      return '<button type="button" class="kit" data-kit="' + esc(k.id) + '">' +
        '<div class="kh">' +
          '<span class="kn">' + esc(k.name) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="badge ' + KIT_BADGE[k.status] + '">' + esc(k.status) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="spacer"></span>' +
          '<span class="badge b-gray">' + k.asset_count + ' assets</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        (sw.length
          ? '<div class="sw">' + sw.map(function(s){ return '<i style="background:' + esc(s.v) + '" title="' + esc(s.k + ' ' + s.v) + '"></i>'; }).join('') + '</div>'
          : '<div class="kk" style="margin-top:8px">No colors in this kit.</div>') +
        '<div class="kk">' +
          '<b>Tone</b> ' + (k.voice_profile && k.voice_profile.tone ? esc(k.voice_profile.tone) : '<span class="nul">not set</span>') + '<br>' +
          '<b>Fonts</b> ' + (fontKeys.length ? esc(fontKeys.map(function(f){ return f + ': ' + k.fonts[f]; }).join(' · ')) : '<span class="nul">none</span>') + '<br>' +
          '<b>Products</b> ' + ((k.products||[]).length ? (k.products.length + ' item' + (k.products.length===1?'':'s')) : '<span class="nul">none</span>') + '<br>' +
          '<b>Logo</b> ' + (k.logo_asset_id ? esc(shortId(k.logo_asset_id)) + ' <span class="nul">(reference, not a picture)</span>' : '<span class="nul">none</span>') +
        '</div>' +
      '</button>';
    }).join('');
    grid.querySelectorAll('[data-kit]').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click', function(){
        for(var i=0;i<KITS.length;i++){ if(KITS[i].id===b.dataset.kit) return openKit(KITS[i]); }
      });
    });
  }
  renderPager('kitPager', pg, function(d){
    S.kitOffset = Math.max(0, S.kitOffset + d * S.kitLimit); renderKits();
  });
}

/* ══ STATIC REFERENCE TABLES ═════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderStaticTables(){
  document.getElementById('flagBody').innerHTML = PROVIDER_FLAGS.map(function(p){
    var badge = function(v){
      var cls = v==='always' ? 'b-ok' : (v==='same as original' ? 'b-info' : (v==='never' || v==='usually not' ? 'b-gray' : 'b-accent'));
      return '<span class="badge ' + cls + '">' + esc(v) + '</span>';
    };
    return '<tr><td class="mono">' + esc(p.key) + '</td><td>' + badge(p.ai) + '</td><td>' + badge(p.synth) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="note">' + esc(p.how) + '</td></tr>';
  }).join('');

  document.getElementById('gapsBody').innerHTML = GAPS.map(function(g){
    var badge = g.tone==='bad' ? 'b-alert' : (g.tone==='warn' ? 'b-warn' : 'b-ok');
    return '<tr class="stripe-' + g.tone + '"><td class="mono">' + esc(g.config) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption)">' + esc(g.detail) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="mnum">' + g.rows_set + '</td>' +
      '<td><span class="badge ' + badge + '" style="white-space:normal">' + esc(g.status) + '</span></td>' +
      '<td class="note">' + esc(g.consequence) + '</td></tr>';
  }).join('');

  var ratesBody = document.getElementById('ratesBody');
  if (ratesBody) {
    ratesBody.innerHTML = RATES.map(function(r){
      return '<tr class="stripe-warn"><td class="mono">' + esc(r.rate_key) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mnum">' + esc(r.rate) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="mono">' + nul('—') + '</td>' +
        '<td><span class="badge b-warn" style="white-space:normal">' + esc(r.status) + '</span></td></tr>';
    }).join('');
  }
}

/* ══ DETAIL DRAWER ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var DW = {
  el: null, scrim: null,
  open: function(eyebrow, title, html){
    this.el = this.el || document.getElementById('drawer');
    this.scrim = this.scrim || document.getElementById('scrim');
    document.getElementById('dwEyebrow').innerHTML = eyebrow;
    document.getElementById('dwTitle').textContent = title;
    document.getElementById('dwBody').innerHTML = html;
    this.el.classList.add('on'); this.el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
    this.scrim.classList.add('on');
    document.getElementById('dwClose').focus();
  },
  close: function(){
    if(!this.el) return;
    this.el.classList.remove('on'); this.el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    this.scrim.classList.remove('on');
  }
};
function kv(pairs){
  return '<div class="kv">' + pairs.map(function(p){
    return '<div><div class="k">' + esc(p[0]) + '</div><div class="v' + (p[2]?' mono':'') + '">' +
      (p[1]==null || p[1]==='' ? '<span class="nul">—</span>' : esc(p[1])) + '</div></div>';
  }).join('') + '</div>';
}

function openAsset(a){
  if(!a) return;
  var html = '<div class="dw-sec"><h3>The basics</h3>' + kv([
    ['Kind', a.kind, 1], ['Shape', a.format, 1],
    ['Made by', a.provider, 1], ['Review state', a.compliance_state, 1],
    ['Length', a.duration_sec == null ? null : a.duration_sec + 's', 1],
    ['AI-generated', a.ai_generated ? 'Yes' : 'No', 0],
    ['Synthetic performer', a.synthetic_performer ? 'Yes' : 'No', 0],
    ['Brand kit', kitName(a.brand_kit_id), 0],
    ['Made from', a.parent_asset_id ? shortId(a.parent_asset_id) : null, 1],
    ['Archived', fmt(a.archived_at), 1], ['Created', fmt(a.created_at), 1],
    ['Reference', a.id, 1]
  ]) + '</div>';

  if(a.kind==='copy'){
    /* Written copy has no file to preview — the words are the asset.
       Shown even when blocked: a stopped script is the one Chris has to
       rewrite, and he cannot rewrite what he cannot read. */
    html += '<div class="dw-sec"><h3>The words</h3>' +
      (a.copy_text
        ? '<div class="copy-body">' + esc(a.copy_text) + '</div>'
        : '<p class="note">Nothing saved yet. The job may still be running, or it failed before it wrote anything.</p>') +
    '</div>';
  } else {
    html += '<div class="dw-sec"><h3>Preview</h3>' +
      '<div style="max-width:230px">' +
      '<div class="tile none" style="aspect-ratio:' + RATIO[a.format] + ';border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--line)"><span class="np">no preview available</span></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<p class="note" style="margin-top:9px">' +
        'The file itself is never sent to this screen, so no preview can be shown and this screen cannot even ' +
        'tell whether a file was saved.' +
      '</p>' +
      '<p class="note" style="margin-top:7px;color:var(--gray2)">Shape <b>' + esc(a.format) +
        '</b>. Exact pixel sizes are not recorded.</p>' +
    '</div>';
  }

  html += '<div class="dw-sec"><h3>Disclosure flags</h3>' +
    '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap">' +
      (a.ai_generated ? '<span class="flag ai">AI-generated</span>' : '<span class="flag">not AI-generated</span>') +
      (a.synthetic_performer ? '<span class="flag synth">Synthetic performer</span>' : '<span class="flag">no synthetic performer</span>') +
      (a.parent_asset_id ? '<span class="flag derived">derived from ' + esc(shortId(a.parent_asset_id)) + '</span>' : '') +
    '</div>' +
    '<p class="note" style="margin-top:9px">' + flagExplain(a) + '</p></div>';

  html += '<div class="dw-sec"><h3>Why it was stopped</h3>' +
    (a.blocked_reasons.length
      ? '<div class="reasons">' + a.blocked_reasons.map(reasonCard).join('') + '</div>' +
        '<p class="note" style="margin-top:9px">A stopped creative always says why. There is no score and no ' +
        'risk level, only the reasons listed above.</p>'
      : '<p class="note">None. This creative is not stopped.</p>') +
  '</div>';

  DW.open('Creative detail', a.kind + ' · ' + a.format + ' · ' + shortId(a.id), html);
}

function flagExplain(a){
  if(a.provider==='ugc-video')
    return 'This kind of video always shows a synthetic person, and anything showing one is always marked ' +
      'AI-generated as well.';
  if(a.provider==='resize')
    return 'Both labels are carried over from the original creative: a crop of an AI image is still AI, and a ' +
      'crop of a synthetic presenter still shows one.';
  if(a.provider==='copy')
    return 'Written copy is always machine-made, and a line of text has no performer.';
  if(!a.ai_generated)
    return 'Marked as not AI-generated. Nothing on this screen can produce that, so it came from somewhere else.';
  return 'Everything generated here is machine-made, so it is always marked AI-generated. Only "synthetic ' +
    'performer" varies with what was asked for.';
}

/* A plain list of whatever the kit actually holds. No raw JSON is shown at a
   person — but nothing is added either: an empty kit says it is empty. */
function plainPairs(obj){
  var keys = Object.keys(obj || {});
  if(!keys.length) return '<p class="note">Nothing set.</p>';
  return '<div class="kv">' + keys.map(function(k){
    var v = obj[k];
    if(v && typeof v === 'object') v = Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(', ') : JSON.stringify(v);
    return '<div><div class="k">' + esc(k) + '</div><div class="v">' +
      (v == null || v === '' ? '<span class="nul">—</span>' : esc(String(v))) + '</div></div>';
  }).join('') + '</div>';
}
function plainList(items){
  if(!(items || []).length) return '<p class="note">None.</p>';
  return '<div class="kv">' + items.map(function(it, i){
    var v = (it && typeof it === 'object') ? (it.name || it.title || JSON.stringify(it)) : String(it);
    return '<div><div class="k">' + (i + 1) + '</div><div class="v">' + esc(v) + '</div></div>';
  }).join('') + '</div>';
}

function openKit(k){
  var sw = swatches(k.palette);
  var html = '<div class="dw-sec"><h3>The basics</h3>' + kv([
    ['Name', k.name, 0], ['Status', k.status, 1],
    ['Creatives using it', String(k.asset_count), 1],
    ['Website it came from', k.source_url, 1], ['Last read', fmt(k.scraped_at), 1],
    ['Logo', k.logo_asset_id ? shortId(k.logo_asset_id) + ' (a reference, not a picture)' : null, 1],
    ['Created', fmt(k.created_at), 1], ['Updated', fmt(k.updated_at), 1],
    ['Reference', k.id, 1]
  ]) + '</div>';

  html += '<div class="dw-sec"><h3>Colours</h3>' +
    (sw.length ? '<div class="sw" style="margin-top:0">' + sw.map(function(s){
        return '<i style="background:' + esc(s.v) + '" title="' + esc(s.k + ' ' + s.v) + '"></i>';
      }).join('') + '</div>' : '') +
    plainPairs(k.palette) + '</div>';

  html += '<div class="dw-sec"><h3>Fonts</h3>' + plainPairs(k.fonts) + '</div>';

  html += '<div class="dw-sec"><h3>Voice</h3>' + plainPairs(k.voice_profile) +
    '<p class="note" style="margin-top:8px">Only the tone is used when creative is made.</p></div>';

  html += '<div class="dw-sec"><h3>Products</h3>' + plainList(k.products) + '</div>';

  html += '<div class="dw-sec"><h3>Where this came from</h3>' +
    '<div class="unwired"><div class="uh"><span>⚠</span><span>no history</span></div>' +
    '<div class="ub">Nothing reads a partner\'s website today, so there is no source list, no freshness ' +
    'date, no version history and no undo.</div></div></div>';

  html += '<div class="dw-sec"><h3>About the count</h3><p class="note">"Creatives using it" counts every ' +
    'creative on this kit that has not been archived. It is the full count. The library grid above only ' +
    'shows one page at a time, so filtering the library by this kit will usually show fewer.</p></div>';

  DW.open('Brand kit', k.name, html);
}

/* The Script picker on the Generate form, rebuilt from the scripts read back by
   /api/scripts/list. "— none —" is rebuilt with it because picking no script is a
   real answer, not an empty state.

   THE LABEL IS THE SAME FORMULA THE SAVE USES — scriptLabel() below is called by
   both, not copied into both, so one script reads identically before and after a
   reload. Two spellings of one label look like two scripts.

   WHATEVER WAS PICKED STAYS PICKED, AND ONLY WHILE IT IS STILL ON OFFER. The
   value is read first and put back, so a render fired by something unrelated does
   not quietly unpick the script somebody just chose. An id this list no longer
   holds is NOT carried over: after a partner switch that would leave the previous
   partner's script sitting in this partner's picker, which is the one thing a
   partner-scoped screen must never do. The save below keeps SCRIPTS in step so
   nothing has to be carried. */
function renderScriptPicker(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('genScript');
  if(!sel) return;
  var prev = sel.value;
  sel.innerHTML = '';
  var none = document.createElement('option');
  none.value = '';
  none.textContent = '— none —';
  sel.appendChild(none);
  (SCRIPTS || []).forEach(function(s){
    if(!s || !s.id) return;
    var o = document.createElement('option');
    o.value = s.id;
    o.textContent = scriptLabel(s.title, s.body_preview, s.version);
    sel.appendChild(o);
  });
  /* Setting a value no option carries leaves the picker on "— none —", which is
     the honest answer: that script is not this partner's to pick. */
  sel.value = prev;
}

/* One label formula, for the picker above and for the save that appends to it. */
function scriptLabel(title, words, version){
  return (title || String(words || '').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0, 48) || 'untitled')
    + ' · v' + (version == null ? '1' : version);
}

function renderAll(){
  renderScope();
  renderStats();
  renderJobs();
  renderLegend();
  renderLibrary();
  renderApprovals();
  renderKits();
  renderScriptPicker();
  var p = currentPartner();
  document.getElementById('footNote').textContent =
    'creative factory · ' + (p ? String(p.name).toLowerCase() : 'no partner selected');
}

/* ══ API WIRING ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   data.js's FHData exposes readers for /api/read/* and /api/dashboard/*, not
   for /api/creative/* (those live at their own paths, under partnerReadHandler,
   not read-api.mjs's requireAuth), so the same { ok, source, data, error }
   envelope is reproduced here — same pattern hiring.html and campaign-manager.html
   use for the same reason.

   Every one of these four endpoints requires ?partner_id= for a staff caller
   (src/http/partner-read-api.mjs resolvePartnerId — a staff session with none
   gets a 400, never "everything"), so every read below is scoped to the one
   partner named in this page's address. With none named, nothing is requested. */
function apiGet(path){
  var demo = false, tok = '';
  try { demo = localStorage.getItem('fh_demo') === '1'; tok = localStorage.getItem('fh_token') || ''; } catch(e){}
  if(demo) return Promise.resolve({ ok:false, source:'demo', data:null, error:'this is a demo session, so nothing was requested' });
  var started;
  try {
    started = fetch(path, { headers: tok ? { accept:'application/json', authorization:'Bearer '+tok } : { accept:'application/json' } });
  } catch(e){
    return Promise.resolve({ ok:false, source:'offline', data:null, error:'this computer could not reach fundhub' });
  }
  return Promise.resolve(started).then(function(r){
    if(r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) return { ok:false, source:'unauthorized', data:null, error:'this sign-in is not allowed to see this partner' };
    if(r.status === 404){
      return r.json().then(function(d){
        return (d && d.error === 'not_found' && typeof d.path === 'string')
          ? { ok:false, source:'offline', data:null, error:'this part of fundhub is not switched on yet' }
          : { ok:false, source:'notfound', data:null, error:'there is nothing on file for this' };
      }).catch(function(){ return { ok:false, source:'offline', data:null, error:'this part of fundhub is not switched on yet' }; });
    }
    if(r.status === 400){
      return r.json().then(function(d){
        return { ok:false, source:'badrequest', data:null, error:(d && d.message) || 'That request was not accepted.' };
      }).catch(function(){ return { ok:false, source:'badrequest', data:null, error:'bad request' }; });
    }
    return r.json().then(function(d){
      if(r.status === 503 || (d && d.db === 'down')) return { ok:false, source:'nodb', data:null, error:(d && d.message) || 'The database is not reachable right now.' };
      if(!d || d.ok !== true) return { ok:false, source:'server', data:null, error:(d && d.message) || 'Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.' };
      return { ok:true, source:'api', data:d, error:null };
    }).catch(function(){ return { ok:false, source:'offline', data:null, error:'the answer came back in a form this screen could not read' }; });
  }).catch(function(e){
    return { ok:false, source:'offline', data:null, error:'the connection dropped' };
  });
}

/* The one thing no endpoint returns is which partner index the row belongs to,
   because the server only ever answers for the one partner_id in the request —
   so that is stamped on here. */
function tagPartner(items){ return (items||[]).map(function(r){ r.partner = S.partner; return r; }); }

var LIVE_CF = {kits:false, jobs:false, assets:false, approvals:false, scripts:false};
var APPROVALS_LIVE = null; // null = the approvals read has not answered; derive the asset rows from ASSETS
var CF_SRC = [];
var CF_ENDPOINT_RES = {};

function wireCreative(){
  var demo=false; try{ demo = localStorage.getItem('fh_demo')==='1'; }catch(e){}
  if(demo){
    /* A demo session queries nothing. There is no sample book to stand in for a
       real one, so the panels show their empty state and say why (§6). */
    KITS=[]; JOBS=[]; ASSETS=[]; SCRIPTS=[]; APPROVALS_LIVE=null;
    CF_ENDPOINT_RES = {
      jobs:{ok:false, source:'demo', data:null, error:'this is a demo sign-in, so nothing was loaded'},
      assets:{ok:false, source:'demo', data:null, error:'this is a demo sign-in, so nothing was loaded'},
      kits:{ok:false, source:'demo', data:null, error:'this is a demo sign-in, so nothing was loaded'},
      approvals:{ok:false, source:'demo', data:null, error:'this is a demo sign-in, so nothing was loaded'},
      scripts:{ok:false, source:'demo', data:null, error:'this is a demo sign-in, so nothing was loaded'}
    };
    CF_SRC = ['demo session — nothing read'];
    if(window.FHData) FHData.banner('sample','creative factory — this is a demo sign-in, so nothing was loaded','creative');
    renderAll();
    return;
  }
  var pid = currentPartnerId();
  if(!pid){
    /* No partner named — issuing these reads with a stand-in id is what this
       screen used to do. Now it asks for nothing and says so. */
    KITS=[]; JOBS=[]; ASSETS=[]; SCRIPTS=[]; APPROVALS_LIVE=null;
    CF_ENDPOINT_RES = {};
    CF_SRC = ['no partner selected — nothing requested'];
    renderAll();
    if(window.FHData) FHData.banner('sample','creative factory · pick a partner to load anything','creative');
    return;
  }
  Promise.all([
    apiGet('/api/creative/jobs?partner_id='+encodeURIComponent(pid)+'&state=all&limit=200').then(function(res){
      CF_ENDPOINT_RES.jobs=res;
      if(res.ok){ LIVE_CF.jobs=true; JOBS=tagPartner(res.data.items||[]); } else { JOBS=[]; }
    }),
    apiGet('/api/creative/library?partner_id='+encodeURIComponent(pid)+'&state=all&include_archived=1&limit=200').then(function(res){
      CF_ENDPOINT_RES.assets=res;
      if(res.ok){ LIVE_CF.assets=true; ASSETS=tagPartner(res.data.items||[]); } else { ASSETS=[]; }
    }),
    apiGet('/api/creative/brand-kits?partner_id='+encodeURIComponent(pid)+'&state=all&limit=200').then(function(res){
      CF_ENDPOINT_RES.kits=res;
      if(res.ok){ LIVE_CF.kits=true; KITS=tagPartner(res.data.items||[]); } else { KITS=[]; }
    }),
    apiGet('/api/creative/approvals?partner_id='+encodeURIComponent(pid)+'&state=all&limit=200').then(function(res){
      CF_ENDPOINT_RES.approvals=res;
      if(res.ok){ LIVE_CF.approvals=true; APPROVALS_LIVE=tagPartner(res.data.items); } else { APPROVALS_LIVE=null; }
    }),
    /* The scripts already saved, so the Script picker below Generate holds them
       after a reload and not only in the tab that saved one. Registered in
       CF_ENDPOINT_RES like the four above so the banner says this failed to load
       in words — an empty picker that says nothing is the exact fault being fixed. */
    apiGet('/api/scripts/list?partner_id='+encodeURIComponent(pid)+'&limit=200').then(function(res){
      CF_ENDPOINT_RES.scripts=res;
      if(res.ok){ LIVE_CF.scripts=true; SCRIPTS=res.data.items||[]; } else { SCRIPTS=[]; }
    })
  ]).then(function(){
    /* The banner names the panels that did not load, in words. It never claims
       everything is fine when one of the four did not answer. */
    var PANEL_WORDS = {jobs:'jobs', assets:'library', kits:'brand kits', approvals:'review queue', scripts:'saved scripts'};
    var missing = [];
    CF_SRC = [];
    ['jobs','assets','kits','approvals','scripts'].forEach(function(k){
      var res=CF_ENDPOINT_RES[k];
      if(res && res.ok) CF_SRC.push(k+':api');
      else if(res){ CF_SRC.push(k+':'+res.source); missing.push(PANEL_WORDS[k]); }
    });
    renderAll();
    var worst='real';
    ['jobs','assets','kits','approvals','scripts'].forEach(function(k){
      var res=CF_ENDPOINT_RES[k];
      if(!res || res.ok) return;
      worst = (res.source==='nodb'||res.source==='server'||res.source==='offline') ? 'error' : (worst==='error'?'error':'sample');
    });
    if(window.FHData) FHData.banner(worst, missing.length
      ? 'creative factory · could not load: ' + missing.join(', ')
      : 'creative factory · everything loaded', 'creative');
  });
}

/* ══ VIDEO PERFORMANCE — YouTube watch-time, org-wide ══════════════════════
   Not partner-scoped: analytics_connections/video_watch_stats carry no
   partner_id (302_analytics_connections.sql), so this panel does not read
   S.partner or currentPartnerId() anywhere, and does not reload when the
   partner picker changes. It loads once at boot and again after Connect or
   Sync now. GET /api/read/video-stats, staff-only. */
var VID_RES = null;
var CONN_BADGE = { pending:'b-gray', active:'b-ok', expired:'b-warn', revoked:'b-gray', error:'b-alert' };

/* Over 60 minutes shows hours+minutes; otherwise plain minutes. Never a raw
   decimal — the API returns estimated_minutes_watched as a numeric. */
function fmtWatchTime(mins){
  if(mins==null) return null;
  var m = Math.round(Number(mins));
  if(m > 60){
    var h = Math.floor(m/60), rem = m%60;
    return h + 'h ' + rem + 'm';
  }
  return m + 'm';
}

function renderVideoStats(){
  var badge = document.getElementById('vidConnBadge');
  var cap = document.getElementById('vidConnCap');
  var body = document.getElementById('vidBody');
  if(!badge || !body) return;

  if(!VID_RES){
    badge.className = 'badge b-gray mono';
    badge.textContent = 'loading…';
    cap.textContent = 'Loading the connection…';
    body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="empty">Loading…</div></td></tr>';
    return;
  }
  if(!VID_RES.ok){
    badge.className = 'badge b-alert mono';
    badge.textContent = 'not loaded';
    cap.textContent = 'This could not be loaded just now. ' + plainCreative(VID_RES);
    body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="empty">This could not be loaded just now. ' + esc(plainCreative(VID_RES)) + ' Nothing is shown, rather than an old or made-up number.</div></td></tr>';
    return;
  }
  var d = VID_RES.data || {};
  var conn = d.connection || null;
  if(!conn){
    badge.className = 'badge b-gray mono';
    badge.textContent = 'not connected';
    cap.innerHTML = '<b>Not connected.</b> Fill in the three fields below and press Connect.';
  } else {
    badge.className = 'badge mono ' + (CONN_BADGE[conn.state] || 'b-gray');
    badge.textContent = conn.state;
    if(conn.state !== 'active'){
      cap.innerHTML = '<b>' + esc(conn.state) + '.</b>' +
        (conn.last_error ? ' ' + esc(conn.last_error) : '') +
        (conn.last_synced_at ? ' Last synced ' + esc(fmt(conn.last_synced_at)) + '.' : ' Never synced yet.');
    } else {
      cap.innerHTML = 'Connected. Last synced ' + (conn.last_synced_at ? esc(fmt(conn.last_synced_at)) : 'never') + '.';
    }
  }

  var videos = d.videos || [];
  if(!videos.length){
    body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="empty">No video stats on file yet.</div></td></tr>';
    return;
  }
  body.innerHTML = videos.map(function(v){
    var wt = fmtWatchTime(v.estimated_minutes_watched);
    return '<tr>' +
      '<td>' + (v.video_title ? esc(v.video_title) : nul('untitled')) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="mono">' + esc(v.stat_date) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="mnum">' + (v.views==null ? nul('—') : v.views) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="mnum">' + (wt==null ? nul('—') : esc(wt)) + '</td>' +
      '<td class="mnum">' + (v.average_view_duration_sec==null ? nul('—') : Math.round(v.average_view_duration_sec) + 's') + '</td>' +
      '<td class="mnum">' + (v.average_view_percentage==null ? nul('—') : Number(v.average_view_percentage).toFixed(1) + '%') + '</td>' +
    '</tr>';
  }).join('');
}

function loadVideoStats(){
  VID_RES = null;
  renderVideoStats();
  apiGet('/api/read/video-stats').then(function(res){
    VID_RES = res;
    renderVideoStats();
  });
}

document.getElementById('ytConnectBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
  var msg = document.getElementById('ytConnectMsg');
  var clientId = document.getElementById('ytClientId').value.trim();
  var clientSecret = document.getElementById('ytClientSecret').value.trim();
  var refreshToken = document.getElementById('ytRefreshToken').value.trim();
  if(!clientId || !clientSecret || !refreshToken){ msg.textContent = 'Fill in all three fields first.'; return; }
  msg.textContent = 'Connecting…';
  fetch('/api/analytics/youtube-connect', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: cfAuthHeaders(),
    body: JSON.stringify({ client_id: clientId, client_secret: clientSecret, refresh_token: refreshToken })
  }).then(function(r){ return r.json().catch(function(){ return { ok:false }; }); })
    .then(function(res){
      /* Google's own error message is shown as-is when the server hands one
         back — that is what tells Chris which of the three fields is wrong.
         Only fall back to a translated sentence when there is no message. */
      if(!res.ok){ msg.textContent = 'Could not connect. ' + (res.message || plainCreative(res)); return; }
      document.getElementById('ytClientSecret').value = '';
      document.getElementById('ytRefreshToken').value = '';
      msg.textContent = 'Connected. Syncing…';
      fetch('/api/analytics/youtube-sync', { method:'POST', headers: cfAuthHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({}) })
        .then(function(r2){ return r2.json().catch(function(){ return { ok:false }; }); })
        .then(function(sres){
          msg.textContent = sres.ok ? 'Connected and synced.' : ('Connected, but the sync failed. ' + (sres.message || plainCreative(sres)));
          loadVideoStats();
        })
        .catch(function(){ msg.textContent = 'Connected, but could not reach the server to sync. Try Sync now in a moment.'; loadVideoStats(); });
    })
    .catch(function(){ msg.textContent = 'Could not reach the server. Try again in a moment.'; });
});
