<script>
(function(){
  var side=document.getElementById('side'),b=document.getElementById('burger');
  b.addEventListener('click',function(){side.classList.toggle('mini');b.textContent=side.classList.contains('mini')?'››':'‹‹';});
  document.querySelectorAll('.navhead').forEach(function(h){
    h.addEventListener('click',function(){if(side.classList.contains('mini'))return;h.parentElement.classList.toggle('closed');});
  });
})();
function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]});}

/* five document classes */
var CLASSES=[
  {k:'auth',   code:'DC-A', n:'Soft-pull authorizations', d:'consent to pull — nothing runs without one'},
  {k:'contract',code:'DC-B',n:'Contracts',                d:'funding agreements · repair engagement · partner licenses'},
  {k:'invoice',code:'DC-C', n:'Invoices',                 d:'issued against a product at point of sale'},
  {k:'deliverable',code:'DC-D',n:'UnderwriteIQ deliverables',d:'the five reports the client actually receives'},
  {k:'upload', code:'DC-E', n:'Uploads',                  d:'bank · FTC · portal files this person sent'}
];

/* gen: queued|generating|generated|failed
   del: na|not_sent|sent|opened|bounced
   sig: na|awaiting|signed|declined|expired
   age: days in the current pending state (0 when nothing is pending) */
var DOCS=[];

var GEN={queued:['b-butter','Queued'],generating:['b-warn','Generating'],generated:['b-ok','Generated'],failed:['b-alert','Failed']};
var DEL={na:['b-info','N/A'],not_sent:['b-butter','Not sent'],sent:['b-warn','Sent'],opened:['b-ok','Opened'],bounced:['b-alert','Bounced']};
var SIG={na:['b-info','N/A'],awaiting:['b-warn','Awaiting'],signed:['b-ok','Signed'],declined:['b-alert','Declined'],expired:['b-alert','Expired']};

/* A sent contract is watched here, not on the Contracts screen — Contracts is
   where the form is built, Documents is where the form is watched.

   The contract's OWN state is not the document's signature state and must not
   be folded into it: a voided contract still has a delivered document sitting
   in the row next to it. Same five words the Contracts screen uses, so the two
   screens cannot drift apart. */
var CSTATE={draft:['b-gray','draft'],sent:['b-info','sent'],viewed:['b-warn','opened'],signed:['b-ok','signed'],void:['b-alert','void']};
/* Set from the session by the loader below. Void is owner/admin at the API, and
   a role does not render a control it cannot use. */
var ctAdmin=false;
function ctCell(d){
  var c=d.contract;                        // undefined = this row is not a contract
  if(!c) return '<span style="color:var(--gray2)">—</span>';
  var m=CSTATE[c.status]||CSTATE.draft;
  var acts=[];
  if(c.status!=='draft') acts.push('<button class="btn sm" data-ct="open" data-cid="'+esc(c.id)+'">Open PDF</button>');
  if(c.status==='sent'||c.status==='viewed') acts.push('<button class="btn sm" data-ct="remind" data-cid="'+esc(c.id)+'">Remind</button>');
  if(ctAdmin&&c.status!=='signed'&&c.status!=='void') acts.push('<button class="btn sm" data-ct="void" data-cid="'+esc(c.id)+'">Void</button>');
  return '<span class="badge '+m[0]+'">'+m[1]+'</span>'+
    (acts.length?'<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;flex-wrap:wrap">'+acts.join('')+'</div>':'');
}

/* The Download control, in the Document cell — no new column, no new screen.
   Drawn only for a row that HAS bytes behind it (d.file, set by the loader from
   the row's mime_type). A row whose file was never generated has nothing to
   fetch, and UI-STANDARDS §4 says a screen does not render a control that
   cannot finish. The click is handled by ACT.download below, which asks the API
   for a fresh link at that moment — the link is never held in this markup. */
function dlCell(d){
  if(!d.file || !d.id) return '';
  return '<div style="margin-top:6px"><button class="btn sm" data-dl="'+esc(d.id)+'">Download</button></div>';
}

function pending(d){
  return d.gen!=='generated' || d.del==='not_sent' || d.del==='bounced' ||
         d.sig==='awaiting' || d.sig==='expired';
}
function ageCls(n){return n>=14?'hot':(n>=7?'warm':'')}

var curCls='', pendingOnly=false, sortKey='age', sortDir=-1;

function renderClassbar(){
  document.getElementById('classbar').innerHTML=CLASSES.map(function(c){
    var set=DOCS.filter(function(d){return d.cls===c.k});
    var pend=set.filter(pending).length, done=set.length-pend;
    var pctDone=set.length?Math.round(done/set.length*100):0;
    return '<div class="classcard '+(curCls===c.k?'on':'')+'" data-c="'+c.k+'">'+
      '<div class="eyebrow">'+c.code+' <span class="sep">/</span> CLASS</div>'+
      '<div class="cn">'+esc(c.n)+'</div>'+
      '<div class="cc">'+set.length+'</div>'+
      '<div class="cs">'+pend+' pending · '+done+' settled</div>'+
      '<div class="bar"><i style="width:'+pctDone+'%;background:var(--ok)"></i><i style="width:'+(100-pctDone)+'%;background:var(--warn)"></i></div>'+
      '<div class="cs" style="margin-top:7px">'+esc(c.d)+'</div></div>';
  }).join('');
  document.querySelectorAll('.classcard').forEach(function(el){
    el.addEventListener('click',function(){setClass(curCls===el.dataset.c?'':el.dataset.c)});
  });
}
function renderTabs(){
  var all=[{k:'',code:'DC-01',n:'All'}].concat(CLASSES.map(function(c){return {k:c.k,code:c.code,n:c.n}}));
  document.getElementById('tabs').innerHTML=all.map(function(t){
    return '<button class="tab '+(curCls===t.k?'on':'')+'" data-c="'+t.k+'"'+(curCls===t.k?' disabled aria-current="true"':'')+'>'+esc(t.n)+'</button>';
  }).join('');
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(b){
    if (b.disabled) return;
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){setClass(b.dataset.c)});
  });
}
function setClass(k){
  curCls=k; renderTabs(); renderClassbar(); render();
  var c=CLASSES.filter(function(x){return x.k===k})[0];
  document.getElementById('listCode').innerHTML=(c?c.code:'DC-01')+' <span class="sep">/</span> '+(c?c.n.toUpperCase():'ALL DOCUMENTS');
}

function rows(){
  var sf=document.getElementById('statusFilter').value;
  var q=document.getElementById('q').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  return DOCS.filter(function(d){
    if(curCls && d.cls!==curCls) return false;
    if(pendingOnly && !pending(d)) return false;
    if(q && (d.doc+' '+d.client+' '+d.sub).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0) return false;
    if(sf==='gen-pending' && d.gen==='generated') return false;
    if(sf==='gen-failed' && d.gen!=='failed') return false;
    if(sf==='del-pending' && d.del!=='not_sent') return false;
    if(sf==='del-bounced' && d.del!=='bounced') return false;
    if(sf==='sig-pending' && d.sig!=='awaiting') return false;
    if(sf==='sig-expired' && d.sig!=='expired') return false;
    return true;
  }).sort(function(a,b){
    var av=a[sortKey],bv=b[sortKey];
    if(sortKey==='cls'){av=a.cls;bv=b.cls}
    if(av<bv) return -sortDir; if(av>bv) return sortDir; return 0;
  });
}

function render(){
  var list=rows();
  var CN={auth:'Soft-pull auth',contract:'Contract',invoice:'Invoice',deliverable:'Deliverable',upload:'Upload'};
  document.getElementById('body').innerHTML=list.map(function(d){
    var g=GEN[d.gen],dl=DEL[d.del],s=SIG[d.sig];
    var isP=pending(d);
    return '<tr class="'+(isP&&d.age>=14?'stale':'')+'">'+
      '<td><div style="font-weight:600">'+esc(d.doc)+'</div><div class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray2);letter-spacing:.08em">'+esc(d.sub)+'</div>'+dlCell(d)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(d.client)+'</td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge b-gray">'+CN[d.cls]+'</span></td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge '+g[0]+'">'+g[1]+'</span></td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge '+dl[0]+'">'+dl[1]+'</span></td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge '+s[0]+'">'+s[1]+'</span></td>'+
      '<td>'+(isP?'<span class="age '+ageCls(d.age)+'">'+d.age+'d</span>':'<span class="age" style="color:var(--gray2)">—</span>')+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+ctCell(d)+'</td></tr>';
  }).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="8" class="empty">'+(DOCS.length?'Nothing matches that filter.':'No documents on file yet.')+'</td></tr>';

  document.querySelectorAll('#tbl th[data-s]').forEach(function(th){
    var arrow=sortKey===th.dataset.s?(sortDir===1?' ↑':' ↓'):'';
    th.textContent=th.textContent.replace(/[ ↑↓]+$/,'')+arrow;
  });
  renderStats();
}

function renderStats(){
  document.getElementById('kTotal').textContent=DOCS.length;
  document.getElementById('kSign').textContent=DOCS.filter(function(d){return d.sig==='awaiting'}).length;
  document.getElementById('kUndel').textContent=DOCS.filter(function(d){return d.gen==='generated'&&d.del==='not_sent'}).length;
  var stale=DOCS.filter(function(d){return pending(d)&&d.age>=14}).length;
  document.getElementById('staleTxt').textContent=stale+' past 14 days';
  document.getElementById('staleChip').className='chip '+(stale?'bad':'on');
}

document.querySelectorAll('#tbl th[data-s]').forEach(function(th){
  th.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var k=th.dataset.s;
    if(sortKey===k) sortDir*=-1; else {sortKey=k;sortDir=-1}
    render();
  });
});
document.getElementById('statusFilter').addEventListener('change',render);
document.getElementById('q').addEventListener('input',render);
document.getElementById('pendingBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
  pendingOnly=!pendingOnly;
  this.classList.toggle('dark',pendingOnly);
  this.textContent=pendingOnly?'Showing pending':'Pending only';
  render();
});

renderTabs(); renderClassbar(); render();
</script>
<script defer src="data.js"></script>
<script>

/* Documents — real metadata from /api/read/documents. Layout untouched: this
   replaces the four KPI numbers and the table body, nothing else. storage_key
   is stripped server-side and is never in the payload. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var esc = function (v) {
    return String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;" }[c]; });
  };
  var set = function (id, v) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = v; };
  var day = function (d) { return d ? new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-US",
    { month:"short", day:"numeric", year:"2-digit" }) : "—"; };

  /* Every redraw of DOCS must redraw the class cards too. render() only rebuilds
     the table and the KPI tiles; the four class cards are built by
     renderClassbar(), which the loader never called — so the cards kept their
     first, empty count while the tiles and the table showed the live rows. One
     screen, two different answers to the same question. Redraw both together. */
  var redraw = function () {
    if (typeof renderClassbar === "function") renderClassbar();
    if (typeof render === "function") render();
  };

  /* ── the sent contract, watched from here ───────────────────────────────────
     Contracts is where the form is built. Documents is where the form is
     watched. Everything below is the watching half: the contract's own signing
     state, opening the signed copy, voiding, and chasing a signature.

     A documents row does NOT point at its contract; a contracts row points at
     its documents (document_id, and signed_document_id once everybody has
     signed). So this asks ONCE for the whole page rather than once per row —
     a 200-row page asking per row is 200 requests for a badge. */
  var CT_CHUNK = 200;                       // the endpoint's cap on ids per call

  /* Whatever the server said, in the server's own words. It lives outside #body
     so a re-sort, a tab change or a search keystroke does not wipe it. */
  var say = function (kind, text) {
    var el = document.getElementById("ctMsg");
    if (!el) return;
    el.style.display = "";
    el.innerHTML = '<span class="badge ' + kind + '">' +
      (kind === "b-ok" ? "done" : "problem") + "</span> " + esc(text);
  };

  var contractById = function (id) {
    if (typeof DOCS === "undefined") return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < DOCS.length; i++) {
      if (DOCS[i].contract && DOCS[i].contract.id === id) return DOCS[i].contract;
    }
    return null;
  };

  var decorateContracts = function () {
    if (typeof DOCS === "undefined" || !DOCS.length) return;
    /* A contract registers its document under contracts.kind, which is
       'contract' OR 'authorization' (db/migrations/124_contracts.sql:148), so
       both classes are asked about. A row that is not a contract simply gets no
       answer back and is left exactly as it was — no badge, no buttons. And
       when the page holds neither class, nothing is asked at all. */
    var ids = DOCS.filter(function (d) {
      return d.id && (d.cls === "contract" || d.cls === "auth");
    }).map(function (d) { return d.id; });
    if (!ids.length) return;

    var chunks = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i += CT_CHUNK) chunks.push(ids.slice(i, i + CT_CHUNK));

    Promise.all(chunks.map(function (chunk) {
      return FHData.read("contracts", { view: "contracts", document_id: chunk.join(",") });
    })).then(function (results) {
      var byDoc = {}, bad = null;
      results.forEach(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok) { bad = bad || res; return; }
        var items = (res.data && res.data.items) || [];
        for (var j = 0; j < items.length; j++) {
          var c = items[j];
          if (c.document_id) byDoc[c.document_id] = c;
          if (c.signed_document_id) byDoc[c.signed_document_id] = c;
        }
      });
      DOCS.forEach(function (d) { d.contract = byDoc[d.id]; });
      try { redraw(); } catch (e) {}
      // A failed lookup must not pass for "these are not contracts". Say so.
      if (bad) FHData.explain(bad, "contract signing status");
    });
  };

  var ACT = {
    /* The bytes come back base64 INSIDE the JSON — not a URL, and never a
       storage key — so the browser builds its own blob out of them. signed=1
       asks for the finished signed copy; with no signed copy on file there
       would be nothing there, so the current copy is asked for instead. */
    open: function (id) {
      var c = contractById(id);
      FHData.read("contracts", {
        file: "contract", id: id, signed: (c && c.signed_document_id) ? 1 : ""
      }).then(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok || !res.data || !res.data.pdf_base64) {
          say("b-alert", (res && res.error) || "There is no file to open for this contract yet.");
          return;
        }
        var bin = atob(res.data.pdf_base64);
        var buf = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
        for (var i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) buf[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([buf], { type: "application/pdf" }));
        var a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = url;
        a.download = res.data.filename || "contract.pdf";
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
        setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 60000);
      });
    },

    /* EVERY answer this gives carries a plain-English message written for the
       person reading it, and it is the only wording shown. A 200 can mean
       "queued nothing, because outbound mail is paused" — from out here that
       looks identical to a reminder that went, and only the server knows it did
       not. Inventing "Reminder sent." over the top of that is how a screen ends
       up lying. data.js keeps the server's sentence on res.error when the call
       failed and on res.data.message when it worked. */
    remind: function (id, btn) {
      var was = btn.textContent;
      btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "sending…";
      FHData.write("/api/contracts", { action: "remind", id: id }).then(function (res) {
        btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = was;
        if (!res.ok) { say("b-alert", res.error || "The reminder did not go."); return; }
        say("b-ok", (res.data && res.data.message) || "The reminder was accepted.");
      });
    },

    void: function (id, btn) {
      var reason = window.prompt("Why is this being voided? This is kept on the record.");
      if (reason == null) return;
      btn.disabled = true;
      FHData.write("/api/contracts", { action: "void", id: id, reason: reason }).then(function (res) {
        btn.disabled = false;
        if (!res.ok) { say("b-alert", res.error || "The contract could not be voided."); return; }
        say("b-ok", (res.data && res.data.message) || "The contract was voided.");
        decorateContracts();   // re-read the state rather than guess the new badge
      });
    },

    /* Open a saved file — an uploaded ID, a bank statement, a generated letter.
       NOT the contract path above: a contract's bytes arrive base64 inside JSON
       from api/contracts.mjs, while a registry document is fetched through a
       short-lived signed link that api/documents/[id].mjs resolves.

       TWO STEPS, AND THE FIRST ONE IS THE POINT. The link does not exist until
       it is asked for: /api/documents-download mints one, valid for fifteen
       minutes, only for a caller who is signed in right now and only for a
       document inside their own company. Before this endpoint existed the ONLY
       link a file ever got was minted in the reply to its upload, so anything
       older than fifteen minutes could not be opened by anybody.

       window.open with the link, rather than an <a download>: the bytes come
       back with the document's own content type and the browser does the right
       thing with a PDF or an image. The URL is never written into the page, so
       a screenshot or a copied row does not carry a working credential. */
    download: function (id, btn) {
      var was = btn.textContent;
      btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "opening…";
      FHData.documentDownload(id).then(function (res) {
        btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = was;
        var link = res.ok && res.data && res.data.document
          && res.data.document.download && res.data.document.download.url;
        if (!link) {
          say("b-alert", (res && res.error) || "That file could not be opened.");
          return;
        }
        window.open(link, "_blank", "noopener");
      });
    }
  };

  /* One listener on the table body, not one per button: render() rebuilds #body
     on every sort, tab, filter and keystroke, and per-button wiring would have
     to be redone after each of those or the buttons would go dead. */
  var tblBody = document.getElementById("body");
  if (tblBody) {
    tblBody.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
      var t = ev.target;
      if (!t || !t.closest) return;

      // The Download control on the Document cell. Checked first because it
      // carries a document id, not a contract id, and the two must not be
      // handed to each other's endpoint.
      var dl = t.closest("button[data-dl]");
      if (dl) return ACT.download(dl.getAttribute("data-dl"), dl);

      var btn = t.closest("button[data-ct]");
      if (!btn) return;
      var fn = ACT[btn.getAttribute("data-ct")];
      if (fn) fn(btn.getAttribute("data-cid"), btn);
    });
  }

  /* Void is owner/admin at the API and answers 403 to anyone else, so the
     button is not drawn for anyone else — same resolution contracts.html uses
     for the same reason: shell.js writes the role from an async session call,
     so reading its cached value synchronously loses the race on a first load
     and would hide Void from an owner until they reloaded. */
  var norm = function (v) { return String(v == null ? "" : v).trim().toLowerCase(); };
  (function resolveRole() {
    var t;
    try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { t = ""; }
    return fetch("/api/auth/session", { headers: t ? { authorization: "Bearer " + t } : {} })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw 0; return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) { if (d && d.ok && d.staff) return d.staff.role; throw 0; })
      .catch(function () {
        try { var s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("fh_demo_staff") || "null");
          if (s && s.role) return s.role; } catch (e) {}
        return "";
      })
      .then(function (r) {
        ctAdmin = norm(r) === "owner" || norm(r) === "admin";
        try { redraw(); } catch (e) {}
      });
  })();

  // data.js carries `defer` (see its tag above), so FHData does not exist yet
  // while this script is being parsed — reading it here threw, and the throw
  // killed the rest of this function before the documents were ever requested.
  // Every deferred script runs before DOMContentLoaded, so the first read waits
  // for that event.
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    try {
      var demo = false;
      try { demo = localStorage.getItem("fh_demo") === "1"; } catch (e) {}
      if (!demo && typeof DOCS !== "undefined") {
        DOCS.length = 0;
        try { redraw(); } catch (e) {}
        FHData.banner("sample", "loading documents…", "documents");
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    var docParams = { limit: 200 };
    try {
      var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
      var cid = String(q.get("client_id") || q.get("id") || "").trim();
      /* URL only. The last-open person in localStorage must not hide everyone
         else — the filter box has to show another person's files after you
         just looked at someone else. */
      if (/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(cid)) {
        docParams.client_id = cid;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    FHData.wire(FHData.documents(docParams), "documents", function (data) {
      var rows = data.items || [];
      if (!rows.length) {
        if (typeof DOCS !== "undefined") {
          DOCS.length = 0;
          try { redraw(); } catch (e) {}
        }
        return "no documents on file yet";
      }

      /* Feed the screen's OWN model and renderer.

         This wrote five <td>s into a SEVEN-column table and set the KPI tiles by
         hand. Both were undone by the first interaction: render() rebuilds #body
         from DOCS on every class-bar click, tab change, search keystroke and
         column sort, and renderStats() recomputes the tiles from DOCS at the end
         of it — so filtering put the sample documents back while the banner still
         said "live documents". Replacing DOCS and calling render() keeps the
         columns right and every control working on real rows. */
      if (typeof DOCS === "undefined" || typeof render !== "function") return null;

      var CLS = { authorization: "auth", contract: "contract",
                  invoice_document: "invoice", deliverable: "deliverable",
                  client_upload: "upload", inquiry_doc: "upload",
                  bureau_response: "upload" };
      var skipped = 0;
      var DAY = 86400000;

      var mapped = rows.map(function (r) {
        var cls = CLS[r.kind];
        /* Named classes only. A blank uploaded template is not sent or received
           paper, and a kind we do not name is not filed as a soft-pull. */
        if (!cls || r.subtype === "template_source") { skipped++; return null; }

        /* delivery_status is a CHECK-constrained vocabulary, not free text:
           not_delivered | pending | sent | delivered | failed | bounced.
           The screen's badges are na | not_sent | sent | opened | bounced.

           Note what is NOT mapped: nothing becomes "opened". The database records
           delivery, never an open — no column tracks it — so claiming a client
           opened a document would be invented. 'delivered' maps to "Sent", which
           is the strongest thing that is actually known.

           Incoming uploads (bank / FTC / portal) were received, not sent. Their
           delivery_status stays not_delivered in the table; showing that as
           "Not sent" would call a file we already have undelivered. */
        var d = String(r.delivery_status || "").toLowerCase();
        var del = cls === "upload" ? "na"
                : (d === "bounced" || d === "failed") ? "bounced"
                : (d === "sent" || d === "delivered") ? "sent"
                : "not_sent";                       // not_delivered, pending

        var sig = !r.signature_required ? "na"
                : r.signed_at ? "signed"
                : (r.expires_at && new Date(r.expires_at) < new Date()) ? "expired"
                : "awaiting";

        /* AGE COUNTS FROM THE LAST STATE CHANGE (the legend says so, and it
           used to count from generation — walkthrough-4 defect 16). The
           state changes this endpoint knows: created, generated, delivered,
           signed, and an expiry that has passed. The latest one wins, so a
           contract made in June and sent yesterday is one day old, not 78. */
        var lastChange = [r.created_at, r.generated_at, r.delivered_at, r.signed_at,
          (r.expires_at && new Date(r.expires_at) < new Date()) ? r.expires_at : null]
          .map(function (t) { return t ? new Date(t).getTime() : NaN; })
          .filter(function (t) { return !isNaN(t); });
        var born = new Date(lastChange.length ? Math.max.apply(null, lastChange) : Date.now());
        return {
          // Carried so the contract lookup below has something to join on. It is
          // the documents row id, not a storage key — redact() strips those.
          id: r.id,
          /* Does this row have bytes behind it? mime_type is written when a
             version is actually stored, so a document that was registered but
             never generated has none — and dlCell() draws no Download button
             for it rather than offering a click that would 404. */
          file: !!r.mime_type,
          doc: r.title || r.document_key || "—",
          cls: cls,
          sub: (r.subtype ? r.subtype + " · " : "") + "v" + (r.current_version || 1),
          client: r.client_name || r.client_id || "—",
          gen: r.generated_at ? "generated" : "queued",
          del: del,
          sig: sig,
          age: Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - born.getTime()) / DAY))
        };
      }).filter(Boolean);

      DOCS.length = 0;
      Array.prototype.push.apply(DOCS, mapped);
      try { redraw(); } catch (e) { return null; }   // class cards + table + tiles, all from DOCS
      decorateContracts();                           // one extra call, then the badges appear

      return "live documents" +
             (data.hasMore ? " · showing first 200" : "") +
             (skipped ? " · " + skipped + " not in this list" : "");
    });
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

/* Shared page frame for the Finance OS write screens.
 *
 * WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The rule "an unknown value renders as an em dash, never
 * as 0.00" is the most important presentation rule in this product, and it was
 * already written twice: once as `.fos-value.is-unknown` in finance-os.html and
 * again as `.bs-gtotal.is-unknown` / `.bs-abal.is-unknown` in
 * banking-surface.html. Six more screens were about to make it eight copies.
 *
 * Two copies of one rule is a bug that takes months to surface — it drifts one
 * screen at a time, and the screen that drifts is the one showing somebody a
 * number about their money. So the rule is written ONCE here and the six Finance
 * OS screens link this file. finance-os.html and banking-surface.html are left
 * alone deliberately: they work, they are owned by other passes, and rewriting a
 * working screen to share a stylesheet is the drive-by refactor CLAUDE.md §8
 * forbids.
 *
 * THE TWO SIGNALS, AND WHY THEY ARE SEPARATE.
 *
 *   .is-unknown   the server sent null. We do not have this number.
 *                 Renders as an em dash in a dimmer weight so it does not read
 *                 as a figure. "We do not know" and "it is zero" are different
 *                 facts about someone's money and only one of them is a claim.
 *
 *   .is-partial   we have a number, but it was totalled over a set with holes in
 *                 it. It is a FLOOR, not a total, and it carries a "+".
 *                 src/finance/os-grid.mjs:71 sumKnown() is the server-side half
 *                 of the same idea: it counts what it could not use.
 *
 * THEY CAN BOTH BE TRUE AT ONCE AND THE PAIR IS NONSENSE (audit m16). sumKnown()
 * returns total:null when nothing was usable, while basisOf() still reports
 * partial:true because unknown > 0 — so a client whose cards report no limit at
 * all got a "+" stacked on the em dash and the row read "—+", which is not a
 * number, not a dash and not a marker; it reads as the page being broken. Worse,
 * the plus means "there is more than this", which is meaningless attached to "we
 * have no number". `:not(.is-unknown)` on the ::after drops only that pair. Both
 * signals still work wherever each is true on its own.
 *
 * Set the two classes INDEPENDENTLY from the response: `.is-unknown` from
 * `display === null`, `.is-partial` from `basis.partial`. Do not derive one from
 * the other.
 */

:root{ --surface:#FFFFFF; --text:var(--ink2); --text-dim:var(--gray); --text-faint:var(--gray2); }

<script>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FINANCE OS — one client's money, on one page.

   WHAT WAS WRONG WITH THIS FILE (walk findings 22.1 to 22.5, 2026-09-06).

     1. It could not open a client. The page read client_id off the address bar
        and nothing else — no list, no search, no dropdown, zero clickable
        elements — so clicking Finance OS in the sidebar always landed on a
        blank "Not connected" page and there was no way forward from it. The
        picker at the top of the page is the fix.
     2. It showed no money in. A paid sale, the deposit against it and anything
        still invoiced appeared nowhere; the page had bank buckets and
        subscriptions and that was all.
     3. It never called its own endpoint. /api/read/finance-os has existed the
        whole time, named after this screen, returning seven computed figures
        about the client's revolving credit, and nothing on this page asked for
        them.
     4. The headline was a hardcoded em dash that could never fill in — it was
        literally the character "—" in the markup, under a label ("Company
        money") that no read on this page can answer.

   WHY THE HEADLINE IS "AVAILABLE CREDIT" AND NOT A CASH TOTAL. There is
   deliberately no single cash number to print. src/finance/banking-surface.mjs
   is explicit about it: personal, business and investment money are not one
   pile, and adding them produces a figure that describes nobody. So the hero is
   the biggest number this screen can actually stand behind — headroom across
   the client's open revolving lines, computed server-side by
   src/finance/os-grid.mjs — and the bank buckets keep their own separate
   figures below it.

   MONEY IS INTEGER CENTS (src/commissions/money.mjs). Every amount that arrives
   as dollars is converted to whole cents before it is added to anything, and
   converted back for display. NULL is not zero anywhere on this page: an
   unknown figure paints an em dash in the dim weight (.is-unknown), and a total
   summed over rows with holes in it paints a "+" (.is-partial), because it is a
   floor and not a total. Those two classes come from finance-os.css and the
   rule is written down once, there.

   FOUR READS, ALL EXISTING, ALL FAILING ON THEIR OWN.
     /api/read/finance-os      the seven credit figures
     /api/dashboard/client     the client's name, payments and invoices
     /api/finance/bank-accounts the bank buckets
     /api/finance/bills        the repeating charges
   A refusal on one of them takes out one panel and says so in that panel's own
   words. Before this pass a single failed read painted one line over the whole
   page.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c];
    });
  }
  function group(s) {
    var parts = String(s).split(".");
    parts[0] = parts[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
    return parts.join(".");
  }

  /* ── MONEY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     The browser half of src/commissions/money.mjs, and it matches that module
     on the two things that matter: everything is added as whole cents, and an
     unknown value stays null all the way to the screen. A float sum of dollar
     strings is off by a penny on a long enough list, and a null coerced to 0 is
     a made-up number printed under a real person's name. */
  function toCents(value) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return null;
    var n = Number(String(value).trim());
    if (!isFinite(n)) return null;
    // Round half away from zero, exactly as roundHalfUp() does server-side, so
    // a refund and the payment it reverses cancel to nothing rather than a cent.
    return n < 0 ? -Math.round(-n * 100) : Math.round(n * 100);
  }
  function fromCents(cents) {
    if (cents === null || cents === undefined) return null;
    var neg = cents < 0;
    var abs = Math.abs(cents);
    var frac = String(abs % 100);
    while (frac.length < 2) frac = "0" + frac;
    return (neg ? "-" : "") + Math.floor(abs / 100) + "." + frac;
  }
  /* sumKnown — total what exists and COUNT what does not, the same rule
     sumKnown() applies in src/finance/os-grid.mjs. Nothing usable means the
     total is null, never 0. */
  function sumKnown(values) {
    var total = 0, known = 0, unknown = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      if (values[i] === null || values[i] === undefined) unknown++;
      else { total += values[i]; known++; }
    }
    return { total: known ? total : null, known: known, unknown: unknown };
  }

  function moneyText(display) {
    if (display === null || display === undefined || display === "") return null;
    var s = String(display);
    var neg = s.charAt(0) === "-";
    if (neg) s = s.slice(1);
    return (neg ? "−$" : "$") + group(s);
  }
  function money(display) {
    var t = moneyText(display);
    return t === null
      ? '<span class="num dash">—</span>'
      : '<span class="num">' + esc(t) + "</span>";
  }

  /* day — the calendar day the server wrote, never the reader's local one.
     A due date is stored as a timestamp at UTC midnight, and new Date(iso)
     read back in any timezone west of UTC lands on the day BEFORE. Measured
     here on 2026-09-06: an invoice due 2026-09-20 printed "due Sep 19, 2026"
     in Mountain time. That is a wrong date on a bill, which is exactly the
     off-by-one api/read/money-map.mjs casts its date columns to text to avoid.
     Reading the Y-M-D out of the string cannot shift, whatever timezone the
     browser is in. The day is pinned to NOON UTC and printed in Arizona, the
     one zone staff screens use (src/http/crm-html.test.mjs): noon UTC is 5 a.m.
     the same day in Phoenix, which has no daylight saving, so the printed date
     is always the stored one. (It used to print in UTC from midnight UTC,
     which gave the same date but named a zone the staff-screen guard refuses.) */
  function day(iso) {
    var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(String(iso == null ? "" : iso));
    if (!m) return "no date";
    var d = new Date(Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]), 12));
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return "no date";
    return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
      timeZone: "America/Phoenix", year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric"
    });
  }

  /* Plain words for a stored status. Chris reads these, not the database. */
  function statusWords(s) {
    var k = String(s == null ? "" : s).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!k) return "not recorded";
    if (k === "paid" || k === "succeeded" || k === "complete" || k === "completed") return "paid";
    if (k === "open" || k === "sent" || k === "issued" || k === "pending") return "not paid yet";
    if (k === "refunded") return "refunded";
    if (k === "failed" || k === "declined") return "failed";
    if (k === "void" || k === "voided" || k === "cancelled" || k === "canceled") return "cancelled";
    return k.replace(/_/g, " ");
  }

  /* ── the shared row shape, from finance-os.css ────────────────────────────
     .is-unknown = the server sent null, we do not have this number.
     .is-partial = we have a number but it was totalled over a set with holes,
                   so it is a floor. Set from the response, never derived one
                   from the other. */
  function fhNum(display, isMoney, partial) {
    var text = isMoney
      ? moneyText(display)
      : (display === null || display === undefined || display === "" ? null : String(display));
    var cls = "fh-num" + (text === null ? " is-unknown" : "") + (partial ? " is-partial" : "");
    return '<span class="' + cls + '">' + (text === null ? "—" : esc(text)) + "</span>";
  }
  function fhRow(label, basis, figure, partial) {
    return '<div class="fh-row' + (partial ? " is-partial" : "") + '">' +
      '<span class="fh-label">' + esc(label) +
      (basis ? '<span class="fh-basis caption">' + esc(basis) + "</span>" : "") +
      "</span>" + figure + "</div>";
  }
  function panel(title, sub, inner) {
    return '<div class="fos-panel"><div class="fos-ph"><h2>' + esc(title) + "</h2>" +
      (sub ? '<span class="sub">' + esc(sub) + "</span>" : "") + "</div>" + inner + "</div>";
  }
  function emptyPanel(title, sub, words) {
    return panel(title, sub, '<div class="fh-empty">' + esc(words) + "</div>");
  }

  /* basisWords — how many rows a figure counted and how many it could not, in
     a sentence. The server sends the counts; this only puts them into English.

     `isFloor` IS NOT DECORATION. "So the real figure is higher" is true of a
     SUM taken over part of a set — leave a card out of a credit-limit total and
     the total can only go up. It is FALSE of a ratio or a weighted average:
     leave a card out of utilization and the real number could land either side
     of the one on screen. Saying "higher" there is a claim the page cannot
     make, so those rows say what happened instead and say nothing about which
     way it moves. */
  function basisWords(b, noun, isFloor) {
    if (!b || !b.lines) return "";
    if (!b.unknown) return "counted all " + b.lines + " " + noun;
    return "counted " + b.counted + " of " + b.lines + " " + noun + " — " + b.unknown +
      (isFloor ? " did not report it, so the real figure is higher"
               : " did not report enough to be counted");
  }

  /* ── the read ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     Same classification data.js uses, kept local so the picker still works on a
     page where data.js has not finished loading. */
  function apiGet(path) {
    var t = "";
    try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { t = ""; }
    var started;
    try {
      started = fetch(path, {
        headers: t ? { accept: "application/json", authorization: "Bearer " + t }
                   : { accept: "application/json" }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: (e && e.message) || "fetch unavailable" });
    }
    return Promise.resolve(started).then(function (r) {
      if (r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) {
        return { ok: false, source: "unauthorized", data: null, error: "not signed in, or not allowed" };
      }
      if (r.status === 404) {
        return r.json().then(function (d) {
          return (d && d.error === "not_found" && typeof d.path === "string")
            ? { ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: "/api/* not deployed" }
            : { ok: false, source: "notfound", data: null, error: "no such record" };
        }).catch(function () { return { ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: "/api/* not deployed" }; });
      }
      if (r.status === 400 || r.status === 409) {
        return r.json().then(function (d) {
          var msg = (d && d.message) || (d && d.error && /\s/.test(d.error) ? d.error : null) || "That request was not accepted.";
          return { ok: false, source: "badrequest", data: null, error: msg };
        }).catch(function () { return { ok: false, source: "badrequest", data: null, error: "That request was not accepted." }; });
      }
      return r.json().then(function (d) {
        if (r.status === 503 || (d && d.db === "down")) {
          return { ok: false, source: "nodb", data: null, error: (d && d.message) || "The database is not reachable right now." };
        }
        if (!d || d.ok !== true) {
          return { ok: false, source: "server", data: null, error: (d && d.message) || "Something went wrong. Try again in a moment." };
        }
        return { ok: true, source: "api", data: d, error: null };
      }).catch(function () { return { ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: "response was not JSON" }; });
    }).catch(function (e) {
      return { ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: (e && e.message) || "network error" };
    });
  }

  /* apiGetSuggestions — NOT apiGet(). apiGet() discards the response body on
     401/403 and reports a single generic "not signed in" sentence, because
     for every other read on this page a 403 only ever means one thing. This
     endpoint's 403 means one of two different, unrelated facts —
     "you're not signed in right" vs "this client has no active finance-os
     subscription" — and the body says which (entitled:false). Losing that
     distinction would make a client who simply hasn't bought the add-on read
     as an auth bug. Everything else mirrors apiGet()'s shape exactly, so
     suggestionsPanel() can be written the same way every other panel here is. */
  function apiGetSuggestions(clientId) {
    var t = "";
    try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { t = ""; }
    var started;
    try {
      started = fetch("/api/read/finance-os-suggestions?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(clientId), {
        headers: t ? { accept: "application/json", authorization: "Bearer " + t }
                   : { accept: "application/json" }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: (e && e.message) || "fetch unavailable" });
    }
    return Promise.resolve(started).then(function (r) {
      if (r.status === 404) {
        return { ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: "/api/* not deployed" };
      }
      return r.json().then(function (d) {
        if (r.status === 403 && d && d.entitled === false) {
          return { ok: false, source: "not_entitled", data: null, error: d.reason || "not entitled" };
        }
        if (r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) {
          return { ok: false, source: "unauthorized", data: null, error: "not signed in, or not allowed" };
        }
        if (r.status === 503 || (d && d.db === "down")) {
          return { ok: false, source: "nodb", data: null, error: (d && d.message) || "The database is not reachable right now." };
        }
        if (!d || d.ok !== true) {
          return { ok: false, source: "server", data: null, error: (d && d.message) || "Something went wrong. Try again in a moment." };
        }
        return { ok: true, source: "api", data: d, error: null };
      }).catch(function () { return { ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: "response was not JSON" }; });
    }).catch(function (e) {
      return { ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: (e && e.message) || "network error" };
    });
  }

  /* One sentence a person can act on, per failure. Deliberately shorter than
     data.js explain(), because these land INSIDE a panel where the reader is
     already looking, not along the bottom edge of the page. */
  function whyWords(res, thing) {
    var s = res && res.source;
    if (s === "unauthorized") return "This account is not allowed to see " + thing + ", or needs to sign in again.";
    if (s === "nodb") return "We could not read " + thing + " — the database is not answering. Try again in a few minutes.";
    if (s === "notfound") return "There is no record of " + thing + " for this client.";
    if (s === "badrequest") return "We could not read " + thing + " — the request was rejected.";
    if (s === "offline") return "We could not reach the server to read " + thing + ". Check your connection and try again.";
    return "We could not read " + thing + " just now. Try again in a few minutes.";
  }
  function explain(res, what) {
    if (window.FHData && !(res && res.ok)) { try { FHData.explain(res, what); } catch (e) { /* banner only */ } }
  }

  var rawClient = "";
  try { rawClient = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("client_id") || ""; } catch (e) { rawClient = ""; }
  var clientId = UUID.test(String(rawClient).trim()) ? String(rawClient).trim() : "";

  /* ═══ 1. THE CLIENT PICKER ════════════════════════════════════════════════
     /api/dashboard/clients is the client book every other screen already reads.
     Picking a name reloads this page with ?client_id=, which is the same shape
     every link into this screen already uses and the shape shell.js carries
     from screen to screen — so the client stays open when you walk away to the
     control panel and back. */
  var ALL = [];

  function nameOf(c) {
    var n = ((c.first_name || "") + " " + (c.last_name || "")).trim();
    return n || c.email || "Unnamed client";
  }

  function fillOptions(filter) {
    var sel = $("fosClient");
    if (!sel) return;
    var needle = String(filter || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    var shown = ALL.filter(function (c) {
      if (!needle) return true;
      return (nameOf(c) + " " + (c.email || "")).toLowerCase().indexOf(needle) !== -1;
    });
    var html = '<option value="">' +
      (shown.length ? "Choose a client…" : "No client matches that") + "</option>";
    html += shown.map(function (c) {
      return '<option value="' + esc(c.id) + '"' + (c.id === clientId ? " selected" : "") + ">" +
        esc(nameOf(c)) + (c.email ? " — " + esc(c.email) : "") + "</option>";
    }).join("");
    sel.innerHTML = html;
    syncOpen();
    var msg = $("fosPickMsg");
    if (msg) {
      msg.textContent = needle
        ? shown.length + " of " + ALL.length + " clients match"
        : ALL.length + " client" + (ALL.length === 1 ? "" : "s") + " on file";
    }
  }

  function syncOpen() {
    var sel = $("fosClient");
    var btn = $("fosOpen");
    if (!sel || !btn) return;
    var picked = sel.value;
    btn.disabled = !picked || picked === clientId;
    btn.textContent = picked && picked === clientId ? "Already open" : "Open this client";
  }

  function loadClients() {
    apiGet("/api/dashboard/clients?limit=500").then(function (res) {
      var sel = $("fosClient");
      var msg = $("fosPickMsg");
      if (!res.ok) {
        if (sel) sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Client list unavailable</option>';
        if (msg) msg.textContent = whyWords(res, "the client list");
        explain(res, "the client list");
        return;
      }
      ALL = ((res.data && res.data.clients) || []).slice().sort(function (a, b) {
        return nameOf(a).toLowerCase() < nameOf(b).toLowerCase() ? -1 : 1;
      });
      if (!ALL.length) {
        if (sel) sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">No clients on file yet</option>';
        if (msg) msg.textContent = "There are no clients in this company yet.";
        return;
      }
      fillOptions($("fosFind") ? $("fosFind").value : "");
    });
  }

  function wirePicker() {
    var find = $("fosFind");
    var sel = $("fosClient");
    var btn = $("fosOpen");
    var clear = $("fosClear");
    if (find) find.addEventListener("input", function () { fillOptions(find.value); });
    if (sel) sel.addEventListener("change", syncOpen);
    if (btn) btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var picked = sel && sel.value;
      if (!picked || !UUID.test(picked)) return;
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = "Opening…";
      location.href = "finance-os.html?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(picked);
    });
    if (clear) {
      clear.hidden = !clientId;
      clear.addEventListener("click", function () {
        /* Forget the client as well as leaving the page. shell.js remembers the
           one you are working in localStorage "fh_client" and puts it back on
           every link, so without this the very next click would reopen the
           client you just closed and the button would look broken. */
        try { localStorage.removeItem("fh_client"); } catch (e) { /* nothing to forget */ }
        location.href = "finance-os.html";
      });
    }
  }

  /* ═══ 2. THE HERO ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function heroFor(name, grid, gridRes) {
    var row = null;
    if (grid && grid.rows) {
      for (var i = 0; i < grid.rows.length; i++) {
        if (grid.rows[i].key === "available") { row = grid.rows[i]; break; }
      }
    }
    var text = row ? moneyText(row.display) : null;
    var partial = !!(row && row.basis && row.basis.partial) && text !== null;
    var lines = grid && typeof grid.lines === "number" ? grid.lines : null;
    var sub;
    if (!gridRes.ok) {
      sub = whyWords(gridRes, "this client's credit");
    } else if (!row) {
      sub = "There is no credit report on file for this client yet.";
    } else if (text === null) {
      sub = "No card on this file reports both a limit and a balance, so there is no figure to give. " +
        "That is not the same as zero.";
    } else {
      sub = "Money still available to draw across " + lines + " open credit card" +
        (lines === 1 ? "" : "s") + ". This is the credit report only — it is not cash in the bank." +
        (partial ? " Some cards did not report a limit, so the real figure is higher than this." : "");
    }
    return '<div class="fos-hero"><div class="fos-hh"><div>' +
      '<div class="k caption">' + esc(name || "This client") + " · available credit</div>" +
      '<div class="n fos-value">' + (text === null ? "—" : esc(text)) + (partial ? "+" : "") + "</div>" +
      '<div class="s">' + esc(sub) + "</div>" +
      "</div></div></div>";
  }

  /* ═══ 3. THE CREDIT GRID — /api/read/finance-os ═══════════════════════════
     Seven figures, every one of them computed server-side so this screen and
     any calculator cannot disagree. Nothing here is worked out in the browser;
     it is formatting and nothing else. */
  var CREDIT_IS_MONEY = { credit_limit: true, balance: true, available: true };

  /* The cheapest-money row arrives as one sentence — "12.99% · Chase · 5000.00"
     — and that last part is a dollars string with no $ and no separator,
     because fromCents() is a storage format, not a display one. Format only
     that part, and only when the sentence still has exactly three; anything
     else is printed exactly as it came rather than guessed at. */
  function cheapestText(display) {
    var parts = String(display).split(" · ");
    if (parts.length !== 3) return display;
    var m = moneyText(parts[2]);
    return m === null ? display : parts[0] + " · " + parts[1] + " · " + m;
  }

  function creditPanel(res) {
    if (!res.ok) return emptyPanel("Credit picture", "credit report", whyWords(res, "this client's credit"));
    var grid = res.data || {};
    var rows = grid.rows || [];
    if (!rows.length) {
      return emptyPanel("Credit picture", "credit report",
        "Nothing yet. These figures appear once a credit report is pulled for this client.");
    }
    var body = rows.map(function (r) {
      var display = r.display;
      if (r.key === "cheapest" && display) display = cheapestText(display);
      var known = display !== null && display !== undefined && display !== "";
      var partial = !!(r.basis && r.basis.partial) && known;
      var isMoney = !!CREDIT_IS_MONEY[r.key];
      // A count is never a floor and never unknown — we know exactly how many
      // rows we hold — so it carries no basis line and no "+".
      var basis = r.unit === "count" ? "" : basisWords(r.basis, "credit cards", isMoney);
      // The "+" means "there is more than this", which only a partial SUM can
      // claim. Utilization, the average APR and the cheapest line are not sums,
      // so they carry the darkened basis line and no plus. See basisWords.
      return fhRow(r.label, basis, fhNum(display, isMoney, partial && isMoney), partial);
    }).join("");
    return panel("Credit picture", "open revolving lines only", body);
  }

  /* ═══ 4. MONEY IN — /api/dashboard/client ═════════════════════════════════
     What this client has actually paid us. Until this pass a paid sale showed
     up nowhere on this screen at all. */
  function moneyInPanel(res) {
    if (!res.ok) return emptyPanel("Money in", "payments received", whyWords(res, "this client's payments"));
    var txs = (res.data && res.data.transactions) || [];
    var cents = txs.map(function (t) { return toCents(t.amount_paid); });
    /* ONLY MONEY THAT WAS KEPT IS "PAID SO FAR" (N1, live 2026-09-18). Every
       row is still listed below with its own status, but a failed card or a
       refunded payment is not money this client has paid. This total used to
       add every row whatever its status, so it disagreed with the portal's
       Payments tab (api/read/portal-summary.mjs readPayments), which counts
       'succeeded' only. */
    var paidCents = [];
    txs.forEach(function (t, i) { if (statusWords(t.status) === "paid") paidCents.push(cents[i]); });
    var notCounted = txs.length - paidCents.length;
    // Rows exist and none of them is paid: that is a real $0, not an unknown.
    var s = paidCents.length ? sumKnown(paidCents) : { total: txs.length ? 0 : null, known: 0, unknown: 0 };
    var partial = s.unknown > 0 && s.total !== null;
    var n = paidCents.length;

    var head = fhRow(
      "Paid so far",
      txs.length
        ? (s.unknown
            ? s.unknown + " of " + n + " payments have no amount recorded, so the real figure is higher"
            : "across " + n + " payment" + (n === 1 ? "" : "s")) +
          (notCounted ? "; " + notCounted + " more listed but not counted (see status)" : "")
        : "",
      fhNum(fromCents(s.total), true, partial),
      partial
    );

    var rows = txs.map(function (t, i) {
      return '<div class="fos-r pay"><span class="nm">' + esc(t.product_name || "Payment") +
        "<em>" + esc(day(t.created_at)) + "</em></span>" +
        '<span class="num muted">' + esc(statusWords(t.status)) + "</span>" +
        money(fromCents(cents[i])) + "</div>";
    }).join("");

    /* THE AGREED SUCCESS FEE PERCENT IS NOT PRINTED, ON PURPOSE. It lives on
       sales.agreed_success_fee_percent (db/migrations/011_sales.sql) and no
       read endpoint in this app returns it — not this screen's, not the client
       detail read, not the invoice read. Saying "10%" here would be this page
       inventing a number about somebody's contract. The absence is the finding;
       it is written on the screen rather than filled in with a plausible guess. */
    var feeNote = '<div class="fos-sug">The agreed success fee percent is not shown. ' +
      "Nothing in the system hands it to this screen yet, and this page will not guess at it. " +
      "A success fee appears under Invoiced below once it has been billed.</div>";

    return panel("Money in", "payments received",
      head + (rows || '<div class="fh-empty">No payment has been recorded against this client yet.</div>') + feeNote);
  }

  /* ═══ 5. INVOICED — the receivable ════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function invoicedPanel(res) {
    if (!res.ok) return emptyPanel("Invoiced", "billed and outstanding", whyWords(res, "this client's invoices"));
    var invs = (res.data && res.data.invoices) || [];
    if (!invs.length) {
      return emptyPanel("Invoiced", "billed and outstanding",
        "Nothing has been invoiced to this client yet.");
    }
    var due = sumKnown(invs.map(function (v) { return toCents(v.amount_due); }));
    var paid = sumKnown(invs.map(function (v) { return toCents(v.amount_paid); }));
    var open = sumKnown(invs.map(function (v) { return toCents(v.balance_due); }));

    function total(label, s, noun) {
      var partial = s.unknown > 0 && s.total !== null;
      return fhRow(label,
        s.unknown ? s.unknown + " of " + invs.length + " invoices do not record it" : "across " + invs.length + " " + noun,
        fhNum(fromCents(s.total), true, partial), partial);
    }

    var rows = invs.map(function (v) {
      return '<div class="fos-r inv"><span class="nm">' + esc(statusWords(v.status)) +
        "<em>" + esc(v.due_at ? "due " + day(v.due_at) : "no due date") + "</em></span>" +
        '<span class="num muted">' + esc(day(v.created_at)) + "</span>" +
        money(fromCents(toCents(v.amount_due))) +
        money(fromCents(toCents(v.balance_due))) + "</div>";
    }).join("");

    var head = '<div class="fos-r inv"><span class="nm muted">status</span>' +
      '<span class="num muted">billed on</span>' +
      '<span class="num muted">amount</span>' +
      '<span class="num muted">still owed</span></div>';

    return panel("Invoiced", "billed and outstanding",
      total("Billed", due, invs.length === 1 ? "invoice" : "invoices") +
      total("Paid", paid, invs.length === 1 ? "invoice" : "invoices") +
      total("Still owed", open, invs.length === 1 ? "invoice" : "invoices") +
      head + rows);
  }

  /* ═══ 6. THE BANK BUCKETS AND THE REPEATING CHARGES ═══════════════════════
     Unchanged in what they show. They now fail on their own instead of taking
     the whole page down with them. */
  function bucketOf(account, groupKey) {
    if (account && account.account_type === "investment") return "investment";
    if (groupKey === "personal" || groupKey === "business") return groupKey;
    return "unknown";
  }
  function collect(surface) {
    var out = { personal: [], business: [], investment: [], unknown: [] };
    var groups = (surface && surface.groups) || [];
    groups.forEach(function (g) {
      (g.accounts || []).forEach(function (a) { out[bucketOf(a, g.key)].push(a); });
    });
    return out;
  }
  function countAccounts(b) {
    return b.personal.length + b.business.length + b.investment.length + b.unknown.length;
  }
  function anyHandEntered(buckets, details) {
    var all = buckets.personal.concat(buckets.business, buckets.investment, buckets.unknown);
    if (!all.length) return false;
    return all.some(function (a) {
      var d = details && details[a.id];
      return !d || d.hand_entered !== false;
    });
  }
  function renderAccountRow(a) {
    return '<div class="fos-r acct"><span class="nm">' + esc(a.name || "Unnamed account") +
      (a.mask ? "<em>····" + esc(a.mask) + "</em>" : "") +
      (a.closed_at ? ' <span class="fos-pill">closed</span>' : "") + "</span>" +
      '<span class="num muted">' + esc(a.account_type || "—") + "</span>" +
      money(a.current_display) + "</div>";
  }
  function renderBucket(title, rows, empty) {
    var list = (rows || []).map(renderAccountRow).join("");
    return panel(title, rows && rows.length
      ? rows.length + " account" + (rows.length === 1 ? "" : "s") : "none",
      list || '<div class="fh-empty">' + esc(empty) + "</div>");
  }
  function bankPanels(res) {
    if (!res.ok) return emptyPanel("Bank accounts", "cash", whyWords(res, "this client's bank accounts"));
    var data = res.data || {};
    var buckets = collect(data.surface || null);
    if (countAccounts(buckets) === 0) {
      return emptyPanel("Bank accounts", "cash",
        "No bank account is on file. Nothing here is a made-up balance.");
    }
    return renderBucket("Personal", buckets.personal, "No personal account on file.") +
      renderBucket("Business", buckets.business, "No business account on file.") +
      renderBucket("Investment", buckets.investment, "No investment account on file.") +
      (buckets.unknown.length ? renderBucket("Not classified", buckets.unknown, "") : "");
  }
  function billsPanel(res) {
    if (!res.ok) return emptyPanel("Repeating charges", "on these accounts", whyWords(res, "the repeating charges"));
    var bills = (res.data && res.data.bills) || [];
    var rows = bills.map(function (b) {
      return '<div class="fos-r bill"><span class="nm">' + esc(b.merchant_display || b.merchant_key || "Unknown charge") +
        "<em>" + esc(b.cadence || "") + "</em></span>" +
        money(b.typical_amount_display) +
        '<span class="num' + (b.next_expected_on ? "" : " dash") + '">' +
        (b.next_expected_on ? esc(b.next_expected_on) : esc(b.next_expected_unknown_reason || "date unknown")) +
        "</span></div>";
    }).join("");
    return panel("Repeating charges", "on these accounts",
      rows || '<div class="fh-empty">Repeating charges show here once a connected account has some history.</div>');
  }

  /* suggestionsPanel — the "little CFO" panel, owner-set 2026-09-09. Finance OS
     is a paid monthly add-on: the panel's four real states are not entitled,
     entitled with no pull yet, entitled with a pull and nothing to flag, and
     entitled with real findings. UI-STANDARDS §6 requires all four and forbids
     inventing a fifth that hides one of them behind another's wording — a
     client who has not subscribed must never read the same sentence as one
     whose pull genuinely found nothing to say. Content is never generated
     here: api/read/finance-os-suggestions.mjs's costing_you and not_a_factor
     are the exact mapping UnderwriteIQ's funding deliverables already use. */
  function suggestionRow(item) {
    var sev = String(item.severity || "").toLowerCase();
    var pill = (sev === "high" || sev === "medium" || sev === "low")
      ? '<span class="fos-pill sev-' + sev + '">' + esc(sev) + "</span>" : "";
    var lines = (item.lines || []).filter(Boolean).map(esc).join(" ");
    return '<div class="fos-sug"><div class="hd"><b>' + esc(item.title || "") + "</b>" + pill + "</div>" +
      (lines ? '<div class="basis">' + lines + "</div>" : "") + "</div>";
  }
  function suggestionsPanel(res) {
    if (!res.ok) {
      if (res.source === "not_entitled") {
        return emptyPanel("Optimize your accounts", "finance-os add-on",
          "This client does not have an active Finance OS subscription. Optimization suggestions are part of that add-on and are not shown without one.");
      }
      return emptyPanel("Optimize your accounts", "finance-os add-on", whyWords(res, "this client's optimization suggestions"));
    }
    var d = res.data || {};
    if (!d.hasPull) {
      return emptyPanel("Optimize your accounts", "finance-os add-on",
        "No credit check has run for this client yet this month. One is requested automatically — see Repeating charges below for what is already known.");
    }
    if (d.engineError) {
      return emptyPanel("Optimize your accounts", "finance-os add-on",
        "The most recent pull could not be read: " + d.engineError + ".");
    }
    var costing = (d.costingYou || []).map(suggestionRow).join("");
    var notFactor = (d.notAFactor || []).map(suggestionRow).join("");
    var body = costing || '<div class="fh-empty">Nothing on the most recent pull is costing this client money right now.</div>';
    if (notFactor) {
      // .sub is on the caption whitelist (UI-STANDARDS §12.7) — no new size rule
      // needed, and no risk of it losing a specificity fight with .fos-ph h2's
      // title-size rule the way reusing an <h2> here would have.
      body += '<div class="fos-sug"><span class="sub">Checked, not a factor</span></div>' + notFactor;
    }
    return panel("Optimize your accounts", "finance-os add-on", body);
  }

  /* ═══ 6b. PAYDOWN SIMULATOR — POST /api/finance/paydown-simulator ═════════
     Body is { client_id, cash_on_hand } and nothing else. The server splits the
     cash across the cards the roadmap already names (biggest paydown first) and
     hands back pre-approval before and after. Every number below is the
     server's: this page adds no underwriting of its own.

     Two honest limits are written on the screen. The cash is TYPED — nothing
     here reads a bank. And the "after" figure is the server's straight-line
     estimate between today's pre-approval and the pre-approval once every card
     reaches its target; it is not a lender's answer.

     Its own POST helper, not apiGet(): a 403 here is either "this client has no
     Finance OS subscription" (entitled:false) or a plain auth failure, and the
     body says which, exactly as apiGetSuggestions() does for its read. */
  function postSimulator(cash) {
    var t = "";
    try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { t = ""; }
    var headers = { accept: "application/json", "content-type": "application/json" };
    if (t) headers.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
    var started;
    try {
      started = fetch("/api/finance/paydown-simulator", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({ client_id: clientId, cash_on_hand: cash })
      });
    } catch (e) {
      return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: (e && e.message) || "fetch unavailable" });
    }
    return Promise.resolve(started).then(function (r) {
      if (r.status === 404) {
        return r.json().then(function (d) {
          return (d && d.error === "not_found" && typeof d.path === "string")
            ? { ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: "/api/* not deployed" }
            : { ok: false, source: "notfound", data: null, error: "no such client" };
        }).catch(function () { return { ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: "/api/* not deployed" }; });
      }
      return r.json().then(function (d) {
        if (r.status === 403 && d && d.entitled === false) {
          return { ok: false, source: "not_entitled", data: null, error: d.reason || "not entitled" };
        }
        if (r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) {
          return { ok: false, source: "unauthorized", data: null, error: "not signed in, or not allowed" };
        }
        if (r.status === 503 || (d && d.db === "down")) {
          return { ok: false, source: "nodb", data: null, error: (d && d.message) || "The database is not reachable right now." };
        }
        if (r.status === 400) {
          var msg = d && d.error && /\s/.test(d.error) ? d.error : "The paydown could not be worked out from this client's credit report.";
          return { ok: false, source: "badrequest", data: null, error: msg };
        }
        if (!d || d.ok !== true) {
          return { ok: false, source: "server", data: null, error: "Something went wrong. Try again in a moment." };
        }
        return { ok: true, source: "api", data: d, error: null };
      }).catch(function () { return { ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: "response was not JSON" }; });
    }).catch(function (e) {
      return { ok: false, source: "offline", data: null, error: (e && e.message) || "network error" };
    });
  }

  /* dollars (a JS number from the server) -> "$1,234.50", or null when unknown. */
  function dollarsText(v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined || v === "") return null;
    var c = toCents(v);
    return c === null ? null : moneyText(fromCents(c));
  }
  function bigNum(v) {
    var t = dollarsText(v);
    return '<div class="fos-value' + (t === null ? " is-unknown" : "") + '">' + (t === null ? "—" : esc(t)) + "</div>";
  }

  /* Only digits with an optional cents part. "$5,000" and "5000.50" pass;
     "abc", "-5" and "" do not. Returns a number, or null when it is not one. */
  function parseCash(raw) {
    var s = String(raw == null ? "" : raw).replace(/[\s$,]/g, "");
    if (!/^\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(s)) return null;
    var n = Number(s);
    return isFinite(n) ? n : null;
  }

  function simResultHtml(d) {
    if (d.hasPull === false) {
      return '<div class="fh-empty">There is no credit report on file for this client yet, so there is no card to split cash across. ' +
        "Run this once a credit report is pulled.</div>";
    }
    var before = d.preapprovalBefore, proj = d.preapprovalProjected;
    var bc = toCents(before), pc = toCents(proj);
    var change = "";
    if (bc !== null && pc !== null) {
      var diff = pc - bc;
      change = '<div class="cmp">' + (diff === 0
        ? "no change vs today"
        : (diff > 0 ? "+" : "−") + esc(moneyText(fromCents(Math.abs(diff)))) + " vs today") + "</div>";
    }
    var head = '<div class="fos-ba">' +
      "<div><div class=\"caption\">Pre-approval today</div>" + bigNum(before) + "</div>" +
      "<div><div class=\"caption\">Estimated after this cash</div>" + bigNum(proj) + change + "</div>" +
      "</div>";

    var allocs = d.allocations || [];
    var rows = fhRow("Cash entered", "typed in above, not read from a bank", fhNum(fromCents(toCents(d.cashOnHand)), true, false)) +
      fhRow("Cash put on cards", allocs.length + " card" + (allocs.length === 1 ? "" : "s"),
        fhNum(fromCents(toCents(d.cashApplied)), true, false)) +
      fhRow("Cash left over", d.cashUnallocated > 0
          ? "no card needs more to reach its target" : "",
        fhNum(fromCents(toCents(d.cashUnallocated)), true, false)) +
      fhRow("Paydown for every card to reach its target", "",
        fhNum(fromCents(toCents(d.totalPaydownNeeded)), true, false)) +
      fhRow("Pre-approval once every card reaches its target", "",
        fhNum(fromCents(toCents(d.preapprovalAfterFull)), true, false));

    var split;
    if (!allocs.length) {
      split = '<div class="fh-empty">' + (d.totalPaydownNeeded > 0
        ? "No cash was entered, so no card is paid down."
        : "No open card is above its target balance, so there is nothing to pay down.") + "</div>";
    } else {
      split = '<div class="fos-r alloc"><span class="nm muted">card</span>' +
        '<span class="num muted">pay</span><span class="num muted">balance now → target</span></div>' +
        allocs.map(function (a) {
          var from = dollarsText(a.balanceBefore), to = dollarsText(a.targetBalance);
          return '<div class="fos-r alloc"><span class="nm">' + esc(a.account || "Unnamed card") + "</span>" +
            money(fromCents(toCents(a.payDollars))) +
            '<span class="num">' + esc(from === null ? "—" : from) + " → " + esc(to === null ? "—" : to) + "</span></div>";
        }).join("");
    }
    var foot = '<div class="fos-sug">This is an estimate, not a lender’s answer. ' +
      "It moves in a straight line from today’s pre-approval toward the figure once every card reaches its target" +
      (d.pulledAt ? ". Based on the credit report pulled " + esc(day(d.pulledAt)) : "") + ".</div>";
    return head + rows + split + foot;
  }

  function simulatorPanel() {
    var form = '<form class="fos-calc fos-sim-form" id="fosSimForm" novalidate>' +
      '<div class="fld"><label for="fosSimCash">Cash on hand ($)</label>' +
      '<input id="fosSimCash" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" placeholder="5000"></div>' +
      '<div class="fld"><button class="btn" id="fosSimGo" type="submit">Split this cash</button></div>' +
      "</form>";
    return panel("Paydown simulator", "Blueprint · Finance OS",
      form + '<div class="fh-msg" id="fosSimMsg" role="status" hidden></div>' +
      '<div id="fosSimOut"><div class="fh-empty">Type how much cash this client can put toward their cards and choose “Split this cash”. ' +
      "The split and the before and after pre-approval appear here.</div></div>");
  }

  /* Promo tracking — labelled NOT LIVE. Measured 2026-09-29: no table stores a
     0% promo end date for a client's cards. client_cards is the card the client
     PAYS US with (last four digits and expiry), not a credit card they hold, and
     it has no promo column. So there is nothing to list or count down, and this
     panel says that in words instead of showing sample dates. */
  function promoPanel() {
    return panel("Promo tracking", "not live",
      '<div class="fh-empty"><p><b>Not live.</b> No promo end dates are stored for this client’s cards, so there is nothing to list and no countdown to show.</p>' +
      "<p>This panel shows nothing made up. It will fill in once promo end dates are recorded.</p></div>");
  }

  function wireSimulator() {
    var form = $("fosSimForm");
    if (!form) return;
    var input = $("fosSimCash"), go = $("fosSimGo"), msg = $("fosSimMsg"), out = $("fosSimOut");
    function say(text, bad) {
      msg.hidden = !text;
      msg.textContent = text || "";
      msg.className = "fh-msg" + (bad ? " bad" : "");
    }
    form.addEventListener("submit", function (ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      var cash = parseCash(input.value);
      if (cash === null) {
        say("Type the cash as a plain number, like 5000 or 5,000.50.", true);
        input.focus();
        return;
      }
      say("", false);
      go.disabled = true;
      go.textContent = "Working…";
      postSimulator(cash).then(function (res) {
        go.disabled = false;
        go.textContent = "Split this cash";
        if (res.ok) {
          say("", false);
          out.innerHTML = simResultHtml(res.data);
          return;
        }
        out.innerHTML = "";
        if (res.source === "not_entitled") {
          say("This client does not have an active Finance OS subscription, so the simulator is not available for them.", true);
        } else if (res.source === "badrequest") {
          say(res.error, true);
        } else if (res.source === "notfound") {
          say("That client could not be found in this company.", true);
        } else {
          say(whyWords(res, "the paydown split"), true);
        }
      });
    });
  }

  /* ═══ 7. PAINT ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function paint(html) {
    var wrap = $("fosWrap");
    if (wrap) wrap.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function skeleton() {
    return '<div class="fos-hero"><div class="fos-hh"><div>' +
      '<div class="k caption">Available credit</div><div class="n fos-value">—</div>' +
      '<div class="s">Reading this client’s file…</div></div></div></div>';
  }

  function pickFirst() {
    paint(
      '<div class="fos-hero"><div class="fos-hh"><div>' +
      '<div class="k caption">No client open</div>' +
      '<div class="n fos-value">Pick a client</div>' +
      '<div class="s">Finance OS shows one client at a time. Use the picker at the top of the page.</div>' +
      "</div></div></div>" +
      panel("What appears once a client is open", "",
        '<div class="fh-empty">' +
        "<p>What credit they have, what they owe on it, and what is left to draw.</p>" +
        "<p>The money they have paid us, and anything still invoiced and unpaid.</p>" +
        "<p>Their bank accounts, and the charges that repeat against those accounts.</p>" +
        "</div>")
    );
  }

  function notesFor(bankRes) {
    var out = [];
    if (bankRes.ok) {
      var data = bankRes.data || {};
      var buckets = collect(data.surface || null);
      if (countAccounts(buckets) && anyHandEntered(buckets, data.details || {})) {
        out.push('<div class="fos-note warn">Some balances below were typed in by hand. ' +
          "The bank is not linked, so they are not live figures and somebody has to keep them current.</div>");
      }
    }
    return out.length ? '<div class="fos-notes">' + out.join("") + "</div>" : "";
  }

  function loadAll() {
    paint(skeleton());
    var q = encodeURIComponent(clientId);
    Promise.all([
      apiGet("/api/read/finance-os?client_id=" + q),
      apiGet("/api/dashboard/client?id=" + q),
      apiGet("/api/finance/bank-accounts?client_id=" + q),
      apiGet("/api/finance/bills?client_id=" + q),
      apiGetSuggestions(clientId)
    ]).then(function (r) {
      var gridRes = r[0], detailRes = r[1], bankRes = r[2], billRes = r[3], suggRes = r[4];

      explain(gridRes, "this client's credit");
      explain(detailRes, "this client's payments and invoices");
      explain(bankRes, "this client's bank accounts");
      explain(billRes, "the repeating charges");
      // not_entitled is an expected business state (no subscription), not a
      // technical failure — it gets its own honest panel below, not a
      // page-wide error banner alongside a database outage or an auth bug.
      if (suggRes.source !== "not_entitled") explain(suggRes, "this client's optimization suggestions");

      var c = detailRes.ok && detailRes.data ? detailRes.data.client : null;
      /* A CLIENT IS OPEN EVEN WHEN THE READ THAT KNOWS HER NAME FAILED, and the
         page must not then say "no client open" — that sends the reader back to
         the picker to fix something that is not broken. Fall back to the start
         of the id, which is at least true. */
      var name = c ? ((c.first_name || "") + " " + (c.last_name || "")).trim() || c.email : "";
      if (!name) name = "client " + clientId.slice(0, 8);
      var who = $("fosWho");
      if (who) who.textContent = name;

      paint(
        heroFor(name, gridRes.ok ? gridRes.data : null, gridRes) +
        notesFor(bankRes) +
        '<div class="fos-sim">' + simulatorPanel() + "</div>" +
        '<div class="grid2"><div class="col">' +
        creditPanel(gridRes) +
        moneyInPanel(detailRes) +
        invoicedPanel(detailRes) +
        bankPanels(bankRes) +
        '</div><div class="col">' +
        suggestionsPanel(suggRes) +
        billsPanel(billRes) +
        promoPanel() +
        "</div></div>"
      );
      wireSimulator();
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    wirePicker();
    loadClients();
    if (!clientId) { pickFirst(); return; }
    loadAll();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
