/* ══ BOOT: grade every sample score, exactly as the server would ═════════
   Sample-only. Live rows from api/hiring/candidates arrive with average /
   recommendation / flags / rubric_version already computed server-side (the
   LATERAL join in the SQL), so this scoring pass never runs against them. */
function deriveSample(apps, decisions){
  var appById={}, decisionById={};
  apps.forEach(function(a){
    a.scores.forEach(function(s){
      var r = RUBRICS[s.rubric];
      var g = grade(r, s.category_scores);
      s.rubric_version = r.version;
      s.rubric_stage   = r.stage_key;
      s.average        = g.average;
      s.recommendation = g.recommendation;
      s.label          = g.label;
      s.flags          = g.flags;
      s.missing        = g.missing;
      s.totalWeight    = g.totalWeight;
      s.weighted       = g.weighted;
    });
    /* The board's LATERAL … ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 — latest only. */
    var latest = a.scores.length ? a.scores[a.scores.length-1] : null;
    a.latest          = latest;
    a.average         = latest ? latest.average : null;
    a.recommendation  = latest ? latest.recommendation : null;
    a.flags           = latest ? latest.flags : [];
    a.rubric_version  = latest ? latest.rubric_version : null;
    a.is_automated    = latest ? latest.is_automated : null;
    a.sort_order      = STAGE_BY_KEY[a.stage_key].sort;
    a.stage_name      = STAGE_BY_KEY[a.stage_key].name;
    a.role_name       = ROLE_BY_KEY[a.role_key].name;
    a.recommendation_status = 'advisory — a human decides';
    a.needs_human     = (a.flags.length > 0) || (a.average === null);
    /* candidates.mjs:48 — (a.video_url IS NOT NULL) AS has_video. The board never
       sees the URL; the drawer's endpoint (application.mjs:21) returns it whole. */
    a.has_video       = a.video_url !== null;
    appById[a.id]=a;
  });
  decisions.forEach(function(d){
    /* The endpoint's CASE expression, reproduced rather than reinterpreted. */
    if(d.recommendation_at_decision===null) d.followed_recommendation=null;
    else if(d.decision==='reject')
      d.followed_recommendation = ['review_likely_no','incomplete'].indexOf(d.recommendation_at_decision)>=0;
    else if(d.decision==='advance'||d.decision==='offer')
      d.followed_recommendation = ['advance','advance_priority','review_maybe'].indexOf(d.recommendation_at_decision)>=0;
    else d.followed_recommendation=null;
    decisionById[d.id]=d;
  });
  apps.forEach(function(a){
    a.decisions = (a.decision_ids||[]).map(function(id){ return decisionById[id]; }).filter(Boolean);
  });
  return {appById:appById, decisionById:decisionById};
}

/* Empty until wireHiring() finishes. SAMPLE_* is demo-session only. */
var APPS = [], POSTINGS = [], DECISIONS = [];
var BENCH_ROWS = null; // null = derive client-side from APPS (benchRows() below)
var LIVE = {candidates:false, postings:false, decisions:false, bench:false, funnel:false};
var APP_BY_ID = {}, DECISION_BY_ID = {};

/* ══ SHARED RENDER HELPERS ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var STATUS_CLS={open:'b-info', hired:'b-ok', rejected:'b-alert', withdrawn:'b-gray'};
var POST_CLS  ={draft:'b-gray', posted:'b-ok', paused:'b-warn', closed:'b-gray', failed:'b-alert'};
var IV_CLS    ={scheduled:'b-info', held:'b-ok', cancelled:'b-gray', no_show:'b-alert'};
var OUT_CLS   ={yes:'b-ok', maybe:'b-warn', no:'b-alert'};
var DEC_CLS   ={advance:'b-info', offer:'b-accent', reject:'b-alert',
                offer_accepted:'b-gray', offer_declined:'b-gray', withdraw:'b-gray', hold:'b-gray'};

/* A role that is not one of the three seeded ones has no display name on this
   page. Show the key itself rather than stopping the render — an unknown name is
   an unknown, not a reason for the screen to fail to load. */
function roleName(key){
  var r = ROLE_BY_KEY[key];
  return r ? r.name : (key || 'unknown role');
}
function badge(cls,txt,title){
  return '<span class="badge '+cls+'"'+(title?' title="'+esc(title)+'"':'')+'>'+esc(txt)+'</span>';
}
/* Recommendation is rendered in ONE neutral style for every value. Colouring it
   would turn advice into a verdict, which is the thing grading.mjs refuses to be. */
function recPill(rec){
  if(!rec) return '<span class="nul mono">no score</span>';
  return '<span class="rec" title="advisory — a human decides">'+esc(rec)+'</span>';
}
function avgCell(avg){
  return avg===null||avg===undefined
    ? '<span class="nul mono" title="Not scored — a scorecard with any part left blank is never averaged.">not scored</span>'
    : '<span class="mnum" style="font-weight:600">'+num(avg)+'</span><span class="nul mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption)"> / 4</span>';
}
function flagList(flags){
  if(!flags||!flags.length) return '<span class="nul mono">—</span>';
  return flags.map(function(f){
    return '<div style="margin-bottom:4px">'+
      (f.unevaluated?'<span class="badge b-warn" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);padding:1px 5px">rule not checked yet</span>':'')+
      '<div style="font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--gray);line-height:1.45;margin-top:2px">'+esc(f.label)+'</div></div>';
  }).join('');
}
function inStageCell(a){
  var d=daysSince(a.entered_stage_at);
  var cls = d>=14 ? 'stripe-bad' : (d>=7 ? 'stripe-warn' : '');
  return {days:d, cls:cls,
    html:'<span class="mnum">'+d+'d</span><span class="sub">since '+esc(fdate(a.entered_stage_at))+'</span>'};
}

/* ══ HR-02 · THE BENCH ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Derived here with exactly the predicates in v_hiring_bench (051 §J) and the
   two correlated subqueries in api/hiring/bench.mjs, so the working can be
   shown. The server computes this in the view; nothing is re-defined. */
function benchRows(){
  var rows = ROLES.map(function(r){
    var mine = APPS.filter(function(a){ return a.role_key===r.key; });
    var open = mine.filter(function(a){ return a.status==='open'; });
    var bench = open.filter(function(a){ return a.stage_key==='one_on_one'||a.stage_key==='offer'; }).length;
    return {
      role_key:r.key, role_name:r.name, bench_target:r.bench_target,
      bench_count:bench,
      bench_shortfall:Math.max(r.bench_target-bench,0),
      open_applications:open.length,
      awaiting_screen: open.filter(function(a){return a.stage_key==='applied';}).length,
      awaiting_group_interview: open.filter(function(a){return a.stage_key==='group_interview';}).length,
      hiring_manager:r.hiring_manager,
      short:(r.bench_target-bench)>0,
      unrouted:!r.hiring_manager
    };
  });
  rows.sort(function(a,b){ return (b.bench_shortfall-a.bench_shortfall) || (a.role_key<b.role_key?-1:1); });
  return rows;
}

function renderBench(rows){
  var tb=document.querySelector('#benchTbl tbody');
  tb.innerHTML = rows.map(function(b){
    var pct = b.bench_target ? Math.min(100, Math.round(100*b.bench_count/b.bench_target)) : 0;
    var mcls = b.bench_shortfall===0 ? '' : (b.bench_shortfall>=3 ? ' bad' : ' warn');
    var scls = b.bench_shortfall===0 ? 'stripe-ok' : (b.bench_shortfall>=3 ? 'stripe-bad' : 'stripe-warn');
    var flags=[];
    if(b.short) flags.push(badge('b-warn','short','fewer people on the bench than this role targets'));
    if(b.unrouted) flags.push(badge('b-alert','unrouted','no hiring manager on this role'));
    if(!flags.length) flags.push('<span class="nul mono">—</span>');
    return '<tr class="'+scls+'">'+
      '<td><b>'+esc(b.role_name)+'</b></td>'+
      '<td><span class="meter'+mcls+'"><i style="width:'+pct+'%"></i></span>'+
        '<span class="mnum" style="font-weight:600">'+b.bench_count+'</span>'+
        '<span class="nul mono"> / '+b.bench_target+'</span>'+
        '<span class="sub">target for this role</span></td>'+
      '<td><span class="mnum" style="font-weight:600'+(b.bench_shortfall?';color:#6E2A22':'')+'">'+b.bench_shortfall+'</span></td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+b.open_applications+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+b.awaiting_screen+'<span class="sub">not screened yet</span></td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+b.awaiting_group_interview+'<span class="sub">at group interview</span></td>'+
      '<td>'+(b.hiring_manager?esc(b.hiring_manager):'<span class="nul mono">unassigned</span>')+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+flags.join(' ')+'</td>'+
    '</tr>';
  }).join('');
}

/* ══ HR-00 · SUMMARY + DERIVATION ════════════════════════════════════════ */
/* Demo Mode's seeded candidates are counted nowhere on this screen. The bench
   numbers arrive already totalled by the server, which counts a demo application
   with the real ones, so the demo rows this screen can see are taken back off
   again here. Subtraction only ever removes rows we positively identified, so a
   demo row this screen cannot see leaves the number too high, never too low. */
function demoApps(){ return APPS.filter(function(a){ return a.is_demo_row; }); }

function benchLessDemo(rows){
  var demo = demoApps().filter(function(a){ return a.status==='open'; });
  if(!demo.length) return rows;
  return rows.map(function(b){
    var mine = demo.filter(function(a){ return a.role_key===b.role_key; });
    if(!mine.length) return b;
    var onBench = mine.filter(function(a){ return a.stage_key==='one_on_one'||a.stage_key==='offer'; }).length;
    var count = Math.max((b.bench_count||0)-onBench, 0);
    var out = Object.assign({}, b);
    out.bench_count       = count;
    out.bench_shortfall   = Math.max((b.bench_target||0)-count, 0);
    out.open_applications = Math.max((b.open_applications||0)-mine.length, 0);
    out.awaiting_screen   = Math.max((b.awaiting_screen||0)-
      mine.filter(function(a){ return a.stage_key==='applied'; }).length, 0);
    out.awaiting_group_interview = Math.max((b.awaiting_group_interview||0)-
      mine.filter(function(a){ return a.stage_key==='group_interview'; }).length, 0);
    return out;
  });
}

function renderStats(){
  var bench = benchLessDemo(BENCH_ROWS || benchRows());
  var benchCount = bench.reduce(function(n,b){return n+b.bench_count;},0);
  var benchTarget= bench.reduce(function(n,b){return n+b.bench_target;},0);
  var shortfall  = bench.reduce(function(n,b){return n+b.bench_shortfall;},0);
  var openApps   = bench.reduce(function(n,b){return n+b.open_applications;},0);

  var queue = APPS.filter(function(a){ return a.needs_human && !a.is_demo_row; });
  var queueOpen = queue.filter(function(a){ return a.status==='open'; }).length;

  var demoOpen  = demoApps().filter(function(a){ return a.status==='open'; }).length;
  var demoQueue = demoApps().filter(function(a){ return a.needs_human; }).length;
  function demoNote(n){
    return n ? ' · '+n+' demo row'+(n===1?'':'s')+' not counted' : '';
  }


  document.getElementById('statRow').innerHTML =
    '<div class="stat"><div class="eyebrow">SHORT BY</div>'+
      '<div class="sv">'+shortfall+'</div>'+
      '<div class="sd">people, across '+bench.length+' role'+(bench.length===1?'':'s')+'</div></div>'+
    '<div class="stat"><div class="eyebrow">WAITING ON YOU</div>'+
      '<div class="sv">'+queue.length+'</div>'+
      '<div class="sd">'+queueOpen+' still open'+demoNote(demoQueue)+'</div></div>'+
    '<div class="stat"><div class="eyebrow">ON THE BENCH</div>'+
      '<div class="sv">'+benchCount+' <span class="nul" style="font-size:var(--fs-title)">/ '+benchTarget+'</span></div>'+
      '<div class="sd">close to starting'+demoNote(demoOpen)+'</div></div>'+
    '<div class="stat"><div class="eyebrow">OPEN APPLICATIONS</div>'+
      '<div class="sv">'+openApps+'</div>'+
      '<div class="sd">across all roles'+demoNote(demoOpen)+'</div></div>';

  var benchInputs = bench.filter(function(b){ return b.bench_shortfall > 0; }).map(function(b){
    return '<b>'+esc(b.role_name)+'</b> short '+b.bench_shortfall;
  }).join(' · ');

  document.getElementById('deriv').innerHTML =
    (benchInputs
      ? '<div class="dcell"><div class="dk">roles you are short on</div><div class="inputs">'+benchInputs+'</div></div>'
      : '<div class="dcell"><div class="dk">roles you are short on</div><div class="inputs">None. Every role is at target.</div></div>')+
    (demoApps().length
      ? '<div class="src">'+demoApps().length+' Demo Mode row'+(demoApps().length===1?' is':'s are')+
        ' shown on the board with a demo label and counted in none of the numbers above</div>'
      : '');

  var chip=document.getElementById('benchChip');
  chip.className = 'chip ' + (shortfall===0?'on':(shortfall>=5?'bad':'wip'));
  document.getElementById('benchChipTxt').textContent = 'bench '+benchCount+' / '+benchTarget;
  return bench;
}

/* ══ HR-03 · PIPELINE BOARD ══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var boardState = {stage:'all', role:'', source:'', flagged:false};

var SHOW_DEMO_ROWS = false;

function boardFiltered(ignoreStage){
  return APPS.filter(function(a){
    if(!SHOW_DEMO_ROWS && a.is_demo_row) return false;
    if(!ignoreStage && boardState.stage!=='all' && a.stage_key!==boardState.stage) return false;
    if(boardState.role && a.role_key!==boardState.role) return false;
    if(boardState.source && a.source!==boardState.source) return false;
    if(boardState.flagged && !a.needs_human) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

function renderStageRail(){
  var pool = boardFiltered(true);
  var counts={}; pool.forEach(function(a){ counts[a.stage_key]=(counts[a.stage_key]||0)+1; });
  var host=document.getElementById('stageRail');
  var html = '<button type="button" data-stage="all"'+(boardState.stage==='all'?' class="on"':'')+
             '>all stages<span class="n">'+pool.length+'</span></button>';
  html += STAGES.map(function(s){
    var n=counts[s.key]||0;
    var cls=[]; if(boardState.stage===s.key) cls.push('on'); if(!n) cls.push('zero');
    return '<button type="button" data-stage="'+s.key+'"'+(cls.length?' class="'+cls.join(' ')+'"':'')+
      '>'+esc(s.name)+'<span class="n">'+n+'</span></button>';
  }).join('');
  host.innerHTML=html;
  host.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){ boardState.stage=b.dataset.stage; renderBoard(); });
  });
}

function cardHTML(a){
  var d = daysSince(a.entered_stage_at);
  var cls='ccard'+(a.needs_human?' needs':'')+(a.status!=='open'?' closed':'');
  var chips=[];
  if(a.is_demo_row) chips.push('<span class="tag" title="Seeded by Demo Mode. Counted in none of the numbers on this screen.">demo row</span>');
  chips.push('<span class="tag'+(a.has_video?' has':' off')+'" title="Whether a video was submitted. Open the candidate to watch it.">video</span>');
  chips.push('<span class="tag'+(a.has_resume?' has':' off')+'" title="Whether a resume was submitted. The file itself cannot be opened from this screen.">resume</span>');
  if(a.disc_profile) chips.push('<span class="tag" title="A note, never a filter and never a reason to turn someone down.">DISC '+esc(a.disc_profile)+'</span>');
  if(a.linkedin_profile_url) chips.push('<span class="tag has" title="A LinkedIn link only. No photo, job history or connections are stored.">li url</span>');

  var s='<div class="sblk">';
  if(a.average===null){
    s+='<div class="row1"><span class="avg nul">not scored</span>'+
       '<span class="rv">rubric v'+esc(a.rubric_version)+'</span></div>';
  } else {
    s+='<div class="row1"><span class="avg">'+num(a.average)+'</span><span class="of">/ 4</span>'+
       '<span class="rv">rubric v'+esc(a.rubric_version)+'</span></div>';
  }
  s+=recPill(a.recommendation);
  s+='<div class="adv">'+esc(a.recommendation_status)+' · '+(a.is_automated?'automated grader':'scored by a person')+'</div>';
  if(a.flags.length) s+='<div class="fl">⚑ '+a.flags.length+' flag'+(a.flags.length===1?'':'s')+
     ' <span class="fk">'+esc(a.flags.map(function(f){return f.key;}).join(', '))+'</span></div>';
  s+='</div>';

  return '<button type="button" class="'+cls+'" data-app="'+esc(a.id)+'">'+
    '<div class="nm"><span class="avi">'+esc(initials(a.full_name))+'</span><span style="min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap">'+esc(a.full_name)+'</span></div>'+
    '<div class="meta">'+esc(a.role_name)+' · '+esc(a.source)+(a.source_detail?' · '+esc(a.source_detail):'')+'<br>'+
      'applied '+esc(fdate(a.applied_at))+' · in stage '+d+'d · status '+esc(a.status)+'</div>'+
    '<div class="chips">'+chips.join('')+'</div>'+ s +
  '</button>';
}

function renderBoard(){
  renderStageRail();
  var rows = boardFiltered(false);
  /* ORDER BY s.sort_order, a.entered_stage_at DESC — fixed, there is no sort control. */
  rows.sort(function(x,y){
    if(x.sort_order!==y.sort_order) return x.sort_order-y.sort_order;
    return pd(y.entered_stage_at)-pd(x.entered_stage_at);
  });
  var shown = boardState.stage==='all' ? STAGES : STAGES.filter(function(s){return s.key===boardState.stage;});
  document.getElementById('board').innerHTML = shown.map(function(s){
    var mine = rows.filter(function(a){ return a.stage_key===s.key; });
    var body = mine.length ? mine.map(cardHTML).join('')
      : '<div class="col-empty">'+(s.key==='withdrawn'
          ? 'nothing puts a candidate<br>in this stage yet'
          : 'nothing here')+'</div>';
    return '<div class="col"><div class="col-hd">'+
      '<div class="cn"><span>'+esc(s.name)+'</span><span class="cc">'+mine.length+'</span></div></div>'+
      '<div class="col-bd">'+body+'</div></div>';
  }).join('');

  document.getElementById('board').querySelectorAll('.ccard').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){ openDrawer(b.dataset.app); });
  });

  var realShown = rows.filter(function(a){ return !a.is_demo_row; }).length;
  var demoShown = rows.length - realShown;
  /* Every candidate on file can be a Demo Mode row, and with Demo Mode off the
     board then draws nothing at all with no explanation. Say the number. */
  var demoHidden = SHOW_DEMO_ROWS ? 0 : APPS.filter(function(a){
    if(!a.is_demo_row) return false;
    if(boardState.stage!=='all' && a.stage_key!==boardState.stage) return false;
    if(boardState.role && a.role_key!==boardState.role) return false;
    if(boardState.source && a.source!==boardState.source) return false;
    if(boardState.flagged && !a.needs_human) return false;
    return true;
  }).length;
  document.getElementById('boardCount').textContent =
    realShown+' application'+(realShown===1?'':'s')+' shown'+
    (demoShown? ' · '+demoShown+' demo':'')+
    (demoHidden? ' · '+demoHidden+' demo hidden':'');
  document.getElementById('boardPager').innerHTML =
    'showing '+rows.length+' of '+APPS.length+' loaded application'+(APPS.length===1?'':'s')+
    (demoShown? ' · '+demoShown+' of them seeded by Demo Mode, labelled on the card and counted nowhere':'')+
    (demoHidden? ' · '+demoHidden+' seeded by Demo Mode and hidden because Demo Mode is off':'')+
    ' · up to 200 are loaded at a time, and no screen-wide total is available';
  var t=document.getElementById('fFlagged');
  t.classList.toggle('on', boardState.flagged);
  t.setAttribute('aria-pressed', boardState.flagged?'true':'false');
}

/* ══ HR-04 · NEEDS A HUMAN ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderReviewQueue(){
  var rows = APPS.filter(function(a){ return a.needs_human && (SHOW_DEMO_ROWS || !a.is_demo_row); });
  rows.sort(function(x,y){
    if(x.sort_order!==y.sort_order) return x.sort_order-y.sort_order;
    return pd(y.entered_stage_at)-pd(x.entered_stage_at);
  });
  var tb=document.querySelector('#rqTbl tbody');
  tb.innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.map(function(a){
    var st=inStageCell(a);
    /* A sample row carries a fully graded `latest` score object. A live row does
       not: the board read returns the number, the recommendation and the flags,
       and no score label or scorecard stage. Those two are genuinely unknown on
       a live row, so they are printed as unknown instead of being invented — and
       reaching into a score that is not there is what used to stop this whole
       page from loading. */
    var latest = a.latest || null;
    var why = (a.average===null || a.average===undefined)
      ? '<div><b>Not scored</b><div style="font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--gray);line-height:1.45;margin-top:2px">'+
        (latest && latest.label ? esc(latest.label) : 'No reason for the missing score was recorded.')+'</div></div>'
      : flagList(a.flags);
    return '<tr class="'+st.cls+(a.status!=='open'?' dim':'')+'" data-app="'+esc(a.id)+'" tabindex="0" style="cursor:pointer">'+
      '<td><b>'+esc(a.full_name)+'</b>'+
        (a.is_demo_row?' '+badge('b-gray','demo row','Seeded by Demo Mode. Counted in none of the numbers on this screen.'):'')+
        '<span class="sub">'+esc(a.id)+' · '+esc(a.source)+'</span></td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(a.role_name)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(a.stage_name)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+badge(STATUS_CLS[a.status],a.status)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+avgCell(a.average)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+recPill(a.recommendation)+'<span class="sub">'+esc(a.recommendation_status)+'</span></td>'+
      '<td class="mono">'+(a.rubric_version?'v'+esc(a.rubric_version):'<span class="nul">no rubric</span>')+
        (latest && latest.rubric_stage?'<span class="sub">'+esc(latest.rubric_stage)+'</span>':'')+'</td>'+
      '<td style="max-width:340px">'+why+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+st.html+'</td>'+
    '</tr>';
  }).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="9"><div class="empty">Nothing is waiting on a person. A row appears when an application needs a review.</div></td></tr>';

  tb.querySelectorAll('tr[data-app]').forEach(function(tr){
    tr.addEventListener('click',function(){ openDrawer(tr.dataset.app); });
    tr.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); openDrawer(tr.dataset.app); }
    });
  });
  /* Demo Mode rows stay visible and labelled, and are counted in nothing. */
  var real = rows.filter(function(a){ return !a.is_demo_row; });
  var demoWaiting = rows.length - real.length;
  document.getElementById('rqCount').textContent =
    real.length+' waiting · '+real.filter(function(a){return a.status==='open';}).length+' open'+
    (demoWaiting? ' · '+demoWaiting+' demo not counted':'');

  /* `carrying` = rows held here by a scorecard rule the grader cannot check. */
  var carrying = real.filter(function(a){
    return a.flags.some(function(f){ return f.unevaluated; });
  });
  document.getElementById('rqInsight').innerHTML = carrying.length
    ? carrying.length+' of these '+real.length+' are here because of a scorecard rule the grader '+
      'cannot check yet. That is one scorecard to fix, not '+carrying.length+' people to read.'
    : '';
}

/* ══ HR-05 · JOB POSTINGS ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var postState={state:'all', channel:'all'};
var POST_STATES=['draft','posted','paused','closed','failed'];
var POST_CHANNELS=['linkedin','facebook','job_board','internal'];

function renderPostRails(){
  /* `key` is the postState slot; `field` is the column on the row it filters —
     they differ for state, which reads postings.status. */
  function rail(host, key, field, values, label){
    var counts={};
    POSTINGS.forEach(function(p){ counts[p[field]]=(counts[p[field]]||0)+1; });
    var html='<button type="button" data-v="all"'+(postState[key]==='all'?' class="on"':'')+'>'+
      label+'<span class="n">'+POSTINGS.length+'</span></button>';
    html+=values.map(function(v){
      var n=counts[v]||0, cls=[]; if(postState[key]===v) cls.push('on'); if(!n) cls.push('zero');
      return '<button type="button" data-v="'+v+'"'+(cls.length?' class="'+cls.join(' ')+'"':'')+
        '>'+esc(v)+'<span class="n">'+n+'</span></button>';
    }).join('');
    host.innerHTML=html;
    host.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){ postState[key]=b.dataset.v; renderPostings(); });
    });
  }
  rail(document.getElementById('postStateRail'),'state','status',POST_STATES,'all states');
  rail(document.getElementById('postChannelRail'),'channel','channel',POST_CHANNELS,'all channels');
}

function renderPostings(){
  renderPostRails();
  var rows=POSTINGS.filter(function(p){
    if(postState.state!=='all' && p.status!==postState.state) return false;
    if(postState.channel!=='all' && p.channel!==postState.channel) return false;
    return true;
  });
  rows.sort(function(a,b){ return pd(b.created_at)-pd(a.created_at); });

  var tb=document.querySelector('#postTbl tbody');
  tb.innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.map(function(p,i){
    var scls = p.status==='failed' ? 'stripe-bad' : (p.status==='paused' ? 'stripe-warn' : (p.status==='posted' ? 'stripe-ok' : ''));
    var main='<tr class="rowbtn '+scls+'" data-p="'+i+'" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">'+
      '<td><span class="chev">▸</span><b>'+esc(p.title)+'</b><span class="sub">'+esc(p.id)+'</span></td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(roleName(p.role_key))+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+badge('b-gray',p.channel)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+(p.location?esc(p.location):'<span class="nul mono">—</span>')+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+badge(POST_CLS[p.status],p.status)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+(p.is_published?badge('b-info','published','Live on the channel it was posted to.')
                            :'<span class="nul mono">not live</span>')+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono">'+(p.posted_at?esc(fdate(p.posted_at)):'<span class="nul">—</span>')+
        (p.closed_at?'<span class="sub">closed '+esc(fdate(p.closed_at))+'</span>':'')+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+p.applications+'<span class="sub">lifetime</span></td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+p.applications_7d+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono">'+(p.last_synced_at?esc(fdate(p.last_synced_at)):'<span class="nul">never</span>')+'</td>'+
    '</tr>';
    var det='<tr class="det" data-det="'+i+'" hidden><td colspan="10"><div class="detwrap">'+
      '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">apply url</div><div class="dv mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption)">'+
        (p.apply_url?esc(p.apply_url):'<span class="nul">—</span>')+'</div></div>'+
      '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">created</div><div class="dv mono">'+esc(fdatey(p.created_at))+'</div></div>'+
      '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">last synced</div><div class="dv mono">'+
        (p.last_synced_at?esc(ftime(p.last_synced_at)):'<span class="nul">never</span>')+'</div></div>'+
      '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">description</div><div class="dv nul mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption)">not available here</div></div>'+
      (p.last_error
        ? '<div class="detcol wide"><div class="dk">what the channel said when it failed</div>'+
          '<div class="errbox">'+esc(p.last_error)+'</div>'+
          '<div class="note" style="margin-top:7px">The posting stays failed until someone fixes what the '+
          'message describes. Nothing tries it again on its own.</div></div>'
        : '<div class="detcol wide"><div class="dk">last failure</div><div class="dv nul mono">none</div></div>')+
    '</div></td></tr>';
    return main+det;
  }).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="10"><div class="empty">No postings match this filter. Add a posting or clear the filter to see the list.</div></td></tr>';

  tb.querySelectorAll('tr.rowbtn').forEach(function(tr){
    function toggle(){
      var open = tr.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true';
      tr.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open?'false':'true');
      var d=tb.querySelector('tr.det[data-det="'+tr.dataset.p+'"]');
      if(d) d.hidden=open;
    }
    tr.addEventListener('click',toggle);
    tr.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();toggle();} });
  });
}

/* ══ HR-06 · FUNNEL BY SOURCE ════════════════════════════════════════════
   Grouped by source × role_key over the window, with the endpoint's own
   count(*) FILTER predicates on the CURRENT stage's sort_order. */
function funnelRows(days, roleKey){
  var cutoff = new Date(NOW.getTime() - days*86400000);
  var scoped = APPS.filter(function(a){
    if(pd(a.applied_at) <= cutoff) return false;
    if(roleKey && a.role_key!==roleKey) return false;
    return true;
  });
  var map={};
  scoped.forEach(function(a){
    var k=a.source+'|'+a.role_key;
    if(!map[k]) map[k]={source:a.source, role_key:a.role_key, applications:0,
      reached_group_interview:0, reached_one_on_one:0, reached_offer:0, hired:0, rejected:0};
    var g=map[k];
    g.applications++;
    if(a.sort_order>=2) g.reached_group_interview++;
    if(a.sort_order>=3) g.reached_one_on_one++;
    if(a.sort_order>=4 && a.stage_key!=='rejected') g.reached_offer++;
    if(a.status==='hired') g.hired++;
    if(a.status==='rejected') g.rejected++;
  });
  var rows=Object.keys(map).map(function(k){
    var g=map[k];
    g.hire_rate_pct = g.applications===0 ? null : Math.round(1000*g.hired/g.applications)/10;
    return g;
  });
  rows.sort(function(a,b){ return b.applications-a.applications; });
  return {rows:rows, scoped:scoped.length, cutoff:cutoff};
}

/* paintFunnel — shared by the live api/hiring/funnel response and the client
   fallback funnelRows() produces; both hand it the identical row shape. */
function paintFunnel(rows, days, roleKey){
  var tb=document.querySelector('#fnTbl tbody');
  var cutoff = new Date(NOW.getTime() - days*86400000);

  tb.innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.map(function(g){
    var src=SOURCES.filter(function(s){return s.key===g.source;})[0];
    return '<tr>'+
      '<td><b>'+esc(src?src.label:g.source)+'</b></td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(roleName(g.role_key))+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum" style="font-weight:600">'+g.applications+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+g.reached_group_interview+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+g.reached_one_on_one+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+g.reached_offer+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+g.hired+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+g.rejected+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+(Number.isFinite(Number(g.hire_rate_pct))?Number(g.hire_rate_pct).toFixed(1)+'%':'<span class="nul">—</span>')+'</td>'+
    '</tr>';
  }).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="9"><div class="empty">No applications in this window. Change the role, source, or days filter to look again.</div></td></tr>';

  var totalApps=rows.reduce(function(n,g){return n+g.applications;},0);

  document.getElementById('fnWindow').textContent =
    days+'d window · '+rows.length+' groups · '+totalApps+' applications';

  var totalHired=rows.reduce(function(n,g){return n+g.hired;},0);
  var rejCount=APPS.filter(function(a){
    return a.stage_key==='rejected' && pd(a.applied_at)>cutoff && (!roleKey||a.role_key===roleKey);
  }).length;
  document.getElementById('fnInsight').innerHTML = totalApps
    ? '<span class="mono">'+totalHired+' hired of '+totalApps+' applications = '+
      (Math.round(1000*totalHired/totalApps)/10).toFixed(1)+'%</span>'+
      (rejCount ? ' · '+rejCount+' turned down in this window are still counted in the earlier columns.' : '')
    : '';
}

/* renderFunnel — live first. api/hiring/funnel takes the same ?days/?role this
   screen's own selectors drive, so a filter change re-queries it rather than
   re-deriving from the cached board rows. Falls back to the client
   funnelRows() derivation (over APPS, which is itself live once wired) only
   when the call cannot be made or fails. */
function renderFunnel(){
  var days=parseInt(document.getElementById('fnDays').value,10);
  var roleKey=document.getElementById('fnRole').value;
  if(!LIVE.candidates){ var out=funnelRows(days, roleKey); paintFunnel(out.rows, days, roleKey); return; }
  apiGet('/api/hiring/funnel?days='+encodeURIComponent(days)+(roleKey?'&role='+encodeURIComponent(roleKey):'')+'&limit=200')
    .then(function(res){
      // A slower control change landing after a faster later one must not repaint stale rows.
      if(days!==parseInt(document.getElementById('fnDays').value,10) ||
         roleKey!==document.getElementById('fnRole').value) return;
      if(res.ok){ LIVE.funnel=true; paintFunnel(res.data.items||[], days, roleKey); }
      else { var out=funnelRows(days, roleKey); paintFunnel(out.rows, days, roleKey); }
    });
}

/* ══ HR-07 · DECISION LOG ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var dcState={state:'all'};

function dcFiltered(ignoreState){
  var days=parseInt(document.getElementById('dcDays').value,10);
  var roleKey=document.getElementById('dcRole').value;
  var cutoff=new Date(NOW.getTime()-days*86400000);
  return DECISIONS.filter(function(d){
    if(pd(d.created_at)<=cutoff) return false;
    if(roleKey && d.role_key!==roleKey) return false;
    if(!ignoreState && dcState.state!=='all' && d.decision!==dcState.state) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

function renderDcRail(){
  var pool=dcFiltered(true), counts={};
  pool.forEach(function(d){ counts[d.decision]=(counts[d.decision]||0)+1; });
  var host=document.getElementById('dcRail');
  var html='<button type="button" data-v="all"'+(dcState.state==='all'?' class="on"':'')+
    '>all<span class="n">'+pool.length+'</span></button>';
  html+=DECISION_VALUES.map(function(v){
    var n=counts[v]||0, cls=[]; if(dcState.state===v) cls.push('on'); if(!n) cls.push('zero');
    var unreachable = DECISION_UNREACHABLE.indexOf(v)>=0;
    return '<button type="button" data-v="'+v+'"'+(cls.length?' class="'+cls.join(' ')+'"':'')+
      (unreachable?' title="A valid kind of decision that nothing in the system produces yet."':'')+
      '>'+esc(v)+(unreachable?' ∅':'')+'<span class="n">'+n+'</span></button>';
  }).join('');
  host.innerHTML=html;
  host.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){ dcState.state=b.dataset.v; renderDecisions(); });
  });
}

function renderDecisions(){
  renderDcRail();
  var rows=dcFiltered(false);
  rows.sort(function(a,b){ return pd(b.created_at)-pd(a.created_at); });

  var judged=rows.filter(function(d){ return d.followed_recommendation!==null; });
  var overrides=judged.filter(function(d){ return d.followed_recommendation===false; });
  var rate = judged.length ? (100*overrides.length/judged.length) : null;
  var byHuman = rows.filter(function(d){ return d.human_decided; }).length;

  document.getElementById('dcSummary').innerHTML =
    '<div class="deriv" style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:14px">'+
      '<div class="dcell"><div class="dk">went against the advice</div>'+
        '<div class="inputs"><b>'+overrides.length+'</b> of <b>'+judged.length+'</b> = <b>'+
          (rate===null?'—':rate.toFixed(1)+'%')+'</b></div></div>'+
      '<div class="dcell"><div class="dk">a person named on the row</div>'+
        '<div class="inputs"><b>'+byHuman+'</b> of <b>'+rows.length+'</b></div></div>'+
      '<div class="src">Race, sex and other protected details are never recorded here, so a fairness '+
        'check by those groups cannot be run from this data.</div>'+
    '</div>';

  var tb=document.querySelector('#dcTbl tbody');
  tb.innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.map(function(d,i){
    var fr = d.followed_recommendation===null
      ? '<span class="nul mono" title="There was no recommendation at the time, or this kind of decision has none to follow.">not defined</span>'
      : (d.followed_recommendation ? badge('b-gray','followed') : badge('b-warn','override'));
    var scls = d.followed_recommendation===false ? 'stripe-warn' : (d.decision==='reject' ? 'stripe-bad' : '');
    var main='<tr class="rowbtn '+scls+'" data-d="'+i+'" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">'+
      '<td><span class="chev">▸</span><span class="mono">'+esc(fdate(d.created_at))+'</span>'+
        '<span class="sub">'+esc(d.id)+'</span></td>'+
      '<td>'+badge(DEC_CLS[d.decision],d.decision)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption)">'+esc(d.from_stage_key||'—')+' → '+esc(d.to_stage_key||'—')+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(roleName(d.role_key))+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(d.source)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+(d.decided_by_name
        ? '<b>'+esc(d.decided_by_name)+'</b>'
        : '<span class="nul mono">no person named</span>')+
        '<span class="sub">'+(d.human_decided?'a person decided':'not decided by a person')+'</span></td>'+
      '<td>'+(d.recommendation_at_decision?recPill(d.recommendation_at_decision):'<span class="nul mono">—</span>')+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mnum">'+(d.score_at_decision===null?'<span class="nul">—</span>':num(d.score_at_decision))+
        (d.rubric_version?'<span class="sub">rubric v'+d.rubric_version+'</span>':'<span class="sub">no score attached</span>')+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+fr+'</td>'+
    '</tr>';
    var det='<tr class="det" data-detd="'+i+'" hidden><td colspan="9"><div class="detwrap">'+
      '<div class="detcol wide"><div class="dk">reason — written out, not picked from a list</div>'+
        '<div class="dv" style="font-weight:400;line-height:1.6">'+
        (d.reason?esc(d.reason):'<span class="nul mono">none recorded — allowed when someone is moved forward, never when they are turned down</span>')+
        '</div></div>'+
      '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">decided at</div><div class="dv mono">'+esc(ftime(d.created_at))+'</div></div>'+
      '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">candidate notified</div><div class="dv nul mono">'+
        (d.candidate_notified_at?esc(ftime(d.candidate_notified_at)):'nothing records this yet')+'</div></div>'+
      '<div class="detcol"><div class="dk">which application / who</div>'+
        '<div class="dv nul mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);line-height:1.55">not shown here — this log names '+
        'no candidate</div></div>'+
      (d.decision==='reject'
        ? '<div class="detcol wide"><div class="dk">what this row had to satisfy</div>'+
          '<div class="note">Turning someone down needs a named person and a reason written out. '+
          'It also raises the job of telling the candidate, which is tracked as a task.</div></div>'
        : '')+
    '</div></td></tr>';
    return main+det;
  }).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="9"><div class="empty">No decisions in this window. A row appears when someone records a hire or reject.</div></td></tr>';

  tb.querySelectorAll('tr.rowbtn').forEach(function(tr){
    function toggle(){
      var open=tr.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true';
      tr.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open?'false':'true');
      var d=tb.querySelector('tr.det[data-detd="'+tr.dataset.d+'"]');
      if(d) d.hidden=open;
    }
    tr.addEventListener('click',toggle);
    tr.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();toggle();} });
  });
  /* No "open the application" control here on purpose: /api/hiring/decisions
     returns no application_id, so there is nothing to open the drawer with. */
}

function jsonBlock(obj){
  return '<div class="jsonbox">'+esc(JSON.stringify(obj,null,2))+'</div>';
}
function scorePanel(a){
  return a.scores.map(function(s,i){
    var r=RUBRICS[s.rubric];
    if(!r){
      /* A real rubric version this page has no local copy of — happens only if
         the database has a stage/version combination beyond the two seeded in
         051 §E. Show the server's own numbers; skip the category breakdown and
         the arithmetic, which need the rubric definition to render at all. */
      return '<div class="panel">'+
        '<div class="panel-hd"><span>Score '+(i+1)+' of '+a.scores.length+'</span>'+
          badge('b-gray',(s.stage_key||'—')+' rubric v'+(s.rubric_version==null?'?':s.rubric_version))+
          (s.is_automated?badge('b-gray','automated'):badge('b-info','scored by '+(s.scored_by_name||'someone')))+
          '<span class="spacer"></span><span class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray2)">'+esc(ftime(s.created_at))+'</span>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<div class="panel-bd">'+
          '<div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin-bottom:9px">'+
            avgCell(s.average)+recPill(s.recommendation)+
          '</div>'+
          '<div class="note">This screen does not hold a copy of that scorecard version, so the breakdown by category '+
          'and the arithmetic behind the average are not shown. The recorded average and recommendation are.</div>'+
          (s.flags&&s.flags.length?'<div style="margin-top:11px">'+flagList(s.flags)+'</div>':'')+
        '</div></div>';
    }
    var cats=r.categories.map(function(c){
      var v=s.category_scores[c.key];
      var has=(v!==undefined&&v!==null&&v!=='');
      return '<div class="cl">'+esc(c.label)+'<small>'+esc(c.key)+
        ' · 1 = '+esc(c.guidance[1])+' … 4 = '+esc(c.guidance[4])+'</small></div>'+
        '<div class="cvv'+(has?'':' un')+'">'+(has?esc(v):'—')+'</div>';
    }).join('');
    var band = s.average===null ? null : bandFor(r.rating_bands, s.average);
    var deriv = s.average===null
      ? '<div class="warnbox">'+esc(s.label)+'. A partial rubric is never banded — averaging the categories '+
        'somebody happened to fill in is how a candidate gets “below bar” from one answered question.</div>'
      : '<div class="deriv" style="margin-top:0;grid-template-columns:1fr">'+
          '<div class="dcell"><div class="dk">average</div>'+
          '<div class="formula">round(Σ(value × weight) ÷ Σweight, 2) = '+s.weighted+' ÷ '+s.totalWeight+' = '+num(s.average)+'</div>'+
          '<div class="inputs">'+
            (band ? 'band <b>'+num(band.min)+'–'+num(band.max)+'</b> → <b>'+esc(s.recommendation)+'</b> · “'+esc(s.label)+'”'
                  : '<b>no band matched</b> → <b>review</b> · “'+esc(s.label)+'” — an unmatched average means a misconfigured rubric, and the safe reading of that is “a person should look at this”')+
            '<br>every category weight is 1 (unset); a weight of 0 would be honoured and excluded from the number</div></div></div>';
    return '<div class="panel">'+
      '<div class="panel-hd"><span>Score '+(i+1)+' of '+a.scores.length+'</span>'+
        badge('b-gray',s.rubric_stage+' rubric v'+s.rubric_version)+
        (s.is_automated?badge('b-gray','automated','Scored by the grader. No person is named on an automated score.')
                       :badge('b-info','scored by '+s.scored_by_name,'Scored by a person, who is named on the score.'))+
        '<span class="spacer"></span><span class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray2)">'+esc(ftime(s.created_at))+'</span>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="panel-bd">'+
        '<div class="catgrid">'+cats+'</div>'+
        '<div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin:11px 0 9px">'+
          avgCell(s.average)+recPill(s.recommendation)+
          '<span class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray2);letter-spacing:.06em">'+esc(a.recommendation_status)+'</span>'+
        '</div>'+
        deriv+
        (s.flags.length?'<div style="margin-top:11px"><div class="dk" style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:var(--fs-caption);letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gray);margin-bottom:5px">review flags</div>'+flagList(s.flags)+'</div>':'')+
      '</div></div>';
  }).join('');
}

/* The forward funnel, in order — must match STAGES in src/hiring/pipeline.mjs. */
var DECIDE_STAGES = ['applied','screening','group_interview','one_on_one',
                     'offer','hired','onboarding','ramp','performing'];

/* decideSection — the Advance / Reject controls.
   A rejection needs a written reason: the endpoint requires it, and so does the
   database. The box is right here so nobody has to go looking for it. */
function decideSection(a){
  if(a.is_demo_row){
    return '<div class="dw-sec"><div class="note">This is a Demo Mode row. '+
      'Decisions are not recorded for demo candidates.</div></div>';
  }
  if(a.status!=='open'){
    return '<div class="dw-sec"><div class="note">This application is '+esc(a.status)+
      ', so it is closed. Nothing further can be decided on it.</div></div>';
  }
  /* Moving to "hired" closes the application (status becomes 'hired'), and
     every later move requires an OPEN application — so onboarding, ramp and
     performing cannot be reached from here at all. Offering them would be a
     button that always fails. The list stops at hired and says so. */
  var HIRED_AT=DECIDE_STAGES.indexOf('hired');
  var i=DECIDE_STAGES.indexOf(a.stage_key);
  var next=(i>=0? DECIDE_STAGES.slice(i+1) : DECIDE_STAGES.slice(0))
    .filter(function(k){ return DECIDE_STAGES.indexOf(k)<=HIRED_AT; });
  var opts=next.map(function(k){
    return '<option value="'+esc(k)+'">'+esc(STAGE_LABEL(k))+'</option>';
  }).join('');
  return '<div class="dw-sec"><div class="eyebrow">DECIDE</div>'+
    '<div class="panel"><div class="panel-bd">'+
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap">'+
        '<label class="k2" for="dcStage">move to</label>'+
        '<select id="dcStage">'+(opts||'<option value="">no stage left to move to</option>')+'</select>'+
        '<button class="btn dark mono" id="dcAdvance" type="button"'+(opts?'':' disabled')+'>Advance</button>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div style="margin-top:11px">'+
        '<label class="k2" for="dcReason">reason — required to reject, optional to advance</label>'+
        '<textarea id="dcReason" rows="3" style="width:100%;margin-top:5px" '+
          'placeholder="Why. This is what the candidate feedback is written from."></textarea>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div style="margin-top:9px;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap">'+
        '<button class="btn mono" id="dcReject" type="button">Reject</button>'+
        '<span id="dcMsg" class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray)"></span>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="note" style="margin-top:9px">Hiring somebody closes their application. '+
      'Onboarding, ramp and performing are tracked elsewhere and cannot be set from this screen.</div>'+
    '</div></div></div>';
}

function STAGE_LABEL(k){ return String(k||'').replace(/_/g,' '); }

/* wireDecide — attaches the two buttons after the drawer body is painted. */
function wireDecide(a){
  /* openDrawer() fetches the full application asynchronously. If the reader has
     already moved to another candidate, this render is stale — wiring it would
     point Advance and Reject at an application the header no longer names. */
  if(!a || !a.id || (window.DRAWER_APP_ID && String(window.DRAWER_APP_ID)!==String(a.id))) return;
  var msg=document.getElementById('dcMsg');
  var adv=document.getElementById('dcAdvance');
  var rej=document.getElementById('dcReject');
  if(!msg||(!adv&&!rej)) return;
  function busy(on,note){
    if(adv) adv.disabled=on||!document.getElementById('dcStage').value;
    if(rej) rej.disabled=on;
    msg.textContent=note||'';
  }
  function send(body){
    busy(true,'saving…');
    return window.FHData.write('/api/hiring/decide', body).then(function(r){
      if(!r.ok){
        busy(false,'');
        msg.textContent=(r.error&&(r.error.message||r.error))||'That did not save.';
        return;
      }
      msg.textContent='Saved. Reloading the board…';
      if(typeof wireHiring==='function'){ try{ wireHiring(); }catch(e){} }
      setTimeout(function(){ location.reload(); },700);
    });
  }
  if(adv) adv.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var stage=document.getElementById('dcStage').value;
    if(!stage) return;
    var reason=(document.getElementById('dcReason').value||'').trim();
    send({application_id:a.id, action:'advance', to_stage:stage, reason:reason||null});
  });
  if(rej) rej.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var reason=(document.getElementById('dcReason').value||'').trim();
    if(!reason){ msg.textContent='Write a reason first. A rejection without one is not allowed.'; return; }
    if(!window.confirm('Reject this candidate? This cannot be undone from this screen.')) return;
    send({application_id:a.id, action:'reject', reason:reason});
  });
}

  var role=ROLE_BY_KEY[a.role_key];
  var answerKeys=Object.keys(a.answers||{});
  document.getElementById('dwBody').innerHTML =
    '<div class="dw-sec"><div class="notice"><b>Scores are advisory. No candidate may be rejected without a named human '+
      'and a written reason; the database enforces this.</b><br>'+
      'Scores are a recommendation. The decision below is yours and is recorded under your name.</div></div>'+
    decideSection(a)+

    '<div class="dw-sec"><div class="eyebrow">CANDIDATE</div>'+
      '<div class="kv">'+
        '<div><div class="k2">email</div><div class="v">'+esc(a.email)+'</div></div>'+
        '<div><div class="k2">phone</div><div class="v">'+esc(a.phone||'—')+'</div></div>'+
        '<div><div class="k2">source</div><div class="v">'+esc(a.source)+
          '<span class="sub">'+esc(a.source_detail||'no detail')+'</span></div></div>'+

/* augmentScore — gives a live api/hiring/application score the same
   rubric/label/weighted/totalWeight fields deriveSample() computes for the
   sample rows, by looking the rubric up from stage_key + rubric_version
   instead of trusting a client-only "rubric" string. The server's own
   average/recommendation/flags win; grade() only fills in the show-your-work
   fields it alone can produce. */
function augmentScore(s){
  s.rubric = s.stage_key+'@'+s.rubric_version;
  var r = RUBRICS[s.rubric];
  if(r){
    var g = grade(r, s.category_scores||{});
    s.rubric_stage = r.stage_key;
    s.label = g.label;
    s.weighted = g.weighted;
    s.totalWeight = g.totalWeight;
    if(s.average===undefined||s.average===null) s.average = g.average;
    if(!s.recommendation) s.recommendation = g.recommendation;
    if(!s.flags) s.flags = g.flags;
  } else {
    s.rubric_stage = s.stage_key;
    if(!s.flags) s.flags = [];
  }
  return s;
}

function openDrawer(appId){
  var a=APP_BY_ID[appId]; if(!a) return;
  window.DRAWER_APP_ID=appId;
  document.getElementById('dwTitle').textContent=a.full_name;
  document.getElementById('dwSub').textContent =
    a.id+' · '+a.role_name+' · '+a.stage_name+' · status '+a.status+' · applied '+fdatey(a.applied_at);
  drawer.classList.add('on'); scrim.classList.add('on');
  drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
  drawer.removeAttribute('inert');
  document.getElementById('dwClose').focus();

  if(!LIVE.candidates){ renderDrawerBody(a); return; }

  /* Live board rows carry only what candidates.mjs projects — no answers, no
     full score history, no interviews, no decisions. Those live on
     api/hiring/application?id=, fetched here on demand rather than for every
     card on the board. */
  document.getElementById('dwBody').innerHTML =
    '<div class="empty" style="padding:40px 8px">Loading application…</div>';
  apiGet('/api/hiring/application?id='+encodeURIComponent(appId)).then(function(res){
    if(document.getElementById('dwTitle').textContent!==a.full_name) return; // drawer moved on
    if(!res.ok){
      document.getElementById('dwBody').innerHTML =
        '<div class="empty" style="padding:40px 8px">Could not load this application ('+esc(res.error||res.source)+'). '+
        'Board-level data only.</div>';
      renderDrawerBody(a);
      return;
    }
    var d = Object.assign({}, a, res.data);
    d.scores = (res.data.scores||[]).map(augmentScore);
    renderDrawerBody(d);
  });
}

  drawer.classList.remove('on'); scrim.classList.remove('on');
  drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  drawer.setAttribute('inert','');
}

/* ══ API WIRING ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   data.js's FHData exposes readers for /api/read/* and /api/dashboard/*, not
   for /api/hiring/* (those live at their own paths, not under read/), so the
   same { ok, source, data, error } envelope is reproduced here rather than
   reaching into its private get() — same pattern campaign-manager.html and
   subscriptions.html use for the same reason. */
function apiGet(path){
  var demo = false, tok = '';
  try { demo = localStorage.getItem('fh_demo') === '1'; tok = localStorage.getItem('fh_token') || ''; } catch(e){}
  if(demo) return Promise.resolve({ ok:false, source:'demo', data:null, error:'demo session — no backend read attempted' });
  var started;
  try {
    started = fetch(path, { headers: tok ? { accept:'application/json', authorization:'Bearer '+tok } : { accept:'application/json' } });
  } catch(e){
    return Promise.resolve({ ok:false, source:'offline', data:null, error:(e && e.message) || 'fetch unavailable' });
  }
  return Promise.resolve(started).then(function(r){
    if(r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) return { ok:false, source:'unauthorized', data:null, error:'not signed in, or role is not owner/admin' };
    if(r.status === 404){
      return r.json().then(function(d){
        return (d && d.error === 'not_found' && typeof d.path === 'string')
          ? { ok:false, source:'offline', data:null, error:'/api/* not deployed' }
          : { ok:false, source:'notfound', data:null, error:'no such record' };
      }).catch(function(){ return { ok:false, source:'offline', data:null, error:'/api/* not deployed' }; });
    }
    if(r.status === 400){
      return r.json().then(function(d){
        return { ok:false, source:'badrequest', data:null, error:(d && d.message) || 'That request was not accepted.' };
      }).catch(function(){ return { ok:false, source:'badrequest', data:null, error:'bad request' }; });
    }
    return r.json().then(function(d){
      if(r.status === 503 || (d && d.db === 'down')) return { ok:false, source:'nodb', data:null, error:(d && d.message) || 'The database is not reachable right now.' };
      if(!d || d.ok !== true) return { ok:false, source:'server', data:null, error:(d && d.message) || 'Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.' };
      return { ok:true, source:'api', data:d, error:null };
    }).catch(function(){ return { ok:false, source:'offline', data:null, error:'response was not JSON' }; });
  }).catch(function(e){
    return { ok:false, source:'offline', data:null, error:(e && e.message) || 'network error' };
  });
}

/* candidates.mjs aliases the application id as application_id (it is the
   pipeline card's id everywhere on this screen) and needs_human is this
   screen's own derived field, not something the endpoint returns. */

/* Demo Mode's seeded candidates come back from the same endpoint as real ones —
   the read carries no is_demo column, so the screen identifies them by the two
   marks the seeder puts on the row itself: source_detail 'platform_demo' and the
   'DEMO ' name prefix. Nothing else is guessed; a row without either mark counts
   as real. These rows stay visible and labelled, and are left out of every count
   on this screen. */
function isDemoRow(r){
  return r.source_detail === 'platform_demo' ||
         /^DEMO[\s—-]/.test(String(r.full_name || ''));
}
function mapCandidateRow(r){
  var c = Object.assign({}, r);
  c.id = r.application_id;
  c.flags = r.flags || [];
  c.needs_human = (r.flags && r.flags.length > 0) || r.average === null || r.average === undefined;
  c.is_demo_row = isDemoRow(r);
  return c;
}

var HIRING_SRC = {};
function wireHiring(){
  var demo=false; try{ demo = localStorage.getItem('fh_demo')==='1'; }catch(e){}
  if(demo){
    SHOW_DEMO_ROWS = true;
    APPS = SAMPLE_APPS.slice();
    POSTINGS = SAMPLE_POSTINGS.slice();
    DECISIONS = SAMPLE_DECISIONS.slice();
    var sampleIdx = deriveSample(APPS, DECISIONS);
    APP_BY_ID = sampleIdx.appById; DECISION_BY_ID = sampleIdx.decisionById;
    boot();
    document.getElementById('footNote').textContent = 'hiring · demo session, sample rows';
    FHData.banner('sample','sample hiring pipeline — demo session, the backend was not queried','hiring');
    return;
  }
  FHData.banner('sample','loading hiring…','hiring');
  Promise.all([
    apiGet('/api/demo/mode').then(function(res){
      var d = res && (res.data || res);
      if (res && res.ok && d && d.demo_mode_enabled) SHOW_DEMO_ROWS = true;
    }).catch(function(){}),
    apiGet('/api/hiring/candidates?state=all&limit=200').then(function(res){
      HIRING_SRC.candidates=res;
      if(res.ok){
        LIVE.candidates=true;
        APPS=(res.data.items||[]).map(mapCandidateRow);
        APP_BY_ID={}; APPS.forEach(function(a){ APP_BY_ID[a.id]=a; });
      } else { APPS=[]; APP_BY_ID={}; }
    }),
    apiGet('/api/hiring/postings?limit=200').then(function(res){
      HIRING_SRC.postings=res;
      if(res.ok){ LIVE.postings=true; POSTINGS=res.data.items||[]; }
      else { POSTINGS=[]; }
    }),
    apiGet('/api/hiring/decisions?state=all&days=730&limit=200').then(function(res){
      HIRING_SRC.decisions=res;
      if(res.ok){
        LIVE.decisions=true;
        DECISIONS=res.data.items||[];
        DECISION_BY_ID={}; DECISIONS.forEach(function(d){ DECISION_BY_ID[d.id]=d; });
      } else { DECISIONS=[]; DECISION_BY_ID={}; }
    }),
    apiGet('/api/hiring/bench?limit=200').then(function(res){
      HIRING_SRC.bench=res;
      if(res.ok){ LIVE.bench=true; BENCH_ROWS=res.data.items||[]; }
      else { BENCH_ROWS=null; }
    })
  ]).then(function(){
    boot();
    var parts=[], worst='real';
    ['candidates','postings','decisions','bench'].forEach(function(k){
      var res=HIRING_SRC[k];
      if(!res) return;
      if(res.ok){ parts.push(k+': loaded'); }
      else {
        parts.push(k+': not loaded'+(res.error?' ('+res.error+')':''));
        var badTone = (res.source==='nodb'||res.source==='server'||res.source==='offline') ? 'error' : 'sample';
        if(badTone==='error') worst='error'; else if(worst!=='error') worst='sample';
      }
    });
    document.getElementById('footNote').textContent =
      'hiring · '+(parts.length?parts.join(' · '):'nothing loaded');
    FHData.banner(worst, 'hiring · '+(parts.length?parts.join(' · '):'no rows yet'), 'hiring');
  });
}

/* ══ BOOT ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function boot(){
  renderBench(renderStats());
  renderBoard();
  renderReviewQueue();
  renderPostings();
  renderFunnel();
  renderDecisions();
}

/* shell.js and data.js are deferred, so FHData does not exist while this script
   is being parsed — calling wireHiring() here threw and the screen never loaded
   anything. DOMContentLoaded fires after both deferred scripts have run. */
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', wireHiring);
} else {
  wireHiring();
}

</script>

/* sidebar: collapse to icons, and let a group fold away */

  var side=document.getElementById('side'),b=document.getElementById('burger');
  b.addEventListener('click',function(){side.classList.toggle('mini');b.textContent=side.classList.contains('mini')?'››':'‹‹';});

  });
})();
