          '<p style="font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--text-dim)">Inquiries and personal-info mismatches staged for this bureau. Inclusion checkboxes land with the letter editor in a follow-up polish.</p>' +
          '<div class="fraud-slot">' +
            '<label>Upload FTC or police report</label>' +
            '<p class="hint">Upload an FTC or police report you obtained. The system never generates or files one.</p>' +
            '<input type="file" class="fraud-file" accept=".pdf,image/*">' +
            '<button type="button" class="qbtn" data-act="upload-fraud" style="margin-top:8px">Upload FTC or police report</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="case-col">' +
          '<h4>Generated letter (draft)</h4>' +
          '<div class="case-letter"><textarea class="letter-edit" readonly>' + esc(letter.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 8000)) + '</textarea></div>' +
          '<p style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--text-dim);margin:6px 0 0">Draft only — nothing sends until you press send below.</p>' +
          '<button type="button" class="qbtn" data-act="generate-letters" style="margin-top:8px">Generate letters</button>' +
          '<p class="gen-result" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--text-dim);margin:6px 0 0"></p>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="case-col">' +
          '<h4>Identity packet</h4>' +
          '<p style="color:var(--text-dim)">Docs: ' + esc(docsLabel(C)) +
            (missingWords ? ' — still needed: ' + esc(missingWords) : '') +
            '. SSN stays masked; reveal uses /api/pii with an audit reason.</p>' +
          '<a class="qbtn" href="documents.html?client_id=' + encodeURIComponent(C.client_id || "") + '">Open documents</a>' +
          '<h4 style="margin-top:14px">Send</h4>' +
          send.note +
          '<label style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:var(--fs-body);margin:6px 0">' +
            '<input type="checkbox" class="want-mail" ' + (blocked ? "disabled" : "checked") + '> Mail letter (PostGrid)</label>' +
          '<label style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:var(--fs-body);margin:6px 0">' +
            'Mail service <select class="mail-service" ' + (blocked ? "disabled" : "") + '>' +
              '<option value="">Bureau default (first class)</option>' +
              '<option value="first_class">First class</option>' +
              '<option value="priority">Priority</option>' +
              '<option value="priority_express">Priority express</option>' +
            '</select></label>' +
          portalBlock +
          '<div class="case-actions">' +
            '<button type="button" class="primary" data-act="send" ' + (blocked ? "disabled" : "") + '>Send</button>' +
            '<button type="button" data-act="call-bureau"' +
              (C.call_fired_at ? ' disabled title="Call already started"' : "") +
            '>Call bureau</button>' +
            '<button type="button" data-act="cleared">Mark cleared</button>' +
            '<button type="button" data-act="close">Close</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  }
  function postCase(body) {
    return fetch("/api/inquiry-cases", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: headers(true),
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); });
  }
  /* Every refusal analyze.mjs can return, in words the Specialist can act on. An
     unlisted reason falls through to the raw string rather than being hidden. */
  var GEN_REASONS = {
    no_credit_file:   "No credit report on file yet. Pull one first.",
    no_inquiries:     "No inquiries on this credit file.",
    no_violations:    "Nothing to dispute on this file — no letter was made.",
    missing_identity: "This client has no name on their record, so a letter cannot be addressed.",
    client_not_found: "That client record could not be found.",
    invalid_round:    "That dispute round is not one this desk can generate.",
    already_generated:"Letters for this round already exist.",
    no_authorization: "This client has no signed repair agreement on file.",
    credit_file_stale_for_round: "Pull a fresh credit report before this round. The newest one on file is older than the last round's letters.",
    identity_not_verified: "This client's ID has not been read yet, so no letter can name them. Upload and accept their government ID and proof of address, then try again.",
    no_bureau_on_case: "This case has no credit bureau on it, so there is nothing to generate. Set the bureau on the case first."
  };

  /* Short forms, for naming a bureau that was skipped inside a longer sentence. */
  var GEN_SHORT = {
    no_violations:        "nothing to dispute",
    already_generated:    "already done",
    missing_identity:     "no name on file",
    no_rule_id_claims:    "no rule-backed findings",
    variance_gate_exhausted: "too similar to an earlier letter",
    identity_not_verified:   "ID not read yet"
  };

  /* Says what happened in one sentence. A letter that was NOT made is as important as
     one that was, so a skipped bureau is named with its reason rather than dropped. */
  function genSummary(d) {
    if (d.already_generated) return "Letters for this round already exist. Nothing was made again.";
    var n = Number(d.letters_stored || 0) || 0;
    var parts = [];
    parts.push(n
      ? n + (n === 1 ? " letter is" : " letters are") + " ready. Nothing has been mailed."
      : "No letter was made.");
    var skipped = (d.skipped || []).filter(function (x) { return x && x.bureau; });
    if (skipped.length) {
      parts.push("Skipped " + skipped.map(function (x) {
        return x.bureau + " — " + (GEN_SHORT[x.reason] || x.reason || "no reason given");
      }).join("; ") + ".");
    }
    if (d.identity_complete === false) {
      parts.push("Heads up: this client's address is incomplete, so the letter is missing it.");
    }
    return parts.join(" ");
  }

  function bindDetail(trDetail, C) {
    trDetail.querySelectorAll("[data-act]").forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        var act = btn.getAttribute("data-act");
        if (act === "call-bureau") {
          btn.disabled = true;
          btn.textContent = "Calling…";
          fetch("/api/inquiry?action=launch", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: headers(true),
            body: JSON.stringify({ id: C.id })
          }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
            if (!d.ok) {
              btn.disabled = false;
              btn.textContent = d.message || d.error || "Call failed";
              return;
            }
            btn.textContent = "Call started";
            load();
          }).catch(function () {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = "Call failed";
          });
          return;
        }
        if (act === "cleared" || act === "close") {
          postCase({
            action: act === "cleared" ? "mark_cleared" : "close",
            id: C.id,
            case_status: act === "close" ? "Canceled" : "Completed"
          }).then(function (d) {
            if (!d.ok) { btn.textContent = d.error || "failed"; return; }
            load();
          });
          return;
        }
        if (act === "generate-letters") {
          /* Writes inquiry items from the credit file onto this case. Does not mail. */
          var out = trDetail.querySelector(".gen-result");
          var req;
          try {
            req = window.FHInquiryView.buildInquiryGenerateRequest({ caseId: C.id });
          } catch (err) {
            if (out) out.textContent = err.message || "no case";
            return;
          }
          btn.disabled = true;
          btn.textContent = "Generating…";
          fetch(req.path, {
            method: req.method,
            headers: headers(true),
            body: JSON.stringify(req.body)
          }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = "Generate letters";
            if (d && d.ok) {
              var n = Number(d.open_inquiry_count != null ? d.open_inquiry_count : d.written) || 0;
              if (out) {
                out.textContent = n + (n === 1
                  ? " inquiry item on this case. Nothing mailed."
                  : " inquiry items on this case. Nothing mailed.");
              }
              load();
              return;
            }
            if (out) {
              out.textContent = GEN_REASONS[d && d.reason] || (d && d.message) || (d && d.error) || "Could not generate.";
            }
          }).catch(function () {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = "Generate letters";
            if (out) out.textContent = "Could not generate.";
          });
          return;
        }
        if (act === "upload-fraud") {
          var fileInput = trDetail.querySelector(".fraud-file");
          var file = fileInput && fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
          if (!file) { btn.textContent = "choose file"; return; }
          if (!C.client_id) { btn.textContent = "no client"; return; }
          if (!window.FHData || typeof FHData.uploadFiles !== "function") {
            btn.textContent = "upload unavailable";
            return;
          }
          btn.disabled = true;
          FHData.uploadFiles("/api/documents-upload", [file], {
            client_id: C.client_id,
            subtype: "additional_fraud_docs",
            title: "Additional documentation — fraud / identity theft cases"
          }).then(function (res) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = res && res.ok ? "attached" : (res && res.error) || "failed";
          }).catch(function () {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = "failed";
          });
          return;
        }
        if (act === "send") {
          var wantMail = !!(trDetail.querySelector(".want-mail") || {}).checked;
          var wantPortal = !!(trDetail.querySelector(".want-portal") || {}).checked;
          var portalRef = ((trDetail.querySelector(".portal-ref") || {}).value || "").trim();
          var serviceSel = trDetail.querySelector(".mail-service");
          var serviceLevel = serviceSel ? serviceSel.value : "";
          var req;
          try {
            req = window.FHInquiryView.buildCaseSendRequest({
              caseId: C.id,
              mail: wantMail,
              portal: wantPortal,
              portalConfirmation: portalRef || null,
              mailServiceLevel: serviceLevel || null
            });
          } catch (err) {
            btn.textContent = err.message || "invalid";
            return;
          }
          btn.disabled = true;
          postCase(req.body).then(function (d) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            if (!d.ok) {
              btn.textContent = d.message || d.error || "failed";
              return;
            }
            load();
          }).catch(function () {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = "failed";
          });
        }
      });
    });
  }
  /* ── A QUEUE YOU EMPTY, WORKED TOP TO BOTTOM ─────────────────────────────
     Every decision below — which case is next, how old it is, whether the
     packet is complete, what the headline says — comes from FHInquiryView, the
     copied-and-tested module above. Nothing here decides anything; it draws.

     THREE THINGS CHANGED HERE ON 2026-08-30:

       1. OLDEST FIRST. The reader ordered by requested_at DESC, so the case she
          had just worked jumped to the top and the one nobody had touched sank
          out of sight. A worklist is worked from the top, so the top has to be
          the oldest thing still waiting.
       2. TWENTY-FIVE ROWS, THEN A BUTTON (UI-STANDARDS §6). Nothing on this
          screen paginated anywhere.
       3. ONE ROW REBUILT PER CLICK, NOT FORTY. renderCases() used to redraw
          every row AND every hidden detail on every single click — including a
          textarea holding up to 8,000 characters of letter text per case. At 40
          cases that is 40 textareas destroyed and 40 rebuilt to open one
          drawer, and every open field in the row you were typing in lost. */
  var PAGE_ROWS = 25;
  var allCases = [];
  var caseTotal = null;
  var pageSize = PAGE_ROWS;
  var nextCaseId = null;

  function caseBody() { return document.getElementById("caseQueueBody"); }

  /* ── THE DOCS COLUMN SAYS WHAT IS MISSING ────────────────────────────────
     Every row on this queue read the single word "chasing" and stopped there,
     so the only way to find out what a client still owed us was to open each
     case one at a time. The list already receives the answer — docs_missing
     rides in beside docs_complete on every row — and nothing was printing it.

     "complete" and "not checked" stay one word, because there is nothing to
     add to either. Only "chasing" gains the list, and the words are the plain
     ones (docsMissingWords), not the database's column names. */
  function docsCell(C) {
    var label = docsLabel(C);
    if (label !== "chasing") return esc(label);
    var words = window.FHInquiryView.docsMissingWords(C.docs_missing);
    if (!words) {
      /* Blocked with nothing itemised: the case was refused before this queue
         learned to ask. Say that, rather than implying we know what is short. */
      return 'chasing <span class="doc-need">— not yet itemised</span>';
    }
    return 'chasing <span class="doc-need">— ' + esc(words) + '</span>';
  }

  function rowHtml(C) {
    var V = window.FHInquiryView;
    var st = uiStatus(C);
    var days = V.waitingDays(C.requested_at);
    /* Age carries a word and a position, never colour alone (§12.6):
       shell.js paintBrand() repaints --alert and --warn off the tenant's ramp,
       so a one-hue brand paints every state the same. */
    return "<td><span class=\"rowchev\">▶</span>" + esc(C.client_name || C.client_email || C.case_id) + "</td>" +
      "<td class=\"queue-age" + (days != null && days >= 3 ? " old" : "") + "\">" +
        esc(V.waitingLabel(days)) +
        (nextCaseId && C.id === nextCaseId ? " <span class=\"oldest\">· oldest</span>" : "") + "</td>" +
      "<td class=\"mono\">" + esc(V.bureauLabel(C.selected_bureaus_raw)) + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + esc(C.open_inquiry_count || 0) + "</td>" +
      "<td><span class=\"status-pill " + esc(st.cls) + "\">" + esc(st.label) + "</span></td>" +
      "<td>" + docsCell(C) + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + deliveryChips(C) + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + esc(callState(C)) + "</td>" +
      "<td class=\"mono\">" + esc(C.funding_round_id ? String(C.funding_round_id).slice(0, 8) : "—") + "</td>";
  }

  function closeAllDetails() {
    var body = caseBody();
    if (!body) return;
    [].slice.call(body.querySelectorAll("tr.case-detail-row")).forEach(function (r) { r.remove(); });
    [].slice.call(body.querySelectorAll("tr.case-main")).forEach(function (r) {
      r.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    });
    EXPANDED = null;
  }

  function toggleCase(tr, C) {
    var wasOpen = tr.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
    closeAllDetails();
    if (wasOpen) return;
    EXPANDED = C.id;
    tr.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    var detail = document.createElement("tr");
    detail.className = "case-detail-row";
    detail.innerHTML = '<td colspan="9">' + detailHtml(C) + "</td>";
    tr.parentNode.insertBefore(detail, tr.nextSibling);
    bindDetail(detail, C);
  }

  function openCase(id) {
    if (!id) return;
    var idx = -1;
    for (var i = 0; i < allCases.length; i++) {
      if (allCases[i] && allCases[i].id === id) { idx = i; break; }
    }
    if (idx < 0) return;
    if (idx >= pageSize) { pageSize = allCases.length; renderCases(); }
    var body = caseBody();
    var tr = body && body.querySelector('[data-case-row="' + id + '"]');
    if (!tr) return;
    if (tr.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true") toggleCase(tr, allCases[idx]);
    if (tr.scrollIntoView) tr.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
  }

  function renderCases() {
    var body = caseBody();
    var moreBtn = document.getElementById("caseMoreBtn");
    var moreNote = document.getElementById("caseMore");
    if (!body) return;
    if (!allCases.length) {
      body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="color:var(--text-dim)">No active cases.</td></tr>';
      if (moreBtn) moreBtn.hidden = true;
      if (moreNote) moreNote.textContent = "";
      return;
    }
    var page = allCases.slice(0, pageSize);
    body.innerHTML = "";
    page.forEach(function (C) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.className = "case-main";
      tr.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      tr.setAttribute("data-case-row", C.id || "");
      tr.innerHTML = rowHtml(C);
      body.appendChild(tr);
      tr.addEventListener("click", function () { toggleCase(tr, C); });
    });
    var hidden = allCases.length - page.length;
    if (moreBtn) {
      moreBtn.hidden = hidden <= 0;
      moreBtn.textContent = "Show the other " + hidden;
    }
    if (moreNote) {
      /* Two different sentences, because they mean different things: rows this
         page is holding back, and rows the READ never fetched. */
      moreNote.textContent = hidden > 0
        ? "showing the oldest " + page.length + " of " + allCases.length
        : (caseTotal != null && caseTotal > allCases.length
            ? "showing the oldest " + allCases.length + " of " + caseTotal + " open cases"
            : "");
    }
    if (EXPANDED) {
      var open = body.querySelector('[data-case-row="' + EXPANDED + '"]');
      var keep = EXPANDED;
      EXPANDED = null;
      if (open) {
        for (var i = 0; i < page.length; i++) {
          if (page[i] && page[i].id === keep) { toggleCase(open, page[i]); break; }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function paintHead() {
    var V = window.FHInquiryView;
    /* ── THE HEADLINE AND THE BUTTON MUST MEAN A CASE THAT CAN BE SENT ────
       Measured 2026-09-06: the one case this desk offered as ready was an empty
       one — no bureau, no inquiries — and the big button at the top of the
       screen pointed straight at it, because the client's three REAL cases were
       Blocked and did not count as ready.

       A case with no bureau has no address. Nothing can be posted to it, no
       letter can be generated for it (src/inquiry-ops/generate-from-crs.mjs
       refuses one now), and sending it is not a piece of work anybody can do.
       So it is not what "the next thing to do" means, and the button skips it.

       The headline is fed the same set, so the number and the button agree.
       A screen that says "1 ready to send" with nothing to press is the same
       defect wearing different clothes.

       THE CASE IS NOT HIDDEN. It stays in the list below with its own line
       saying it has no bureau and cannot go anywhere, and the quiet line says
       how many there are. Dropping it off the screen would be the other kind
       of lie. */
    var sendable = allCases.filter(function (C) {
      return !!V.bureauKey(C.selected_bureaus_raw);
    });
    var unaddressed = allCases.length - sendable.length;
    var head = V.inquiryHeadline(sendable, {
      total: caseTotal == null ? null : caseTotal - unaddressed
    });
    var next = V.nextInquiryAction(sendable);
    nextCaseId = next ? next.caseId : null;
    /* THE QUIET LINE, WHEN THERE IS NO BUTTON TO PRESS.
       nextInquiryAction only ever names a case that is ready to send, so with
       three Blocked cases and nothing ready it returns null and this line is
       what she reads. It used to say "every open case is already sent", which
       was flatly untrue: Blocked means the send was refused and somebody has to
       chase identity documents. It counts them now instead of sending her home. */
    var waiting = V.casesNeedingAPerson(sendable).length;
    var quiet;
    if (!allCases.length) {
      quiet = "No cases are open.";
    } else if (waiting) {
      quiet = "Nothing is ready to send — " + (waiting === 1
        ? "1 case needs a person before it can be sent."
        : waiting + " cases need a person before they can be sent.");
    } else if (sendable.length) {
      quiet = "Nothing is waiting on you — every open case is already sent.";
    } else {
      quiet = "Nothing here can be sent.";
    }
    if (unaddressed) {
      quiet += unaddressed === 1
        ? " One more case has no credit bureau on it, so nothing can be sent for it at all. It is in the list below."
        : " " + unaddressed + " more cases have no credit bureau on them, so nothing can be sent for them at all. They are in the list below.";
    }
    window.FHDeskHead.put(
      "inquiries",
      head,
      next ? { text: next.text, onClick: function () { openCase(next.caseId); } } : null,
      quiet
    );
  }

  function headFailed(http) {
    /* An em-dash, not a zero. "We could not look" and "there is nothing" are
       different sentences and only one of them means she can go home. */
    window.FHDeskHead.put(
      "inquiries",
      { label: "Ready to send", value: "—", sub: "the case queue could not be read" },
      null,
      http === 403
        ? "This queue is for staff on this desk."
        : "The case queue could not be read. Reload the page to try again."
    );
  }

  function load() {
    fetch("/api/read/inquiry-cases?active_only=true&limit=500", { headers: headers() })
      .then(function (r) {
        return r.json().then(
          function (d) { return { http: r.status, d: d }; },
          function () { return { http: r.status, d: null }; }
        );
      })
      .then(function (pack) {
        var d = pack.d;
        var body = caseBody();
        if (!d || d.ok !== true) {
          if (body) {
            body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="color:var(--text-dim)">' +
              (pack.http === 403
                ? "This queue is for staff on this desk."
                : "Could not load cases (sign in?).") + "</td></tr>";
          }
          headFailed(pack.http);
          return;
        }
        allCases = window.FHInquiryView.sortCasesOldestFirst(d.cases || []);
        caseTotal = typeof d.total === "number" ? d.total : null;
        pageSize = PAGE_ROWS;
        paintHead();
        renderCases();
      })
      .catch(function () {
        var body = caseBody();
        if (body) body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" style="color:var(--text-dim)">Could not load cases (sign in?).</td></tr>';
        headFailed(0);
      });
  }
  var moreBtnEl = document.getElementById("caseMoreBtn");
  if (moreBtnEl) {
    moreBtnEl.addEventListener("click", function () {
      pageSize = allCases.length;
      renderCases();
    });
  }
  load();
})();

/* ── RECENT LETTERS ISSUED — the block that never had a reader ─────────────
   This was static markup. Nothing on the page wrote into .letters-list (the only
   two writers targeted #repairExceptionsList), so it said "No letters issued
   yet" after the fortieth letter had gone out — a sentence that was true on day
   one and never true again.

   The trail existed the whole time: src/inquiry-ops/send.mjs logs a letter or
   portal attempt through logAttempt() every time a person presses Send. Nothing
   had ever read them back across the desk. GET /api/inquiries?recent=letters
   does now — same org binding as the per-row history, and limited to the four
   roles that work this desk (api/inquiries.mjs). A setter or a closer gets a 403
   here, which is the point: these rows name clients and say which bureau each
   one's dispute letter went to.

   FHData.wire, not a hand-rolled fetch: it is the one thing in the app that
   tells "the read failed" apart from "the read worked and there is nothing", and
   those two must never both come out as the empty row. */
function loadRecentLetters() {
  var list = document.getElementById("lettersList");
  var empty = document.getElementById("lettersEmpty");
  if (!list || !empty || !window.FHData || !window.FHData.recentLetters) return;
  /* "No letters issued yet" is an ANSWER, so it waits for one. It ships visible
     in the markup, and paint() below only ever turns it back on for a read that
     came back with zero rows — so leaving it up here would let it stand as the
     answer while the read is still in flight, and keep standing if the read is
     refused or fails. Hidden until something is known. */
  empty.hidden = true;
  function esc(v) {
    return String(v == null ? "" : v)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
  }
  var V = window.FHInquiryView;
  FHData.wire(FHData.recentLetters(8), "recent letters", function (data) {
    var rows = (data && data.letters) || [];
    [].slice.call(list.querySelectorAll(".letter-row.live")).forEach(function (r) { r.remove(); });
    if (!rows.length) { empty.hidden = false; return null; }
    empty.hidden = true;
    var anchor = list.querySelector(".letter-more");
    rows.forEach(function (row) {
      var div = document.createElement("div");
      div.className = "letter-row live";
      div.innerHTML =
        '<div><div class="lt-name">' + esc(row.client_name || "(unnamed client)") + "</div>" +
        '<div class="lt-detail">' + esc(V.bureauLabel(row.bureau)) + " \u00b7 " +
          esc(row.kind === "portal" ? "portal upload" : "letter") +
          (row.staff_name ? " \u00b7 " + esc(row.staff_name) : "") + "</div></div>" +
        '<div class="lt-time">' + esc(V.formatWhen(row.created_at) || "") + "</div>";
      list.insertBefore(div, anchor);
    });
    return rows.length + (rows.length === 1 ? " letter" : " letters") + " issued";
  });
}
/* data.js carries `defer`, so window.FHData does not exist yet while this
   script is being parsed. Reading here would mean never reading at all, and the
   block would paint a convincing "No letters issued yet" instead of saying so —
   the same trap the wiring block at the top of this file already fell into
   once. Wait for the event, exactly as calendar.html and pipeline.html do. */
if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", loadRecentLetters);
} else {
  loadRecentLetters();
}
</script>
<script>
function tickClock() {
  var el = document.querySelector(".clock");
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", {
    weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit",
    timeZone: "America/Phoenix", timeZoneName: "short"
  });
}
tickClock();
setInterval(tickClock, 1000);

function initials(name) {
  var p = String(name || "").trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (!p.length) return "—";
  return p.slice(0, 2).map(function (w) { return w.charAt(0).toUpperCase(); }).join("");
}
/* viewerRole — this session's staff role, folded the way shell.js normRole()
   folds it (staff.role is free text, so "Owner" and "owner " are one role).

   It is used for ONE thing: deciding whether a control renders at all.
   docs/rules/UI-STANDARDS.md §5 — "no controls the role lacks permission for". The
   server gate is still the authority and still refuses; this only stops the
   page offering a button whose answer is already known to be no.

   Seeded from shell.js's fh_role cache so the very first paint is already
   gated, then corrected by /api/auth/session below. Unknown role renders
   nothing extra, which is the safe direction. */
var viewerRole = "";
try { viewerRole = String(localStorage.getItem("fh_role") || "").trim().toLowerCase(); }
catch (e) { viewerRole = ""; }

function paintStaff(staff) {
  var name = (staff && staff.name) || "";
  var rawRole = staff && staff.role ? String(staff.role) : "";
  viewerRole = rawRole.trim().toLowerCase();
  var role = rawRole.replace(/_/g, " ");
  if (rawRole === "inquiry_specialist") role = "Specialist";
  var av = document.getElementById("whoAv");
  var nm = document.getElementById("whoName");
  var rl = document.getElementById("whoRole");
  var foot = document.getElementById("whoFoot");
  var footAv = document.getElementById("whoFootAv");
  var ini = initials(name);
  if (av) av.textContent = ini;
  if (nm) nm.textContent = name || "—";
  if (rl) rl.textContent = role || "—";
  if (foot) foot.textContent = name || "—";
  if (footAv) footAv.textContent = ini;
}
var token = "";
try { token = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) {}
fetch("/api/auth/session", {
  headers: token
    ? { accept: "application/json", authorization: "Bearer " + token }
    : { accept: "application/json" }
}).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (s) {
  paintStaff(s && s.staff);
}).catch(function () { paintStaff(null); });

/* FH-REPAIR-LENS-BEGIN — pure helpers mirrored from src/repair/lens.mjs */
(function () {
  var CHIPS = [
    { key: "needs_agreement", label: "Needs agreement" },
    { key: "review_answer", label: "Read their answer" },
    { key: "send_letters", label: "Send letters" },
    { key: "stuck", label: "Stuck" },
    { key: "waiting_on_bureau", label: "Waiting on the bureau" },
    { key: "round_done", label: "Round done — next?" },
    { key: "trial_done", label: "Trial done — sales" },
    { key: "none", label: "—" }
  ];
  var CHIP_BY_KEY = {};
  CHIPS.forEach(function (c) { CHIP_BY_KEY[c.key] = c; });
  function num(v) { var n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0; }
  function truthy(v) { return v === true; }
  function deriveChip(row) {
    row = row || {};
    if (row.authorization_ok === false) return CHIP_BY_KEY.needs_agreement;
    if (truthy(row.has_unconfirmed_parse)) return CHIP_BY_KEY.review_answer;
    var ready = num(row.letters_ready);
    var sent = num(row.letters_sent);
    if ((ready > 0 && sent === 0) || (row.can_send === true && sent === 0)) return CHIP_BY_KEY.send_letters;
    var stage = String(row.stage_key || "");
    if (stage === "stalled" || truthy(row.sla_breached)) return CHIP_BY_KEY.stuck;
    if (stage === "in_transit" || stage === "awaiting_response") return CHIP_BY_KEY.waiting_on_bureau;
    if (stage === "round_complete") return CHIP_BY_KEY.round_done;
    if (truthy(row.upsell_pending) || String(row.program_status || "") === "upsell_pending") return CHIP_BY_KEY.trial_done;
    return CHIP_BY_KEY.none;
  }
  function dueWords(responseDueAt, asOf) {
    if (!responseDueAt) return { text: "—", tone: "dim" };
    var due = new Date(responseDueAt).getTime();
    var now = new Date(asOf || Date.now()).getTime();
    if (!Number.isFinite(due) || !Number.isFinite(now)) return { text: "—", tone: "dim" };
    var diffDays = Math.round((due - now) / 86400000);
    if (diffDays > 0) return { text: "due in " + diffDays + (diffDays === 1 ? " day" : " days"), tone: "ok" };
    if (diffDays === 0) return { text: "due today", tone: "ok" };
    var overdue = Math.abs(diffDays);
    return { text: "overdue " + overdue + (overdue === 1 ? " day" : " days"), tone: "late" };
  }
  function roundLabel(row) {
    row = row || {};
    var cap = num(row.rounds_cap);
    var raw = row.round == null ? "" : String(row.round);
    var m = raw.match(/R(\d+)/i);
    var n = m ? Number(m[1]) : null;
    if (n != null && cap > 0) return n + " / " + cap;
    if (n != null) return String(n);
    if (cap > 0) return "— / " + cap;
    return raw || "—";
  }
  function tileSets(row, chip) {
    var c = chip || deriveChip(row);
    var sets = [];
    var stage = String((row && row.stage_key) || "");
    if (c.key === "needs_agreement" || c.key === "review_answer" || c.key === "send_letters" || c.key === "round_done" || (row && row.need_me === true)) sets.push("need");
    if (c.key === "send_letters" || stage === "ready_to_send" || (num(row && row.letters_ready) > 0 && num(row && row.letters_sent) === 0)) sets.push("ready");
    if (c.key === "waiting_on_bureau" || stage === "awaiting_response" || stage === "in_transit") sets.push("wait");
    if (c.key === "stuck" || stage === "stalled" || truthy(row && row.sla_breached)) sets.push("stuck");
    if (c.key === "trial_done" || truthy(row && row.upsell_pending)) sets.push("trial");
    return sets;
  }
  function warningDots(row) {
    var out = [];
    if (row && row.address_ok === false) out.push({ key: "no_address", label: "no address on file" });
    if (row && row.no_furnisher_address === true) out.push({ key: "no_furnisher_address", label: "no furnisher address" });
    return out;
  }
  function timelineLine(row) {
    row = row || {};
    var action = String(row.action || row.decision || "").trim();
    var ts = row.ts || row.created_at || null;
    var when = "";
    if (ts) {
      var d = new Date(ts);
      if (Number.isFinite(d.getTime())) {
        when = d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "America/Phoenix" });
      }
    }
    var words = action ? action.replace(/[._]/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() : "update";
    return when ? when + " · " + words : words;
  }
  window.FHRepairLens = {
    deriveChip: deriveChip,
    dueWords: dueWords,
    roundLabel: roundLabel,
    tileSets: tileSets,
    warningDots: warningDots,
    timelineLine: timelineLine
  };
})();
/* FH-REPAIR-LENS-END */

/* Specialist desk: Inquiries / Repair toggle. Repair loads on first open. */
(function deskToggle() {
  var tabs = document.querySelectorAll(".desk-tab");
  var inqPane = document.getElementById("pane-inquiries");
  var repairPane = document.getElementById("pane-repair");
  var inqStats = document.getElementById("inq-stats");
  var repairStats = document.getElementById("repair-stats");
  var loaded = false;

  function show(pane) {
    var repair = pane === "repair";
    tabs.forEach(function (t) {
      t.setAttribute("aria-selected", t.getAttribute("data-pane") === pane ? "true" : "false");
    });
    if (inqPane) inqPane.hidden = repair;
    if (repairPane) repairPane.hidden = !repair;
    if (inqStats) inqStats.hidden = repair;
    if (repairStats) repairStats.hidden = !repair;
    /* One headline slot, two desks. The Repair side has not been read yet on
       first open, so it shows an em-dash and says so rather than borrowing the
       Inquiries number for a second. */
    if (window.FHDeskHead) window.FHDeskHead.show(repair ? "repair" : "inquiries");
    if (repair && !loaded) {
      loaded = true;
      window.FHDeskHead.put("repair",
        { label: "Need me", value: "—", sub: "reading the repair queue…" },
        null, "Reading the repair queue…");
      loadRepairDesk();
    }
  }

  tabs.forEach(function (t) {
    t.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var pane = t.getAttribute("data-pane");
      /* Which desk you were working is worth one line of memory. A repair file
         is a thirty-day cycle: somebody who lives on that side had to press
         Repair again after every reload, and the first thing they saw each time
         was somebody else's queue. Per-viewer, per-browser, and the page still
         works exactly as before when storage is unavailable. */
      try { localStorage.setItem("fh_specialist_pane", pane); } catch (e) {}
      show(pane);
    });
  });

  /* ── WHY THE RESTORE IS NOT DONE HERE ──────────────────────────────────
     It used to be, and that is what made the Repair tab spin forever.

     This block runs while the page is still being read top to bottom. The
     Repair desk is a SEPARATE IIFE further down the same <script>, and
     loadRepairDesk only becomes reachable on its very last line
     (`window.loadRepairDesk = loadRepairDesk`). So calling show("repair") from
     here reached for a function that did not exist yet: the browser threw
     ReferenceError, and because the throw happened part-way through the script,
     EVERYTHING BELOW IT — the whole Repair desk, its Retry button, its filter
     tiles — never ran at all. The spinner had nothing left alive to replace it.

     It only ever bit the person who works the Repair side, because it needs
     "repair" in storage from a previous visit to fire. Clearing that one stored
     value recovered the page, which is why it looked intermittent.

     The restore is now the last thing on the page — see restoreRememberedPane
     at the bottom of this script. Clicking a tab still works exactly as before;
     only the reopen-where-you-left-off path moved. */
  window.FHSpecialistPane = { show: show };
})();

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   THE REPAIR DESK.

   Everything down to `window.loadRepairDesk` lives in one scope on purpose,
   split into two halves that are NOT the same thing:

     · The CHROME — the letter drawer, the PULL modal, the Escape key and the
       five filter tiles. Built once by the page, so bound once, out here.
     · The RELOAD — loadRepairDesk(), which refetches the queue and repaints
       the rows. It runs again after every Send, Stage, Enroll and drawer Send.

   They used to be one function, and that was the bug. Each reload re-ran the
   binding block against the SAME elements, so a second listener piled on top
   of the first and neither was ever removed. Two handlers on one tile ran the
   toggle twice: the first set aria-pressed="true", the second read that fresh
   value and turned the filter straight back off. Net effect, nothing moved —
   and the tiles are the only way this desk has to sort itself, so one Send
   disabled sorting for the rest of the page's life. The document-level Escape
   listener was the worst of them: nothing on the page ever removed it, so it
   accumulated one copy per reload until the tab was closed.

   Rule for the next person: anything that binds a listener to an element the
   page already had belongs up here. Only things that touch the rows this load
   just created belong inside loadRepairDesk().
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function repairDesk() {

var V = window.FHInquiryView;
var L = window.FHRepairLens;
var filterTiles = document.querySelectorAll("#repair-stats .stat-tile[data-filter]");

/* State that has to outlive a reload. Declared out here for the same reason
   the listeners are: a fresh copy per load is exactly what broke the tiles. */
var activeFilter = null;
var pullClientId = null;
var letterSendCtx = null;

var tok = "";
try { tok = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) {}

/* ── who may press what ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Mirrors of the two server gates, so a control whose answer is already known
   to be "no" never renders. docs/rules/UI-STANDARDS.md §5: "Every visible control
   works. No buttons wired to nothing, no controls the role lacks permission
   for." A button that renders and refuses is the thing that rule forbids.

     CRS_PULL_ROLES  — api/finance/crs-pull.mjs
     ERASURE_ROLES   — api/privacy/erasure.mjs

   inquiry_specialist is on NEITHER list, and is not being added to either.
   A soft pull is a real paid order to all three bureaus through UnderwriteIQ,
   and an erasure cannot be undone. This desk's job is to dispute what is
   already on a report, not to order one; the report reaches it from the closer
   and funding-advisor side, who do hold that permission.
   docs/journeys/role-inquiry-remover-intended.md lists Finance and privacy
   among the routes this role stays blocked from, and CLAUDE.md §4 forbids
   adding a step the intended journey does not have.

   Owner and admin open this desk too. For them both buttons still render and
   still work — this hides a control from the roles the server refuses, and
   from nobody else.

   src/http/repair-desk-screen.test.mjs reads both handlers and fails if either
   server list moves without this one moving with it. */
var CRS_PULL_ROLES = ["owner", "admin", "closer", "funding_advisor"];
var ERASURE_ROLES = ["owner", "admin"];
function mayPullCredit() { return CRS_PULL_ROLES.indexOf(viewerRole) !== -1; }
function mayErase() { return ERASURE_ROLES.indexOf(viewerRole) !== -1; }

function headers(json) {
  var h = { accept: "application/json" };
  if (tok) h.authorization = "Bearer " + tok;
  if (json) h["content-type"] = "application/json";
  return h;
}
function esc(s) {
  return String(s == null ? "" : s)
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
}
function repairBody() { return document.getElementById("repairBody"); }
function showErr(msg) {
  var err = document.getElementById("repairErr");
  if (!err) return;
  err.hidden = false;
  err.textContent = msg;
}
function clearErr() {
  var err = document.getElementById("repairErr");
  if (err) { err.hidden = true; err.textContent = ""; }
}

function closeLetterDrawer() {
  var d = document.getElementById("repairLetterDrawer");
  if (!d) return;
  d.classList.remove("open");
  d.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  letterSendCtx = null;
}
function openLetterDrawer(letter, file, signerName, signedAt) {
  var d = document.getElementById("repairLetterDrawer");
  if (!d) return;
  var title = document.getElementById("repairLetterTitle");
  var meta = document.getElementById("repairLetterMeta");
  var bodyEl = document.getElementById("repairLetterBody");
  var sendOne = document.getElementById("repairLetterSendOne");
  var name = (V && V.bureauLabel) ? V.bureauLabel(letter.bureau) : (letter.bureau || "Letter");
  if (title) title.textContent = name + " · " + (letter.round || "");
  if (meta) {
    meta.textContent = "target: " + (letter.target || "bureau") +
      " · rules " + ((letter.rule_ids || []).join(" · ") || "—") +
      " · status " + (letter.status || "—");
  }
  var html = letter.html || "";
  if (signerName && bodyEl) {
    var sigDate = signedAt
      ? new Date(signedAt).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric", timeZone: "America/Phoenix" })
      : "";
    html += "\n\n<span class=\"sig\">" + esc(signerName) + "</span>\n" +
      esc(signerName) + "\n<span class=\"sigmeta\">Signed electronically" +
      (sigDate ? " · " + esc(sigDate) : "") + " · from the signed repair agreement</span>";
  }
  if (bodyEl) bodyEl.innerHTML = html;
  letterSendCtx = { clientId: file && file.client_id, letter: letter };
  if (sendOne) {
    sendOne.disabled = !(letter && letter.can_send && letter.html);
    /* onclick, not addEventListener: the drawer element is reused for every
       letter, so assignment REPLACES the previous letter's handler instead of
       stacking a second one on the same button. */
    sendOne.onclick = function () {
      if (!letterSendCtx || !V) return;
      var req;
      try {
        req = V.buildRepairSendRequest({
          clientId: letterSendCtx.clientId,
          mail: true,
          letters: [letterSendCtx.letter]
        });
      } catch (e) {
        showErr(e.message || "Could not send");
        return;
      }
      sendOne.disabled = true;
      sendOne.textContent = "Sending…";
      fetch(req.path, { method: req.method, headers: headers(true), body: JSON.stringify(req.body) })
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (out) {
          sendOne.textContent = "Send this one";
          sendOne.disabled = false;
          if (out && out.ok) {
            closeLetterDrawer();
            loadRepairDesk();
          } else {
            showErr((out && (out.error || out.message)) || "Send failed");
          }
        })
        .catch(function () {
          sendOne.textContent = "Send this one";
          sendOne.disabled = false;
          showErr("Send failed");
        });
    };
  }
  d.classList.add("open");
  d.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
}

function pullCheck() {
  var go = document.getElementById("repairPullGo");
  var input = document.getElementById("repairPullInput");
  if (go && input) go.disabled = input.value.trim() !== "PULL";
}
function closePull() {
  var m = document.getElementById("repairPullModal");
  if (!m) return;
  m.classList.remove("open");
  m.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  pullClientId = null;
}
function openPull(clientId) {
  pullClientId = clientId;
  var m = document.getElementById("repairPullModal");
  var input = document.getElementById("repairPullInput");
  if (!m) return;
  if (input) input.value = "";
  pullCheck();
  m.classList.add("open");
  m.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
  if (input) input.focus();
}

/* ── the soft pull ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Three bureaus, one at a time, and EVERY answer is now read.

   This used to be `.then(function () { next(); }).catch(function () { next(); })`
   — three POSTs whose replies were thrown on the floor, a modal that closed
   itself, and a desk that reported success by saying nothing at all. A staff
   member with no permission to pull typed PULL, pressed Pull, watched the box
   close, and three refusals vanished into an empty catch.

   FHData.write classifies the answer exactly the way every other screen's does
   (401/403, 404, 400/409, 503, 500, no reply at all) and FHData.explain says it
   in the house wording, so this screen invents no error copy of its own. The
   same sentence is mirrored into the desk's own error line, because
   explain()'s "sample"-tone cases — a demo session, a rejected request — paint
   nothing on the bottom strip, and silence is what this whole change is about.

   It stops on the FIRST failure. Three identical refusals is noise, and the
   second and third bureau are billable questions not worth asking once the
   first has been answered no. */
var PULL_WHAT = "the credit pull";
function runSoftPull() {
  if (!pullClientId) return;
  if (!window.FHData) { showErr("The credit pull could not start."); return; }
  var clientId = pullClientId;
  var go = document.getElementById("repairPullGo");
  var bureaus = ["EX", "EQ", "TU"];
  var i = 0;

  if (go) { go.disabled = true; go.textContent = "Pulling…"; }
  function release() { if (go) { go.textContent = "Pull"; go.disabled = false; } }

  function next() {
    if (i >= bureaus.length) {
      release();
      closePull();
      clearErr();
      return;
    }
    var bureau = bureaus[i++];
    FHData.write("/api/finance/crs-pull", { client_id: clientId, bureau: bureau })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (res && res.ok) { next(); return; }
        release();
        closePull();
        FHData.explain(res, PULL_WHAT);
        /* The wording explain() just chose, reused rather than rewritten. */
        var said = FHData._parts && FHData._parts[PULL_WHAT] && FHData._parts[PULL_WHAT].text;
        if (said) showErr(said);
      });
  }
  next();
}

function applyFilter(filterKey) {
  activeFilter = filterKey;
  filterTiles.forEach(function (t) {
    t.setAttribute("aria-pressed", t.getAttribute("data-filter") === filterKey ? "true" : "false");
  });
  var body = repairBody();
  if (!body) return;
  body.querySelectorAll("tr.repair-row").forEach(function (tr) {
    if (!filterKey) {
      tr.classList.remove("filtered-out");
      return;
    }
    var sets = (tr.getAttribute("data-set") || "").split(/\s+/);
    tr.classList.toggle("filtered-out", sets.indexOf(filterKey) === -1);
  });
  var open = body.querySelector("tr.repair-expand");
  if (open) open.remove();
  body.querySelectorAll("tr.repair-row.active-row").forEach(function (r) {
    r.classList.remove("active-row");
    r.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
  });
}

/* ── REPAIR-BIND-ONCE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Runs exactly once, at page load, against elements the page shipped with.
   Nothing below this line may be moved back inside loadRepairDesk(). */
document.querySelectorAll("[data-repair-close-letter]").forEach(function (el) {
  el.addEventListener("click", closeLetterDrawer);
});
document.querySelectorAll("[data-repair-close-pull]").forEach(function (el) {
  el.addEventListener("click", closePull);
});
var pullInput = document.getElementById("repairPullInput");
if (pullInput) pullInput.addEventListener("input", pullCheck);
var pullGo = document.getElementById("repairPullGo");
if (pullGo) pullGo.addEventListener("click", runSoftPull);
document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
  if (e.key === "Escape") { closeLetterDrawer(); closePull(); }
});

filterTiles.forEach(function (t) {
  function fire() {
    var key = t.getAttribute("data-filter");
    var on = t.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true";
    applyFilter(on ? null : key);
  }
  t.addEventListener("click", fire);
  t.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); fire(); }
  });
});

/* ── the reload ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Refetch and repaint. Called on first open of the Repair tab, by Retry, and
   after every Send, Stage, Enroll and drawer Send. Binds listeners ONLY to
   rows it has just created. */
function loadRepairDesk() {
  var pane = document.getElementById("pane-repair");
  var body = repairBody();
  var stateBlock = document.getElementById("repairStateBlock");
  var need = document.getElementById("repairNeedMe");
  var ready = document.getElementById("repairReady");
  var waiting = document.getElementById("repairWaiting");
  var stalled = document.getElementById("repairStalled");
  var trial = document.getElementById("repairTrial");
  var loadedFiles = [];

  function setPaneState(name) {
    if (!pane) return;
    pane.classList.remove("state-loading", "state-empty", "state-error", "state-loaded");
    if (name) pane.classList.add("state-" + name);
  }
  function dashTiles() {
    [need, ready, waiting, stalled, trial].forEach(function (el) {
      if (el) el.textContent = "—";
    });
  }
  function setTiles(d) {
    function n(v) { return v == null ? "—" : String(v); }
    if (need) need.textContent = n(d.need_me);
    if (ready) ready.textContent = n(d.ready);
    if (waiting) waiting.textContent = n(d.waiting);
    if (stalled) stalled.textContent = n(d.stalled);
    if (trial) trial.textContent = n(d.trial_ending);
  }
  function showStateMessage(html) {
    if (!stateBlock) return;
    stateBlock.hidden = false;
    stateBlock.innerHTML = html;
  }
  function hideStateMessage() {
    if (!stateBlock) return;
    stateBlock.hidden = true;
    stateBlock.innerHTML = "";
  }

  clearErr();
  setPaneState("loading");
  dashTiles();
  hideStateMessage();
  if (body) {
    body.innerHTML =
      '<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="sk"></div></td></tr>' +
      '<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="sk"></div></td></tr>' +
      '<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="sk"></div></td></tr>';
  }

  fetch("/api/read/repair-cases", { headers: headers() }).then(function (r) {
    return r.json().then(function (d) { return { http: r.status, d: d }; });
  }).then(function (pack) {
    if (!pack.d || pack.d.ok !== true) {
      dashTiles();
      window.FHDeskHead.put("repair",
        { label: "Need me", value: "—", sub: "the repair queue could not be read" },
        null,
        pack.http === 403
          ? "This queue is for staff on this desk."
          : "The repair queue could not be read. Press Retry.");
      setPaneState("error");
      showStateMessage(
        '<div class="big">Couldn\'t load</div>' +
        '<p><button type="button" class="primary" id="repairRetry">Retry</button></p>'
      );
      var retry = document.getElementById("repairRetry");
      if (retry) retry.addEventListener("click", function () { loadRepairDesk(); });
      if (pack.http === 403) showErr("This queue is for staff on this desk.");
      return;
    }
    clearErr();
    setTiles(pack.d);
    loadedFiles = pack.d.files || [];
    /* The same top-left slot the Inquiries pane fills, filled from the rollup
       the ROWS are derived from — src/repair/lens.mjs rollupCounts() over the
       same deriveChip/tileSets the table runs, so the number and the list can
       never disagree. "of 40 open" is the comparison §7 asks for: this count
       never reaches zero, so the number alone says nothing. */
    window.FHDeskHead.put("repair", V.repairHeadline(pack.d), null,
      V.repairQuietLine(pack.d));
    if (!loadedFiles.length) {
      setPaneState("empty");
      showStateMessage('<div class="big">No repair clients yet.</div><p>Close a client on repair and they land here on their own.</p>');
      if (body) body.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }
    setPaneState("loaded");
    hideStateMessage();
    if (!body) return;
    /* ── TRIAGE ORDER: who needs me, then how late it is ────────────────────
       A caseload you nurse is not a queue you empty — it never reaches zero, so
       the question is never "what is left" but "which of these forty need me
       today, and which are correctly quiet waiting on a bureau". So the files
       that need a person come first, and inside each group the most overdue is
       at the top, because Due is the clock this whole desk runs on.

       The reader hands them back need-me-stage first then updated_at, which is
       recency — the file touched most recently, not the file most overdue. A
       row three days past its bureau deadline was landing tenth.

       A file with no due date sorts to the bottom of its own group rather than
       being treated as due now. The quiet rows are NOT hidden: they stay on the
       list carrying the words "Waiting on the bureau", because a triage board
       that hides two thirds of the caseload is a board you cannot trust. */
    loadedFiles = loadedFiles.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      var an = L.tileSets(a, L.deriveChip(a)).indexOf("need") !== -1 ? 0 : 1;
      var bn = L.tileSets(b, L.deriveChip(b)).indexOf("need") !== -1 ? 0 : 1;
      if (an !== bn) return an - bn;
      var at = a && a.response_due_at ? new Date(a.response_due_at).getTime() : NaN;
      var bt = b && b.response_due_at ? new Date(b.response_due_at).getTime() : NaN;
      if (!Number.isFinite(at) && !Number.isFinite(bt)) return 0;
      if (!Number.isFinite(at)) return 1;
      if (!Number.isFinite(bt)) return -1;
      return at - bt;
    });
    body.innerHTML = loadedFiles.map(function (f) {
      var chip = L.deriveChip(f);
      var due = L.dueWords(f.response_due_at);
      var sets = L.tileSets(f, chip).join(" ");
      var dots = L.warningDots(f).map(function (d) {
        return '<span class="repair-wdot">' + esc(d.label) + "</span>";
      }).join("");
      var pill = (V && V.repairStagePill)
        ? V.repairStagePill(f.stage_key)
        : { cls: "", text: f.stage_label || "—" };
      return '<tr class="case-main repair-row" data-repair-row="' + esc(f.client_id) +
        '" data-set="' + esc(sets) + '" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">' +
        '<td class="name">' + esc(f.name) + "</td>" +
        '<td class="mono">' + esc(f.program || "—") + "</td>" +
        '<td class="mono">' + esc(L.roundLabel(f)) + "</td>" +
        '<td><span class="status-pill ' + pill.cls + '">' + esc(pill.text) + "</span></td>" +
        '<td><span class="repair-chip ' + esc(chip.key) + '">' + esc(chip.label) + "</span>" + dots + "</td>" +
        '<td class="repair-due ' + esc(due.tone) + '">' + esc(due.text) + "</td>" +
        "</tr>";
    }).join("");
    if (activeFilter) applyFilter(activeFilter);
    body.querySelectorAll("[data-repair-row]").forEach(function (tr) {
      tr.addEventListener("click", function () { toggleRepairRow(tr); });
      tr.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); toggleRepairRow(tr); }
      });
    });
    /* THE NEXT ACTION, SAID ONCE. Bound after the rows exist, so the sentence
       and the row it opens are the same file. The chip comes from the same
       FHRepairLens call the row's own Needs cell used — a second derivation
       here is how a headline starts naming a file the table does not show. */
    var nextUp = V.nextRepairAction(loadedFiles, function (f) {
      var chip = L.deriveChip(f);
      return L.tileSets(f, chip).indexOf("need") !== -1 ? chip.label : "";
    });
    window.FHDeskHead.put("repair", V.repairHeadline(pack.d),
      nextUp ? {
        text: "Open " + nextUp.text,
        onClick: function () {
          var row = body.querySelector('[data-repair-row="' + nextUp.clientId + '"]');
          if (!row) return;
          if (row.scrollIntoView) row.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
          if (row.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true") toggleRepairRow(row);
        }
      } : null,
      V.repairQuietLine(pack.d));
  }).catch(function () {
    dashTiles();
    window.FHDeskHead.put("repair",
      { label: "Need me", value: "—", sub: "the repair queue could not be read" },
      null, "The repair queue could not be read. Press Retry.");
    setPaneState("error");
    showStateMessage(
      '<div class="big">Couldn\'t load</div>' +
      '<p><button type="button" class="primary" id="repairRetry">Retry</button></p>'
    );
    var retry = document.getElementById("repairRetry");
    if (retry) retry.addEventListener("click", function () { loadRepairDesk(); });
  });

  fetch("/api/repair/exceptions", { headers: headers() }).then(function (r) {
    if (r.status === 403) return null;
    return r.json();
  }).then(function (d) {
    var wrap = document.getElementById("repair-exceptions");
    var list = document.getElementById("repairExceptionsList");
    if (!d || d.ok !== true || !wrap || !list) return;
    var stalledRows = d.stalled || [];
    var parses = d.lowConfidenceParses || [];
    if (!stalledRows.length && !parses.length) return;
    wrap.hidden = false;
    var html = "";
    stalledRows.forEach(function (row) {
      html += '<div class="letter-row"><div><div class="lt-name">' +
        esc(row.email || row.client_id) + '</div><div class="lt-detail">Stuck in repair</div></div></div>';
    });
    parses.forEach(function (row) {
      html += '<div class="letter-row"><div><div class="lt-name">Bureau answer needs a look</div>' +
        '<div class="lt-detail">Confidence ' + esc(row.confidence) + "</div></div>" +
        '<div class="case-actions"><button type="button" class="primary" data-confirm-parse="' +
        esc(row.id) + '">Mark as checked</button></div></div>';
    });
    list.innerHTML = html;
    list.querySelectorAll("[data-confirm-parse]").forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var req;
        try {
          req = V.buildRepairConfirmParseRequest({ responseId: btn.getAttribute("data-confirm-parse") });
        } catch (e) {
          btn.textContent = e.message || "invalid";
          return;
        }
        btn.disabled = true;
        fetch(req.path, { method: req.method, headers: headers(true), body: JSON.stringify(req.body) })
          .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
          .then(function (out) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = out && out.ok ? "Checked" : (out && out.error) || "failed";
          })
          .catch(function () {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = "failed";
          });
      });
    });
  }).catch(function () { });

  function toggleRepairRow(tr) {
    var id = tr.getAttribute("data-repair-row");
    var open = tr.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
    var next = tr.nextElementSibling;
    if (next && next.classList.contains("repair-expand")) next.remove();
    body.querySelectorAll("tr.repair-row.active-row").forEach(function (r) {
      if (r !== tr) {
        r.classList.remove("active-row");
        r.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        var n2 = r.nextElementSibling;
        if (n2 && n2.classList.contains("repair-expand")) n2.remove();
      }
    });
    if (open) {
      tr.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      tr.classList.remove("active-row");
      return;
    }
    tr.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    tr.classList.add("active-row");
    var detail = document.createElement("tr");
    detail.className = "repair-expand";
    detail.innerHTML = '<td colspan="6"><div class="lt-detail">Loading…</div></td>';
    tr.parentNode.insertBefore(detail, tr.nextSibling);
    fetch("/api/read/repair-cases?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(id), { headers: headers() })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        if (!d || d.ok !== true) {
          detail.innerHTML = '<td colspan="6"><div class="repair-err">Could not load this file.</div></td>';
          return;
        }
        var file = d.file || {};
        var letters = d.letters || [];
        var items = d.items || [];
        var timeline = d.timeline || [];
        var sendable = letters.filter(function (l) { return l.can_send && l.html; });
        var itemHtml = items.length
          ? "<ul>" + items.slice(0, 20).map(function (it) {
              var sev = String(it.severity || "");
              var tagCls = sev === "deletion" ? "del" : (sev === "strong" ? "strong" : "mod");
              return "<li>" + (it.bureau ? esc(it.bureau) + " · " : "") + esc(it.creditor || it.rule_id) +
                (it.account_last4 ? ' <span class="mono">····' + esc(it.account_last4) + "</span>" : "") +
                (it.round ? ' <span class="repair-tag">' + esc(it.round) + "</span>" : "") +
                ' <span class="repair-tag ' + tagCls + '">' + esc(sev || "item") + "</span>" +
                ' <span class="repair-tag">' + esc(it.rule_id || "") + "</span></li>";
            }).join("") + "</ul>"
          : '<p class="lt-detail">No dispute items on this file yet.</p>';
        var letterHtml = letters.length
          ? "<ul>" + letters.map(function (l, idx) {
              var name = (V && V.bureauLabel) ? V.bureauLabel(l.bureau) : (l.bureau || "Letter");
              var furn = l.target === "furnisher" ? ' <span class="repair-tag furn">furnisher</span>' : "";
              return '<li role="button" tabindex="0" data-letter-idx="' + idx + '">' +
                esc(name) + " · " + esc(l.round || "") +
                ' <span class="repair-tag">' + esc(l.status || "") + "</span>" + furn + "</li>";
            }).join("") + "</ul>"
          : '<p class="lt-detail">No letters ready. Analysis has to finish first.</p>';
        var timeHtml = timeline.length
          ? '<ul class="mono">' + timeline.map(function (t) {
              return "<li>" + esc(t.words || L.timelineLine(t)) + "</li>";
            }).join("") + "</ul>"
          : '<p class="lt-detail">No timeline yet.</p>';
        var rounds = d.rounds || [];
        var STATUS_WORDS = {
          written: "Written",
          held: "Held — wait for bureau",
          current: "Next to write",
          later: "Later",
          blocked_at_cap: "Blocked on this program"
        };
        var nextHtml = rounds.length
          ? "<ul>" + rounds.map(function (r) {
              var attacked = (r.attacks && r.attacks.length)
                ? r.attacks.slice(0, 8).join("; ")
                : "No items on this round yet";
              return "<li><strong>" + esc(r.round) + "</strong> · " +
                esc(STATUS_WORDS[r.status] || r.status) + "<br>" +
                '<span class="lt-detail">' + esc(r.title || "") + " — " + esc(r.when || "") +
                "<br>" + esc(attacked) + "</span></li>";
            }).join("") + "</ul>"
          : '<p class="lt-detail">Round plan is not on this file yet.</p>';
        detail.innerHTML =
          '<td colspan="6"><div class="repair-xgrid">' +
          '<div class="repair-xcard"><h3>Items</h3>' + itemHtml + "</div>" +
          '<div class="repair-xcard"><h3>Letters this round</h3>' + letterHtml + "</div>" +
          '<div class="repair-xcard"><h3>What is next</h3>' + nextHtml + "</div>" +
          '<div class="repair-xcard"><h3>Timeline</h3>' + timeHtml + "</div>" +
          '</div><div class="case-actions" style="margin-top:14px">' +
          '<button type="button" class="primary" data-act="repair-send"' + (sendable.length ? "" : " disabled") + ">Send</button>" +
          '<button type="button" data-act="repair-stage">Stage</button>' +
          /* Soft pull and Clean personal info render only for the roles their
             endpoints accept — see CRS_PULL_ROLES and ERASURE_ROLES at the top
             of this block for why the Specialist is not one of them. */
          (mayPullCredit() ? '<button type="button" data-act="repair-pull">Soft pull</button>' : "") +
          (mayErase() ? '<button type="button" data-act="repair-clean">Clean personal info</button>' : "") +
          '<button type="button" data-act="repair-enroll">Enroll</button>' +
          '<p class="lt-detail" data-send-msg></p></div></td>';

        detail.querySelectorAll("[data-letter-idx]").forEach(function (li) {
          function open() {
            var idx = Number(li.getAttribute("data-letter-idx"));
            openLetterDrawer(letters[idx], file, d.signer_name, d.signed_at);
          }
          li.addEventListener("click", function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); open(); });
          li.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
            if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); open(); }
          });
        });

        var sendBtn = detail.querySelector("[data-act=repair-send]");
        if (sendBtn && sendable.length) {
          sendBtn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            var req;
            try {
              req = V.buildRepairSendRequest({ clientId: id, mail: true, letters: sendable });
            } catch (errSend) {
              var slot = detail.querySelector("[data-send-msg]");
              if (slot) slot.textContent = errSend.message || "invalid";
              return;
            }
            sendBtn.disabled = true;
            sendBtn.textContent = "Sending…";
            fetch(req.path, { method: req.method, headers: headers(true), body: JSON.stringify(req.body) })
              .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
              .then(function (out) {
                sendBtn.disabled = false;
                if (out && out.ok) {
                  sendBtn.textContent = "Sent";
                  loadRepairDesk();
                } else {
                  sendBtn.textContent = "Send";
                  var slot = detail.querySelector("[data-send-msg]");
                  if (slot) slot.textContent = (out && (out.error || out.message)) || "Send failed";
                }
              })
              .catch(function () {
                sendBtn.disabled = false;
                sendBtn.textContent = "Send";
              });
          });
        }
        var stageBtn = detail.querySelector("[data-act=repair-stage]");
        if (stageBtn) {
          stageBtn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            stageBtn.disabled = true;
            stageBtn.textContent = "Staging…";
            fetch("/api/repair/generate", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: headers(true),
              body: JSON.stringify({ client_id: id })
            }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (out) {
              stageBtn.disabled = false;
              stageBtn.textContent = "Stage";
              var slot = detail.querySelector("[data-send-msg]");
              if (slot) {
                slot.textContent = (out && out.ok)
                  ? "Letters staged."
                  : ((out && (out.message || out.reason || out.error)) || "Stage failed");
              }
              if (out && out.ok) loadRepairDesk();
            }).catch(function () {
              stageBtn.disabled = false;
              stageBtn.textContent = "Stage";
            });
          });
        }
        var pullBtn = detail.querySelector("[data-act=repair-pull]");
        if (pullBtn) {
          pullBtn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            openPull(id);
          });
        }
        var cleanBtn = detail.querySelector("[data-act=repair-clean]");
        if (cleanBtn) {
          cleanBtn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            var slot = detail.querySelector("[data-send-msg]");
            if (!window.confirm("Clean personal info for this client? Owner/admin only. This cannot be undone.")) return;
            cleanBtn.disabled = true;
            fetch("/api/privacy/erasure", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: headers(true),
              body: JSON.stringify({
                client_id: id,
                confirm_client_id: id,
                reason: "Specialist desk Clean personal info"
              })
            }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (d2) { return { status: r.status, d: d2 }; }); })
              .then(function (pack2) {
                cleanBtn.disabled = false;
                if (slot) {
                  slot.textContent = (pack2.d && pack2.d.ok)
                    ? "Personal info cleaned."
                    : ((pack2.d && (pack2.d.error || pack2.d.message)) || "Could not clean (owner/admin only).");
                }
              })
              .catch(function () {
                cleanBtn.disabled = false;
                if (slot) slot.textContent = "Could not clean.";
              });
          });
        }
        var enrollBtn = detail.querySelector("[data-act=repair-enroll]");
        if (enrollBtn) {
          enrollBtn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            enrollBtn.disabled = true;
            fetch("/api/repair/enroll", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: headers(true),
              body: JSON.stringify({ client_id: id, program: "trial", price_total: 200, amount_paid: 200 })
            }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (out) {
              enrollBtn.disabled = false;
              var slot = detail.querySelector("[data-send-msg]");
              if (slot) slot.textContent = (out && out.ok) ? "Enrolled in trial." : ((out && (out.error || out.message)) || "Enroll failed");
              if (out && out.ok) loadRepairDesk();
            }).catch(function () {
              enrollBtn.disabled = false;
            });
          });
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        detail.innerHTML = '<td colspan="6"><div class="repair-err">Could not load this file.</div></td>';
      });
  }
}

/* deskToggle above is a separate IIFE and calls this by name when the Repair
   tab is opened for the first time, so it has to be reachable from outside
   this one. Everything else stays in here. */
window.loadRepairDesk = loadRepairDesk;

})();

/* ── REOPEN ON THE DESK YOU WERE WORKING ───────────────────────────────────
   Last thing on the page, and it has to stay last. Both desks are fully built
   by this line, so show("repair") can reach loadRepairDesk. Run this any
   earlier and the Repair pane opens on a spinner that never resolves — the
   whole story is written above the tab handlers.

   Storage being unavailable, or holding something this page does not know, is
   simply the Inquiries pane, which is what the page already shows. */
(function restoreRememberedPane() {
  var remembered = "";
  try { remembered = localStorage.getItem("fh_specialist_pane") || ""; } catch (e) {}
  if (remembered !== "repair") return;
  if (!window.FHSpecialistPane || typeof window.FHSpecialistPane.show !== "function") return;
  window.FHSpecialistPane.show("repair");
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>

let J=seed();
/* SAVED — last-known-good state per journey: the server's row once it loads,
   the seed example until then. "Discard" reverts here, not to the hardcoded
