const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const now=()=>new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit',timeZone:'America/Phoenix'});

function listAt(path){ if(!path||!path.length) return J[active].nodes;
  const c=J[active].nodes.find(n=>n.id===path[0]); return c?c.branches[path[1]].nodes:J[active].nodes; }
function findNode(id,nodes=J[active].nodes,path=[]){
  for(let i=0;i<nodes.length;i++){ const n=nodes[i];
    if(n.id===id) return {node:n,list:nodes,idx:i,path};
    if(n.branches) for(let b=0;b<n.branches.length;b++){
      const r=findNode(id,n.branches[b].nodes,[n.id,b]); if(r) return r; } }
  return null;
}
function countNodes(k){let n=0;const w=l=>l.forEach(x=>{n++;if(x.branches)x.branches.forEach(b=>w(b.nodes))});w(J[k].nodes);return n}

/* ── change log: mirrors the action_log table (actor, target, before, after, undo) ── */
function record(actor,what,before){
  log.unshift({id:'l'+Date.now()+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6),actor,what,
    journey:active,ts:now(),before,reverted:false});
  if(log.length>60) log.pop();
}
function revert(entryId){
  const e=log.find(x=>x.id===entryId); if(!e||e.reverted) return;
  const cur=JSON.stringify(J[e.journey]);
  J[e.journey]=JSON.parse(e.before);
  e.reverted=true;
  record('you','Reverted: '+e.what,cur);
  log[0].reverted=true;
  selId=null; pending=null; bump(); render();
  toast('<b>Reverted.</b> ' + esc(e.what) + ' — put back the way it was.');
}
function bump(){dirty++;touched[active]=true}
function pushUndo(){undoStack.push(JSON.stringify(J[active]));if(undoStack.length>40)undoStack.shift()}
function commit(what){bump();record('you',what,undoStack[undoStack.length-1]);render()}

function defaults(t){return{sms:{body:'Reply STOP to opt out.',delay:'instant'},email:{subject:'',body:'',delay:'instant'},
  wait:{amount:'1',unit:'days'},stage:{stage:'New Lead',pipeline:'Sales'},assign:{role:'Setter'},
  handoff:{role:'Closer',stage:''},agent:{agent:'UnderwriteIQ',note:''},payment:{amount:'',product:''},
  record:{note:''},condition:{field:'',op:'is true'}}[t]||{}}
function addNode(path,idx,type){ pushUndo();
  const n=N(type,TYPES[type].k,defaults(type),[]);
  if(type==='condition'){n.title='New question';n.branches=[{label:'Yes',nodes:[]},{label:'No',nodes:[]}]}
  listAt(path).splice(idx,0,n); selId=n.id; tab='step'; closeMenu(); commit('Added a step: '+n.title); }
function delNode(id){const f=findNode(id);if(!f)return;const t=f.node.title;pushUndo();
  f.list.splice(f.idx,1);selId=null;commit('Deleted a step: '+t)}
function moveNode(id,d){const f=findNode(id);if(!f)return;const j=f.idx+d;
  if(j<0||j>=f.list.length)return;pushUndo();
  [f.list[f.idx],f.list[j]]=[f.list[j],f.list[f.idx]];commit('Moved '+f.node.title+(d<0?' up':' down'))}
let editTimer=null, editBefore=null;
function setCfg(id,k,v){const f=findNode(id);if(!f)return;
  if(!editBefore) editBefore=JSON.stringify(J[active]);
  if(k==='title')f.node.title=v;else f.node.cfg[k]=v;
  bump();syncHeader();renderCanvas();
  clearTimeout(editTimer);
  editTimer=setTimeout(()=>{ undoStack.push(editBefore);
    record('you','Edited '+f.node.title,editBefore); editBefore=null; renderPanel(); },900);
}
function undo(){if(!undoStack.length)return;J[active]=JSON.parse(undoStack.pop());
  dirty=Math.max(0,dirty-1);selId=null;pending=null;render()}

/* ── versions ── */
function saveVersion(){
  const name=prompt('Name this version','Journey as of '+new Date().toLocaleDateString());
  if(!name) return;
  versions.unshift({id:'v'+Date.now(),name,journey:active,ts:new Date().toLocaleString(),
    snap:JSON.stringify(J[active]),steps:countNodes(active)});
  toast('<b>Saved.</b> You can come back to “'+esc(name)+'” at any point.');
  tab='hist'; render();
}
function restoreVersion(id){
  const v=versions.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!v) return;
  const before=JSON.stringify(J[v.journey]);
  pushUndo(); J[v.journey]=JSON.parse(v.snap); active=v.journey; selId=null; pending=null;
  bump(); record('you','Rolled back to “'+v.name+'”',before); render();
  toast('<b>Rolled back.</b> This journey is the way it was at “'+esc(v.name)+'”.');
}

/* ── Claude — real server call via /api/journeys/ask, which holds the key ── */
function compact(nodes){return nodes.map(n=>{const o={id:n.id,type:n.type,title:n.title,cfg:n.cfg};
  if(n.branches)o.branches=n.branches.map(b=>({label:b.label,nodes:compact(b.nodes)}));return o})}
function sysPrompt(){return `You edit workflow journeys for Fundhub, a business-funding company. Return ONLY JSON.

STEP TYPES and exact cfg shape:
sms      {body, delay}          delay: ${DELAYS.join(' | ')}
email    {subject, body, delay}
wait     {amount, unit}         unit: minutes | hours | days
condition{field, op}            op: is true | is false | is set | is empty | = funding | = optimization
                                 MUST also carry "branches": [{label,nodes:[]},{label,nodes:[]}]
stage    {stage, pipeline}      stage: ${STAGES.join(' | ')}
                                 pipeline: ${PIPES.join(' | ')}
assign   {role}                 role: ${ROLES.join(' | ')}
handoff  {role, stage}
agent    {agent, note}          agent: UnderwriteIQ | Setter Josh | Brand Studio | Inquiry Voice | Alerts Engine
payment  {amount, product}
record   {note}

RETURN:
{"summary":"one plain past-tense sentence",
 "ops":[{"op":"insert","after":"<id>|start","path":[],"node":{...}},
        {"op":"update","id":"<id>","title":"...","cfg":{...}},
        {"op":"delete","id":"<id>"}]}

RULES:
1. FILL EVERYTHING IN. Never a placeholder, TODO, empty string, or unfilled {{variable}}. Write the real SMS
   copy. Pick the real delay. Name the real field. A half-finished step is worse than none — this is the point.
2. Match the existing SMS voice: first person from Chris, short, casual, one clear ask, {{first_name}} and
   links like {{booking_link}}. Merge tags always use DOUBLE curly braces — {{first_name}}, never
   {first_name} — that is what the renderer reads. Every SMS body MUST end "Reply STOP to opt out."
3. "path":["conditionId",0] targets the first lane, 1 the second. [] or omitted = main line.
4. "after" is the id the new step goes below, or "start" for the top of that line.
5. Every inserted node needs type, title (plain English, verb first), cfg. Conditions need two labelled lanes.
6. Smallest change that does the job. Do not restructure what the user did not mention.`}

async function askClaude(text,scopeId){
  busy=true; askErr=''; renderCanvas();
  const j=J[active];
  const user=`Current journey:\n${JSON.stringify({journey:j.name,startsWhen:j.start,endsWhen:j.end,steps:compact(j.nodes)})}\n\nChange requested:\n${text}`+
    (scopeId?`\n\nThe user is looking at step "${scopeId}". Scope the change there unless they say otherwise.`:'')+
    `\n\nReturn only the JSON object.`;
  try{
    const res=await fetch("/api/journeys/ask",{method:"POST",credentials:"include",
      headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
      body:JSON.stringify({system:sysPrompt(),user})});
    const data=await res.json();
    if(!res.ok||!data.ok) throw new Error(data.error||('HTTP '+res.status));
    const raw=String(data.text||'').trim();
    const patch=JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^```(?:json)?/,'').replace(/```$/,'').trim());
    if(!patch.ops||!patch.ops.length) throw new Error('empty');
    stagePatch(patch,text);
  }catch(err){
    if(err&&err.message==='anthropic_api_key_not_configured'){
      const l=localPatch(text,scopeId);
      if(l){stagePatch(l,text);askErr='ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set on this deployment, so this is a worked example instead of a real Claude answer. Set it and this writes the real change.'}
      else askErr='ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set on this deployment. Add the step by hand with + until it is.';
    } else {
      const l=localPatch(text,scopeId);
      if(l){stagePatch(l,text);askErr='Could not reach Claude, so this is a worked example. Try again in a moment for the real answer.'}
      else askErr='Could not reach Claude just now. Try again, or add the step by hand with +.';
    }
  }
  busy=false; render();
}
function localPatch(text,scopeId){
  const t=text.toLowerCase(); const last=J[active].nodes[J[active].nodes.length-1];
  const after=scopeId||(last&&last.id)||'start';
  if(/confirm|no.?show|remind|follow.?up|again|chase|nudge|quiet/.test(t)) return {summary:'Added a wait and a follow-up text.',ops:[
    {op:'insert',after,path:[],node:{type:'wait',title:'Give them a couple of hours',cfg:{amount:'2',unit:'hours'}}},
    {op:'insert',after,path:[],node:{type:'sms',title:'Follow up if they went quiet',
      cfg:{body:"{{first_name}} — haven't heard back. Still want me to look at what you'd qualify for? Reply STOP to opt out.",delay:'after 2 hours'}}}]};
  if(/email/.test(t)) return {summary:'Added an email step.',ops:[{op:'insert',after,path:[],
    node:{type:'email',title:'Email them a recap',cfg:{subject:'What we covered',body:'A short recap of the call and what happens next.',delay:'instant'}}}]};
  if(/wait|delay|hold/.test(t)) return {summary:'Added a one-day wait.',ops:[{op:'insert',after,path:[],
    node:{type:'wait',title:'Wait a day',cfg:{amount:'1',unit:'days'}}}]};
  return {summary:'Added a text step.',ops:[{op:'insert',after,path:[],
    node:{type:'sms',title:'Reach out',cfg:{body:"{{first_name}} — quick one from Fundhub. Reply STOP to opt out.",delay:'instant'}}}]};
}
function stagePatch(patch,askedFor){
  pushUndo();
  const added=[],changed=[];
  (patch.ops||[]).forEach(op=>{ try{
    if(op.op==='delete'){const f=findNode(op.id);if(f)f.list.splice(f.idx,1);return}
    if(op.op==='update'){const f=findNode(op.id);if(!f)return;
      if(op.title)f.node.title=op.title; if(op.cfg)Object.assign(f.node.cfg,op.cfg);
      f.node._chg=true;changed.push(f.node.id);return}
    if(op.op==='insert'){
      const s=op.node||{}; if(!TYPES[s.type])return;
      const n=N(s.type,s.title||TYPES[s.type].k,Object.assign(defaults(s.type),s.cfg||{}),[]);
      if(s.type==='condition'){
        n.branches=(s.branches&&s.branches.length===2?s.branches:[{label:'Yes',nodes:[]},{label:'No',nodes:[]}])
          .map(b=>({label:b.label||'—',nodes:(b.nodes||[]).map(cn=>N(cn.type,cn.title,Object.assign(defaults(cn.type),cn.cfg||{}),[]))}));
        n.branches.forEach(b=>b.nodes.forEach(x=>{x._new=true;added.push(x.id)}));
      }
      n._new=true; added.push(n.id);
      const list=listAt(op.path||[]); let at=list.length;
      if(op.after==='start') at=0;
      else if(op.after){const f=findNode(op.after); if(f&&f.list===list) at=f.idx+1}
      list.splice(at,0,n);
    }}catch(e){} });
  if(!added.length&&!changed.length){undoStack.pop();askErr='That came back empty. Try saying it a different way.';return}
  pending={summary:patch.summary||'Change ready to review.',asked:askedFor,added,changed};
  selId=added[0]||changed[0]||null; tab='step'; askText='';
}
function acceptPending(){
  const w=n=>{delete n._new;delete n._chg;if(n.branches)n.branches.forEach(b=>b.nodes.forEach(w))};
  J[active].nodes.forEach(w);
  const n=pending.added.length+pending.changed.length, s=pending.summary;
  record('claude',s,undoStack[undoStack.length-1]);
  pending=null; bump(); render();
  toast('<b>Kept it.</b> '+n+' step'+(n>1?'s':'')+' now part of this journey. Not in the code until you press Apply.');
}
function rejectPending(){ if(undoStack.length) J[active]=JSON.parse(undoStack.pop());
  pending=null; selId=null; render(); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   The simulator
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const FAKE={first_name:'Dana',last_name:'Reyes',company:'Reyes Fabrication LLC',
  survey_link:'fundhub.ai/s/dq8f2',booking_link:'fundhub.ai/b/dq8f2',portal_link:'portal.fundhub.ai/c/dq8f2',
  time:'2:30pm',lender:'Chase Ink',amount:'$18,000'};
function fill(s){return String(s||'').replace(/\{\{\s*(\w+)\s*\}\}/g,(m,k)=>FAKE[k]!==undefined?FAKE[k]:m)}

function plan(nodes){
  const out=[];
  nodes.forEach(n=>{
    out.push({node:n});
    if(n.branches){
      if(sim.mode==='both'){
        n.branches.forEach((b,i)=>{ out.push({lane:{cond:n.id,i,label:b.label}}); out.push(...plan(b.nodes)); });
      }else{
        const i=sim.mode==='second'?1:0;
        out.push({lane:{cond:n.id,i,label:n.branches[i].label,skip:1-i}});
        out.push(...plan(n.branches[i].nodes));
      }
    }
  });
  return out;
}
function startSim(fromId){
  stopSim();
  sim.running=true; sim.done=false; sim.feed=[]; sim.report=null;
  document.body.classList.add('running');
  let steps=plan(J[active].nodes);
  if(fromId){ const at=steps.findIndex(s=>s.node&&s.node.id===fromId); if(at>0) steps=steps.slice(at); }
  document.querySelectorAll('.nrow').forEach(r=>r.classList.remove('fired','now','skipped'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.lane').forEach(l=>l.classList.remove('notaken'));
  sim.feed.push({t:'evt',time:now(),text:'Started as '+FAKE.first_name+' '+FAKE.last_name+' — '+FAKE.company});
  renderPanel();
  let i=0, sent=0, fired=0;
  const tick=()=>{
    if(i>=steps.length){ finish(); return; }
    const s=steps[i++];
    if(s.lane){
      const el=document.querySelector('.nrow[data-id="'+s.lane.cond+'"]');
      if(el){
        const lanes=el.parentElement.querySelector('.lanes')||
          (el.nextElementSibling&&el.nextElementSibling.nextElementSibling);
        const set=document.querySelectorAll('.lanes');
        set.forEach(g=>{ if(g.previousElementSibling&&g.previousElementSibling.previousElementSibling===el){
          [...g.children].forEach((L,li)=>{ if(s.lane.skip!==undefined&&li===s.lane.skip) L.classList.add('notaken'); }); } });
      }
      sim.feed.push({t:'evt',time:now(),text:'Took the “'+s.lane.label+'” path'});
      renderPanel(); sim.timer=setTimeout(tick,380); return;
    }
    const n=s.node;
    document.querySelectorAll('.nrow.now').forEach(r=>{r.classList.remove('now');r.classList.add('fired')});
    const row=document.querySelector('.nrow[data-id="'+n.id+'"]');
    if(row){ row.classList.add('now'); row.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'smooth'}); }
    fired++;
    if(n.type==='sms'){ sent++;
      sim.feed.push({t:'sms',time:now(),body:fill(n.cfg.body),step:n.title}); }
    else if(n.type==='email'){ sent++;
      sim.feed.push({t:'email',time:now(),subj:fill(n.cfg.subject),body:fill(n.cfg.body),step:n.title}); }
    else if(n.type==='wait'){
      sim.feed.push({t:'evt',time:now(),text:'Waited '+n.cfg.amount+' '+n.cfg.unit+' (skipped ahead)'}); }
    else if(n.type==='condition'){
      sim.feed.push({t:'evt',time:now(),text:'Checked: '+(n.cfg.field||'field')+' '+n.cfg.op}); }
    else sim.feed.push({t:'evt',time:now(),text:n.title});
    renderPanel();
    sim.timer=setTimeout(tick, n.type==='sms'||n.type==='email'?900:520);
  };
  const finish=()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('.nrow.now').forEach(r=>{r.classList.remove('now');r.classList.add('fired')});
    sim.running=false; sim.done=true;
    sim.report={steps:fired,messages:sent,
      unreached:countNodes(active)-fired};
    renderPanel();
  };
  sim.timer=setTimeout(tick,420);
}
function stopSim(){
  clearTimeout(sim.timer); sim.running=false;
  document.body.classList.remove('running');
  document.querySelectorAll('.nrow').forEach(r=>r.classList.remove('fired','now','skipped'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.lane').forEach(l=>l.classList.remove('notaken'));
}

/* ── rendering ── */
/* stepFault — is this step missing something it cannot work without?
   Mirrors the check the server does on save (api/journeys.mjs findBadSteps), so
   the author sees the problem on the canvas instead of finding out when the
   save is refused, or worse, in a "Test against the code" report reading
   'wait unit "undefined"'. Only settings whose absence makes a step meaningless
   are faults here — an unwritten message is a draft, not a fault. */
const WAIT_UNITS=['minutes','hours','days'];
function stepFault(n){
  const c=n.cfg||{};
  if(n.type==='wait'){
    const amt=Number(c.amount);
    if(WAIT_UNITS.indexOf(c.unit)<0||!isFinite(amt)||amt<=0)
      return 'This step is not set up — a wait needs a number and one of minutes, hours or days.';
  }
  if(n.type==='condition'){
    if(!(c.field||'').trim()) return 'This step is not set up — a question needs something to check.';
    if(!Array.isArray(n.branches)||n.branches.length!==2)
      return 'This step is not set up — a question needs its two paths.';
  }
  if(n.type==='stage'&&(!(c.stage||'').trim()||!(c.pipeline||'').trim()))
    return 'This step is not set up — moving a card needs a pipeline and a stage.';
  if(!TYPES[n.type]) return 'This step is not set up — there is no such kind of step.';
  return null;
}
function summary(n){
  const c=n.cfg||{};
  const fault=stepFault(n); if(fault) return fault;
  switch(n.type){
    case 'sms': return c.body||'Nothing written yet';
    case 'email': return c.subject? c.subject+' — '+(c.body||'') : (c.body||'No subject yet');
    case 'wait': return 'Nothing happens for '+c.amount+' '+c.unit;
    case 'stage': return 'Their card moves to '+c.stage+' in '+c.pipeline;
    case 'assign': return 'Goes to whichever '+c.role+' is available';
    case 'handoff': return 'The '+c.role+' journey picks up'+(c.stage?' at '+c.stage:'');
    case 'agent': return c.note||c.agent;
    case 'payment': return c.amount? 'Charge $'+c.amount+(c.product?' for '+c.product:'') : 'No amount set yet';
    case 'record': return c.note||'Nothing written yet';
    case 'condition': return 'Two paths below, depending on the answer';
  } return '';
}
function wireHTML(path,idx,plain){return '<div class="wire'+(plain?' plain':'')+'" data-path=\''+JSON.stringify(path)+
  '\' data-idx="'+idx+'"><button class="add" aria-label="Add a step here">+</button></div>'}
function nodeHTML(n){
  const fault=stepFault(n);
  const s=summary(n), quiet=!fault&&/^N(o|othing) /.test(s);
  const nc=n._new?' prop':(n._chg?' edited-n':'');
  /* "Not set up" outranks New and Changed — it is the one a person has to act
     on, and a step is only ever one of the three. */
  const tag=fault?'<span class="tagpill x">Not set up</span>':
    (n._new?'<span class="tagpill n">New</span>':(n._chg?'<span class="tagpill c">Changed</span>':''));
  // A step whose type nothing recognises still has to render, or one bad row
  // takes the whole canvas blank and the author cannot even delete it.
  const t=TYPES[n.type]||{g:'act',k:n.type||'Unknown step'};
  return '<div class="nrow" aria-selected="'+(n.id===selId)+'" data-id="'+n.id+'">'+tag+
    '<button class="node g-'+t.g+(n.branches?' ask-n':'')+nc+'"><div class="nin">'+
    '<div class="ntop"><b>'+esc(n.title)+'</b><span class="ty">'+esc(t.k)+'</span></div>'+
    '<div class="nsub'+(fault?' x':(quiet?' q':''))+'">'+esc(s)+'</div></div></button></div>';
}
function chainHTML(nodes,path){
  let h='';
  nodes.forEach((n,i)=>{
    h+=wireHTML(path,i)+nodeHTML(n);
    if(n.branches){
      h+='<div class="fork"><span class="stem"></span><span class="cross"></span><span class="dl"></span><span class="dr"></span>'+
        '<span class="tag l">'+esc(n.branches[0].label)+'</span><span class="tag r">'+esc(n.branches[1].label)+'</span></div>'+
        '<div class="lanes">'+n.branches.map((b,bi)=>'<div class="lane">'+
          (b.nodes.length? chainHTML(b.nodes,[n.id,bi])+wireHTML([n.id,bi],b.nodes.length,true)
            : wireHTML([n.id,bi],0,true)+'<div class="emptylane">Nothing on this path yet</div>')+'</div>').join('')+
        '</div><div class="merge"><span class="ul"></span><span class="ur"></span><span class="cross"></span><span class="stem"></span></div>';
    }
  });
  return h+wireHTML(path,nodes.length);
}
function askHTML(){
  if(busy) return '<div class="ask"><div class="askbox"><div class="thinking"><span class="sp"></span>'+
    '<span>Working out the change, writing the copy, wiring it in…</span></div></div></div>';
  const egs=['If they don’t confirm by 6pm, text them again at 8am','Add a 3-day check-in after the call',
    'Email a recap once the diagnostic is done'];
  return '<div class="ask"><div class="askbox">'+
    '<textarea id="askin" rows="2" placeholder="Describe the change — &ldquo;if they go quiet for two days, send one more text&rdquo;">'+esc(askText)+'</textarea>'+
    '<div class="askrow"><span class="lbl">Changes this journey</span>'+
    '<button class="sendbtn" id="asksend"'+(askText.trim()?'':' disabled')+'>Make the change</button></div>'+
    (askErr?'<div class="askerr">'+esc(askErr)+'</div>':'')+'</div>'+
    '<div class="egs">'+egs.map(e=>'<button class="eg">'+esc(e)+'</button>').join('')+'</div></div>';
}
function renderCanvas(){
  const j=J[active];
  let h='<div class="chead"><div class="eyebrow">Journey</div><h1>'+esc(j.name)+'</h1><p>'+esc(j.desc)+'</p></div>'+
    (sim.running?'':askHTML())+
    '<div class="rail"><div class="cap"><div class="pill"><span class="dot"></span><span class="tx">'+
    '<span class="lb">Starts when</span><span class="tt">'+esc(j.start)+'</span></span></div></div>'+
    chainHTML(j.nodes,[])+
    '<div class="cap end"><div class="pill"><span class="dot"></span><span class="tx">'+
    '<span class="lb">Ends when</span><span class="tt">'+esc(j.end)+'</span></span></div></div></div>';
  if(pending){
    const c=pending.added.length,u=pending.changed.length;
    h+='<div class="bar"><div class="bartop"><span class="what"><b>'+esc(pending.summary)+'</b> '+
      (c?c+' new step'+(c>1?'s':''):'')+(c&&u?', ':'')+(u?u+' changed':'')+
      ' — highlighted above. Nothing is saved until you keep it.</span>'+
      '<span class="btns"><button class="ab" id="reject">Throw it away</button>'+
      '<button class="ab p" id="accept">Keep it</button></span></div></div>';
  } else if(dirty&&!sim.running){
    const imp=impact();
    h+='<div class="bar"><div class="bartop"><span class="what"><b>'+dirty+' change'+(dirty>1?'s':'')+
      ' not applied.</b> Applying writes them into the code and updates everything downstream.</span>'+
      '<span class="btns"><button class="ab" id="discard">Discard</button>'+
      '<button class="ab p" id="applybar">Apply to code</button></span></div>'+
      (imp.length?'<div class="impact">'+imp.map(g=>'<span class="ii"><b>'+esc(g[0])+'</b>'+esc(g[1])+'</span>').join('')+'</div>':'')+'</div>';
  }
  document.getElementById('canvas').innerHTML=h;
  wireCanvas();
}
function impact(){
  const seen={};
  const walk=l=>l.forEach(n=>{(n.touches||[]).forEach(([k,v])=>{(seen[k]=seen[k]||new Set()).add(v)});
    if(n.branches)n.branches.forEach(b=>walk(b.nodes))});
  walk(J[active].nodes);
  return Object.entries(seen).map(([k,v])=>[k+'s touched',[...v].slice(0,2).join(', ')+(v.size>2?' +'+(v.size-2)+' more':'')]);
}
const F={
  txt:(l,k,v,h)=>'<div class="fld"><label>'+l+'</label><input value="'+esc(v)+'" data-k="'+k+'">'+(h?'<div class="hint">'+h+'</div>':'')+'</div>',
  area:(l,k,v,h)=>'<div class="fld"><label>'+l+'</label><textarea data-k="'+k+'">'+esc(v)+'</textarea>'+(h?'<div class="hint">'+h+'</div>':'')+'</div>',
  sel:(l,k,v,o,h)=>'<div class="fld"><label>'+l+'</label><select data-k="'+k+'">'+
    o.map(x=>'<option'+(x===v?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(x)+'</option>').join('')+'</select>'+(h?'<div class="hint">'+h+'</div>':'')+'</div>'
};
function stepHTML(){
  if(!selId||!findNode(selId)) return '<div class="eyebrow">Nothing selected</div><div class="empty">'+
    'Type what you want changed in the box on the canvas and it gets built — copy written, timing set, wired in.<br><br>'+
    'Or click any step to change it by hand, and use <b>+</b> on the line between steps to add one.</div>';
  const n=findNode(selId).node,c=n.cfg||{};
  let body='';
  switch(n.type){
    case 'sms': body=F.area('What it says','body',c.body,'Use double braces like {{first_name}} to fill in from their file. The opt-out line has to stay.')+
      F.sel('When it goes out','delay',c.delay,DELAYS); break;
    case 'email': body=F.txt('Subject','subject',c.subject)+F.area('What it says','body',c.body)+
      F.sel('When it goes out','delay',c.delay,['instant','after 1 hour','after 1 day','after 2 days']); break;
    case 'wait': body='<div class="two">'+F.txt('How long','amount',c.amount)+F.sel('Unit','unit',c.unit,['minutes','hours','days'])+'</div>'+
      '<div class="fld"><div class="hint">Nothing moves until this runs out. A reply can still push them forward early.</div></div>'; break;
    case 'stage': body=F.sel('Move to','stage',c.stage,STAGES)+F.sel('In which pipeline','pipeline',c.pipeline,PIPES); break;
    case 'assign': body=F.sel('Which role','role',c.role,ROLES,'Goes to whoever on that role is clocked in.'); break;
    case 'handoff': body=F.sel('Who picks up','role',c.role,ROLES)+F.txt('Where they pick up','stage',c.stage); break;
    case 'agent': body=F.sel('Which agent','agent',c.agent,['UnderwriteIQ','Setter Josh','Brand Studio','Inquiry Voice','Alerts Engine'])+
      F.area('What it does','note',c.note); break;
    case 'payment': body=F.txt('Amount','amount',c.amount)+F.txt('What for','product',c.product,'Consent is always captured before a charge.'); break;
    case 'record': body=F.area('What gets saved','note',c.note); break;
    case 'condition': body=F.txt('What to check','field',c.field)+
      F.sel('Test','op',c.op,['is true','is false','is set','is empty','= funding','= optimization'])+
      '<div class="fld"><div class="hint">Two paths open below this step. Add steps to either one.</div></div>'; break;
  }
  const t=n.touches||[];
  return '<div class="eyebrow">Step</div><div class="ptitle">'+esc(n.title)+'</div>'+
    '<div class="pmeta">'+esc(TYPES[n.type].k)+'</div>'+F.txt('Step name','title',n.title)+body+
    '<div class="pactions"><button class="pa" data-mv="-1">Move up</button>'+
      '<button class="pa" data-mv="1">Move down</button><button class="pa del" data-del="1">Delete</button></div>'+
    '<div class="touch"><div class="th">Changing this also affects</div>'+
      (t.length? t.map(([k,v])=>'<div class="ti"><span class="k">'+esc(k)+'</span><span class="v">'+esc(v)+'</span></div>').join('')
        : '<div class="none">Nothing else depends on this step.</div>')+'</div>'+
    '<div class="stepask"><div class="fld"><label>Change just this step</label>'+
      '<textarea id="sprompt" placeholder="Make it shorter and move it two hours later"></textarea></div>'+
      '<button class="gobtn" id="sgo">Make the change</button>'+
      '<button class="gobtn" id="runhere" style="background:transparent;color:var(--gray);border:1px solid var(--line)">Run from here</button></div>';
}
function simHTML(){
  let h='<div class="eyebrow">Simulate</div>'+
    /* NOTHING IS SENT (walkthrough-4 defect 15, 2026-09-06). startSim() is a
       timer on this page with no network call, so the two "go to" boxes did
       nothing and the report said "Messages sent 4 · Everything went to <your
       phone>" while nothing left the browser. The boxes are gone and every
       line says the truth: the run plays here and sends nothing. */
    '<div class="testbanner"><b>Test mode — nothing is sent.</b> This run plays on this screen only. '+
    'No text or email leaves Fundhub, and a simulated run can never reach a real client record.</div>'+
    '<div class="fld"><label>At a question</label><select data-sim="mode">'+
      [['first','Take the first path'],['second','Take the second path'],['both','Run both paths']]
        .map(([v,l])=>'<option value="'+v+'"'+(sim.mode===v?' selected':'')+'>'+l+'</option>').join('')+
      '</select><div class="hint">Fake client: '+esc(FAKE.first_name+' '+FAKE.last_name+', '+FAKE.company)+'</div></div>'+
    '<div class="runctl">'+
      (sim.running? '<button class="gobtn" id="simstop" style="background:transparent;color:var(--gray);border:1px solid var(--line)">Stop</button>'
        : '<button class="gobtn" id="simstart">Run the journey</button>')+
    '</div>';
  if(sim.feed.length){
    h+='<div class="runstat">'+(sim.running?'<span class="sp"></span>Running':'Run finished')+'</div><div class="feed">';
    sim.feed.forEach(m=>{
      if(m.t==='sms') h+='<div class="msg sms"><div class="mh2"><span>Text</span><span>'+m.time+'</span></div>'+
        esc(m.body)+'<div class="to">not sent · '+esc(m.step)+'</div></div>';
      else if(m.t==='email') h+='<div class="msg email"><div class="mh2"><span>Email</span><span>'+m.time+'</span></div>'+
        '<div class="subj">'+esc(m.subj)+'</div>'+esc(m.body)+'<div class="to">not sent · '+esc(m.step)+'</div></div>';

  if(sim.report){
    h+='<div class="report"><div class="rh">Run report</div>'+

      '<div class="rrow"><span>Messages drafted (not sent)</span><span class="v">'+sim.report.messages+'</span></div>'+
      '<div class="rrow"><span>Steps not reached</span><span class="v">'+sim.report.unreached+'</span></div>'+
      '<div class="rrow"><span>Sent to anyone</span><span class="v">No — test mode</span></div></div>';
  }
  return h;
}
function histHTML(){
  let h='<div class="eyebrow">History</div>';
  h+='<div class="sect"><div class="sh">Saved versions</div>';
  if(!versions.length) h+='<div class="empty">No versions yet. Press <b>Save version</b> up top to keep a named copy '+
    'of this journey you can come back to.</div>';
  else versions.forEach(v=>{ h+='<div class="li"><div class="lt"><span class="wt" style="font-weight:500">'+esc(v.name)+'</span>'+
    '<span class="when">'+esc(v.ts)+'</span></div>'+
    '<div class="wt" style="color:var(--gray)">'+esc(J[v.journey].name)+' · '+v.steps+' steps</div>'+
    '<button class="rv" data-ver="'+v.id+'">Roll back to this</button></div>'; });
  h+='</div>';
  h+='<div class="sect"><div class="sh">Every change</div>';
  if(!log.length) h+='<div class="empty">Nothing changed yet.</div>';
  else log.forEach(e=>{ h+='<div class="li'+(e.reverted?' reverted':'')+'"><div class="lt">'+
    '<span class="who'+(e.actor==='claude'?' ai':'')+'">'+(e.actor==='claude'?'Claude':'You')+' · '+esc(J[e.journey].name)+'</span>'+
    '<span class="when">'+esc(e.ts)+'</span></div><div class="wt">'+esc(e.what)+'</div>'+
    (e.reverted?'<button class="rv" disabled>Reverted</button>':'<button class="rv" data-rev="'+e.id+'">Put it back</button>')+
    '</div>'; });
  h+='</div>';
  return h;
}
function renderPanel(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.ptab').forEach(t=>t.setAttribute('aria-selected',t.dataset.tab===tab));
  const el=document.getElementById('pbody');
  el.innerHTML = tab==='step'? stepHTML() : tab==='sim'? simHTML() : histHTML();
  if(tab==='step'&&selId&&findNode(selId)){
    el.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach(i=>i.oninput=()=>setCfg(selId,i.dataset.k,i.value));
    el.querySelectorAll('[data-mv]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>moveNode(selId,+b.dataset.mv));
    const d=el.querySelector('[data-del]'); if(d) d.onclick=()=>delNode(selId);

function toast(html){
  document.querySelectorAll('.toast').forEach(t=>t.remove());
  const d=document.createElement('div'); d.className='toast';

/* Same check the server runs (src/journeys/copy-tags.mjs), duplicated here so a
   staff member finds out before a network round trip, not after. The server
   check is still the one that actually protects the database — this is only
   the fast path to the same answer. A naive /\{(\w+)\}/ would also match inside
   a correct {{first_name}} (the substring "{first_name}" satisfies it), so real
   double-brace tokens are stripped first and only what is left is checked. */
function singleBraceTags(s){
  if(s==null) return [];
  const stripped=String(s).replace(/\{\{\s*\w+(?:\.\w+)*\s*\}\}/g,'');
  const seen=new Set();
  for(const m of stripped.matchAll(/\{(\w+)\}/g)) seen.add(m[1]);
  return [...seen];
}
function singleBraceViolations(nodes){
  const out=[];
  const walk=list=>(list||[]).forEach(n=>{
    if(n.type==='sms'||n.type==='email'){
      ['body','subject'].forEach(f=>{ const tags=singleBraceTags(n.cfg&&n.cfg[f]);
        if(tags.length) out.push({title:n.title,field:f,tags}); });
    }
    (n.branches||[]).forEach(b=>walk(b.nodes));
  });
  walk(nodes);
  return out;
}
/* applyAll — saves every touched journey to the database via PUT /api/journeys.
   One request per touched journey; on any failure nothing is cleared, so a
   half-saved batch always shows up as still dirty rather than looking applied. */
async function applyAll(){
  if(!dirty){toast('<b>Nothing to apply.</b> Change a step first.');return}
  const keys=Object.keys(touched);
  const n=dirty, imp=impact();
  const braceProblems=[];
  keys.forEach(k=>{ const v=singleBraceViolations(J[k].nodes); if(v.length) braceProblems.push(...v.map(x=>J[k].name+' — "'+x.title+'": {'+x.tags.join('}, {')+'}')); });
  if(braceProblems.length){
    toast('<b>Fix the braces first.</b> These steps use one { } instead of two {{ }} — nothing was saved: '+esc(braceProblems.join('; '))+'.');
    return;
  }
  const btn=document.getElementById('apply'); if(btn) btn.disabled=true;
  try{
    for(const k of keys){
      const j=J[k];
      const res=await fetch('/api/journeys',{method:'PUT',credentials:'include',
        headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body:JSON.stringify({key:k,name:j.name,start:j.start,end:j.end,desc:j.desc,nodes:j.nodes})});
      const data=await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
      if(!res.ok||!data.ok){
        /* Name the steps. "Some steps are missing something" with no list is a
           dead end — the author has to guess which of forty steps it means. */
        let why=(data&&(data.message||data.error))||('HTTP '+res.status);
        if(data&&Array.isArray(data.violations)&&data.violations.length&&data.error==='steps_not_set_up'){
          why+=' '+data.violations.map(v=>'“'+(v.title||v.nodeId||'a step')+'” '+v.reason).join('; ')+'.';
        }
        throw new Error(why);
      }
    }
    keys.forEach(k=>{ SAVED[k]=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(J[k])); });
    dirty=0; touched={}; undoStack=[];
    toast('<b>Applied '+n+' change'+(n>1?'s':'')+'.</b> Saved to the database — '+
      (imp.length?imp.length+' connected area'+(imp.length>1?'s':'')+' brought in line, ':'')+
      'this is what loads next time the editor opens. Nothing is live until you deploy.');
  }catch(err){
    toast('<b>Could not save.</b> '+esc((err&&err.message)||'Try again in a moment.')+' Nothing was applied.');
  }
  if(btn) btn.disabled=false;
  render();
}

/* ── Test against the code ────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Posts to /api/journeys/run, which walks every branch of every journey with
   a throwaway client per path, fires the real events into the real workflows,
   and reports where the journey and the code disagree.

   Nothing it does survives: the whole run happens inside a transaction the
   server always rolls back, and messages go to a recording provider that
   cannot send. Safe to press. */
function runPanel(){
  let el=document.getElementById('runout');
  if(!el){ el=document.createElement('div'); el.id='runout'; document.body.appendChild(el); }
  return el;
}
function closeRun(){ const e=document.getElementById('runout'); if(e) e.remove(); }
function rowsHtml(list,empty){
  if(!list.length) return '<p class="jr-rmuted">'+empty+'</p>';
  return list.map(f=>'<div class="jr-rrow"><b>'+esc(f.journey||'')+'</b> · '+
    esc(f.nodeTitle||f.category||'')+'<span>'+esc(f.summary||'')+'</span></div>').join('');
}
/* WHAT HELD THE MESSAGES BACK.
 *
 * The server has always sent these numbers and this screen has never shown one
 * of them. That is why a run where the safety fence stopped everything looked
 * exactly like a run where the journeys send nothing at all: both showed
 * "0 messages that would send" and no explanation. They are opposite problems
 * and the owner had no way to tell them apart. */
function heldHtml(d){
  const s=d.summary, m=s.messages, out=[];
  if(m.pathsRefusedByFence){
    const why=(m.fenceRefusals&&m.fenceRefusals.length&&m.fenceRefusals[0].reason)||'';
    out.push('<div class="jr-rrow"><b>The safety fence stopped '+m.pathsRefusedByFence+
      ' path'+(m.pathsRefusedByFence===1?'':'s')+'</b><span>Nothing on '+
      (m.pathsRefusedByFence===1?'that path':'those paths')+' was handed over to be sent, '+
      'so the messages were written and then held. This is the test harness protecting real people '+
      'from a test run — it is not a fault in the journey.'+(why?' Reason given: '+esc(why):'')+'</span></div>');
  }
  if(m.blockedByGate){
    out.push('<div class="jr-rrow"><b>'+m.blockedByGate+' message'+(m.blockedByGate===1?'':'s')+
      ' held by the compliance gate</b><span>These were written and then stopped before sending. '+
      'The row exists; it just did not go out.</span></div>');
  }
  const truncated=(d.paths||[]).filter(p=>p.dispatchTruncated).length;
  if(truncated){
    out.push('<div class="jr-rrow"><b>'+truncated+' path'+(truncated===1?'':'s')+
      ' ran out of sending rounds</b><span>The run stops after a fixed number of sending rounds so a '+
      'looping message cannot spin forever. Anything still waiting was left waiting.</span></div>');
  }
  if(!out.length) return '';
  return '<h4>What held messages back</h4>'+out.join('');
}
function paintRun(d){
  const s=d.summary, el=runPanel();
  const wf=s.workflows;
  const skipped=d.journeysSkipped||[];
  const noStart=d.startEventFindings||[];
  el.innerHTML='<div class="jr-rcard">'+
    '<div class="jr-rhead"><b>Test against the code</b>'+
      '<button class="hbtn" id="runclose">Close</button></div>'+
    '<p class="jr-rlead">'+esc(d.headline)+'</p>'+
    '<div class="jr-rstats">'+
      '<span><i>'+s.walked.paths+'</i>paths walked</span>'+
      '<span><i>'+s.walked.clients+'</i>test clients</span>'+
      '<span><i>'+s.messages.wouldHaveGoneOut+'</i>messages that would send</span>'+
      '<span><i>'+wf.fired.length+'/'+wf.registered+'</i>automations reached</span>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<p class="jr-rmuted">Journeys read from: '+esc(d.journeySource)+
      '. Nothing was saved — the run was undone when it finished, and none of the events this test '+
      'fires were handed to the live automation service.</p>'+
    (skipped.length? '<h4>Rows in the table this test left out ('+skipped.length+')</h4>'+
      '<p class="jr-rmuted">These are not part of the six journeys the editor owns, so testing them '+
      'would say nothing about your automations.</p>'+
      skipped.map(x=>'<div class="jr-rrow"><b>'+esc(x.key)+'</b><span>'+esc(x.reason)+'</span></div>').join('')
      : '')+
    (noStart.length? '<h4>Journeys nothing can start ('+noStart.length+')</h4>'+
      noStart.map(x=>'<div class="jr-rrow"><b>'+esc(x.journey)+'</b><span>'+esc(x.note)+'</span></div>').join('')
      : '')+
    '<h4>The code does not do this the way the journey says ('+s.findings.broken.length+')</h4>'+
    rowsHtml(s.findings.broken,'Nothing — which on a first run usually means the check itself is not working.')+
    heldHtml(d)+
    '<h4>Could not check ('+s.findings.couldNotCheck.length+')</h4>'+
    rowsHtml(s.findings.couldNotCheck,'Everything could be checked.')+
    '<h4>Automations no journey reaches ('+wf.neverFired.length+')</h4>'+
    (wf.neverFired.length? '<p class="jr-rmuted">Each one is either code nobody uses, or a journey nobody wrote.</p>'+
      '<div class="jr-rrow"><span>'+wf.neverFired.map(w=>esc(w.id)).join(', ')+'</span></div>'
      : '<p class="jr-rmuted">Every automation is reached by some journey.</p>')+
    '<h4>Screens</h4>'+
    /* A zero here used to be ambiguous: it meant either "no journey touches
       any screen" or "the screens folder would not open". Say which. */
    (d.screensUnreadable?
      '<p class="jr-rmuted">The screens folder could not be read on this run, so no screen was checked. '+
      'This is not a count of zero — it is a count that could not be taken.</p>'
      : '<div class="jr-rrow"><span>'+s.screens.touchedAndWired.length+' touched by a journey and showing real data · '+
      s.screens.touchedAndWireframe.length+' touched but still a mock-up · '+
      s.screens.touchedByNoJourney.length+' touched by no journey</span></div>'+
    (s.screens.touchedAndWireframe.length? '<div class="jr-rrow"><span>Mock-ups a journey needs: '+
      s.screens.touchedAndWireframe.map(x=>esc(x.file)).join(', ')+'</span></div>':''))+
  '</div>';
  document.getElementById('runclose').onclick=closeRun;
}
async function runAgainstCode(){
  const btn=document.getElementById('runreal'); if(!btn||btn.disabled) return;
  btn.disabled=true; const was=btn.textContent; btn.textContent='Testing…';
  try{
    const res=await fetch('/api/journeys/run',{method:'POST',credentials:'include',
      headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({})});
    const data=await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
    if(!res.ok||!data.ok){
      const why=(data&&data.error)||('HTTP '+res.status);
      if(res.status===401||res.status===403) toast('<b>Not allowed.</b> Only an owner or admin can run this.');
      else if(res.status===503) toast('<b>The database is not reachable.</b> Nothing was run.');
      else toast('<b>Could not run.</b> '+esc(why));
      return;
    }
    paintRun(data);
  }catch(err){
    toast('<b>Could not run.</b> '+esc((err&&err.message)||'Try again in a moment.'));
  }finally{ btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent=was; }
}

/* loadJourneys — the real starting state, once it arrives. seed() paints
   instantly so the editor is never blank; whatever the server has for a
   journey key replaces the local example the moment it lands. A journey the
   server has nothing for (migration not applied yet, or never saved) keeps
   its seed example — which is exactly the "worked example" behavior the ask
   box already uses when the AI key isn't configured either. */
async function loadJourneys(){
  try{
    const res=await fetch('/api/journeys',{credentials:'include'});
    if(!res.ok) return;
    const data=await res.json();
    if(!data.ok||!data.journeys) return;
    let maxUid=0;
    const bumpPast=nodes=>nodes.forEach(n=>{
      const m=/^n(\d+)$/.exec(n.id); if(m) maxUid=Math.max(maxUid,+m[1]);
      if(n.branches) n.branches.forEach(b=>bumpPast(b.nodes));
    });
    ORDER.forEach(k=>{
      const r=data.journeys[k];
      if(r && Array.isArray(r.nodes) && r.nodes.length){
        J[k]={name:r.name||J[k].name,start:r.start||J[k].start,end:r.end||J[k].end,
          desc:r.desc||J[k].desc,nodes:r.nodes};
        SAVED[k]=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(J[k]));
        bumpPast(r.nodes);
      }
    });
    uid=Math.max(uid,maxUid+1);
    render();
  }catch(err){ /* offline, or the journeys table migration hasn't run yet — the seed examples stay on screen */ }
}
function syncHeader(){
  const d=document.getElementById('dirty');
  d.textContent=dirty?dirty+' unsaved':''; d.className='dirty'+(dirty?' on':'');
  document.getElementById('undo').disabled=!undoStack.length;
}
function render(){syncHeader();renderJList();renderCanvas();renderPanel()}

document.querySelectorAll('.ptab').forEach(t=>t.onclick=()=>{tab=t.dataset.tab;renderPanel()});
document.getElementById('undo').onclick=undo;
document.getElementById('apply').onclick=applyAll;
document.getElementById('runreal').onclick=runAgainstCode;
document.getElementById('savever').onclick=saveVersion;
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!e.target.closest('.menu')&&!e.target.closest('.add'))closeMenu()});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if((e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey)&&e.key==='z'){e.preventDefault();undo()}
  if(e.key==='Escape'){closeMenu();if(sim.running){stopSim();renderPanel()}}
});
window.addEventListener('resize',closeMenu);
render();
loadJourneys();
</script>

    <main class="fh-maxw">
      <div class="banner" id="emptyBanner">
        The lender list starts empty on purpose. Export the seven spreadsheet product tables, then Import CSV here.
      </div>

      <div class="tabs" role="tablist">
        <button class="tab on" data-tab="list" type="button">Lender list</button>
        <button class="tab" data-tab="review" type="button">Bureau mismatch queue <span id="mismatchCount"></span></button>
        <button class="tab" data-tab="bureau" type="button">AI bureau config</button>
      </div>

      <section id="tab-list">
        <div class="filters">
          <label>Product table
            <select id="fTable"><option value="">All</option></select>
          </label>
          <label>Bureau pulled
            <input id="fBureau" placeholder="EX / EQ / TU" list="bureauHints"/>
            <datalist id="bureauHints"><option value="EX"/><option value="EQ"/><option value="TU"/></datalist>
          </label>
          <label>Priority tier
            <select id="fTier"><option value="">All</option><option>1</option><option>2</option><option>3</option></select>
          </label>
          <label>Status
            <select id="fActive"><option value="">All</option><option value="true">Active</option><option value="false">Inactive</option></select>
          </label>
          <label>Eligible state
            <input id="fState" placeholder="e.g. AZ" maxlength="40"/>
          </label>
          <label>Search
            <input id="fQ" placeholder="Name…"/>
          </label>
          <button class="btn" type="button" id="btnFilter">Apply filters</button>
          <button class="btn" type="button" id="btnExport">Export CSV</button>
          <button class="btn dark" type="button" id="btnImportToggle">Import CSV</button>
          <button class="btn" type="button" id="btnAdd">Add blank row</button>

        <div class="panel">

          <div class="import-box" id="importBox">
            <p style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--gray)">Paste CSV with <code>lender_table</code> and <code>name</code>. Known columns only — extras are ignored.</p>
            <textarea id="importCsv" placeholder="lender_table,name,bureaus_pulled,priority_tier,..."></textarea>
            <div style="margin-top:8px;display:flex;gap:8px">
              <button class="btn dark" type="button" id="btnImportRun">Import now</button>
              <button class="btn" type="button" id="btnImportCancel">Cancel</button>

                  <th></th><th>Name</th><th>Table</th><th>Bureaus</th><th>Requirements</th>
                  <th>Tier</th><th>Status</th><th>State</th><th>Updated</th><th>Apply</th><th></th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody id="lenderBody"></tbody>

      <section id="tab-review" class="hide">

          When an application’s real bureau pull differs from the lender record, it lands here for the funding advisor.

                  <th>Lender</th><th>Table</th><th>Expected</th><th>Observed</th>
                  <th>Source</th><th>Client</th><th>Notes</th><th></th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody id="reviewBody"></tbody>
            </table>
            <div class="empty hide" id="reviewEmpty">No open mismatches.</div>

      <section id="tab-bureau" class="hide">

                </tr>
              </thead>

<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>
<script>
(function () {
  var TABLES = [
    "OnlineBizCC","InBranchBizCC","BizLOC_Stated","BizLOC_Documented",
    "PersonalCC","PersonalLoans","PersonalLOC"
  ];
  var sel = document.getElementById("fTable");
  TABLES.forEach(function (t) {
    var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = t; o.textContent = t; sel.appendChild(o);
  });

  function token() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; }
  }
  function headers(json) {
    var h = { accept: "application/json" };
    var t = token();
    if (t) h.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
    if (json) h["content-type"] = "application/json";
    return h;
  }
  function toast(msg) {
    var el = document.getElementById("toast");
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.classList.add("show");
    setTimeout(function () { el.classList.remove("show"); }, 2200);
  }
  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s)
      .replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g,"&quot;");
  }

  /* tabs */
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove("on"); });
      btn.classList.add("on");
      var tab = btn.getAttribute("data-tab");
      document.getElementById("tab-list").classList.toggle("hide", tab !== "list");
      document.getElementById("tab-review").classList.toggle("hide", tab !== "review");
      document.getElementById("tab-bureau").classList.toggle("hide", tab !== "bureau");
      if (tab === "review") loadReview();
      if (tab === "bureau") loadBureau();
    });
  });

  function filterQuery() {
    var p = new URLSearchParams();
    var table = document.getElementById("fTable").value;
    var bureau = document.getElementById("fBureau").value.trim();
    var tier = document.getElementById("fTier").value;
    var active = document.getElementById("fActive").value;
    var state = document.getElementById("fState").value.trim();
    var q = document.getElementById("fQ").value.trim();
    if (table) p.set("lender_table", table);
    if (bureau) p.set("bureau", bureau);
    if (tier) p.set("priority_tier", tier);
    if (active) p.set("active", active);
    if (state) p.set("state", state);
    if (q) p.set("q", q);
    return p;
  }

  var rows = [];
  var scopedClientId = (new URLSearchParams(location.search)).get("client_id") || "";
  if (scopedClientId) {
    var applyBanner = document.createElement("div");
    applyBanner.className = "banner";
    applyBanner.id = "applyClientBanner";
    applyBanner.appendChild(document.createTextNode("Client-scoped Apply · "));
    var code = document.createElement("code");
    code.textContent = scopedClientId;
    applyBanner.appendChild(code);
    applyBanner.appendChild(document.createTextNode(". Click Apply to check a nearby exit. The bank page opens the safe way only if the Fundhub Proxy add-on is on. If the add-on is off, Apply will not open the bank page — do not open the bank link from this computer."));
    var emptyBanner = document.getElementById("emptyBanner");
    if (emptyBanner && emptyBanner.parentNode) emptyBanner.parentNode.insertBefore(applyBanner, emptyBanner);
  }

  function render() {
    var body = document.getElementById("lenderBody");
    body.innerHTML = "";
    document.getElementById("lenderEmpty").classList.toggle("hide", rows.length > 0);
    document.getElementById("emptyBanner").style.display = rows.length ? "none" : "block";
    document.getElementById("listMeta").textContent = rows.length
      ? (scopedClientId
          ? rows.length + " fit"
          : rows.length + " lender" + (rows.length === 1 ? "" : "s"))
      : (scopedClientId ? "No lenders fit this file" : "Empty — import from the spreadsheet");
    rows.forEach(function (L) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.dataset.id = L.id;
      tr.innerHTML =
        '<td><img class="lender-logo" src="' + esc(L.logo_path || "/assets/lenders/placeholder.svg") +
          '" alt="" width="28" height="28" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src=\'/assets/lenders/placeholder.svg\'"/></td>' +
        '<td><input data-f="name" value="' + esc(L.name) + '"/></td>' +
        '<td><select data-f="lender_table">' + TABLES.map(function (t) {
          return '<option value="' + t + '"' + (t === L.lender_table ? " selected" : "") + ">" + t + "</option>";
        }).join("") + "</select></td>" +
        '<td><input data-f="bureaus_pulled" value="' + esc(L.bureaus_pulled) + '" placeholder="EX/EQ/TU"/></td>' +
        '<td><input data-f="stated_requirements" value="' + esc(L.stated_requirements) + '"/></td>' +
        '<td><select data-f="priority_tier">' +
          [ "", "1", "2", "3" ].map(function (t) {
            return '<option value="' + t + '"' + (String(L.priority_tier || "") === t ? " selected" : "") + ">" +
              (t || "—") + "</option>";
          }).join("") + "</select></td>" +
        '<td><select data-f="active">' +
          '<option value="true"' + (L.active !== false ? " selected" : "") + ">Active</option>" +
          '<option value="false"' + (L.active === false ? " selected" : "") + ">Inactive</option>" +
        "</select></td>" +
        '<td><input data-f="eligible_states" value="' + esc(L.eligible_states) + '"/></td>' +
        '<td style="white-space:nowrap;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray)">' +
          esc(L.last_updated_by || "—") + "<br/>" + esc(L.last_updated_date || "") + "</td>" +
        '<td class="apply-cell"></td>' +
        '<td><button class="btn sm save-btn" type="button">Save</button></td>';
      body.appendChild(tr);
      tr.querySelectorAll("input,select").forEach(function (el) {
        el.addEventListener("change", function () { el.classList.add("dirty"); });
        el.addEventListener("input", function () { el.classList.add("dirty"); });
      });
      tr.querySelector(".save-btn").addEventListener("click", function () { saveRow(tr); });
      var applyCell = tr.querySelector(".apply-cell");
      if (scopedClientId && L.application_url && window.FHProxyApply) {
        var ab = document.createElement("button");
        ab.type = "button";
        ab.className = "btn sm dark";
        ab.textContent = "Apply";
        ab.setAttribute("data-fh-apply", "1");
        ab.setAttribute("data-client-id", scopedClientId);
        ab.setAttribute("data-lender-id", L.id);
        ab.setAttribute("data-lender-name", L.name || "Lender");
        ab.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
          ev.preventDefault();
          window.FHProxyApply.applyToLender({
            clientId: scopedClientId,
            lenderId: L.id,
            lenderName: L.name || "Lender"
          });
        });
        applyCell.appendChild(ab);
      } else if (scopedClientId && !L.application_url) {
        applyCell.textContent = "No URL";
        applyCell.style.color = "var(--gray)";
        applyCell.style.fontSize = "11px";
      } else {
        applyCell.textContent = "—";
        applyCell.style.color = "var(--gray2)";
      }
    });
  }

  function saveRow(tr) {
    var id = tr.dataset.id;
    var patch = {};
    tr.querySelectorAll("[data-f]").forEach(function (el) {
      var k = el.getAttribute("data-f");
      var v = el.value;
      if (k === "active") v = v === "true";
      if (k === "priority_tier") v = v === "" ? null : Number(v);
      patch[k] = v === "" ? null : v;
    });
    fetch("/api/lenders", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: headers(true),
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "save", id: id, patch: patch })
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      if (!d.ok) { toast(d.message || d.error || "Save failed"); return; }
      toast("Saved");
      var i = rows.findIndex(function (x) { return x.id === id; });
      if (i >= 0) rows[i] = d.lender;
      render();
    }).catch(function () { toast("Save failed"); });
  }

  function loadList() {
    document.getElementById("listMeta").textContent = "Loading…";
    if (scopedClientId) {
      var mp = new URLSearchParams();
      mp.set("client_id", scopedClientId);
      var matchTable = document.getElementById("fTable").value;
      if (matchTable) mp.set("lender_table", matchTable);
      fetch("/api/read/lender-matches?" + mp.toString(), { headers: headers() })
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (d) {
          if (!d.ok) { toast(d.message || d.error || "Load failed"); rows = []; render(); return; }
          rows = d.matches || [];
          render();
        })
        .catch(function () {
          rows = [];
          render();
          document.getElementById("listMeta").textContent = "Could not load (sign in?)";
        });
      return;
    }
    var p = filterQuery();
    fetch("/api/read/lenders?" + p.toString(), { headers: headers() })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        if (!d.ok) { toast(d.message || d.error || "Load failed"); rows = []; render(); return; }
        rows = d.lenders || [];
        render();
      })
      .catch(function () {
        rows = [];
        render();
        document.getElementById("listMeta").textContent = "Could not load (sign in?)";
      });
  }

  function loadReview() {
    fetch("/api/read/lender-observations?mismatch_only=true&review_status=pending", { headers: headers() })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        var list = (d && d.observations) || [];
        document.getElementById("mismatchCount").textContent = list.length ? "(" + list.length + ")" : "";
        document.getElementById("reviewMeta").textContent = list.length + " open";
        var body = document.getElementById("reviewBody");
        body.innerHTML = "";
        document.getElementById("reviewEmpty").classList.toggle("hide", list.length > 0);
        list.forEach(function (O) {
          var tr = document.createElement("tr");
          tr.innerHTML =
            "<td>" + esc(O.lender_name) + "</td>" +
            "<td>" + esc(O.lender_table) + "</td>" +
            "<td>" + esc(O.expected_bureaus_raw) + "</td>" +
            '<td class="mismatch">' + esc(O.observed_bureau) + "</td>" +
            "<td>" + esc(O.observation_source) + "</td>" +
            "<td style=\"font-family:var(--mono);font-size:var(--fs-caption)\">" + esc(O.client_id) + "</td>" +
            "<td>" + esc(O.notes) + "</td>" +
            '<td style="white-space:nowrap">' +
              '<button class="btn sm" data-act="confirmed" type="button">Confirm</button> ' +
              '<button class="btn sm" data-act="corrected" type="button">Corrected</button> ' +
              '<button class="btn sm" data-act="dismissed" type="button">Dismiss</button>' +
            "</td>";
          body.appendChild(tr);
          tr.querySelectorAll("button[data-act]").forEach(function (btn) {
            btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
              fetch("/api/lender-observations", {
                method: "POST",
                headers: headers(true),
                body: JSON.stringify({ action: "review", id: O.id, review_status: btn.getAttribute("data-act") })
              }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d2) {
                if (!d2.ok) { toast(d2.error || "Review failed"); return; }
                toast("Updated");
                loadReview();
              });
            });
          });
        });
      })
      .catch(function () {
        document.getElementById("reviewMeta").textContent = "Could not load";
      });
  }

  document.getElementById("btnFilter").addEventListener("click", loadList);
  document.getElementById("btnExport").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var p = filterQuery();
    p.set("format", "csv");
    fetch("/api/read/lenders?" + p.toString(), { headers: headers() })
      .then(function (r) { return r.text(); })
      .then(function (csv) {
        var blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" });
        var a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        a.download = "lenders.csv";
        a.click();
      });
  });
  document.getElementById("btnImportToggle").addEventListener("click", function () {
    document.getElementById("importBox").classList.toggle("on");
  });
  document.getElementById("btnImportCancel").addEventListener("click", function () {
    document.getElementById("importBox").classList.remove("on");
  });
  document.getElementById("btnImportRun").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var csv = document.getElementById("importCsv").value;
    fetch("/api/lenders", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: headers(true),
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "import", csv: csv })
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      var el = document.getElementById("importResult");
      if (!d.ok) { el.textContent = d.message || d.error || "Import failed"; return; }
      el.textContent = "Imported " + d.imported + ", updated " + d.updated +
        (d.errors && d.errors.length ? " · " + d.errors.length + " issues" : "");
      if (d.errors && d.errors.length) el.textContent += "\n" + d.errors.slice(0, 8).join("\n");
      toast("Import done");
      loadList();
    });
  });
  document.getElementById("btnAdd").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var table = document.getElementById("fTable").value || "OnlineBizCC";
    var name = window.prompt("Lender name (required — must be a real lender you are adding)");
    if (!name || !name.trim()) return;
    fetch("/api/lenders", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: headers(true),
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "create", lender_table: table, name: name.trim(), active: true })
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      if (!d.ok) { toast(d.message || d.error || "Create failed"); return; }
      toast("Added");
      loadList();
    });
  });

  // clock
  (function tick() {
    var el = document.getElementById("clock");
    // Same header clock every other screen shows ("Mon, Aug 17, 2:15 AM EDT"),
    // not the browser's local numeric one ("8/16/2026, 11:15:52 PM"). Same
    // moment, one wording, and the zone is named so a west-coast browser does
    // not read an east-coast operation's clock as its own.
    if (el) el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", {
      weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric",
      hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit",
      timeZone: "America/Phoenix", timeZoneName: "short"
    });
    setTimeout(tick, 1000);
  })();

  var bureauRows = [];

  function renderBureau() {
    var body = document.getElementById("bureauBody");
    body.innerHTML = "";
    document.getElementById("bureauEmpty").classList.toggle("hide", bureauRows.length > 0);
    bureauRows.forEach(function (B) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.dataset.id = B.id || "";
      tr.innerHTML =
        '<td><input data-f="bureau_code" value="' + esc(B.bureau_code) + '" maxlength="8"/></td>' +
        '<td><input data-f="bureau_name" value="' + esc(B.bureau_name) + '"/></td>' +
        '<td><input data-f="service_number" value="' + esc(B.service_number) + '" placeholder="+1…"/></td>' +
        '<td><input data-f="ivr_version" value="' + esc(B.ivr_version) + '"/></td>' +
        '<td><input data-f="menu_path" value="' + esc(B.menu_path) + '"/></td>' +
        '<td><input data-f="expected_hold_minutes" value="' + esc(B.expected_hold_minutes) + '" style="width:70px"/></td>' +
        '<td><select data-f="active">' +
          '<option value="true"' + (B.active !== false ? " selected" : "") + '>Yes</option>' +
          '<option value="false"' + (B.active === false ? " selected" : "") + '>No</option>' +
        "</select></td>" +
        '<td><button class="btn sm save-bureau" type="button">Save</button></td>';
      body.appendChild(tr);
      tr.querySelector(".save-bureau").addEventListener("click", function () {
        var patch = {};
        tr.querySelectorAll("[data-f]").forEach(function (el) {
          var k = el.getAttribute("data-f");
          var v = el.value;
          if (k === "active") v = v === "true";
          if (k === "expected_hold_minutes") v = v === "" ? null : Number(v);
          patch[k] = v === "" ? null : v;
        });
        var payload = B.id
          ? { action: "save", id: B.id, patch: patch }
          : Object.assign({ action: "upsert" }, patch);
        fetch("/api/ai-bureau-config", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: headers(true),
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
          if (!d.ok) { toast(d.message || d.error || "Save failed"); return; }
          toast("Saved");
          loadBureau();
        });
      });
    });
  }

  function loadBureau() {
    fetch("/api/read/ai-bureau-config", { headers: headers() })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        bureauRows = (d && d.configs) || [];
        renderBureau();
      })
      .catch(function () {
        bureauRows = [];
        renderBureau();
      });
  }

  document.getElementById("btnAddBureau").addEventListener("click", function () {
    bureauRows.push({
      bureau_code: "",
      bureau_name: "",
      service_number: "",
      ivr_version: "",
      menu_path: "",
      expected_hold_minutes: null,
      active: true
    });
    renderBureau();
  });

  loadList();
  loadReview();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
/* The demo-zone disclosure. The sidebar wiring that used to sit alongside it
   here — burger, scrim, .navhead, and forcing .mini below 860px — is gone:
   shell.js replaces the whole <aside> on mount, so listeners bound to the
   markup this file ships died with the element they were attached to, and the
   forced .mini fought the off-canvas drawer shell.js now owns. This is the
   only part of the old block that ever did anything. */
(function(){
  var demoToggle=document.getElementById('demoToggle'),
      demoBody=document.getElementById('demoBody'),
      demozone=document.getElementById('demozone');
  if(!demoToggle) return;
  demoToggle.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var open=demoBody.hasAttribute('hidden');
    if(open){demoBody.removeAttribute('hidden');}else{demoBody.setAttribute('hidden','');}
    demozone.classList.toggle('open',open);
    demoToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'true':'false');
  });
})();

</script>
