<script>
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   THE STAFF REPLY INBOX

   Three reads and one write, and no sample data anywhere in the page:

     GET  /api/read/inbox                        the conversation list
     GET  /api/read/messages?conversation_id=    one thread
     GET  /api/read/conversations?client_id=     that client's other threads
     POST /api/messages                          send a reply

   WHAT THIS SCREEN WILL NOT DO. It will not render a thread it did not read,
   it will not show a client fact no endpoint answered, and it will not report
   an accepted message as a delivered one. Every one of those was in the page
   it replaces, as markup with nothing behind it.

   The view model below is separated out between FH-INBOX markers because it is
   the part with rules in it — what a row says, which count is which, and what
   each send outcome means in plain words — and src/http/messaging-screen.test.mjs
   loads exactly that block and drives it. The DOM wiring underneath is the part
   a test cannot usefully reach without a browser, so it is kept as thin as it
   can be: fetch, hand to the view model, put the string in an element.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* FH-INBOX-BEGIN */
(function (root) {
  "use strict";

  function esc(v) {
    return String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c];
    });
  }

  /* A person's initials for the avatar. Falls back to a dash rather than to a
     letter we made up: an avatar reading "A" for somebody whose name we do not
     have is a small lie that looks like data. */
  function initials(row) {
    var a = String((row && row.first_name) || "").trim();
    var b = String((row && row.last_name) || "").trim();
    var s = (a ? a[0] : "") + (b ? b[0] : "");
    return s ? s.toUpperCase() : "—";
  }

  /* The name on the row. A client with no name on file is "Unnamed client",
     which is honest and searchable, rather than a blank line. */
  function displayName(row) {
    var s = [(row && row.first_name) || "", (row && row.last_name) || ""]
      .join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    return s || "Unnamed client";
  }

  /* How long ago, coarsely. Coarse on purpose: an inbox is scanned, and
     "2d" answers the question "is this stale" faster than a timestamp does.
     `nowMs` is an argument so this is testable without waiting. */
  function shortWhen(iso, nowMs) {
    if (!iso) return "";
    var then = new Date(iso).getTime();
    if (!isFinite(then)) return "";
    var secs = Math.floor(((nowMs == null ? Date.now() : nowMs) - then) / 1000);
    if (secs < 0) secs = 0;
    if (secs < 60) return "now";
    var mins = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    if (mins < 60) return mins + "m";
    var hrs = Math.floor(mins / 60);
    if (hrs < 24) return hrs + "h";
    /* Arizona, not UTC. A message sent at 6pm here is already tomorrow in UTC,
       so anything sent after 5pm was dated a day late — on the one line whose
       entire job is saying which day it was. */
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "America/Phoenix" });
  }

  /* "Last activity" in the side panel (hole N16, 2026-09-18). It used to be
     shortWhen() + " ago", which read "never ago" when the row carried no time,
     "now ago" inside a minute, and "Sep 17 ago" after a day. It is a sentence
     now: "12m ago" / "Just now" under a day, the Arizona date and time after
     (UI-STANDARDS §7), and "No messages yet" only when there is truly no time. */
  function lastActivity(iso, nowMs) {
    var w = shortWhen(iso, nowMs);
    if (!w) return "No messages yet";
    if (w === "now") return "Just now";
    if (/^\d+[mh]$/.test(w)) return w + " ago";
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleString("en-US", {
      month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "America/Phoenix"
    });
  }

  /* EMAILS ARE STORED AS THE WHOLE HTML PAGE WE SENT (hole N16). Escaping that
     put "<!DOCTYPE html> <html lang=…" in the bubble and in the list preview.
     So an email that is HTML is turned into its readable text first: the head,
     styles and scripts are dropped, paragraphs and line breaks become new
     lines, every other tag is removed and entities are decoded. The result is
     STILL escaped before it reaches the page, so nothing in an email can ever
     run or render as markup here — the tag stripping is for reading, the
     escaping is what keeps it safe. A text message is left exactly as it is:
     "I <3 you" is not HTML. */
  var HTML_TAG = /<\s*(!doctype|html|head|body|table|tbody|tr|td|p|div|br|span|a|img|meta|style|center|font|h[1-6]|ul|ol|li|strong|em|b|i)\b[^>]*>/i;
  var NAMED = { amp: "&", lt: "<", gt: ">", quot: '"', apos: "'", nbsp: " ", mdash: "—", ndash: "–",
                hellip: "…", rsquo: "’", lsquo: "‘", rdquo: "”", ldquo: "“", bull: "•", middot: "·", copy: "©" };

  function looksLikeHtmlEmail(body, channel) {
    return String(channel || "").toLowerCase() === "email" && HTML_TAG.test(String(body == null ? "" : body));
  }

  function emailText(html) {
    var s = String(html == null ? "" : html)
      .replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, " ")
      .replace(/<(head|style|script|title|noscript|template|svg|iframe|object)\b[\s\S]*?<\/\1\s*>/gi, " ")
      .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
      .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, "\n")
      .replace(/<\/(p|h[1-6]|blockquote)\s*>/gi, "\n\n")
      .replace(/<\/(div|tr|li|table|ul|ol)\s*>/gi, "\n")
      .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, "")
      .replace(/&(#x[0-9a-f]+|#\d+|[a-z]+);/gi, function (m, name) {
        if (name.charAt(0) === "#") {
          var code = /^#x/i.test(name) ? parseInt(name.slice(2), 16) : parseInt(name.slice(1), 10);
          return code > 0 && code <= 0x10FFFF ? String.fromCodePoint(code) : m;
        }
        var k = name.toLowerCase();
        return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(NAMED, k) ? NAMED[k] : m;
      });
    return s.split("\n").map(function (line) { return line.replace(/[ \t\u00a0]+/g, " ").trim(); })
      .join("\n").replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
  }

  /* The one-line preview. A thread with no messages says so rather than
     rendering an empty quote — a conversation row can exist before any message
     lands on it, and a blank line reads as a rendering bug. */
  function previewOf(row) {
    var body = row && row.last_body;
    if (body == null || String(body).trim() === "") return "No messages on this thread yet.";
    if (looksLikeHtmlEmail(body, row.channel)) {
      return emailText(body).replace(/\s*\n+\s*/g, " ") || "An email with no text in it.";
    }
    return String(body);
  }

  /* The two tab counts. `needs_reply` comes from the server (see
     api/read/inbox.mjs) and is null on a thread with no messages — null is not
     false and is not counted either way. */
  function countsFor(items) {
    var rows = items || [];
    var reply = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) if (rows[i] && rows[i].needs_reply === true) reply++;
    return { all: rows.length, reply: reply };
  }

  /* Client-side search over what is already loaded. Deliberately NOT a server
     query: the list is one page of threads, and a search box that silently
     searches only the loaded page while looking like it searches everything is
     worse than one that plainly filters what is on screen. */
  function matches(row, term) {
    var q = String(term || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return true;
    return (displayName(row) + " " + previewOf(row) + " " + ((row && row.channel) || ""))
      .toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
  }

  /* THE TAB IS NO LONGER FILTERED HERE. It is `?needs_reply=1` on the server —
     see api/read/inbox.mjs. Filtering it in the browser meant "Needs reply"
     showed the unanswered threads among the page that happened to be loaded,
     while looking like it showed all of them, and the oldest unanswered
     message is exactly the one that would be missing.

     The `filter` option is still accepted and still applied, because the rows
     handed in are already the right set and re-checking them is free — but it
     is now a consistency check rather than the mechanism. */
  /* A SEARCH IS NOT A TAB, and this is the half of hole 15 the data fix does
     not reach. The screen opens on "Needs reply". Every message the system
     sends is outbound, so a client we have only ever texted is never on that
     tab — and somebody typing their name into a box that says "Search people
     and messages" got "Nothing matches what you typed" about a person the
     company had messaged three times. The box now means what it says: while
     there is a term, it looks at every thread. Empty it and the tab is back in
     charge, unchanged. */
  function filterRows(items, opts) {
    var o = opts || {};
    var searching = String(o.q || "").trim() !== "";
    return (items || []).filter(function (r) {
      if (!searching && o.filter === "reply" && r.needs_reply !== true) return false;
      return matches(r, o.q);
    });
  }

  /* What the search box is actually searching, said out loud.

     The search filters the rows that are LOADED, which is one page. At fifty
     threads that is everything and the distinction is meaningless. At fifty
     thousand it is not, and a box that silently searches 2% of the data while
     looking like it searches all of it will have somebody swear a customer
     never messaged them. So the screen says which it is doing. */
  function searchScopeNote(loaded, hasMore, term, filter) {
    if (!String(term || "").trim()) return "";
    var everyone = filter === "reply" ? "Searching everyone, not just Needs reply." : "";
    if (!hasMore) return everyone;
    return ("Searching the " + loaded + " most recent conversations only. " + everyone).trim();
  }

  /* One row of the conversation list. `unread` is the needs-a-reply marker —
     the class name is the stylesheet's, the meaning is stated on the row. */
  function conversationRow(row, opts) {
    var o = opts || {};
    var waiting = row.needs_reply === true;
    return '<div class="convo' + (waiting ? " unread" : "") + (o.active ? " active" : "") +
      '" role="option" aria-selected="' + (o.active ? "true" : "false") +
      '" data-id="' + esc(row.id) + '" tabindex="0">' +
      '<div class="av client">' + esc(initials(row)) + "</div>" +
      '<div class="cv-body">' +
        '<div class="cv-top"><span class="cv-name">' + esc(displayName(row)) + "</span>" +
        '<span class="cv-time">' + esc(shortWhen(row.last_at || row.last_pulse_at, o.now)) + "</span></div>" +
        '<div class="cv-prev">' + esc(previewOf(row)) + "</div>" +
        '<div class="cv-meta">' +
          '<span class="ch-tag">' + esc(String(row.channel || "").toUpperCase()) + "</span>" +
          (waiting ? '<span class="who-tag client">Waiting on us</span>' : "") +
        "</div>" +
      "</div>" +
      (waiting ? '<span class="unread-dot"></span>' : "") +
      "</div>";
  }

  /* One message. Direction decides the side and the bubble; `sender_name`
     decides the name. A message with no sender_name and direction outbound was
     queued by a workflow, not by a person — it is labelled "Automatic" rather
     than being attributed to whoever happens to be looking at the screen. */
  /* It left the building. `sent` means the provider accepted it; `delivered`
     means their server confirmed it arrived. Neither is a problem and neither
     gets an error block. They are kept as separate values rather than collapsed
     because accepted is not delivered — that distinction is the whole reason
     the delivery webhook exists. */
  var LANDED = ["sent", "delivered"];

  function messageRow(msg, opts) {
    var o = opts || {};
    var inbound = msg.direction === "inbound";
    var who = inbound ? (o.clientName || "Them")
                      : (msg.sender_name || "Automatic");
    /* WHICH OUTBOUND STATUSES ARE A PROBLEM. This used to read
       `msg.status !== "sent"`, which painted a red error block on ANY other
       value — including `delivered`, which is the best outcome there is. The
       Mailgun delivery path already writes `delivered` and `complained` today,
       so a successfully delivered message was being shown to staff as "Not
       sent yet". Landed states are listed, not inferred. */
    var held = !inbound && msg.status && LANDED.indexOf(msg.status) === -1;
    return '<div class="msg' + (inbound ? "" : " out") + '" data-id="' + esc(msg.id) + '">' +
      '<div class="av ' + (inbound ? "client" : (msg.sender_name ? "human" : "agent")) + '">' +
        esc(inbound ? (o.clientInitials || "—") : (msg.sender_name ? initialsFromName(msg.sender_name) : "SYS")) +
      "</div>" +
      '<div class="msg-col">' +
        '<div class="msg-sender">' +
          '<span class="ch-pill">' + esc(String(msg.channel || "").toUpperCase()) + "</span>" +
          '<span class="nm">' + esc(who) + "</span>" +
          (!inbound && !msg.sender_name ? '<span class="agent-tag">Automatic</span>' : "") +
        "</div>" +
        '<div class="bubble ' + (inbound ? "in" : (msg.sender_name ? "out-human" : "out-agent")) + '">' +
          (msg.subject ? '<div class="email-subj">' + esc(msg.subject) + "</div>" : "") +
          (looksLikeHtmlEmail(msg.rendered_body, msg.channel)
            ? esc(emailText(msg.rendered_body)).replace(/\n/g, "<br>")
            : esc(msg.rendered_body == null ? "" : msg.rendered_body)) +
        "</div>" +
        '<div class="msg-time">' + esc(shortWhen(msg.created_at, o.now)) + "</div>" +
        /* A held or failed message says so ON the message. This is the one
           place a staff member finds out their reply did not go, and burying
           it in a toast that has already gone is how somebody assumes it did. */
        (held ? '<div class="msg-error"><b>' + esc(statusWord(msg.status)) + "</b>" +
                (msg.blocked_reason ? " — " + esc(msg.blocked_reason) : "") +
                (msg.last_error ? " — " + esc(msg.last_error) : "") + "</div>" : "") +
      "</div></div>";
  }

  function initialsFromName(name) {
    var parts = String(name || "").trim().split(/\s+/);
    var s = (parts[0] ? parts[0][0] : "") + (parts[1] ? parts[1][0] : "");
    return s ? s.toUpperCase() : "—";
  }

  /* QUIET HOURS, ON SCREEN, BEFORE ANYBODY TYPES.
     Texts are not sent between 8pm and 8am Arizona time (TCPA). The rule was
     already enforced at send time; nothing said it beforehand, so the first a
     staff member knew of it was a reply that did not go. The owner asked for
     the warning up front — people forget a rule they have never been told.

     These mirror QUIET_START_HOUR / QUIET_END_HOUR / QUIET_HOURS_TZ in
     src/messaging/gate.mjs. src/http/messaging-screen.test.mjs reads the gate's
     own constants and fails if these drift from them, so the screen cannot end
     up promising a window the server does not honour. */
  var QUIET_START_HOUR = 20;
  var QUIET_END_HOUR = 8;
  var QUIET_TZ = "America/Phoenix";

  /* The hour right now in Arizona. Intl carries the timezone database, so the
     zone is looked up rather than hardcoded as an offset — the same reason the
     server reads it out of Intl. Arizona never shifts for daylight saving, so
     this answer is stable all year; that is the point of naming it. */
  function hourInZone(nowMs) {
    try {
      var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
        timeZone: QUIET_TZ, hour: "numeric", hour12: false
      }).formatToParts(new Date(nowMs == null ? Date.now() : nowMs));
      for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        if (parts[i].type === "hour") return Number(parts[i].value) % 24;
      }
    } catch (e) { /* no Intl, or an unknown zone */ }
    return null;
  }

  /* The window wraps midnight, so this is an OR rather than start <= h < end.
     Returns null when the hour could not be read — and the caller treats null
     as "do not claim anything", because a warning that guesses is worse than
     no warning. */
  function inQuietHours(nowMs) {
    var h = hourInZone(nowMs);
    if (h == null) return null;
    return h >= QUIET_START_HOUR || h < QUIET_END_HOUR;
  }

  /* The line under the compose box. Three states, and they are three different
     sentences on purpose:
       email          the rule does not apply; say nothing about it
       sms, open      state the rule, so it is not a surprise at 11pm
       sms, closed    say plainly that this will NOT go out now, and when it will */
  function quietNotice(channel, nowMs) {
    if (channel !== "sms") return { closed: false, text: "" };
    var closed = inQuietHours(nowMs);
    if (closed === null) return { closed: false, text: "" };
    if (closed) {
      return { closed: true, text:
        "Texting hours are closed. Anything you send now is saved and goes out " +
        "automatically at 8:00am Arizona time — you do not need to send it again." };
    }
    return { closed: false, text:
      "Texting hours: 8:00am to 8:00pm Arizona time. Outside those hours a text is " +
      "held and sent the next morning." };
  }

  function statusWord(status) {
    if (status === "blocked") return "Not sent — the compliance check stopped it";
    if (status === "failed") return "Not sent";
    if (status === "queued") return "Waiting to go out";
    if (status === "sending") return "Going out now";
    if (status === "bounced") return "Not delivered — their mail server rejected it";
    if (status === "rejected") return "Not sent — the address was refused";
    if (status === "complained") return "Delivered, but they marked it as spam";
    if (status === "undelivered") return "Sent, but it did not arrive";
    return "Not sent yet";
  }

  /* What the send actually did, in words. THE POINT OF THIS FUNCTION IS THAT
     "accepted" IS NOT "delivered". Each of these is a different thing to tell a
     person, and collapsing them into "sent" or "failed" would either make
     somebody retype a message that is already queued, or let them believe a
     blocked one went out. The vocabulary is the dispatcher's own — see OUTCOME
     in src/messaging/dispatch.mjs. */
  function outcomeMessage(outcome, detail) {
    switch (outcome) {
      case "sent":       return { tone: "ok",   text: "Sent." };
      /* THE SAME SENTENCE AS quietNotice's closed state, word for word. Two
         wordings for one rule is how somebody ends up believing they are two
         different rules — and the browser test that compares them is what
         caught this drifting the first time. */
      case "deferred":   return { tone: "hold", text: "Saved. It goes out automatically at 8:00am " +
                                                       "Arizona time — you do not need to send it again." };
      case "blocked":    return { tone: "stop", text: "Not sent. The compliance check stopped it" +
                                                       (detail && detail.length ? " (" + [].concat(detail).join(", ") + ")" : "") + "." };
      case "no_route":   return { tone: "stop", text: "Not sent. No text or email provider is set up for your company yet." };
      case "no_address": return { tone: "stop", text: "Not sent. We do not have a phone number or email address for this person." };
      case "retry":      return { tone: "hold", text: "Not sent yet. The provider did not answer, so it is queued to try again." };
      case "gave_up":
      case "rejected":   return { tone: "stop", text: "Not sent. The provider refused it." };
      case "channel_mismatch":
      case "unknown_provider":
        return { tone: "stop", text: "Not sent. The provider set up for this channel cannot carry it." };
      case "not_claimable":
        return { tone: "hold", text: "Saved, but it could not be sent right now. It stays in the queue." };
      default:
        return { tone: "hold", text: "Saved. We could not tell what happened next — check the message in the thread." };
    }
  }

  /* addressLooksRight — is what is in the destination box sendable?
     PURE, and inside the markers, so the test harness can drive it without a
     browser. The shapes are the same ones src/messaging/compose.mjs enforces on
     the server, so the box never says yes to something the send will refuse.
     The server checks again regardless — this is here to tell somebody before
     they write three paragraphs, not instead of the real check. */
  var ADDRESS_SHAPE = {
    email: /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/,
    sms: /^\+[1-9]\d{7,14}$/
  };

  function addressLooksRight(channel, value) {
    var v = String(value == null ? "" : value).trim();
    if (!v) {
      return { ok: false, empty: true, text: channel === "email"
        ? "We have no email address for this person. Type one to send."
        : "We have no phone number for this person. Type one to send." };
    }
    var shape = ADDRESS_SHAPE[channel];
    if (!shape) return { ok: false, empty: false, text: "This channel cannot be addressed by hand." };
    if (!shape.test(v)) {
      return { ok: false, empty: false, text: channel === "email"
        ? "That does not look like an email address."
        : "Use the full number with the country code, like +15551234567." };
    }
    return { ok: true, empty: false, text: "" };
  }

  root.FHInbox = {
    esc: esc,
    addressLooksRight: addressLooksRight,
    initials: initials,
    initialsFromName: initialsFromName,
    displayName: displayName,
    shortWhen: shortWhen,
    lastActivity: lastActivity,
    looksLikeHtmlEmail: looksLikeHtmlEmail,
    emailText: emailText,
    previewOf: previewOf,
    countsFor: countsFor,
    filterRows: filterRows,
    searchScopeNote: searchScopeNote,
    conversationRow: conversationRow,
    messageRow: messageRow,
    statusWord: statusWord,
    outcomeMessage: outcomeMessage,
    hourInZone: hourInZone,
    inQuietHours: inQuietHours,
    quietNotice: quietNotice,
    QUIET_START_HOUR: QUIET_START_HOUR,
    QUIET_END_HOUR: QUIET_END_HOUR
  };
})(window);
/* FH-INBOX-END */

(function () {
  "use strict";

  var V = window.FHInbox;
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };

  var state = { rows: [], hasMore: false, selected: null, filter: "reply", q: "", sending: false };

  /* How often the inbox re-reads itself while somebody is sitting on it.

     WITHOUT THIS THE SCREEN IS A SNAPSHOT. A staff member with the inbox open
     would never see a message arrive — it would sit unanswered until they
     happened to reload the page. For a screen whose entire job is "what came
     in", that is the difference between an inbox and a report.

     Thirty seconds: fast enough that a customer's text shows up while somebody
     is looking at the screen, slow enough that a room of ten staff is twenty
     requests a minute rather than six hundred. It skips a tick while a send is
     in flight so a refresh cannot land between pressing Send and the reply
     appearing. */
  var REFRESH_MS = 30000;

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------- the list ---- */

  function paintList() {
    var shown = V.filterRows(state.rows, { filter: state.filter, q: state.q });
    var counts = V.countsFor(state.rows);
    $("nAll").textContent = counts.all;
    $("nReply").textContent = counts.reply;

    var scope = V.searchScopeNote(state.rows.length, state.hasMore, state.q, state.filter);
    var scopeHtml = scope
      ? '<div class="search-scope">' + V.esc(scope) + "</div>"
      : "";

    if (!shown.length) {
      $("convoList").innerHTML = scopeHtml +
        '<div class="empty-box" id="convoEmpty" style="margin:14px 12px;">' +
        (state.rows.length
          ? (state.filter === "reply" && !String(state.q || "").trim()
              ? "Nothing here needs a reply."
              : "Nothing matches what you typed.")
          : (state.filter === "reply"
              ? "Nothing is waiting on a reply. Everything has been answered."
              : "No conversations yet. One appears here the moment a client texts or emails you.")) +
        "</div>";
      return;
    }
    var now = Date.now();
    $("convoList").innerHTML = scopeHtml + shown.map(function (r) {
      return V.conversationRow(r, { active: state.selected && r.id === state.selected.id, now: now });
    }).join("");
  }

  function loadList(opts) {
    var quiet = opts && opts.quiet;
    /* The tab is a SERVER-SIDE filter now. See searchScopeNote and the header of
       api/read/inbox.mjs for why it stopped being a browser-side one. */
    var params = { limit: 200 };
    /* The tab narrows the query — unless somebody is searching. See filterRows:
       a search looks at every thread, so asking the server for only the
       unanswered ones would hide the very person being searched for. */
    if (state.filter === "reply" && !String(state.q || "").trim()) params.needs_reply = 1;

    return FHData.inbox(params).then(function (res) {
      if (!res.ok) {
        /* A FAILED BACKGROUND REFRESH LEAVES THE SCREEN ALONE. Blanking a
           working inbox because one poll missed would take the thread somebody
           is mid-reply to off the screen. The banner still reports it. */
        if (quiet) { FHData.explain(res, "conversations"); return; }
        state.rows = [];
        $("convoList").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-box" style="margin:14px 12px;">' +
          "We could not load your conversations. See the message at the bottom of the screen." + "</div>";
        FHData.explain(res, "conversations");
        return;
      }
      state.hasMore = res.data.hasMore === true;
      state.rows = res.data.items || [];
      FHData.banner("real", state.rows.length
        ? "live conversations"
        : "connected · no conversations in the database yet", "conversations");
      paintList();
      // Keep the open thread selected across a refresh; if it is gone, drop it.
      if (state.selected) {
        var still = state.rows.filter(function (r) { return r.id === state.selected.id; })[0];
        if (still) state.selected = still; else clearThread();
      }
    });
  }

  /* -------------------------------------------------------- the thread ---- */

  function clearThread() {
    state.selected = null;
    $("thName").textContent = "No conversation open";
    $("thSub").textContent = "Pick one on the left to read it.";
    $("thAv").textContent = "—";
    $("thread").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-box">Pick a conversation on the left to read it.</div>';
    $("footName").textContent = "none open";
    paintChannelToggle(null);
    paintQuietNote(null);
    $("composeBody").disabled = true;
    $("composeBody").value = "";
    $("composeBody").placeholder = "Pick a conversation first";
    $("composeTo").disabled = true;
    $("composeTo").value = "";
    $("composeTo").placeholder = "Pick a conversation first";
    $("composeToNote").hidden = true;
    $("sendBtn").disabled = true;
    paintContext(null);
  }

  /* Repaint the note under the destination box and decide whether Send can be
     pressed. Called when a thread opens, when the client's record arrives, and
     on every keystroke — the sender should never press Send only to be told
     the address was wrong.

     AN EMPTY BOX DOES NOT DISABLE SEND, and that is deliberate. The first
     version of this gated Send on the box being filled, which quietly coupled
     sending to a completely separate read: the box is prefilled from the client
     record, so a slow or failed client fetch left Send dead with nothing the
     person could do about it. That is a worse bug than the one this box was
     added to fix. Empty means "use the address on their record", exactly as it
     always did — the note still warns when there is none, and if there really
     is no address the dispatcher gives the same honest answer it always has.

     A FILLED BUT MALFORMED box DOES disable Send: there the person has said
     where to send, and it cannot work. */
  function paintTo() {
    var row = state.selected;
    if (!row) return;
    var verdict = V.addressLooksRight(row.channel === "email" ? "email" : "sms", $("composeTo").value);
    var note = $("composeToNote");
    note.hidden = verdict.ok;
    note.textContent = verdict.text;
    note.className = "to-note" + (verdict.ok || verdict.empty ? "" : " bad");
    $("sendBtn").disabled = (!verdict.ok && !verdict.empty) || state.sending;
  }

  /* The texting-hours line. Repainted on every thread open AND on a slow timer,
     because a browser left open across 11pm must not still be showing "texting
     hours are open" at midnight. */
  function paintQuietNote(channel) {
    var el = $("quietNote");
    var notice = V.quietNotice(channel, Date.now());
    if (!notice.text) { el.hidden = true; el.textContent = ""; el.className = "quiet-note"; return; }
    el.hidden = false;
    el.textContent = notice.text;
    el.className = "quiet-note" + (notice.closed ? " closed" : "");
  }

  /* Email / Text toggle. One conversation per channel. Switching does not
     change the send channel on the open thread — it opens (or starts) the
     other conversation for the same person. */
  function paintChannelToggle(channel) {
    var wrap = $("composeChannelToggle");
    if (!channel || (channel !== "email" && channel !== "sms")) {
      wrap.hidden = true;
      $("chEmail").classList.remove("active");
      $("chText").classList.remove("active");
      $("chEmail").disabled = true;
      $("chText").disabled = true;
      return;
    }
    wrap.hidden = false;
    $("chEmail").disabled = false;
    $("chText").disabled = false;
    $("chEmail").classList.toggle("active", channel === "email");
    $("chText").classList.toggle("active", channel === "sms");
  }

  function openEmptyChannel(row) {
    state.selected = row;
    paintList();
    $("thName").textContent = V.displayName(row);
    $("thSub").textContent = (row.channel === "email" ? "EMAIL" : "SMS") + " · no thread yet";
    $("thAv").textContent = V.initials(row);
    $("footName").textContent = V.displayName(row);
    paintChannelToggle(row.channel);
    paintQuietNote(row.channel);
    $("composeBody").disabled = false;
    $("composeBody").value = "";
    $("composeBody").placeholder = "Write to " + V.displayName(row) + "…";
    $("composeTo").disabled = false;
    $("composeTo").value = "";
    $("composeTo").placeholder = row.channel === "email"
      ? "name@example.com" : "+15551234567";
    paintTo();
    $("thread").innerHTML = row.channel === "email"
      ? '<div class="empty-box">No emails with them yet. Your reply below would be the first.</div>'
      : '<div class="empty-box">No texts with them yet. Your reply below would be the first.</div>';
    paintContext(row);
  }

  function switchChannel(channel) {
    var row = state.selected;
    if (!row || !row.client_id) return;
    if (channel !== "email" && channel !== "sms") return;
    if ((row.channel === "email" ? "email" : "sms") === channel && row.id) {
      paintChannelToggle(channel);
      return;
    }
    if (state.sending) return;

    $("thread").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-box">Opening ' +
      (channel === "email" ? "email" : "text") + " conversation…</div>";
    paintChannelToggle(channel);

    return FHData.conversations({ client_id: row.client_id, limit: 50 }).then(function (res) {
      if (!state.selected || state.selected.client_id !== row.client_id) return;
      var items = (res.ok && res.data && res.data.items) || [];
      var match = items.filter(function (t) {
        return String(t.channel || "").toLowerCase() === channel;
      })[0];
      if (match) {
        openThread({
          id: match.id,
          client_id: row.client_id,
          channel: match.channel,
          first_name: row.first_name,
          last_name: row.last_name,
          needs_reply: match.needs_reply === true,
          last_at: match.last_at || match.last_pulse_at,
          last_pulse_at: match.last_pulse_at
        });
        return;
      }
      openEmptyChannel({
        id: null,
        client_id: row.client_id,
        channel: channel,
        first_name: row.first_name,
        last_name: row.last_name,
        needs_reply: false
      });
    });
  }

  function openThread(row) {
    state.selected = row;
    paintList();

    $("thName").textContent = V.displayName(row);
    $("thSub").textContent = String(row.channel || "").toUpperCase() + " · " +
      (row.needs_reply === true ? "waiting on a reply from us" : "no reply owed");
    $("thAv").textContent = V.initials(row);
    $("footName").textContent = V.displayName(row);
    paintChannelToggle(row.channel === "email" ? "email" : "sms");
    paintQuietNote(row.channel);
    $("composeBody").disabled = false;
    $("composeBody").placeholder = "Write a message…";
    /* The box opens empty and disabled-looking until the person's record
       answers. It is filled in by paintContext below, from the SAME client read
       the right rail already makes — a second call for the same fact would be
       a second thing to keep in step. */
    $("composeTo").disabled = false;
    $("composeTo").value = "";
    $("composeTo").placeholder = row.channel === "email"
      ? "name@example.com" : "+15551234567";
    paintTo();
    $("thread").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-box">Loading this conversation…</div>';

    paintContext(row);

    if (!row.id) {
      $("thread").innerHTML = row.channel === "email"
        ? '<div class="empty-box">No emails with them yet. Your reply below would be the first.</div>'
        : '<div class="empty-box">No texts with them yet. Your reply below would be the first.</div>';
      return Promise.resolve();
    }

    return FHData.thread(row.id, 200).then(function (res) {
      if (state.selected !== row) return; // they moved on while this was in flight
      if (!res.ok) {
        $("thread").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-box">We could not load this conversation.</div>';
        if (!(row.last_at || row.last_pulse_at) && $("ctxLast")) $("ctxLast").textContent = "Not known";
        FHData.explain(res, "this conversation");
        return;
      }
      paintThread(res.data.items || []);
    });
  }

  function paintThread(items) {
    var row = state.selected;
    /* The row had no time (see paintContext): the newest message is the truth.
       The endpoint answers newest-first, so that is items[0]. */
    if (row && !(row.last_at || row.last_pulse_at)) {
      row.last_at = items.length ? items[0].created_at : null;
      if ($("ctxLast")) $("ctxLast").textContent = V.lastActivity(row.last_at, Date.now());
    }
    if (!items.length) {
      $("thread").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-box">Nothing has been said on this thread yet. ' +
        "Your reply below would be the first message.</div>";
      return;
    }
    // The endpoint answers newest-first so `?limit=` returns the END of a long
    // history. Reading order is the other way round.
    var ordered = items.slice().reverse();
    var now = Date.now();
    var opts = { clientName: V.displayName(row), clientInitials: V.initials(row), now: now };
    $("thread").innerHTML = ordered.map(function (m) { return V.messageRow(m, opts); }).join("");
    $("thread").scrollTop = $("thread").scrollHeight;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- the context ---- */

  function paintContext(row) {
    if (!row) {
      $("ctxRole").textContent = "Pick a conversation to see who it is with.";
      $("ctxRows").innerHTML = "";
      $("ctxThreads").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-box">Pick a conversation first.</div>';
      $("ctxLinks").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-box">Pick a conversation first.</div>';
      return;
    }
    $("ctxRole").textContent = "Talking to us on " + String(row.channel || "").toLowerCase() + ".";
    /* A thread opened with no time on it (a ?conversation_id= link older than
       the loaded list) says "Loading…" until paintThread reads its newest
       message — not "No messages yet" for a second, which would be untrue. */
    var when = row.last_at || row.last_pulse_at;
    $("ctxRows").innerHTML =
      '<div class="ctx-row"><span class="k">Last activity</span><span class="v" id="ctxLast">' +
        V.esc(when || !row.id ? V.lastActivity(when, Date.now()) : "Loading…") + "</span></div>" +
      '<div class="ctx-row"><span class="k">Waiting on us</span><span class="v">' +
        (row.needs_reply === true ? "yes" : "no") + "</span></div>";
    if (row.client_id && FHData.client) {
      FHData.client(row.client_id).then(function (res) {
        if (state.selected !== row) return;
        var cl = (res && res.ok && res.data && res.data.client) || {};
        var extra = "";
        if (cl.email) extra += '<div class="ctx-row"><span class="k">Email</span><span class="v">' + V.esc(cl.email) + "</span></div>";
        if (extra) $("ctxRows").insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", extra);
        /* Fill the destination box from their file. Only if nobody has typed
           over it — a late-arriving read must not wipe what somebody is in the
           middle of writing. */
        if (!$("composeTo").value) {
          $("composeTo").value = (row.channel === "email" ? cl.email : cl.phone) || "";
          paintTo();
        }
      });
    }

    $("ctxLinks").innerHTML =
      '<a class="link-btn" href="client-control-panel.html?id=' + encodeURIComponent(row.client_id) +
      '">Their file <span class="ar">&#8599;</span></a>';

    $("ctxThreads").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-box">Loading&hellip;</div>';
    FHData.conversations({ client_id: row.client_id, limit: 50 }).then(function (res) {
      if (state.selected !== row) return;
      if (!res.ok) {
        $("ctxThreads").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-box">We could not load their other threads.</div>';
        return;
      }
      var others = (res.data.items || []).filter(function (c) { return c.id !== row.id; });
      if (!others.length) {
        $("ctxThreads").innerHTML = '<div class="empty-box">This is the only thread with them.</div>';
        return;
      }
      $("ctxThreads").innerHTML = '<div class="ctx-card">' + others.map(function (c) {
        return '<div class="ctx-row"><span class="k">' + V.esc(String(c.channel).toUpperCase()) +
          '</span><span class="v">' + V.esc(V.shortWhen(c.last_pulse_at, Date.now()) || "quiet") + "</span></div>";
      }).join("") + "</div>";
    });
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------- sending ---- */

  function say(text, tone) {
    var el = $("sendStatus");
    el.textContent = text;
    el.style.color = tone === "stop" ? "var(--alert)" : (tone === "hold" ? "var(--warn)" : "var(--text-dim)");
  }

  function send() {
    var row = state.selected;
    var body = $("composeBody").value;
    if (!row || state.sending || !String(body).trim()) return;

    state.sending = true;
    $("sendBtn").disabled = true;
    say("Sending…", "hold");

    /* An idempotency key per attempt. If the request is retried by the network
       — or the button is somehow hit twice — the server returns the message it
       already has instead of sending a second one. Regenerated only when a send
       genuinely completes, so a retry of THIS attempt carries THIS key. */
    var key = state.sendKey || (state.sendKey = "inbox-" + row.id + "-" + Date.now() + "-" +
      Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10));

    var payload = { body: body, idempotency_key: key };
    /* Where this one goes. Sent only when there is something in the box, so a
       send with nothing typed behaves exactly as it always did and the client
       record answers. The server validates it again and records it on the
       message row — it is never written back to the person's record. */
    var to = String(($("composeTo") && $("composeTo").value) || "").trim();
    if (to) payload.to = to;
    if (row.id) payload.conversation_id = row.id;
    else {
      payload.client_id = row.client_id;
      payload.channel = row.channel || "sms";
    }
    FHData.sendMessage(payload)
      .then(function (res) {
        state.sending = false;
        // Through paintTo rather than straight to false: if the destination box
        // is empty or malformed, Send has to stay off.
        paintTo();
        if (!res.ok) {
          // A 403 here is very often "you are not clocked in", which is a thing
          // the person can fix in ten seconds — so it must not read as an outage.
          say(res.source === "unauthorized"
            ? "Not sent. You need to be signed in and clocked in to send a message."
            : "Not sent. " + (res.error || "The request was refused."), "stop");
          return;
        }
        state.sendKey = null;
        var verdict = V.outcomeMessage(res.data.deduped ? "sent" : res.data.outcome, res.data.detail);
        say(verdict.text, verdict.tone);
        // Only clear the box on an outcome where retyping would be wrong. On a
        // hard stop the words stay put so they can be edited rather than lost.
        if (verdict.tone !== "stop") $("composeBody").value = "";
        openThread(row);
        loadList();
      });
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ wiring ---- */

  $("convoList").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var el = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest(".convo") : null;
    if (!el) return;
    var row = state.rows.filter(function (r) { return r.id === el.getAttribute("data-id"); })[0];
    if (row) openThread(row);
  });

  $("q").addEventListener("input", function (e) {
    var was = String(state.q || "").trim() !== "";
    state.q = e.target.value;
    var now = String(state.q || "").trim() !== "";
    paintList();
    // Crossing empty↔typed changes the SERVER query on the Needs-reply tab —
    // see loadList. Only then, so a keystroke is not a request.
    if (was !== now && state.filter === "reply") loadList({ quiet: true });
  });

  [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".ctab")).forEach(function (tab) {
    tab.addEventListener("click", function () {
      [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".ctab")).forEach(function (t) { t.classList.remove("active"); });
      tab.classList.add("active");
      state.filter = tab.getAttribute("data-filter");
      // Refetch: the tab is a server-side filter, so switching it is a new
      // question, not a different view of the same answer.
      loadList();
    });
  });

  $("sendBtn").addEventListener("click", send);
  $("chEmail").addEventListener("click", function () { switchChannel("email"); });
  $("chText").addEventListener("click", function () { switchChannel("sms"); });
  // Repaint on every keystroke, so a bad address is caught before anything is
  // written rather than after Send is pressed.
  $("composeTo").addEventListener("input", paintTo);
  $("composeBody").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    // Enter sends, Shift+Enter is a new line — the convention every messaging
    // app already taught everyone.
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); send(); }
  });

  /* ── keeping the screen current ──────────────────────────────────────────
     Two timers, both cheap, both doing something a static page cannot:

       the inbox     re-read every REFRESH_MS so a message that arrives while
                     somebody is looking at the screen actually appears
       the notice    the texting-hours line must change by itself at 11pm and
                     11am; a browser left open overnight would otherwise still
                     be telling somebody the window is open at 2am

     The inbox refresh SKIPS a tick while a send is in flight, and never
     disturbs the open thread — openThread() is not re-run, so a half-typed
     reply and the scroll position both survive. */
  setInterval(function () {
    if (state.sending) return;
    if (document.hidden) return;   // a background tab is not a person looking
    loadList({ quiet: true });
  }, REFRESH_MS);

  setInterval(function () {
    paintQuietNote(state.selected ? state.selected.channel : null);
  }, 60000);

  // data.js carries `defer` (see its tag above), so FHData does not exist yet
  // while this script is being parsed — the first inbox read here threw, and
  // the throw killed the rest of this function before the conversation list
  // was ever requested. Every deferred script runs before DOMContentLoaded, so
  // the first read waits for that event. The deep-link handling below stays
  // inside it, because it only runs once that first read has come back.
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  clearThread();
  loadList().then(function () {
    var UUID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    /* Deep link from the pipeline phone/email: open that person's thread. */
    var deepClient = FHData.param("client_id");
    var deepChannel = String(FHData.param("channel") || "").toLowerCase();
    if (deepChannel !== "email" && deepChannel !== "sms") deepChannel = "";
    if (deepClient && UUID_RE.test(String(deepClient).trim())) {
      return Promise.all([
        FHData.conversations({ client_id: deepClient, limit: 50 }),
        FHData.client(deepClient)
      ]).then(function (pair) {
        var items = (pair[0].ok && pair[0].data && pair[0].data.items) || [];
        var cl = (pair[1].ok && pair[1].data && pair[1].data.client) || {};
        var sms = items.filter(function (t) { return /sms|text/i.test(String(t.channel || "")); })[0];
        var email = items.filter(function (t) { return String(t.channel || "") === "email"; })[0];
        var pick = deepChannel === "email" ? (email || null)
          : deepChannel === "sms" ? (sms || null)
          : (sms || items[0] || null);
        var row = {
          id: pick ? pick.id : null,
          client_id: deepClient,
          channel: (pick && pick.channel) || deepChannel || "sms",
          first_name: cl.first_name || null,
          last_name: cl.last_name || null,
          needs_reply: false,
          /* Without this the side panel read "Last activity: never ago" on
             every pipeline link (hole N16). */
          last_pulse_at: (pick && pick.last_pulse_at) || null
        };
        if (row.id) {
          openThread(row);
          return;
        }
        openEmptyChannel(row);
      });
    }
    /* Deep link from global search: ?conversation_id=<uuid> opens that thread.
       If it is not in the loaded page (older than the newest 200), open a
       stub row so the thread endpoint still runs — the list stays honest. */
    var deepId = FHData.param("conversation_id");
    if (!deepId) return;
    if (!UUID_RE.test(String(deepId).trim())) return;
    var found = state.rows.filter(function (r) { return r.id === deepId; })[0];
    if (found) {
      openThread(found);
      return;
    }
    openThread({
      id: deepId,
      client_id: null,
      channel: "",
      first_name: null,
      last_name: null,
      needs_reply: false
    });
  });
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
function tickClock() {
  var el = document.querySelector(".clock");
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", {
    weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit",
    timeZone: "America/Phoenix", timeZoneName: "short"
  });
}
tickClock();
setInterval(tickClock, 1000);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">

/* File protection alerts — FinanceOS.sections.alerts (money-alerts.js).
   Every rule is under .fh-alerts, and the file carries every rule the section
   needs (card, grid, type roles, buttons, the switch, forms, skeleton), so it can
   sit inside the combined FinanceOS page — or any page with .app on a wrapper —
   without borrowing from its neighbours or reaching them.

   brand whitelist — h1/h2 20px, .big 32px, body 16px, and 13px for .caption,
   .eyebrow, .tag, .badge and label. Phone: one column, and the page never
   scrolls sideways (UI-STANDARDS §11). */

<!-- ══ YOUR FUNDING PAPERS — THE APPLICATION DOCUMENT VAULT ═══════════════════
     Capital Blueprint launch unit B3, the screen (ops/workflows/blueprint-launch-2026-10-06.md,
     map item 15). Offer: "The agent collects bank statements, tax returns and ID
     ahead of time, so the file is complete when the closer calls."

     Reads ONE endpoint, GET /api/money/vault (shape: docs/finance/document-vault.md).
     A client sends each paper through the EXISTING upload endpoint,
     POST /api/documents-upload, with the exact fields the line carries. Staff
     (owner, admin, sales manager) also accept or reject each file and add a paper
     the standard list lacks (POST /api/money/vault).

     CLIENT-FACING, SO NO shell.js — same reason as money.html. The gate is the
     endpoint: a client session only gets its own file; staff need ?client_id=.

     THIN SHELL. The section itself is FinanceOS.sections.vault in money-vault.js
     (styles in money-vault.css, all under .fh-vault), so the combined FinanceOS
     page can mount it with one stylesheet link and one script tag. This page only
     adds the header, the money nav and the frame. The header is money-accounts.html's
     dark bar; the nav is the single row that scrolls inside itself on a phone
     (money-declines.html), so the page never scrolls sideways (UI-STANDARDS §11).

     .app on the wrapper so fundhub-brand.css sizes type to the four tokens.
     No px font sizes anywhere (UI-STANDARDS §12.7). -->

    if (text != null) n.textContent = String(text);
    return n;
  }
  function add(parent) {
    for (var i = 1; i < arguments.length; i++) if (arguments[i]) parent.appendChild(arguments[i]);
    return parent;
  }
  function clear(n) { while (n.firstChild) n.removeChild(n.firstChild); }

  function showMessage(text) {
    clear(root);
    var col = el("div", "col");
    add(root, add(col, el("p", "gone", text)));
  }
  function showBadLink() { showMessage(BAD_LINK); }
  function showLater() { showMessage(LATER); }

  /* ---------- formatting ---------- */
  /* Same rule as money() in src/ops/morning-brief.mjs: integer cents in,
     "$1,234.56" out, "unknown" when there is no number. A value that is not a
     whole number of cents is not guessed at; it is "unknown" too. */
  function money(cents) {
    if (cents == null || cents === "") return "unknown";
    var n = Number(cents);
    if (!Number.isInteger(n)) return "unknown";
    var neg = n < 0;
    var abs = Math.abs(n);
    var whole = Math.floor(abs / 100);
    var frac = String(abs % 100);
    if (frac.length < 2) frac = "0" + frac;
    return (neg ? "-" : "") + "$" + whole.toLocaleString("en-US") + "." + frac;
  }
  function count(v) {
    if (v == null || v === "") return "unknown";
    var n = Number(v);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n.toLocaleString("en-US") : "unknown";
  }
  function isNum(v) { return v != null && v !== "" && Number.isFinite(Number(v)); }
  function plural(n, one, many) { return Number(n) === 1 ? one : many; }
  function obj(v) { return v && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v) ? v : null; }
  function arr(v) { return Array.isArray(v) ? v : null; }
  function str(v) { return typeof v === "string" && v.trim() ? v.trim() : null; }

  var MONTHS = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July",
    "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
  var DAYS = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"];
  function dayParts(ymd) {
    var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(ymd || "");
    if (!m) return null;
    var d = new Date(Date.UTC(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]));
    if (d.getUTCFullYear() !== +m[1] || d.getUTCMonth() !== +m[2] - 1 || d.getUTCDate() !== +m[3]) return null;
    return d;
  }
  function longDay(d) { return DAYS[d.getUTCDay()] + ", " + MONTHS[d.getUTCMonth()] + " " + d.getUTCDate(); }
  function dayBefore(d) { return new Date(d.getTime() - 86400000); }

  /* ---------- section frame ---------- */
  var sectionN = 0;
  function section(title) {
    var id = "s" + (++sectionN);
    var s = el("section", "card");
    s.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", id);
    var h = el("h2", null, title);
    h.id = id;
    s.appendChild(h);
    return s;
  }
  function tile(label, value, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    var t = el("div", "tile" + (opts.wide ? " wide" : "") + (opts.tone ? " is-" + opts.tone : ""));
    add(t, el("span", "lb", label), el("span", "big" + (opts.word ? " word" : ""), value));
    return t;
  }
  function plain(text) { return el("p", "plain", text); }
  function note(text) { return el("p", "note", text); }

  /* ---------- 1. systems ---------- */
  var REDS_SHOWN = 5;
  function renderSystems(sys) {
    var s = section("Systems");
    if (!obj(sys) || sys.status !== "ok" || !isNum(sys.total)) {
      add(s, plain(str(sys && sys.line) || (obj(sys) ? "Systems: the morning check did not run, so nothing was checked." : "Systems: could not be read.")));
      return s;
    }
    var red = Number(sys.red) || 0;
    var notProved = Number(sys.not_proved) || 0;
    var notChecked = Number(sys.not_checked) || 0;
    var tiles = el("div", "tiles");
    add(tiles,
      tile("Broken", count(red), { tone: red ? "red" : null }),
      tile("Not proved", count(notProved)),
      tile("Green", count(sys.green), { tone: "green" }),
      tile("Not checked", count(notChecked)));
    add(s, tiles);
    var from = /^Systems, (from this morning's check(?: at \d{1,2}:\d{2}\s?[AP]M)?):/.exec(str(sys.line) || "");
    var lead = "Out of " + count(sys.total) + " checks.";
    if (from) lead += " " + from[1].charAt(0).toUpperCase() + from[1].slice(1) + ".";
    add(s, note(lead));
    if (!red && !notProved && !notChecked) add(s, el("p", "row-line", "Nothing needs you."));

    var reds = arr(sys.reds) || [];
    if (reds.length) {
      var list = el("ul", "list");
      list.setAttribute("aria-label", "Broken checks");
      reds.forEach(function (c, i) {
        c = obj(c) || {};
        var li = el("li", "red-item");
        if (i >= REDS_SHOWN) li.hidden = true;
        var title = el("p", "row-title");
        var day = isNum(c.day_count) && Number(c.day_count) > 1 ? "Broken · day " + count(c.day_count) : "Broken";
        add(title, el("span", "tag red", day), el("span", "mono", str(c.id) || "unnamed check"));
        add(li, title);
        var sees = str(c.customer_sees);
        if (sees && !/^unknown/i.test(sees)) add(li, labelled("What people see: ", sees));
        if (str(c.proof)) add(li, labelled("What we saw: ", c.proof));
        add(li, labelled("Fix: ", str(c.fix) || "no fix written yet."));
        list.appendChild(li);
      });
      add(s, list);
      if (reds.length > REDS_SHOWN) {
        var btn = el("button", "more", "Show all " + reds.length + " broken checks");
        btn.type = "button";
        btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var open = btn.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true";
          Array.prototype.forEach.call(list.children, function (li, i) { if (i >= REDS_SHOWN) li.hidden = !open; });
          btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
          btn.textContent = open ? "Show only the first " + REDS_SHOWN : "Show all " + reds.length + " broken checks";
        });
        add(s, btn);
      }
    }
    return s;
  }
  function labelled(label, text) {
    var p = el("p", "row-line");
    add(p, el("b", null, label), document.createTextNode(String(text)));
    return p;
  }

  /* ---------- 2. last 24 hours ---------- */
  function c8(team, key) {
    var c = obj(team) && obj(team.company_8);
    var v = c && obj(c[key]);
    return v && isNum(v.value) ? v.value : null;
  }
  function renderLast24(team) {
    var s = section("Last 24 hours");
    if (!obj(team) || !obj(team.company_8)) {
      add(s, plain(str(team && team.company_error) || "Cash collected: unknown."));
      return s;
    }
    var cash = c8(team, "cash_cents");
    var tiles = el("div", "tiles");
    add(tiles,
      tile("Cash collected", money(cash), { wide: true }),
      tile("Files funded", count(c8(team, "funded_count"))),
      tile("Funded dollars", money(c8(team, "funded_dollars_cents")), { wide: true }));
    add(s, tiles);
    return s;
  }

  /* ---------- 3. team ---------- */
  function windowWords(kind, d) {
    if (kind === "evening") return "today so far";
    return d ? "yesterday, " + longDay(dayBefore(d)) : "yesterday";
  }
  function closeWords(sales, held) {
    if (!isNum(held) || !Number(held)) return "No calls held.";
    return count(sales) + " " + plural(sales, "sale", "sales") + " from " + count(held) + " " + plural(held, "call", "calls") + ".";
  }
  function renderTeam(team, ctx) {
    var s = section("Team");
    if (!obj(team)) { add(s, plain("Team: could not be read.")); return s; }
    add(s, el("p", "caption", "Calls " + windowWords(ctx.kind, ctx.day) + "."));
    var closers = arr(team.closers);
    if (!closers) {
      add(s, el("p", "row-line", str(team.closers_error) || "Closer calls: could not be read."));
    } else {
      var held = 0, noShows = 0, sales = 0;
      closers.forEach(function (c) {
        c = obj(c) || {};
        held += Number(c.calls_held) || 0;
        noShows += Number(c.no_shows) || 0;
        sales += Number(c.deposits) || 0;
      });
      var tiles = el("div", "tiles");
      tiles.style.marginTop = "8px";
      add(tiles, tile("Calls held", count(held)), tile("Sales", count(sales)), tile("No-shows", count(noShows)));
      add(s, tiles);
      add(s, el("p", "row-line", closeWords(sales, held)));
      if (!closers.length) {
        add(s, note("No closer logged a call."));
      } else {
        var list = el("ul", "list");
        list.setAttribute("aria-label", "Each closer");
        closers.forEach(function (c) {
          c = obj(c) || {};
          var li = el("li");
          add(li, el("p", "row-title", str(c.name) || "Name not on file"));
          add(li, el("p", "row-line",
            count(c.calls_held) + " " + plural(c.calls_held, "call", "calls") + " held, " +
            count(c.deposits) + " " + plural(c.deposits, "sale", "sales") + ", " +
            count(c.no_shows) + " " + plural(c.no_shows, "no-show", "no-shows") + "."));
          list.appendChild(li);
        });
        add(s, list);
      }
    }
    var now = el("ul", "list");
    now.setAttribute("aria-label", "Right now");
    var csm = el("li");
    add(csm, el("p", "row-title", "Right now"),
      el("p", "row-line", isNum(team.csm_overdue)
        ? count(team.csm_overdue) + " " + plural(team.csm_overdue, "task is", "tasks are") + " late for the success team."
        : (str(team.csm_error) || "Late success team tasks: unknown.")),
      el("p", "row-line", isNum(team.unrecorded_calls)
        ? count(team.unrecorded_calls) + " " + plural(team.unrecorded_calls, "call was", "calls were") + " not recorded."
        : (str(team.unrecorded_error) || "Calls not recorded: unknown.")));
    now.appendChild(csm);
    add(s, now);
    (arr(team.waiting) || []).forEach(function (w) { if (str(w)) add(s, note(w)); });
    return s;
  }

  /* ---------- 4. money ---------- */
  function renderMoney(m, ctx) {
    var s = section("Money");
    if (!obj(m) || m.status !== "ok") {
      add(s, plain(str(m && m.line) || (obj(m) && m.status === "not_connected" ? "Money: not connected yet." : "Money: could not be read.")));
      return s;
    }
    add(s, el("p", "caption", "Bank money " + windowWords(ctx.kind, ctx.day) + "."));
    var tiles = el("div", "tiles");
    tiles.style.marginTop = "8px";
    add(tiles,
      tile("In", money(m.in_cents), { wide: true }),
      tile("Out", money(m.out_cents), { wide: true }),
      tile("In this month", money(m.mtd_in_cents), { wide: true }),
      tile("Out this month", money(m.mtd_out_cents), { wide: true }));
    add(s, tiles);
    var accts = arr(m.by_account);
    if (accts && accts.length) {
      var list = el("ul", "list");
      list.setAttribute("aria-label", "Each bank account");
      accts.forEach(function (a) {
        a = obj(a) || {};
        var li = el("li");
        var name = (str(a.name) || "Account not known") + (str(a.mask) ? " ··" + a.mask : "");
        add(li, el("p", "row-title", name), el("p", "row-line", money(a.in_cents) + " in, " + money(a.out_cents) + " out."));
        list.appendChild(li);
      });
      add(s, list);
    }
    (arr(m.waiting) || []).forEach(function (w) { if (str(w)) add(s, note(w)); });
    return s;
  }

  /* ---------- 5. ads and sales ---------- */
  function backPerDollar(roas) {
    if (!isNum(roas)) return "unknown";
    return money(Math.round(Number(roas) * 100)) + " back for each $1";
  }
  function perBooked(cpb) {
    var c = obj(cpb);
    if (c && isNum(c.cost_cents)) return money(c.cost_cents);
    return "Too few booked to say";
  }
  function offerLine(t) {
    t = obj(t) || {};
    return (isNum(t.spend_cents) ? money(t.spend_cents) + " ad spend, " : "") +
      count(t.leads) + " new " + plural(t.leads, "person", "people") + ", " +
      count(t.booked) + " booked, " + count(t.showed) + " showed, " +
      count(t.sales) + " " + plural(t.sales, "sale", "sales") + ", " + money(t.cash_cents) + " cash.";
  }
  function renderAds(mk, ctx) {
    var s = section("Ads and sales");
    if (!obj(mk) || mk.status !== "ok" || !obj(mk.all_offers) || !obj(mk.all_offers.totals)) {
      add(s, plain(str(mk && mk.line) || "Ads and sales: could not be read."));
      return s;
    }
    var t = mk.all_offers.totals;
    add(s, el("p", "caption", "All offers, " + windowWords(ctx.kind, ctx.day) + "."));
    var tiles = el("div", "tiles");
    tiles.style.marginTop = "8px";
    add(tiles,
      tile("Ad spend", isNum(t.spend_cents) ? money(t.spend_cents) : "None synced", { wide: true, word: !isNum(t.spend_cents) }),
      tile("New people", count(t.leads)),
      tile("Booked", count(t.booked)),
      tile("Showed", count(t.showed)),
      tile("Sales", count(t.sales)),
      tile("Cash", money(t.cash_cents), { wide: true }),
      tile("Cost per booked person", perBooked(t.cost_per_booked), { wide: true, word: !(obj(t.cost_per_booked) && isNum(t.cost_per_booked.cost_cents)) }),
      tile("Return on ad spend", backPerDollar(t.roas), { wide: true, word: true }));
    add(s, tiles);

    (arr(mk.all_offers.not_split) || []).forEach(function (x) {
      x = obj(x) || {};
      if (!isNum(x.value) || !str(x.what)) return;
      add(s, note(x.what + ": " + (x.unit === "cents" ? money(x.value) : count(x.value)) + "."));
    });

    var offers = arr(mk.offers) || [];
    if (!offers.length) {
      add(s, note("No offer had ads or sales."));
    } else {
      var list = el("ul", "list");
      list.setAttribute("aria-label", "Each offer");
      offers.forEach(function (o) {
        o = obj(o) || {};
        var li = el("li");
        add(li, el("p", "row-title", str(o.name) || "No offer label"), el("p", "row-line", offerLine(o.totals)));
        (arr(o.funnels) || []).forEach(function (f) {
          f = obj(f) || {};
          add(li, el("p", "row-line caption", (str(f.name) || "No landing page") + ": " + offerLine(f.totals)));
        });
        list.appendChild(li);
      });
      add(s, list);
    }
    if (str(mk.dashboard_line)) add(s, note(mk.dashboard_line));
    return s;
  }

  /* ---------- 6. dying ads ---------- */
  function renderDying(mk) {
    var s = section("Dying ads");
    if (!obj(mk) || mk.status !== "ok") { add(s, plain("Dying ads: could not be read.")); return s; }
    var dying = arr(mk.dying_ads) || [];
    if (!dying.length) { add(s, plain("None flagged.")); return s; }
    var list = el("ul", "list");
    list.setAttribute("aria-label", "Dying ads");
    dying.forEach(function (d) {
      d = obj(d) || {};
      var li = el("li", "red-item");
      var title = el("p", "row-title");
      add(title, el("span", "tag red", "Dying"), document.createTextNode(str(d.ad_name) || "Ad name not on file"));
      add(li, title);
      if (str(d.offer_name)) add(li, el("p", "row-line caption", "Offer: " + d.offer_name));
      if (isNum(d.plays) && isNum(d.reached_25_rate)) {
        var got = Math.round(Number(d.plays) * Number(d.reached_25_rate));
        add(li, el("p", "row-line", count(got) + " of " + count(d.plays) + " plays got a quarter of the way in."));
      }
      if (isNum(d.spend_7d_cents)) add(li, el("p", "row-line", money(d.spend_7d_cents) + " spent on it in the last 7 days."));
      add(li, labelled("Fix: ", "change the opening line. Keep the rest."));
      list.appendChild(li);
    });
    add(s, list);
    return s;
  }

  /* ---------- 7. suggestions ---------- */
  function renderSuggestions(items) {
    var s = section("Suggestions");
    var list = (arr(items) || []).map(obj).filter(function (x) { return x && (str(x.write_up) || str(x.headline)); });
    if (!list.length) { add(s, plain("None today.")); return s; }
    var ul = el("ul", "list");
    ul.setAttribute("aria-label", "Suggestions");
    list.forEach(function (x) {
      var li = el("li");
      add(li, el("p", "plain", str(x.write_up) || str(x.headline)));
      if (str(x.rule_text)) add(li, el("p", "row-line caption", x.rule_text));
      ul.appendChild(li);
    });
    add(s, ul);
    return s;
  }

  /* ---------- 8. today ---------- */
  function renderToday(today) {
    var s = section("Today");
    var t = obj(today);
    var line = t && t.status !== "waiting" ? str(t.line) : null;
    add(s, plain(line || "Nothing on today's list yet."));
    return s;
  }

  /* ---------- the whole page ---------- */
  function guarded(fn, title) {
    try { return fn(); } catch (e) {
      var s = section(title);
      add(s, plain("This part could not be shown."));
      return s;
    }
  }

  function render(brief, ctx) {
    clear(root);
    var col = el("div", "col");
    var top = el("div", "top");
    var logo = el("span", "logo");
    logo.setAttribute("role", "img");
    logo.setAttribute("aria-label", "Fundhub");
    add(top, logo);
    add(col, top);
    add(col, el("p", "eyebrow", ctx.kind === "evening" ? "Evening brief" : "Morning brief"));
    add(col, el("h1", null, ctx.day ? longDay(ctx.day) : "Your brief"));
    add(col, el("p", "lede", ctx.kind === "evening"
      ? "Numbers are for today so far. Cash is the last 24 hours."
      : "Numbers are for " + windowWords(ctx.kind, ctx.day) + ". Cash is the last 24 hours."));

    add(col,
      guarded(function () { return renderSystems(brief.systems); }, "Systems"),
      guarded(function () { return renderLast24(brief.team); }, "Last 24 hours"),
      guarded(function () { return renderTeam(brief.team, ctx); }, "Team"),
      guarded(function () { return renderMoney(brief.money, ctx); }, "Money"),
      guarded(function () { return renderAds(brief.marketing, ctx); }, "Ads and sales"),
      guarded(function () { return renderDying(brief.marketing); }, "Dying ads"),
      guarded(function () { return renderSuggestions(brief.suggestions); }, "Suggestions"),
      guarded(function () { return renderToday(brief.today); }, "Today"));
    add(root, col);
    document.title = (ctx.kind === "evening" ? "Evening" : "Morning") + " brief · Fundhub";
  }

  /* ---------- read the link, fetch once ---------- */
  var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  var date = q.get("date") || "";
  var kind = q.get("kind") || "morning";
  var k = q.get("k") || "";
  var day = dayParts(date);
  if (!day || (kind !== "morning" && kind !== "evening") || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,128}$/.test(k)) {
    showBadLink();
    return;
  }

  var url = "/api/public/morning-brief?date=" + encodeURIComponent(date) +
    "&kind=" + encodeURIComponent(kind) + "&k=" + encodeURIComponent(k);
  k = null;
  var ctrl = typeof AbortController === "function" ? new AbortController() : null;
  var timer = ctrl ? setTimeout(function () { ctrl.abort(); }, 20000) : null;

  fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    credentials: "omit",
    cache: "no-store",
    referrerPolicy: "no-referrer",
    headers: { Accept: "application/json" },
    signal: ctrl ? ctrl.signal : undefined
  })
    .then(function (res) {
      if (res.status === 200) return res.json();
      // Only the route's own "not found" means the link is bad. A 503 (database blip), a 5xx, a blocked
      // request or a dropped signal says nothing about the link, so it must not call a good link expired.
      var err = new Error("status");
      err.fhKind = res.status === 404 ? "bad" : "later";
      throw err;
    })
    .then(function (body) {
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
      if (!body || body.ok !== true || !obj(body.brief)) {
        var err = new Error("shape");
        err.fhKind = "bad";
        throw err;
      }
      render(body.brief, { kind: kind, day: day });
    })
    .catch(function (e) {
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
      if (e && e.fhKind === "bad") showBadLink();
      else showLater();
    });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

   !important is only here so screen-standard.test.mjs can tell a live px size
   from a dead one — it changes nothing, because no other rule anywhere sets a
   body font-size. */

   `font-size:inherit !important` onto every element inside .app-shell, so the
   px sizes this screen used to write in here never painted once. The brand
   file hands the caption size back to a whitelist, and `.lb` is NOT on it —
   only `.kpi .lb` is — so every label on this screen was rendering at 16px
   body size, the same size as the number underneath it. These are this
   screen's own class names for labels, column headers, sub-captions and
   section headings; !important is what beats the brand's `*` rule.

   Every arm is a single class this screen alone owns. NONE of them is scoped
   under `.app`/`.app-shell` on purpose: that would raise the rule to (0,2,0)
   and let it outrank shared chrome that shell.js styles at (0,1,0). At (0,1,0)

   shared chrome always wins. Checked 2026-08-30 against every class shell.js

   money figure when the figure is unknown, and it sits in the same column cell

<script>
/* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Ops & Admin — wireframe behaviour. No backend.
   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* ══ ZONES ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Money is the default. People is one click. Nothing is unreachable and
   nothing competes with the thing you came here for.                        */
(function(){
  var tabs = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.zonetab'));
  var zones = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.zone'));
  tabs.forEach(function(t){
    t.addEventListener('click', function(){
      tabs.forEach(function(x){
        var on = x === t;
        x.classList.toggle('on', on);
        x.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
      zones.forEach(function(z){
        var on = z.dataset.zone === t.dataset.zone;
        z.classList.toggle('on', on);
        z.hidden = !on;
      });
    });
  });
})();

/* the affiliates link opens the real surface; it must not also toggle the
   drawer it happens to sit inside */
