  if(a) a.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); });
})();

/* ══ DATE RANGE ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   'Last 7 Days' is the file's own baseline and is reproduced here exactly.
   The other three ranges are scaled from it so switching shows movement.    */
(function(){
  var RANGES = [
    { id:'today', label:'Today',           range:'today',        foot:'today',
      meta:'today',          kpi:{cash:'—', funded:'—', close:'—', show:'—', cpf:'—', clients:'—'} },
    { id:'7d',    label:'Last 7 Days',     range:'last 7 days',  foot:'last 7 days',
      meta:'last 7 days',    kpi:{cash:'—', funded:'—', close:'—', show:'—', cpf:'—', clients:'—'} },
    { id:'30d',   label:'Last 30 Days',    range:'last 30 days', foot:'last 30 days',
      meta:'last 30 days',   kpi:{cash:'—', funded:'—', close:'—', show:'—', cpf:'—', clients:'—'} },
    { id:'qtd',   label:'Quarter to Date', range:'quarter',     foot:'quarter to date',
      meta:'quarter to date',kpi:{cash:'—', funded:'—', close:'—', show:'—', cpf:'—', clients:'—'} }
  ];
  var current = '7d';
  var btn   = document.getElementById('period-btn'),
      menu  = document.getElementById('period-menu'),
      label = document.getElementById('period-label'),
      meta  = document.getElementById('kpi-meta'),
      foot  = document.getElementById('foot-period'),
      grid  = document.getElementById('kpi-grid');

  RANGES.forEach(function(r){
    var o = document.createElement('button');
    o.type='button'; o.className='period-opt'; o.setAttribute('role','menuitem');
    o.dataset.id = r.id;
    o.innerHTML = '<span>'+r.label+'</span><span class="po-range">'+r.range+'</span>';
    o.addEventListener('click', function(){ pick(r.id); close(); });
    menu.appendChild(o);
  });

  function mark(){
    [].forEach.call(menu.children, function(o){
      o.setAttribute('aria-current', String(o.dataset.id === current));
    });
  }
  function open(){ menu.hidden=false; btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true'); mark(); }
  function close(){ menu.hidden=true;  btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); }

  /* The dates in the pill are COMPUTED, never written down. This mirrors the
     look-back the server actually measures (src/dashboard/kpis.mjs
     daysForPeriod): N days back, today included; 'qtd' from the 1st of the
     current quarter. Label and meta therefore describe the same window. */
  function windowFor(id){
    var end = new Date(); end.setHours(0,0,0,0);
    var start = new Date(end);
    if(id === 'today')      { /* one day: start === end */ }
    else if(id === '30d')   { start.setDate(end.getDate() - 29); }
    else if(id === 'qtd')   { start = new Date(end.getFullYear(), Math.floor(end.getMonth()/3)*3, 1); }
    else                    { start.setDate(end.getDate() - 6); }
    return { start:start, end:end };
  }
  function rangeText(id){
    var w = windowFor(id), md = { month:'short', day:'numeric' };
    var s = w.start.toLocaleDateString('en-US', md);
    var e = w.end.toLocaleDateString('en-US', md);
    if(s === e) return e;
    if(w.start.getFullYear() === w.end.getFullYear() && w.start.getMonth() === w.end.getMonth()){
      return s + '–' + w.end.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { day:'numeric' });
    }
    return s + ' – ' + e;
  }

  function applyDisplay(display){
    if(!display) return;
    Object.keys(display).forEach(function(k){
      var el = grid.querySelector('[data-kpi="'+k+'"]');
      if(el) el.textContent = display[k] == null ? '—' : display[k];
    });
  }

  var BLANK = { cash:'—', funded:'—', close:'—', show:'—', cpf:'—', clients:'—' };

  function loadKpis(period){
    if(typeof FHData === 'undefined' || !FHData.kpis){ applyDisplay(BLANK); return; }
    grid.classList.add('swapping');
    FHData.kpis(period).then(function(res){
      grid.classList.remove('swapping');
      if(res && res.ok && res.data && res.data.display){
        applyDisplay(res.data.display);
        return;
      }
      /* The read did not come back. Clear the tiles so no number from the
         previous period is left standing under the new one, and let the shared
         data layer word the reason. */
      applyDisplay(BLANK);
      if(FHData.explain) FHData.explain(res, 'the Company KPIs');
    });
  }

  function paintPulse(res){
    var state = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-state');
    var body  = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-body');
    var meta  = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-meta');
    var ceo   = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-ceo');
    var own   = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-owner');
    var hire  = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-hire');
    var learn = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-learn');
    var adsEl = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-ads');
    var fire  = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-fire');
    var act   = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-act');
    if(!state || !body) return;
    if(!res || !res.ok || !res.data){
      state.hidden = false;
      body.hidden = true;
      state.textContent = 'Could not load today’s briefs. Refresh this page.';
      if(meta) meta.textContent = 'error';
      if(FHData.explain) FHData.explain(res, 'today’s briefs');
      return;
    }
    var briefs = res.data.briefs || {};
    var rec = res.data.hire || {};
    var pulse = res.data.pulse || {};
    var cal = pulse.calendar || {};
    var gaps = pulse.gaps || res.data.gaps || {};
    var ads = pulse.ads || res.data.ads || {};
    var li  = rec.linkedin || {};
    var profile = rec.profile || {};
    if(!briefs.ceo && !briefs.owner){
      state.hidden = false;
      body.hidden = true;
      state.textContent = 'No pulse yet. Sign in as owner or admin.';
      if(meta) meta.textContent = 'empty';
      return;
    }
    state.hidden = true;
    body.hidden = false;
    var learning = pulse.learning || res.data.learning || {};
    var topLearn = (learning.top && learning.top[0]) || null;
    if(meta) meta.textContent = topLearn
      ? ('discovery · ' + (topLearn.source || 'data'))
      : (cal.packed ? 'calendar packed (MODEL)' : 'calendar not packed (MODEL)');
    if(learn){
      learn.textContent = topLearn
        ? ('Discovery: ' + topLearn.headline)
        : 'Discovery: not enough data to learn yet. We do not invent averages.';
    }
    if(ceo) ceo.textContent = briefs.ceo || '';
    if(own) own.textContent = briefs.owner || '';
    if(hire){
      hire.textContent = (cal.packed ? 'Hire: calendar is packed. ' : 'Hire: calendar is not packed. ') +
        'LinkedIn: ' + (li.status || 'unknown') +
        (rec.existing_task_id ? '. Hire task already on file.' : '.') +
        (profile.lines && profile.lines.length ? ' Profile: ' + profile.lines.join(' ') : '');
    }
    if(adsEl){
      adsEl.textContent = ads.status === 'ok'
        ? ('Ad spend this window: ' + (ads.spend_cents == null ? 'missing'
            : '$' + (Number(ads.spend_cents) / 100).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })) +
           '. Read only. Do not buy ads from here.')
        : ('Ad spend: ' + (ads.status || 'missing') + '.');
    }
    if(fire) fire.textContent = 'Fire: no fire rule yet. Raise: no raise rule yet. Bonus: no bonus rule yet. The brain writes a C-suite task only. It does not kick anyone out or change pay.';
    if(act){
      var needsAct = !!(cal.packed || gaps.has_short || (ads.status === 'ok' && ads.spend_cents > 0));
      act.hidden = !needsAct;
    }
  }

  function loadPulse(period){
    var state = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-state');
    var body  = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-body');
    if(typeof FHData === 'undefined' || !FHData.opsPulse){
      if(state){ state.hidden = false; state.textContent = 'No pulse yet. Sign in as owner or admin.'; }
      if(body) body.hidden = true;
      return;
    }
    if(state){ state.hidden = false; state.textContent = 'Loading today’s briefs…'; }
    if(body) body.hidden = true;
    FHData.opsPulse(period).then(paintPulse);
  }

  function pick(id){
    var r = RANGES.filter(function(x){ return x.id===id; })[0];
    if(!r) return;
    if(id===current && id !== '7d') return;
    current = id;
    paintPeriod(r);
    loadKpis(id);
    loadPulse(id);
  }

  function paintPeriod(r){
    label.textContent = r.label + ' — ' + rangeText(r.id);
    meta.textContent  = r.meta;
    foot.textContent  = r.foot;
  }

  // Paint the real dates for the default period, then read live. Do not wait
  // for a period click — the pill shipped with a hardcoded range for weeks.
  paintPeriod(RANGES.filter(function(x){ return x.id === current; })[0]);
  // data.js carries `defer` (see its tag above), so FHData does not exist yet
  // while this script is being parsed — reading here only ever hit the
  // `typeof FHData === 'undefined'` guard above, so the five KPI tiles were
  // blanked and never asked for. Every deferred script runs before
  // DOMContentLoaded, so the first read waits for that event.
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){ loadKpis(current); loadPulse(current); });

  btn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
    menu.hidden ? open() : close();
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if(!e.target.closest('.period-wrap')) close();
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape') close(); });
  mark();

  var actBtn = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-act');
  if(actBtn){
    actBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var msg = document.getElementById('ops-pulse-act-msg');
      if(typeof FHData === 'undefined' || !FHData.hireCloser){
        if(msg) msg.textContent = 'That action is not available on this page.';
        return;
      }
      actBtn.disabled = true;
      if(msg) msg.textContent = 'Working…';
      FHData.hireCloser().then(function(res){
        actBtn.disabled = false;
        if(!res || !res.ok){
          if(msg) msg.textContent = 'Could not write today’s tasks. Try again.';
          if(FHData.explain) FHData.explain(res, 'today’s tasks');
          return;
        }
        var d = res.data || {};
        var li = (d.linkedin && d.linkedin.status) || 'unknown';
        if(d.acted){
          if(msg) msg.textContent = 'Tasks saved. LinkedIn: ' + li + '. A person still has to send the invite.';
        } else if(d.diagnose || d.ads_task){
          if(msg) msg.textContent = 'Review tasks already on file. LinkedIn: ' + li + '.';
        } else {
          if(msg) msg.textContent = 'No new C-suite tasks this time.';
        }
        loadPulse(current);
      });
    });
  }
})();

/* ══ SORTABLE TABLES ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function(){
  /* Leading number out of a cell, or null. Handles '$1,000 DIY', '$1.34M', '45',
     '2d 14h' -> 2. Cells like 'Wendell Pryce' give null. */
  function num(td){
    var t = (td ? td.textContent : '').trim().replace(/[$,]/g,'');
    var m = t.match(/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/);
    if(!m) return null;
    var v = parseFloat(m[0]);
    if(/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*M/i.test(t)) v *= 1e6;
    if(/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*K/i.test(t)) v *= 1e3;
    return v;
  }
  function text(td){ return (td ? td.textContent : '').trim().toLowerCase(); }

  /* A column is numeric when most of its cells parse as numbers. Deciding once
     per column stops mixed number/string comparisons from ordering randomly. */
  function isNumericCol(rows, col){
    var vals = rows.map(function(r){ return num(r.cells[col]); });
    var hits = vals.filter(function(v){ return v !== null; }).length;
    return hits > vals.length / 2;
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('table.admin').forEach(function(table){
    var header = table.rows[0];
    if(!header || !header.cells.length || header.cells[0].tagName !== 'TH') return;

    [].forEach.call(header.cells, function(th, col){
      th.classList.add('sortable');
      th.tabIndex = 0;
      if(!th.hasAttribute('aria-sort')) th.setAttribute('aria-sort','none');
      th.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span class="sarrow">▲</span>');

      function sort(){
        var dir = th.getAttribute('aria-sort') === 'ascending' ? -1 : 1;
        [].forEach.call(header.cells, function(o){ o.setAttribute('aria-sort','none'); });
        th.setAttribute('aria-sort', dir === 1 ? 'ascending' : 'descending');

        /* collect body rows, keeping any expanded detail with its parent */
        var groups = [], cur = null;
        [].slice.call(table.rows, 1).forEach(function(r){
          if(r.classList.contains('ar-detail')){ if(cur) cur.extra.push(r); return; }
          cur = { row:r, extra:[] }; groups.push(cur);
        });

        var numeric = isNumericCol(groups.map(function(g){ return g.row; }), col);
        groups.sort(function(a,b){
          var av, bv;
          if(numeric){
            av = num(a.row.cells[col]); bv = num(b.row.cells[col]);
            /* unparseable cells in a numeric column always sort to the bottom */
            if(av === null && bv === null) return 0;
            if(av === null) return 1;
            if(bv === null) return -1;
          } else {
            av = text(a.row.cells[col]); bv = text(b.row.cells[col]);
          }
          if(av < bv) return -dir;
          if(av > bv) return  dir;
          return 0;
        });
        groups.forEach(function(g){
          table.appendChild(g.row);
          g.extra.forEach(function(x){ table.appendChild(x); });
        });
      }

      th.addEventListener('click', sort);
      th.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
        if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); sort(); }
      });
    });
  });
})();

/* ══ AR ROWS EXPAND ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function(){
  var table = document.getElementById('ar-table');
  if(!table) return;

  function collapse(r){
    r.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    if(r._d){ r._d.remove(); r._d = null; }
  }

  function expand(r){
    var tr = document.createElement('tr');
    tr.className = 'ar-detail';
    var td = document.createElement('td');
    td.colSpan = r.cells.length;

    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'ardetail';

    function col(k, v, mono){
      var c = document.createElement('div'); c.className = 'arcol';
      var kk = document.createElement('div'); kk.className = 'ark'; kk.textContent = k;
      var vv = document.createElement('div'); vv.className = 'arv' + (mono ? ' mono' : ''); vv.textContent = v;
      c.appendChild(kk); c.appendChild(vv); wrap.appendChild(c);
    }
    col('Terms', r.dataset.terms || '—');
    col('Payment method', r.dataset.method || '—');
    col('Owner', r.dataset.owner || '—');
    col('Outstanding', r.cells[1].textContent.trim(), true);

    var tl = document.createElement('div');
    tl.className = 'artimeline';
    var tk = document.createElement('div'); tk.className='ark'; tk.textContent='Collection history';
    tl.appendChild(tk);
    (r.dataset.timeline || '').split(';').filter(Boolean).forEach(function(step){
      var parts = step.split('|');
      var s = document.createElement('div'); s.className='arstep';
      var d = document.createElement('span'); d.className='ard'; d.textContent = parts[0] || '';
      var w = document.createElement('span'); w.textContent = parts[1] || '';
      s.appendChild(d); s.appendChild(w); tl.appendChild(s);
    });
    wrap.appendChild(tl);

    td.appendChild(wrap); tr.appendChild(td);
    r.parentNode.insertBefore(tr, r.nextSibling);
    r._d = tr;
    r.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
  }

  table.querySelectorAll('tr[data-ar]').forEach(function(r){
    function toggle(){
      if(r.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true') collapse(r); else expand(r);
    }
    r.addEventListener('click', toggle);
    r.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); toggle(); }
    });
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
/* The outbound mail panel. Every action goes through /api/messages-outbound, which is
   ROLE_SETS.STAFF to look and owner/admin to act — so a narrower role sees the
   state and simply gets a refusal if they press a button, rather than the
   screen pretending the controls are not there. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
    return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]; }); }
  if (!$("outboxCard")) return;

  var state = null;

  function show(id, on) { var el = $(id); if (el) el.style.display = on ? "" : "none"; }
  function queued() { return Number((state && state.counts && state.counts.queued) || 0); }

  function paint(d) {
    state = d;
    $("outboxSummary").textContent = d.message || d.summary || "";
    var c = d.counts || {};
    var route = (d.routing || []).filter(function (r) { return r.enabled; })
      .map(function (r) { return r.channel + " via " + r.provider; }).join(", ");
    $("outboxDetail").innerHTML =
      esc((c.queued || 0) + " waiting · " + (c.sent_today || 0) + " sent today · " +
          (c.failed || 0) + " failed · " + (c.blocked || 0) + " held by compliance") +
      (route ? "<br>" + esc("Set up to send: " + route) : "<br>Nothing is set up to send yet.") +
      (d.invoices_never_emailed
        ? "<br><strong>" + esc(d.invoices_never_emailed + " invoice(s) were never emailed to the client.") + "</strong>"
        : "");
    $("outboxToggle").textContent =
      d.settings && d.settings.outbound_enabled ? "Pause sending" : "Turn sending on";
    // "Send what is waiting" with nothing waiting is a control that does
    // nothing, so it only appears when there is something to send.
    show("outboxSend", queued() > 0);
    show("outboxToggle", true);
    show("outboxInvoices", !!d.invoices_never_emailed);
  }

  function say(kind, text) {
    $("outboxMsg").textContent = text;
    $("outboxMsg").style.color = kind === "ok" ? "#2C5138" : "#6E2A22";
  }

  function call(body, done) {
    return FHData.write("/api/messages-outbound", body).then(function (res) {
      if (!res.ok) {
        say("err", res.error === "unauthorized"
          ? "Only an owner or an admin can change this."
          : (res.error || "that did not work"));
        return;
      }
      if (res.data && res.data.message) say("ok", res.data.message);
      if (done) done(res.data);
      refresh();
    });
  }

  /* A READ, SO A GET. This runs on every page load; it used to be a POST
     {action:"status"}, which made opening the page look like a write (hole N3). */
  function refresh() {
    return FHData.outboxStatus().then(function (res) {
      if (res.ok) { paint(res.data); return; }
      /* The queue could not be read, so nothing here can say what would go out
         or what would stop. Buttons that cannot name their consequence do not
         render. */
      state = null;
      show("outboxSend", false);
      show("outboxToggle", false);
      show("outboxInvoices", false);
      $("outboxSummary").textContent =
        "Could not read the outbound queue, so this panel cannot show what is waiting or send it. Refresh this page.";
      $("outboxDetail").textContent = "";
    });
  }

  $("outboxSend").onclick = function () {
    var n = queued();
    if (!n) { say("err", "Nothing is waiting to send."); return; }
    if (!window.confirm(
      "Send the " + n + " message(s) waiting now? They go out to real clients and cannot be pulled back."
    )) return;
    say("ok", "sending…");
    call({ action: "dispatch" });
  };
  $("outboxToggle").onclick = function () {
    var on = !(state && state.settings && state.settings.outbound_enabled);
    var n = queued();
    if (!window.confirm(on
      ? "Turn sending on? Queued messages start going out to real clients. " + n + " message(s) waiting now."
      : "Pause sending? Nothing goes out to clients until you turn sending back on. " +
        n + " message(s) will sit in the queue."
    )) return;
    call({ action: "settings", outbound_enabled: on });
  };
  $("outboxInvoices").onclick = function () {
    if (!window.confirm("Email every invoice the client was never told about?")) return;
    call({ action: "email_invoice_backlog" });
  };

  // data.js carries `defer` (see its tag above), so FHData does not exist yet
  // while this script is being parsed — calling it here threw, and the throw
  // killed the rest of this function before the outbound queue was ever read.
  // Every deferred script runs before DOMContentLoaded, so the first read waits
  // for that event.
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    refresh();
  });
})();
</script>
<script>

/* Ops & Admin — KPIs, dead-letter queue, AR, compliance blocks from live APIs. */
// data.js carries `defer` (see its tag above), so FHData does not exist yet
// while this script is being parsed — the reads below threw, and the throw
// killed the rest of this block before the AR table, the compliance table, the
// failed-events tile and the staff tables were ever requested. Every deferred
// script runs before DOMContentLoaded, so this whole block waits for that
// event; none of it needs to run before the page is built.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  "use strict";
  var esc = function (v) {
    return String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;" }[c]; });
  };

  function relTime(iso) {
    if (!iso) return "—";
    var ms = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();
    if (!Number.isFinite(ms) || ms < 0) return "—";
    var m = Math.round(ms / 60000);
    if (m < 60) return m + "m ago";
    var h = Math.round(m / 60);
    if (h < 48) return h + "h ago";
    return Math.round(h / 24) + "d ago";
  }

  /* ══ AR + COLLECTIONS ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
     This panel said "No unpaid invoices" on 2026-09-06 with a real, sent,
     unpaid $5,000 success fee in the database, and it would have said that
     forever. It asked the server for status=open; invoices_status_check permits
     eight values and "open" is not one of them, so the comparison matched no
     row. The fix is on the server (src/invoices/ar-filter.mjs maps "open" to a
     balance rather than to a status that does not exist); the screen keeps
     asking the same question, which now has an answer.

     THREE THINGS THIS TABLE USED TO PRINT THAT NOBODY COULD ACT ON:
       · a raw client UUID in a column headed "Client"
       · no dollar amount at all
       · "—" in Days Overdue whenever due_at was NULL, which is every invoice
         this platform raises today — there is no due-date policy yet (031's
         open question Q2). A dash there reads as "nothing overdue". It is not.
         The server now says days_overdue: null and the row says the words.

     Money is not coloured and status is not coloured: UI-STANDARDS 12.6 — a
     white-label tenant's ramp can paint every status the same hue, so the
     signal here is the word and the position, never a fill. */

  // Same shape as invoiceDisplayNumber() in src/invoices/index.mjs, so the
  // reference an operator reads here is the one the client reads on the emailed
  // invoice. If that helper changes, change this with it.
  function invoiceRef(id) {
    var s = String(id == null ? "" : id).replace(/-/g, "");
    return s ? "INV-" + s.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase() : "";
  }

  // null, not a dash, when the number is unknown — the caller picks the words.
  function usd(v) {
    var n = Number(v);
    if (v == null || v === "" || !isFinite(n)) return null;
    return "$" + n.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  }

  function overdueWords(days) {
    if (days == null || days === "") return "No due date set";
    var n = Number(days);
    if (!isFinite(n)) return "No due date set";
    if (n <= 0) return "Not due yet";
    return n === 1 ? "1 day" : n + " days";
  }

  function statusWords(status) {
    var s = String(status == null ? "" : status).trim();
    if (!s) return "Status not recorded";
    s = s.replace(/_/g, " ");
    return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
  }

  var AR_HEAD = '<tr><th>Client</th><th>Invoice</th><th>Amount owed</th>' +
    '<th aria-sort="descending">Overdue</th><th>Status</th></tr>';

  function arRow(text) {
    return '<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty-note" style="border-bottom:none">' + text + "</td></tr>";
  }

  function paintAr(data) {
    var table = document.getElementById("ar-table");
    var total = document.getElementById("ar-total");
    if (!table) return null;

    // Could not read it. Say that, rather than leaving "Loading…" on the screen.
    if (!data) {
      table.innerHTML = AR_HEAD + arRow("We could not load unpaid invoices. Reload the page.");
      if (total) total.textContent = "Could not load";
      return null;
    }

    // The server already filtered to a balance still owed and ordered them
    // oldest due date first, so nothing is re-filtered or re-sorted here.
    var rows = data.items || [];
    if (!rows.length) {
      table.innerHTML = AR_HEAD + arRow("No unpaid invoices. Bills that go out show here until they are paid.");
      if (total) total.textContent = "Nothing outstanding";
      /* A truthful answer, so the footer says so. Returning null here would make
         wire() call this "sample" data and claim there is no AR table in the
         database — there is; it read it, and every bill is paid. */
      return "live AR · nothing outstanding";
    }

    var owed = 0;
    var unknown = 0;
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var n = Number(r.open_balance);
      if (r.open_balance == null || !isFinite(n)) unknown += 1; else owed += n;
    });

    var shown = rows.slice(0, 25);
    var html = AR_HEAD;
    shown.forEach(function (r) {
      var amount = usd(r.open_balance);
      html += "<tr><td>" + esc(r.client_name || r.client_code || "Name not on file") +
        '</td><td class="mono">' + esc(invoiceRef(r.id)) +
        "</td><td>" + esc(amount == null ? "Amount not recorded" : amount) +
        "</td><td>" + esc(overdueWords(r.days_overdue)) +
        "</td><td>" + esc(statusWords(r.status)) + "</td></tr>";
    });
    if (rows.length > shown.length) {
      html += arRow((rows.length - shown.length) + " more unpaid invoices are not shown here.");
    }
    table.innerHTML = html;

    var totalWords = usd(owed) + " owed · " + rows.length +
      (rows.length === 1 ? " invoice" : " invoices");
    if (unknown) totalWords += " · " + unknown + " with no amount recorded";
    if (total) total.textContent = totalWords;
    return "live AR · " + totalWords;
  }

  if (FHData.invoices) {
    var arRead = FHData.invoices({ status: "open", limit: 50 });
    // wire() paints the happy path and owns the footer banner. It does NOT
    // repaint on a refused or failed read, which is how this table used to sit
    // on "Loading…" for any role without finance access, so the failure is
    // painted here.
    arRead.then(function (res) { if (!res || !res.ok) paintAr(null); },
                function () { paintAr(null); });
    FHData.wire(arRead, "AR table", paintAr);
  } else {
    paintAr(null);
  }

  // Compliance gate — always paint empty, rows, or error. Never leave Loading.
  function paintCompliance(res) {
    var table = document.getElementById("compliance-blocked-table");
    if (!table) return;
    var html = "<tr><th>Client</th><th>Channel</th><th>Reason</th><th>When</th></tr>";
    if (!res || !res.ok) {
      html += '<tr><td colspan="4" class="empty-note" style="border-bottom:none">Could not load stopped messages. Refresh this page.</td></tr>';
      table.innerHTML = html;
      return;
    }
    var data = res.data || {};
    var rows = data.items || data.messages || [];
    if (!rows.length) {
      html += '<tr><td colspan="4" class="empty-note" style="border-bottom:none">No messages stopped by the compliance gate</td></tr>';
    } else {
      rows.slice(0, 15).forEach(function (r) {
        html += "<tr><td>" + esc(r.client_name || r.client_id || "—") +
          "</td><td>" + esc(r.channel || "—") +
          "</td><td>" + esc(r.blocked_reason || r.status || "blocked") +
          "</td><td class=\"mono\">" + esc(relTime(r.created_at)) + "</td></tr>";
      });
    }
    table.innerHTML = html;
    if (FHData.banner) {
      FHData.banner("real", "live compliance gate · " + rows.length + " blocked", "compliance blocks");
    }
  }
  if (FHData.read) {
    FHData.read("messages", { status: "blocked", limit: 30 }).then(paintCompliance).catch(function () {
      paintCompliance(null);
    });
  }

  FHData.wire(FHData.failedEvents({ status: "pending", limit: 200 }), "ops health",
    function (data) {
      var rows = data.items || [];
      var grid = document.getElementById("kpi-grid");
      if (!grid) return null;

      // Reuse whatever a KPI tile already looks like on this screen, so the
      // added tile cannot drift from the approved design.
      var tpl = grid.querySelector(".kpi") || grid.firstElementChild;
      if (!tpl) return null;
      var tile = tpl.cloneNode(true);
      tile.id = "kpi-dlq";
      var big = tile.querySelector(".sv, .kpi-value, .value, h3, strong");
      var cap = tile.querySelector(".sd, .kpi-label, .label, p, span:last-child");
      if (big) big.textContent = rows.length;
      if (cap) cap.textContent = rows.length
        ? "failed events awaiting retry"
        : "no failed events";
      if (!document.getElementById("kpi-dlq")) grid.appendChild(tile);

      var worst = rows.slice(0, 1)[0];
      return "live ops health · " + rows.length + " pending failure(s)" +
             (worst ? " · latest: " + esc(worst.event_name) + "/" + esc(worst.handler_name) : "");
    });

  var ROLE_LABEL = {
    owner: "Owner", admin: "Admin", closer: "Closer",
    sales_manager: "Sales Manager", funding_advisor: "Funding Advisor",
    inquiry_specialist: "Inquiry Remover", setter: "Setter"
  };
  function roleLabel(r) {
    return ROLE_LABEL[r] || String(r || "—").replace(/_/g, " ");
  }
  function initials(name) {
    var p = String(name || "").trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    var a = (p[0] || "?").charAt(0);
    var b = p.length > 1 ? p[p.length - 1].charAt(0) : "";
    return (a + b).toUpperCase();
  }
  function hiddenText(n) {
    return n === 1
      ? "1 person is hidden from this list (owner and seeded test logins)."
      : n + " people are hidden from this list (owner and seeded test logins).";
  }
  function paintStaff(rows, hiddenCount) {
    var line = document.getElementById("staffHiddenLine");
    /* Written on EVERY load, not only when the list is empty. A one-row table
       with nothing else said reads as "this company has one employee". */
    if (line) line.textContent = Number(hiddenCount) > 0 ? hiddenText(Number(hiddenCount)) : "";
    var comp = document.getElementById("staff-comp-body");
    var consent = document.getElementById("staff-consent-body");
    if (!rows.length) {
      /* An empty list has two very different causes and the screen used to
         print the same words for both. Say which one it is. */
      var hidden = Number(hiddenCount) || 0;
      var msg = hidden ? hiddenText(hidden) : "No staff rows.";
      if (comp) comp.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4">' + esc(msg) + "</td></tr>";
      if (consent) consent.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="2">' + esc(msg) + "</td></tr>";
      return;
    }
    if (comp) {
      comp.innerHTML = rows.map(function (s) {
        var name = String(s.name || s.email || "—").trim() || "—";
        /* Pay is not on this read and staff.comp has no agreed shape yet, so
           these stay unknown. An unknown is a dash with a reason, never a $0. */
        return '<tr><td><span class="av human">' + esc(initials(name)) + "</span> " +
          esc(name) + "</td><td>" + esc(roleLabel(s.role)) +
          '</td><td class="section-meta"><span title="Pay plans are not stored on this screen yet">—</span>' +
          '</td><td class="mono"><span title="This week\'s earnings are not on this screen yet">—</span></td></tr>';
      }).join("");
    }
    if (consent) {
      consent.innerHTML = rows.map(function (s) {
        var name = String(s.name || s.email || "—").trim() || "—";
        var signed = !!s.monitoring_consent_at;
        return '<tr' + (signed ? '' : ' class="warn"') +
          '><td><span class="av human">' + esc(initials(name)) + '</span> ' +
          esc(name) + '</td><td><span class="status-pill ' +
          (signed ? 'ok">Signed' : 'warn">Not yet signed') +
          '</span></td></tr>';
      }).join("");
    }
  }
  if (FHData.staff) {
    FHData.wire(FHData.staff({ limit: 200 }), "staff tables", function (data) {
      var rows = data.items || [];
      var hidden = Number(data.hiddenCount) || 0;
      paintStaff(rows, hidden);
      if (rows.length) return "live staff · " + rows.length;
      return hidden ? ("no staff on this list · " + hidden + " hidden") : "No staff rows.";
    });
  }
});
</script>

function tickClock() {
  var el = document.querySelector(".clock");
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", {
    weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit",
    timeZone: "America/Phoenix", timeZoneName: "short"
  });
}
tickClock();
setInterval(tickClock, 1000);
</script>

     fundhub-brand.css sets `:is(.app,…) * {font-size:inherit !important}`, so

     ONE rule, never two.
     DELIBERATELY OUT OF THIS LIST, and the reason matters more than the list:
     a `.app :is(…)` selector scores (0,2,0), so it OUTRANKS a shared one-class

(function(){
"use strict";

/* ============================================================
   FUNDHUB GALAXY — a live pulse of the whole company.
   Force-directed workers on a dark canvas. Clusters are teams.
   Rails run behind everything; clients travel them as pulses.
   Read-only. Nothing here does anything but show you.

   NO NUMBERS LIVE ON THIS CANVAS. (T10-02, owner ruling 2026-08-19.)
   Six labelled tiles used to sit along the bottom — Cash Collected Today,
   Funded Today, Close Rate, Show Rate, Movement Today, Cost / Funded Client —
   and every one of their values was made up. They started at zero and the only
   thing that ever changed them was a dice roll: a scheduled evMoney() picked
   `3000 + (Math.random()<0.5?300:0)` or `8500 + Math.round(Math.random()*7)*2500`
   and flew that figure into a tile as a "flare", printing "+$11,000 ROUND FUNDED"
   over the sky on the way. A partner reading this screen was reading invented
   money on a money surface.

   The rule the owner set: wire a tile to real data if the read already exists,
   and if it does not exist, DELETE the tile — never a zero, never a dash, never
   a "demo" label. Every partner-readable endpoint was checked one by one — the
   audit sits where KPIS used to, further down this file. None of the six had a
   partner-scoped source, so all six are gone, and the flare machinery that fed
   them is gone with them.

   The sky itself STAYS. The owner objected to invented numbers, not to the
   animation.
   ============================================================ */

var TAU = Math.PI*2;

/* ---------- palette ---------- */
var C = {
  /* pace rings are spectrum stops; the rest is the brand neutral ramp.
     sage = ahead, peach = behind, coral = blocked. */
  neutral:'#52525B', green:'#A8D8B0', amber:'#F5CE8F', red:'#F2A69B',
  gold:'#F2E39B', text:'#FCFCFC', dim:'#A1A1AA', faint:'#52525B',
  /* starlight: brand neutrals, depth carried by alpha not hue */
  star:'#E4E4E7', star2:'#A1A1AA', glow:'#A9C6E8', deep:'#111113',
  /* node mass — neutral dark ramp so hue never competes with the pace ring */
  bodyHi:'#26262B', bodyMid:'#18181B', bodyLo:'#111113'
};

function rgba(hex,a){
  var h = hex.replace('#','');
  if(h.length===3) h = h[0]+h[0]+h[1]+h[1]+h[2]+h[2];
  var n = parseInt(h,16);
  return 'rgba('+((n>>16)&255)+','+((n>>8)&255)+','+(n&255)+','+a+')';
}
function lerp(a,b,t){return a+(b-a)*t;}
function hex3(h){
  h = h.replace('#','');
  if(h.length===3) h = h[0]+h[0]+h[1]+h[1]+h[2]+h[2];
  var n = parseInt(h,16);
  return [(n>>16)&255, (n>>8)&255, n&255];
}
function mixHex(a,b,t){
  var A=hex3(a), B=hex3(b);
  var r=Math.round(A[0]+(B[0]-A[0])*t), g=Math.round(A[1]+(B[1]-A[1])*t), c=Math.round(A[2]+(B[2]-A[2])*t);
  return '#'+((1<<24)+(r<<16)+(g<<8)+c).toString(16).slice(1);
}
function clamp(v,a,b){return v<a?a:(v>b?b:v);}
function pick(arr){return arr[(Math.random()*arr.length)|0];}
function easeInOut(t){return t<0.5?4*t*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,3)/2;}

/* ============================================================
   1. THE COMPANY
   ============================================================ */

var RAILS = [
  {name:'Sales',              amp:24, ph:0.2, stages:['Survey Completed','Booked','Diagnostic Paid','Decision Rendered']},

/* ---------- company KPIs — six were DELETED (T10-02); THREE are back (T10-02
   follow-up) because a partner-scoped read now exists for each. This comment
   is the audit that decided which, and it is kept current rather than left as
   a record of the original delete — a stale "none exists" note next to a tile
   that now renders would be exactly the kind of untruth this screen exists to
   refuse.

   Every partner-reachable read was checked before any tile was added back. A
   source only counts if a PARTNER principal can call it and it is scoped to
   THAT partner; an org-wide staff number shown to a partner is a different
   untruth, not a fix. The three below are rendered as real DOM tiles
   (.home-tiles, further down this file) fed by GET /api/read/partner-home-tiles
   (api/read/partner-home-tiles.mjs) — never drawn on the canvas, which is why
   the checks lower in this comment block scope themselves to the canvas
   script alone and would not see these tiles at all.

     Cash Collected Today  — SUM(partner_revenue.share_amount) for the UTC day,
                             the partner's own accrual rows, status <> 'void'
                             (db/migrations/042_partners.sql). No rows today is
                             a real zero, not "not known".
     Funded Today           — countFundingClients() (src/partners/floors.mjs),
                             the SAME definition the production floor counts
                             with, so this tile and the floor decision can
                             never disagree.
     Cost / Funded Client   — today's ad spend (v_partner_spend_vs_ceiling,
                             db/migrations/046_ad_platforms.sql, the
                             scope='partner' row) divided by Funded Today.
                             Either side unknown -> "not known", never $0 and
                             never a divide-by-zero.

   Still none of the other three. Nothing partner-scoped reports a show, a
   close, or a movement, and an org-wide staff number is not a substitute:

     Close Rate            — none exists.
     Show Rate              — none exists.
     Movement Today         — none exists.

   Every tile on this screen — sourced or not — must carry a `source` naming
   the read it comes from, or be absent. src/http/partner-galaxy-tiles.test.mjs
   enforces that and fails the build on a tile with no source, and separately
   fails the build if Close Rate, Show Rate or Movement Today reappear by name
   anywhere on this screen. */

/* ============================================================
   2. CANVAS + LAYOUT
   ============================================================ */

var cv = document.getElementById('sky'), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
var W=0,H=0,DPR=1,GH=0;
var dust=[], railPaths=[];

function resize(){
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1, 2);
  W = cv.clientWidth; H = cv.clientHeight;
  cv.width = Math.round(W*DPR); cv.height = Math.round(H*DPR);
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  layout();
}

function layout(){
  GH = H;
  var padX = clamp(W*0.11, 92, 190);
  var top  = 66, bot = 44;
  var scale = clamp(Math.min(W/1460, GH/820), 0.62, 1.18);

  CLUSTERS.forEach(function(c){
    c.hx = padX + c.fx*(W-2*padX);
    c.hy = top  + c.fy*(GH-top-bot);
    c.rr = c.r*scale;
    c.cx = (c.cx===undefined)?c.hx:c.cx;
    c.cy = (c.cy===undefined)?c.hy:c.cy;
    var mem = NODES.filter(function(n){return n.c===c.id;});
    c.count = mem.length;
    mem.forEach(function(n,i){
      n.sa  = i*2.399963 + c.seed;
      n.sr_ = mem.length<=1 ? 0 : c.rr*Math.sqrt((i+0.55)/mem.length);
    });
  });

  NODES.forEach(function(n){
    if(n.x===undefined){
      var c = CL[n.c];
      n.x = c.hx + Math.cos(n.sa)*n.sr_;
      n.y = c.hy + Math.sin(n.sa)*n.sr_*0.82;
      n.vx = 0; n.vy = 0;
      n.z = 0.5; n.b = 0.3; n.flash = 0; n.hit = 0; n.res = 0;
    }
  });

  /* rails: gentle sine paths spanning the whole sky, deep behind everything */
  railPaths = RAILS.map(function(r,i){
    var y = 74 + (GH-150) * ((i+0.5)/RAILS.length);
    return {y:y, amp:r.amp*clamp(GH/760,0.7,1.2), ph:r.ph, freq: (1.15 + i*0.13)};
  });

  /* dust — three depths */
  if(!dust.length || dust.length<160){
    dust = [];
    for(var i=0;i<190;i++){
      dust.push({x:Math.random(), y:Math.random(), z:Math.random(),
                 r:0.5+Math.random()*1.4, tw:Math.random()*TAU, sp:0.2+Math.random()*0.8});
    }
  }

  /* the camera lives in world coords — park it on the sky so the first frame
     is already framed, and so a resize doesn't send it sliding */
  if(layer===0){ cam.x = W/2; cam.y = GH/2; cam.k = 1; }
}

function railPoint(i,u){
  var p = railPaths[i];
  var x = -40 + u*(W+80);
  var y = p.y + Math.sin(u*Math.PI*p.freq*2 + p.ph + time*0.06)*p.amp;
  return {x:x,y:y};
}

/* ============================================================
   3. LIVE EVENTS
   ============================================================ */

var time=0, frame=0, dt=1/60;
var threads=[], pulses=[];

function nodeSay(n, txt){
  n.act = txt; n.flash = Math.max(n.flash, 0.85);
  if(!n.tl) n.tl=[];
  n.tl.push([nowClock(true), txt]);
  if(n.tl.length>9) n.tl.shift();
  if(sel===n.id) renderPanel(n);
}

function fillC(s){ return s.replace('{C}', pick(CLIENTS)); }

/* -- workers change what they're doing -- */
function evActivity(){
  if(!NODES.length) return;
  var cands = NODES.filter(function(n){return n.state!=='blocked' && n.pool && n.pool.length>1;});
  if(!cands.length) return;
  var n = pick(cands);
  var txt = fillC(pick(n.pool));
  if(txt===n.act) return;
  if(n.state==='idle' && Math.random()<0.55){ n.state='active'; }
  else if(n.state==='active' && txt.indexOf('Idle')===0){ n.state='idle'; }
  nodeSay(n, txt);
  n.out += 1 + ((Math.random()*3)|0);
  sizeNode(n);
}

/* -- one worker hands something to another -- */
function evHandoff(){
  if(!NODES.length) return;
  if(threads.length>=5) return;
  var r = pick(ROUTES);
  var a = ND[r[0]], b = ND[r[1]];
  if(!a||!b) return;
  threads.push({a:a,b:b, label:fillC(r[2]), t:0, dur:6.2, off:(Math.random()<0.5?1:-1)*(0.14+Math.random()*0.10), landed:false});
  a.flash = Math.max(a.flash, 0.6);
  if(b.state==='idle' && Math.random()<0.5) b.state='active';
}

/* -- a client advances a stage: a pulse travels its rail -- */
function evMove(){
  if(!CLIENTS.length) return;
  if(pulses.length>=4) return;
  var i = (Math.random()*RAILS.length)|0;
  if(RAILS[i].quiet && Math.random()<0.88) i = (Math.random()*(RAILS.length-1))|0;
  var r = RAILS[i];
  pulses.push({rail:i, t:0, dur:3.6+Math.random()*1.4,
               u0:0.05+Math.random()*0.28, span:0.34+Math.random()*0.22,
               label: pick(CLIENTS)+'  →  '+pick(r.stages)});
}

function sizeNode(n){ n.r = clamp(9 + 4.2*Math.log(1+n.out), 10, 33); }
NODES.forEach(sizeNode);

/* -- scheduler: driven off the render clock, so nothing piles up
      while the tab is hidden and nothing runs double on a 120Hz screen -- */
var SCHED = [
  {fn:evActivity, lo:3.2, hi:7.0,  next:1.2},
  {fn:evHandoff,  lo:4.2, hi:9.0,  next:0.9},
  {fn:evMove,     lo:2.6, hi:5.4,  next:0.4}
];
function tickEvents(){
  for(var i=0;i<SCHED.length;i++){
    var s = SCHED[i];
    if(time >= s.next){ s.fn(); s.next = time + s.lo + Math.random()*(s.hi-s.lo); }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   4. PHYSICS — drift, cluster gravity, repulsion, depth
   ============================================================ */

function physics(){
  CLUSTERS.forEach(function(c){
    c.cx = lerp(c.cx, c.hx + Math.sin(time*0.13+c.seed)*17 + Math.sin(time*0.041+c.seed*2)*10, 0.06);
    c.cy = lerp(c.cy, c.hy + Math.cos(time*0.11+c.seed*1.7)*13 + Math.cos(time*0.037+c.seed)*8, 0.06);
  });

  NODES.forEach(function(n){
    var c = CL[n.c];
    var ang = n.sa + time*0.035*c.spin;
    var tx = c.cx + Math.cos(ang)*n.sr_;
    var ty = c.cy + Math.sin(ang)*n.sr_*0.80;
    n.vx += (tx-n.x)*0.0026;
    n.vy += (ty-n.y)*0.0026;
    var jit = 0.085*(0.35+n.tempo);
    n.vx += (Math.random()-0.5)*jit;
    n.vy += (Math.random()-0.5)*jit;
  });

  for(var i=0;i<NODES.length;i++){
    for(var j=i+1;j<NODES.length;j++){
      var a=NODES[i], b=NODES[j];
      var dx=b.x-a.x, dy=b.y-a.y;
      var d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)||0.001;
      var min = a.r + b.r + (a.c===b.c ? 36 : 64);
      if(d<min){
        var f = ((min-d)/min)*0.55;
        a.vx-=(dx/d)*f; a.vy-=(dy/d)*f; b.vx+=(dx/d)*f; b.vy+=(dy/d)*f;
      }
      /* names and status lines hang below each node — keep those lanes clear */
      var lane = (a.state==='blocked'||b.state==='blocked'||
                  paceState(a)==='behind'||paceState(b)==='behind') ? 62 : 42;
      if(Math.abs(dx)<104 && Math.abs(dy)<lane){
        var vf = ((lane-Math.abs(dy))/lane)*0.34;
        var sgn = dy>=0 ? 1 : -1;
        a.vy -= sgn*vf; b.vy += sgn*vf;
      }
    }
  }

  NODES.forEach(function(n){
    n.vx*=0.905; n.vy*=0.905;
    var sp=Math.sqrt(n.vx*n.vx+n.vy*n.vy);
    if(sp>2.3){ n.vx*=2.3/sp; n.vy*=2.3/sp; }
    n.x+=n.vx; n.y+=n.vy;
    var m=n.r+22;
    if(n.x<m){n.x=m;n.vx*=-0.4;}
    if(n.x>W-m){n.x=W-m;n.vx*=-0.4;}
    if(n.y<m+8){n.y=m+8;n.vy*=-0.4;}
    if(n.y>GH-m+6){n.y=GH-m+6;n.vy*=-0.4;}

    /* depth: working comes forward, idle recedes, blocked comes furthest forward */
    var zt = n.state==='blocked' ? 0.98 : n.state==='active' ? (0.70+0.28*n.tempo) : 0.30;
    n.z = lerp(n.z, zt, 0.03);
    /* brightness */
    var bt = n.state==='blocked' ? 1 : n.state==='active' ? (0.68+0.30*n.tempo) : 0.32;
    n.b = lerp(n.b, bt, 0.045);
    n.flash *= 0.955;
    n.hit   *= 0.93;
  });
}

/* pace classification — the only thing allowed to be loud */
function paceState(n){
  if(n.state==='blocked') return 'blocked';
  if(n.pace===null || n.pace===undefined) return 'none';
  if(n.pace < 0.85) return 'behind';
  if(n.pace >= 1.05) return 'ahead';
  return 'on';
}
function paceColor(s){
  return s==='blocked'?C.red : s==='behind'?C.amber : s==='ahead'?C.green : C.neutral;
}

/* ============================================================
   5. RENDER
   ============================================================ */

var drift={x:0,y:0}, hover=null, hoverC=null, sel=null, mouse={x:-999,y:-999};
var lastT=0, t0=0, acc=0;

/* ---------- three layers, one camera ----------
   0 SKY      five masses of light, workers unreadable
   1 CLUSTER  one team resolves, the rest shrink to the edges
   2 WORKER   camera pushes in, cluster-mates recede, day panel opens
   Zoom is the navigation. Every move is animated, never a cut.       */
var K1 = 2.15, K2 = 3.30;
var layer = 0, focusC = null;
var cam = {x:0, y:0, k:1};
var vcx = 0;                 /* view-centre offset — makes room for the panel */
var squashAmt = 0;           /* how hard off-focus space is folded to the edges */

function camTarget(){
  if(layer===0 || !focusC) return {x:W/2, y:GH/2, k:1};
  var c = CL[focusC];
  if(layer===1 || !sel) return {x:c.cx, y:c.cy, k:K1};
  var n = ND[sel];
  return {x: lerp(c.cx, n.x, 0.85), y: lerp(c.cy, n.y, 0.85), k: K2};
}

/* world → screen. depth drives parallax, camAmt how much the camera bites
   (rails and far dust sit deep, so the camera barely moves them). */
function view(wx, wy, depth, camAmt){
  if(camAmt===undefined) camAmt = 1;
  var k  = 1 + (cam.k-1)*camAmt;
  var ox = lerp(W/2, cam.x, camAmt), oy = lerp(GH/2, cam.y, camAmt);
  var dx = (wx + drift.x*depth - ox)*k;
  var dy = (wy + drift.y*depth - oy)*k;
  /* Off-focus space folds toward the rim. Log, not asymptotic: distant teams
     keep their order and stay apart instead of piling up on the edge. */
  var sq = squashAmt*camAmt;
  if(sq > 0.002){
    var AX = W*0.40, AY = GH*0.40, R0 = 0.55, KS = 0.34;
    var nx = dx/AX, ny = dy/AY;
    var rn = Math.sqrt(nx*nx + ny*ny);
    if(rn > R0){
      var rr = R0 + KS*Math.log(1 + (rn-R0)/KS);
      var s  = 1 + (rr/rn - 1)*sq;
      dx *= s; dy *= s;
    }
  }
  return {x: W/2 + vcx + dx, y: GH/2 + dy};
}

/* how resolved a thing is right now: 0 = a point of light, 1 = a worker */
function focusAmt(cid){
  if(layer===0) return 0;
  return cid===focusC ? 1 : 0.10;
}

function draw(now){
  now = now||0;
  if(!t0){ t0 = now; lastT = now; }
  dt = clamp((now-lastT)/1000, 0, 0.05);
  lastT = now;
  /* wall-clock, so a backgrounded tab resumes in sync instead of
     replaying a backlog of events all at once */
  time = (now-t0)/1000; frame++;

  drift.x = Math.sin(time*0.062)*15 + Math.sin(time*0.021)*7;
  drift.y = Math.cos(time*0.049)*11 + Math.cos(time*0.017)*5;

  /* camera glides; scale eases in log space so the zoom reads as a move */
  var T = camTarget(), e = 1-Math.exp(-dt*3.6);
  cam.x = lerp(cam.x, T.x, e);
  cam.y = lerp(cam.y, T.y, e);
  cam.k = Math.exp(lerp(Math.log(cam.k), Math.log(T.k), e));
  vcx   = lerp(vcx, (layer===2 && W>900) ? -168 : 0, e);
  squashAmt = clamp((cam.k-1)/(K1-1), 0, 1);

  NODES.forEach(function(n){
    n.res = lerp(n.res===undefined?0:n.res, focusAmt(n.c), 1-Math.exp(-dt*4.2));
  });

  /* fixed-step physics so behaviour is identical at 60Hz and 120Hz */
  acc += dt;
  var steps=0;
  while(acc >= 1/60 && steps < 3){ physics(); acc -= 1/60; steps++; }
  if(acc > 1/6) acc = 0;

  tickEvents();

  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  ctx.fillStyle=C.deep;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  drawDust();
  drawNebulae();
  drawRails();
  drawClusterLabels();
  drawStandingThreads();
  drawThreads();
  drawNodes();
  drawBreadcrumb();
  drawFootnote();

  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}

/* ---------- deep dust, parallax by depth ---------- */
function drawDust(){
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  for(var i=0;i<dust.length;i++){
    var d=dust[i];
    var wx = d.x*W, wy = d.y*GH;
    var P = view(wx, wy, 0.10 + d.z*1.5, 0.08 + d.z*0.45);
    if(P.x < -14 || P.x > W+14 || P.y < -14 || P.y > GH+14) continue;
    var tw = 0.35 + 0.65*(0.5+0.5*Math.sin(time*d.sp + d.tw));
    var a = (0.020 + d.z*0.075) * tw;
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.star, a);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(P.x, P.y, d.r*(0.5+d.z), 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
}

/* what's wrong inside a team — this is what tints the mass from orbit */
function clusterTrouble(mem){
  var t = null;
  for(var i=0;i<mem.length;i++){
    var ps = paceState(mem[i]);
    if(ps==='blocked') return 'blocked';
    if(ps==='behind') t = 'behind';
  }
  return t;
}

/* ---------- LAYER 1: teams as soft masses of light ---------- */
function drawNebulae(){
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  CLUSTERS.forEach(function(c){
    var mem = NODES.filter(function(n){return n.c===c.id;});
    var live = 0; mem.forEach(function(n){ live += n.b; });
    live = mem.length ? live/mem.length : 0;

    var fa = focusAmt(c.id);
    c.fa  = lerp(c.fa===undefined?0:c.fa, fa, 1-Math.exp(-dt*4.2));
    var dk = lerp(lerp(1, 0.45, squashAmt), cam.k, c.fa);   /* off-focus shrinks */

    var P = view(c.cx, c.cy, 0.45, 1);
    c.sx = P.x; c.sy = P.y;
    c.sr = (c.rr*1.30 + 34)*dk;

    /* from orbit the mass is the object; inside it, it's just ambience */
    var sky  = 1 - c.fa;
    var hov  = (hoverC===c.id && layer===0) ? 1 : 0;
    var R    = (c.rr*2.35 + 46)*dk;

    /* trouble doesn't sit on top of the team colour — it becomes it.
       From orbit a team in trouble simply glows the wrong colour. */
    var tr  = clusterTrouble(mem);
    c.trouble = tr;
    var col = tr ? (tr==='blocked' ? C.red : C.amber) : null;
    var pul = tr ? 0.5+0.5*Math.sin(time*(tr==='blocked'?2.6:1.5) + c.seed) : 0;
    var tint = tr
      ? mixHex(c.tint, col, (tr==='blocked'?0.86:0.68)*(0.30+0.70*sky))
      : c.tint;

    var base = (0.030 + 0.032*live) + sky*(0.105 + 0.075*live) + hov*0.045;
    base *= (0.9 + 0.1*Math.sin(time*0.5 + c.seed));
    if(tr) base *= (1 + (tr==='blocked'?0.85:0.45)*(0.45+0.55*pul)*sky);

    var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(P.x,P.y,0,P.x,P.y,R);
    g.addColorStop(0,   rgba(tint, base));
    g.addColorStop(0.42,rgba(tint, base*0.42));
    g.addColorStop(1,   rgba(tint, 0));
    ctx.fillStyle=g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(P.x,P.y,R,0,TAU); ctx.fill();

    /* a brighter core, so the mass has a centre to read and click */
    if(sky > 0.02){
      var CR = (c.rr*0.80 + 20)*dk;
      var hot = tr ? mixHex(C.star, col, 0.70*sky) : C.star;
      var cg = ctx.createRadialGradient(P.x,P.y,0,P.x,P.y,CR);
      cg.addColorStop(0,   rgba(hot,  sky*(0.10 + 0.11*live)));
      cg.addColorStop(0.5, rgba(tint, sky*(0.08 + 0.085*live)));
      cg.addColorStop(1,   rgba(tint, 0));
      ctx.fillStyle=cg;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(P.x,P.y,CR,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    }

    /* a slow swell at the edge of a stuck team — catches the eye without
       drawing a circle on the sky */
    if(tr==='blocked' && sky > 0.05){
      var RR = c.sr*(1.05 + 0.22*pul);
      var eg = ctx.createRadialGradient(P.x,P.y,RR*0.72,P.x,P.y,RR);
      eg.addColorStop(0, rgba(col, 0));
      eg.addColorStop(0.7,rgba(col, 0.085*sky*(0.35+0.65*pul)));
      eg.addColorStop(1, rgba(col, 0));
      ctx.fillStyle=eg;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(P.x,P.y,RR,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    }
  });
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
}

/* ---------- the seven rails, and clients travelling them ---------- */
function drawRails(){
  /* rails sit deepest — the camera barely bites them */
  var RC = 0.28, RD = 0.28;
  function rp(i,u){ var p = railPoint(i,u); return view(p.x, p.y, RD, RC); }
  var nameA = 1 - squashAmt;   /* labels recede as you zoom into a team */

  /* which rails are hot right now */
  var hot = {};
  pulses.forEach(function(p){ hot[p.rail] = Math.max(hot[p.rail]||0, 1-Math.abs(p.t/p.dur*2-1)); });

  for(var i=0;i<RAILS.length;i++){
    var heat = hot[i]||0;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(var s=0;s<=44;s++){
      var pt = rp(i, s/44);
      if(s===0) ctx.moveTo(pt.x, pt.y); else ctx.lineTo(pt.x, pt.y);
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(C.star2, 0.030 + heat*0.055);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    /* rail name, whispered at the left edge */
    if(nameA > 0.02){
      var lp = rp(i, 0.012);
      ctx.font = '600 8.5px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
      ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.star2, (0.085 + heat*0.42)*nameA);
      ctx.fillText(RAILS[i].name.toUpperCase(), lp.x+46, lp.y-11);
    }
  }

  /* the pulse: a client advancing a stage, moving */
  for(var k=pulses.length-1;k>=0;k--){
    var p = pulses[k];
    p.t += dt;
    if(p.t>p.dur){ pulses.splice(k,1); continue; }
    var q = p.t/p.dur;
    var u = p.u0 + easeInOut(clamp(q/0.86,0,1))*p.span;
    var fade = q<0.10 ? q/0.10 : q>0.80 ? (1-q)/0.20 : 1;
    fade = clamp(fade,0,1);

    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    /* comet tail */
    for(var tl=10;tl>=0;tl--){
      var uu = u - tl*0.0085;
      if(uu<0) continue;
      var pt = rp(p.rail, uu);
      var a = fade*(1-tl/11)*0.55;
      ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.glow, a*0.8);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, (1-tl/13)*2.6, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    }
    var head = rp(p.rail, u);
    var hg = ctx.createRadialGradient(head.x,head.y,0,head.x,head.y,26);
    hg.addColorStop(0, rgba(C.glow, 0.55*fade));
    hg.addColorStop(0.35,rgba(C.glow, 0.20*fade));
    hg.addColorStop(1, rgba(C.glow, 0));
    ctx.fillStyle=hg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(head.x, head.y, 26, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';

    ctx.font='500 9.5px Inter, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.star, 0.52*fade);
    ctx.fillText(p.label, head.x+13, head.y-10);
  }
}

function drawClusterLabels(){
  ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  CLUSTERS.forEach(function(c){
    var mem = NODES.filter(function(n){return n.c===c.id;});
    var act=0, blk=0, bhd=0;
    mem.forEach(function(n){
      if(n.state==='active')act++;
      if(paceState(n)==='blocked')blk++; else if(paceState(n)==='behind')bhd++;
    });

    /* big from orbit; fades once you're standing inside the team */
    var sky = 1 - c.fa;
    var em  = 0.16 + 0.84*sky;
    if(hoverC===c.id && layer===0) em = 1;
    if(em < 0.03) return;

    var y = c.sy - (c.sr*0.74 + 26);
    var big = layer===0;

    ctx.font = big ? '700 11px "JetBrains Mono", monospace' : '700 9px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.star, (big?0.50:0.19)*em);
    ctx.fillText(c.name.toUpperCase(), c.sx, y);

    var note = act+' working  ·  '+mem.length+' total';
    var col  = C.star, ca = (big?0.26:0.115)*em;
    if(blk){ note = blk+' BLOCKED  ·  '+act+' working'; col = C.red;   ca = (big?0.92:0.45)*em; }
    else if(bhd){ note = bhd+' behind  ·  '+act+' working'; col = C.amber; ca = (big?0.80:0.40)*em; }

    ctx.font = big ? '600 9.5px "JetBrains Mono", monospace' : '400 8.5px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(col, ca);
    ctx.fillText(note, c.sx, y + (big?15:12));
  });
}

function ctrl(a,b,off){
  var mx=(a.x+b.x)/2, my=(a.y+b.y)/2;
  var dx=b.x-a.x, dy=b.y-a.y;
  return {x: mx - dy*off, y: my + dx*off};
}
function qbez(p0,p1,p2,t){
  var u=1-t;
  return {x:u*u*p0.x+2*u*t*p1.x+t*t*p2.x, y:u*u*p0.y+2*u*t*p1.y+t*t*p2.y};
}
function scr(n){ return view(n.x, n.y, 0.42 + 0.62*n.z, 1); }

/* a thread is worth drawing when at least one end is resolved; from orbit only
   the wires *between* teams still read, and then only faintly */
function threadVis(a,b){
  if(layer===0) return a.c===b.c ? 0.16 : 0.70;
  return clamp(Math.max(a.res||0, b.res||0), 0.18, 1);
}

/* ---------- two people on the same file: a thread that just sits there ---------- */
function drawStandingThreads(){
  STANDING.forEach(function(pr,i){
    var a=ND[pr[0]], b=ND[pr[1]]; if(!a||!b) return;
    var A=scr(a), B=scr(b);
    var cp = ctrl(A,B, 0.10*(i%2?1:-1));
    var sh = 0.5+0.5*Math.sin(time*0.6 + i);
    var em = (sel && (sel===a.id||sel===b.id)) ? 3.2 : 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(A.x,A.y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cp.x,cp.y,B.x,B.y);
    ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(C.star2, (0.026 + sh*0.020)*em*threadVis(a,b));
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.9; ctx.stroke();
  });
}

/* ---------- live handoffs: an actual line, and something travelling it ---------- */
function drawThreads(){
  for(var i=threads.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    var t = threads[i];
    t.t += dt;
    if(t.t>t.dur){ threads.splice(i,1); continue; }
    var A=scr(t.a), B=scr(t.b);
    var cp = ctrl(A,B,t.off);
    var travel = clamp(t.t/2.4, 0, 1);
    var u = easeInOut(travel);
    var life = t.t<0.35 ? t.t/0.35 : t.t>(t.dur-2.4) ? (t.dur-t.t)/2.4 : 1;
    life = clamp(life,0,1);
    var em = (sel && (sel===t.a.id||sel===t.b.id)) ? 2.6 : 1;
    em *= threadVis(t.a, t.b);

    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(A.x,A.y,B.x,B.y);
    g.addColorStop(0, rgba(CL[t.a.c].tint, 0.34*life*em));
    g.addColorStop(1, rgba(CL[t.b.c].tint, 0.34*life*em));
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(A.x,A.y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cp.x,cp.y,B.x,B.y);
    ctx.strokeStyle=g; ctx.lineWidth=1.15; ctx.stroke();

    if(travel<1){
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
      for(var k=7;k>=0;k--){
        var uu = clamp(u - k*0.022, 0, 1);
        var pt = qbez(A,cp,B,uu);
        var a = (1-k/8)*0.85*life;
        ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.glow, a*0.55);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pt.x,pt.y,(1-k/10)*2.4,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      }
      var hp = qbez(A,cp,B,u);
      var hg = ctx.createRadialGradient(hp.x,hp.y,0,hp.x,hp.y,18);
      hg.addColorStop(0, rgba('#FFFFFF', 0.55*life));
      hg.addColorStop(0.4,rgba(C.glow, 0.18*life));
      hg.addColorStop(1, rgba(C.glow, 0));
      ctx.fillStyle=hg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(hp.x,hp.y,18,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    } else if(!t.landed){
      t.landed = true;
      t.b.flash = Math.max(t.b.flash, 0.95);
      t.b.hit = 1;
    }

    var mid = qbez(A,cp,B,0.5);
    var la = life * (travel<0.25?travel/0.25:1) * 0.62 * clamp(em,0,1.2);
    ctx.shadowColor='rgba(6,6,10,0.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur=6;
    ctx.font='500 9.5px Inter, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.star, la*0.85);
    ctx.fillText(t.a.name+'  →  '+t.b.name, mid.x, mid.y-9);
    ctx.font='400 9px Inter, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.star2, la*0.75);
    ctx.fillText(t.label, mid.x, mid.y+3);
    ctx.shadowBlur=0; ctx.shadowColor='transparent';
  }
}

/* ---------- the workers ---------- */
function drawNodes(){
  var order = NODES.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return a.z-b.z; });

  order.forEach(function(n){
    var S = scr(n);
    var res = n.res===undefined ? 0 : n.res;
    var dk  = lerp(lerp(1, 0.45, squashAmt), cam.k, res); /* only focus magnifies */
    var ds  = 0.72 + 0.42*n.z;
    var r   = n.r*ds*(0.34 + 0.66*res)*dk;
    n.sx=S.x; n.sy=S.y; n.dr=r; n.hit_ok = res > 0.35;

    var ps = paceState(n);
    var pc = paceColor(ps);
    var isSel = (sel===n.id), isHov=(hover===n.id);

    /* em: how present this worker is at the current layer */
    var em = 0.22 + 0.78*res;
    if(layer===2 && res>0.5 && !isSel) em *= 0.40;   /* cluster-mates recede */
    if(isSel) em = 1;
    if(isHov) em = Math.max(em, 0.90);

    var b  = clamp(n.b + n.flash*0.55, 0, 1.35);
    if(isSel||isHov) b = Math.max(b, 0.95);

    /* off-screen once folded to the edge — skip the expensive parts */
    if(S.x < -140 || S.x > W+140 || S.y < -140 || S.y > GH+140) return;

    /* --- pace halo: only behind + blocked get to be loud --- */
    if(ps==='behind'){
      var br = 0.5+0.5*Math.sin(time*1.5);
      var hg = ctx.createRadialGradient(S.x,S.y,r*0.7,S.x,S.y,r*3.3);
      hg.addColorStop(0, rgba(C.amber, (0.16+0.09*br)*em));
      hg.addColorStop(1, rgba(C.amber, 0));
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
      ctx.fillStyle=hg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.x,S.y,r*3.3,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    }
    if(ps==='blocked'){
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
      var bp = 0.5+0.5*Math.sin(time*2.6);
      var rg = ctx.createRadialGradient(S.x,S.y,r*0.6,S.x,S.y,r*4.1);
      rg.addColorStop(0, rgba(C.red, (0.26+0.14*bp)*em));
      rg.addColorStop(1, rgba(C.red, 0));
      ctx.fillStyle=rg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.x,S.y,r*4.1,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      /* shockwaves */
      for(var w=0;w<3;w++){
        var wt = ((time*0.5 + w/3) % 1);
        var wr = r*1.1 + wt*r*3.0;
        ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(C.red, (1-wt)*0.30*em);
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.4*(1-wt)+0.4;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.x,S.y,wr,0,TAU); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    }

    /* --- core glow: brightness = working right now --- */
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    var glowR = r*(2.5 + 1.4*b);
    var tint = CL[n.c].tint;
    var gg = ctx.createRadialGradient(S.x,S.y,0,S.x,S.y,glowR);
    gg.addColorStop(0,   rgba(tint, 0.30*b*em));
    gg.addColorStop(0.30,rgba(tint, 0.11*b*em));
    gg.addColorStop(1,   rgba(tint, 0));
    ctx.fillStyle=gg; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.x,S.y,glowR,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';

    /* --- body: an opaque mass first, so a node always reads as an object --- */
    var soft = clamp(1-n.z, 0, 1);
    var body = ctx.createRadialGradient(S.x-r*0.26, S.y-r*0.30, r*0.05, S.x, S.y, r);
    body.addColorStop(0,   C.bodyHi);
    body.addColorStop(0.55,C.bodyMid);
    body.addColorStop(1,   C.bodyLo);
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(0.50+0.50*n.z, 0, 1)*em;
    ctx.fillStyle = body;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.x,S.y,r,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    /* luminous fill — brightness is the "working right now" channel */
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
    var lum = ctx.createRadialGradient(S.x-r*0.24, S.y-r*0.28, r*0.04, S.x, S.y, r);
    lum.addColorStop(0,   rgba('#FFFFFF', (0.05+0.38*b)*em));
    lum.addColorStop(0.44,rgba(tint,      (0.09+0.44*b)*em));
    lum.addColorStop(1,   rgba(tint, 0));
    ctx.fillStyle=lum;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.x,S.y,r,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';

    /* rim — softens the further back it sits: depth without a camera */
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.x,S.y,r,0,TAU);
    ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(C.star, (0.05+0.24*b)*(1-soft*0.60)*em);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke();

    /* everything below is worker-layer detail: it fades out toward orbit,
       where the cluster's own glow carries the signal instead */
    var dem = em*res;
    if(dem < 0.035) return;

    /* --- ring = pace. on-pace stays almost invisible --- */
    var pv = (n.pace===null||n.pace===undefined) ? null : clamp(n.pace,0,1);
    var ringR = r + 5*clamp(dk*0.62, 1, 2.2);
    if(pv!==null){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.x,S.y,ringR,0,TAU);
      ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(C.neutral, 0.55*dem); ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.stroke();
      var arcA = ps==='blocked' ? 1 : pv;
      var alpha = ps==='on' ? 0.42 : ps==='ahead' ? 0.50 : 0.90;
      if(ps==='behind') alpha = 0.72 + 0.22*Math.sin(time*1.5);
      if(ps==='blocked') alpha = 0.80 + 0.20*Math.sin(time*2.6);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(S.x,S.y,ringR, -Math.PI/2, -Math.PI/2 + arcA*TAU);
      ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(pc, alpha*dem);
      ctx.lineWidth = (ps==='on'||ps==='ahead') ? 1.9 : 2.6;
      ctx.lineCap='round'; ctx.stroke(); ctx.lineCap='butt';
    }
    /* ahead: one quiet green tick, nothing more */
    if(ps==='ahead'){
      var ax = S.x + Math.cos(-0.72)*(ringR+0.5), ay = S.y + Math.sin(-0.72)*(ringR+0.5);
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
      var ag=ctx.createRadialGradient(ax,ay,0,ax,ay,7);
      ag.addColorStop(0, rgba(C.green,0.85*dem)); ag.addColorStop(1, rgba(C.green,0));
      ctx.fillStyle=ag; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ax,ay,7,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
      ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.green, 0.92*dem);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ax,ay,2.4,0,TAU); ctx.fill();
    }

    /* selection */
    if(isSel){
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.x,S.y,ringR+7,0,TAU);
      ctx.strokeStyle=rgba('#FFFFFF',0.42); ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.x,S.y,ringR+7+4*(0.5+0.5*Math.sin(time*2)),0,TAU);
      ctx.strokeStyle=rgba('#FFFFFF',0.10); ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.stroke();
    }

    /* handoff landing flash */
    if(n.hit>0.02){
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
      var fr = ringR + (1-n.hit)*26;
      ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(C.glow, n.hit*0.5*dem);
      ctx.lineWidth=1.6; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.x,S.y,fr,0,TAU); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
    }

    /* initials */
    if(r>13){
      ctx.font='700 '+Math.round(clamp(r*0.52,9,26))+'px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
      ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillStyle = rgba('#FFFFFF', (0.28+0.55*b)*dem);
      ctx.fillText(n.ini, S.x, S.y+0.5);
    }

    /* text sits on top of a lot of glow — give it a dark halo */
    ctx.shadowColor='rgba(6,6,10,0.92)'; ctx.shadowBlur=7;

    /* name */
    ctx.font='600 10.5px Inter, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='top';
    var na = (0.22 + 0.62*b)*dem;
    if(isSel||isHov) na = res;
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.star, na);
    ctx.fillText(n.name, S.x, S.y + r + 7);

    /* role, only when it's worth reading */
    if(b>0.55 || isHov || isSel){
      ctx.font='400 8.5px Inter, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.star2, (0.30+0.42*b)*dem);
      ctx.fillText(n.role, S.x, S.y + r + 20);
    }

    /* what they're doing — always shown for the ones you need to look at */
    var showAct = (ps==='blocked' || ps==='behind' || isHov || isSel);
    if(showAct){
      var ac = ps==='blocked'?'#F2A69B' : ps==='behind'?'#F5CE8F' : '#A9C6E8';
      ctx.font='500 9.5px Inter, sans-serif';
      ctx.fillStyle = rgba(ac, 0.92*res);
      var txt = n.act;
      if(txt.length>46) txt = txt.slice(0,44)+'…';
      ctx.fillText(txt, S.x, S.y + r + 32);
      if(ps==='behind' && n.behindFor){
        ctx.font='700 8.5px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
        ctx.fillStyle=rgba(C.amber,0.95*res);
        ctx.fillText('BEHIND '+n.behindFor.toUpperCase(), S.x, S.y+r+45);
      }
      if(ps==='blocked'){
        ctx.font='700 8.5px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
        ctx.fillStyle=rgba(C.red,(0.95+0.05*Math.sin(time*4))*res);
        ctx.fillText('BLOCKED '+(n.behindFor||'').toUpperCase(), S.x, S.y+r+45);
      }
    }
    ctx.shadowBlur=0; ctx.shadowColor='transparent';
  });
}

/* ---------- where you are, and how to get back ---------- */
function drawBreadcrumb(){
  var crumbs = [{t:'Sky', on: layer===0}];
  if(focusC) crumbs.push({t: CL[focusC].name, on: layer===1});
  if(sel && layer===2) crumbs.push({t: ND[sel].name, on:true});

  ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  var x = 18, y = 20;
  for(var i=0;i<crumbs.length;i++){
    if(i){
      ctx.font='400 11px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.star2, 0.55);
      ctx.fillText('/', x, y);
      x += ctx.measureText('/').width + 7;
    }
    ctx.font = (crumbs[i].on?'700 ':'400 ')+'11px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(crumbs[i].on?C.star:C.star2, crumbs[i].on?0.92:0.50);
    ctx.fillText(crumbs[i].t, x, y);
    x += ctx.measureText(crumbs[i].t).width + 7;
  }

  if(layer>0){
    ctx.font='400 9px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = rgba(C.star2, 0.42);
    ctx.fillText('click empty space to pull back', 18, y+16);
  }
}

function drawFootnote(){
  ctx.font='400 8.5px "JetBrains Mono", monospace';
  ctx.textAlign='left'; ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  ctx.fillStyle=rgba(C.star2,0.42);
  ctx.fillText('FUNDHUB-GALAXY · v1 · ORG: fundhub · read-only — no actions from this screen · work product only · named activity: consent on file for all shown', 16, H-9);
}

/* ============================================================
   6. NAVIGATION — zoom is the only control. Sky → cluster → worker.
      Still read-only: nothing here changes anything.
   ============================================================ */

var panel = document.getElementById('panel');
var panelBody = document.getElementById('panelBody');

function hitTest(mx,my){
  var best=null, bd=1e9;
  for(var i=0;i<NODES.length;i++){
    var n=NODES[i];
    if(n.sx===undefined || !n.hit_ok) continue;
    var d=Math.hypot(mx-n.sx, my-n.sy);
    if(d < n.dr+13 && d<bd){ bd=d; best=n; }
  }
  return best;
}

/* clusters are the objects at orbit — pick by how deep inside the mass you are */
function hitCluster(mx,my){
  var best=null, bs=1e9;
  for(var i=0;i<CLUSTERS.length;i++){
    var c=CLUSTERS[i];
    if(c.sx===undefined) continue;
    var s = Math.hypot(mx-c.sx, my-c.sy) / Math.max(c.sr, 1);
    if(s < 1 && s < bs){ bs=s; best=c; }
  }
  return best;
}

/* ---------- moving between layers. always a camera move, never a cut ---------- */
function goCluster(cid){
  layer = 1; focusC = cid;
  sel = null; panel.classList.remove('open');
}
function goWorker(nid){
  var n = ND[nid]; if(!n) return;
  layer = 2; focusC = n.c; sel = nid;
  renderPanel(n); panel.classList.add('open');
}
function goOut(){
  if(layer===2){ layer = 1; sel = null; panel.classList.remove('open'); }
  else if(layer===1){ layer = 0; focusC = null; }
}

cv.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
  var r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();
  mouse.x=e.clientX-r.left; mouse.y=e.clientY-r.top;
  var n = layer>0 ? hitTest(mouse.x,mouse.y) : null;
  hover = n?n.id:null;
  var c = n ? null : hitCluster(mouse.x,mouse.y);
  hoverC = c ? c.id : null;
  cv.style.cursor = (n || (c && c.id!==focusC)) ? 'pointer' : (layer>0 ? 'zoom-out' : 'default');
});
cv.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){ hover=null; hoverC=null; mouse.x=-999; });
cv.addEventListener('click', function(e){
  var r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();
  var mx=e.clientX-r.left, my=e.clientY-r.top;

  if(layer>0){
    var n = hitTest(mx,my);
    if(n){
      if(n.c===focusC) goWorker(n.id); else goCluster(n.c);
      return;
    }
  }
  var c = hitCluster(mx,my);
  if(c && (layer===0 || c.id!==focusC)){ goCluster(c.id); return; }
  goOut();
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape') goOut(); });

function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'); }

function renderPanel(n){
  var ps = paceState(n);
  var paceTxt = ps==='blocked' ? 'BLOCKED · '+(n.behindFor||'')
              : ps==='behind'  ? Math.round(n.pace*100)+'% of pace · behind '+(n.behindFor||'')
              : ps==='ahead'   ? Math.round(n.pace*100)+'% of pace · ahead'
              : ps==='on'      ? Math.round(n.pace*100)+'% of pace · on track'
              : 'No target set · pace not tracked';
  var paceCls = ps==='blocked'?'blocked':ps==='behind'?'behind':ps==='ahead'?'ahead':ps==='on'?'on':'none';
  var nowCls  = ps==='blocked'?'blocked':ps==='behind'?'behind':'';

  var rows = n.stats.map(function(s){
    var cls='';
    if(/BLOCKED/.test(s[1])) cls=' red';
    else if(/behind|ago/.test(s[1])) cls=' amber';
    return '<div class="p-row"><span class="k">'+esc(s[0])+'</span><span class="v'+cls+'">'+esc(s[1])+'</span></div>';
  }).join('');

  var tl = n.tl.map(function(t,i){
    return '<div class="p-tl-i'+(i===n.tl.length-1?' now':'')+'"><span class="t">'+esc(t[0])+'</span><span class="x">'+esc(t[1])+'</span></div>';
  }).join('');

  var chips = (n.files||[]).map(function(f){ return '<span class="p-chip">'+esc(f)+'</span>'; }).join('');

  panelBody.innerHTML =
    '<div class="p-top"><div>'+
      '<div class="p-kicker">'+(n.kind==='agent'?'Agent':'Person')+' · '+esc(CL[n.c].name)+'</div>'+
      '<div class="p-name"><span class="av '+(n.kind==='agent'?'agent':'human')+'">'+esc(n.ini)+'</span> '+esc(n.name)+'</div>'+
      '<div class="p-role">'+esc(n.role)+'</div>'+
    '</div><button class="p-close" id="pClose">esc</button></div>'+
    '<div class="p-pace '+paceCls+'">'+esc(paceTxt)+'</div>'+
    '<div class="p-now '+nowCls+'">'+
      '<div class="p-now-k">Right now</div>'+
      '<div class="p-now-v">'+esc(n.act)+'</div>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<div class="p-sec"><div class="p-sec-t">Presence</div>'+
      '<div class="p-row"><span class="k">'+(n.kind==='agent'?'Runtime start':'Shift start')+'</span><span class="v">'+esc(n.shift)+'</span></div>'+
      '<div class="p-row"><span class="k">'+(n.kind==='agent'?'Uptime':'On shift')+'</span><span class="v">'+esc(n.on)+'</span></div>'+
      '<div class="p-row"><span class="k">State</span><span class="v'+(n.state==='blocked'?' red':n.state==='idle'?' amber':' green')+'">'+n.state.toUpperCase()+'</span></div>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<div class="p-sec"><div class="p-sec-t">Output today</div>'+rows+
      '<div class="p-row"><span class="k">Total events</span><span class="v">'+n.out+' '+esc(n.unit)+'</span></div>'+
    '</div>'+

/* Live clock in America/Phoenix. Timeline stamps use the same clock. */
function nowClock(shortT){
  var d = new Date();
  if (shortT) {
    return d.toLocaleString("en-US", {
      hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit",
      timeZone: "America/Phoenix"
    });
  }
  return d.toLocaleString("en-US", {
    weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit",
    timeZone: "America/Phoenix", timeZoneName: "short"
  });
}
