<script>

/* Partner Galaxy — the census line reports the partner's OWN book only.
   Scoping is server-side (src/partners/scope.mjs); this screen never filters
   client data itself, so there is nothing here that could leak another
   partner's book by getting a predicate wrong. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var esc = function (v) {
    return String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;" }[c]; });
  };
  /* Report the partner census in the BANNER, and leave #census alone.

     Two things were wrong with writing into #census. First, chrome() runs on a
     1000ms setInterval and rewrites that element from the sample NODES array,
     so the real figures survived for under a second and the screen then showed
     sample text under a mint "live partner census" badge indefinitely. Second
     — and this would have been wrong even without the ticker — #census does not
     describe partners at all. It is the swarm read-out: "N workers · N working
     · N idle". Partner counts and accrued dollars written into it were a
     category error dressed as live data.

     This screen has no element that describes partners, and inventing one would
     be changing the approved layout. The banner is the honest place for it. */
  /* THE BANNER USED TO LIE, TWICE, IN ONE LINE. (T10-01, 2026-08-19)

     It built "/sites/<partner id>/apply" out of the SESSION ALONE, labelled it
     "Your page ·", and never asked whether any such page was live. The partner
     whose only page was a draft saw a web address on their Home screen, clicked
     it, and got a 404. Nothing here ever said "draft". Second lie: the words on
     screen were the /sites/ address while the link underneath them went to
     brand-studio.html — the text and the destination were different places.

     The 404 is correct: a draft is not public, and it must not become public
     because a banner promised it. So the banner is what changes. It now reads
     GET /api/partner-pages, which ALREADY reports status plus live_path and
     live_url (both NULL unless status = 'published'), and it says what is true:
     live → the real address, and the link goes to that same address; draft →
     says draft and points at Brand Studio, where Publish lives; nothing on file
     → says that. If the read fails it says nothing new rather than guessing.

     It adds NO control and no new surface. Publish stays in Brand Studio and
     pressing it stays the partner's own decision — this screen only reports. */
  /* TWO MORE THINGS THIS BANNER OWES THE PARTNER. (T10-01b, 2026-08-19)

     1. A READ THAT FAILS HAS TO SAY SO. The first pass left the page's own
     starting words in place when either read failed — "Your page · sign in to
     see your address". A partner who IS signed in then reads a caption telling
     them to sign in. That is a wrong caption on a real failure path, so the
     banner now says the true thing: we could not load your page details right
     now. The one case where "sign in" really is the answer — the server itself
     refusing the session as expired — gets its own words and keeps that meaning.

     2. WITH MORE THAN ONE PAGE, WHICH ONE IS "YOUR PAGE" IS NOW A DECISION.
     /api/partner-pages lists newest-edited first and does not sort by kind, so
     "the first published page" quietly meant "whichever page they last touched".
     A partner whose apply page is still a draft but whose thank-you page is live
     would have seen the thank-you address labelled "Your page". True address,
     wrong name for it. The apply page is the one a partner hands out, so the
     apply page is what "Your page" means here, and nothing else is allowed to
     borrow that label. If the apply page is not live and something else is, the
     banner says exactly that and shows the address that IS live. */
  (function showOwnUrl() {
    var el = document.getElementById("wl-own-url");
    if (!el) return;
    var tok = "";
    try { tok = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { tok = ""; }
    // Nobody is signed in, so the words already on the page are true. Leave them.
    if (!tok || tok === "demo") return;
    var auth = { accept: "application/json", authorization: "Bearer " + tok };
    var origin = location.origin || "https://fundhub.ai";

    function studioHref(id) {
      return "brand-studio.html?partner_id=" + encodeURIComponent(id);
    }
    /* The words and the destination come from the same call, so they cannot
       drift apart again: whatever the partner reads is where the link goes. */
    function render(lead, linkText, href) {
      el.textContent = "";
      el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(lead));
      var a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = href;
      a.textContent = linkText;
      el.appendChild(a);
    }
    /* Plain words and no link, for the states where there is nowhere useful to
       send them. Both of these REPLACE the caption — never leave the starting
       words sitting there once we know they are not true. */
    function say(words) { el.textContent = words; }
    function couldNotLoad() {
      say("Your page · we could not load your page details right now");
    }
    function signInAgain() {
      say("Your page · your sign-in has expired — sign in again");
    }

    function isApply(p) { return p.funnel_key === "apply" || p.slug === "apply"; }
    function isLive(p) {
      return p.status === "published" && (p.live_url || p.live_path);
    }
    function addressOf(p) {
      var addr = p.live_url || p.live_path;
      if (!/^https?:/i.test(addr)) addr = origin + addr;
      return addr;
    }

    // Returned instead of a body when a branch has already written the caption,
    // so the step after it does not overwrite the better message with a worse one.
    var SAID = { said: true };

    fetch("/api/auth/session", { headers: auth })
      .then(function (r) {
        if (r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) { signInAgain(); return SAID; }
        return r.ok ? r.json().catch(function () { return null; }) : null;
      })
      .then(function (d) {
        if (d === SAID) return null;
        if (!d) { couldNotLoad(); return null; }
        var id = d.staff && (d.staff.partner_id || d.staff.partnerId);
        // A real answer that says this sign-in is not a partner. Not a failure,
        // and not "sign in" either — they already did.
        if (!id) { say("Your page · this sign-in does not have one"); return null; }
        return fetch("/api/partner-pages?partner_id=" + encodeURIComponent(id), { headers: auth })
          .then(function (r) {
            return r.ok ? r.json().catch(function () { return null; }) : null;
          })
          .then(function (p) {
            var items = (p && p.ok && Array.isArray(p.items)) ? p.items : null;
            if (!items) { couldNotLoad(); return; }   // could not read it — do not guess
            if (!items.length) {
              render("Your page · none made yet — ", "open Brand Studio", studioHref(id));
              return;
            }
            var liveApply = null, liveOther = null;
            for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
              if (!isLive(items[i])) continue;
              if (isApply(items[i])) { liveApply = items[i]; break; }
              if (!liveOther) liveOther = items[i];
            }
            if (liveApply) {
              var addr = addressOf(liveApply);
              render("Your page · ", addr, addr);
              return;
            }
            if (liveOther) {
              var other = addressOf(liveOther);
              render("Your apply page is not live. Live now · ", other, other);
              return;
            }
            render("Your page · draft, not live yet — ", "publish it in Brand Studio",
              studioHref(id));
          });
      }).catch(function () { couldNotLoad(); });
  })();

  // data.js carries `defer` (see its tag above), so FHData does not exist yet
  // while this script is being parsed — calling it here threw, and the throw
  // killed the rest of this IIFE before the census was ever requested. Download
  // wiring lives in its own script so a census throw cannot take it down.
  // Every deferred script runs before DOMContentLoaded, so the first read waits
  // for that event.
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    FHData.wire(FHData.partners({ limit: 200 }), "partner census", function (data) {
      var rows = data.items || [];
      var census = document.getElementById("census");
      if (!rows.length) {
        if (census) census.textContent = "No partners on file";
        return "No partners on file";
      }
      if (census) {
        census.innerHTML = "<b>" + rows.length + "</b> partner" +
          (rows.length === 1 ? "" : "s") + " on file";
      }
      /* MONEY RULE (CLAUDE.md §12 and the owner's 2026-08-19 decision): a NULL
         balance_accrued means "not calculated", NOT "nothing owed". The old
         `Number(p.balance_accrued || 0)` folded every unknown into the sum, so
         this badge printed a confident dollar total that silently left money
         out. Unknowns are counted and named instead. FH-T10-ACCRUED-NULL */
      var unknownOwed = 0;
      var owed = rows.reduce(function (a, p) {
        var v = p.balance_accrued;
        if (v === null || v === undefined || v === "") { unknownOwed++; return a; }
        var n = Number(v);
        if (!isFinite(n)) { unknownOwed++; return a; }
        return a + n;
      }, 0);
      var money = "$" + Math.round(owed).toLocaleString("en-US") + " accrued";
      if (unknownOwed === rows.length) money = "accrued not known yet";
      else if (unknownOwed) money += ", " + unknownOwed + " not known yet";
      var signed = rows.filter(function (p) { return p.agreement_signed; }).length;
      var unsigned = rows.length - signed;
      return "live partner census · " + rows.length + " partner(s) · " + money + " · " +
             (unsigned ? unsigned + " agreement(s) unsigned" : "all agreements signed");
    });
  });
})();

/* Home tiles — T10-02 follow-up. The three KPI tiles that have a real,
   partner-scoped source: see the audit comment near the top of the canvas
   script for which three still do not and why they stay off this screen.

   Every tile below carries a `source` naming the read it comes from —
   src/http/partner-galaxy-tiles.test.mjs fails the build on one that doesn't.
   Built as real DOM nodes fed by a fetch, same family as the wl-own-url
   banner and the partner-census read just above — never drawn on the canvas,
   which is why the canvas script's own checks assume no fetch happens there. */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var HOME_TILES = [
    { id: "cash-collected-today", label: "Cash Collected Today", source: "/api/read/partner-home-tiles" },
    { id: "funded-today", label: "Funded Today", source: "/api/read/partner-home-tiles" },
    { id: "cost-per-funded-client", label: "Cost / Funded Client", source: "/api/read/partner-home-tiles" }
  ];

  var host = document.getElementById("homeTiles");
  if (!host) return;

  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    if (text != null) e.textContent = text;
    return e;
  }

  // Skeletons render immediately, in the real layout — UI-STANDARDS.md §6:
  // never a blank strip, never a full-page spinner, while the read is in flight.
  HOME_TILES.forEach(function (t) {
    var card = el("div", "tile");
    card.setAttribute("data-tile", t.id);
    card.appendChild(el("div", "tile-label", t.label));
    var val = el("div", "tile-value skeleton", "");
    val.id = "tile-value-" + t.id;
    card.appendChild(val);
    var cmp = el("div", "tile-compare", " ");
    cmp.id = "tile-compare-" + t.id;
    card.appendChild(cmp);
    host.appendChild(card);
  });
  var statusEl = el("div", "home-tiles-status", "");
  statusEl.id = "homeTilesStatus";
  statusEl.hidden = true;
  host.appendChild(statusEl);

  // Whole dollars, comma-grouped — matches the accrued-balance figure already
  // on this screen (the partner-census script above), not a second money style.
  function fmtDollars(cents) { return "$" + Math.round(cents / 100).toLocaleString("en-US"); }
  function fmtCount(n) { return Number(n).toLocaleString("en-US"); }

  function setTile(id, valueText, compareText) {
    var v = document.getElementById("tile-value-" + id);
    var c = document.getElementById("tile-compare-" + id);
    if (v) { v.textContent = valueText; v.classList.remove("skeleton"); }
    if (c) c.textContent = compareText || " ";
  }

  function showStatus(text) {
    if (!statusEl) return;
    statusEl.textContent = text || "";
    statusEl.hidden = !text;
  }

  // Zero is a real answer and renders as zero. Unknown renders as "not known",
  // never $0 — the rule the whole endpoint (api/read/partner-home-tiles.mjs)
  // is built around; this function only ever DISPLAYS what it decided.
  function paint(d) {
    setTile("cash-collected-today", fmtDollars(d.cash_collected_today_cents),
      fmtDollars(d.cash_collected_yesterday_cents) + " yesterday");

    setTile("funded-today", fmtCount(d.funded_today),
      fmtCount(d.funded_yesterday) + " yesterday");

    var spendKnown = d.ad_spend_today_cents !== null && d.ad_spend_today_cents !== undefined;
    if (d.cost_per_funded_client_cents === null || d.cost_per_funded_client_cents === undefined) {
      setTile("cost-per-funded-client", "not known",
        spendKnown ? "no funded clients yet" : "ad spend not tracked");
    } else {
      var clientsWord = d.funded_today === 1 ? " client" : " clients";
      setTile("cost-per-funded-client", fmtDollars(d.cost_per_funded_client_cents),
        (spendKnown ? fmtDollars(d.ad_spend_today_cents) : "spend not known") +
        " ÷ " + fmtCount(d.funded_today) + clientsWord);
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    // data.js carries `defer`, so FHData exists by DOMContentLoaded — same
    // reasoning as the partner-census script above.
    if (typeof FHData === "undefined" || typeof FHData.read !== "function") {
      showStatus("Could not load today's numbers right now.");
      return;
    }
    FHData.read("partner-home-tiles").then(function (res) {
      if (res && res.ok && res.data) { paint(res.data); return; }
      var source = res && res.source;
      showStatus((source === "unauthorized" || source === "demo")
        ? "Sign in to see today's numbers."
        : "Could not load today's numbers right now.");
    });
  });
})();

    }).then(function (res) {
      if (!res.ok) {
        return res.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (j) {
          throw new Error(j.error || ("HTTP " + res.status));
        });
      }
      return res.blob();
    }).then(function (blob) {
      var a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = "MessageBlaster.dmg";
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      if (status) status.textContent = "Download started — open the file on your Mac.";
    }).catch(function (e) {
      if (status) status.textContent = "Could not download — " + ((e && e.message) || "error");
    }).finally(function () { btn.disabled = false; });
  });
})();

/* ── THE ONE ESCAPE HATCH (UI-STANDARDS.md §12.7) ─────────────────────────────
   This screen mounts .app-shell, and fundhub-brand.css:184-186 sets
   `font-size:inherit !important` on EVERY element inside it. An important
   author rule beats a normal one whatever the load order, so every plain px
   size this file used to carry was discarded by the browser — the screen was
   painting flat at 16px and the twenty-one declarations above had never once
   had an effect. They are gone rather than left as decoration.

   These class names are h3/h4/div/b/em, so they miss the brand's own caption
   list (.chip .eyebrow .note label th .caption .sub .mono …), which is why they
   need naming here. ONE rule, not two: a second is how a screen ends up with
   six sizes and no hierarchy (§3).

   Not listed on purpose: .release .big and .next .vl. `.big` and `.vl` are on
   the brand's METRIC list, so those two already paint at --fs-metric. That is
   the size they have been rendering at all along, and it is the right one — the
   release sentence and the next gate are what a partner opens this screen for. */
.app-shell :is(.gate h4,.blocked h3,.gcode,.gwk,.gbl,.mno,.cert,
  .mwk,.mgate,.mmsg,.mrow,.blocked .msg,.release .lb,.next .lb,.mrow.hd){
  font-size:var(--fs-caption)!important;
}
</style>

<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}

  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:28px 18px}

  <div class="card">
    <div class="mono">Fundhub · payment</div>
    <h1>Thanks — you are back from checkout</h1>
    <p class="lede">We are checking your account to see what has opened up. Stay on the call with your advisor.</p>
    <div id="state" aria-live="polite"><div class="pend">Checking your account…</div></div>
    <p class="refline" id="refline" hidden></p>
    <p class="fine">This page does not take payments and it cannot confirm one. It only shows what your account says.</p>
    <a class="back" id="back" href="client-portal.html">Back to your portal</a>
  </div>
<script>
/* WHAT THIS PAGE MAY AND MAY NOT SAY.
 *
 * This is the success_url every minted checkout session points at
 * (src/payments/commas-api.mjs). Landing here means the payment page sent the
 * person back. It does NOT mean money moved: nothing on this page sees the
 * payment, and there is no public endpoint that would tell it. So the page no
 * longer says "payment received". It says the one thing it can actually check
 * — what /api/read/entitlements reports as open on the account — and when it
 * cannot check, it says so plainly rather than dressing a guess up as a
 * receipt.
 *
 * THE ONE READ. GET /api/read/entitlements (api/read/entitlements.mjs) answers
 * { ok, count, limit, offset, hasMore, items[] }, and each item carries
 * client_id, entitlement_code, entitlement_name, kind, sort_order, granted_at,
 * expires_at, revoked_at, active, source_transaction_id. A CLIENT session is
 * scoped to its own rows server-side and ?client_id= is ignored for it; a
 * STAFF session is scoped by ?client_id=. No session at all is a 401.
 *
 * THE TWO PARAMETERS arrive on the checkout success URL: `ref` (the payment
 * link reference) and `client_id`. Neither is trusted for anything beyond
 * display and scoping that read — nothing here decides what anybody owns.
 *
 * BASELINE, NOT WISHFUL THINKING. The first successful read is remembered as
 * what was already open. Only a code that appears AFTER that is reported as
 * "just opened". A purchase that posted before this page loaded therefore
 * shows up in the "already open" list instead, which under-claims rather than
 * over-claims — the right direction for a page that cannot see the payment.
 *
 * BOUNDED. Six tries, three seconds apart, then it stops and tells the person
 * what to do. A "Check again" button starts one more round on a human click.
 * Nothing here polls the API forever from a tab somebody left open. */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
  var MAX_TRIES = 6;
  var GAP_MS = 3000;

  var stateEl = document.getElementById("state");
  var refEl = document.getElementById("refline");
  var backEl = document.getElementById("back");

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
  }

  function param(name) {
    try { return new URLSearchParams(location.search).get(name) || ""; }
    catch (e) { return ""; }
  }

  var ref = param("ref");
  var clientId = param("client_id");
  if (!UUID.test(clientId)) clientId = "";

  /* Fall back to the signed-in client's own account, resolved the same way
     client-portal.html resolves it. A malformed id is dropped, not sent. */
  if (!clientId) {
    try {
      var acct = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("fh_account") || "null");
      var own = acct && (acct.clientId || acct.client_id);
      if (own && UUID.test(own)) clientId = own;
    } catch (e) { /* nothing stored — the read may still be scoped by session */ }
  }

  /* client-portal.html opens on nobody when the address bar carries no id, so
     the way out of this page has to carry one. It reads ?id= or ?client_id=. */
  if (clientId && backEl) {
    backEl.href = "client-portal.html?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(clientId);
  }

  if (ref && refEl) {
    refEl.hidden = false;
    refEl.textContent = "Payment reference: " + ref;
  }

  function token() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; }
  }

  function headers() {
    var t = token();
    var h = { accept: "application/json" };
    /* A portal sign-in also sets an HttpOnly cookie, which this page cannot
       read; a same-origin fetch carries it regardless. */
    if (t) h.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
    return h;
  }

  function readUrl() {
    var u = "/api/read/entitlements?limit=200";
    if (clientId) u += "&client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(clientId);
    return u;
  }

  function setState(html) { stateEl.innerHTML = html; wireAgain(); }

  function wireAgain() {
    var b = document.getElementById("again");
    if (b) b.addEventListener("click", function () { start(); });
  }

  function listOf(rows) {
    var out = "<ul>";
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      out += "<li>" + esc(rows[i].entitlement_name || rows[i].entitlement_code) + "</li>";
    }
    return out + "</ul>";
  }

  /* WORDED CONDITIONALLY ON PURPOSE. Every state that uses this line is a state
     where this page read NOTHING back, so it does not know whether a payment
     succeeded. Saying "the payment is done" here would be this page asserting an
     outcome it cannot see — on a regulated consumer-finance product, in the one
     screen a client lands on straight from a card form. "If you completed" is
     the honest form, and "do not pay again" is the part that actually protects
     them either way. */
  var TODO =
    '<p class="fine">What to do: if you completed the payment, tell your advisor and stay ' +
    "on the call. Do not pay again. You can also open your portal in a few minutes " +
    "and look there.</p>";

  var AGAIN = '<button class="btn" type="button" id="again">Check again</button>';

  /* ── the states this page is allowed to be in ─────────────────────────── */

  function showChecking(n) {
    setState('<div class="pend">Checking your account… (' + n + " of " + MAX_TRIES + ")</div>");
  }

  function showOpened(fresh) {
    setState(
      '<div class="ok"><b>Just opened on your account</b>' + listOf(fresh) + "</div>" +
      '<p class="fine">Open your portal to use these.</p>'
    );
  }

  function showNothingNew(held) {
    setState(
      '<div class="warn"><b>Nothing new has opened yet</b>' +
      "<p>Your account already shows these open:</p>" + listOf(held) +
      "<p>A payment can take a few minutes to show up here.</p></div>" +
      TODO + AGAIN
    );
  }

  function showNothingAtAll() {
    setState(
      '<div class="warn"><b>Nothing is open on your account yet</b>' +
      "<p>We checked, and your account shows nothing open. A payment can take a " +
      "few minutes to show up here.</p></div>" +
      TODO + AGAIN
    );
  }

  function showSignedOut() {
    setState(
      '<div class="warn"><b>We cannot check your account from here</b>' +
      "<p>You are not signed in on this device, so this page cannot look up what " +
      "is open on your account.</p></div>" +
      /* No sign-in link of its own: the portal link at the foot of this card
         already bounces a signed-out visitor to /portal-login.html
         (public/app/shell.js), so a second one would be two doors to one room. */
      '<p class="fine">Use the “Back to your portal” link below and sign in there ' +
      "to see what is open. If you completed a payment, do not pay again — tell " +
      "your advisor instead.</p>"
    );
  }

  function showUnknownScope() {
    setState(
      '<div class="warn"><b>We cannot tell which account this is</b>' +
      "<p>This page did not get an account reference, so it cannot say what " +
      "opened up.</p></div>" + TODO
    );
  }

  function showUnreachable() {
    setState(
      '<div class="err"><b>We could not reach your account</b>' +
      "<p>Nothing was read, so this page cannot say what is open, and it cannot " +
      "say whether your payment went through. The failure to read is on our " +
      "side.</p></div>" +
      TODO + AGAIN
    );
  }

  /* ── the bounded poll ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  var tries = 0;
  var baseline = null;   // codes already open on the first successful read
  var timer = null;

  function codesOf(rows) {
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) out.push(rows[i].entitlement_code);
    return out;
  }

  /* The rows this page is willing to show. With a client id we keep only that
     person's; without one we accept the server's own scoping, but only while
     every row belongs to the same person — so a staff session that read widely
     can never paint somebody else's account onto this screen. */
  function mine(items) {
    var rows = [];
    var seen = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      var r = items[i];
      if (!r || !r.active) continue;
      if (clientId) {
        if (r.client_id !== clientId) continue;
      } else {
        if (seen !== null && r.client_id !== seen) return null;
        seen = r.client_id;
      }
      rows.push(r);
    }
    return rows;
  }

  function later(fn) {
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(fn, GAP_MS);
  }

  function retryOrStop(giveUp) {
    if (tries < MAX_TRIES) { later(check); return; }
    giveUp();
  }

  function handle(items) {
    var rows = mine(items);
    if (rows === null) { showUnknownScope(); return; }

    if (baseline === null) baseline = codesOf(rows);

    var fresh = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      if (baseline.indexOf(rows[i].entitlement_code) === -1) fresh.push(rows[i]);
    }

    if (fresh.length) { showOpened(fresh); return; }
    if (tries < MAX_TRIES) { later(check); return; }
    if (rows.length) { showNothingNew(rows); } else { showNothingAtAll(); }
  }

  function check() {
    tries++;
    showChecking(tries);
    var started;
    try {
      started = fetch(readUrl(), { headers: headers(), credentials: "same-origin" });
    } catch (e) {
      retryOrStop(showUnreachable);
      return;
    }
    Promise.resolve(started).then(function (r) {
      return r.json().catch(function () { return null; }).then(function (b) {
        return { status: r.status, body: b };
      });
    }).then(function (res) {
      /* 401 is "sign in", 403 is "this session may not read that". Neither
         changes by asking again, so stop rather than spend the budget. */
      if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) { showSignedOut(); return; }
      if (res.status === 200 && res.body && res.body.ok === true &&
          Object.prototype.toString.call(res.body.items) === "[object Array]") {
        handle(res.body.items);
        return;
      }
      /* Anything else — a 500, or the database saying it is down — is a read
         that did not come back. Retry inside the budget, then say so. */
      retryOrStop(showUnreachable);
    }).catch(function () {
      retryOrStop(showUnreachable);
    });
  }

  function start() {
    tries = 0;
    if (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; }
    check();
  }

  start();
})();
</script>
</body>

  /* ── ON A PHONE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     Both the filter bar and the lens row are built as one horizontal line,
     and on a 390px screen one line is not enough room for either of them.

     Measured at 390, before this block: the filter bar wanted 481px of a
     390px screen, so the search box collapsed to a bare icon with a 4px
     input, "$50,000 est." was cut at the screen edge and "— held" sat 53px
     past it; and on the lens, 82 coloured labels landed on top of the
     sentence beside them with 21 of those running off the card. At 1440 both
     numbers were already zero.

     EVERY RULE IS INSIDE THIS QUERY. At 1440 not one of them matches, so the
     desktop rendering of this screen is exactly what it was. Nothing is
     removed and nothing is reordered at any width — the same controls, in the
     same order, allowed to use a second and third line instead of being
     squeezed off the edge of the first.

     640px, not the 480px used higher up this file, because the squeeze starts
     well above a phone: at 390 the bar overflows by 91px and the search box is
     unusable long before that. */
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    /* THE FILTER BAR WRAPS INSTEAD OF SQUEEZING. Three lines: the view switch,
       then the search with the Filter button, then the summary. */
    .filterbar{flex-wrap:wrap;row-gap:7px;}
    .filterbar .lens-switch{flex:1 0 100%;}
    .filterbar .lens-switch button{flex:1;}
    /* The search stops being a fixed 230px that shrinks to nothing, and
       becomes the line's stretch instead — it is the widest it has ever been
       at this width, not the narrowest. */
    .filterbar .search{width:auto;flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;}
    .filter-chips{flex-wrap:wrap;}

    /* THE HEADLINE IS FIRST ON A PHONE TOO, AND IT STACKS.
       The number and its next action keep the top of the screen; the
       reference counters drop underneath them onto their own line instead of
       being pushed off the right edge by margin-left:auto, which at 390px is
       exactly what the old .filter-spacer did to the money summary. Nothing
       is hidden and nothing is reordered — the same figures, in the same
       order, allowed a second line. */
    .headline{gap:10px;padding:8px 14px 10px;}
    .hl-lead{flex:1 0 100%;}
    .hl-ref{flex:1 0 100%;margin-left:0;gap:6px;}
    .hl-next,.hl-next-btn,.hl-note{max-width:100%;white-space:normal;overflow:visible;}
    .hl-sep{display:none;}
    .board-summary{flex:1 0 100%;flex-wrap:wrap;}
    /* Each figure stays whole. Wrapping BETWEEN them is fine; wrapping inside
       one is what chopped "$50,000" in half. */
    .board-summary > span{white-space:nowrap;}

    /* THE LENS ROW STACKS. The chip and the coloured labels sit under the
       sentence instead of beside it, so a label wider than half the phone has
       somewhere to go and stops landing on top of the words next to it. */
    .fh-lens-row{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:6px;}
    .lr-side{align-items:flex-start;max-width:100%;}
    .lr-blockers{justify-content:flex-start;}
    .lr-blocker{white-space:normal;}
    .fh-chip{white-space:normal;text-align:left;}
    .lr-round{text-align:left;}
  }

<script>


/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   THE BOARD
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function(){
"use strict";
var board   = document.querySelector('.board');
/* scoped to .board on purpose — the demonstration strip at the bottom of the
   page reuses .col / .card markup and must stay out of the live board's model.

   A LIVE query, not a cached array: the live board (below) tears down and
   rebuilds .col sections on every pipeline switch, so a snapshot taken once
   at load would go stale the first time a real board replaces the sample
   columns and point drag/sort at detached nodes. */
function cols(){ return [].slice.call(board.querySelectorAll('.col')); }
var STORE   = 'fundhub.pipeline.sales';

function cards(){ return [].slice.call(board.querySelectorAll('.col-body > .card')); }
function nameOf(c){ var n=c.querySelector('.c-name'); return n?n.textContent.trim():''; }
function colOf(c){ return c.closest('.col'); }
function colName(col){ return col.querySelector('.col-name').textContent.trim(); }

/* ---- money + counts move by DELTA, never recomputed from the DOM: the
        columns show real totals (42) while rendering only a few cards. ---- */
function money(el){ var m=(el.textContent||'').replace(/[^0-9.]/g,''); return m?parseFloat(m):0; }
function fmt(n){ return '$'+Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US'); }
function amountOf(card){ var a=card.querySelector('.c-amt'); return a?money(a):0; }

function bump(col,dCount,dMoney){
  var cEl=col.querySelector('.col-count');
  cEl.textContent=String(Math.max(0,parseInt(cEl.textContent,10)+dCount));
  var mEl=col.querySelector('.col-money');
  if(mEl){ mEl.textContent=fmt(Math.max(0,money(mEl)+dMoney))+' est.'; }
}

/* ---- in-session persistence was sessionStorage only; real cards now
        persist through /api/pipeline-cards. Sample markup cards (no
        data-client-id) still use sessionStorage so the demo strip keeps
        working offline. ---- */
function save(){
  var map={};
  var live=cols();
  cards().forEach(function(c){
    if(c.dataset.clientId) return; // live cards persist via API
    map[nameOf(c)]=live.indexOf(colOf(c));
  });
  try{ sessionStorage.setItem(STORE,JSON.stringify(map)); }catch(e){}
}
function restore(){
  var raw; try{ raw=sessionStorage.getItem(STORE); }catch(e){ return; }
  if(!raw) return;
  var map; try{ map=JSON.parse(raw); }catch(e){ return; }
  var live=cols();
  cards().forEach(function(c){
    if(c.dataset.clientId) return;
    var want=map[nameOf(c)];
    if(want===undefined) return;
    var from=colOf(c), to=live[want];
    if(!to||to===from) return;
    var amt=amountOf(c);
    to.querySelector('.col-body').appendChild(c);
    bump(from,-1,-amt); bump(to,1,amt);
  });
}

/* ---- the Funded column is the one move that must carry money ----------------
   src/workflows/cards.mjs refuses a move onto Funded that has no dollars on it,
   because funding_rounds.funded_amount is what the success fee is billed from
   (docs/finance/CLOSEOUT-FEE-BASIS.md). Until this box existed nobody could answer that
   question, so every drag to Funded bounced and no client was ever billed.

   Blank, Cancel, or a word all ABANDON the move. None of them sends a zero — a
   zero would be a claim that nothing funded, and "I don't know yet" is not
   nothing. FHMoneyInput.parseAmount is the shared rule (public/app/money-input.js);
   it hands back a fixed 2dp DOLLAR string, which is the unit
   funding_rounds.funded_amount stores. */
var CARD_STACKING_KEY = 'funding_card_stacking';
var FUNDED_ASK_TRIES = 3;
var NO_AMOUNT = 'no funded amount was entered, so nothing was saved.';

function askFundedAmount(card){
  if(!window.FHMoneyInput || !window.FHMoneyInput.parseAmount){
    // Fail closed. Never guess an amount just because the helper is missing.
    return { ok:false, message:'the amount box could not load, so nothing was saved.' };
  }
  /* Deliberately NOT prefilled from the card. The number on the card is the
     column's estimate ("est."), and offering it here invites someone to press
     OK and record an estimate as the amount that actually funded. A wrong
     number that looks right is worse than making them type it. */
  var prefill = '';
  for(var i=0;i<FUNDED_ASK_TRIES;i++){
    var raw = window.prompt(
      'How much actually FUNDED for ' + nameOf(card) + '?\n\n' +
      'This is the money that reached the account, not the approved amount.\n' +
      'Dollars, like 45000 or 45,000.50.\n\n' +
      'Leave it empty to cancel. Empty is not zero.',
      prefill
    );
    if(raw === null) return { ok:false, message:NO_AMOUNT };
    var parsed = window.FHMoneyInput.parseAmount(raw);
    if(parsed.ok) return parsed;
    if(parsed.reason === 'blank') return { ok:false, message:NO_AMOUNT };
    alert(parsed.message);
    prefill = raw;
  }
  return { ok:false, message:NO_AMOUNT };
}

function persistCardMove(card, pipelineKey, stageKey, onFail, onOk){
  if(typeof FHData === 'undefined' || !FHData.write){
    if(onFail) onFail('data layer not loaded');
    return;
  }
  var clientId = card && card.dataset.clientId;
  if(!clientId){
    // Sample/demo card — local only.
    save();
    return;
  }
  if(!pipelineKey || !stageKey){
    if(onFail) onFail('missing stage');
    return;
  }
  // The rail this card is leaving. A cross-rail MOVE hands the client over —
  // the old rail must not keep an open card for the same person.
  var fromKey = (window.FHPipelineBoard && window.FHPipelineBoard.currentKey) || null;
  var body = {
    action: 'move',
    client_id: clientId,
    pipeline_key: pipelineKey,
    stage_key: stageKey,
    from_pipeline_key: (fromKey && fromKey !== pipelineKey) ? fromKey : null
  };
  // Ask BEFORE the card shows as saving, so a cancelled box leaves no trace.
  if(pipelineKey === CARD_STACKING_KEY && stageKey === 'funded'){
    var asked = askFundedAmount(card);
    if(!asked.ok){
      if(onFail) onFail(asked.message);
      return;
    }
    body.funded_amount = asked.dollars;
  }
  card.classList.add('saving');
  FHData.write('/api/pipeline-cards', body).then(function(res){
    card.classList.remove('saving');
    if(!res || !res.ok){
      var msg = (res && res.error) || 'move failed';
      if(onFail) onFail(msg);
      else alert('Could not save the move: ' + msg);
      return;
    }
    // Bust the board cache so the next rail click refetches.
    if(window.FHPipelineBoard && typeof window.FHPipelineBoard.invalidate === 'function'){
      window.FHPipelineBoard.invalidate(pipelineKey);
      if(fromKey && fromKey !== pipelineKey) window.FHPipelineBoard.invalidate(fromKey);
    }
    if(typeof onOk === 'function') onOk();
  });
}

/* ---------- drag: pointer-driven, reuses the mockup's own drag styling ---------- */
var drag=null;
function startDrag(card,e){
  var r=card.getBoundingClientRect();
  var ghost=document.createElement('div');
  ghost.className='drag-card';
  ghost.appendChild(card.cloneNode(true));
  ghost.firstChild.style.cursor='grabbing';
  document.body.appendChild(ghost);
  ghost.style.position='fixed'; ghost.style.width=r.width+'px';

  var hint=document.createElement('div');
  hint.className='drag-hint'; hint.style.position='fixed'; hint.hidden=true;
  document.body.appendChild(hint);

  var ph=document.createElement('div');
  ph.className='drop-placeholder'; ph.textContent='moving '+nameOf(card);

  drag={card:card,ghost:ghost,hint:hint,ph:ph,dx:e.clientX-r.left,dy:e.clientY-r.top,
        from:colOf(card),target:null};
  card.classList.add('dragging');
  card.parentNode.insertBefore(ph,card.nextSibling);
  move(e);
  document.body.style.userSelect='none';
}
function colUnder(x,y){
  var live=cols();
  for(var i=0;i<live.length;i++){
    var r=live[i].getBoundingClientRect();
    if(x>=r.left&&x<=r.right&&y>=r.top&&y<=r.bottom) return live[i];
  }
  return null;
}
function move(e){
  if(!drag) return;
  drag.ghost.style.left=(e.clientX-drag.dx)+'px';
  drag.ghost.style.top =(e.clientY-drag.dy)+'px';
  var c=colUnder(e.clientX,e.clientY);
  if(drag.target&&drag.target!==c) drag.target.classList.remove('drop-target');
  drag.target=c;
  if(c&&c!==drag.from){
    c.classList.add('drop-target');
    c.querySelector('.col-body').appendChild(drag.ph);
    drag.hint.hidden=false;
    drag.hint.innerHTML='Drop to move into <b>'+colName(c)+'</b>';
    drag.hint.style.left=(e.clientX+14)+'px';
    drag.hint.style.top =(e.clientY+18)+'px';
  }else{
    if(c) c.classList.remove('drop-target');
    drag.hint.hidden=true;
  }
}
function end(){
  if(!drag) return;
  var d=drag; drag=null;
  d.card.classList.remove('dragging');
  document.body.style.userSelect='';
  if(d.target&&d.target!==d.from){
    var amt=amountOf(d.card);
    var fromCol=d.from, toCol=d.target;
    d.ph.parentNode.insertBefore(d.card,d.ph);
    bump(fromCol,-1,-amt); bump(toCol,1,amt);
    var pipelineKey = toCol.dataset.pipelineKey
      || (window.FHPipelineBoard && window.FHPipelineBoard.currentKey)
      || null;
    var stageKey = toCol.dataset.stageKey || null;
    persistCardMove(d.card, pipelineKey, stageKey, function(msg){
      // Revert the DOM move if the server refused.
      fromCol.querySelector('.col-body').appendChild(d.card);
      bump(toCol,-1,-amt); bump(fromCol,1,amt);
      alert('Could not save the move: ' + msg);
    });
  }
  if(d.target) d.target.classList.remove('drop-target');
  if(d.ph.parentNode) d.ph.parentNode.removeChild(d.ph);
  d.ghost.remove(); d.hint.remove();
}
board.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
  var card=e.target.closest('.card');
  if(!card||e.target.closest('.c-btn.route')||e.target.closest('.c-msg')||e.button!==0) return;
  if(card.closest('.drag-card')) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  startDrag(card,e);
});
window.addEventListener('pointermove',move);
window.addEventListener('pointerup',end);
window.addEventListener('pointercancel',end);

  }
  if(!e.target.closest('.route-menu')){ menu.hidden=true; moveCard=null; }

/* ---------- filters, search, sort ---------- */
var q=document.getElementById('q'), fOwner=document.getElementById('fOwner'),
    fOwnerWrap=document.getElementById('fOwnerWrap'), fAge=document.getElementById('fAge'),
    fSort=document.getElementById('fSort'), fWait=document.getElementById('fWait');

/* owner list is built from who actually appears on the cards.

   NAMED and re-runnable, not a one-shot IIFE. It used to run once at load
   against the SAMPLE cards, so after the board was repainted with real data the
   dropdown still held sample owners — every one of which matched nothing, so
   choosing an owner hid every real card and the board looked empty. The wiring
   calls this again after it paints. */
function rebuildOwnerOptions(){
  var seen={};
  cards().forEach(function(c){
    var b=c.querySelector('.c-act b'); if(!b) return;
    var n=b.textContent.trim(); if(n&&!seen[n]){seen[n]=1;}
  });
  var keep=fOwner.value;
  while(fOwner.options.length>1) fOwner.remove(1);   // keep "Anyone"
  Object.keys(seen).sort().forEach(function(n){
    var o=document.createElement('option'); o.value=n; o.textContent=n; fOwner.appendChild(o);
  });
  // Preserve the current choice if that owner still exists on the board.
  fOwner.value = seen[keep] ? keep : "";
  /* NO OWNERS ON THE BOARD MEANS NO OWNER FILTER. With nothing but "Anyone" in
     it this select could not change what you see, and offering it said the
     board knows who owns a card when every card on it says "unassigned". It
     comes back on its own as soon as one does. */
  var haveOwners = Object.keys(seen).length > 0;
  if (fOwnerWrap) fOwnerWrap.hidden = !haveOwners;
  if (!haveOwners && fOwner.value) fOwner.value = "";
}
window.rebuildOwnerOptions = rebuildOwnerOptions;
rebuildOwnerOptions();

/* HOW LONG THIS CARD HAS BEEN IN ITS STAGE, IN MINUTES.

   The timestamp first, the words only as a fallback. cardEl() writes the raw
   entered_at onto the element; this used to read the RENDERED text back off
   the card instead ("4h in stage"), and that text has already been rounded to
   the nearest hour or day by age(). So a card sitting 3h 40m answered 240
   minutes, and "over 3 days" was being decided by a number that had been
   rounded before anything compared it. The words are for the reader; the
   filter uses the clock.

   A card with no readable timestamp answers 0 — unknown, so it never satisfies
   an "over N" filter and never wins "longest in stage". Unknown must not be
   able to win a comparison it was never measured for. */
function ageMins(card){
  var iso=card.dataset && card.dataset.enteredAt;
  if(iso){
    var t=Date.parse(iso);
    if(!isNaN(t)) return Math.max(0, Math.round((Date.now()-t)/60000));
  }
  var el=card.querySelector('.c-age'); if(!el) return 0;
  var t2=el.textContent, m=0, x;
  if((x=/(\d+)\s*d/.exec(t2))) m+=parseInt(x[1],10)*1440;
  if((x=/(\d+)\s*h/.exec(t2))) m+=parseInt(x[1],10)*60;
  if((x=/(\d+)\s*m/.exec(t2))) m+=parseInt(x[1],10);
  return m;
}
/* Does this card match the "Waiting on" choice? Reads the bucket cardEl()
   stamped on the element from the shared pure rule, so a card can never be
   counted in the headline and hidden by the filter at the same time. */
function waitHit(card, want){
  if(!want) return true;
  if(want==='us_amount') return (card.dataset&&card.dataset.needsAmount)==='1';
  return (card.dataset&&card.dataset.wait)===want;
}
function applyFilters(){
  var term=(q.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  var owner=fOwner.value, age=parseInt(fAge.value||'0',10);
  var wait=fWait?fWait.value:'';
  cards().forEach(function(c){
    var hit=true;
    if(term && nameOf(c).toLowerCase().indexOf(term)<0) hit=false;
    if(hit&&owner){ var b=c.querySelector('.c-act b'); if(!b||b.textContent.trim()!==owner) hit=false; }
    if(hit&&age && ageMins(c)<age) hit=false;
    if(hit&&!waitHit(c,wait)) hit=false;
    c.classList.toggle('filtered',!hit);
  });
  syncWaitButtons();
  /* The headline's "longest wait" link points at ONE card. If this pass hid
     that card, the link has nowhere to go and must stop being a control. */
  if(typeof window.fhSyncHeadlineNext==='function') window.fhSyncHeadlineNext();
}
window.fhApplyFilters=applyFilters;
function applySort(){
  var mode=fSort.value; if(!mode) return;
  cols().forEach(function(col){
    var body=col.querySelector('.col-body');
    var list=[].slice.call(body.querySelectorAll(':scope > .card'));
    list.sort(function(a,b){
      if(mode==='name') return nameOf(a).localeCompare(nameOf(b));
      if(mode==='amt')  return amountOf(b)-amountOf(a);
      if(mode==='age')  return ageMins(b)-ageMins(a);
      /* Approvals with no dollar amount to the top, and among those the one
         that has been waiting longest — the order somebody chasing amounts
         works in. */
      if(mode==='needs'){
        var na=waitHit(a,'us_amount')?1:0, nb=waitHit(b,'us_amount')?1:0;
        return nb-na || ageMins(b)-ageMins(a);
      }
      return 0;
    });
    var more=body.querySelector('.col-more');
    list.forEach(function(c){ body.insertBefore(c, more||null); });
  });
}
[q,fOwner,fAge,fWait].forEach(function(el){
  if(!el) return;
  el.addEventListener('input',applyFilters);
  el.addEventListener('change',applyFilters);
});
fSort.addEventListener('change',applySort);

/* THE HEADLINE COUNTERS ARE THE SAME FILTER, NOT A SECOND ONE.
   Each one writes into #fWait and lets the existing machinery run, so the
   chip, the Clear all button and the count on the Filter control all keep
   working with nothing added. Pressing the one that is already on clears it. */
function syncWaitButtons(){
  var v=fWait?fWait.value:'';
  [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-wait]'),function(btn){
    var mine=btn.getAttribute('data-wait');
    btn.classList.toggle('on', v===mine || (mine==='us' && v==='us_amount'));
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(btn.classList.contains('on')));
  });
}
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-wait]'),function(btn){
  btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
    if(!fWait) return;
    var want=btn.getAttribute('data-wait');
    fWait.value = (fWait.value===want) ? '' : want;
    applyFilters();
    if(typeof syncChips==='function') syncChips();
  });
});

/* ---------- the four selects hide behind one Filter control ----------
   An active filter is never hidden: it comes back out as a chip, so the bar
   only ever shows state that is actually changing what you see. */
var fBtn=document.getElementById('filterBtn'), fPanel=document.getElementById('filterPanel'),
    fN=document.getElementById('filterN'), fChips=document.getElementById('filterChips'),
    fClear=document.getElementById('filterClear');
var CONTROLS=[{el:fWait,k:'Waiting on'},{el:fOwner,k:'Owner'},
              {el:fAge,k:'Age'},{el:fSort,k:'Sort'}].filter(function(c){return !!c.el;});

function labelOf(c){ return c.el.options[c.el.selectedIndex].textContent.trim(); }
function syncChips(){
  var on=CONTROLS.filter(function(c){ return c.el.value!==''; });
  fChips.innerHTML='';
  on.forEach(function(c){
    var chip=document.createElement('span');
    chip.className='fchip';
    chip.innerHTML='<span>'+c.k+': '+labelOf(c)+'</span>';
    var x=document.createElement('span');
    x.className='x'; x.textContent='✕'; x.title='Clear '+c.k;
    x.addEventListener('click',function(){
      c.el.value=''; applyFilters(); if(c.el===fSort) applySort(); syncChips();
    });
    chip.appendChild(x); fChips.appendChild(chip);
  });
  fN.hidden = on.length===0;
  fN.textContent = String(on.length);
}
fBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){
  var open=fPanel.hidden;
  fPanel.hidden=!open;
  fBtn.classList.toggle('open',open);
  fBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));
});
CONTROLS.forEach(function(c){ c.el.addEventListener('change',syncChips); });
fClear.addEventListener('click',function(){
  CONTROLS.forEach(function(c){ c.el.value=''; });
  applyFilters(); syncChips();
});
syncChips();

(function(){
  var openBtn=document.getElementById('fhNewClient');
  var modal=document.getElementById('fhNewModal');
  var nameEl=document.getElementById('fhNewName');
  var emailEl=document.getElementById('fhNewEmail');
  var phoneEl=document.getElementById('fhNewPhone');
  var productEl=document.getElementById('fhNewProduct');
  var errEl=document.getElementById('fhNewErr');
  var cancelBtn=document.getElementById('fhNewCancel');
  var goBtn=document.getElementById('fhNewGo');
  if(!openBtn||!modal||!goBtn) return;

  function showErr(msg){
    errEl.textContent=msg||'';
    errEl.classList.toggle('show', !!msg);
  }
  function closeNew(){
    modal.classList.remove('open');
    showErr('');
    goBtn.disabled=false;
    goBtn.textContent='Save';
  }
  function openNew(){
    nameEl.value=''; emailEl.value=''; phoneEl.value=''; productEl.value='';
    showErr('');
    goBtn.disabled=false;
    goBtn.textContent='Save';
    modal.classList.add('open');
    setTimeout(function(){ nameEl.focus(); }, 0);
  }
  function reloadBoard(){
    var t=document.querySelector('.rail-tab.active');
    if(!window.FHPipelineBoard || !t) return;
    window.FHPipelineBoard.invalidate();
    var name=(t.textContent||'').replace(/^\s*R-\d+\s*/,'').trim() || 'Sales';
    window.FHPipelineBoard.load(t.dataset.rail, name);
  }
  openBtn.addEventListener('click', openNew);
  cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', closeNew);
  modal.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if(e.target===modal) closeNew(); });
  goBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    if(typeof FHData === 'undefined' || !FHData.write){
      showErr('Could not save yet. Refresh and try again.');
      return;
    }
    var name=String(nameEl.value||'').trim();
    var email=String(emailEl.value||'').trim();
    var phone=String(phoneEl.value||'').trim();
    var product=String(productEl.value||'').trim();
    if(!name || !email || !phone || !product){
      showErr('Fill in name, email, phone, and product.');
      return;
    }
    goBtn.disabled=true;
    goBtn.textContent='Saving…';
    showErr('');
    FHData.write('/api/pipeline-clients', {
      name: name,
      email: email,
      phone: phone,
      product: product
    }).then(function(res){
      if(!res || !res.ok){
        goBtn.disabled=false;
        goBtn.textContent='Save';
        showErr((res && (res.error || res.message)) || 'Could not save this client.');
        return;
      }
      closeNew();
      reloadBoard();
    });
  });
})();
