<!-- ══ LIVE BOARD ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Replaces the sample cards with the real board from
     /api/dashboard/pipeline?key=<pipeline> — the client's actual position,
     read from cards.stage_id, not inferred from payment flags. Every wired
     rail goes through this, not just Sales: the backend endpoint was
     always generic per `key`, and every column here is now built FROM the
     stages the API returns rather than matched against a fixed set of
     Sales-shaped columns, so a pipeline with 4 stages or 7 renders exactly
     that many — no invented or missing columns either way.

     It runs after the interaction script above on purpose. Drag is delegated
     on .board and the filters re-query the DOM each time (cols() above is a
     live query for the same reason), so columns swapped in by a pipeline
     switch stay fully interactive without any handoff back to that script.

     If the backend cannot answer, the sample board is left untouched and the
     banner says so. Half-real boards are worse than either — so when the API
     does answer, every column is rebuilt from it, including the empty ones.
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script defer src="data.js"></script>
<script src="proxy-apply.js"></script>
<script src="money-input.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var board = document.querySelector(".board");
  if (!board) return;

  function usd(n) { return "$" + Math.round(n || 0).toLocaleString("en-US"); }

  /* FH-SUMMARY-BEGIN */
  // Pure, so it can be unit-tested without a DOM. Sums the same count/amount
  // fields buildColumn() already put on each column — the summary bar can
  // never disagree with the columns under it.
  function fhPipelineSummary(stages) {
    var count = 0, money = 0, known = false;
    (stages || []).forEach(function (s) {
      count += s.count || 0;
      if (s.amount != null) {
        money += s.amount;
        if ((s.count || 0) > 0) known = true;
      }
    });
    /* Cards on the board but not one estimate among them: unknown, never $0.
       An empty board is still a real zero. */
    if (count > 0 && !known) money = null;
    return { count: count, money: money };
  }
  window.FHPipelineSummary = fhPipelineSummary;

  /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     WHOSE MOVE IS IT? — the one question this board could not answer.

     Pure, DOM-free and beside fhPipelineSummary on purpose: the counters at
     the top, the "Waiting on" filter and the next-action line all call these
     same functions, so the number in the headline and the cards left on the
     board after filtering can never tell two different stories.

     EVERY VALUE IS A FACT ALREADY ON THE CARD. Nothing here reads a new table,
     opens a new route or infers a state from a payment flag:

       sms_needs_reply / email_needs_reply
           A real EXISTS over `messages`: the newest message on that thread is
           inbound. The client wrote and nobody here has answered. Someone here
           owes a reply — that is waiting on US.
       approval_amount_missing
           A bank said yes on the client's CURRENT round and no dollar amount
           has been recorded, the approval has not been marked as not counting,
           and this is a funding rail. Somebody here has to type the number in.
           Also waiting on US.
       the stage the card is sitting in
           `round_submitted` — the round has gone to the lenders, so the next
           move is a bank's.
           `action_required` — a lender has come back needing something from
           the file, so the next move is the client's.

     THOSE TWO STAGE KEYS AND NO OTHERS. Every other stage on every other rail
     comes back "none", and "none" is stated on screen as *nothing recorded* —
     never as "nothing to do". The system holds no record of whose move it is,
     and saying so is the honest answer. Guessing a party from a stage name we
     have not agreed on would be exactly the kind of number that looks real and
     is not.

     EXACTLY ONE BUCKET PER CARD. A card can be sitting in Round Submitted AND
     have a text nobody answered. If both counted, the four figures would add
     to more than the card count and the row would contradict itself on its own
     first line. So: us wins first, because a reply we owe is a thing a person
     here can do right now; bank and client are stages and a card has only one
     stage. us + bank + client + none === the card count, always, and
     src/http/pipeline-screen.test.mjs proves it.
     ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var FH_WAIT_STAGE = { round_submitted: "bank", action_required: "client" };

  function fhWaitingOn(card, stageKey) {
    if (!card) return "none";
    // Only an explicit true. A reply that never carried the key is not
    // evidence of a clean file, and must never be counted as one.
    if (card.sms_needs_reply === true) return "us";
    if (card.email_needs_reply === true) return "us";
    if (card.approval_amount_missing === true) return "us";
    return FH_WAIT_STAGE[String(stageKey == null ? "" : stageKey)] || "none";
  }

  // The filter predicate, so the select and the counters share one rule.
  // "us_amount" is a subset of "us", not a fifth bucket — it never changes a
  // count, it only narrows what the board shows.
  function fhWaitMatches(card, stageKey, want) {
    if (!want) return true;
    if (want === "us_amount") return !!card && card.approval_amount_missing === true;
    return fhWaitingOn(card, stageKey) === want;
  }

  function fhPipelineWaiting(stages) {
    var t = { us: 0, bank: 0, client: 0, none: 0, cards: 0 };
    (stages || []).forEach(function (s) {
      ((s && s.cards) || []).forEach(function (c) {
        t[fhWaitingOn(c, s && s.key)] += 1;
        t.cards += 1;
      });
    });
    return t;
  }

  /* THE ONE CARD TO GO TO NEXT: of everything waiting on someone here, the one
     that has been waiting longest. A card whose entered_at cannot be read is
     never picked — an unreadable date is unknown, and unknown must not
     masquerade as "waited the longest". Returns null when nothing qualifies,
     which the screen says in words rather than showing a zero. */
  function fhNextUp(stages) {
    var best = null, bestT = Infinity;
    (stages || []).forEach(function (s) {
      ((s && s.cards) || []).forEach(function (c) {
        if (fhWaitingOn(c, s && s.key) !== "us") return;
        var t = Date.parse(c && c.entered_at);
        if (isNaN(t) || t >= bestT) return;
        bestT = t;
        best = { id: c.id, client_id: c.client_id, name: c.name, stage: s.name, entered_at: c.entered_at };
      });
    });
    return best;
  }

  window.FHPipelineWaiting = fhPipelineWaiting;
  window.FHWaitingOn = fhWaitingOn;
  window.FHWaitMatches = fhWaitMatches;
  window.FHNextUp = fhNextUp;
  /* FH-SUMMARY-END */

  // Held count has no honest value here: no card the API returns carries a
  // hold flag (see api/dashboard/pipeline.mjs — cards has no hold column), so
  // the board summary shows no "held" stat at all (defect 24). Card count and est.
  // money DO come from the API and are set for real once a pipeline loads;
  // unknown (not yet loaded, or the load failed) is a dash too, never 0.
  var sumCountEl = document.getElementById("sumCount");
  var sumMoneyEl = document.getElementById("sumMoney");
  var sumMoneyWrap = document.getElementById("sumMoneyWrap");
  function setSummary(totals) {
    if (sumCountEl) sumCountEl.textContent = totals ? String(totals.count) : "—";
    if (sumMoneyEl) sumMoneyEl.textContent = totals && totals.money != null ? usd(totals.money) : "—";
    /* The money on a card is the client's FUNDING number, so a board total is
       only meaningful on the rails that are about funding. Everywhere else the
       figure is hidden instead of being summed into something it is not. */
    if (sumMoneyWrap) sumMoneyWrap.hidden = !railHasMoney();
  }

  /* ── THE HEADLINE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     Painted from the SAME stages array the columns are built from, in the same
     applyBoard() call, so the number at the top and the cards underneath it
     are two views of one thing rather than two reads that can drift apart.

     A DASH IS NOT A ZERO. Before a rail answers, and after a rail fails to
     answer, every figure here is "—" and the line underneath says the number
     is unknown. A 0 would be a claim that nothing is waiting, which is the
     opposite of what an unanswered read means. */
  var hlEls = {
    us: document.getElementById("hlUsN"),
    bank: document.querySelector("#hlBank b"),
    client: document.querySelector("#hlClient b"),
    none: document.querySelector("#hlNone b")
  };
  var hlNextLink = document.getElementById("hlNextLink");
  var hlNextNote = document.getElementById("hlNextNote");
  var hlNextTarget = null;
  var hlNextLabel = "";

  function hlNote(text) {
    if (!hlNextNote) return;
    hlNextNote.textContent = text;
    hlNextNote.hidden = !text;
  }

  function clearHeadline(note) {
    Object.keys(hlEls).forEach(function (k) {
      if (hlEls[k]) hlEls[k].textContent = "—";
    });
    if (hlEls.us) hlEls.us.classList.add("none");
    hlNextTarget = null;
    if (hlNextLink) { hlNextLink.hidden = true; hlNextLink.textContent = ""; hlNextLink.removeAttribute("href"); }
    hlNote(note || "");
  }

  function setHeadline(stages) {
    var t = fhPipelineWaiting(stages);
    Object.keys(hlEls).forEach(function (k) {
      if (hlEls[k]) hlEls[k].textContent = String(t[k]);
    });
    // A real, measured zero is a good answer and is allowed to look like one.
    if (hlEls.us) hlEls.us.classList.toggle("none", t.us === 0);

    var next = fhNextUp(stages);
    hlNextTarget = next;
    if (!next) {
      if (hlNextLink) { hlNextLink.hidden = true; hlNextLink.textContent = ""; hlNextLink.removeAttribute("href"); }
      hlNote(t.cards === 0
        ? "No cards on this rail."
        : "Nothing on this rail is waiting on someone here.");
      return;
    }
    hlNextLabel = next.name + " — " + age(next.entered_at) +
      (next.stage ? ", " + next.stage : "");
    if (hlNextLink) {
      hlNextLink.textContent = "Longest wait: " + hlNextLabel;
      hlNextLink.setAttribute("href", "#" + cardAnchor(next.id));
    }
    hlSyncNext();
  }

  /* THE LINK MUST NOT OUTLIVE THE CARD IT POINTS AT. A filter hides a card
     with .card.filtered{display:none}, which leaves the node in the DOM: so
     getElementById still finds it, the click handler's `if (!el) return` never
     fires, and scrollIntoView on a box-less element scrolls nowhere. Filtering
     the board — including with the counters in this same row — used to leave an
     underlined link that did nothing whatever when pressed, and rang a card
     nobody could see. Now it drops to plain text the moment its card is off the
     board, which is the rule already stated at .hl-next: a control that cannot
     do anything must not render as one. The name is kept in the note, because
     the fact is still true — it is only unreachable from here. */
  function hlSyncNext() {
    if (!hlNextLink || !hlNextTarget) return;
    var el = document.getElementById(cardAnchor(hlNextTarget.id));
    var reachable = !!el && !el.classList.contains("filtered");
    hlNextLink.hidden = !reachable;
    hlNote(reachable ? "" : "This filter hides the longest wait: " + hlNextLabel + ".");
  }
  window.fhSyncHeadlineNext = hlSyncNext;

  // One place that turns a card id into its anchor, so the link and the card
  // can never spell it differently.
  function cardAnchor(id) { return "fh-card-" + String(id); }

  if (hlNextLink) {
    hlNextLink.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      if (!hlNextTarget) return;
      var el = document.getElementById(cardAnchor(hlNextTarget.id));
      // display:none leaves the node findable, so "exists" is not "reachable".
      if (!el || el.classList.contains("filtered")) return;
      try { el.scrollIntoView({ block: "center", inline: "center", behavior: "smooth" }); }
      catch (e) { el.scrollIntoView(); }
      el.classList.add("fh-spot");
      setTimeout(function () { el.classList.remove("fh-spot"); }, 2200);
    });
  }

  function initials(name) {
    var parts = String(name).trim().split(/\s+/);
    return ((parts[0] || "?")[0] + (parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1][0] : "")).toUpperCase();
  }

  function formatScores(c) {
    var band = c && c.survey_fico;
    return band ? String(band) : "—";
  }

  function age(iso) {
    var t = Date.parse(iso);
    if (isNaN(t)) return "in stage";
    var mins = Math.max(0, Math.round((Date.now() - t) / 60000));
    if (mins < 60) return mins + "m in stage";
    if (mins < 1440) return Math.round(mins / 60) + "h in stage";
    return Math.round(mins / 1440) + "d in stage";
  }

  /* Built with createElement and textContent throughout: card names and owners
     are client data and must never be interpreted as markup. */
  function cardEl(c, stageKey) {
    function div(cls, text) {
      var d = document.createElement("div");
      d.className = cls;
      if (text != null) d.textContent = text;
      return d;
    }
    var card = div("card");
    if (c.client_id) card.dataset.clientId = c.client_id;
    if (c.id) { card.dataset.cardId = c.id; card.id = cardAnchor(c.id); }

    /* WHOSE MOVE IT IS, AND WHEN THE CARD ARRIVED — written onto the element
       so the filter bar reads the same values the headline counted.

       entered_at is stored raw. The age filter used to re-read the rounded
       words back off the card ("4h in stage"), so "over 3 days" was answered
       with a number that had already been rounded to the nearest hour or day
       before anything compared it. The words stay for the reader; the filter
       now uses the timestamp. */
    card.dataset.wait = fhWaitingOn(c, stageKey);
    if (c.approval_amount_missing === true) card.dataset.needsAmount = "1";
    if (c.entered_at) card.dataset.enteredAt = c.entered_at;

    var top = div("c-top");
    top.appendChild(div("av agent", initials(c.name)));
    top.appendChild(div("c-name", c.name));
    var tools = div("c-tools");
    var move = document.createElement("span");
    move.className = "c-btn route"; move.textContent = "MOVE";
    var delBtn = document.createElement("span");
    delBtn.className = "c-btn del"; delBtn.textContent = "DEL";
    delBtn.title = "Archive (type DELETE)";
    delBtn.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      ev.stopPropagation();
      openDeleteConfirm(c);
    });
    var grip = document.createElement("span");
    grip.className = "grip"; grip.textContent = "⠿";
    tools.appendChild(move); tools.appendChild(delBtn); tools.appendChild(grip);
    top.appendChild(tools);
    card.appendChild(top);
    card.appendChild(div("c-scores", formatScores(c)));
    card.appendChild(msgLine("sms", c.phone, c.client_id, c.sms_needs_reply));
    card.appendChild(msgLine("email", c.email, c.client_id, c.email_needs_reply));

    /* THE SAME NUMBER ON EVERY BOARD, BECAUSE IT IS ABOUT THE CLIENT, NOT THE
       BOARD. It is what this client is estimated to get funded (or the amount
       that has funded already), so the unit says "funding est." wherever it
       paints. It used to read a bare "est.", which on the Inquiry Removal board
       read as money for inquiry removal. The column and board totals are drawn
       on the funding rails only — see railHasMoney(). */
    var amt = div("c-amt", c.amount == null ? "—" : usd(c.amount) + " ");
    amt.title = c.funded
      ? "What this client has funded."
      : "What this client is estimated to get funded. The same number on every board.";
    if (c.amount != null) {
      var unit = document.createElement("span");
      unit.className = "unit"; unit.textContent = c.funded ? "funded" : "funding est.";
      amt.appendChild(unit);
    }
    card.appendChild(amt);

    /* AN APPROVAL WITH NO DOLLAR AMOUNT, SAID OUT LOUD ON THE BOARD THE
       FULFILLMENT TEAM ALREADY WATCHES.

       A bank can say yes before anyone knows the limit — the team has to ask
       the client or wait for the bank's approval email — and recording that
       approval with no amount is allowed on purpose (owner-set 2026-08-29).
       What is NOT allowed is nobody ever noticing. Until the dollars are in,
       that approval is left out of the round's lender breakdown, so no success
       fee is ever billed for it. Per-client this is chipped on the lender row
       in the Client Control Panel; this is the same fact across every client,
       on the card that is stuck.

       ONLY an explicit true paints it. A reply that never carried the key is
       not evidence of a clean file, and a card must never claim all-clear on
       something nobody measured — so `undefined` shows nothing at all rather
       than a green "fine". */
    if (c.approval_amount_missing === true) {
      card.appendChild(div("c-needs-amount", "Amount needed"));
    }

    card.appendChild(div("c-age", age(c.entered_at)));

    var foot = div("c-foot");
    var act = div("c-act");
    if (c.owner) {
      var b = document.createElement("b");
      b.textContent = c.owner;
      act.appendChild(b);
      act.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" owns this card"));
    } else {
      act.textContent = "unassigned";
    }
    foot.appendChild(act);
    foot.appendChild(div("c-when", c.funded ? "funded" : (c.outcome_tier || "")));
    card.appendChild(foot);

    // Any rail: open right drawer with scores / survey / prequal / tier.
    // Card stacking also keeps the lender match panel as a deep link inside.
    if (c.client_id) {
      card.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        if (ev.target && (ev.target.closest && (ev.target.closest(".c-btn") || ev.target.closest(".grip") || ev.target.closest(".c-msg")))) return;
        openClientDrawer(c);
      });
    }
    return card;
  }

  var drawerClient = null;
  var drawerEl = document.getElementById("fhDrawer");
  var drawerBody = document.getElementById("fhDrawerBody");
  var drawerName = document.getElementById("fhDrawerName");
  var delModal = document.getElementById("fhDelModal");
  var delInput = document.getElementById("fhDelInput");
  var delGo = document.getElementById("fhDelGo");
  var pendingDelete = null;

  function dashHeaders() {
    var t = "";
    try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) {}
    var headers = { accept: "application/json", "content-type": "application/json" };
    if (t) headers.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
    return headers;
  }

  function closeClientDrawer() {
    if (drawerEl) {
      drawerEl.classList.remove("open");
      drawerEl.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    }
    drawerClient = null;
  }

  function row(label, value) {
    if (value == null || value === "") return null;
    return rowAlways(label, value);
  }

  function fmtWhen(iso) {
    if (!iso) return null;
    var d = new Date(iso);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
    return d.toLocaleString("en-US", {
      timeZone: "America/Phoenix",
      month: "short",
      day: "numeric",
      year: "numeric",
      hour: "numeric",
      minute: "2-digit"
    });
  }

  function callStatus(v) {
    if (!v) return null;
    var s = String(v);
    if (s === "no_show") return "No-show";
    if (s === "past") return "Past";
    if (s === "upcoming") return "Upcoming";
    if (s === "booked") return "Booked";
    if (s === "done") return "Done";
    return s;
  }

  function messagingHref(clientId, channel) {
    return "messaging.html?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(clientId) + "&channel=" + encodeURIComponent(channel);
  }

  function msgLine(channel, value, clientId, needsReply) {
    var wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "c-msg";
    if (!value || !clientId) {
      wrap.textContent = "—";
      return wrap;
    }
    var a = document.createElement("a");
    a.className = "c-msg-link";
    a.href = messagingHref(clientId, channel);
    a.textContent = String(value);
    a.addEventListener("click", function (ev) { ev.stopPropagation(); });
    wrap.appendChild(a);
    if (needsReply) {
      var badge = document.createElement("span");
      badge.className = "c-msg-badge";
      badge.textContent = "1";
      badge.setAttribute("aria-label", "Needs a reply");
      wrap.appendChild(badge);
    }
    return wrap;
  }

  function contactRow(label, channel, value, clientId, needsReply) {
    var d = document.createElement("div");
    d.className = "fh-drawer-row";
    var a = document.createElement("span");
    a.textContent = label;
    var right = document.createElement("span");
    right.className = "fh-drawer-msg";
    if (clientId && value) {
      var link = document.createElement("a");
      link.href = messagingHref(clientId, channel);
      link.textContent = String(value);
      right.appendChild(link);
      if (needsReply) {
        var badge = document.createElement("span");
        badge.className = "c-msg-badge";
        badge.textContent = "1";
        badge.setAttribute("aria-label", "Needs a reply");
        right.appendChild(badge);
      }
    } else {
      var empty = document.createElement("span");
      empty.textContent = "—";
      right.appendChild(empty);
    }
    d.appendChild(a);
    d.appendChild(right);
    return d;
  }

  function rowAlways(label, value) {
    var d = document.createElement("div");
    d.className = "fh-drawer-row";
    var a = document.createElement("span");
    a.textContent = label;
    var b = document.createElement("span");
    b.textContent = (value == null || value === "") ? "—" : String(value);
    d.appendChild(a); d.appendChild(b);
    return d;
  }

  function sec(title) {
    var s = document.createElement("div");
    s.className = "fh-drawer-sec";
    var h = document.createElement("h3");
    h.textContent = title;
    s.appendChild(h);
    return s;
  }

  function cfGet(cf, keys) {
    if (!cf) return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      var v = cf[keys[i]];
      if (v != null && v !== "") return v;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /* FH-DRAWER-BEGIN */
  /* CF stores option IDs on cf_svy_* and the words on *_label / *_labels.
     Never paint a bare 6-digit ID as the answer. */
  function isCfOptionId(v) {
    if (typeof v === "number") return v >= 10000;
    return typeof v === "string" && /^\d{5,}$/.test(v.trim());
  }

  function surveyAnswer(cf, key) {
    if (!cf) return null;
    var label = cf[key + "_label"];
    if (label != null && label !== "") return String(label);
    var labels = cf[key + "_labels"];
    if (labels != null && labels !== "") {
      if (Array.isArray(labels)) return labels.filter(Boolean).join(", ");
      try {
        var parsed = JSON.parse(labels);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed.filter(Boolean).join(", ");
      } catch (e) {}
      return String(labels);
    }
    var v = cf[key];
    if (v == null || v === "") return null;
    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      if (v.every(isCfOptionId)) return null;
      return v.filter(function (x) { return x != null && x !== "" && !isCfOptionId(x); }).join(", ") || null;
    }
    if (isCfOptionId(v)) return null;
    return String(v);
  }

  /* One row per survey question, in the order the survey asks them
     (marketing/landing-pages/clickfunnels/cf-survey-ground-truth.md). The third slot is the
     branch the question belongs to: the survey asks EITHER the two business
     questions OR the two personal ones, never both, so painting all four to
     everybody put two permanent "—" rows on every client and made a real
     missing answer indistinguishable from a question that was never asked
     (F8, 2026-09-03 walk). */
  var SURVEY_ROWS = [
    ["Target amount", "cf_svy_funding_target_amount", null],
    ["Planned use", "cf_svy_planned_use", null],
    ["What money changes", "cf_svy_money_change_now", null],
    ["Current score", "cf_svy_self_reported_fico", null],
    ["Has a business", "cf_svy_has_business", null],
    ["Business revenue", "cf_svy_business_revenue", "business"],
    ["Can verify revenue", "cf_svy_revenue_verifiable", "business"],
    ["Personal income", "cf_svy_annual_income_range", "personal"],
    ["Can verify income", "cf_svy_income_verifiable", "personal"],
    ["Available capital", "cf_svy_available_capital", null]
  ];

  /* Which side of the survey's one branch this client went down. The exact
     option text is ground truth: any "Yes, …" tenure takes the business path,
     "No, personal funding only" takes the personal path. */
  function surveyBranch(cf) {
    var answer = surveyAnswer(cf, "cf_svy_has_business");
    if (answer) {
      var s = String(answer).trim().toLowerCase();
      if (s.indexOf("yes") === 0) return "business";
      if (s.indexOf("no") === 0) return "personal";
    }
    /* No answer to the branch question. Do not guess a side — show whichever
       side actually carries an answer, and neither when both are empty. */
    var hasBusiness = surveyAnswer(cf, "cf_svy_business_revenue") != null ||
      surveyAnswer(cf, "cf_svy_revenue_verifiable") != null;
    var hasPersonal = surveyAnswer(cf, "cf_svy_annual_income_range") != null ||
      surveyAnswer(cf, "cf_svy_income_verifiable") != null;
    if (hasBusiness && !hasPersonal) return "business";
    if (hasPersonal && !hasBusiness) return "personal";
    return null;
  }

  /** [label, answer] for every survey question this client was actually asked. */
  function surveyRowsFor(cf) {
    var branch = surveyBranch(cf);
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < SURVEY_ROWS.length; i++) {
      var row = SURVEY_ROWS[i];
      if (row[2] && row[2] !== branch) continue;
      out.push([row[0], surveyAnswer(cf, row[1])]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /* The four routing lines the closer dashboard already reads off
     /api/read/ad-attribution (public/app/closer-call.js paintAd). Same
     endpoint, same wording — this screen is the one non-closers open, and it
     was the only surface where gate/entry/primary/secondary never appeared
     (F9, 2026-09-03 walk). Wording is the owner's, said once in
     api/read/ad-attribution.mjs; keep the two screens reading the same. */
  var OFFER_WORDS = {
    funding_dfy: "Funding, done-for-you",
    credit_optimization: "Credit optimization",
    capital_blueprint: "Capital Blueprint",
    capital_academy: "Capital Academy",
    white_label: "White-label partner",
    none: "None"
  };
  function offerWord(k) { return OFFER_WORDS[k] || k; }

  /** [label, value] rows for the routing block, or [] when nothing is known. */
  function adRoutingRows(payload) {
    var v = payload && payload.resolved;
    if (!v) return [];
    var known = payload.registry && payload.registry.known;
    var adId = payload.attribution && payload.attribution.ad_id;
    var entry = v.entry === "direct"
      ? "Direct · sell what they were promised"
      : "Sorting · every road is open" +
        (adId && !known ? " (ad " + adId + " not in the registry)" : (adId ? "" : " (no ad on file)"));
    var secondary = v.secondary_offers === "all"
      ? "All"
      : (v.secondary_offers && v.secondary_offers.length
          ? v.secondary_offers.map(offerWord).join(", ")
          : "None");
    return [
      ["Gate", v.gate === "none" ? "No FICO gate" : v.gate + "+"],
      ["Entry", entry],
      ["Primary offer", offerWord(v.primary_offer) +
        (v.entry === "sorting" && v.primary_offer !== "none" ? " · lead with it" : "")],
      ["Secondary offers", secondary]
    ];
  }

  window.FHPipelineDrawer = {
    surveyAnswer: surveyAnswer,
    surveyBranch: surveyBranch,
    surveyRowsFor: surveyRowsFor,
    adRoutingRows: adRoutingRows
  };
  /* FH-DRAWER-END */

  /* One extra read after the drawer paints, appended into "How they got here".
     Silent when the endpoint cannot answer — a closer must never read a guess
     about what the ad promised, so nothing is better than a default. */
  function paintAdRouting(section, clientId) {
    if (!section || !clientId) return;
    if (typeof FHData === "undefined" || !FHData.read) return;
    FHData.read("ad-attribution", { client_id: clientId }).then(function (r) {
      if (!drawerClient || drawerClient.client_id !== clientId) return;
      if (!section.isConnected) return;
      if (!r || !r.ok || !r.data) return;
      adRoutingRows(r.data).forEach(function (pair) {
        section.appendChild(rowAlways(pair[0], pair[1]));
      });
    });
  }

  function paintDrawer(c, data) {
    drawerBody.textContent = "";
    var client = (data && data.client) || {};
    var cf = client.custom_fields || {};
    var tm = (data && data.tri_merge) || c.scores || {};
    var tier = client.outcome_tier || c.outcome_tier || null;

    var email = client.email || c.email || null;
    var phone = client.phone || c.phone || null;
    var who = sec("Contact");
    var clientId = c.client_id || client.id;
    who.appendChild(contactRow("Email", "email", email, clientId, c.email_needs_reply || client.email_needs_reply));
    who.appendChild(contactRow("Phone", "sms", phone, clientId, c.sms_needs_reply || client.sms_needs_reply));
    drawerBody.appendChild(who);

    var book = (data && data.latest_booking) || {};
    var call = sec("Call");
    call.appendChild(rowAlways("When", fmtWhen(book.when)));
    call.appendChild(rowAlways("Status", callStatus(book.status || cf.call_outcome)));
    if (book.title) call.appendChild(rowAlways("What", book.title));
    drawerBody.appendChild(call);

    var said = surveyAnswer(cf, "cf_svy_self_reported_fico") || c.survey_fico || null;
    var biz = (data && data.business_credit) || {};
    var inc = (data && data.income_estimates) || {};
    function moneyYr(row) {
      if (!row || row.annual == null) return null;
      return "$" + Number(row.annual).toLocaleString("en-US") + "/yr";
    }
    var creditMore = sec("Credit");
    /* THE THREE REAL SCORES, FIRST, BECAUSE THEY ARE THE ANSWER.
       `tm` (the tri-merge from the client's last credit pull) has been read on
       this line since the drawer shipped and was never drawn. So a file with
       771 / 778 / 766 on it opened on "They said —" — the client's own guess,
       unknown — with the three measured numbers sitting in the reply the panel
       had already received. Bureau order matches the Client Control Panel.
       A dash here is unknown: no pull on file yet, or that bureau sent no
       score. It is never a zero and never a guess. */
    creditMore.appendChild(rowAlways("Experian", tm.experian));
    creditMore.appendChild(rowAlways("Equifax", tm.equifax));
    creditMore.appendChild(rowAlways("TransUnion", tm.transunion));
    /* A sample report was never pulled, and says so (live hole 23). tm.sample
       is set by triMerge() in src/http/client-detail.mjs; only true labels. */
    if (tm.sample === true) {
      creditMore.appendChild(rowAlways("Sample report loaded", fmtWhen(tm.asOf)));
      creditMore.appendChild(rowAlways("Scores", "Sample scores. Not a real credit pull."));
    } else {
      creditMore.appendChild(rowAlways("Scores pulled", fmtWhen(tm.asOf)));
    }
    creditMore.appendChild(rowAlways("They said", said));
    /* These two are the bureau's GUESS at a yearly income, worked out from the
       credit file (Experian Income Insight / Equifax IncomeView). They are not
       pay stubs and not bank balances, and the label has to say so — read as a
       plain "Income" on a call, a modelled number becomes something we told the
       client we knew. */
    creditMore.appendChild(rowAlways("Income, Experian's estimate", moneyYr(inc.experian)));
    creditMore.appendChild(rowAlways("Income, Equifax's estimate", moneyYr(inc.equifax)));
    creditMore.appendChild(rowAlways("Business score", biz.intelliscore));
    creditMore.appendChild(rowAlways("Business FSR", biz.fsr));
    drawerBody.appendChild(creditMore);

    var bizList = Array.isArray(biz.businesses) ? biz.businesses : [];
    var bizSec = sec("Businesses");
    if (!bizList.length) {
      var bizEmpty = document.createElement("p");
      bizEmpty.className = "fh-drawer-empty";
      bizEmpty.textContent = "No businesses on file";
      bizSec.appendChild(bizEmpty);
    } else {
      bizList.forEach(function (row, i) {
        var n = bizList.length > 1 ? " " + (i + 1) : "";
        bizSec.appendChild(rowAlways("Business" + n, row.name));
        bizSec.appendChild(rowAlways("State" + n, row.state));
        bizSec.appendChild(rowAlways("EIN" + n, row.ein));
        bizSec.appendChild(rowAlways("Incorporated" + n, row.incorporated_date));
        bizSec.appendChild(rowAlways("Age (months)" + n, row.age_months));
        if (row.address) bizSec.appendChild(rowAlways("Address" + n, row.address));
        if (row.extra_owners_warning) {
          bizSec.appendChild(rowAlways(
            "Extra owners" + n,
            "Yes — funding is slower and harder"
          ));
        }
      });
    }
    drawerBody.appendChild(bizSec);

    var path = sec("Path");
    path.appendChild(rowAlways("Tier", tier));
    path.appendChild(rowAlways("Prequal", cfGet(cf, ["analyzer_prequal_amount", "cf_reanalyzer_prequal_amount", "total_funding_estimate"])));
    drawerBody.appendChild(path);

    var attr = sec("How they got here");
    attr.appendChild(rowAlways("Source", cf.utm_source || null));
    attr.appendChild(rowAlways("Campaign", cf.utm_campaign || null));
    attr.appendChild(rowAlways("Ad", cf.utm_content || null));
    attr.appendChild(rowAlways("Landed on", cf.landing_path || null));
    attr.appendChild(rowAlways("Magnet", cf.lead_magnet_type || null));
    drawerBody.appendChild(attr);
    paintAdRouting(attr, clientId);

    var survey = sec("Survey");
    surveyRowsFor(cf).forEach(function (pair) {
      survey.appendChild(rowAlways(pair[0], pair[1]));
    });
    drawerBody.appendChild(survey);

    var box = document.createElement("div");
    box.className = "fh-drawer-links";
    var a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = "client-control-panel.html?id=" + encodeURIComponent(c.client_id);
    a.textContent = "Open full file ↗";
    box.appendChild(a);
    drawerBody.appendChild(box);
  }

  function openClientDrawer(c) {
    drawerClient = c;
    if (drawerName) drawerName.textContent = c.name || "Contact";
    if (drawerBody) {
      paintDrawer(c, { client: { email: c.email, phone: c.phone, custom_fields: {}, outcome_tier: c.outcome_tier } });
    }
    if (drawerEl) {
      drawerEl.classList.add("open");
      drawerEl.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    }
    if (typeof FHData !== "undefined" && FHData.client) {
      FHData.client(c.client_id).then(function (res) {
        if (!drawerClient || drawerClient.client_id !== c.client_id) return;
        if (res && res.ok && res.data) paintDrawer(c, res.data);
        else if (res && res.ok) paintDrawer(c, res);
      });
    } else {
      fetch("/api/dashboard/client?id=" + encodeURIComponent(c.client_id), { headers: dashHeaders() })
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (d) {
          if (!drawerClient || drawerClient.client_id !== c.client_id) return;
          if (d && d.ok) paintDrawer(c, d);
          else {
            drawerBody.textContent = "";
            var err = document.createElement("p");
            err.className = "fh-drawer-empty";
            err.textContent = "Could not load this contact.";
            drawerBody.appendChild(err);
          }
        })
        .catch(function () {
          drawerBody.textContent = "";
          var err = document.createElement("p");
          err.className = "fh-drawer-empty";
          err.textContent = "Could not load this contact.";
          drawerBody.appendChild(err);
        });
    }
  }

  function syncDelGo() {
    if (!delGo) return;
    delGo.disabled = !(delInput && delInput.value === "DELETE");
  }

  function openDeleteConfirm(c) {
    pendingDelete = c;
    if (delInput) delInput.value = "";
    syncDelGo();
    if (delModal) delModal.classList.add("open");
    if (delInput) setTimeout(function () { delInput.focus(); }, 0);
  }

  function closeDeleteConfirm() {
    pendingDelete = null;
    if (delModal) delModal.classList.remove("open");
  }

  function runArchive() {
    if (!pendingDelete || !pendingDelete.client_id) return;
    if (!delInput || delInput.value !== "DELETE") return;
    var c = pendingDelete;
    delGo.disabled = true;
    fetch("/api/dashboard/client-archive", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: dashHeaders(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ client_id: c.client_id, confirm: "DELETE" })
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (d) { return { ok: r.ok, d: d }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok || !res.d || !res.d.ok) {
          banner("error", "Archive failed" + (res.d && res.d.error ? (": " + res.d.error) : ""));
          syncDelGo();
          return;
        }
        closeDeleteConfirm();
        closeClientDrawer();
        // Drop from local cache and re-paint current board without a full reload.
        Object.keys(cache).forEach(function (k) {
          cache[k] = (cache[k] || []).map(function (st) {
            return Object.assign({}, st, {
              cards: (st.cards || []).filter(function (card) {
                return card.client_id !== c.client_id;
              })
            });
          });
        });
        if (activePipelineKey && cache[activePipelineKey]) {
          var rail = null;
          Object.keys(PIPELINE_KEYS).forEach(function (rk) {
            if (PIPELINE_KEYS[rk] === activePipelineKey) rail = rk;
          });
          applyBoard(cache[activePipelineKey], rail || "R-01", "board", activePipelineKey);
        }
        banner("note", "Archived " + (c.name || "contact") + " · removed from pipeline");
      })
      .catch(function () {
        banner("error", "Archive failed — network");
        syncDelGo();
      });
  }

  if (document.getElementById("fhDrawerClose")) {
    document.getElementById("fhDrawerClose").addEventListener("click", closeClientDrawer);
  }
  if (document.getElementById("fhDrawerDel")) {
    document.getElementById("fhDrawerDel").addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (drawerClient) openDeleteConfirm(drawerClient);
    });
  }
  if (document.getElementById("fhDelCancel")) {
    document.getElementById("fhDelCancel").addEventListener("click", closeDeleteConfirm);
  }
  if (delGo) delGo.addEventListener("click", runArchive);
  if (delInput) {
    delInput.addEventListener("input", syncDelGo);
    delInput.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
      if (ev.key === "Enter") runArchive();
      if (ev.key === "Escape") closeDeleteConfirm();
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
    if (ev.key === "Escape" && delModal && delModal.classList.contains("open")) {
      closeDeleteConfirm();
      return;
    }
    if (ev.key === "Escape" && drawerEl && drawerEl.classList.contains("open")) {
      closeClientDrawer();
    }
  });

  // A single reused element, not one appended per load: switching rails
  // repeatedly used to stack a fresh fixed banner at the bottom of the page
  // on every click, once loads stopped happening exactly once at page load.
  var bannerEl = null;
  /* NO COLOURED BAR — owner call 2026-08-28, they go from the whole CRM. This
     was a mint, peach or rose strip across the bottom of the board. What each
     tone does now:

       real   — renders nothing. "live pipeline" is a developer's receipt and
                it was the green bar; the board being full says it better.
       sample — renders nothing. Every caller of this tone also calls
                showNote(), which puts the same sentence on the board itself
                where the reader is already looking.
       note   — renders, in app ink with ordinary text. This is the tone for
                something the person just DID and needs told about — an archive
                that worked, a rail that is genuinely empty. Without it,
                removing the green bar would have silently swallowed the only
                confirmation an archive ever gave.
       error  — renders, in app ink with the sentence in the brand's alert
                colour, which shell.js repaints per company. */
  function banner(tone, text) {
    if (tone === "real" || tone === "sample") return;
    if (!bannerEl) {
      bannerEl = document.createElement("div");
      bannerEl.setAttribute("role", "status");
      bannerEl.style.cssText =
        "position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:2147482000;padding:7px 14px;" +
        "background:#0A0A0A;border-top:1px solid #26262B;" +
        "font:600 11px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;" +
        "letter-spacing:.05em;text-align:center";
      document.body.appendChild(bannerEl);
    }
    bannerEl.style.color = tone === "error" ? "var(--alert,#F2A69B)" : "#E4E4E7";
    bannerEl.textContent = text;
  }

  // No-column note, shown only for a genuine problem (backend down, or a key
  // the database truly has no pipeline for) — never for "we haven't wired
  // this rail yet", because every rail is wired to the same generic endpoint.
  // Status note over the board. Used for loading, honest empty, and failures.
  // Never leave the board area blank without a sentence saying why.
  var wrap = document.querySelector(".board-wrap");
  var statusEl = document.getElementById("boardStatus");
  function showNote(text) {
    if (!statusEl) {
      statusEl = document.createElement("div");
      statusEl.className = "empty-rail-note";
      statusEl.id = "boardStatus";
      wrap.insertBefore(statusEl, board);
    }
    statusEl.textContent = text;
    statusEl.hidden = false;
    board.hidden = true;
  }
  function hideNote() {
    if (statusEl) statusEl.hidden = true;
    board.hidden = false;
  }
  function showLoading(label) {
    showNote("Loading " + (label || "the board") + "…");
    setSummary(null);
    clearHeadline("Loading " + (label || "the board") + "…");
  }

  /* ── WHOSE MONEY IS THIS? ────────────────────────────────────────────────
     Every card carries ONE dollar figure and it is the same figure on every
     rail: funded_amount if the file has funded, otherwise the client's
     total_funding_estimate (api/dashboard/pipeline.mjs builds `amount` that
     way). That is the client's FUNDING number.

     Adding those up per column made sense on Sales and on Card Stacking and
     was plainly wrong everywhere else: the Inquiry Removal board printed
     "$212,000 est." as its column total and its board total, which reads as
     money owed for inquiry removal. It is nothing of the sort — inquiry
     removal, repair rounds, AR, affiliates and hiring have no dollar figure on
     this board at all.

     So the totals are drawn on the rails the number belongs to, and nowhere
     else. The card keeps the number on every rail — it is true about the
     client wherever you meet them — but it now says what it is. */
  var MONEY_RAILS = { sales: 1, funding_card_stacking: 1, funding_altfin: 1 };
  function railHasMoney(key) {
    return !!MONEY_RAILS[key || activePipelineKey];
  }

  function buildColumn(stage, pipelineKey) {
    var col = document.createElement("section");
    col.className = "col";
    if (pipelineKey) col.dataset.pipelineKey = pipelineKey;
    if (stage.key) col.dataset.stageKey = stage.key;
    var head = document.createElement("div");
    head.className = "col-head";
    var headTop = document.createElement("div");
    headTop.className = "col-head-top";
    var nameEl = document.createElement("div");
    nameEl.className = "col-name"; nameEl.textContent = stage.name;
    var countEl = document.createElement("div");
    countEl.className = "col-count"; countEl.textContent = String(stage.count);
    headTop.appendChild(nameEl); headTop.appendChild(countEl);
    head.appendChild(headTop);
    if (railHasMoney(pipelineKey)) {
      var moneyEl = document.createElement("div");
      moneyEl.className = "col-money";
      moneyEl.textContent = (stage.amount == null ? "—" : usd(stage.amount)) + " funding est.";
      moneyEl.title = stage.amount == null
        ? "No client in this column has a funding estimate yet."
        : "The funding these clients are estimated to get. Not money collected.";
      head.appendChild(moneyEl);
    }
    var body = document.createElement("div");
    body.className = "col-body";
    (stage.cards || []).forEach(function (c) { body.appendChild(cardEl(c, stage.key)); });
    col.appendChild(head); col.appendChild(body);
    return col;
  }

  var activePipelineKey = "sales";

  function paint(stages, pipelineKey) {
    while (board.firstChild) board.removeChild(board.firstChild);
    var shown = 0;
    (stages || []).forEach(function (s) {
      board.appendChild(buildColumn(s, pipelineKey || activePipelineKey));
      shown += (s.cards || []).length;
    });
    hideNote();
    return { shown: shown, stageCount: (stages || []).length };
  }

  var PIPELINE_KEYS = {
    "R-01": "sales",
    "R-02": "funding_card_stacking",
    "R-03": "funding_altfin",
    "R-04": "optimization",
    "R-05": "inquiry_removal",
    "R-06": "ar_collections",
    "R-08": "affiliates_white_label",
    "R-09": "hiring"
  };

  var cache = {};
  var loadSeq = 0;

  /* ── THE SALES BOARD DOES NOT MOVE ITSELF WHEN MONEY LANDS ───────────────
     Traced 2026-09-06, because "Closed Won (deposit)" read 0 with a paid
     $3,000 client sitting two columns back in Decision Rendered:

       * payment.received / deposit.paid only stamp a flag on the client
         (src/handlers/client-lifecycle.mjs onDepositPaid) — no card is touched.
       * the purchase router places a card on the FUNDING board when someone
         buys (src/handlers/purchase-routing.mjs) and never advances the sales
         card.
       * the one thing that does move a card into Closed Won is a client
         texting back "yes" (src/workflows/dpc-03-inbound-reply-router.mjs).
         That is their answer, not their payment.

     So the move is manual, and this says so where the zero is, rather than
     leaving the board looking broken. It is a note, not a fix: putting a
     payment-driven move into the product is a decision for the owner and a
     change to a handler, not to this screen. */
  var railNoteEl = document.getElementById("railNote");
  var RAIL_NOTES = {
    sales: "A payment does not move a card. When a deposit is paid, somebody has to " +
           "move the card to Closed Won (deposit) — drag it, or use MOVE on the card. " +
           "Nothing moves it for you."
  };
  function setRailNote(key) {
    if (!railNoteEl) return;
    var text = RAIL_NOTES[key || activePipelineKey] || "";
    railNoteEl.textContent = text;
    railNoteEl.hidden = !text;
  }

  function applyBoard(stages, rail, label, key) {
    var r = paint(stages, key);
    setRailNote(key);
    setSummary(fhPipelineSummary(stages));
    setHeadline(stages);
    if (typeof window.rebuildOwnerOptions === "function") {
      try { window.rebuildOwnerOptions(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    // A rail that arrives while a filter is on must obey it, or the board
    // shows cards the filter says are hidden.
    if (typeof window.fhApplyFilters === "function") {
      try { window.fhApplyFilters(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (r.shown === 0) {
      banner("note",
        label.toLowerCase() +
        " · no cards on this rail yet — stages are ready, nobody has been placed here");
    }
  }

  function failBoard(res, label) {
    setSummary(null);
    // The read did not answer, so the count is UNKNOWN and says so. A 0 here
    // would read as "nothing is waiting on you", which is the one thing a
    // failed read can never prove. The reason itself is carried by the banner
    // and the board note below, in the house wording, not repeated here.
    clearHeadline("The board did not load, so this number is unknown.");
    while (board.firstChild) board.removeChild(board.firstChild);
    if (res.source === "demo") {
      showNote(label + " — demo session. The board was not loaded from the database.");
      banner("sample", "demo session — the backend was not queried");
    } else if (res.source === "notfound") {
      showNote(label + " — the database has no pipeline configured for this rail yet.");
      banner("sample", label + " — pipeline not configured");
    } else if (res.source === "unauthorized") {
      showNote(label + " — you are not signed in, so the board cannot load.");
      banner("error", label + " — not signed in");
    } else {
      showNote(label + " — could not load the board (" + (res.source || "error") +
               (res.error ? ": " + res.error : "") + ").");
      banner("error", label + " — load failed (" + res.source + ": " + res.error + ")");
    }
  }

  function load(rail, label) {
    var key = PIPELINE_KEYS[rail];
    if (!key) { showNote(label + " — unknown rail."); return; }
    activePipelineKey = key;
    // Set here as well as in applyBoard so the note is right while the board is
    // loading and after a load that failed — it is a fact about the rail, not
    // about the cards that came back.
    setRailNote(key);
    if (window.FHPipelineBoard) window.FHPipelineBoard.currentKey = key;

    if (cache[key]) {
      applyBoard(cache[key], rail, label, key);
      return;
    }

    var seq = ++loadSeq;
    showLoading(label);
    FHData.pipeline(key).then(function (res) {
      if (seq !== loadSeq) return;
      if (res.ok && res.data && res.data.stages) {
        cache[key] = res.data.stages;
        applyBoard(res.data.stages, rail, label, key);
        return;
      }
      failBoard(res || { source: "offline", error: "no answer" }, label);
    });
  }

  function showPipeline(pipelineKey) {
    var rail = null;
    Object.keys(PIPELINE_KEYS).forEach(function (rk) {
      if (PIPELINE_KEYS[rk] === pipelineKey) rail = rk;
    });
    if (!rail) return;
    delete cache[pipelineKey];
    var tab = document.querySelector('.rail-tab[data-rail="' + rail + '"]');
    var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.rail-tab');
    for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) tabs[i].classList.remove('active');
    if (tab) tab.classList.add('active');
    var name = tab
      ? [].filter.call(tab.childNodes, function (n) { return n.nodeType === 3; })
          .map(function (n) { return n.textContent; }).join('').trim()
      : pipelineKey;
    var railLabel = document.getElementById('railLabel');
    if (railLabel && name) railLabel.textContent = name;
    load(rail, name || pipelineKey);
  }

  // Exposed so the rail-tab click handler (defined earlier in the page) can
  // drive the same loader. currentKey / invalidate / showPipeline are used by
  // drag + MOVE.
  window.FHPipelineBoard = {
    load: load,
    currentKey: activePipelineKey,
    showPipeline: showPipeline,
    invalidate: function (key) {
      if (key) delete cache[key];
      else Object.keys(cache).forEach(function (k) { delete cache[k]; });
    }
  };

  // data.js carries `defer` (see its tag above), so FHData does not exist yet
  // while this script is being parsed — calling it here threw, and the throw
  // killed the rest of this function before the board was ever requested. Every
  // deferred script runs before DOMContentLoaded, so the first read waits for
  // that event. The rail on screen is asked for first; the other tabs' counts
  // follow and never queue in front of the board the user is looking at.
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    load("R-01", "Sales");
  });
})();
</script>

<!-- ══ FULFILLMENT LENS ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Chris's option A. The client list with a next-action chip on each row, the
     six rollup tiles, and click-a-chip-to-filter — on the page that already
     exists, behind a switch.

     READ AND DISPLAY ONLY. One GET (/api/dashboard/clients, already routed and
     already called by this page's neighbours through FHData.clients). No write,
     no new route, no new screen.

     It runs LAST and it never touches the board. The board IIFE above owns
     .board and everything in it; this script only sets `hidden` on .board-row
     and reads elements it created itself.

     WHAT IT EXPECTS BACK, and what it does when it is not there:
       client.next_action     { key, label, why }        missing ⇒ neutral chip
       client.active_blockers [{ key, label, severity }] missing ⇒ no pills
       client.funding_round   { number, status, hold_reason,
                                approved_amount, finalized }  missing ⇒ no line
       data.rollups           the six tiles               missing ⇒ six dashes,
                                                          list still renders
       data.rollups.needs_consent  how many paid clients are waiting on written
                              permission. It is the SENTENCE under "Needs Pull",
                              never a seventh tile.  missing ⇒ no sentence
     Every one of those is guarded, and the whole paint is inside try/catch, so
     a shape that does not arrive costs a dash — never a blank row and never a
     crash that takes the board down with it.

     THE LIST IS ONE PAGE; THE TILES COUNT EVERYONE. This lens asks for a page
     of clients (see loadOnce below) while rollups.total_clients counts the
     whole org. When the page comes back short of that total, "Total clients"
     carries a sentence saying how many the list is showing. No paging control
     was added — Chris approved a list and six tiles, and this only stops the
     screen making a claim it cannot back up.
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* FH-LENS-BEGIN */
  /* The decisions, with no DOM in them, so they can be unit-tested the way
     FHPipelineSummary above is. Nothing in this block reads `document`. */

  var UNKNOWN_KEY = "not_enough_information";
  var NONE_APPLIES_KEY = "none_applies";

  /* ── TWO ANSWERS THAT ARE NOT A STEP, AND THEY ARE NOT THE SAME ANSWER ───
     An empty cell would read as "nothing to do", so both of these are real
     chips with real words. But they do not mean the same thing:

       NONE_APPLIES_CHIP — the read layer WORKED THIS FILE OUT and no step on
         Chris's list applies to it. That is a finished answer, and it is
         often the correct one: a repair-only client has no funding step, by
         design. Saying so is not a fault report.
       NEUTRAL_CHIP — nothing was worked out. Either the file could not be
         read, or the reply did not arrive in a shape we can trust.

     THE WORDS ARE THE CLIENT CONTROL PANEL'S OWN, COPIED EXACTLY — NONE_APPLIES
     and NOT_WORKED_OUT in the FH-CCP block of
     public/app/client-control-panel.html. One client, one answer, whichever
     screen it is read on. Telling staff on the list that we could not work a
     client out, while that same client's file says no step applies, makes
     behaviour Chris signed off look like a fault — and it read that way for
     six real clients, his repair-only one among them.

     They are two separate keys, not one key with two labels, because the chip
     is also the filter: one key would file both answers under whichever label
     happened to be first on screen and count them as one pile. */
  var NEUTRAL_CHIP = {
    key: UNKNOWN_KEY,
    label: "Not worked out yet.",
    why: "We could not work out a next step from what is on this client's file.",
    neutral: true
  };
  var NONE_APPLIES_CHIP = {
    key: NONE_APPLIES_KEY,
    label: "No step applies right now.",
    why: "No step on the list applies to this file right now.",
    neutral: true
  };

  function isObj(v) { return typeof v === "object" && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v); }
  function str(v) {
    if (typeof v !== "string") return null;
    var t = v.trim();
    return t === "" ? null : t;
  }

  /* ── MONEY: THE UNIT IS WHOLE DOLLARS ────────────────────────────────────
     Both money values this screen shows are DOLLARS. Not cents. Traced, not
     assumed:

       funding_rounds.approved_amount — numeric(14,2), db/schema/001_init.sql:127.
         node-postgres registers no parser for numeric (type 1700), so it
         arrives in JavaScript as a STRING: "50000.00" means $50,000.
       rollups.total_prequal — SUM of custom_fields.total_funding_estimate cast
         to numeric (src/fulfillment/read-signals.mjs:438), so also a STRING of
         dollars. The stored field itself is written in dollars as a NUMBER:
         src/handlers/client-lifecycle.mjs:449 saves crs.mjs's fundingEstimate,
         which the fixture in src/adapters/crs.test.mjs:63 pins at 80000 for an
         $80,000 pre-approval.

     THESE TWO ARE EXCEPTIONS TO CLAUDE.md §12's "money is integer cents".
     §12 describes src/commissions/money.mjs, and that module converts INTO
     cents at its own door: src/commissions/calculate.mjs:59 calls
     toCents(round.funded_amount), which multiplies by 100 — proof the column
     holds dollars. Cents never leave src/commissions/.

     ONE RULE, BOTH SCREENS. public/app/client-control-panel.html money()
     applies exactly this rule, and src/http/client-panel-screen.test.mjs
     fails if the two ever format the same value differently again.

     Anything that is not a number or a plain numeric string — null, undefined,
     a blank, a word, a wrong type — is UNKNOWN and comes back null so the
     caller prints a dash. Never 0 for unknown: a zero would be a claim that
     the amount is nothing, and unknown is not nothing. A RECORDED zero is a
     fact and does print, as $0. */
  function moneyText(v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return null;
    // A { cents: N } wrapper is the one shape here that really is cents.
    if (isObj(v)) {
      if (!("cents" in v)) return null;
      var c = v.cents;
      if (typeof c !== "number" || !isFinite(c)) return null;
      return "$" + Math.round(c / 100).toLocaleString("en-US");
    }
    var dollars;
    if (typeof v === "number") {
      if (!isFinite(v)) return null;
      dollars = v;
    } else if (typeof v === "string") {
      var t = v.trim();
      if (!/^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(t)) return null;
      dollars = Number(t);
      if (!isFinite(dollars)) return null;
    } else {
      return null;
    }
    return "$" + Math.round(dollars).toLocaleString("en-US");
  }

  /** Did the read layer work this file out?

      ONLY AN EXPLICIT `false` SAYS SO. api/dashboard/clients.mjs attaches
      next_action_degraded to every row alongside the answer itself, all four
      keys together or none of them, so a row that was derived always carries
      the flag. Absent, null, or any other shape is UNKNOWN — and unknown must
      survive as unknown. Reading a missing flag as "worked out" would put
      "No step applies right now." on a client nobody worked out, which is the
      more dangerous of the two wrong answers: it reads as an all-clear.
      `degraded` is accepted as a second spelling for the same reason the
      Client Control Panel accepts it — so this cannot go blind if the key is
      ever renamed. */
  function workedOut(client) {
    if (!isObj(client)) return false;
    var d = client.next_action_degraded;
    if (d == null) d = client.degraded;
    return d === false;
  }

  /** One client -> the chip to show. Never null, never blank, never throws. */
  function chipOf(client) {
    try {
      var na = client ? client.next_action : null;
      // A reply we cannot read is not a reply saying "nothing to do".
      if (na != null && !isObj(na)) return NEUTRAL_CHIP;
      if (isObj(na)) {
        var key = str(na.key), label = str(na.label);
        if (key && label) {
          return { key: key, label: label, why: str(na.why) || NEUTRAL_CHIP.why, neutral: false };
        }
      }
      return workedOut(client) ? NONE_APPLIES_CHIP : NEUTRAL_CHIP;
    } catch (e) {
      return NEUTRAL_CHIP;
    }
  }

  /** How many clients sit under each chip. Used for the filter bar's count. */
  function chipCounts(clients) {
    var out = {};
    (Array.isArray(clients) ? clients : []).forEach(function (c) {
      var k = chipOf(c).key;
      out[k] = (out[k] || 0) + 1;
    });
    return out;
  }

  /** A person's name from whatever the row actually carries. */
  function nameOf(client) {
    if (!isObj(client)) return "Unnamed client";
    var direct = str(client.name);
    if (direct) return direct;
    var both = [str(client.first_name), str(client.last_name)].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
    if (both) return both;
    return str(client.email) || "Unnamed client";
  }

  /** active_blockers, passed through as-is minus anything unreadable. */
  function blockersOf(client) {
    var arr = client && client.active_blockers;
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];
    var out = [];
    arr.forEach(function (b) {
      if (!isObj(b)) return;
      var label = str(b.label) || str(b.key);
      if (!label) return;
      out.push({ label: label, severity: b.severity === "high" ? "high" : "normal" });
    });
    return out;
  }

  /** funding_round -> one line, or null when there is no round to describe.

      COMPLIANCE GATE B. The only value ever passed in here is
      client.funding_round, and the server refuses to send that key for any
      tier outside the three funding tiers — fundingChipsAllowed() in
      src/fulfillment/next-action.mjs, the same whitelist the chips use. So a
      REPAIR_ONLY row arrives with null, this returns null, and the row shows
      no round and no approved amount. Never read a raw funding_rounds row
      here: that walks straight around the gate. */
  function roundText(round) {
    if (!isObj(round)) return null;
    var bits = [];
    if (typeof round.number === "number" && isFinite(round.number)) bits.push("Round " + round.number);
    var status = str(round.status);
    if (status) bits.push(status);
    var hold = str(round.hold_reason);
    if (hold) bits.push("held: " + hold);
    var money = moneyText(round.approved_amount);
    if (bits.length === 0 && money === null) return null;
    bits.push("approved " + (money === null ? "—" : money));
    return bits.join(" · ");
  }

  /* THE SIX TILES. `unknownNote` is the sentence a tile carries when it has no
     number — Phase 0 §5 proved "Ready" has no honest source today, and a 0
     would be a false statement, so it says what it is instead. "Total
     Approved" is now counted from the bank approvals on the rounds (hole 8);
     it is a dash only when no approval has been recorded at all. */
  var TILES = {
    total_clients:  { kind: "count",
      unknownNote: "Not measured yet." },
    needs_pull:     { kind: "count",
      unknownNote: "Not measured yet." },
    action_needed:  { kind: "count",
      unknownNote: "Not measured yet." },
    ready:          { kind: "count",
      unknownNote: "No honest source yet. Nothing in the system records this, so there is no number to show. A zero here would be a false claim." },
    total_prequal:  { kind: "money",
      unknownNote: "Not measured yet." },
    total_approved: { kind: "money",
      unknownNote: "No bank approval has been recorded yet. A zero here would be a false claim." }
  };

  /* How many clients contributed to Total Prequal. It is one client's number
     today (Phase 0 §5), so the tile must never read as a company total. */
  function prequalContributors(rollups) {
    if (!isObj(rollups)) return null;
    var keys = ["total_prequal_clients", "total_prequal_client_count", "total_prequal_count"];
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      var v = rollups[keys[i]];
      if (typeof v === "number" && isFinite(v)) return v;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /** One tile -> { value, note }. Unknown is always a dash plus a sentence.
   *
   *  `shown` is how many clients the list underneath actually got back. It is
   *  only used by the "Total clients" tile — see the note there. Leave it out
   *  and no tile says anything about it. */
  function rollupText(rollups, id, shown) {
    var tile = TILES[id];
    if (!tile) return { value: "—", note: "" };
    if (!isObj(rollups)) {
      return { value: "—", note: "The totals did not come back with the list." };
    }
    var raw = rollups[id];
    var value = null;
    if (tile.kind === "count") {
      if (typeof raw === "number" && isFinite(raw)) value = String(raw);
    } else {
      value = moneyText(raw);
    }
    if (value === null) return { value: "—", note: tile.unknownNote };

    if (id === "total_prequal") {
      var n = prequalContributors(rollups);
      return {
        value: value,
        note: n === null
          ? "This is not a company total. We could not tell how many clients it came from."
          : ("From " + n + " client" + (n === 1 ? "" : "s") + ". This is not a company total.")
      };
    }

    /* Total Approved is the bank yeses on the rounds, which is not the money
       that funded. On a file with two $25,000 funded rounds and one $10,000
       bank yes, this tile says $10,000 — so it says where that came from and
       how many funded rounds have no approval on them, rather than reading as
       if it disagreed with the funded total (hole 8). */
    if (id === "total_approved") {
      var bits = [];
      var rounds = rollups.total_approved_rounds;
      if (typeof rounds === "number" && isFinite(rounds) && rounds > 0) {
        bits.push("From " + rounds + " round" + (rounds === 1 ? "" : "s") + " with a bank approval on file.");
      }
      var unapproved = rollups.funded_rounds_no_approval;
      if (typeof unapproved === "number" && isFinite(unapproved) && unapproved > 0) {
        bits.push(unapproved + " funded round" + (unapproved === 1 ? " has" : "s have") + " no approval recorded.");
      }
      return { value: value, note: bits.join(" ") };
    }

    /* "Needs Pull" counts only clients whose written permission is live, the
       same rule the chip and the pull button use. The ones it leaves out have
       paid and have nothing pulled, but nobody may touch their credit yet — so
       they are named here rather than quietly lost. NOT a seventh tile. */
    if (id === "needs_pull") {
      var waiting = rollups.needs_consent;
      if (typeof waiting === "number" && isFinite(waiting) && waiting > 0) {
        return {
          value: value,
          note: waiting + " more " + (waiting === 1 ? "is" : "are") +
                " waiting on written permission first."
        };
      }
      return { value: value, note: "" };
    }

    /* THE TILE COUNTS THE WHOLE BOOK. THE LIST UNDER IT DOES NOT.
       loadOnce() asks for one page of clients; this number counts every client
       in the org, with no cap. At 47 clients the two are the same and nobody
       notices. Above the page size the tile sits over a list that cannot show
       everyone, and until this sentence existed nothing on screen said so.
       One sentence, only when the two numbers actually disagree. No second
       tile, and no paging. */
    if (id === "total_clients") {
      if (typeof shown === "number" && isFinite(shown) && shown < raw) {
        return {
          value: value,
          note: "The list below shows " + shown + " of these " + raw + "."
        };
      }
      return { value: value, note: "" };
    }
    return { value: value, note: "" };
  }

  window.FHFulfillmentLens = {
    UNKNOWN_KEY: UNKNOWN_KEY,
    NONE_APPLIES_KEY: NONE_APPLIES_KEY,
    NEUTRAL_CHIP: NEUTRAL_CHIP,
    NONE_APPLIES_CHIP: NONE_APPLIES_CHIP,
    moneyText: moneyText,
    chipOf: chipOf,
    chipCounts: chipCounts,
    nameOf: nameOf,
    blockersOf: blockersOf,
    roundText: roundText,
    rollupText: rollupText,
    TILE_IDS: Object.keys(TILES)
  };
  /* FH-LENS-END */

  var L = window.FHFulfillmentLens;

  var lensEl   = document.getElementById("fhLens");
  var boardRow = document.querySelector(".board-row");
  var btnLens  = document.getElementById("lensFulfillment");
  var btnBoard = document.getElementById("lensBoard");
  if (!lensEl || !boardRow || !btnLens || !btnBoard) return;

  var listEl   = document.getElementById("fhLensList");
  var statusEl = document.getElementById("fhLensStatus");
  var barEl    = document.getElementById("fhLensBar");
  var barText  = document.getElementById("fhLensBarText");
  var clearEl  = document.getElementById("fhLensClear");

  /* Board-only chrome. Search, the filter control, its chips and the card /
     money / held summary all describe the BOARD; none of them means anything
     while the lens is up. They are hidden, and each one's previous `hidden`
     value is remembered so switching back restores it exactly — the filter
     panel does not spring open, an already-hidden Archive button stays
     hidden, and no filter is re-applied or cleared. */
  var boardOnly = [];
  [".search", "#filterBtn", "#fhNewClient", "#filterChips", ".headline", ".board-summary", "#filterPanel", "#railNote"].forEach(function (sel) {
    var el = document.querySelector(sel);
    if (el) boardOnly.push(el);
  });
  var priorHidden = null;

  var TILE_EL = {
    total_clients:  ["ltTotalClients",  "ltTotalClientsNote"],
    needs_pull:     ["ltNeedsPull",     "ltNeedsPullNote"],
    action_needed:  ["ltActionNeeded",  "ltActionNeededNote"],
    ready:          ["ltReady",         "ltReadyNote"],
    total_prequal:  ["ltTotalPrequal",  "ltTotalPrequalNote"],
    total_approved: ["ltTotalApproved", "ltTotalApprovedNote"]
  };

  var activeChip = null;
  var loaded = false;
  var loadedClients = [];

  function note(text) {
    if (!statusEl) return;
    statusEl.textContent = text;
    statusEl.hidden = false;
  }
  function hideNote() { if (statusEl) statusEl.hidden = true; }

  function paintTiles(rollups, shown) {
    Object.keys(TILE_EL).forEach(function (id) {
      var out = L.rollupText(rollups, id, shown);
      var v = document.getElementById(TILE_EL[id][0]);
      var n = document.getElementById(TILE_EL[id][1]);
      if (v) v.textContent = out.value;
      if (n) n.textContent = out.note;
    });
  }

  function rowEl(client) {
    var chip = L.chipOf(client);

    var row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "fh-lens-row";
    row.dataset.action = chip.key;
    if (client && client.id) row.dataset.clientId = client.id;

    var main = document.createElement("div");
    main.className = "lr-main";
    var nameEl = document.createElement("div");
    nameEl.className = "lr-name";
    nameEl.textContent = L.nameOf(client);   // client data: textContent, never innerHTML
    main.appendChild(nameEl);
    var whyEl = document.createElement("div");
    whyEl.className = "lr-why";
    whyEl.textContent = chip.why;
    main.appendChild(whyEl);
    row.appendChild(main);

    var side = document.createElement("div");
    side.className = "lr-side";

    var btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.type = "button";
    // Both answers that are not a step are drawn quiet, so a real step never
    // has to compete with one for attention.
    btn.className = "fh-chip" + (chip.neutral ? " unknown" : "");
    btn.dataset.action = chip.key;
    btn.textContent = chip.label;
    btn.title = chip.neutral
      ? "Show only clients whose row says: " + chip.label
      : "Show only clients whose next action is " + chip.label;
    side.appendChild(btn);

    var blockers = L.blockersOf(client);
    if (blockers.length) {
      var box = document.createElement("div");
      box.className = "lr-blockers";
      blockers.forEach(function (b) {
        var pill = document.createElement("span");
        pill.className = "lr-blocker" + (b.severity === "high" ? " high" : "");
        pill.textContent = b.label;
        box.appendChild(pill);
      });
      side.appendChild(box);
    }

    var line = L.roundText(client && client.funding_round);
    if (line) {
      var roundEl = document.createElement("div");
      roundEl.className = "lr-round";
      roundEl.textContent = line;
      side.appendChild(roundEl);
    }

    row.appendChild(side);
    return row;
  }

  function applyChipFilter() {
    var rows = [].slice.call(listEl.querySelectorAll(".fh-lens-row"));
    var shown = 0;
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      var hit = !activeChip || r.dataset.action === activeChip;
      r.classList.toggle("filtered", !hit);
      if (hit) shown++;
    });
    listEl.querySelectorAll(".fh-chip").forEach(function (c) {
      c.classList.toggle("on", !!activeChip && c.dataset.action === activeChip);
    });
    if (!activeChip) {
      if (barEl) barEl.hidden = true;
      return;
    }
    var label = activeChip;
    var first = listEl.querySelector('.fh-lens-row[data-action="' + activeChip + '"] .fh-chip');
    if (first) label = first.textContent;
    if (barText) {
      barText.textContent = 'Showing only "' + label + '" — ' + shown +
        " of " + rows.length + " client" + (rows.length === 1 ? "" : "s") + ".";
    }
    if (barEl) barEl.hidden = false;
  }

  function paintList(clients) {
    loadedClients = Array.isArray(clients) ? clients : [];
    while (listEl.firstChild) listEl.removeChild(listEl.firstChild);
    if (!loadedClients.length) {
      note("No clients came back for this org.");
      return;
    }
    loadedClients.forEach(function (c) { listEl.appendChild(rowEl(c)); });
    hideNote();
    applyChipFilter();
  }

  function failNote(res) {
    var src = (res && res.source) || "error";
    if (src === "demo") return "Demo session. The client list was not read from the database.";
    if (src === "unauthorized") return "You are not signed in, so the client list cannot load.";
    if (src === "nodb") return "The database is not reachable right now, so the list cannot load.";
    return "Could not load the client list (" + src +
           (res && res.error ? ": " + res.error : "") + ").";
  }

  // One read, the first time the lens is opened. The board's own loads are
  // untouched and nothing here re-requests a pipeline.
  function loadOnce() {
    if (loaded) return;
    loaded = true;
    if (typeof FHData === "undefined" || !FHData.clients) {
      note("The client list could not be requested on this page.");
      return;
    }
    note("Loading the client list…");
    /* { fulfillment: true } is what asks the endpoint to work out the chips and
       the tiles. It is opt-in — that work costs eleven extra reads and this
       lens is the only screen that uses them, so every other caller of
       FHData.clients() still gets the plain client list it always got. */
    FHData.clients(200, { fulfillment: true }).then(function (res) {
      try {
        if (!res || !res.ok || !res.data) {
          paintTiles(null);
          note(failNote(res));
          return;
        }
        /* Tiles first: if the rollups are missing the list must still paint.
           The tiles are told how many clients came back, so "Total clients"
           can say when the list underneath is showing fewer than it counts. */
        var shown = Array.isArray(res.data.clients) ? res.data.clients.length : null;
        try { paintTiles(res.data.rollups, shown); } catch (e) { paintTiles(null, null); }
        paintList(res.data.clients);
      } catch (e) {
        note("Something went wrong building this view. The board is unaffected — switch back to Board.");
      }
    });
  }

  function setLens(on) {
    try {
      if (on) {
        if (priorHidden === null) {
          priorHidden = boardOnly.map(function (el) { return el.hidden; });
          boardOnly.forEach(function (el) { el.hidden = true; });
        }
        boardRow.hidden = true;
        lensEl.hidden = false;
      } else {
        if (priorHidden !== null) {
          boardOnly.forEach(function (el, i) { el.hidden = priorHidden[i]; });
          priorHidden = null;
        }
        lensEl.hidden = true;
        boardRow.hidden = false;
      }
      btnLens.classList.toggle("on", on);
      btnBoard.classList.toggle("on", !on);
      btnLens.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
      btnBoard.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!on));
      if (on) loadOnce();
    } catch (e) {
      // Any failure leaves the board where it was. Never a blank page.
    }
  }

  btnLens.addEventListener("click", function () { setLens(true); });
  btnBoard.addEventListener("click", function () { setLens(false); });

  // Click a chip to filter to it. Click the same chip again to clear.
  listEl.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
    var chip = ev.target && ev.target.closest && ev.target.closest(".fh-chip");
    if (!chip) return;
    var key = chip.dataset.action;
    activeChip = (activeChip === key) ? null : key;
    applyChipFilter();
  });
  if (clearEl) {
    clearEl.addEventListener("click", function () { activeChip = null; applyChipFilter(); });
  }
})();
</script>
<script>
function tickClock() {
  var el = document.querySelector(".clock");
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", {
    weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit",
    timeZone: "America/Phoenix", timeZoneName: "short"
  });
}
tickClock();
setInterval(tickClock, 1000);
</script>
</body>
</html>

  t.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var w=t.closest('.card');
    w.classList.remove('on-ledger');
    w.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('on')});
