/* ══ THE LEDGER IS A LINK, NOT A TAB ══════════════════════════════════════
   This screen is for editing rules. The ledger keeps its full pane but is
   reached by name, and hands you back to the rules it was computed from.   */
function showLedger(on){
  var card=document.querySelector('.tabs').closest('.card');
  card.classList.toggle('on-ledger',on);
  card.querySelectorAll('.tabpane').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('on')});
  if(on){
    document.getElementById('tab-ledger').classList.add('on');
  }else{
    card.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('on')});
    var rt=card.querySelector('.tab[data-tab="rules"]');
    rt.classList.add('on');
    document.getElementById('tab-rules').classList.add('on');
  }
}
document.getElementById('ledgerLink').addEventListener('click',function(){showLedger(true)});
document.getElementById('ledgerBack').addEventListener('click',function(){showLedger(false)});
function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]});}
function money(n){return '$'+Number(n||0).toLocaleString('en-US',{maximumFractionDigits:2})}
var TODAY=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);   /* §6: read, not typed */
/* §6: "PAID MTD" must name the month it actually is. Read off the clock, never
   typed in — MONTH_START also bounds the month-to-date sum below. */
var MONTH_START=(function(){var d=new Date();return d.getFullYear()+'-'+('0'+(d.getMonth()+1)).slice(-2)+'-01'})();
var MONTH_LABEL=new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'long',year:'numeric'}).toLowerCase();
/* ══ PRODUCTS — start empty; /api/read/products fills when live ══════════ */
var PRODUCTS=[];

/* ══ COMMISSION RULES — effective-dated rows from /api/commission-rules. ══ */
var RULES=[];
var RULES_ERROR='';
function activeV(r){return r.versions.filter(function(v){return v.to===null})[0]||r.versions[r.versions.length-1]}
function dateOnly(v){return v?String(v).slice(0,10):null}
function roleLabel(v){return String(v||'Everyone').replace(/_/g,' ').replace(/\b\w/g,function(c){return c.toUpperCase()})}
function ruleGroups(rows){
  var groups={};
  (rows||[]).forEach(function(row){
    var key=[row.name,row.basis,row.stacking,row.product_id||'*',row.role||'*',
      row.staff_id||'*',row.calc_method,row.amount_basis].join('|');
    if(!groups[key]){
      groups[key]={
        id:row.id,name:row.name||'Commission rule',
        side:row.basis==='front_end'?'Front-end':'Back-end',
        scope:row.product_name||'All products',
        who:row.staff_name||roleLabel(row.role),
        kind:row.calc_method==='flat_per_unit'?'per-unit':row.calc_method,
        tiers:row.tiers||[],versions:[]
      };
    }
    var rate=row.calc_method==='percent'?Number(row.percent):
      (row.flat_amount==null?null:Number(row.flat_amount));
    groups[key].versions.push({
      rowId:row.id,rate:rate,from:dateOnly(row.effective_from),
      to:dateOnly(row.effective_to),by:'—',why:row.notes||'—'
    });
  });
  return Object.keys(groups).map(function(key){
    var rule=groups[key];
    rule.versions.sort(function(a,b){return String(a.from).localeCompare(String(b.from))});
    rule.versions.forEach(function(v,i){v.v=i+1});
    return rule;
  });
}

/* ══ WHO A RULE AFFECTS ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Read straight off the ledger rows that name this rule, so the header
   answers "if I change this, who does it affect?" without opening anything.  */
function impactOf(r){
  var rows=LEDGER.filter(function(l){return l.rule===r.id});
  var people=[]; rows.forEach(function(l){ if(people.indexOf(l.who)<0) people.push(l.who); });
  var unpaid=rows.filter(function(l){return l.st!=='Paid'});
  return {rows:rows,people:people,
          total:rows.reduce(function(a,l){return a+l.amt},0),
          unpaid:unpaid.reduce(function(a,l){return a+l.amt},0),
          nUnpaid:unpaid.length};
}
function impactStr(r){
  var im=impactOf(r);
  if(!im.rows.length) return '<span class="ri-none">Affects nobody yet — no payout has been computed from this rule</span>';
  return 'Affects <b>'+esc(im.people.join(', '))+'</b> · '+im.rows.length+
    ' payout'+(im.rows.length===1?'':'s')+' · '+money(im.total)+' to date'+
    (im.nUnpaid?' · <b class="ri-open">'+money(im.unpaid)+' still unpaid</b>':'');
}
function rateStr(r,v){
  if(r.kind==='tiered') return 'tiered';
  if(r.kind==='per-unit') return '$'+v.rate+'/unit';
  if(r.kind==='flat') return money(v.rate);
  return v.rate+'%';
}

var LEDGER=[];
var ST_CLS={Paid:'b-ok',Approved:'b-info',Accrued:'b-warn'};

/* ══ RENDER ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderProducts(){
  document.getElementById('prodBody').innerHTML=PRODUCTS.map(function(p){
    var price = p.min !== p.max ? money(p.min)+' – '+money(p.max) : money(p.price);
    return '<tr class="clik" data-p="'+p.id+'">'+
      '<td><div style="font-weight:600">'+esc(p.name)+'</div><div class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray2);letter-spacing:.1em">'+p.id+'</div></td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge b-gray">'+esc(p.cat)+'</span></td>'+
      '<td class="money">'+price+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+(p.variable?'<span class="badge b-info">Variable</span>':'<span class="badge b-gray">Fixed</span>')+'</td>'+
      '<td style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray)">'+(p.rails&&p.rails.length?esc(p.rails.join(' · ')):'<span title="No rails source">—</span>')+'</td></tr>';
  }).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">No products on file yet.</td></tr>';
  document.querySelectorAll('#prodBody tr[data-p]').forEach(function(tr){
    tr.addEventListener('click',function(){openProduct(tr.dataset.p)});
  });
  document.getElementById('kProd').textContent=PRODUCTS.length;
  paintVariableCaption();
}

/* The caption used to be frozen sample copy ("3 with variable pricing") while
   the table below it showed 4. Count it from the same rows the table draws. */
function paintVariableCaption(){
  var el=document.getElementById('kProdVar');
  if(!el) return;
  if(typeof PRODUCTS==='undefined'||!PRODUCTS.length){el.textContent='no products on file yet';return;}
  var n=PRODUCTS.filter(function(p){return !!p.variable}).length;
  el.textContent=n+(n===1?' with variable pricing':' with variable pricing');
}

function renderRules(){
  var list=RULES;
  document.getElementById('ruleList').innerHTML=list.map(function(r){
    var av=activeV(r);
    var vrows=r.versions.slice().reverse().map(function(v){
      var open=v.to===null;
      return '<tr class="'+(open?'':'closed')+'">'+
        '<td><span class="vrail" style="background:'+(open?'var(--ok)':'var(--line)')+'"></span> <span class="mono">v'+v.v+'</span></td>'+
        '<td class="money">'+(r.kind==='tiered'?'tier table':(r.kind==='per-unit'?'$'+v.rate+'/unit':v.rate+'%'))+'</td>'+
        '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+v.from+'</td>'+
        '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+(v.to||'—')+'</td>'+
        '<td>'+(open?'<span class="badge b-ok">Open</span>':'<span class="badge b-gray">Closed</span>')+'</td>'+
        '<td style="font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--gray)">'+esc(v.why)+'<div class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption);color:var(--gray2)">'+esc(v.by)+'</div></td></tr>';
    }).join('');

    var tiers='';
    if(r.kind==='tiered'){
      tiers='<div class="tierbox"><div class="eyebrow" style="margin-bottom:6px">TIERS</div>'+
        r.tiers.map(function(t,i){
          var tierRate=t.percent!=null?Number(t.percent)+'%':
            (t.flat_amount!=null?money(Number(t.flat_amount)):
              (t.per_unit_amount!=null?money(Number(t.per_unit_amount))+'/unit':'—'));
          return '<div class="tierrow"><span class="badge b-accent">T'+(i+1)+'</span>'+
            '<span class="tb">'+money(Number(t.min_amount||0))+' → '+
              (t.max_amount==null?'no ceiling':money(Number(t.max_amount)))+'</span>'+
            '<span class="money">'+tierRate+'</span></div>';
        }).join('')+'</div>';
    }

    var actions='<div style="display:flex;gap:9px;margin-top:11px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center">'+
      '<button class="btn sm mono" data-led="'+r.id+'">See these payouts →</button>'+
      '<span class="note" style="align-self:center">Tier changes stay read-only until tier version writes are supported.</span></div>';
    if(r.kind!=='tiered'){
      actions='<div style="display:flex;gap:9px;margin-top:11px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center">'+
        '<button class="btn sm mono dark" data-chg="'+r.id+'">Change rate</button>'+
        '<button class="btn sm mono" data-led="'+r.id+'">See these payouts →</button>'+
        '<span class="note" style="align-self:center">Closes v'+av.v+' and opens v'+(av.v+1)+'. The old version stays on the ledger.</span></div>'+
        '<div class="editline" id="el-'+r.id+'"><div class="grid2">'+
        '<div class="field"><label>New rate'+(r.kind==='per-unit'||r.kind==='flat'?' ($)':' (%)')+'</label>'+
        '<input class="num" type="number" step="0.01" min="0" id="nr-'+r.id+'" value="'+(av.rate==null?'':av.rate)+'"></div>'+
        '<div class="field"><label>Effective from</label><input type="date" id="nd-'+r.id+'" value="'+TODAY+'"></div>'+
        '<div class="field" style="grid-column:1/-1"><label>Reason</label><input id="nw-'+r.id+'" placeholder="Why this changed — shows on the ledger"></div></div>'+
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:9px;margin-top:11px"><button class="btn sm mono dark" data-save="'+r.id+'">Close v'+av.v+' · open v'+(av.v+1)+'</button>'+
        '<button class="btn sm mono" data-cancel="'+r.id+'">Cancel</button></div></div>';
    }

    return '<div class="rule" data-r="'+r.id+'">'+
      '<div class="rule-hd">'+
        '<span class="rc">'+r.id+'</span>'+
        '<span class="badge '+(r.side==='Front-end'?'b-info':'b-accent')+'">'+r.side+'</span>'+
        '<div style="flex:1;min-width:180px"><div class="rn">'+esc(r.name)+'</div>'+
        '<div class="rs">'+esc(r.scope)+' · '+esc(r.who)+'</div>'+
        '<div class="rimpact">'+impactStr(r)+'</div></div>'+
        '<span class="badge b-gray">'+r.kind+'</span>'+
        '<span class="rate">'+rateStr(r,av)+'</span>'+
        '<span class="badge b-ok">v'+av.v+' open</span>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="rule-bd">'+
        tiers+
        /* history is a record, not something you edit — collapsed per rule */
        '<details class="vhist"><summary>Rate history — '+r.versions.length+
          ' version'+(r.versions.length===1?'':'s')+', v'+av.v+' open since '+av.from+'</summary>'+
        '<table class="vtable"><thead><tr><th>Version</th><th>Rate</th><th>Effective from</th><th>Effective to</th><th>State</th><th>Reason</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+vrows+'</tbody></table>'+
        '</details>'+
        actions+
      '</div></div>';
  }).join('')||(RULES_ERROR
    ? '<div class="empty" role="alert">Commission rules could not be loaded. Try again.</div>'
    : '<div class="empty">No commission rules are on file yet. Payouts already earned are on the payout ledger — use "View payout ledger" at the top of the page.</div>');

  document.querySelectorAll('.rule-hd').forEach(function(h){
    h.addEventListener('click',function(){h.parentElement.classList.toggle('open')});
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-chg]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();document.getElementById('el-'+b.dataset.chg).classList.add('on')});
  });
  /* a rule's payouts open the ledger already narrowed to the people it pays */
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-led]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      var im=impactOf(RULES.filter(function(x){return x.id===b.dataset.led})[0]);
      var pf=document.getElementById('perFilter');
      pf.value = im.people.length===1 && [].some.call(pf.options,function(o){return o.value===im.people[0];})
        ? im.people[0] : '';
      document.getElementById('statFilter').value='';
      renderLedger(); showLedger(true);
    });
  });
  /* a details element inside a clickable rule header must not toggle the rule */
  document.querySelectorAll('.vhist summary').forEach(function(s){
    s.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation()});
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-cancel]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();document.getElementById('el-'+b.dataset.cancel).classList.remove('on')});
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-save]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      var id=b.dataset.save;
      var r=RULES.filter(function(x){return x.id===id})[0];
      var av=activeV(r);
      var nr=parseFloat(document.getElementById('nr-'+id).value);
      var nd=document.getElementById('nd-'+id).value||TODAY;
      var nw=document.getElementById('nw-'+id).value.trim()||'Rate change';
      if(r.kind!=='tiered'&&(isNaN(nr)||nr<0)){alert('Enter a valid rate.');return}
      if(nd<=av.from){alert('The new version must start after the current version began ('+av.from+').');return}
      b.disabled=true;
      FHData.write('/api/commission-rules',{
        rule_id:av.rowId,effective_from:nd,rate:nr,reason:nw
      }).then(function(res){
        b.disabled=false;
        if(!res||!res.ok){alert('Could not change the rate: '+((res&&res.error)||'request failed'));return}
        loadCommissionRules(id);
      });
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('kRules').textContent=RULES_ERROR?'—':RULES.length;
}

function loadCommissionRules(reopenId){
  if(typeof FHData==='undefined'||typeof FHData.commissionRules!=='function') return Promise.resolve();
  return FHData.commissionRules().then(function(res){
    if(!res||!res.ok){
      RULES_ERROR=(res&&res.error)||'read_failed';
      RULES.length=0;
      renderRules();
      return;
    }
    RULES_ERROR='';
    var mapped=ruleGroups((res.data&&res.data.rules)||[]);
    RULES.length=0;
    Array.prototype.push.apply(RULES,mapped);
    renderRules();
    if(reopenId){
      var el=document.querySelector('.rule[data-r="'+reopenId+'"]');
      if(el) el.classList.add('open');
    }
  });
}

function renderLedger(){
  var pf=document.getElementById('perFilter').value, sf=document.getElementById('statFilter').value;
  var rows=LEDGER.filter(function(l){return (!pf||l.who===pf)&&(!sf||l.st===sf)});
  document.getElementById('ledgerBody').innerHTML=rows.map(function(l){
    var ruleCell=(l.rule&&l.rule!=='—')?'<span class="badge b-gray">'+esc(l.rule)+(l.ver?(' v'+l.ver):'')+'</span>':'—';
    var canPick=l.st==='Accrued'||l.st==='Approved';
    var check=canPick
      ?'<input type="checkbox" class="ledger-pick" data-id="'+esc(l.id)+'" data-st="'+esc(l.st)+'">'
      :'';
    return '<tr data-id="'+esc(l.id||'')+'"><td>'+check+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+l.d+'</td>'+
      '<td style="font-weight:500">'+esc(l.who)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(l.client)+'</td>'+
      '<td style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+esc(l.prod)+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+ruleCell+'</td>'+
      '<td class="money">'+money(l.basis)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+esc(l.rate)+'</td>'+
      '<td class="money" style="text-align:right">'+money(l.amt)+'</td>'+
      '<td><span class="badge '+(ST_CLS[l.st]||'b-gray')+'">'+esc(l.st)+'</span></td></tr>';
  }).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="10" class="empty">'+(LEDGER.length?'Nothing matches that filter.':'No payouts on file.')+'</td></tr>';
  var tot=rows.reduce(function(a,l){return a+l.amt},0);
  document.getElementById('ledgerTotal').textContent=money(tot);
  var all=document.getElementById('ledgerCheckAll');
  if(all) all.checked=false;
}

function selectedLedgerIds(wantStatus){
  var ids=[];
  document.querySelectorAll('#ledgerBody .ledger-pick:checked').forEach(function(el){
    if(wantStatus && el.getAttribute('data-st')!==wantStatus) return;
    var id=el.getAttribute('data-id');
    if(id) ids.push(id);
  });
  return ids;
}

function reloadCommissionLedger(){
  if(typeof FHData==='undefined'||!FHData.commissions) return Promise.resolve();
  return FHData.wire(FHData.commissions({ limit: 200 }), "commission ledger", function (data) {
    var rows = data.items || [];
    if (typeof LEDGER !== "undefined") {
      LEDGER.length = 0;
      Array.prototype.push.apply(LEDGER, rows.map(ledgerFromApiLive));
    }
    if (typeof fillPersonFilter === "function") fillPersonFilter();
    if (typeof renderLedger === "function") try { renderLedger(); } catch (e) {}
    if (typeof renderStats === "function") try { renderStats(); } catch (e) {}
    if (typeof renderRules === "function") try { renderRules(); } catch (e) {}
    if (!rows.length) return "no commission rows yet";
    var accrued = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.status !== "paid" && r.status !== "void"; })
                      .reduce(function (a, r) { return a + Number(r.amount || 0); }, 0);
    var paid = rows.filter(function (r) {
                     var when = String(r.paid_at || r.earned_at || r.created_at || "").slice(0, 10);
                     return r.status === "paid" && when >= MONTH_START;
                   })
                   .reduce(function (a, r) { return a + Number(r.amount || 0); }, 0);
    var kA=document.getElementById("kAccrued"); if(kA) kA.textContent=money(accrued);
    var kP=document.getElementById("kPaid"); if(kP) kP.textContent=money(paid);
    return "live ledger · " + rows.length + " entries · " + money(accrued) + " accrued";
  });
}

function ledgerFromApiLive(r) {
  var st = String(r.status || "").toLowerCase();
  var stLabel = st === "paid" ? "Paid"
    : st === "approved" ? "Approved"
    : (st === "earned" || st === "accrued") ? "Accrued"
    : (r.status || "Accrued");
  var when = r.earned_at || r.created_at || "";
  var rate = r.split_percent != null && r.split_percent !== "" ? (Number(r.split_percent) + "%") : "—";
  return {
    id: r.id || "",
    d: when ? String(when).slice(0, 10) : "—",
    who: r.staff_name || r.employee_code || "—",
    client: "—",
    prod: r.product_name_at_earning || "—",
    rule: "—",
    ver: "",
    basis: Number(r.basis) || 0,
    rate: rate,
    amt: Number(r.amount) || 0,
    st: stLabel,
    paid_at: r.paid_at || null
  };
}

document.getElementById('ledgerCheckAll').addEventListener('change',function(){
  var on=this.checked;
  document.querySelectorAll('#ledgerBody .ledger-pick').forEach(function(el){ el.checked=on; });
});

document.getElementById('ledgerApprove').addEventListener('click',function(){
  var ids=selectedLedgerIds('Accrued');
  var hint=document.getElementById('ledgerActionHint');
  if(!ids.length){
    if(hint) hint.textContent='Select one or more Accrued rows first.';
    return;
  }
  if(typeof FHData==='undefined'||!FHData.write){
    alert('Not available — the data layer has not loaded.');
    return;
  }
  if(hint) hint.textContent='Approving…';
  FHData.write('/api/commissions',{ action:'approve', ledger_ids:ids }).then(function(res){
    if(!res||!res.ok){
      if(hint) hint.textContent=(res&&res.error)||'Approve failed.';
      return;
    }
    if(hint) hint.textContent='Approved '+(res.data&&res.data.updated!=null?res.data.updated:ids.length)+' row(s).';
    reloadCommissionLedger();
  });
});

document.getElementById('ledgerMarkPaid').addEventListener('click',function(){
  var ids=selectedLedgerIds('Approved');
  var hint=document.getElementById('ledgerActionHint');
  if(!ids.length){
    if(hint) hint.textContent='Select one or more Approved rows first.';
    return;
  }
  var ref=window.prompt('Paste the payout id (ACH / check / payroll batch). This does not send money — it only records that you paid.');
  if(ref==null) return;
  ref=String(ref).trim();
  if(!ref){
    if(hint) hint.textContent='Payout id is required to mark paid.';
    return;
  }
  if(typeof FHData==='undefined'||!FHData.write){
    alert('Not available — the data layer has not loaded.');
    return;
  }
  if(hint) hint.textContent='Marking paid…';
  FHData.write('/api/commissions',{ action:'mark_paid', ledger_ids:ids, payout_ref:ref }).then(function(res){
    if(!res||!res.ok){
      if(hint) hint.textContent=(res&&res.error)||'Mark paid failed.';
      return;
    }
    if(hint) hint.textContent='Marked paid '+(res.data&&res.data.updated!=null?res.data.updated:ids.length)+' · ref '+ref;
    reloadCommissionLedger();
  });
});

function renderStats(){
  document.getElementById('kAccrued').textContent=money(LEDGER.filter(function(l){return l.st!=='Paid'}).reduce(function(a,l){return a+l.amt},0));
  document.getElementById('kPaid').textContent=money(LEDGER.filter(function(l){
    var when=l.paid_at?String(l.paid_at).slice(0,10):l.d;
    return l.st==='Paid'&&when>=MONTH_START;
  }).reduce(function(a,l){return a+l.amt},0));
}

function openProduct(id){
  var p=PRODUCTS.filter(function(x){return x.id===id})[0]; edProd=id;
  document.getElementById('edMode').textContent='EDIT PRODUCT';
  document.getElementById('edTitle').textContent=p.name;

  document.getElementById('p_price').value=p.price;
  document.getElementById('p_min').value=p.min;
  document.getElementById('p_max').value=p.max;
  document.getElementById('p_var').classList.toggle('on',p.variable);
  syncVar();
  var refs=RULES.filter(function(r){return r.scope.indexOf(p.name)>=0||r.scope==='All products'});
  document.getElementById('p_rules').innerHTML=refs.length
    ? refs.map(function(r){return '<div style="padding:4px 0"><span class="badge b-gray">'+r.id+'</span> '+esc(r.name)+' — <span class="mono">'+rateStr(r,activeV(r))+'</span></div>'}).join('')
    : 'No commission rule targets this product directly.';
  document.getElementById('editor').classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('scrim').classList.add('on');
}

  document.getElementById('editor').classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('scrim').classList.add('on');
}

document.getElementById('edSave').addEventListener('click',function(){
  var name=document.getElementById('p_name').value.trim();
  if(!name){alert('Product name is required.');return}
  var variable=document.getElementById('p_var').classList.contains('on');
  var price=parseFloat(document.getElementById('p_price').value)||0;
  var mn=variable?(parseFloat(document.getElementById('p_min').value)||0):price;
  var mx=variable?(parseFloat(document.getElementById('p_max').value)||0):price;
  if(variable&&mn>mx){alert('Minimum cannot exceed maximum.');return}
  if(variable&&(price<mn||price>mx)){alert('Default price must sit inside the min/max band.');return}
  if(typeof FHData === 'undefined' || !FHData.write){
    alert('Not available — the data layer has not loaded.');
    return;
  }
  var payload={
    name:name,
    category:document.getElementById('p_cat').value,
    default_price:price,
    min_price:mn,
    max_price:mx,
    price_is_variable:variable
  };
  if(edProd){
    payload.action='save';
    payload.code=edProd;
  }else{
    payload.action='create';
  }
  var btn=document.getElementById('edSave');
  btn.disabled=true;
  FHData.write('/api/products', payload).then(function(res){
    btn.disabled=false;
    if(!res || !res.ok){
      alert('Could not save product: ' + ((res && res.error) || 'request failed'));
      return;
    }
    var p=res.data && res.data.product;
    var rec={
      id:(p && p.code) || edProd || name,
      name:name,
      cat:document.getElementById('p_cat').value,
      price:price,
      variable:variable,
      min:mn,
      max:mx,
      rails:[]
    };
    if(edProd){
      var existing=PRODUCTS.filter(function(x){return x.id===edProd})[0];
      if(existing) Object.keys(rec).forEach(function(k){existing[k]=rec[k]});
      else PRODUCTS.push(rec);
    }else{
      PRODUCTS.push(rec);
    }
    closeEd(); renderProducts();
  });
});

function fillPersonFilter(){
  var sel=document.getElementById('perFilter'); if(!sel) return;
  var cur=sel.value;
  var names=[]; LEDGER.forEach(function(l){if(l.who&&l.who!=='—'&&names.indexOf(l.who)<0)names.push(l.who)});
  sel.innerHTML='<option value="">Everyone</option>';
  names.sort().forEach(function(n){var o=document.createElement('option');o.textContent=n;sel.appendChild(o)});
  if(cur) sel.value=cur;
}

<script defer src="data.js"></script>
<script>

/* Products & Commissions — the product ladder from /api/read/products and the
   earnings ledger from /api/read/commissions.

   NOTE: no commission PERCENTAGE is rendered from a constant. Rates live in
   commission_rules rows; the tiles show the count of active rules and the
   amounts actually accrued, never an invented rate. */

// data.js carries `defer` (see its tag above), so FHData does not exist yet
// while this script is being parsed — the two FHData.wire calls below ran at
// parse time and threw, and the throw killed the rest of this block before the
// product ladder or the commission ledger was ever requested, which is why the
// tiles sat on "loading…" and both tables stayed empty. Every deferred script
// runs before DOMContentLoaded, so the first read waits for that event.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  "use strict";
  var esc = function (v) {
    return String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;" }[c]; });
  };
  var set = function (id, v) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = v; };
  var usd = function (n) {
    return "$" + Number(n || 0).toLocaleString("en-US",
      { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  };
  var money = function (n) {
    return n == null || n === "" ? "—" : "$" + Number(n).toLocaleString("en-US");
  };

  FHData.wire(FHData.read("products", { limit: 200 }), "product ladder", function (data) {
    var rows = data.items || [];
    if (!rows.length) {
      if (typeof PRODUCTS !== "undefined") {
        PRODUCTS.length = 0;
        if (typeof renderProducts === "function") try { renderProducts(); } catch (e) {}
      }
      return "no products on file yet";
    }
    set("kProd", rows.length);
    try { paintVariableCaption(); } catch (e) {}
    set("kRules", rows.reduce(function (a, p) { return a + (p.active_rules || 0); }, 0));

    /* Feed the screen's OWN model and renderer.

       This wrote five <td>s into a SEVEN-column table
       (Product | Category | Default price | Variable | Min | Max | Rails), so
       the success-fee percent landed under "Variable", the rule count under
       "Min", and "Max"/"Rails" were empty. It also dropped the data-p attribute
       the row-click handler keys on, so "CLICK A ROW TO EDIT" silently stopped
       working on every real row. */
    if (typeof PRODUCTS === "undefined" || typeof renderProducts !== "function") return null;

    var noRails = 0;
    var mapped = rows.map(function (p) {
      // `rails` describes which funnels a product sits on. Nothing in the
      // products table records that, so it stays empty rather than invented.
      noRails++;
      return {
        id: p.code || p.id,
        name: p.name,
        cat: p.category || "—",
        price: Number(p.default_price) || 0,
        variable: !!p.price_is_variable,
        min: Number(p.min_price != null ? p.min_price : p.default_price) || 0,
        max: Number(p.max_price != null ? p.max_price : p.default_price) || 0,
        rails: []
      };
    });
    PRODUCTS.length = 0;
    Array.prototype.push.apply(PRODUCTS, mapped);
    try { renderProducts(); } catch (e) { return null; }

    return "live product ladder · rails have no source";
  });

  loadCommissionRules();

  function ledgerFromApi(r) {
    var st = String(r.status || "").toLowerCase();
    var stLabel = st === "paid" ? "Paid"
      : st === "approved" ? "Approved"
      : (st === "earned" || st === "accrued") ? "Accrued"
      : (r.status || "Accrued");
    var when = r.earned_at || r.created_at || "";
    var rate = r.split_percent != null && r.split_percent !== "" ? (Number(r.split_percent) + "%") : "—";
    return {
      id: r.id || "",
      d: when ? String(when).slice(0, 10) : "—",
      who: r.staff_name || r.employee_code || "—",
      client: "—",
      prod: r.product_name_at_earning || "—",
      rule: "—",
      ver: "",
      basis: Number(r.basis) || 0,
      rate: rate,
      amt: Number(r.amount) || 0,
      st: stLabel,
      paid_at: r.paid_at || null
    };
  }

  FHData.wire(FHData.commissions({ limit: 200 }), "commission ledger", function (data) {
    var rows = data.items || [];
    if (typeof LEDGER !== "undefined") {
      LEDGER.length = 0;
      Array.prototype.push.apply(LEDGER, rows.map(ledgerFromApi));
    }
    if (typeof fillPersonFilter === "function") fillPersonFilter();
    if (typeof renderLedger === "function") try { renderLedger(); } catch (e) {}
    if (typeof renderStats === "function") try { renderStats(); } catch (e) {}
    if (typeof renderRules === "function") try { renderRules(); } catch (e) {}
    if (!rows.length) return "no commission rows yet";
    var accrued = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.status !== "paid" && r.status !== "void"; })
                      .reduce(function (a, r) { return a + Number(r.amount || 0); }, 0);
    /* The tile is labelled PAID MTD, so it counts this month only. Prefer paid_at. */
    var paid = rows.filter(function (r) {
                     var when = String(r.paid_at || r.earned_at || r.created_at || "").slice(0, 10);
                     return r.status === "paid" && when >= MONTH_START;
                   })
                   .reduce(function (a, r) { return a + Number(r.amount || 0); }, 0);
    set("kAccrued", usd(accrued));
    set("kPaid", usd(paid));
    return "live ledger · " + rows.length + " entries · " + usd(accrued) + " accrued";
  });

  function token() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; }
  }
  function showSloForm(row) {
    var form = document.getElementById("sloForm");
    if (!form) return;
    document.getElementById("slo_id").value = row && row.id ? row.id : "";
    document.getElementById("slo_name").value = row && row.name ? row.name : "";
    document.getElementById("slo_funnel").value = row && row.cf_funnel_id ? row.cf_funnel_id : "";
    document.getElementById("slo_cfprod").value = row && row.cf_product_id ? row.cf_product_id : "";
    var sel = document.getElementById("slo_product");
    var want = row && (row.product_code || row.product_id) ? String(row.product_code || row.product_id) : "";
    if (sel && want) sel.value = want;
    var sw = document.getElementById("slo_active");
    if (sw) {
      if (!row || row.active !== false) sw.classList.add("on");
      else sw.classList.remove("on");
    }
    form.hidden = false;
  }
  function hideSloForm() {
    var form = document.getElementById("sloForm");
    if (form) form.hidden = true;
  }
  function fillSloProducts() {
    var sel = document.getElementById("slo_product");
    if (!sel) return;
    var rows = (typeof PRODUCTS !== "undefined" ? PRODUCTS : []).slice();
    sel.innerHTML = "<option value=\"\">Pick a Fundhub product</option>";
    rows.forEach(function (p) {
      var o = document.createElement("option");
      o.value = p.id;
      o.textContent = p.name + (p.id ? " (· " + p.id + ")" : "");
      sel.appendChild(o);
    });
  }
  function renderSlo(rows, errText) {
    var body = document.getElementById("sloBody");
    var load = document.getElementById("sloLoad");
    var err = document.getElementById("sloErr");
    if (load) load.hidden = true;
    if (err) {
      if (errText) { err.hidden = false; err.textContent = errText; }
      else { err.hidden = true; err.textContent = ""; }
    }
    var live = (rows || []).filter(function (r) { return r.active !== false; }).length;
    set("sloLiveCount", String(live));
    set("sloLiveHint", live === 1
      ? "1 map is on. A signed paid webhook writes that Fundhub product."
      : live + " maps are on. A signed paid webhook writes the mapped Fundhub product.");
    if (!body) return;
    if (errText) {
      body.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }
    if (!rows || !rows.length) {
      body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">No SLO connections yet. Add one to map a ClickFunnels product to a Fundhub product.</td></tr>';
      return;
    }
    body.innerHTML = rows.map(function (r) {
      return '<tr class="clik" data-slo="' + esc(r.id) + '">' +
        "<td><div style=\"font-weight:600\">" + esc(r.name) + "</div></td>" +
        '<td class="mono">' + esc(r.cf_funnel_id) + "</td>" +
        '<td class="mono">' + esc(r.cf_product_id) + "</td>" +
        "<td>" + esc(r.product_name || r.product_code || "—") + "</td>" +
        "<td>" + (r.active !== false ? '<span class="badge b-ok">On</span>' : '<span class="badge b-gray">Off</span>') + "</td></tr>";
    }).join("");
    body.querySelectorAll("tr[data-slo]").forEach(function (tr) {
      tr.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var row = rows.filter(function (x) { return x.id === tr.dataset.slo; })[0];
        fillSloProducts();
        showSloForm(row);
      });
    });
  }
  function loadSlo() {
    var load = document.getElementById("sloLoad");
    if (load) load.hidden = false;
    if (!window.FHData || typeof FHData.read !== "function") {
      renderSlo([], "SLO connections could not be loaded. Try again.");
      return;
    }
    FHData.read("slo-connections", { limit: 200 }).then(function (res) {
      if (!res || !res.ok) {
        var msg = (res && res.error) || "SLO connections could not be loaded. Try again.";
        if (res && res.source === "unauthorized") {
          msg = "SLO connections are for the owner.";
        }
        renderSlo([], msg);
        return;
      }
      renderSlo((res.data && res.data.items) || [], null);
    });
  }
  fetch("/api/auth/session", {
    headers: { accept: "application/json", authorization: "Bearer " + token() }
  }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (sess) {
    var role = String(sess && sess.staff && sess.staff.role || "").toLowerCase();
    if (role !== "owner" && role !== "admin") return;
    var tab = document.getElementById("sloTab");
    if (tab) tab.hidden = false;
    loadSlo();
  }).catch(function () {});

  var addSlo = document.getElementById("addSloBtn");
  if (addSlo) addSlo.addEventListener("click", function () {
    fillSloProducts();
    showSloForm(null);
  });
  var sloCancel = document.getElementById("sloCancel");
  if (sloCancel) sloCancel.addEventListener("click", hideSloForm);
  var sloSw = document.getElementById("slo_active");
  if (sloSw) sloSw.addEventListener("click", function () { this.classList.toggle("on"); });
  var sloSave = document.getElementById("sloSave");
  if (sloSave) sloSave.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (!window.FHData || typeof FHData.write !== "function") {
      alert("Not available — the data layer has not loaded.");
      return;
    }
    var name = document.getElementById("slo_name").value.trim();
    var funnel = document.getElementById("slo_funnel").value.trim();
    var cfprod = document.getElementById("slo_cfprod").value.trim();
    var productCode = document.getElementById("slo_product").value.trim();
    if (!name) { alert("This connection needs a name."); return; }
    if (!funnel) { alert("Paste the ClickFunnels funnel ID."); return; }
    if (!cfprod) { alert("Paste the ClickFunnels product ID."); return; }
    if (!productCode) { alert("Pick a Fundhub product."); return; }
    sloSave.disabled = true;
    var payload = {
      name: name,
      cf_funnel_id: funnel,
      cf_product_id: cfprod,
      product_code: productCode,
      active: document.getElementById("slo_active").classList.contains("on")
    };
    var id = document.getElementById("slo_id").value.trim();
    if (id) payload.id = id;
    FHData.write("/api/slo-connections", payload).then(function (res) {
      sloSave.disabled = false;
      if (!res || !res.ok) {
        alert("Could not save connection: " + ((res && res.error) || "request failed"));
        return;
      }
      hideSloForm();
      loadSlo();
    });
  });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

/* ══ HELPERS ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var MONTHS=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
function pad(n){return (n<10?'0':'')+n;}
function fmt(iso){
  if(!iso) return '—';
  var d=new Date(iso);
  return MONTHS[d.getUTCMonth()]+' '+pad(d.getUTCDate())+' '+pad(d.getUTCHours())+':'+pad(d.getUTCMinutes())+'Z';
}
function fmtLong(iso){
  if(!iso) return 'null';
  var d=new Date(iso);
  return MONTHS[d.getUTCMonth()]+' '+pad(d.getUTCDate())+', '+d.getUTCFullYear()+' '+
         pad(d.getUTCHours())+':'+pad(d.getUTCMinutes())+':'+pad(d.getUTCSeconds())+' UTC';
}
function rel(iso){
  if(!iso) return '';
  var ms=new Date(iso)-NOW, a=Math.abs(ms), m=Math.round(a/60000);
  var s = m<60 ? m+'m' : (m<1440 ? Math.round(m/60)+'h' : Math.round(m/1440)+'d');
  return ms<0 ? s+' ago' : 'in '+s;
}

   defect 12). Peach is "in progress, behind". */

/* ══ the account's next posting time ═════════════════════════════════════
   The same walk the server does, including the fact that it works in UTC and
   never reads the time zone saved on the account. */
function nextBestTime(channel, from){
  from = from || NOW;
  var times = channel && channel.best_times;
  if(!times || typeof times !== 'object' || !Object.keys(times).length) return null;
  var DAYS=['sun','mon','tue','wed','thu','fri','sat'];
  for(var offset=0; offset<8; offset++){
    var d=new Date(from.getTime()+offset*864e5);
    var slots=times[DAYS[d.getUTCDay()]];
    if(!Array.isArray(slots) || !slots.length) continue;
    var sorted=slots.slice().sort();
    for(var i=0;i<sorted.length;i++){
      var parts=String(sorted[i]).split(':');
      var h=Number(parts[0]), m=Number(parts[1]);
      if(!isFinite(h)) continue;
      var when=new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(),d.getUTCMonth(),d.getUTCDate(),h,m||0));
      if(when>from) return when.toISOString();
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/* ══ the copy check preview ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   A PREVIEW ONLY. The answer that counts is worked out on the server when the
   post is saved; this exists so the writer does not send words it can already
   tell will be refused. It uses the same rules, the same scoping and the same
   approval gates. It never assumes a disclosure has been attached. */
var _rx={};
function toRegex(p){ if(!_rx[p]) _rx[p]=new RegExp(p,'i'); return _rx[p]; }
function appliesTo(scope, value){
  var list = scope || [];
  if(!list.length) return true;
  return value !== null && list.indexOf(value) !== -1;
}
function previewScreen(caption, offerType, approveBeforeLaunch){
  if(OFFER_TYPES.indexOf(offerType) === -1){
    return {state:'blocked', reasons:[{code:'missing-topic', rule_set:'required', severity:'block',
      message:'Choose what this post is about first. It has to be funding, credit cards or credit repair.'}]};
  }
  var reasons=[], hay=String(caption||''), platform=null, hasDisclosureAsset=false;
  RULES.forEach(function(rule){
    if(!appliesTo(rule.offer_types, offerType)) return;
    if(!appliesTo(rule.platforms, platform)) return;
    if(rule.match_type === 'required'){
      var inText = toRegex(rule.pattern).test(hay);
      if(!inText && !hasDisclosureAsset) reasons.push(fromRule(rule));
      return;
    }
    /* mirrors the server verbatim. Unreachable here — the check above already
       returned, because these are ordinary posts, not paid adverts. */
    if(rule.rule_key === 'tiktok-credit-repair-prohibited') return;
    var matched = rule.match_type === 'phrase'
      ? hay.toLowerCase().indexOf(String(rule.pattern).toLowerCase()) !== -1
      : toRegex(rule.pattern).test(hay);
    if(matched) reasons.push(fromRule(rule));
  });
  var hard = reasons.filter(function(x){ return x.severity !== 'warn'; });
  if(hard.length) return {state:'blocked', reasons:reasons};
  if(offerType === 'credit_repair'){
    return {state:'needs_approval', reasons:reasons.concat([{
      code:'human_approval_required_credit_repair', rule_set:'approval',
      message:'Credit-repair creative always requires human approval before launch. This gate cannot be turned off.'}])};
  }
  if(approveBeforeLaunch){
    return {state:'needs_approval', reasons:reasons.concat([{
      code:'human-approval-required', rule_set:'approval',
      message:'This partner is set so a person must approve posts before they go out.'}])};
  }
  return {state:'passed', reasons:reasons};
}
function fromRule(rule){
  return {code:rule.rule_key, rule_set:rule.rule_set, message:rule.message,
          citation:rule.citation, severity:rule.severity};
}

/* ══ SCOPE ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var P = 0;                                   /* index into PARTNERS */
var pane = 'queued';
var fltChannel = '', fltOffer = '';
var derivKey = 'channels';

function partner(){ return PARTNERS[P] || null; }
function hasPartner(){ return !!partner(); }
/* §6 empty state. Names what would be here and why nothing is, instead of
   painting a tile, a row or a count for a partner nobody has chosen. */
function noPartner(what){
  return '<div class="empty">'+what+' will show here once a partner is chosen.<br>'+
    'No partner is chosen, so nothing is loaded and nothing is sent.</div>';
}
/* Who is looking at this screen. A partner never sees the connect buttons — the
   block at the bottom of this file replaces them with a sentence — so the empty
   state must not send a partner to look for a button that is not there. */
function viewerRole(){
  try { return String(localStorage.getItem('fh_role') || '').trim().toLowerCase(); }
  catch(e){ return ''; }
}
function viewerCanConnect(){ return viewerRole() !== 'partner'; }
/* Who may approve a held post. Owner or admin only, and an unknown role is not
   admitted — the same idiom brand-studio.html uses for its own owner-only
   button. This only decides whether the button is drawn; api/social/posts.mjs
   refuses anybody else whether or not the button was there. */
function viewerCanApprove(){ var r = viewerRole(); return r === 'owner' || r === 'admin'; }
function channels(){ return SOCIAL_CHANNELS.filter(function(c){ return c.partner === P; }); }
function chById(id){ return SOCIAL_CHANNELS.filter(function(c){ return c.id === id; })[0] || null; }
function assets(){ return ASSETS.filter(function(a){ return a.partner === P; }); }
function posts(){ return POSTS; }
function byStatus(s){ return posts().filter(function(p){ return p.status === s; }); }
/* Posts that have not gone anywhere yet, and so belong in the waiting list.
   'awaiting_approval' IS ONE OF THEM. The copy check can stop a post and hold it
   (see db/migrations/240 and 243), and this list once kept only 'queued' and
   'draft' while the other tabs read 'blocked', 'failed' and 'posted' — so a held
   post appeared on no tab at all. The partner could not see that it existed, let
   alone that it had stopped. What it is doing is said per row by queueState().

   'scheduled' IS ALSO ONE OF THEM, and was not before. A post that has been
   handed to a social account with a send time sits in 'scheduled', which no tab
   on this screen read — so it vanished from the screen the moment it was lined
   up. Approving a held post moves it there, so without this an approval would
   look like the post had been deleted. */
function readyPosts(){
  return posts().filter(function(p){
    return p.status === 'queued' || p.status === 'draft' ||
           p.status === 'scheduled' || p.status === 'awaiting_approval';
  });
}
function postById(id){ return POSTS.filter(function(p){ return p.id === id; })[0] || null; }

/* ══ THE TWO WRITES THAT NEED NO CONNECTED ACCOUNT ═══════════════════════
   POST /api/social/posts is the only write on this screen that works with zero
   social accounts, and nothing on the page called it — the endpoint was routed,
   handled a partner, and was dead code from the browser's side.

   With no channel_id it sets the post to waiting and saves the send time.
   With action:'discard' it throws the post away. Neither one touches Facebook,
   Instagram or LinkedIn, which is what lets a partner with no connected account
   do the three things the white-label journey promises: write a post into the
   queue, set a time, or throw one away.

   /api/social/schedule is still the right call when an account IS picked — it
   is the only path that makes a real social_posts row — so the composer keeps
   using it for that case.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function postWrite(body){
  var t = '';
  try { t = localStorage.getItem('fh_token') || ''; } catch (e) { t = ''; }
  return fetch('/api/social/posts', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: Object.assign(
      { accept: 'application/json', 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      (t && t !== 'demo') ? { authorization: 'Bearer ' + t } : {}),
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
    .catch(function () { return { ok: false, error: 'offline' }; });
}
/* ══ WHAT A REFUSAL SAYS TO A PERSON ═════════════════════════════════════
   CLAUDE.md §10 — nobody reading this screen is technical. When the server
   refuses, it answers with a short internal word: "not_found", "suite_off",
   "unauthorized". Those words mean nothing to a partner and must never reach
   the screen. This turns each one into one plain sentence, and anything it does
   not recognise into a sentence that says what happened without naming anything
   internal. The server's own `message` is deliberately not used: some of them
   are written for a developer, not for a person.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function plainWrite(res){
  switch (String((res && res.error) || '')) {
    case 'offline':
      return 'The screen could not reach the server, so nothing was changed. Check the connection and try again.';
    case 'not_found':
      return 'That post is not in the list any more. Reload the page to see what is there now.';
    case 'suite_off':
      return 'This part of the system is switched off for this partner. Only the owner can turn it on.';
    case 'partner_id_required':
      return 'The screen does not know which partner this is for. Pick a partner at the top and try again.';
    case 'id_required':
      return 'The screen lost track of which post this was. Reload the page and try again.';
    case 'channel_id_required':
      return 'A post can only be sent on a connected account, and no account was picked.';
    case 'unauthorized':
      return 'You are signed out. Sign in again and try once more.';
    case 'forbidden':
      return 'Your account is not allowed to change this partner\'s posts.';
    case 'auth_unavailable':
      return 'The system could not check who you are just now. Try again in a moment.';
    case 'caption_required':
      return 'Write the post first. Nothing was saved.';
    case 'partner_not_found':
      return 'That partner is not in the system, so nothing was changed. Pick a different partner.';
    case 'staff_only_for_all':
      return 'Only a member of staff can do that for every partner at once. Pick one partner first.';
    case 'token_cap':
      return 'The writing allowance for this month is used up, so nothing new was written.';
    case 'no_model':
      return 'The writer is not switched on, so nothing was written.';
    case 'method_not_allowed':
      return 'The screen asked for something this part of the system does not do.';
    default:
      return 'The server would not do it, and nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.';
  }
}
function qActMsg(text){
  var el = document.getElementById('qActMsg');
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = text || '';
  el.hidden = !text;
}
/* The time boxes on this screen are UTC — every time it prints is UTC, and the
   column header says so. A datetime-local box has no zone of its own, so the
   value is read back as UTC. Reading it as the browser's local time would save
   a different moment than the one shown in the box. */
function utcFromBox(v){
  if (!v) return null;
  var d = new Date(v.length === 16 ? v + ':00Z' : v + 'Z');
  return isFinite(d.getTime()) ? d.toISOString() : null;
}
function queueOne(id){
  var post = postById(id); if (!post) return;
  var p = partner();
  if (!p) { qActMsg('No partner is chosen — nothing was saved.'); return; }
  var box = document.querySelector('[data-qwhen="' + id + '"]');
  var when = utcFromBox(box ? box.value : '');
  qActMsg('Saving…');
  postWrite({ partner_id: p.id, id: id, scheduled_for: when }).then(function (res) {
    if (!res.ok) {
      qActMsg('Not saved. ' + plainWrite(res));
      return;
    }
    /* ══ THE SENTENCE IS BUILT FROM THE SERVER'S ANSWER, NOT FROM THE BOX ══
       api/social/posts.mjs, the branch that runs when no account is picked,
       saves the time as
           scheduled_for = COALESCE($2::timestamptz, scheduled_for)
       with $2 = body.scheduled_for || row.scheduled_for.

       Read that twice: an EMPTY time box does not clear a time that is already
       saved. The old time is kept and the post still goes out. Building this
       sentence from the box would have told the partner the exact opposite of
       what happened. So it is built from the row the server sends back, which
       is what is really stored. */
    var item = res.item;
    if (!item || !('scheduled_for' in item)) {
      qActMsg('Saved. The screen could not read the send time back, so check the "Send at" column below.');
      loadQueue();
      return;
    }
    var saved = item.scheduled_for;
    if (!saved) {
      qActMsg('Saved. That post is waiting, and it has no send time, so it will not go out on its own.');
    } else if (!when) {
      qActMsg('Saved. That post is waiting and is still set for ' + fmt(saved) + '. ' +
        'Emptying the time box does not take away a time that was already saved. ' +
        'To stop a post going out, throw it away.');
    } else {
      qActMsg('Saved. That post is waiting and set for ' + fmt(saved) + '.');
    }
    loadQueue();
  });
}
function settings(){ var p = partner(); return (p && p.settings) || null; }
function approveBeforeLaunch(){
  var s = settings();
  /* unknown means the safe answer, and so does a saved `false` we could not read */
  return (s && typeof s.approve_before_launch === 'boolean') ? s.approve_before_launch : true;
}
function logs(){ return ACTION_LOG.filter(function(l){ return l.partner === P; }); }
function tasks(){ return TASKS.filter(function(t){ return t.partner === P; }); }

/* what happens next to one post, worked out from what the post really carries */
function queueState(p){
  if (p.status === 'draft') return {k:'draft', short:'Draft', label:'Written, not lined up yet', cls:'b-gray'};
  /* Stopped by the copy check and waiting for a person. Both halves still have
     to be said: it does not go out, AND who can release it. This line used to
     say nothing in the system could approve one — true when it was written, and
     false now that the buttons below exist, which is the reassuring direction to
     be wrong in. A reader who cannot approve it is told so plainly rather than
     shown a button that would refuse them. */
  if (p.status === 'awaiting_approval')
    return {k:'held_for_person', short:'Held for a person',
            label: viewerCanApprove()
              ? 'A person has to approve it before it goes out. You can approve or refuse it here'
              : 'A person has to approve it, so it will not go out. Only the owner or an admin at Fundhub can approve it',
            cls:'b-accent'};
  var c = chById(p.channel_id);
  if(!p.scheduled_for) return {k:'no_time', short:'No send time', label:'No send time set — it will never go out on its own', cls:'b-warn'};
  if(c && c.connection_state !== 'active')
    return {k:'skip', short:'Held', label:"That account cannot post right now — "+connLabel(c.connection_state)+". The post waits, it has not failed", cls:'b-alert'};
  if(new Date(p.scheduled_for) <= NOW) return {k:'due', short:'Due', label:'Past its time — it goes out on the next send', cls:'b-ok'};
  return {k:'wait', short:'Waiting', label:'Waiting for its time', cls:'b-gray'};
}

/* ══ THE FIVE HEADLINE NUMBERS ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
var DERIV = {};
function renderStats(){
  if(!hasPartner()){
    ['Channels','Queued','Blocked','Failed','Posted'].forEach(function(k){
      document.getElementById('k'+k).textContent = '—';
      document.getElementById('k'+k+'D').textContent = 'no partner chosen';
    });
    DERIV = {};
    document.getElementById('derivBody').textContent =
      'Nothing to count. Every number above belongs to one partner, and no partner is chosen.';
    return;
  }
  var chs = channels(), act = chs.filter(function(c){ return c.connection_state === 'active'; });
  var q = readyPosts(), b = byStatus('blocked'), f = byStatus('failed'), po = byStatus('posted');
  var noTime = q.filter(function(p){ return queueState(p).k === 'no_time'; });
  var held = q.filter(function(p){ return p.status === 'awaiting_approval'; });
  /* Past its time is the only thing that can honestly be worked out here: a post
     carries no account, so whether the account could publish is unknowable.
     A held post is left out however old its send time is — counting it here
     would say it is about to go out, and it is not going out at all. */
  var selected = q.filter(function(p){
    return p.status !== 'awaiting_approval' && p.scheduled_for && new Date(p.scheduled_for) <= NOW;
  });
  var reasonCount = b.reduce(function(a,p){ return a + p.blocked_reasons.length; }, 0);

  document.getElementById('kChannels').textContent = chs.length + ' of 8';
  document.getElementById('kChannelsD').textContent = act.length + ' can post · ' + (chs.length-act.length) + ' cannot';
  document.getElementById('kQueued').textContent = q.length;
  document.getElementById('kQueuedD').textContent =
    selected.length + ' past their time · ' + held.length + ' held for a person';
  document.getElementById('kBlocked').textContent = b.length;
  document.getElementById('kBlockedD').textContent = reasonCount + ' reason' + (reasonCount===1?'':'s') + ' given';
  document.getElementById('kFailed').textContent = f.length;
  document.getElementById('kFailedD').textContent = 'tries ' + MAX_ATTEMPTS + ' times before giving up';
  document.getElementById('kPosted').textContent = po.length;
  document.getElementById('kPostedD').textContent = 'no like or view figures exist';

  DERIV = {
    channels:
      'Social accounts this partner has connected: <b>'+chs.length+'</b>. '+
      'Of those, <b>'+act.length+'</b> can post right now.<br>'+
      'The 8 is not a count. It is how many kinds of social account this system allows.',
    queued:
      'Posts written and not gone anywhere yet: <b>'+q.length+'</b>.<br>'+
      '<b>'+selected.length+'</b> '+(selected.length===1?'is':'are')+' already past the time set on '+
      (selected.length===1?'it':'them')+', measured against '+fmtLong(NOW_ISO)+'.<br>'+
      '<b>'+noTime.length+'</b> '+(noTime.length===1?'has':'have')+' no send time at all, so '+
      (noTime.length===1?'it':'they')+' will never go out until someone sets one.<br>'+
      '<b>'+held.length+'</b> '+(held.length===1?'was':'were')+' stopped by the copy check and '+
      (held.length===1?'is':'are')+' waiting for a person to approve '+(held.length===1?'it':'them')+'. '+
      (held.length===1?'It stays':'They stay')+' where '+(held.length===1?'it is':'they are')+
      ' and '+(held.length===1?'does':'do')+' not go out until somebody signed in as the owner or an '+
      'admin approves '+(held.length===1?'it':'them')+' in the waiting list below.',
    blocked:
      'Posts the copy check refused: <b>'+b.length+'</b>, with <b>'+reasonCount+'</b> reason'+(reasonCount===1?'':'s')+
      ' given between them.<br>'+
      'A refused post is kept with its reasons and can never be sent. To change the wording, write a new post. '+
      'This number only ever goes up.',
    failed:
      'Posts that could not be sent: <b>'+f.length+'</b>.<br>'+
      'The system tries '+MAX_ATTEMPTS+' times before it gives up.',
    posted:
      'Posts that went out: <b>'+po.length+'</b>.<br>'+
      'Nothing else can be shown here. There are no like, view, click or share figures anywhere in the system.'
  };
  document.getElementById('derivBody').innerHTML = DERIV[derivKey] || '—';
}

/* ══ CONNECTED ACCOUNTS ══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderChannels(){
  var chs = channels(), host = document.getElementById('chGrid');
  if(!hasPartner()){
    document.getElementById('chCount').textContent = '—';
    host.className='';
    host.innerHTML = noPartner('Each connected social account');
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('chCount').textContent = CHANNELS_ERR ? '—' : (chs.length + ' connected');
  if(!chs.length){
    host.className='';
    /* Three different things, and none of them may wear another's words: the read
       has not come back, the read failed, or there really are no accounts. */
    if(CHANNELS_ERR){
      host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">The connected accounts could not be read. '+esc(CHANNELS_ERR)+
        '<br>Nothing is shown in their place, and this is <b>not</b> the same as having none. '+
        'Reload the page to try again.</div>';
      return;
    }
    host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">'+
      (CHANNELS_READ
        ? 'No social accounts are connected yet. Once one is, it will show here.'
        : 'Reading this partner\'s connected accounts…')+
      '<br>With no account, a post typed in the writer below cannot be saved yet. Use "Write 3 posts for me" at the top to put posts in the waiting list. From there you can give a post a send time, or throw it away, without an account.<br>'+
      (viewerCanConnect()
        ? 'You can connect Facebook, Instagram or LinkedIn further down this page. If a button there is greyed out, that service has not been switched on for this site yet, and nothing can be connected until somebody does that.'
        : 'Only the owner can connect an account, so there is nothing for you to do here.')+
      '</div>';
    return;
  }
  host.className='chgrid';
  host.innerHTML = chs.map(function(c){
    var next = nextBestTime(c);
    var days = Object.keys(c.best_times || {});
    var slotCount = days.reduce(function(a,d){ return a + (c.best_times[d]||[]).length; }, 0);
    var consequence = c.connection_state === 'active'
      ? 'This account can post. Anything due on it goes out on the next send.'
      : '<b>This account cannot post.</b> Its posts wait rather than fail — they stay in the waiting list and are not counted as a failed try.';
    var tokenNote = c.connection_state === 'active'
      ? ''
      : (c.has_access_token
         ? 'A sign-in key is still stored, but the account is ' + c.connection_state + '.'
         : 'No sign-in key is stored. This account can never be switched on while that is true.');
    return '<div class="chcard s-'+esc(c.connection_state)+'">'+
      '<div class="chcard-hd">'+
        '<span class="cn">'+esc(CHANNEL_LABEL[c.channel])+
          '<span class="ch">'+esc(c.handle||'no handle')+'</span></span>'+
        '<span class="spacer"></span>'+
        '<span class="badge '+STATE_BADGE[c.connection_state]+'">'+esc(c.connection_state)+'</span>'+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="chcard-bd">'+
        '<div class="kv"><span class="k">kind</span><span class="v mono">'+esc(CHANNEL_LABEL[c.channel] || c.channel)+'</span></div>'+
        '<div class="kv"><span class="k">account id</span><span class="v mono">'+esc(c.external_account_id)+'</span></div>'+
        '<div class="kv"><span class="k">sign-in key</span><span class="v">'+
          '<span class="tick '+(c.has_access_token?'y':'n')+'">'+(c.has_access_token?'✓ stored':'✗ missing')+'</span></span></div>'+
        '<div class="kv"><span class="k">renewal key</span><span class="v">'+
          '<span class="tick '+(c.has_refresh_token?'y':'n')+'">'+(c.has_refresh_token?'✓ stored':'✗ missing')+'</span></span></div>'+
        '<div class="kv"><span class="k">key expires</span><span class="v mono">'+
          (c.token_expires_at ? esc(fmt(c.token_expires_at))+' <span style="color:var(--gray2)">('+esc(rel(c.token_expires_at))+')</span>' : 'no date stored')+'</span></div>'+
        '<div class="kv"><span class="k">time zone</span><span class="v mono">'+esc(c.timezone)+' <span style="color:var(--gray2)">(saved, not used)</span></span></div>'+
        '<div class="kv"><span class="k">posting times</span><span class="v mono">'+
          (slotCount ? slotCount+' time'+(slotCount===1?'':'s')+' over '+days.length+' day'+(days.length===1?'':'s') : 'none set')+'</span></div>'+
        '<div class="kv"><span class="k">next time</span><span class="v mono">'+(next?esc(fmt(next)):'none — no times set')+'</span></div>'+
        '<div class="kv"><span class="k">permissions</span><span class="v"><span class="scopes">'+
          (c.scopes.length ? c.scopes.map(function(s){return '<span class="scope">'+esc(s)+'</span>';}).join('') : '<span class="scope">none</span>')+
          '</span></span></div>'+
        (c.last_error ? '<div class="kv"><span class="k">last error</span><span class="v err">'+esc(c.last_error)+'</span></div>' : '')+
        '<div class="consq">'+consequence+(tokenNote?' '+esc(tokenNote):'')+'</div>'+
      '</div>'+
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
}
