/* ══ THE WRITER ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderComposerOptions(){
  var chs = channels();
  var sel = document.getElementById('cChannel');
  sel.innerHTML = chs.length
    ? chs.map(function(c){
        return '<option value="'+esc(c.id)+'">'+esc(CHANNEL_LABEL[c.channel] || c.channel)+' · '+
               esc(c.handle||c.external_account_id)+' ('+esc(c.connection_state)+')</option>'; }).join('')
    : '<option value="">— connect an account first —</option>';

  var a = document.getElementById('cAsset');
  a.innerHTML = '<option value="">— none —</option>' + assets().map(function(x){
    return '<option value="'+esc(x.id)+'">'+esc(x.kind)+' · '+esc(x.format)+'</option>'; }).join('');
}
function composerState(){
  return {
    channelId: document.getElementById('cChannel').value,
    offerType: document.getElementById('cOffer').value,
    caption:   document.getElementById('cCaption').value,
    assetId:   document.getElementById('cAsset').value,
    when:      document.getElementById('cWhen').value
  };
}
function renderVerdict(){
  var s = composerState();
  document.getElementById('capCount').textContent = s.caption.length.toLocaleString('en-US') + ' letters' +
    (s.caption.length > 8000 ? ' · only the first 8,000 are checked' : '');

  var ch = chById(s.channelId);
  var next = ch ? nextBestTime(ch) : null;
  var hint = document.getElementById('cWhenHint');
  if(!ch){ hint.textContent = 'No account chosen yet.'; }
  else if(s.when){ hint.textContent = 'It goes out at the time you set.'; }
  else { hint.textContent = next
    ? 'Left empty, it goes out at the next posting time: ' + fmt(next) + ' (UTC).'
    : 'This account has no posting times set, so this post would have no send time and would never go out.'; }

  var badge = document.getElementById('vState');
  /* Nothing has been typed and nothing picked, so nothing is checked. The panel
     used to open showing a verdict and a reason count for words nobody wrote — a
     judgement about text that does not exist. It now waits. */
  if(!s.caption.trim() && !s.offerType){
    badge.textContent = '—';
    badge.className = 'badge b-gray mono';
    document.getElementById('vCount').textContent = 'nothing checked yet';
    document.getElementById('vWhat').innerHTML =
      'Write the post and say what it is about. Nothing is checked until both are filled in, and leaving out what the post is about is itself a refusal.';
    document.getElementById('vReasons').innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  var v = previewScreen(s.caption, s.offerType, approveBeforeLaunch());
  badge.textContent = CHECK_LABEL[v.state] || v.state.replace('_',' ');
  badge.className = 'badge ' + (SCREEN_BADGE[v.state] || 'b-gray');
  document.getElementById('vCount').textContent = v.reasons.length + ' reason' + (v.reasons.length===1?'':'s');

  var what;
  if(v.state === 'blocked'){
    what = 'This post would be <b>saved and refused</b>, with the reasons below kept on it. It would stay in the '+
           '"needs a rewrite" list for good — it cannot be checked again, overruled, or edited and re-sent.';
  } else if(v.state === 'needs_approval'){
    /* This used to say a post needing approval was lined up and went out at its
       time anyway. That was true when it was written and is false now: the post
       is stopped and waits for a person. Saying it here matters more than
       anywhere else on this screen, because this is what the writer reads
       BEFORE they save. */
    var wHeld = s.when ? new Date(s.when + ':00Z').toISOString() : next;
    what = 'This post would be <b>saved and stopped</b>. It does not go out on its own' +
           (wHeld ? ' — not at <b>'+esc(fmt(wHeld))+'</b>, and not at any other time.' : '.') +
           ' Somebody signed in as the owner or an admin has to approve it in the waiting list on this ' +
           'screen before it can go out. If they refuse it instead, it is kept and never sent.';
  } else {
    var w = s.when ? new Date(s.when + ':00Z').toISOString() : next;
    what = 'This post would be <b>saved and lined up</b>' +
           (w ? ' to go out at <b>'+esc(fmt(w))+'</b>.' : ' with <b>no send time</b> — it would sit and wait for good.');
  }
  document.getElementById('vWhat').innerHTML = what;

  var host = document.getElementById('vReasons');
  host.innerHTML = v.reasons.length ? v.reasons.map(reasonHtml).join('') :
    '<div class="empty" style="padding:14px 0">No rule was broken. '+
    (v.state==='passed' ? 'This would be lined up to go out.' : '')+'</div>';
}
function reasonHtml(r){
  var sev = r.severity === 'warn' ? 'warn'
          : (r.rule_set === 'approval' ? 'approval'
          : (r.severity === 'block' ? 'block' : 'none'));
  return '<div class="rsn sev-'+sev+'">'+
    '<div class="rh">'+
      '<span class="rc">'+esc(r.code)+'</span>'+
      '<span class="badge '+(RULESET_BADGE[r.rule_set]||'b-gray')+'">'+esc(r.rule_set)+'</span>'+
      (r.severity ? '<span class="badge b-gray">'+esc(r.severity === 'block' ? 'refuses the post'
                       : (r.severity === 'warn' ? 'warning' : r.severity))+'</span>' : '') +
    '</div>'+
    '<div class="rm">'+esc(r.message)+'</div>'+
    (r.detail ? '<div class="rcite">detail: '+esc(r.detail)+'</div>' : '')+
    (r.citation ? '<div class="rcite">'+esc(r.citation)+'</div>' : '')+
    (!r.severity && r.rule_set !== 'approval'
      ? '<div class="rsevnote">No severity was set, so this counts as a hard refusal.</div>' : '')+
  '</div>';
}

/* ══ THE POST LISTS ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var EYEBROWS = {
  queued:'Waiting to post',
  blocked:'Needs a rewrite',
  failed:'Could not be sent',
  posted:'Sent',
  audit:'Send history'
};
function applyFilters(list){
  return list.filter(function(p){
    if(fltChannel && p.channel_id !== fltChannel) return false;
    if(fltOffer && p.offer_type !== fltOffer) return false;
    return true;
  });
}
function renderFilterOptions(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('fChannel');
  sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">All accounts</option>' + channels().map(function(c){
    return '<option value="'+esc(c.id)+'"'+(fltChannel===c.id?' selected':'')+'>'+
      esc(CHANNEL_LABEL[c.channel] || c.channel)+'</option>'; }).join('');
  document.getElementById('fOffer').value = fltOffer;
}
function capCell(p){
  return '<div class="pcap trunc">'+esc(p.caption)+'</div>';
}
function chLabel(id){ var c = chById(id); return c ? (CHANNEL_LABEL[c.channel] || c.channel) : '—'; }
/* How many times a post has been tried.
   A post that is only written down has no try count at all — nothing has been
   attempted — and the table used to print the word "undefined" in that cell. */
function hasTries(p){ return typeof p.attempt === 'number'; }
function triesText(p){ return hasTries(p) ? String(p.attempt) : '—'; }
/* what a post is about, in the words the screen shows */
var OFFER_LABEL = {funding:'Funding', credit_cards:'Credit cards', credit_repair:'Credit repair'};
function offerLabel(v){ return OFFER_LABEL[v] || (v || '—'); }

/* THE TWO BUTTONS THAT DRAIN THE HELD QUEUE.
   Drawn beside the line that already says the post is held, and only there.
   Only for a signed-in owner or admin: api/social/posts.mjs refuses everybody
   else, so showing a partner this button would offer an action that always
   fails. The empty line after the buttons is where the answer is written, so a
   refusal appears next to the post it is about. */
function heldControls(p){
  if(p.status !== 'awaiting_approval' || !viewerCanApprove()) return '';
  return '<div style="margin-top:7px;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap">'+
      '<button class="btn sm" data-approve="'+esc(p.id)+'">Approve it</button>'+
      '<button class="btn sm" data-reject="'+esc(p.id)+'">Refuse it</button>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<span class="substate" data-decidemsg="'+esc(p.id)+'"></span>';
}

function renderQueue(){
  var rows = applyFilters(readyPosts()).sort(function(a,b){
    if(!a.scheduled_for) return 1; if(!b.scheduled_for) return -1;
    return new Date(a.scheduled_for) - new Date(b.scheduled_for);
  });
  var host = document.getElementById('tblQueued');
  if(!hasPartner()){ host.innerHTML = noPartner('Posts waiting to go out'); return; }
  if(!rows.length){ host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Nothing is waiting to go out for this partner and filter.</div>'; return; }
  host.innerHTML = '<table class="grid"><thead><tr>'+
    '<th>Account</th><th>Post</th><th>About</th><th>Send at</th>'+
    '<th>Tries</th><th>What happens next</th><th>Set a time, or throw it away</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
    rows.map(function(p){
      var qs = queueState(p);
      return '<tr data-row="'+esc(p.id)+'" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">'+
        '<td><span class="rchev">▸</span><span class="mono">'+esc(chLabel(p.channel_id))+'</span></td>'+
        '<td>'+capCell(p)+
          (p.last_error?'<span class="substate">Last error: '+esc(p.last_error)+' — it will try again</span>':'')+'</td>'+
        '<td class="mono">'+esc(offerLabel(p.offer_type))+'</td>'+
        '<td class="mono">'+(p.scheduled_for?esc(fmt(p.scheduled_for))+'<span class="substate">'+esc(rel(p.scheduled_for))+'</span>':'<span style="color:#6E2A22">no time set</span>')+'</td>'+
        '<td><span class="attn'+(p.attempt>0?' hot':'')+'">'+triesText(p)+'</span><span class="substate">'+
          (hasTries(p) ? 'of '+MAX_ATTEMPTS : 'not tried yet')+'</span></td>'+
        '<td><span class="badge '+qs.cls+'">'+esc(qs.short)+'</span><span class="substate">'+esc(qs.label)+'</span>'+
          heldControls(p)+'</td>'+
        '<td>'+queueActions(p)+'</td>'+
      '</tr>' + detailRow(p, 7);
    }).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
  wireRows(host);
}

/* The two things a partner can do to a waiting post with no connected account.
   Both go to POST /api/social/posts — see postWrite() above. The time box is
   UTC, like every other time on this screen.

   The throw-away button here is drawn by the SAME check, canDiscard(), that
   draws the one inside the row's details. A post held for a person cannot be
   thrown away, and before this check the two buttons disagreed about that. */
function queueActions(p){
  /* toISOString() throws on an unparseable value, and one bad row must not take
     the whole table down with it — an empty box is the honest fallback. */
  var when = '';
  if (p.scheduled_for) {
    var d = new Date(p.scheduled_for);
    if (isFinite(d.getTime())) when = d.toISOString().slice(0,16);
  }
  return '<div class="qact" style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center">'+
    '<input type="datetime-local" data-qwhen="'+esc(p.id)+'" value="'+esc(when)+'" '+
      'aria-label="Send at, in UTC" style="font:inherit;padding:4px 6px">'+
    '<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-qqueue="'+esc(p.id)+'">Queue it</button>'+
    (canDiscard(p)
      ? '<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-qdrop="'+esc(p.id)+'">Throw it away</button>'
      : '')+
    '</div>';
}

function renderBlocked(){
  var rows = applyFilters(byStatus('blocked')).sort(function(a,b){ return new Date(b.created_at)-new Date(a.created_at); });
  var host = document.getElementById('tblBlocked');
  if(!hasPartner()){ host.innerHTML = noPartner('Posts the copy check refused'); return; }
  if(!rows.length){ host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">No post has been refused for this partner and filter.</div>'; return; }
  host.innerHTML = '<table class="grid"><thead><tr>'+
    '<th>Account</th><th>Post</th><th>About</th><th>Rules broken</th><th>Reasons</th><th>Written</th>'+
    '</tr></thead><tbody>'+
    rows.map(function(p){
      var sets = {};
      p.blocked_reasons.forEach(function(r){ sets[r.rule_set]=1; });
      return '<tr data-row="'+esc(p.id)+'" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">'+
        '<td><span class="rchev">▸</span><span class="mono">'+esc(chLabel(p.channel_id))+'</span></td>'+
        '<td>'+capCell(p)+'</td>'+
        '<td class="mono">'+esc(offerLabel(p.offer_type))+'</td>'+
        '<td>'+Object.keys(sets).map(function(s){
          return '<span class="badge '+(RULESET_BADGE[s]||'b-gray')+'" style="margin-right:4px">'+esc(s)+'</span>'; }).join('')+'</td>'+
        '<td><span class="attn hot">'+p.blocked_reasons.length+'</span></td>'+
        '<td class="mono">'+esc(fmt(p.created_at))+'</td>'+
      '</tr>' + reasonDetailRow(p, 6);
    }).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
  wireRows(host);
}

function renderFailed(){
  var rows = applyFilters(byStatus('failed')).sort(function(a,b){ return new Date(b.created_at)-new Date(a.created_at); });
  var host = document.getElementById('tblFailed');
  if(!hasPartner()){
    host.innerHTML = noPartner('Posts that gave up after ' + MAX_ATTEMPTS + ' tries');
    document.getElementById('taskStrip').innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }
  if(!rows.length){
    host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Nothing has failed. This screen cannot yet see posts that were actually sent, '+
      'so this list stays empty.</div>';
  } else {
    host.innerHTML = '<table class="grid"><thead><tr>'+
      '<th>Account</th><th>Post</th><th>Tries</th><th>Why it stopped</th><th>Send at</th>'+
      '</tr></thead><tbody>'+
      rows.map(function(p){
        return '<tr data-row="'+esc(p.id)+'" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">'+
          '<td><span class="rchev">▸</span><span class="mono">'+esc(chLabel(p.channel_id))+'</span></td>'+
          '<td>'+capCell(p)+'</td>'+
          '<td><span class="attn hot">'+triesText(p)+'</span><span class="substate">gave up after '+MAX_ATTEMPTS+'</span></td>'+
          '<td><span class="err">'+esc(p.last_error)+'</span><span class="substate">the message is cut off after 1,000 letters</span></td>'+
          '<td class="mono">'+(p.scheduled_for?esc(fmt(p.scheduled_for)):'no time set')+'</td>'+
        '</tr>' + detailRow(p, 5);
      }).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
    wireRows(host);
  }

  var open = tasks().filter(function(t){ return !t.resolved_at && t.task_key === 'social_post_failed'; });
  var strip = document.getElementById('taskStrip');
  if(!open.length){
    strip.innerHTML = rows.length
      ? '<div class="cap">Nothing to fix. Jobs are not shown on this screen yet.</div>'
      : '';
    return;
  }
  /* The one-job point is about how many of THIS PARTNER's posts failed, not how
     many survive the account/topic filter — so the line below counts the
     unfiltered set. Filtering the table must not change what is true. */
  var allFailed = byStatus('failed');
  strip.innerHTML = open.map(function(t){
    return '<div class="task">'+
      '<div class="tk">job to fix · '+esc(t.severity)+'</div>'+
      '<div class="tt" style="margin-top:5px">'+esc(t.title)+'</div>'+
      '<div class="td">'+esc(t.detail)+'</div>'+
      '<div class="td" style="opacity:.85">opened '+esc(fmtLong(t.created_at))+' · last updated '+esc(fmtLong(t.updated_at))+
        (t.resolved_at?' · fixed '+esc(fmtLong(t.resolved_at)):' · not fixed yet')+'</div>'+
      '<div class="td" style="opacity:.85;border-top:1px dashed var(--warn);padding-top:8px;margin-top:9px">'+
        allFailed.length+' post'+(allFailed.length===1?'':'s')+' could not be sent for this partner, and there is '+
        '<b>one</b> job covering all of them. Every failure after the first only refreshes the wording of this job — '+
        'the heading keeps the account named by the first one. The job cannot be traced back to a single post.'+
      '</div>'+
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function renderPosted(){
  var rows = applyFilters(byStatus('posted')).sort(function(a,b){ return new Date(b.posted_at)-new Date(a.posted_at); });
  var host = document.getElementById('tblPosted');
  if(!hasPartner()){ host.innerHTML = noPartner('Posts that went out'); return; }
  if(!rows.length){ host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">This screen cannot yet see posts that went out. '+
    'There are no like, view or click figures anywhere in the system.</div>'; return; }
  host.innerHTML = '<table class="grid"><thead><tr>'+
    '<th>Account</th><th>Post</th><th>About</th><th>Went out</th><th>Reference</th>'+
    '</tr></thead><tbody>'+
    rows.map(function(p){
      return '<tr data-row="'+esc(p.id)+'" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false">'+
        '<td><span class="rchev">▸</span><span class="mono">'+esc(chLabel(p.channel_id))+'</span></td>'+
        '<td>'+capCell(p)+'</td>'+
        '<td class="mono">'+esc(offerLabel(p.offer_type))+'</td>'+
        '<td class="mono">'+esc(fmt(p.posted_at))+'<span class="substate">'+esc(rel(p.posted_at))+'</span></td>'+
        '<td class="mono" style="word-break:break-all;font-size:var(--fs-caption)">'+esc(p.external_post_id)+'</td>'+
      '</tr>' + detailRow(p, 5);
    }).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
  wireRows(host);
}

/* The send history — live rows, and nothing else. There used to be a second
   renderer here that drew invented rows whenever the live read failed; a failed
   read now says it failed. The account and topic filters above the table do not
   apply to these rows: a send-history line carries neither. */
function renderAudit(){
  var host = document.getElementById('tblAudit');
  if(LIVE_ACTIONS){
    if(!LIVE_ACTIONS.length){ host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">No send attempts have been recorded for this partner yet.</div>'; return; }
    host.innerHTML = '<table class="grid"><thead><tr>'+
      '<th>When</th><th>What</th><th>Who</th><th>Why</th><th>Post</th>'+
      '<th>Change</th><th>Done at</th><th>Problem</th><th>Undo recorded</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
      LIVE_ACTIONS.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return new Date(b.created_at)-new Date(a.created_at); }).map(function(l){
        return '<tr>'+
          '<td class="mono">'+esc(fmt(l.created_at))+'</td>'+
          '<td class="mono">'+esc(l.rule_key||'—')+'</td>'+
          '<td><span class="badge '+(l.actor==='agent'?'b-accent':'b-gray')+'">'+esc(l.actor)+'</span>'+
            '<span class="substate">'+(l.agent_name?esc(l.agent_name):(l.user_name?esc(l.user_name):'—'))+'</span></td>'+
          '<td>'+esc(l.reason||'—')+'</td>'+
          '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption)">'+esc(String(l.target_id||'—'))+'</td>'+
          '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-caption)">'+esc(JSON.stringify(l.before))+'<br>→ '+esc(JSON.stringify(l.after))+'</td>'+
          '<td class="mono">'+(l.executed_at?esc(fmt(l.executed_at)):'<span style="color:#6E2A22">null</span>')+'</td>'+
          '<td>'+(l.execute_error?'<span class="err">'+esc(l.execute_error)+'</span>':'<span style="color:var(--gray2)">—</span>')+'</td>'+
          '<td><span class="badge '+(l.revertible?'b-info':'b-gray')+'">'+(l.revertible?'yes':'no')+'</span></td>'+
        '</tr>';
      }).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
    return;
  }
  if(!hasPartner()){ host.innerHTML = noPartner('Every attempt to send, newest first'); return; }
  host.innerHTML = ACTIONS_ERR
    ? '<div class="empty">The send history could not be read. ' + esc(ACTIONS_ERR) +
      '<br>Nothing is shown in its place. Reload the page to try again.</div>'
    : '<div class="empty">Reading the send history…</div>';
}

/* expanding row bodies ---------------------------------------------------- */
function detailRow(p, span){
  var c = chById(p.channel_id), a = p.asset_id ? ASSETS.filter(function(x){return x.id===p.asset_id;})[0] : null;
  return '<tr class="det" hidden data-det="'+esc(p.id)+'"><td colspan="'+span+'"><div class="detbox">'+
    '<div class="detcol"><div class="dt">Post</div>'+
      kvline('Reference', p.id)+kvline('State', STATUS_LABEL[p.status]||p.status)+kvline('About', offerLabel(p.offer_type))+
      kvline('Tries', triesText(p))+kvline('Written', fmtLong(p.created_at))+'</div>'+
    '<div class="detcol"><div class="dt">Account</div>'+
      kvline('Reference', p.channel_id)+kvline('Kind', c?(CHANNEL_LABEL[c.channel]||c.channel):'—')+
      kvline('Account state', c?connLabel(c.connection_state):'—')+kvline('Time zone', c?c.timezone:'—')+'</div>'+
    '<div class="detcol"><div class="dt">picture or video</div>'+
      (a ? kvline('Reference', a.id)+kvline('Kind', a.kind+' '+a.format)+
           kvline('Check state', a.compliance_state)+kvline('Made by a computer', String(a.ai_generated))+
           kvline('Person in it is not real', String(a.synthetic_performer))+
           '<div class="jsonline">The copy check never looks at the picture. It only reads the words.</div>'
         : '<div class="jsonline">No picture. This post is words only.</div>')+'</div>'+
    '<div class="detcol" style="flex:2;min-width:240px"><div class="dt">what it says</div>'+
      '<div class="pcap">'+esc(p.caption)+'</div>'+
      '<div style="margin-top:9px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">'+
        '<button class="btn sm" data-open="'+esc(p.id)+'">See the details</button>'+
        /* Throwing a post away already existed on the server (api/social/posts.mjs
           takes action "discard"); nothing on this screen ever called it, so old
           drafts piled up with no way to clear them. Only for posts that have not
           been sent — a sent post is a record, not a draft. */
        (canDiscard(p)
          ? '<button class="btn sm" data-discard="'+esc(p.id)+'">Throw this post away</button>'
          : '')+
      '</div></div>'+
  '</div></td></tr>';
}
/* Which posts may be thrown away. Draft, waiting and lined-up posts have not gone
   anywhere; sent, failed and refused ones are history and are left alone. */
function canDiscard(p){
  return p.status === 'draft' || p.status === 'queued' || p.status === 'scheduled';
}
function reasonDetailRow(p, span){
  return '<tr class="det" hidden data-det="'+esc(p.id)+'"><td colspan="'+span+'"><div class="detbox" style="flex-direction:column">'+
    '<div style="width:100%"><div class="dt" style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:var(--fs-caption);letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gray2);margin-bottom:8px">why it was refused</div>'+
    p.blocked_reasons.map(reasonHtml).join('')+
    '<div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn sm" data-open="'+esc(p.id)+'">See the details</button></div></div>'+
  '</div></td></tr>';
}
function kvline(k,v){ return '<div class="jsonline"><b>'+esc(k)+':</b> '+esc(v)+'</div>'; }

function wireRows(host){
  host.querySelectorAll('tr[data-row]').forEach(function(tr){
    function toggle(){
      var open = tr.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      tr.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'false' : 'true');
      var det = host.querySelector('tr.det[data-det="'+tr.dataset.row+'"]');
      if(det) det.hidden = open;
    }
    tr.addEventListener('click', toggle);
    tr.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if(e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' '){ e.preventDefault(); toggle(); }
    });
  });
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-open]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); openDrawer(b.dataset.open); });
  });
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-discard]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); discardOne(b.dataset.discard, b); });
  });
  /* A click inside the action box must not also open the row's detail. */
  host.querySelectorAll('.qact').forEach(function(box){
    box.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); });
    box.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); });
  });
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-qqueue]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); queueOne(b.dataset.qqueue); });
  });
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-qdrop]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); discardOne(b.dataset.qdrop, b); });
  });
  /* stopPropagation for the same reason the two above have it: the whole row is
     a click target that opens the details, and a button inside it must not do
     both things at once. */
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-approve]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); decideHeld(b.dataset.approve, 'approve', b); });
  });
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-reject]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); decideHeld(b.dataset.reject, 'reject', b); });
  });
}

/* ══ THROW A POST AWAY ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
   §5 — asks first and names what it does. The post is marked as thrown away, not
   removed: nothing on this screen deletes anything, and the record stays.

   ONE function, and only one. Two buttons offer this — the one inside a row's
   details and the one in the waiting list's own column — and both call this, and
   both are drawn only when canDiscard() says the post may go. Two functions, or
   one button drawn without that check, would let the screen answer the same
   question two different ways on the same row. It did, and this is that fix.

   The request itself goes through postWrite(), which is the single place on this
   screen that talks to /api/social/posts. An unreachable site comes back from it
   as a refusal like any other, so there is one failure path, not two. */
function discardOne(id, btn){
  var p = postById(id), pr = partner();
  if(!p || !pr) return;
  var words = String(p.caption || '').slice(0, 80);
  if(!window.confirm('Throw this post away?\n\n"'+words+(String(p.caption||'').length>80?'…':'')+'"\n\n'+
     'It stops waiting and will never go out. It cannot be put back from this screen.')) return;
  var was = btn ? btn.textContent : '';
  if(btn){ btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Throwing away…'; }
  postWrite({ partner_id: pr.id, id: id, action: 'discard' })
    .then(function(res){
      if(!res.ok){
        if(btn){ btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = was; }
        window.alert('It was not thrown away. ' + plainWrite(res));
        return;
      }
      loadQueue();
    });
}

/* ══ APPROVE OR REFUSE A HELD POST ═══════════════════════════════════════
   Asks first and names what it does, the same way throwing a post away does.
   Approving lets a post go out, and refusing stops it for good, so neither is
   worth doing on a stray click. The server is the real gate — this only sends
   the decision and prints what came back. */
function decideHeld(id, action, btn){
  var p = postById(id), pr = partner();
  if(!p || !pr) return;
  var full = String(p.caption || '');
  var words = full.slice(0, 80) + (full.length > 80 ? '…' : '');
  var ask = action === 'approve'
    ? 'Approve this post?\n\n"'+words+'"\n\nIt stops being held and goes out at its send time.'
    : 'Refuse this post?\n\n"'+words+'"\n\nIt will never go out. It cannot be put back from this screen.';
  if(!window.confirm(ask)) return;
  var msg = document.querySelector('[data-decidemsg="'+id+'"]');
  var was = btn ? btn.textContent : '';
  if(btn){ btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = action === 'approve' ? 'Approving…' : 'Refusing…'; }
  if(msg) msg.textContent = '';
  var t = '';
  try { t = localStorage.getItem('fh_token') || ''; } catch (e) { t = ''; }
  fetch('/api/social/posts', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: Object.assign(
      { accept: 'application/json', 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      (t && t !== 'demo') ? { authorization: 'Bearer ' + t } : {}),
    body: JSON.stringify({ partner_id: pr.id, id: id, action: action })
  }).then(function(r){ return r.json().catch(function(){ return { ok:false }; }); })
    .then(function(res){
      if(!res.ok){
        if(btn){ btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = was; }
        if(msg) msg.textContent = 'Nothing changed: ' +
          (res.message || res.error || 'something went wrong.');
        return;
      }
      loadQueue();
    })
    .catch(function(){
      if(btn){ btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = was; }
      if(msg) msg.textContent = 'Nothing changed — the site could not be reached. Try again in a moment.';
    });
}

/* ══ BEST TIMES TO POST ══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var DAY_ORDER = ['sun','mon','tue','wed','thu','fri','sat'];
function renderBestTimes(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('btChannel'), chs = channels();
  if(sel.innerHTML === '' || !chs.filter(function(c){return c.id===sel.value;}).length){
    sel.innerHTML = chs.length ? chs.map(function(c){
      return '<option value="'+esc(c.id)+'">'+esc(CHANNEL_LABEL[c.channel] || c.channel)+'</option>'; }).join('')
      : '<option value="">— none —</option>';
  }
  var c = chById(sel.value) || chs[0];
  var host = document.getElementById('btBody');
  if(!hasPartner()){ host.innerHTML = noPartner('The times of day an account posts at'); return; }
  if(!c){ host.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Set your posting times once an account is connected. All times are UTC.</div>'; return; }
  var next = nextBestTime(c);
  var nextSlot = next ? pad(new Date(next).getUTCHours())+':'+pad(new Date(next).getUTCMinutes()) : null;
  var nextDay  = next ? DAY_ORDER[new Date(next).getUTCDay()] : null;

  var body = '<div class="kv" style="margin-bottom:4px"><span class="k">time zone</span>'+
             '<span class="v mono">'+esc(c.timezone)+' <span style="color:var(--gray2)">(saved, but nothing uses it)</span></span></div>'+
             '<div class="kv" style="margin-bottom:11px"><span class="k">next time</span><span class="v mono">'+
             (next ? esc(fmtLong(next))+' <span style="color:var(--gray2)">('+esc(rel(next))+')</span>' : '<span style="color:#6E2A22">none — no post will ever be given a time</span>')+
             '</span></div>';

  var days = Object.keys(c.best_times || {});
  if(!days.length){
    body += '<div class="notice warn" style="margin-top:0"><span class="ni">⚠</span><span>'+
      '<b>No posting times are set for this account.</b> Every post written for it gets no send time, so it waits '+
      'in the list and never goes out. Somebody has to set a time.</span></div>';
  } else {
    body += '<div class="btgrid">' + DAY_ORDER.map(function(d){
      var slots = (c.best_times[d] || []).slice().sort();
      return '<div class="btrow"><span class="bd">'+esc(d)+'</span><span class="bs">'+
        (slots.length ? slots.map(function(s){
          var isNext = (d === nextDay && s === nextSlot);
          return '<span class="slot'+(isNext?' next':'')+'">'+esc(s)+(isNext?' ◂ next':'')+'</span>'; }).join('')
          : '<span class="none">no times</span>')+
      '</span></div>';
    }).join('') + '</div>';
  }
  host.innerHTML = body;
}

/* ══ WHO APPROVES POSTS ══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderApproval(){
  var host = document.getElementById('approvalBody');
  if(!hasPartner()){ host.innerHTML = noPartner('Who has to approve a post'); return; }
  /* Three different answers, and they must not be blurred into one:
       s is null        — the setting has not been read (or the read failed)
       s.stored = false — nothing has ever been saved for this partner, so the
                          system falls back to "a person must approve"
       s.stored = true  — a real saved value */
  var s = settings(), on = approveBeforeLaunch();
  var saved = !!(s && s.stored);
  var crRows = posts().filter(function(p){ return p.offer_type === 'credit_repair'; });
  host.innerHTML =
    '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px">'+
      '<span class="sw'+(on?' on':'')+'" role="img" aria-label="a person must approve: '+(on?'yes':'no')+'"></span>'+
      '<span style="font-size:var(--fs-body);font-weight:600">'+
        (on?'A person must approve a post before it goes out':'Posts go out with nobody approving them')+'</span>'+
      '<span class="badge '+(saved?'b-gray':(s?'b-info':'b-warn'))+'">'+
        (saved ? 'your saved setting' : (s ? 'nothing saved — the safe default' : 'setting not read'))+'</span>'+
    '</div>'+
    (saved
       ? (s.weekly_asset_target != null
            ? '<div class="kv"><span class="k">weekly target</span><span class="v mono">'+s.weekly_asset_target+' pictures a week</span></div>' : '')+
         (s.max_concurrent_jobs != null
            ? '<div class="kv"><span class="k">jobs at once</span><span class="v mono">'+s.max_concurrent_jobs+'</span></div>' : '')+
         '<div class="kv" style="margin-bottom:10px"><span class="k">autopilot</span><span class="v mono">'+
           (s.autopilot_enabled?'on':'off')+' · launching '+(s.launch_enabled?'on':'off')+
           ' <span style="color:var(--gray2)">(paid adverts only — no effect here)</span></span></div>'
       : s
         ? '<div class="notice" style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:10px"><span class="ni">◉</span><span>'+
           '<b>Nothing has been saved for this partner yet.</b> With nothing saved, the system treats every post as '+
           'needing a person to look at it. That is the safe answer, and it is the same answer the sending part of '+
           'the system uses.</span></div>'
         : '<div class="notice warn" style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:10px"><span class="ni">⚠</span><span>'+
           '<b>This screen could not read the approval setting.</b> Until it can, treat every post as needing a '+
           'person to look at it.</span></div>')+
    '<div class="notice'+(on?'':' warn')+'" style="margin-top:4px"><span class="ni">'+(on?'◉':'⚠')+'</span><span>'+
      (on
        /* This used to say the opposite, and it was right at the time: a post
           marked "needs approval" was lined up and sent anyway. Then it stopped
           and waited with no way out, and this said so. Both halves are true
           now — it stops, AND a person can release it — so both are said here,
           in the same words the waiting list and the counts above use. */
        ? '<b>A post marked "needs approval" now stops and waits. It does not go out.</b> '+
          'The part of the system that sends posts cannot see a post that is waiting, so nothing sends it — '+
          'not late, not by accident, not at all.'+
          '<br><br><b>Somebody signed in as the owner or an admin can approve it.</b> Every held post is in '+
          'the waiting list on this screen, with a button to approve it or refuse it. Approving it lets it go '+
          'out at its time. Refusing it stops it for good and it can never be sent. Nobody else can do either '+
          '— not the partner, and not any other kind of employee.'
        : '<b>With this off, a post that breaks no rule is marked as passed, and it does go out.</b> '+
          'This switch is not just a note any more. On, it stops posts and makes them wait. Off, it lets them '+
          'through. Credit repair is the one exception, and this switch never releases those — see below.')+
    '</span></div>'+
    '<div class="notice bad" style="margin-top:10px"><span class="ni">◆</span><span>'+
      '<b>Credit repair ignores this switch completely.</b> Every credit-repair post that is not refused outright is '+
      'marked as needing a person to approve it, before this setting is even looked at, and that cannot be turned off. '+
      'This partner has <b>'+crRows.length+'</b> credit-repair post'+(crRows.length===1?'':'s')+'.'+
      '<br><br>Separately: a credit-repair post that does not itself carry the words '+
      '"Consumer Credit File Rights Under State and Federal Law" is <b>refused</b>, not merely held.'+
    '</span></div>';
}

/* §5/§6 — a send button that cannot act does not sit there looking live. With no
   partner selected there is nothing to write to, so every control that would
   send is disabled and says why, instead of posting to an id that does not
   exist. */
/* Connect buttons for a service this site has not been set up for. Filled in by
   the connect block at the bottom of this file once the server has said so.
   Held here because every redraw runs syncWriteControls, and without this the
   redraw put a dead button back to looking usable. */
var OAUTH_OFF = {};
function syncWriteControls(){
  var on = hasPartner();
  var why = 'No partner is chosen — nothing can be queued, sent or connected from this screen yet.';
  ['queueBtn','publishDueBtn','oauthFb','oauthIg','oauthLi','liOrg'].forEach(function(id){
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if(!el) return;
    if(el._title0 === undefined) el._title0 = el.getAttribute('title') || '';
    if(OAUTH_OFF[id]){ el.disabled = true; return; }   /* not set up — stays off */
    el.disabled = !on;
    if(on){ if(el._title0) el.setAttribute('title', el._title0); else el.removeAttribute('title'); }
    else el.setAttribute('title', why);
  });
  var gen = document.getElementById('ssGenBtn');
  if (gen) {
    var suiteOn = window.__ssSuiteEnabled === true;
    gen.disabled = !on || !suiteOn;
    gen.setAttribute('title', !on
      ? why
      : (suiteOn ? '' : 'The owner has not turned this on for this partner.'));
  }
  if(!on){
    document.getElementById('queueMsg').textContent = why;
    var om = document.getElementById('oauthMsg');
    if (om) om.textContent = 'Connecting an account needs a partner. No partner is chosen.';
  } else {
    var qm = document.getElementById('queueMsg');
    if (qm && /No partner is chosen/.test(qm.textContent || '')) qm.textContent = '';
    var omOn = document.getElementById('oauthMsg');
    if (omOn && /No partner is chosen/.test(omOn.textContent || '')) {
      omOn.textContent = 'Connecting opens that account\'s own sign-in page. If an account is not set up yet, this line will say so and nothing is sent.';
    }
  }
}

/* ══ THE LIVE READS ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   The partner list, the written posts, the writing allowance and the send
   history are read live. Connected accounts, the picture library and the jobs
   list have no read yet, so their panels say so and show nothing.

   apiGet() reproduces data.js's contract, the same way hiring.html and
   creative-factory.html do, because these reads sit outside the wrapped
   /api/read/* family.

   `code` IS ADDED, AND IT IS NEVER SHOWN. Every refusal carries the server's own
   short word for what went wrong — 'query_failed', 'unauthorized', 'bad_state'.
   That word is for this file to look up, not for a person to read: see
   channelsErrorText() below, which turns it into a sentence. Adding the field
   changes nothing for the readers that already ignore it. */
function apiGet(path){
  var demo = false, tok = '';
  try { demo = localStorage.getItem('fh_demo') === '1'; tok = localStorage.getItem('fh_token') || ''; } catch(e){}
  if(demo) return Promise.resolve({ ok:false, source:'demo', code:null, data:null, error:'demo session — no backend read attempted' });
  var started;
  try {
    started = fetch(path, { headers: tok ? { accept:'application/json', authorization:'Bearer '+tok } : { accept:'application/json' } });
  } catch(e){
    return Promise.resolve({ ok:false, source:'offline', code:null, data:null, error:(e && e.message) || 'fetch unavailable' });
  }
  return Promise.resolve(started).then(function(r){
    /* The body is not read on this path, so the code is taken from the status.
       These are the two words the sign-in gate really sends with them — see
       src/http/middleware/requirePrincipal.mjs — not words invented here. */
    if(r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) return { ok:false, source:'unauthorized', code:(r.status === 401 ? 'unauthorized' : 'forbidden'), data:null, error:'not signed in, or role is not staff/partner' };
    if(r.status === 404){
      return r.json().then(function(d){
        return (d && d.error === 'not_found' && typeof d.path === 'string')
          ? { ok:false, source:'offline', code:'not_deployed', data:null, error:'/api/* not deployed' }
          : { ok:false, source:'notfound', code:(d && d.error) || null, data:null, error:'no such record' };
      }).catch(function(){ return { ok:false, source:'offline', code:'not_deployed', data:null, error:'/api/* not deployed' }; });
    }
    if(r.status === 400){
      return r.json().then(function(d){
        return { ok:false, source:'badrequest', code:(d && d.error) || null, data:null, error:(d && d.message) || 'That request was not accepted.' };
      }).catch(function(){ return { ok:false, source:'badrequest', code:null, data:null, error:'bad request' }; });
    }
    return r.json().then(function(d){
      if(r.status === 503 || (d && d.db === 'down')) return { ok:false, source:'nodb', code:(d && d.error) || 'auth_unavailable', data:null, error:(d && d.message) || 'The database is not reachable right now.' };
      if(!d || d.ok !== true) return { ok:false, source:'server', code:(d && d.error) || null, data:null, error:(d && d.message) || 'Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.' };
      return { ok:true, source:'api', code:null, data:d, error:null };
    }).catch(function(){ return { ok:false, source:'offline', code:null, data:null, error:'response was not JSON' }; });
  }).catch(function(e){
    return { ok:false, source:'offline', code:null, data:null, error:(e && e.message) || 'network error' };
  });
}

var LIVE_ACTIONS = null; // null = not read; the table then says why, and shows no rows
var ACTIONS_ERR = null;  // the reason the read failed, already in plain words
function wireActionLog(){
  var p = partner();
  if(!p){ LIVE_ACTIONS = null; ACTIONS_ERR = null; renderAudit(); renderCounts(); return; }
  apiGet('/api/campaigns/action-log?partner_id='+encodeURIComponent(p.id)+'&target_type=social_post&state=all&limit=200')
    .then(function(res){
      LIVE_ACTIONS = res.ok ? (res.data.items||[]) : null;
      /* Plain words, not the server's internal word — CLAUDE.md §10. */
      ACTIONS_ERR = res.ok ? null : plainWrite(res);
      renderAudit(); renderCounts();
      if(window.FHData){
        /* Plain words. This used to print the name the database uses for a post
           and the word "api" — neither means anything to the person reading it.
           The third value is a key the banner uses to keep sources apart and is
           never shown, so it stays as it is. */
        if(res.ok) FHData.banner('real', 'post send history · live', 'social-audit');
        else FHData.explain(res, 'the post send history');
      }
    });
}

(function(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('partnerSel');
  function applyPartners(list){
    PARTNERS = list || [];
    if(!PARTNERS.length){
      sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">No partners on file</option>';
      sel.disabled = true;
      var n = document.getElementById('ssNoticeTxt');
      if (n) n.textContent = 'No partner is chosen, so nothing on this page is loaded.';
      renderAll();
      return;
    }
    sel.disabled = false;
    var qid = null;
    try { qid = new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('partner_id'); } catch(e){}
    var idx = 0;
    if (qid) {
      for (var i = 0; i < PARTNERS.length; i++) if (PARTNERS[i].id === qid) idx = i;
    }
    P = idx;
    sel.innerHTML = PARTNERS.map(function(p,i){
      return '<option value="'+i+'">'+(p.name || p.slug || p.id)+'</option>';
    }).join('');
    sel.value = String(P);
    var n = document.getElementById('ssNoticeTxt');
    if (n) n.textContent = 'Showing ' + (PARTNERS[P].name || PARTNERS[P].id) + '.';
    renderAll();
    wireActionLog();
    loadChannels();
    loadSettings();
    loadQueue();
  }
  sel.addEventListener('change', function(){
    P = parseInt(sel.value,10) || 0;
    var p = PARTNERS[P];
    var url = new URL(location.href);
    if (p && p.id) url.searchParams.set('partner_id', p.id);
    else url.searchParams.delete('partner_id');
    location.assign(url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
  });
  if(!window.FHData || typeof FHData.partners !== 'function'){
    apiGet('/api/read/partners?limit=200').then(function(res){
      applyPartners(res.ok ? (res.data.items || res.data.rows || []) : []);
    });
  } else {
    FHData.partners({ limit: 200 }).then(function(res){
      applyPartners(res.ok ? ((res.data && (res.data.items || res.data.rows)) || []) : []);
    });
  }
})();

document.getElementById('queueBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
  var msg = document.getElementById('queueMsg');
  var caption = document.getElementById('cCaption').value.trim();
  var channelId = document.getElementById('cChannel').value;
  var offer = document.getElementById('cOffer').value || 'funding';
  var when = document.getElementById('cWhen').value;
  var asset = document.getElementById('cAsset').value || null;
  /* The partner this screen is scoped to, or nothing. Never the picker's index,
     and never a hardcoded id. */
  var p = partner();
  if (!p) {
    msg.textContent = 'No partner is chosen — nothing was sent.';
    return;
  }
  if (!channelId) {
    /* THE ONE THING THIS SCREEN STILL CANNOT DO, SAID PLAINLY.
       A caption typed here can only be saved by POST /api/social/schedule, and
       that route refuses without a connected account (channel_id_required). The
       queue's own write, POST /api/social/posts, only ever changes a post that
       is ALREADY in the list — it has no "make a new one" branch. So with zero
       accounts there is no route that stores a hand-typed post, and this says so
       instead of asking for an account the partner is not allowed to connect. */
    msg.textContent = channels().length
      ? 'Pick an account to post to first.'
      : 'There is no account to post to, so a post typed here cannot be saved yet. '+
        'Use "Write 3 posts for me" at the top to put posts in the waiting list. '+
        'From there you can set a time or throw one away without an account.';
    return;
  }
  if (!caption) { msg.textContent = 'Write the post first.'; return; }
  msg.textContent = 'Saving…';
  var t = '';
  try { t = localStorage.getItem('fh_token') || ''; } catch (e) { t = ''; }
  var body = {
    partner_id: p.id,
    channel_id: channelId,
    caption: caption,
    offer_type: offer,
    asset_id: asset || null,
    scheduled_for: when ? new Date(when).toISOString() : null
  };
  fetch('/api/social/schedule', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      accept: 'application/json',
      'content-type': 'application/json',
      ...(t && t !== 'demo' ? { authorization: 'Bearer ' + t } : {})
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
    .then(function (res) {
      if (!res.ok) {
        msg.textContent = 'Not saved. ' + plainWrite(res);
        return;
      }
      msg.textContent = 'Saved. Copy check says: ' + String(res.state || 'ok').replace('_', ' ') +
        '. Use "Send anything due now" to send everything that is already past its time.';
    });
});
document.getElementById('publishDueBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
  var msg = document.getElementById('queueMsg');
  var p = partner();
  if (!p) {
    msg.textContent = 'No partner is chosen — nothing was sent.';
    return;
  }
  /* §5 — a send asks first and names what it does. No count is given: this screen
     cannot read what is really due, so a number here would be invented. */
  if (!window.confirm(
    'Publish every post that is already due for ' + (p.name || 'this partner') + '?\n\n' +
    'They go out on that partner\'s connected social accounts right away, in public. ' +
    'Posting cannot be undone from this screen.')) {
    msg.textContent = 'Nothing was published.';
    return;
  }
  msg.textContent = 'Sending everything that is due…';
  var t = '';
  try { t = localStorage.getItem('fh_token') || ''; } catch (e) { t = ''; }
  fetch('/api/social/publish', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      accept: 'application/json',
      'content-type': 'application/json',
      ...(t && t !== 'demo' ? { authorization: 'Bearer ' + t } : {})
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ partner_id: p.id })
  }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
    .then(function (res) {
      if (!res.ok) {
        msg.textContent = 'Nothing was sent. ' + plainWrite(res);
        return;
      }
      var n = (res.results || []).length;
      var ok = (res.results || []).filter(function (x) { return x.ok; }).length;
      msg.textContent = n === 0
        ? 'Nothing was due, so nothing went out.'
        : 'Tried ' + n + ' post' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' · ' + ok + ' went out.';
    });
});

/* ══ OAUTH CONNECT ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
(function () {
  var msg = document.getElementById('oauthMsg');
  // Same partner the rest of this screen is scoped to (the top bar picker). With
  // no partner this returns '' and the connect buttons are disabled — nothing is
  // sent for a partner that does not exist.
  function partnerId() { var p = partner(); return p ? p.id : ''; }
  function token() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem('fh_token') || ''; } catch (e) { return ''; }
  }
  /* §6 — the screen never shows a raw error code. Every reason it can send back
     is said in words, and each one ends with what to do next. Anything unmapped
     falls through to a plain sentence, never to the code itself. */
  var LABEL = { facebook:'Facebook', instagram:'Instagram', linkedin:'LinkedIn' };
  function plainReason(code, channel) {
    var name = LABEL[channel] || 'that channel';
    switch (String(code || '')) {
      case 'partner_id_required':
        return 'Pick a partner in the bar at the top first. Nothing was sent.';
      case 'partner_not_found':
        return 'That partner is not in the system, so nothing was connected. Pick a different partner.';
      case 'needs_org':
        return 'LinkedIn needs the organization ID. Type it in the box above and click Connect LinkedIn again.';
      case 'not_configured':
        return name + ' is not set up yet, so it cannot be connected. Nothing was sent. Someone has to finish setting up the ' + name + ' app first.';
      case 'invalid_channel':
        return name + ' cannot be connected from this screen.';
      case 'forbidden':
      case 'unauthorized':
        return 'Your account is not allowed to connect social accounts. Nothing was sent.';
      default:
        return 'The ' + name + ' connection did not start, and nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.';
    }
  }
  function start(channel) {
    var pid = partnerId();
    if (!pid) {
      if (msg) msg.textContent = 'Pick a partner in the bar at the top before connecting.';
      return;
    }
    var url = '/api/social/oauth?action=start&channel=' + encodeURIComponent(channel) +
      '&partner_id=' + encodeURIComponent(pid);
    if (channel === 'linkedin') {
      var orgEl = document.getElementById('liOrg');
      var org = orgEl ? orgEl.value.trim() : '';
      if (!org) {
        if (msg) msg.textContent = 'LinkedIn needs the organization ID. Type it in the box above, then click Connect LinkedIn. Nothing was sent.';
        if (orgEl) orgEl.focus();
        return;
      }
      url += '&external_account_id=' + encodeURIComponent(org);
    }
    var t = token();
    if (msg) msg.textContent = 'Starting the ' + (LABEL[channel] || channel) + ' connection…';
    fetch(url, {
      headers: Object.assign({ accept: 'application/json' },
        (t && t !== 'demo') ? { authorization: 'Bearer ' + t } : {})
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { ok: false }; }); })
      .then(function (res) {
        if (!res.ok) {
          if (msg) msg.textContent = plainReason(res.error, channel);
          return;
        }
        if (res.url) location.href = res.url;
        else if (msg) msg.textContent = plainReason(null, channel);
      })
      .catch(function () {
        if (msg) msg.textContent = 'The connection could not be started — the site could not be reached. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.';
      });
  }
  ['oauthFb', 'oauthIg', 'oauthLi'].forEach(function (id) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.addEventListener('click', function () {
      start(el.getAttribute('data-oauth'));
    });
  });

  var role = '';
  try { role = String(localStorage.getItem('fh_role') || '').trim().toLowerCase(); } catch (e) { role = ''; }
  var box = document.getElementById('oauthConnectBox');
  if (box && role === 'partner') {
    box.innerHTML = 'Only the owner can connect a social account, and only Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn can ever be connected. ' +
      'The other five cannot be posted to at all. You can still write posts here — they wait until an account is connected.';
  } else if (box) {
    function markMissing(channel, code) {
      var id = channel === 'facebook' ? 'oauthFb' : (channel === 'instagram' ? 'oauthIg' : 'oauthLi');
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!el) return;
      if (code === 'not_configured') {
        OAUTH_OFF[id] = true;   /* so the next redraw does not switch it back on */
        el.disabled = true;
        el.setAttribute('title', (LABEL[channel] || channel) + ' is not set up yet. Nothing was sent.');
      }
    }
    function probe(channel) {
      var pid = partnerId();
      if (!pid) return;
      var url = '/api/social/oauth?action=start&channel=' + encodeURIComponent(channel) +
        '&partner_id=' + encodeURIComponent(pid);
      if (channel === 'linkedin') url += '&external_account_id=probe';
      fetch(url, {
        headers: Object.assign({ accept: 'application/json' },
          (token() && token() !== 'demo') ? { authorization: 'Bearer ' + token() } : {})
      }).then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return {}; }); })
        .then(function (res) {
          if (res && res.error === 'not_configured') markMissing(channel, 'not_configured');
        });
    }
    ['facebook', 'instagram', 'linkedin'].forEach(probe);
  }
})();

/* ══ THE CONNECTED ACCOUNTS ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   The read this screen never had. The tile counted zero however many accounts
   were connected, because nothing ever filled SOCIAL_CHANNELS.

   THE STAMP AT THE END MATTERS. channels() filters on `c.partner === P`, and P is
   the partner picker's position in the list, not a partner id — a leftover from
   when this screen was drawn against made-up data. A row from the server carries
   a partner id and no such field, so without the stamp every card would be
   filtered out and the list would look empty on a perfectly good read.
   loadQueue() below stamps the same field for the same reason.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ══ WHY THE ACCOUNT READ FAILED, IN WORDS ═══════════════════════════════
   The tile used to print the server's answer straight through, and the server
   answers with a short machine word. A partner read "The connected accounts
   could not be read: query_failed" — or "unauthorized" — and learned nothing
   they could act on.

   EVERY WORD BELOW IS ONE api/social/channels.mjs OR ITS GATE REALLY SENDS.
   Nothing here is invented, and nothing it can send is missing:

     from src/http/middleware/requirePrincipal.mjs, in front of the read
       unauthorized       401 — no signed-in session at all
       forbidden          403 — a session of a kind this read does not serve
       auth_unavailable   503 — the sign-in check itself could not run
     from src/http/partner-read-api.mjs, which runs the read
       partner_id_required  400 — no partner was named
       bad_state            400 — ?state= named a state that does not exist
       bad_request          400 — the read's own precondition was not met
       invalid_parameter    400 — Postgres refused a value in the request
       query_failed         500 — the read itself fell over
       method_not_allowed   405 — asked for in a way this read does not take
     from the page's own wrapper, where no server answer exists to read
       not_deployed       this build has no such address

   ANYTHING ELSE FALLS BACK to one neutral sentence. The raw word is never
   shown, not even in the fallback — an unknown word is exactly the case where
   printing it would put a machine code in front of a person. */
var CHANNELS_ERR_TEXT = {
  unauthorized:        'You are not signed in any more. Sign in again, then open this page.',
  forbidden:           'This sign-in is not allowed to see this partner\'s connected accounts.',
  auth_unavailable:    'The sign-in check could not run, so nothing was read. Try again in a moment.',
  partner_id_required: 'This page did not say which partner to read, so nothing was read.',
  bad_state:           'This page asked for accounts of a kind the server does not know about.',
  bad_request:         'The server did not accept the way this page asked for the accounts.',
  invalid_parameter:   'The server did not accept the way this page asked for the accounts.',
  query_failed:        'The server could not get the list out of its records.',
  method_not_allowed:  'The server did not accept the way this page asked for the accounts.',
  not_deployed:        'This part of the site is not switched on here yet.'
};
function channelsErrorText(res){
  /* These two never reach the server, so they have no code of their own and are
     answered first. */
  if(res.source === 'demo')    return 'This page is in demo mode, so no accounts were asked for.';
  if(res.source === 'offline') return CHANNELS_ERR_TEXT[res.code] ||
    'The page could not reach the site. Check the connection and try again.';
  if(res.source === 'notfound') return 'The server has no account list at that address.';
  return CHANNELS_ERR_TEXT[res.code] ||
    'Something went wrong at the server end and it did not say what.';
}

function loadChannels(){
  var p = partner();
  SOCIAL_CHANNELS = [];
  CHANNELS_READ = false;
  CHANNELS_ERR = null;
  if(!p){ renderAll(); return; }
  apiGet('/api/social/channels?partner_id='+encodeURIComponent(p.id)+'&state=all&limit=50')
    .then(function(res){
      CHANNELS_READ = true;
      /* Plain words only. res.error carries the server's own short word, and in
         the 500 case it can carry raw database text naming tables and columns —
         neither goes on the screen. */
      CHANNELS_ERR = res.ok ? null : channelsErrorText(res);
      SOCIAL_CHANNELS = res.ok ? ((res.data.items)||[]).map(function(row){
        return Object.assign({}, row, {
          partner: P,
          /* the card walks both of these; a missing one would stop the whole grid */
          scopes: Array.isArray(row.scopes) ? row.scopes : [],
          best_times: (row.best_times && typeof row.best_times === 'object') ? row.best_times : {}
        });
      }) : [];
      renderAll();
    });
}

/* ══ WHO HAS TO APPROVE A POST ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Read on its own because the partner list this screen uses does not carry it.
   The value is hung on the chosen partner row, which is where the approval card
   already looks for it. Left unset if the read fails, so the card says it could
   not read the setting rather than showing a value nobody saved. */
function loadSettings(){
  var p = partner();
  if(!p){ return; }
  var forPartner = p.id;
  apiGet('/api/social/settings?partner_id='+encodeURIComponent(forPartner))
    .then(function(res){
      var cur = partner();
      if(!cur || cur.id !== forPartner) return;   /* the picker moved on */
      if(res.ok && res.data && res.data.settings) cur.settings = res.data.settings;
      renderApproval();
    });
}

function loadQueue(){
  var p = partner();
  POSTS = [];
  if(!p){ renderAll(); return; }
  apiGet('/api/social/posts?partner_id='+encodeURIComponent(p.id)).then(function(res){
    POSTS = res.ok ? ((res.data.items)||[]).map(function(row){
      return Object.assign({}, row, { partner: P, blocked_reasons: row.blocked_reasons || [] });
    }) : [];
    renderAll();
  });
  apiGet('/api/partner-marketing/usage?partner_id='+encodeURIComponent(p.id)).then(function(res){
    var txt = document.getElementById('ssSuiteTxt');
    var chip = document.getElementById('ssSuiteChip');
    if (!res.ok) {
      if (txt) txt.textContent = '—';
      window.__ssSuiteEnabled = false;
      syncWriteControls();
      return;
    }
    if (txt) txt.textContent = (res.data.enabled ? 'Writing on' : 'Writing off') + (res.data.remaining != null ? ' · ' + res.data.remaining + ' left' : '');
    if (chip) chip.className = 'chip ' + (res.data.enabled ? 'on' : '');
    window.__ssSuiteEnabled = !!res.data.enabled;
    syncWriteControls();
  });
}

document.getElementById('ssGenBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
  var msg = document.getElementById('ssGenMsg');
  var p = partner();
  if (!p) { msg.textContent = 'Pick a partner first.'; return; }
  if (window.__ssSuiteEnabled !== true) {
    msg.textContent = 'The owner has not turned this on for this partner.';
    return;
  }
  msg.textContent = 'Writing…';
  var t = '';
  try { t = localStorage.getItem('fh_token') || ''; } catch (e) { t = ''; }
  fetch('/api/social/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      accept: 'application/json',
      'content-type': 'application/json',
      ...(t && t !== 'demo' ? { authorization: 'Bearer ' + t } : {})
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ partner_id: p.id, count: 3, offer_type: 'funding' })
  }).then(function(r){ return r.json().catch(function(){ return { ok:false }; }); })
    .then(function(res){
      msg.textContent = res.ok
        ? 'Wrote ' + ((res.items && res.items.length) || 0) + ' posts. They are in the waiting list below.'
        : plainWrite(res);
      loadQueue();
    })
    /* Without this the button sat on "Writing…" for ever whenever the request
       itself fell over — a dropped connection, or the server being cut off part
       way through. The connect block further up this file has had the same
       ending for the same reason. */
    .catch(function(){
      msg.textContent = 'The writing did not finish and nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.';
      loadQueue();
    });
});

/* The writer opens empty. It used to open with words and a topic already filled

renderAll();
wireActionLog();

<script>
(function () {
  var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  var token = { org: q.get("org"), client: q.get("client"), exp: q.get("exp"), sig: q.get("sig") };
  var root = document.getElementById("app");
  var pricing = { base_cents: 3200, business_addon_cents: 1000, max_businesses: 20, base_display: "$32", business_addon_display: "$10" };
  var bizCount = 0;
  var bizDrafts = [];

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
  }

  function money(cents) {
    return "$" + (Number(cents) / 100).toFixed(0);
  }

  function apiUrl() {
    return "/api/soft-pull-approve?org=" + encodeURIComponent(token.org || "") +
      "&client=" + encodeURIComponent(token.client || "") +
      "&exp=" + encodeURIComponent(token.exp || "") +
      "&sig=" + encodeURIComponent(token.sig || "");
  }

  function showErr(msg) {
    root.innerHTML =
      '<div class="mono">Fundhub · soft pull</div>' +
      '<h1>Link problem</h1>' +
      '<div class="err">' + esc(msg) + "</div>" +
      '<p class="lede">Stay on the call and ask your advisor to send a fresh link.</p>';
  }

  function updateTotal() {
    var el = document.getElementById("total_line");
    if (!el) return;
    var total = pricing.base_cents + pricing.business_addon_cents * bizCount;
    el.innerHTML = "Total due: " + money(total) +
      ' <span>(' + esc(pricing.base_display) + " soft pull" +
      (bizCount ? " + " + bizCount + " × " + esc(pricing.business_addon_display) : "") +
      ")</span>";
  }

  function normalizeEin(raw) {
    var digits = String(raw == null ? "" : raw).replace(/\D/g, "");
    if (digits.length !== 9) return null;
    return digits.slice(0, 2) + "-" + digits.slice(2);
  }

  function readBizBlock(i) {
    var name = document.getElementById("biz_name_" + i);
    if (!name) return null;
    return {
      name: name.value,
      address_line1: document.getElementById("biz_line1_" + i).value,
      city: document.getElementById("biz_city_" + i).value,
      state: document.getElementById("biz_state_" + i).value,
      postal_code: document.getElementById("biz_zip_" + i).value,
      ein: document.getElementById("biz_ein_" + i).value,
      incorporated_date: document.getElementById("biz_inc_" + i).value,
      extra_owner_name: document.getElementById("biz_owner_" + i).value
    };
  }

  function fillBizBlock(i, row) {
    if (!row) return;
    document.getElementById("biz_name_" + i).value = row.name || "";
    document.getElementById("biz_line1_" + i).value = row.address_line1 || "";
    document.getElementById("biz_city_" + i).value = row.city || "";
    document.getElementById("biz_state_" + i).value = row.state || "";
    document.getElementById("biz_zip_" + i).value = row.postal_code || "";
    document.getElementById("biz_ein_" + i).value = row.ein || "";
    document.getElementById("biz_inc_" + i).value = row.incorporated_date || "";
    document.getElementById("biz_owner_" + i).value = row.extra_owner_name || "";
  }

  function snapshotBiz() {
    var list = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < bizCount; i++) {
      var row = readBizBlock(i);
      if (row) list.push(row);
    }
    return list.length ? list : bizDrafts.slice();
  }

  function bizBlockHtml(i) {
    return '<div class="biz" data-biz="' + i + '">' +
      '<div class="biz-head"><strong>Business ' + (i + 1) + '</strong>' +
      '<button type="button" class="biz-rm" data-rm="' + i + '">Remove</button></div>' +
      '<label for="biz_name_' + i + '">Business name</label>' +
      '<input id="biz_name_' + i + '" name="biz_name_' + i + '" required>' +
      '<label for="biz_line1_' + i + '">Business street address</label>' +
      '<input id="biz_line1_' + i + '" name="biz_line1_' + i + '" required>' +
      '<div class="row2"><div><label for="biz_city_' + i + '">City</label>' +
      '<input id="biz_city_' + i + '" name="biz_city_' + i + '" required></div>' +
      '<div><label for="biz_state_' + i + '">State</label>' +
      '<input id="biz_state_' + i + '" name="biz_state_' + i + '" maxlength="2" required placeholder="AZ"></div></div>' +
      '<label for="biz_zip_' + i + '">ZIP</label>' +
      '<input id="biz_zip_' + i + '" name="biz_zip_' + i + '" inputmode="numeric" required>' +
      '<label for="biz_ein_' + i + '">EIN</label>' +
      '<input id="biz_ein_' + i + '" name="biz_ein_' + i + '" inputmode="numeric" required placeholder="12-3456789">' +
      '<label for="biz_inc_' + i + '">When was this business incorporated?</label>' +
      '<input id="biz_inc_' + i + '" name="biz_inc_' + i + '" type="month" required>' +
      '<label for="biz_owner_' + i + '">Extra owner name (if any)</label>' +
      '<input id="biz_owner_' + i + '" name="biz_owner_' + i + '">' +
      "</div>";
  }

  function renderBizList(kept) {
    var box = document.getElementById("biz_list");
    var addBtn = document.getElementById("add_biz");
    if (!box) return;
    var snap = kept || snapshotBiz();
    var html = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < bizCount; i++) html += bizBlockHtml(i);
    box.innerHTML = html;
    for (var k = 0; k < bizCount && k < snap.length; k++) fillBizBlock(k, snap[k]);
    bizDrafts = snapshotBiz();
    if (addBtn) addBtn.disabled = bizCount >= pricing.max_businesses;
    box.querySelectorAll("[data-rm]").forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var idx = Number(btn.getAttribute("data-rm"));
        var next = [];
        for (var j = 0; j < bizCount; j++) {
          if (j === idx) continue;
          var row = readBizBlock(j);
          if (row) next.push(row);
        }
        bizCount = next.length;
        bizDrafts = next;
        renderBizList(next);
        updateTotal();
      });
    });
    updateTotal();
  }

  function collectBusinesses() {
    var list = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < bizCount; i++) {
      var row = readBizBlock(i);
      if (!row) continue;
      list.push({
        name: row.name.trim(),
        address_line1: row.address_line1.trim(),
        city: row.city.trim(),
        state: row.state.trim(),
        postal_code: row.postal_code.trim(),
        ein: row.ein.trim(),
        incorporated_date: row.incorporated_date.trim(),
        extra_owner_name: row.extra_owner_name.trim()
      });
    }
    return list;
  }

  function renderForm(data) {
    if (data.pricing) pricing = data.pricing;
    var name = data.contact && data.contact.first_name ? data.contact.first_name : "there";
    var already = data.consent && data.consent.valid;
    bizCount = 0;
    root.innerHTML =
      '<div class="mono">Fundhub · soft pull</div>' +
      "<h1>Approve your soft-pull assessment</h1>" +
      '<p class="lede">Hi ' + esc(name) + ". Fill this out while you stay on the Google Meet. " +
      "It is a soft inquiry — it does not hurt your score. Authorize first, then pay the total shown below.</p>" +
      (already ? '<div class="ok">Consent is already on file. You can update your details below if needed, then pay.</div><br>' : "") +
      '<div class="card"><h2>Soft pull authorization</h2>' +
      '<div class="disc">' + esc((data.disclosure && data.disclosure.text) || "") + "</div>" +
      '<p class="fine">Version ' + esc((data.disclosure && data.disclosure.version) || "—") + "</p></div>" +
      '<div class="card"><h2>What happens next</h2><ol class="next">' +
      "<li>You fill this in (optional businesses at the bottom) and submit. Your advisor never sees your Social Security number.</li>" +
      "<li>You pay the total shown — " + esc(pricing.base_display) + " soft pull plus " +
      esc(pricing.business_addon_display) + " per business.</li>" +
      "<li>Once that payment clears, we request the report. Nothing else is needed from you.</li>" +
      "</ol></div>" +
      '<form id="f">' +
      '<label for="granted_name">Full legal name</label>' +
      '<input id="granted_name" name="granted_name" autocomplete="name" required>' +
      '<label for="ssn">Social Security number</label>' +
      '<input id="ssn" name="ssn" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" required placeholder="123-45-6789">' +
      '<label for="dob">Date of birth</label>' +
      '<input id="dob" name="dob" type="date" required>' +
      '<label for="address_line1">Street address</label>' +
      '<input id="address_line1" name="address_line1" autocomplete="street-address" required>' +
      '<div class="row2"><div><label for="city">City</label><input id="city" name="city" required></div>' +
      '<div><label for="state">State</label><input id="state" name="state" maxlength="2" required placeholder="AZ"></div></div>' +
      '<label for="postal_code">ZIP</label>' +
      '<input id="postal_code" name="postal_code" inputmode="numeric" required>' +
      '<div class="card" style="margin-top:16px">' +
      "<h2>Add businesses (optional)</h2>" +
      "<p class=\"lede\" style=\"margin:0 0 8px\">If a company has other owners, say so. Extra owners make funding slower and harder. We usually prefer one-owner companies, but write the truth here anyway.</p>" +
      "<p class=\"lede\" style=\"margin:0 0 8px\">Add each business you want funded. Each one adds " +
      esc(pricing.business_addon_display) + ". Leave empty if you only need the personal soft pull.</p>" +
      '<div id="biz_list"></div>' +
      '<button type="button" class="btn-sec" id="add_biz">+ Add a business</button>' +
      '<div class="total" id="total_line"></div></div>' +
      '<button class="btn" type="submit" id="go">I agree — submit soft-pull approval</button>' +
      '<p class="fine">Your advisor cannot see this Social Security number on their screen. ' +
      "After you submit, pay the total from the Pay button (or the matching link in your email if you added no businesses).</p>" +
      '<div id="msg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div></form>';

    document.getElementById("add_biz").addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (bizCount >= pricing.max_businesses) return;
      bizDrafts = snapshotBiz();
      bizCount += 1;
      renderBizList(bizDrafts);
    });
    renderBizList();

    document.getElementById("f").addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var btn = document.getElementById("go");
      var msg = document.getElementById("msg");
      btn.disabled = true;
      msg.innerHTML = "";

      var addr = {
        address_line1: document.getElementById("address_line1").value.trim(),
        city: document.getElementById("city").value.trim(),
        state: document.getElementById("state").value.trim(),
        postal_code: document.getElementById("postal_code").value.trim()
      };
      if (!addr.address_line1 || !addr.city || !addr.state || !addr.postal_code) {
        btn.disabled = false;
        msg.innerHTML = '<div class="err">Enter your current street address, city, state and ZIP.</div>';
        return;
      }

      var businesses = collectBusinesses();
      for (var i = 0; i < businesses.length; i++) {
        var b = businesses[i];
        if (!b.name || !b.address_line1 || !b.city || !b.state || !b.postal_code) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          msg.innerHTML = '<div class="err">Business ' + (i + 1) + ": fill name, street, city, state, and ZIP.</div>";
          return;
        }
        var ein = normalizeEin(b.ein);
        if (!ein) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          msg.innerHTML = '<div class="err">Business ' + (i + 1) + ": enter a 9-digit EIN (you can type 12-3456789).</div>";
          return;
        }
        b.ein = ein;
        if (!b.incorporated_date) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          msg.innerHTML = '<div class="err">Business ' + (i + 1) + ": enter when this business was incorporated (month and year).</div>";
          return;
        }
      }

      var body = {
        org: token.org,
        client: token.client,
        exp: token.exp,
        sig: token.sig,
        granted_name: document.getElementById("granted_name").value,
        ssn: document.getElementById("ssn").value,
        dob: document.getElementById("dob").value,
        address_line1: addr.address_line1,
        city: addr.city,
        state: addr.state,
        postal_code: addr.postal_code,
        businesses: businesses
      };
      fetch("/api/soft-pull-approve", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "content-type": "application/json", accept: "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body)
      }).then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (j) { return { status: r.status, body: j }; }); })
        .then(function (r) {
          if (!r.body || !r.body.ok) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            msg.innerHTML = '<div class="err">' + esc((r.body && (r.body.message || r.body.error)) || "Could not save") + "</div>";
            return;
          }
          var pay = r.body.checkout && r.body.checkout.checkout_url;
          var total = (r.body.pricing && r.body.pricing.total_display) ||
            (r.body.checkout && r.body.checkout.amount_display) || pricing.base_display;
          root.innerHTML =
            '<div class="mono">Fundhub · soft pull</div>' +
            "<h1>Consent saved</h1>" +
            '<div class="ok">Your soft-pull authorization is on file. ' +
            esc(r.body.next || ("Pay " + total + " next.")) + "</div>" +
            (pay
              ? '<a class="btn-pay" href="' + esc(pay) + '">Pay ' + esc(total) + " assessment</a>"
              : '<p class="lede" style="margin-top:14px">Ask your advisor for the pay link for ' + esc(total) + ".</p>") +
            '<p class="lede" style="margin-top:14px">After payment clears, the soft pull runs automatically. Stay on the Meet.</p>';
        })
        .catch(function () {
          btn.disabled = false;
          msg.innerHTML = '<div class="err">Network error — try again.</div>';
        });
    });
  }

  if (!token.org || !token.client || !token.exp || !token.sig) {
    showErr("This page needs a full link from your advisor.");
    return;
  }

  fetch(apiUrl(), { headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
    .then(function (r) { return r.json().then(function (j) { return { status: r.status, body: j }; }); })
    .then(function (r) {
      if (!r.body || !r.body.ok) {
        showErr((r.body && (r.body.message || r.body.error)) || "Could not open this link.");
        return;
      }
      renderForm(r.body);
    })
    .catch(function () { showErr("Could not reach the server."); });
})();
</script>
