<script>

document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(t){
  t.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var w=t.closest('.card');
    w.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('on')});
    w.querySelectorAll('.tabpane').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('on')});
    t.classList.add('on');
    var p=document.getElementById('tab-'+t.dataset.tab); if(p)p.classList.add('on');
  });
});
function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]});}

/* ══ DATA ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var PEOPLE=[];
var nextId=8;

var ROLE_KEY={
  Owner:null,
  Admin:'admin',
  Closer:'closer',
  'Funding Advisor':'funding_advisor',
  'Inquiry Specialist':'inquiry_specialist',
  Setter:'setter',
  'Sales Manager':'sales_manager',
  Affiliate:null
};
/* There is deliberately no permission matrix in this file.

   An 18×6 chart used to live here, typed in by hand. Nothing read it from the
   server, because nothing serves it: role rules are enforced per endpoint in
   the server's own code and are never published to the browser. An owner
   looking at that chart was reading a guess about who can issue refunds or see
   a Social Security number in a regulated product. Removed until a real source
   exists — see the ST-02 tab, which now says so on screen. */

var ROLE_CLS={Owner:'b-accent','Sales Manager':'b-info',Closer:'b-ok','Funding Advisor':'b-warn','Inquiry Specialist':'b-gray',Affiliate:'b-gray'};
function initials(p){return (p.first[0]+p.last[0]).toUpperCase()}

/* ══ ROLE CELL ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   The person's real role, and nothing more. This column used to add "which
   areas they reach" and "14 of 18 permissions", both counted off the
   hand-written chart that used to sit above. Those numbers described the
   chart, not the system, so they are gone.                                 */
function presetCell(role){
  return '<div class="acc"><span class="badge '+(ROLE_CLS[role]||'b-gray')+'">'+esc(role)+'</span></div>';
}

/* ══ RENDER ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var selId=null;

function visible(){
  var r=document.getElementById('roleFilter').value;
  var q=document.getElementById('qFilter').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  return PEOPLE.filter(function(p){
    if(r && p.role!==r) return false;
    if(q && (p.first+' '+p.last+' '+p.code+' '+p.email).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)<0) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

function renderRoster(){
  var rows=visible().map(function(p){
    /* employee code and start date ride in the row's hover title and stay
       editable in the person editor — they don't earn a column here */
    var t=p.code+' · started '+p.start;
    return '<tr data-id="'+esc(String(p.id))+'" class="'+(String(p.id)===String(selId)?'sel':'')+'" title="'+esc(t)+'">'+
      '<td><div class="who-cell"><span class="av">'+initials(p)+'</span><div><div class="nm">'+esc(p.first+' '+p.last)+'</div><div class="em">'+esc(p.email)+'</div></div></div></td>'+
      '<td>'+presetCell(p.role)+'</td>'+
      /* consent === null means a REAL staff row: monitoring consent and clock
         state have no column anywhere in the schema. Rendering the sample
         "On file" badge against a real employee would be fabricating a
         compliance record about a named person, which is the one kind of
         invented data that could actually hurt someone. Show that it is
         unknown. */
      '<td>'+(p.consent===null?'<span class="badge b-gray" title="No consent record in the database">—</span>'
             :p.consent?'<span class="badge b-ok">On file</span>':'<span class="badge b-alert">Missing</span>')+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+(p.clock===null?'<span class="badge b-gray" title="No clock data in the database">—</span>'
             :p.clock?'<span class="badge b-ok">In · '+p.since+'</span>':'<span class="badge b-gray">Out</span>')+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+(p.status==='suspended'?'<span class="badge b-warn">Revoked</span>'
             :p.status==='invited'?'<span class="badge b-warn">Invited</span>'
             :p.active?'<span class="badge b-ok">Active</span>':'<span class="badge b-warn">Invited</span>')+'</td></tr>';
  }).join('');
  document.getElementById('rosterBody').innerHTML=rows||'<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">No one matches that filter.</td></tr>';
  document.querySelectorAll('#rosterBody tr[data-id]').forEach(function(tr){
    tr.addEventListener('click',function(){openEditor(tr.dataset.id);});
  });
}

function renderClock(){
  document.getElementById('clockBody').innerHTML=PEOPLE.map(function(p){
    var canSelf = !!p.self;
    var clockKnown = p.clock !== null;
    var clockCell = canSelf
      ? '<button class="btn sm mono" data-clock="'+esc(String(p.id))+'">'+(p.clock?'Clock out':'Clock in')+'</button>'
      : '<span class="badge b-gray" title="Each person clocks themselves via /api/shifts — you can only clock your own row">—</span>';
    var consentCell = p.consent===null
      ? '<span class="badge b-gray" title="No consent record in the database">—</span>'
      : p.consent?'<span class="badge b-ok">On file</span>':'<span class="badge b-alert">Off</span>';
    var consentBtn = (window.__FH_IS_OWNER && p.staffId)
      ? '<button class="btn sm mono" data-consent="'+esc(String(p.staffId))+'" data-on="'+(p.consent?1:0)+'">'+(p.consent?'Revoke':'Record form')+'</button>'
      : '';
    return '<tr>'+
      '<td><div class="who-cell"><span class="av">'+initials(p)+'</span><div><div class="nm">'+esc(p.first+' '+p.last)+(canSelf?' <span class="badge b-info">you</span>':'')+'</div><div class="em">'+esc(p.email||p.code)+'</div></div></div></td>'+
      '<td>'+(clockKnown
             ?(p.clock?'<span class="badge b-ok">Clocked in</span>':'<span class="badge b-gray">Clocked out</span>')
             :'<span class="badge b-gray" title="Open shift unknown for this row">—</span>')+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+(clockKnown&&p.clock?p.since:'—')+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body)">'+(p.today||'—')+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+consentCell+'</td>'+
      '<td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--fs-body);color:var(--gray)">'+(p.consentAt||'—')+'</td>'+
      '<td style="text-align:right;display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap">'+consentBtn+clockCell+'</td></tr>';
  }).join('');
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-clock]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      var p=PEOPLE.filter(function(x){return String(x.id)===String(b.dataset.clock)})[0];
      if(!p || !p.self){ alert('You can only clock yourself. /api/shifts always uses the signed-in session.'); return; }
      if(typeof window.FHStaffClock !== 'function'){ alert('Clock API not loaded — sign in as staff.'); return; }
      b.disabled = true;
      window.FHStaffClock(p.clock ? 'clock_out' : 'clock_in').then(function(){ b.disabled = false; });
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-consent]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      if(typeof window.FHMonitoringConsent !== 'function'){ alert('Consent API not loaded.'); return; }
      var on = b.dataset.on === '1';
      var msg = on
        ? 'Revoke monitoring consent? Hubstaff ingest will skip this person.'
        : 'Record that a signed monitoring consent form is on file for this person?';
      if(!confirm(msg)) return;
      b.disabled = true;
      window.FHMonitoringConsent(b.dataset.consent, on ? 'revoke' : 'grant').then(function(){ b.disabled = false; });
    });
  });
}

/* ST-02 has no render function on purpose: there is no permission data to
   render. Its tab is static copy explaining why. */

function renderStats(){
  var hasClock=PEOPLE.some(function(p){return p.clock!==null});
  var hasConsent=PEOPLE.some(function(p){return p.consent!==null});
  var shift=hasClock?PEOPLE.filter(function(p){return p.clock===true}).length:null;
  var cons=hasConsent?PEOPLE.filter(function(p){return p.consent===true}).length:null;
  document.getElementById('kHead').textContent=PEOPLE.length;
  document.getElementById('kShift').textContent=shift===null?'—':String(shift);
  document.getElementById('kConsent').textContent=cons===null?'—':(cons+'/'+PEOPLE.length);
  document.getElementById('kPending').textContent=PEOPLE.filter(function(p){return !p.active}).length;
  document.getElementById('onShiftTxt').textContent=(shift===null?'—':shift)+' on shift';
  var chip=document.getElementById('onShiftChip');
  chip.className='chip '+(shift===null?'wip':(shift>0?'on':'wip'));
}
function renderAll(){renderRoster();renderClock();renderStats();}

function setSw(id,on){document.getElementById(id).classList.toggle('on',!!on)}
function getSw(id){return document.getElementById(id).classList.contains('on')}

function openEditor(id){
  /* Live roster ids are UUIDs — keep as string. Sample ids stay numeric strings. */
  selId=id==null?null:String(id);
  var p=PEOPLE.filter(function(x){return x.id===id})[0];
  document.getElementById('edMode').textContent='EDIT PERSON';
  document.getElementById('edTitle').textContent=p.first+' '+p.last;
  document.getElementById('ed_first').value=p.first;
  document.getElementById('ed_last').value=p.last;
  document.getElementById('ed_email').value=p.email;
  document.getElementById('ed_phone').value=p.phone;
  document.getElementById('ed_code').value=p.code;
  document.getElementById('ed_role').value=p.role;
  document.getElementById('ed_start').value=(p.start && p.start!=='—') ? String(p.start).slice(0,10) : '';
  ['ed_code'].forEach(function(i){
    document.getElementById(i).readOnly=true;
  });
  ['ed_first','ed_last','ed_email','ed_phone','ed_start'].forEach(function(i){
    document.getElementById(i).readOnly=false;
  });
  setSw('ed_consent',p.consent);
  setSw('ed_booked_sms', p.notifyBookedCallSms);
  document.getElementById('edReset').style.display = p.email ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('edDeact').style.display = '';
  document.getElementById('editor').classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('scrim').classList.add('on');
  renderRoster();
  loadStaffAgreements(p.staffId || p.id);
}
function openNew(){
  selId=null;
  document.getElementById('edMode').textContent='ADD PERSON';
  document.getElementById('edTitle').textContent='New person';
  ['ed_first','ed_last','ed_email','ed_phone'].forEach(function(i){document.getElementById(i).value=''});
  /* No employee code is issued anywhere — the invite reply carries none. Show
     the same unknown marker the roster uses instead of inventing one. */
  document.getElementById('ed_code').value='—';
  document.getElementById('ed_role').value='Closer';
  document.getElementById('ed_start').value='';
  document.getElementById('ed_email').placeholder='inbox for the invite — login is name@fundhub.ai';
  ['ed_first','ed_last','ed_email'].forEach(function(i){document.getElementById(i).readOnly=false;});
  ['ed_phone','ed_start'].forEach(function(i){document.getElementById(i).readOnly=true;});
  setSw('ed_consent',false);
  setSw('ed_booked_sms',false);
  document.getElementById('edReset').style.display='none';   // no account exists yet
  document.getElementById('edDeact').style.display='none';   // nothing to revoke yet
  document.getElementById('edAgreements').textContent='Save / invite first — agreements attach after hire.';
  document.getElementById('editor').classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('scrim').classList.add('on');
}
function closeEditor(){
  document.getElementById('editor').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('scrim').classList.remove('on');
  selId=null; renderRoster();
}

/* Employment agreements for this roster person. Stored in contracts +
   documents (signed_document_id). Filtered by contracts.staff_id. */
function loadStaffAgreements(staffId){
  var box=document.getElementById('edAgreements');
  if(!box) return;
  if(!staffId || typeof FHData==='undefined' || !FHData.read){
    box.textContent='—';
    return;
  }
  box.textContent='Loading…';
  FHData.read('contracts',{ view:'contracts', staff_id:String(staffId), limit:50 }).then(function(res){
    if(!res || !res.ok){
      box.textContent=(res && res.error) || 'Could not load agreements.';
      return;
    }
    var items=(res.data && res.data.items) || [];
    if(!items.length){
      box.textContent='None on file yet.';
      return;
    }
    box.innerHTML=items.map(function(c){
      var st=esc(c.status||'');
      var when=c.signed_at ? new Date(c.signed_at).toLocaleDateString() : (c.sent_at ? ('sent '+new Date(c.sent_at).toLocaleDateString()) : '—');
      var label=c.signed_document_id ? 'Open signed' : 'Open';
      var openBtn=(c.id && (c.signed_document_id || c.document_id || c.status==='signed' || c.status==='sent' || c.status==='viewed' || c.status==='void'))
        ? (' <button type="button" class="btn sm mono ed-open-signed" data-cid="'+esc(c.id)+'" data-signed="'+(c.signed_document_id?'1':'0')+'">'+label+'</button>')
        : '';
      return '<div style="padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)">'+esc(c.title||c.template_key||'Agreement')+
        ' <span class="badge b-gray">'+st+'</span> · '+esc(when)+openBtn+'</div>';
    }).join('');
    box.querySelectorAll('.ed-open-signed').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener('click',function(){
        var id=btn.getAttribute('data-cid');
        var wantSigned=btn.getAttribute('data-signed')==='1';
        if(!id) return;
        var was=btn.textContent;
        btn.disabled=true; btn.textContent='opening…';
        FHData.read('contracts',{ file:'contract', id:id, signed: wantSigned ? 1 : 0 }).then(function(r){
          btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent=was;
          if(!r.ok || !r.data || !r.data.pdf_base64){
            alert((r && r.error) || 'No file on file yet.');
            return;
          }
          downloadPdfB64(r.data.pdf_base64, r.data.filename || 'agreement.pdf');
        });
      });
    });
  });
}
function downloadPdfB64(b64, filename){
  var bin=atob(b64);
  var buf=new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for(var i=0;i<bin.length;i++) buf[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
  var url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([buf],{ type:'application/pdf' }));
  var a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=url; a.download=filename || 'agreement.pdf';
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
  setTimeout(function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 60000);
}

document.getElementById('addBtn').addEventListener('click',openNew);

document.getElementById('edSave').addEventListener('click',function(){
  var first=document.getElementById('ed_first').value.trim();
  var last=document.getElementById('ed_last').value.trim();
  if(!first||!last){alert('First and last name are required.');return}
  var rec={first:first,last:last,
    email:document.getElementById('ed_email').value.trim(),
    phone:document.getElementById('ed_phone').value.trim(),
    role:document.getElementById('ed_role').value,
    start:document.getElementById('ed_start').value,
    consent:getSw('ed_consent'),
    notifyBookedCallSms:getSw('ed_booked_sms')};
  if(selId){
    var p=PEOPLE.filter(function(x){return String(x.id)===String(selId)})[0];
    if(!p || !p.staffId){
      alert('This row is not a real login.');
      return;
    }
    function applyLocalProfile(st){
      if(st && st.name){
        var sp=st.name.indexOf(' ');
        p.first=sp>0?st.name.slice(0,sp):st.name;
        p.last=sp>0?st.name.slice(sp+1):'';
      }
      if(st && st.email) p.email=st.email;
      if(st && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(st,'phone')) p.phone=st.phone||'—';
      if(st && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(st,'notify_booked_call_sms')) p.notifyBookedCallSms=!!st.notify_booked_call_sms;
      if(st && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(st,'start_date')){
        p.start=st.start_date ? String(st.start_date).slice(0,10) : '—';
      }
      if(st && st.employee_code) p.code=st.employee_code;
    }
    function finishEdit(){
      if(typeof window.FHMonitoringConsent === 'function' && window.__FH_IS_OWNER){
        var want = !!rec.consent;
        var had = !!p.consent;
        if(want !== had){
          window.FHMonitoringConsent(p.staffId, want ? 'grant' : 'revoke').then(function(){
            p.role=rec.role;
            closeEditor(); renderAll();
          });
          return;
        }
      }
      p.role=rec.role;
      closeEditor(); renderAll();
    }
    var fullName=(rec.first+' '+rec.last).trim();
    var profileChanged=fullName!==(p.first+' '+p.last).trim()
      ||rec.email!==p.email
      ||rec.phone!==p.phone
      ||rec.start!==p.start
      ||!!rec.notifyBookedCallSms!==!!p.notifyBookedCallSms;
    var nextRole=ROLE_KEY[rec.role];
    var roleChanged=nextRole && rec.role !== p.role;
    if(typeof FHData==='undefined'||!FHData.write){alert('Not available — the data layer has not loaded.');return}
    var saveBtn=document.getElementById('edSave');
    saveBtn.disabled=true; saveBtn.textContent='Saving…';
    var chain=Promise.resolve({ok:true});
    if(profileChanged){
      chain=chain.then(function(){
        return FHData.write('/api/auth/staff-update',{
          staff_id:p.staffId,
          name:fullName,
          email:rec.email,
          phone:rec.phone==='—'?'':rec.phone,
          start_date:rec.start==='—'?'':rec.start,
          notify_booked_call_sms:!!rec.notifyBookedCallSms
        });
      }).then(function(res){
        if(!res.ok){
          throw new Error('Could not save their details: '+(res.error||'unknown error')+
            (res.source==='unauthorized'?' — sign in as owner.':''));
        }
        applyLocalProfile(res.data && res.data.staff);
        return res;
      });
    }
    if(roleChanged){
      chain=chain.then(function(){
        return FHData.write('/api/auth/staff-role',{staff_id:p.staffId,role:nextRole});
      }).then(function(res){
        if(!res.ok){
          throw new Error('Could not save the job: '+(res.error||'unknown error')+
            (res.source==='unauthorized'?' — sign in as owner.':''));
        }
        p.role=rec.role;
        return res;
      });
    }
    chain.then(function(){
      saveBtn.disabled=false; saveBtn.textContent='Save';
      finishEdit();
    }).catch(function(err){
      saveBtn.disabled=false; saveBtn.textContent='Save';
      alert(err && err.message ? err.message : 'Could not save.');
    });
    return;
  }
  var roleKey=ROLE_KEY[rec.role];
  if(!roleKey){alert('Pick a job we can log in: closer, advisor, inquiry, setter, sales manager, or admin.');return}
  if(typeof FHData==='undefined'||!FHData.write){alert('Not available — the data layer has not loaded.');return}
  var btn=document.getElementById('edSave');
  btn.disabled=true; btn.textContent='Creating…';
  var notify=rec.email||'';
  FHData.write('/api/auth/invite',{name:first+' '+last,role:roleKey,notify_email:notify}).then(function(res){
    btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent='Save';
    if(!res.ok){
      alert('Could not create them: '+(res.error||'unknown error')+
        (res.source==='unauthorized'?' — sign in as owner.':''));
      return;
    }
    var email=(res.data&&res.data.email)||'';
    var path=(res.data&&res.data.invitePath)||'';
    var link=location.origin+path;
    var mailed=!!(res.data&&res.data.mailed);
    prompt(
      mailed

/* Reset password — owner/admin only, enforced server-side on the whole route
   (api/auth/admin-reset.mjs). Nothing in this system sends outbound email, so
   the response hands back a real link for the admin to copy and relay by

   Requires window.FHData from data.js, loaded further down this page; by the

document.getElementById('edReset').addEventListener('click', async function(){
  if(!selId){return}
  var p=PEOPLE.filter(function(x){return String(x.id)===String(selId)})[0];
  if(!p || !p.email){alert('This person has no email on file.');return}
  if(typeof FHData === 'undefined' || !FHData.write){alert('Not available — the data layer has not loaded.');return}
  if(!confirm('Create a password reset link for '+p.first+' '+p.last+' ('+p.email+')?')) return;
  var btn=this; btn.disabled=true; btn.textContent='Working…';
  var res = await FHData.write('/api/auth/admin-reset', {email:p.email});
  btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent='Reset password';
  if(!res.ok){
    alert('Could not create a reset link: '+(res.error||'unknown error')+
      (res.source==='unauthorized' ? ' — you may need to be signed in as owner or admin.' : ''));
    return;
  }
  var link = location.origin + res.data.resetPath;
  prompt('Reset link for '+p.email+' — copy this and send it to them. Reset links last 1 hour:', link);
});

<script>

/* Staff & Teams — the real roster from /api/read/staff. Replaces the roster
   table body only; the clock table has no endpoint and keeps its sample markup
   (reported in the unit notes). The permissions tab has no endpoint either and
   now renders nothing rather than a hand-written stand-in. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var esc = function (v) {
    return String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;" }[c]; });
  };
  var label = function (r) {
    return String(r || "").replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, function (m) { return m.toUpperCase(); });
  };

  /* Feed the screen's OWN model and let it render.

     This used to overwrite #rosterBody directly with five <td>s in the order
     name/email/role/status/tasks. The table's header is
     Person | Access | Consent | Clock | Status — so every value landed one
     column left of where it belonged: the role appeared under "Consent" and the
     account status under "Clock". And because renderRoster() rebuilds the body
     from PEOPLE on every filter change, the first keystroke in the search box
     replaced the six real staff with the seven-person sample roster while the
     banner still said "live".

     Replacing PEOPLE and calling the screen's own renderAll() fixes both: the
     columns are right by construction, and filtering, the row editor and the
     clock tab all keep working against real people. */

  // DB role -> the label this screen shows. Only exact correspondences are
  // mapped; anything else keeps its real name rather than being forced into a
  // preset it does not have.
  var ROLE_LABEL = {
    owner: "Owner",
    admin: "Admin",
    closer: "Closer",
    funding_advisor: "Funding Advisor",
    inquiry_specialist: "Inquiry Specialist",
    setter: "Setter",
    sales_manager: "Sales Manager"
  };
  var ROLE_KEY = {
    Owner: null,
    Admin: "admin",
    Closer: "closer",
    "Funding Advisor": "funding_advisor",
    "Inquiry Specialist": "inquiry_specialist",
    Setter: "setter",
    "Sales Manager": "sales_manager",
    Affiliate: null
  };

  var meEmail = null;
  var meId = null;

  function loadMe() {
    var t;
    try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { t = ""; }
    return fetch("/api/auth/session", { headers: t ? { authorization: "Bearer " + t } : {} })
      .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw 0; return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        if (!(d && d.ok && d.principal === "staff" && d.staff)) return;
        if (d.staff.email) meEmail = String(d.staff.email).toLowerCase();
        if (d.staff.id) meId = d.staff.id;
        window.__FH_IS_OWNER = String(d.staff.role || "").toLowerCase() === "owner";
      })
      .catch(function () {
        try {
          var sess = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("fh_account") || "null");
          if (sess && sess.email) meEmail = String(sess.email).toLowerCase();
          if (sess && sess.id) meId = sess.id;
        } catch (e) {}
      });
  }

  window.__FH_IS_OWNER = window.__FH_IS_OWNER || false;
  function fmtWhen(v) {
    if (!v) return "—";
    try { var d = new Date(v); if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(v); return d.toLocaleString(); }
    catch (e) { return String(v); }
  }
  function fillTeleSelect() {
    var sel = document.getElementById("teleStaff"); if (!sel) return;
    var cur = sel.value;
    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Select a person…</option>' +
      PEOPLE.filter(function (p) { return p.staffId; }).map(function (p) {
        return '<option value="' + esc(String(p.staffId)) + '">' + esc(p.first + " " + p.last) + "</option>";
      }).join("");
    if (cur) sel.value = cur;
  }
  function renderTelemetry(data) {
    var empty = document.getElementById("teleEmpty");
    var body = document.getElementById("teleBody");
    if (!empty || !body) return;
    if (!data || !data.ok) {
      empty.style.display = ""; body.style.display = "none";
      empty.textContent = (data && data.error) ? ("Could not load: " + data.error) : "Pick someone to see shifts, hours, and Hubstaff activity.";
      return;
    }
    empty.style.display = "none"; body.style.display = "";
    var on = !!(data.staff && data.staff.monitoring_on);
    document.getElementById("teleConsent").textContent = on ? "On" : "Off";
    document.getElementById("teleConsentSd").textContent = on ? ("signed " + fmtWhen(data.staff.monitoring_consent_at)) : "no consent — ingest skips";
    var hrs = data.hours && data.hours.payable_hours;
    document.getElementById("teleHours").textContent = hrs == null ? "—" : (Math.round(hrs * 100) / 100) + "h";
    var avg = data.activity && data.activity.avg_overall;
    document.getElementById("teleAvg").textContent = avg == null ? "—" : (avg + "%");
    document.getElementById("teleAvgSd").textContent = (data.activity && data.activity.activity_samples || 0) + " activity blocks";
    document.getElementById("teleSamples").textContent = String((data.activity && (data.activity.activity_samples + data.activity.screenshot_samples)) || 0);
    document.getElementById("teleShifts").innerHTML = (data.shifts || []).map(function (s) {
      return "<tr><td class=\"mono\" style=\"font-size:var(--fs-body)\">" + esc(fmtWhen(s.started_at)) +
        "</td><td class=\"mono\" style=\"font-size:var(--fs-body)\">" + esc(s.open ? "open" : fmtWhen(s.ended_at)) +
        "</td><td>" + (s.open ? '<span class="badge b-ok">Open</span>' : '<span class="badge b-gray">Closed</span>') + "</td></tr>";
    }).join("") || '<tr><td colspan="3" class="empty">No shifts on file.</td></tr>';
    document.getElementById("teleEvents").innerHTML = ((data.activity && data.activity.recent) || []).map(function (e) {
      var d = e.detail || {};
      var summary = e.kind === "monitor_activity"
        ? ("overall " + (d.overall == null ? "—" : d.overall + "%"))
        : "screenshot";
      return "<tr><td class=\"mono\" style=\"font-size:var(--fs-body)\">" + esc(fmtWhen(e.created_at)) +
        "</td><td><span class=\"badge b-info\">" + esc(e.kind) + "</span></td><td style=\"font-size:var(--fs-body)\">" + esc(summary) + "</td></tr>";
    }).join("") || '<tr><td colspan="3" class="empty">No monitor events yet.</td></tr>';
  }
  window.FHLoadTelemetry = function (staffId) {
    if (!staffId) return Promise.resolve(null);
    var t; try { t = localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { t = ""; }
    return fetch("/api/staff/telemetry?staff_id=" + encodeURIComponent(staffId), {
      headers: { accept: "application/json", authorization: t ? "Bearer " + t : "" }
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) { renderTelemetry(d); return d; })
      .catch(function () { renderTelemetry({ ok: false, error: "network" }); });
  };
  window.FHMonitoringConsent = function (staffId, action) {
    return FHData.write("/api/staff/monitoring-consent", { staff_id: staffId, action: action }).then(function (res) {
      if (!res.ok) { alert("Could not update consent: " + (res.error || "unknown")); return res; }
      var at = res.data && res.data.staff && res.data.staff.monitoring_consent_at;
      var on = !!(res.data && res.data.staff && res.data.staff.monitoring_on);
      PEOPLE.forEach(function (p) {
        if (String(p.staffId) !== String(staffId)) return;
        p.consent = on; p.consentAt = on && at ? fmtWhen(at).slice(0, 10) : null;
      });
      try { renderAll(); fillTeleSelect(); } catch (e) {}
      FHData.banner("real", on ? "consent on file" : "consent revoked", "monitoring-consent");
      return res;
    });
  };
  var teleSel = document.getElementById("teleStaff");
  var teleBtn = document.getElementById("teleRefresh");
  function syncTeleRefresh() {
    if (teleBtn) teleBtn.hidden = !(teleSel && teleSel.value);
  }
  if (teleSel) teleSel.addEventListener("change", function () {
    syncTeleRefresh();
    if (teleSel.value) window.FHLoadTelemetry(teleSel.value); else renderTelemetry(null);
  });
  if (teleBtn) teleBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (teleSel && teleSel.value) window.FHLoadTelemetry(teleSel.value);
  });
  syncTeleRefresh();

  /* /api/shifts only clocks the signed-in session — never another person. */
  window.FHStaffClock = function (action) {
    return FHData.write("/api/shifts", { action: action }).then(function (res) {
      if (!res.ok) {
        alert("Could not " + (action === "clock_in" ? "clock in" : "clock out") + ": " +
              (res.error || (res.data && res.data.error) || "unknown error"));
        return res;
      }
      var shift = res.data && res.data.shift;
      PEOPLE.forEach(function (p) {
        if (!p.self) return;
        if (action === "clock_in" && shift) {
          p.clock = true;
          p.since = "now";
        } else {
          p.clock = false;
          p.since = "—";
        }
      });
      try { renderAll(); } catch (e) {}
      FHData.banner("real", action === "clock_in" ? "clocked in" : "clocked out", "shifts");
      return res;
    });
  };

  function applyMyShift(people) {
    return fetch("/api/shifts", {
      headers: {
        accept: "application/json",
        authorization: "Bearer " + (localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || "")
      }
    }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
      var open = d && d.ok && d.shift;
      people.forEach(function (p) {
        if (!p.self) return;
        p.clock = !!open;
        p.since = open ? "now" : "—";
      });
    }).catch(function () {});
  }

  loadMe().then(function () {
  try {
    var demo = false;
    try { demo = localStorage.getItem("fh_demo") === "1"; } catch (e) {}
    if (!demo && typeof PEOPLE !== "undefined") {
      PEOPLE.length = 0;
      if (typeof renderAll === "function") try { renderAll(); } catch (e) {}
      FHData.banner("sample", "loading roster…", "roster");
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  FHData.wire(FHData.staff({ limit: 200 }), "roster", function (data) {
    var rows = data.items || [];
    function showHidden(n) {
      var el = document.getElementById("hiddenLine");
      if (!el) return;
      var count = Number(n) || 0;
      el.textContent = count === 1
        ? "1 person is hidden from this list (owner and seeded test logins)."
        : count + " people are hidden from this list (owner and seeded test logins).";
    }
    showHidden(data.hiddenCount);
    if (!rows.length) {
      if (typeof PEOPLE !== "undefined") {
        PEOPLE.length = 0;
        if (typeof renderAll === "function") try { renderAll(); } catch (e) {}
      }
      var hidden = Number(data.hiddenCount) || 0;
      return hidden
        ? "no staff on the roster yet · " + hidden + " hidden"
        : "no staff on the roster yet";
    }
    if (typeof PEOPLE === "undefined" || typeof renderAll !== "function") return null;

    var unmapped = [];
    var mapped = rows.map(function (s, i) {
      var name = String(s.name || s.email || "").trim();
      var sp = name.indexOf(" ");
      var role = ROLE_LABEL[s.role];
      if (!role) { role = label(s.role); unmapped.push(role); }
      var email = String(s.email || "").toLowerCase();
      var self = !!(meEmail && email && meEmail === email) || !!(meId && s.id && String(meId) === String(s.id));
      return {
        id: s.id || ("row-" + (i + 1)),
        staffId: s.id || null,
        self: self,
        first: sp > 0 ? name.slice(0, sp) : name,
        last:  sp > 0 ? name.slice(sp + 1) : "",
        code: s.employee_code || "—",
        role: role,
        email: s.email || "",
        phone: s.phone || "—",
        notifyBookedCallSms: s.notify_booked_call_sms === true,
        start: s.start_date ? String(s.start_date).slice(0, 10) : "—",
        active: s.status === "active",
        status: s.status || "",
        consent: (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s, "monitoring_consent_at") ? !!s.monitoring_consent_at : null),
        consentAt: s.monitoring_consent_at ? String(s.monitoring_consent_at).slice(0, 10) : null,
        clock: self ? false : (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s, "open_shift") ? Number(s.open_shift) > 0 : null),
        since: Number(s.open_shift) > 0 ? "now" : "—",
        today: (s.monitor_events_today != null ? (s.monitor_events_today + " mon") : "—"),
        hubstaffUserId: s.hubstaff_user_id || null
      };
    });

    applyMyShift(mapped).then(function () {
      PEOPLE.length = 0;
      Array.prototype.push.apply(PEOPLE, mapped);
      try { renderAll(); fillTeleSelect(); } catch (e) {}
    });
    var selfRow = mapped.filter(function (p) { return p.self; })[0];
    var consented = mapped.filter(function (p) { return p.consent === true; }).length;
    return "live roster · " + rows.length + " staff" +
           (selfRow ? (selfRow.clock ? " · you are clocked in" : " · you are clocked out") : " · signed-in user not on roster") +
           " · consent " + consented + "/" + rows.length +
           (unmapped.length ? " · " + unmapped.length + " role(s) outside the permission matrix" : "");
  });
  });
})();

<script>
/* Full screen so the words can reach the edges. Safari will not drop its
   address bar until a tap, so try on open and again on the first tap.
   Does not touch play, record, or the scroll. */
(function () {
  function enter() {
    var d = document;
    if (d.fullscreenElement || d.webkitFullscreenElement) return null;
    var el = d.documentElement;
    var req = el.requestFullscreen || el.webkitRequestFullscreen || el.webkitRequestFullScreen;
    if (!req) return null;
    try {
      return req.call(el, { navigationUI: "hide" });
    } catch (e) {
      try { return req.call(el); } catch (e2) { return null; }
    }
  }
  function quiet(p) {
    if (p && typeof p.then === "function") p.then(function () {}, function () {});
  }
  function arm() {
    var stop = function () {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", once, true);
      document.removeEventListener("touchstart", once, true);
    };
    function once() {
      quiet(enter());
      stop();
    }
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", once, true);
    document.addEventListener("touchstart", once, true);
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { quiet(enter()); });
  else quiet(enter());
  arm();
})();
</script>

  <div class="field"><label for="r-measure">Line width <span id="v-measure"></span></label><input type="range" id="r-measure" min="12" max="60" step="1"></div>
  <div class="field"><label for="r-line">Reading line <span id="v-line"></span></label><input type="range" id="r-line" min="8" max="60" step="1"></div>
  <div class="field"><label for="r-pause">Extra time on a blank gap <span id="v-pause"></span></label><input type="range" id="r-pause" min="0" max="2.5" step="0.1"></div>
  <p class="note">A blank gap keeps the same speed as the words. This only adds more time. It does not make the gap race.</p>
  <label class="toggle" for="t-mirror">Mirror left to right (beam-splitter glass) <input type="checkbox" id="t-mirror"></label>
  <label class="toggle" for="t-flipv">Flip upside down (some rigs need it) <input type="checkbox" id="t-flipv"></label>
  <label class="toggle" for="t-count">3-2-1 countdown on first play of a script <input type="checkbox" id="t-count"></label>
  <h3>Camera</h3>
  <p class="note" id="cam-now">The front camera is starting.</p>
  <button type="button" class="pill" id="q-4k">4K (3840×2160) — VSLs, thank-you, testimonials</button>
  <button type="button" class="pill" id="q-1080">1080p (1920×1080) — ads</button>
  <p class="note">Ads use 1080p. VSLs, thank-you videos and testimonials use 4K. Every take is 30 fps for now; 60 fps comes with the iPhone app. The saved video is never called faster than it is.</p>
  <h3>Learn remote</h3>
  <p class="note">Tap a slot, then press the button on your remote or foot pedal. It is saved on this device.</p>
  <div class="list" id="learn"></div>
  <button type="button" class="pill" id="b-forget">Clear learned buttons</button>
  <h3>Touch</h3>
  <p class="note">Play moves the words. Tap Play again and the words pause. The camera keeps going. When the words are paused, double-tap a word to change that word. Hold a line to change the whole line.</p>
  <p class="note keys">Keyboard: Space, Enter or Page Down plays and pauses. The arrows change the speed. Page Up restarts the take. At the end of a script, Space is Got it and Page Up is Another take.</p>

<!--
  THE CLIENT SIGNING PAGE.

  IT LIVES AT THE SITE ROOT AND NOT UNDER /app/, AND THAT IS LOAD-BEARING.
  Every file in public/app/ loads shell.js, which requires a CRM session and
  bounces anybody without one. The person opening this page has no session and
  must never be given one — they are a customer, not an employee. So this page
  carries no shell.js, no data.js (which attaches a staff bearer token to every
  request), and no reference to anything under /app/.

  ITS ONLY CREDENTIAL IS THE LINK ITSELF. The contract id, the signer id, the
  expiry and the signature in the address bar are passed straight through to
  /api/contracts/sign, which verifies the HMAC before it looks anything up.

  IT HOLDS NO COPY OF THE DOCUMENT. The words, the file, the boxes, the sentence
  next to the checkbox and the names of the other signers all come from the
  server on load. A page with its own hardcoded paragraph would be a second
  source of truth for the one string that has to be exact.

  TWO KINDS OF DOCUMENT, ONE PAGE. A typed contract renders as text. An uploaded
  PDF renders through pdf.js with this signer's boxes laid over the pages at the
  fractional positions they were placed at. Everything else — the signature
  capture, the refusals, the record afterwards — is identical for both.
-->

<script type="module">
/* pdf.js is VENDORED into this repository (public/vendor/pdfjs) rather than
   loaded from a CDN. There is no build step here — netlify.toml publishes
   public/ as-is — so a committed file is the only way a module reaches the
   browser, and a client signing a contract must not depend on a third-party
   host being up.

   IT IS THE LEGACY 4.x BUILD, DELIBERATELY. pdf.js 6 calls
   Map.prototype.getOrInsertComputed, which is far too new for a great many
   browsers in use today — it threw outright in the Chromium this was tested
   against. The people opening this page are customers on whatever device they
   own, so the widest compatible build is the correct one, not the newest.

   Loaded as a module and handed to the classic script below through a global +
   event, because the rest of this page is deliberately ES5-ish for the same
   compatibility reason. */
import * as pdfjsLib from "/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.min.mjs";
pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = "/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.mjs";
window.__pdfjs = pdfjsLib;
window.dispatchEvent(new Event("pdfjs-ready"));
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
    return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]; }); }

  /* The link's parameters are passed through untouched. This page never
     invents, rewrites or stores them — it is a courier for a credential it does
     not own. */
  var qs = location.search;
  var params = new URLSearchParams(qs);
  var API = "/api/contracts/sign" + qs;
  var FILE_API = "/api/contracts/sign" + qs + (qs ? "&" : "?") + "file=1";

  var state = { contract: null, values: {}, rendered: false };

  function problem(text) {
    $("documentLoading").hidden = true;
    $("title").textContent = "This document could not be opened";
    $("sub").textContent = ""; $("who").innerHTML = "";
    $("problem").style.display = ""; $("problemText").innerHTML = esc(text);
    $("main").style.display = "none"; $("bar").style.display = "none";
    $("waiting").style.display = "none";
  }
  function waiting(text) {
    $("documentLoading").hidden = true;
    $("title").textContent = "Not your turn yet";
    $("sub").innerHTML = '<span class="badge b-warn">waiting</span>';
    $("waiting").style.display = ""; $("waitingText").innerHTML = esc(text);
    $("main").style.display = "none"; $("bar").style.display = "none";
    $("problem").style.display = "none";
  }
  function whenText(iso) {
    if (!iso) return "";
    var d = new Date(iso);
    return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? String(iso) : d.toLocaleString();
  }

  /* Who else is on this document, and where they are up to. Names and states
     only — never their email addresses, and never their links. */
  function renderWho(c) {
    var list = c.signers || [];
    if (list.length < 2) { $("who").innerHTML = ""; return; }
    var turnIdx = -1;
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      if (list[i].status !== "signed" && list[i].status !== "declined") { turnIdx = i; break; }
    }
    $("who").innerHTML = list.map(function (s, i) {
      var cls = s.status === "signed" ? "signed" : (i === turnIdx ? "now" : "");
      var word = s.status === "signed" ? "signed"
        : (s.status === "declined" ? "did not sign" : (i === turnIdx ? "signing now" : "waiting"));
      return '<span class="p ' + cls + '"><span class="d"></span>' + esc(s.name) +
        ' <span style="color:var(--gray2)">· ' + esc(s.role_label) + " · " + word + "</span></span>";
    }).join("");
  }

  /* ── the pages of an uploaded PDF, with this signer's boxes on them ─────── */

  function waitForPdfjs() {
    if (window.__pdfjs) return Promise.resolve(window.__pdfjs);
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var t = setTimeout(function () {
        reject(new Error("The document viewer did not load. Please refresh the page."));
      }, 20000);
      window.addEventListener("pdfjs-ready", function () { clearTimeout(t); resolve(window.__pdfjs); });
    });
  }

  function b64ToBytes(b64) {
    var raw = atob(b64), out = new Uint8Array(raw.length);
    for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) out[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
    return out;
  }

  function renderPdf(c) {
    return waitForPdfjs().then(function (pdfjs) {
      return fetch(FILE_API, { headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (d) {
          if (!d || d.ok !== true || !d.pdf_base64) {
            throw new Error("The document could not be loaded. Please refresh the page.");
          }
          return pdfjs.getDocument({ data: b64ToBytes(d.pdf_base64) }).promise;
        })
        .then(function (doc) {
          $("pages").innerHTML = "";
          $("pages").style.display = "";
          var chain = Promise.resolve();
          for (var n = 1; n <= doc.numPages; n++) {
            (function (page) {
              // Rendered one page after another, not all at once: a long
              // document on a phone runs out of memory doing them in parallel.
              chain = chain.then(function () { return renderPage(doc, page, c); });
            })(n);
          }
          return chain;
        });
    });
  }

  function renderPage(doc, n, c) {
    return doc.getPage(n).then(function (page) {
      /* 1.35 is readable on a laptop and still legible on a phone once the
         canvas is scaled down by max-width. The overlay is positioned in
         PERCENTAGES, so it follows whatever size the canvas ends up being. */
      var vp = page.getViewport({ scale: 1.35 });
      var wrap = document.createElement("div");
      wrap.className = "pagewrap";
      wrap.style.width = vp.width + "px";
      var canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = vp.width; canvas.height = vp.height;
      wrap.appendChild(canvas);
      $("pages").appendChild(wrap);
      return page.render({ canvasContext: canvas.getContext("2d"), viewport: vp }).promise
        .then(function () { overlayFields(wrap, n - 1, c); });
    });
  }

  function overlayFields(wrap, pageIndex, c) {
    (c.fields || []).filter(function (f) { return Number(f.page) === pageIndex; })
      .forEach(function (f) {
        var el = document.createElement("div");
        el.className = "fld" + (f.locked ? " locked" : "") +
          (f.type === "signature" || f.type === "initials" ? " sig" : "") +
          (f.type === "checkbox" ? " chk" : "");
        /* PERCENTAGES, from the same fractions the box was placed at. Nothing
           here converts to pixels, so the box sits in the same place on every
           screen and in the finished PDF. */
        el.style.left = (f.x * 100) + "%";
        el.style.top = (f.y * 100) + "%";
        el.style.width = (f.w * 100) + "%";
        el.style.height = (f.h * 100) + "%";
        el.setAttribute("data-fid", f.id);

        var tag = document.createElement("span");
        tag.className = "tag";
        tag.textContent = f.label + (f.required && !f.locked ? " *" : "");

        if (f.locked) {
          var v = document.createElement("span");
          v.className = "lockval";
          v.textContent = f.value || "";
          el.appendChild(v);
        } else if (f.type === "signature" || f.type === "initials") {
          el.setAttribute("data-sig", "1");
          el.onclick = function () { $("name").focus(); $("name").scrollIntoView({ block: "center" }); };
        } else if (f.type === "checkbox") {
          el.onclick = function () {
            state.values[f.id] = state.values[f.id] === "true" ? "" : "true";
            paintField(el, f); check();
          };
        } else {
          var input = document.createElement("input");
          input.type = "text";
          input.setAttribute("aria-label", f.label + (f.required ? " (required)" : ""));
          input.value = state.values[f.id] || "";
          input.oninput = function () { state.values[f.id] = input.value; paintField(el, f); check(); };
          el.appendChild(input);
        }
        if (!f.locked && (f.type === "signature" || f.type === "initials" || f.type === "checkbox")) {
          el.tabIndex = 0;
          el.setAttribute("role", f.type === "checkbox" ? "checkbox" : "button");
          el.setAttribute("aria-label", f.label + (f.required ? " (required)" : ""));
          el.onkeydown = function (event) {
            if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") { event.preventDefault(); el.click(); }
          };
        }
        el.appendChild(tag);
        wrap.appendChild(el);
        paintField(el, f);
      });
  }

  /* One box's appearance. Signature boxes show the typed name live, so somebody
     sees their signature appear where it will actually print before they commit
     to it — which is the whole reassurance a signing page has to give. */
  function paintField(el, f) {
    var filled, tag = el.querySelector(".tag");
    if (f.locked) {
      filled = true;
    } else if (f.type === "signature" || f.type === "initials") {
      var nm = $("name").value.trim();
      filled = nm.length >= 2;
      el.textContent = filled ? (f.type === "initials" ? initialsOf(nm) : nm) : "";
      if (tag) el.appendChild(tag);
    } else if (f.type === "checkbox") {
      filled = state.values[f.id] === "true";
      el.setAttribute("aria-checked", filled ? "true" : "false");
      el.textContent = filled ? "X" : "";
      if (tag) el.appendChild(tag);
    } else {
      filled = String(state.values[f.id] || "").trim() !== "";
    }
    el.className = el.className.replace(/ done\b/g, "") + (filled ? " done" : "");
  }

  function initialsOf(n) {
    return n.split(/\s+/).map(function (w) { return w.charAt(0) || ""; }).join("").toUpperCase().slice(0, 5);
  }

  function repaintSignatures() {
    var c = state.contract; if (!c) return;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".fld[data-sig]"), function (el) {
      var id = el.getAttribute("data-fid");
      var f = (c.fields || []).filter(function (x) { return x.id === id; })[0];
      if (f) paintField(el, f);
    });
  }

  /* ── what still needs doing ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  function outstanding() {
    var c = state.contract; if (!c) return [];
    return (c.fields || []).filter(function (f) {
      if (f.locked || !f.required) return false;
      // A signature box is filled by typing your name below, not separately.
      if (f.type === "signature" || f.type === "initials") return false;
      if (f.type === "checkbox") return state.values[f.id] !== "true";
      return String(state.values[f.id] || "").trim() === "";
    }).map(function (f) { return f.label; });
  }

  function check() {
    var c = state.contract;
    var nameOk = $("name").value.trim().length >= 2;
    var left = outstanding();
    var ready = Boolean(nameOk && $("agree").checked && left.length === 0 && c && c.can_sign);
    $("go").disabled = !ready;
    $("barGo").disabled = !ready;
    $("todo").innerHTML = left.length
      ? '<span class="badge b-warn">to fill in</span> ' + esc(left.join(", "))
      : (c && (c.fields || []).length
          ? '<span class="badge b-ok">all filled in</span> Everything on the document is complete.'
          : "");
    $("barText").innerHTML = left.length
      ? esc(left.length + (left.length === 1 ? " box" : " boxes") + " still to fill in")
      : (ready ? "Ready to sign." : "Type your name and tick the box to sign.");
    repaintSignatures();
  }

  /* ── render ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  function render(c) {
    $("documentLoading").hidden = true;
    state.contract = c;
    $("main").style.display = "";
    $("problem").style.display = "none";
    $("waiting").style.display = "none";
    $("title").textContent = c.title || "Your document";
    renderWho(c);

    if (c.source_kind === "pdf") {
      if (!state.rendered) {
        state.rendered = true;
        renderPdf(c).catch(function (e) {
          $("pages").innerHTML = '<div class="err">' + esc(e.message ||
            "The document could not be displayed.") + "</div>";
          $("pages").style.display = "";
        });
      }
    } else {
      $("body").style.display = "";
      $("body").textContent = c.body || "";
    }

    var iSigned = c.signer && c.signer.status === "signed";
    if (c.status === "signed" || iSigned) {
      $("signPanel").style.display = "none";
      $("bar").style.display = "none";
      $("donePanel").style.display = "";
      var all = c.status === "signed";
      $("sub").innerHTML = '<span class="badge ' + (all ? "b-ok" : "b-info") + '">' +
        (all ? "signed" : "you have signed") + "</span>";
      $("doneText").textContent = all
        ? "This document is signed. Nothing else is needed from you."
        : "Thank you — your signature is saved. We are waiting for the other people to sign.";
      $("doneRecord").innerHTML = iSigned
        ? "Signed by " + esc(c.signer.signer_name || c.signer.name) + "<br>On " +
          esc(whenText(c.signer.signed_at))
        : "";
      $("dlBtn").style.display = all ? "" : "none";
      return;
    }

    if (c.verified === false) {
      /* The document on screen does not match what was sent. The page says so
         before anybody types their name, rather than letting them fill it in
         and hit a refusal — and it does NOT offer a way to sign anyway. */
      $("signPanel").style.display = "none";
      $("bar").style.display = "none";
      $("sub").innerHTML = '<span class="badge b-alert">cannot be signed</span>';
      $("problem").style.display = "";
      $("problemText").innerHTML =
        "This document does not match the copy that was sent to you, so it " +
        "cannot be signed. Nothing has been agreed and nothing has been charged. " +
        "Please contact the person who sent it to you.";
      return;
    }

    if (!c.can_sign) {
      $("signPanel").style.display = "none";
      $("bar").style.display = "none";
      $("sub").innerHTML = '<span class="badge b-warn">read only</span>';
      return;
    }

    $("sub").innerHTML = '<span class="badge b-info">waiting for your signature</span>' +
      (c.sent_at ? ' <span style="color:var(--gray);font-size:12.5px">· sent ' + esc(whenText(c.sent_at)) + "</span>" : "");
    $("signPanel").style.display = "";
    $("bar").style.display = "";
    $("statement").textContent = c.signature_statement ||
      "I have read this document and I agree to it. Typing my name here is my signature.";
    check();
  }

  /* ── network ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  function load() {
    if (!params.get("id") || !params.get("sig") || !params.get("exp")) {
      problem("This link is incomplete. Please ask whoever sent it for a fresh one.");
      return;
    }
    fetch(API, { headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
      .then(function (r) {
        return r.json().catch(function () { return null; }).then(function (d) { return { r: r, d: d }; });
      })
      .then(function (out) {
        var d = out.d;
        if (out.r.status === 410) {
          problem("This link has expired. Please ask for a new one — nothing has been lost.");
          return;
        }
        if (out.r.status === 404) {
          problem("This link is not valid. Please check you copied the whole thing, " +
                  "or ask whoever sent it for a fresh one.");
          return;
        }
        // Sequential signing: somebody ahead of them has not finished. Not an
        // error — the same link works once it is their turn, and it says so.
        if (out.r.status === 409 && d && d.error === "not_your_turn") {
          waiting(d.message || "Somebody else has to sign this first.");
          return;
        }
        if (!d || d.ok !== true) {
          problem((d && d.message) ||
            "We could not open this document. Please try again in a few minutes.");
          return;
        }
        render(d.contract);
      })
      .catch(function () {
        problem("We could not reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.");
      });
  }

  function sign() {
    $("go").disabled = true; $("barGo").disabled = true;
    $("msg").textContent = "signing…";
    fetch(API, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", accept: "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        signer_name: $("name").value,
        agreed: $("agree").checked,
        field_values: state.values
      })
    })
      .then(function (r) {
        return r.json().catch(function () { return null; }).then(function (d) { return { r: r, d: d }; });
      })
      .then(function (out) {
        var d = out.d;
        if (!d || d.ok !== true) {
          $("msg").innerHTML = '<span class="badge b-alert">not signed</span> ' +
            esc((d && d.message) || "Something went wrong. Please try again.");
          check();
          return;
        }
        $("msg").textContent = "";
        render(d.contract);
        window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      })
      .catch(function () {
        $("msg").innerHTML = '<span class="badge b-alert">not signed</span> ' +
          "We could not reach the server. Nothing was signed. Please try again.";
        check();
      });
  }

  /* Declining is a real answer, recorded with a reason. Without it, somebody who
     will not sign simply never comes back and the contract sits in "waiting"
     forever while staff chase them. */
  function decline() {
    var why = window.prompt(
      "You do not have to sign. Please say why, so the person who sent it knows:");
    if (why == null || !String(why).trim()) return;
    fetch(API, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", accept: "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "decline", reason: why })
    })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        if (!d || d.ok !== true) {
          $("msg").innerHTML = '<span class="badge b-alert">not recorded</span> ' +
            esc((d && d.message) || "Please try again.");
          return;
        }
        $("signPanel").style.display = "none";
        $("bar").style.display = "none";
        $("sub").innerHTML = '<span class="badge b-gray">not signed</span>';
        $("donePanel").style.display = "";
        $("doneText").textContent = d.message;
        $("doneRecord").innerHTML = "";
      })
      .catch(function () {
        $("msg").innerHTML = '<span class="badge b-alert">not recorded</span> ' +
          "We could not reach the server. Please try again.";
      });
  }

  /* A failed download says so (defect 17): it used to return silently, so the
     client believed they had saved a copy they did not have. */
  function download() {
    var btn = $("dlBtn");
    function failed() { btn.textContent = "Download failed — try again"; }
    fetch(FILE_API, { headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) {
        if (!d || d.ok !== true || !d.pdf_base64) return failed();
        var a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = "data:application/pdf;base64," + d.pdf_base64;
        a.download = d.filename || "contract.pdf";
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
        btn.textContent = "Download a copy";
      }, failed);
  }

  $("name").addEventListener("input", check);
  $("agree").addEventListener("change", check);
  $("go").addEventListener("click", sign);
  $("barGo").addEventListener("click", sign);
  $("dlBtn").addEventListener("click", download);
  load();
})();
</script>
</body></html>

      <label class="client-login-label" for="fh-forgot-email">Reset email address</label>
      <input id="fh-forgot-email" type="email" placeholder="Email address" autocomplete="username">
      <button class="btn" id="fh-forgot-go" type="button">Send reset link</button>
      <p class="note" id="fh-forgot-msg"></p>
    </div>

    <!-- THE DEMO SWITCHER MOUNTS HERE, OR IT DOES NOT MOUNT AT ALL.
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         THIS ELEMENT IS EMPTY IN THE SERVED FILE ON PURPOSE, AND MUST STAY EMPTY.

         The previous version of this page carried the nine demo addresses and
         the shared password as a JavaScript literal a few lines below here. That
         is a credential published on a static asset: `curl .../login.html`
         returned the password whether or not DEMO_LOGINS_ENABLED was set on the
         deploy, and it would go on returning it on the day somebody switched
         demo logins off in production, because switching an env var does not
         rewrite an HTML file. The switch worked; the page still gave the
         password away.

         So the roster now comes from GET /api/auth/login (api/auth/login.mjs),
         which reads the switch server-side and answers { enabled:false } —
         no addresses, no password, no roster — when it is off. With the switch
         off this panel does not render, because there is nothing to render it
         from. That is the difference between "hidden" and "absent", and only
         one of them survives View Source.

         Do not put a demo address, a role list or a password back into this
         file. src/http/demo-logins.test.mjs fails if any of them appear here.
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div id="fh-demo-mount"></div>

    <p class="note"><a href="/" style="text-decoration:underline">← Back to fundhub.ai</a></p>
  </div>

<script src="/fh.js"></script>
<script>
/* esc — the same helper every screen in this repo defines (public/app/shell.js
   :esc, and one per app screen). EVERYTHING that reaches innerHTML goes through
   it. The switcher's text arrives over the wire from GET /api/auth/login, and
   "it is our own endpoint" is not a reason to trust it into innerHTML: the day
   a demo account's name is edited in the database to contain a tag, an escaped
   page shows the tag and an unescaped one runs it. */
function esc(v) {
  return String(v == null ? "" : v)
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

/* Which demo role this browser last signed in as. THE MARKER, and the reason it
   lives here rather than in the app.

   The requirement is a visible, permanent marker while signed in as a demo
   account. There already is one and it is inside the app: public/app/shell.js
   :mountChip draws a fixed chip top-right reading `staff.name`, and every demo
   row is named "DEMO Owner", "DEMO Affiliate", "DEMO Client" and so on
   (src/auth/demo-roster.mjs) — so every portal screen says DEMO in the corner
   without shell.js being touched. shell.js and public/app/*.html belong to
   another workflow in this tree and are not edited from here.

   What this key adds is the OTHER half: when he comes back to this page to
   switch, it says which portal he was just in and marks that button, so nine
   sign-ins in a row do not blur together.

   IT IS ONLY BELIEVED ALONGSIDE A TOKEN. shell.js:signOut() clears fh_token but
   knows nothing about this key, so on its own it would outlive the session and
   claim he is signed in as an affiliate an hour after he signed out. No token,
   no claim — and the stale key is dropped. */
var DEMO_ROLE_KEY = "fh_demo_role";

function currentDemoRole() {
  try {
    if (!localStorage.getItem("fh_token")) { localStorage.removeItem(DEMO_ROLE_KEY); return null; }
    return localStorage.getItem(DEMO_ROLE_KEY) || null;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

/* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   signIn — ask the REAL backend, and only fall back to the offline mock when
   there is genuinely no backend to ask.

   TWO BUGS IN public/fh.js MADE THIS NECESSARY, AND BETWEEN THEM THEY ARE WHY
   "I still can't log in" was true even after accounts existed.

   1. DEMO MODE IS STICKY AND NEVER LETS GO. fh.js:109 sets localStorage
      fh_demo="1" the first time the client-side mock answers a login. After
      that fh.js:177 reads `if (isDemo() || path === "/api/auth/login")` and
      then `if (!isDemo())` — so once that flag is set, the real backend is
      NEVER contacted again, for anything, including the next login. The only
      thing that clears it is signing out. A browser that once fell back
      because the API was down is permanently stuck on seven hardcoded
      @fundhub.ai addresses, and no real account — no matter how correctly it
      is seeded — can ever sign in from it. Clearing the flag here, on the one
      page whose entire job is to start a session, is what unsticks it. The
      offline fallback is NOT removed: if the backend really is unreachable,
      the catch below still reaches it, and fh.js sets the flag again.

   2. A REAL REFUSAL IS SWALLOWED AND REPLACED BY A GUESS. fh.js:188 keeps the
      backend's answer only when `data.ok || r.status === 401`. Every other
      refusal — a 403 for a suspended account, a 403 for demo logins being
      switched off, a 429 rate limit — is discarded and the local mock answers
      instead, which for any address it does not recognise says
      "invalid_credentials". So the page told people their password was wrong
      when it was right. Going straight to fetch() here keeps the real answer.

   3. THIS FILE REPEATED BUG (2) FOR STATUS >= 500, AND THAT IS THE ONE THAT
      ACTUALLY BROKE CHRIS'S LOGIN. The line that used to be here —
      `if (data && r.status < 500) return {...}` — meant a genuine 500 WITH A
      REAL, PARSED JSON BODY still fell through to the offline mock below,
      exactly the failure mode (2) already names and fixes for every OTHER
      status code. netlify/functions/api.mjs:501 catches any thrown error
      (a missing GRANT, a database that doesn't exist, anything) and answers a
      clean, scrubbed `{ok:false, error:"internal_error", message:...}` — but
      this function threw that answer away and asked the OFFLINE MOCK instead,
      which does not recognise a real @fundhub.ai address and answers its own
      fabricated "invalid_credentials". The result: any server-side fault,
      including one serious enough to be the actual outage, rendered on screen
      as indistinguishable from a mistyped password. Fixed by returning
      whatever the backend actually said whenever it said anything parseable —
      including 500 — and only falling through to the offline mock when
      fetch() itself could not reach anything at all.
   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
async function signIn(body) {
  // See (1). Do this BEFORE anything else, or FH.api below never leaves the box.
  localStorage.removeItem("fh_demo");
  localStorage.removeItem("fh_demo_staff");

  try {
    const r = await fetch("/api/auth/login", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    let data = null;
    try { data = await r.json(); } catch (e) { data = null; }
    // See (3). ANY parseable JSON body is a real answer from a real backend —
    // status included, 500 included — and is reported as given. Only a body
    // that will not parse at all falls through, because there is nothing
    // useful to show for it.
    if (data) return { ok: r.ok && data.ok === true, status: r.status, data };
  } catch (e) { /* no backend at all — fall through to the offline mock */ }

  return FH.api("/api/auth/login", { method: "POST", body });
}

/* roleFrom — the role key public/app/shell.js gates on, pulled out of whatever
   shape the login reply arrived in.

   A client, affiliate or partner has no staff row — it is a principal from the
   accounts table (db/migrations/044_accounts.sql) and its KIND is the key
   shell.js ROLE_TABS uses for its portal. Without the second and third branches
   those three signed in, cached no role, and the shell held the screen blank
   until the slow path resolved. */
function roleFrom(data) {
  return (data && data.staff && data.staff.role)
    || (data && data.account && data.account.kind)
    || (data && data.principal && data.principal !== "staff" ? data.principal : null);
}

function storeSession(data, demoRole) {
  if (data.token) localStorage.setItem("fh_token", data.token);
  var role = roleFrom(data);
  // Hand the role to /app/shell.js so the first screen is gated before it
  // paints, instead of drawing and then bouncing while the session resolves.
  if (role) localStorage.setItem("fh_role", String(role).trim().toLowerCase());
  else localStorage.removeItem("fh_role");
  // The client portal reads fh_account.clientId. Login already returns that
  // id on data.account; without writing it here the portal paints empty.
  if (data.account) localStorage.setItem("fh_account", JSON.stringify(data.account));
  else localStorage.removeItem("fh_account");
  try {
    if (demoRole) localStorage.setItem(DEMO_ROLE_KEY, demoRole);
    else localStorage.removeItem(DEMO_ROLE_KEY);
  } catch (e) { /* private mode — the marker is cosmetic, the session is not */ }
}

function failureText(status, data) {
  // "demo accounts are switched off" is named rather than folded into the
  // generic 403. The password WAS right; what is missing is an environment
  // variable, and "Account not active — ask an admin" would send whoever hit
  // this to reset a password that was never wrong.
  if (status === 429) return "Too many attempts — wait 15 minutes.";
  if (data && data.error === "demo_logins_disabled") {
    return "Demo logins are switched off on this deploy. Set DEMO_LOGINS_ENABLED=1 and redeploy.";
  }
  if (status === 403) return "Account not active — ask an admin.";
  // A genuine server fault (missing DB grant, wrong database, connection
  // refused — see netlify/functions/api.mjs:501) must never read the same as
  // a mistyped password. It was hitting exactly this branch before signIn()
  // stopped discarding 5xx responses — see (3) above. `message` is
  // safeError()'d server-side (src/http/health.mjs) — never a password, host
  // or DSN, but everything else about the failure survives.
  if (status === 0 || status >= 500 || (data && data.error === "internal_error")) {
    return "Server error, not a wrong password — " +
      ((data && data.message) || "no detail returned") +
      ". Check Netlify function logs for /api/auth/login.";
  }
  return "Wrong email or password.";
}

document.getElementById("f").addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const err = document.getElementById("err"), btn = document.getElementById("go");
  err.style.display = "none"; btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Signing in…";
  const { ok, status, data } = await signIn({
    email: document.getElementById("email").value,
    password: document.getElementById("pw").value
  });
  btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Sign in";
  if (!ok) {
    err.style.display = "block";
    err.textContent = failureText(status, data);
    return;
  }
  storeSession(data, null);   // typed by hand — not a demo switch, clear the marker
  const next = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("next");
  location.href = next && next.startsWith("/") ? next : "/app/";
});

document.getElementById("fh-forgot-link").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  document.getElementById("fh-forgot-box").style.display = "block";
  document.getElementById("fh-forgot-note").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("fh-forgot-email").value = document.getElementById("email").value;
  document.getElementById("fh-forgot-email").focus();
});

document.getElementById("fh-forgot-go").addEventListener("click", async function () {
  const email = document.getElementById("fh-forgot-email").value.trim();
  const msg = document.getElementById("fh-forgot-msg");
  const btn = this;
  if (!email) { msg.textContent = "Enter your email first."; return; }
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Sending…";
  var mailed = false;
  try {
    var r = await fetch("/api/auth/reset", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "request", email: email })
    });
    try {
      var d = await r.json();
      mailed = !!(d && d.mailed);
    } catch (e2) { mailed = false; }
  } catch (e) { mailed = false; }
  btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Send reset link";
  msg.textContent = mailed
    ? "Check that inbox. The reset link lasts 1 hour."
    : "Nothing was sent. Ask an owner or admin for a reset link.";
});

/* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   THE SWITCHER.

   The workflow this is shaped around, in the owner's words: open a portal, look
   at it, say "that's good", switch to the next one. Nine times. Nine sign-out /
   sign-in cycles with nine remembered passwords is enough friction that the
   review stops after two, so a click has to do the whole thing — sign in AND
   arrive on that role's own home screen, not a generic landing page.

   `home` comes from the server, and the server takes it from
   src/auth/demo-roster.mjs, which is asserted against public/app/shell.js's
   HOME map by src/http/demo-logins.test.mjs. That chain matters: shell.js sends
   a role that asks for a screen it may not open back to its home, and a role
   with NO allowed screens straight to signOut() — so a button pointing at the
   wrong screen looks exactly like a broken login. The test is what keeps the
   button and the shell agreeing.
   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
async function loadSwitcher() {
  var mount = document.getElementById("fh-demo-mount");
  if (!mount) return;

  var demo = null;
  try {
    // Cache-busted: this page is a static asset behind a CDN and the answer
    // changes when an env var changes, with no redeploy of the HTML to bust it.
    var r = await fetch("/api/auth/login", { headers: { accept: "application/json" }, cache: "no-store" });
    if (!r.ok) return;                       // 404 (no API deployed) or 5xx — draw nothing
    var body = await r.json();
    demo = body && body.demo;
  } catch (e) { return; }                    // no backend at all — draw nothing

  // THE ONE DECISION, AND THE SERVER MADE IT. Anything other than an explicit
  // `enabled === true` with a roster attached means no panel. Not a disabled
  // panel, not a panel that explains itself — nothing rendered, because with
  // the switch off there is no password and no roster to render.
  if (!demo || demo.enabled !== true || !Array.isArray(demo.logins) || !demo.logins.length) return;

  var current = currentDemoRole();
  var now = current
    ? '<p id="fh-demo-now">Signed in now as <b>' + esc(current) + '</b>. Pick another to switch.</p>'
    : "";

  mount.innerHTML =
    '<div id="fh-demo">' +
      '<h2>Demo portals — one click each</h2>' +
      '<p class="note" style="margin:0">Click a role. It signs in and opens that role\'s own screen.</p>' +
      now +
      '<div id="fh-demo-grid"></div>' +
      '<p class="note" style="margin-top:10px;opacity:.75">' +
        'These are not real people. Every address is on a domain that resolves nowhere and ' +
        'every row is flagged as a demo row. They stop working the moment <b>' +
        esc(demo.envVar || "DEMO_LOGINS_ENABLED") + '</b> is unset on this deploy. ' +
        'Shared password: <b>' + esc(demo.password) + '</b> — you do not need to type it.' +
      '</p>' +
    '</div>';

  var grid = document.getElementById("fh-demo-grid");
  demo.logins.forEach(function (d) {
    var b = document.createElement("button");
    b.type = "button";
    b.className = "fh-demo-btn";
    b.setAttribute("data-role", d.role);
    if (current && d.role === current) b.setAttribute("data-current", "1");
    // "Affiliate — Affiliate Portal": what he is, then what opens. The address
    // is the second line so the button is still self-describing when something
    // goes wrong and he has to tell somebody which account it was.
    b.innerHTML =
      "<b>" + esc(d.label) + " — " + esc(d.portal) + "</b>" +
      "<span>" + esc(d.email) + " → " + esc(d.home) + "</span>";
    b.addEventListener("click", function () { return openAs(d, demo.password, b); });
    grid.appendChild(b);
  });
}

/* openAs — one click: sign in as this role, land on that role's home screen.

   It goes through the SAME signIn() the typed form uses, which is the same
   POST /api/auth/login, which is the same scrypt verifyPassword as every other
   account. There is no bypass here and there must never be one: the button
   knows the password because the server just told it, not because the check is
   skipped. With DEMO_LOGINS_ENABLED unset this function is unreachable (the
   panel never renders) AND would fail anyway (the server refuses demo rows). */
async function openAs(d, password, btn) {
  var err = document.getElementById("err");
  err.style.display = "none";
  var was = btn.innerHTML;
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = "<b>Opening " + esc(d.portal) + "…</b><span>" + esc(d.email) + "</span>";

  var out = await signIn({ email: d.email, password: password });
  if (!out.ok) {
    btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = was;
    err.style.display = "block";
    err.textContent = failureText(out.status, out.data);
    return;
  }
  storeSession(out.data, d.role);
  // Straight to the role's own screen. `home` is server-supplied, so it is
  // checked before it becomes a navigation: a same-origin /app/ path, and
  // nothing else. A value that failed this would be a bug in the roster, but
  // "it came from our own API" is not a reason to hand an unchecked string to
  // location.href.
  location.href = /^\/app\/[a-z0-9-]+\.html$/.test(d.home)
    ? d.home : "/app/";
}

loadSwitcher();
</script>
</body></html>

  .row{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:13px 15px;background:var(--paper)}
  .row .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .row .name{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600}
  .row .meta{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--gray)}
  .row .why{margin-top:8px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.6}
  .row .pair{margin-top:8px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink);
    background:var(--soft);border-radius:7px;padding:9px 11px;line-height:1.7;
    overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  /* The law behind an item. Every finding the engine returns carries `citations`
     (FCRA sections and case law) and `metro2Ref` (the exact reporting field).
     Showing them is the point — it is what tells a person we know the rule that
     was broken, not just that something looks wrong. */
  .law{margin-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:10px}
  .law .h{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--gray)}
  .law ul{margin:7px 0 0;list-style:none}
  .law li{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--ink);padding-left:15px;position:relative;
    overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  .law li::before{content:"§";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--gray2);font-weight:600}
  .law li.field::before{content:"#"}

  .lawbook{margin-top:16px;display:grid;gap:9px}
  .lawbook .item{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;
    background:var(--paper)}
  .lawbook .cite{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  .lawbook .plain{margin-top:6px;font-size:13px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.6}

  .tag{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;
    text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;padding:3px 7px;
    color:var(--gray)}
  .tag.now{border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}

  .steps{margin-top:16px;display:grid;gap:10px}
  .step{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 15px;background:var(--paper)}
  .step.now{border-color:var(--ink)}
  .step .no{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--gray)}
  .step h3{margin-top:6px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}
  .step .when{margin-top:5px;font-size:13px;color:var(--gray)}
  .step ul{margin:9px 0 0 17px}
  .step li{font-size:13px;color:var(--gray);line-height:1.7;overflow-wrap:anywhere}

  .close{max-width:720px;width:calc(100% - 48px);margin:18px auto 0;background:var(--paper);
    border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:24px 22px;

  .close h2{margin-top:13px;font-size:19px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em}
