<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ── THE ONE ESCAPE FUNCTION ──────────────────────────────────────────────
     Every value that reaches innerHTML on this page passes through here. It is
     the same implementation public/contract.html:182 uses. If a second one ever
     appears in this file, one of them will be the weaker one. */
  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c];
    });
  }

  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };

  /* ── WAVE 2'S ENDPOINTS, NAMED IN ONE PLACE ───────────────────────────────
     The read is built to ops/workflows/portal-progress-contract.md by a
     separate lane. The paid-round write is built by a third. Both are named
     here and nowhere else, so if either lane chose a different path this page
     is a one-line change rather than a search.

     If PROGRESS_PATH answers 404 this page says so plainly instead of showing a
     half-empty screen that looks like an empty file. */
  var PROGRESS_PATH     = "/api/read/client-progress";
  /* NOT "/api/paid-services/request". This page was written against the contract
     before the endpoint existed and guessed a sub-path; the endpoint that shipped
     is flat, and netlify/functions/api.mjs explains why — a key with a slash
     would sit under the "documents/" prefix branch, which src/http/routes.test.mjs
     forbids. GET lists the price, POST mints the checkout link. */
  var PAID_REQUEST_PATH = "/api/paid-services";
  var REFERRAL_PATH     = "/api/affiliates/refer";
  var DOWNLOAD_PATH     = "/api/documents-download";

  /* ── THE CREDENTIAL ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     public/portal-login.html:147 stores the client's token here after a magic
     link. Same read as public/app/client-portal.html:2065. A private-mode
     browser can throw on localStorage, so it is wrapped. */
  function token() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem("fh_token") || ""; } catch (e) { return ""; }
  }

  function toLogin() {
    location.href = "/portal-login.html?next=" + encodeURIComponent("/progress.html");
  }

  /* ── WHOSE FILE THIS PAGE IS SHOWING ──────────────────────────────────────

     WHAT WAS BROKEN (walk finding 15, 2026-09-06). This page opened as three
     lines — the header, the back link, and "We could not load your file just
     now. Please refresh in a moment." — and refreshing never helped, because
     nothing about a refresh could.

     The read below is pinned to a CLIENT's session and works for a client. But
     staff and clients share one localStorage key for their token
     (public/login.html:230 and public/portal-login.html:147 both write
     `fh_token`), so a staff member who clicked the link from a client's portal
     arrived here with a STAFF token and no client named. The endpoint cannot
     guess, and answers 400 client_id_required. This page then read that as "the
     read failed" and printed the refresh line, which is the one instruction
     that could not possibly work.

     TWO HALVES TO THE FIX AND THIS IS THE FIRST. client-portal.html now puts
     the id it is already showing on the link for a staff viewer, and this page
     passes it through. THE SERVER STILL DECIDES: it never reads client_id from
     a client principal — a client is pinned to themself and this parameter is
     not consulted at all — and it refuses a staff member whose org does not
     hold that file. Nothing here widens what anybody may see; it names which
     file a staff member is asking about, which is the question that was
     missing. The second half is the error copy at the bottom of this file. */
  function clientIdFromUrl() {
    try {
      var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
      return q.get("client_id") || q.get("id") || "";
    } catch (e) { return ""; }
  }

  function progressPath() {
    var id = clientIdFromUrl();
    return PROGRESS_PATH + (id ? "?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(id) : "");
  }

  /* The way back is the way in. A staff member who arrived with a file open
     should land on that same file's portal, not on an empty one. */
  function paintBackLink() {
    var a = document.querySelector("header .back");
    var id = clientIdFromUrl();
    if (a && id) a.setAttribute("href", "/app/client-portal.html?id=" + encodeURIComponent(id));
  }

  function api(path, options) {
    var init = options || {};
    init.headers = init.headers || {};
    init.headers["accept"] = "application/json";
    var t = token();
    if (t) init.headers["authorization"] = "Bearer " + t;
    if (init.body !== undefined && typeof init.body !== "string") {
      init.headers["content-type"] = "application/json";
      init.body = JSON.stringify(init.body);
    } else if (init.body !== undefined) {
      init.headers["content-type"] = "application/json";
    }
    init.credentials = "same-origin";
    return fetch(path, init).then(function (r) {
      return r.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (body) {
        return { status: r.status, ok: r.ok, body: body || {} };
      });
    });
  }

  /* ── FORMATTERS. Every one of them has to survive null. ───────────────────
     The contract's first rule is that unknown arrives as null and stays
     unknown. A formatter that turns null into "0" or "—" without saying why is
     how a client reads a missing pull as a bad score. */

  var MONTHS = ["January","February","March","April","May","June",
                "July","August","September","October","November","December"];

  function parseDate(iso) {
    if (!iso) return null;
    var d = new Date(iso);
    return isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
  }

  /* ── safeUrl — the second half of the escaping rule ───────────────────────

     esc() protects everything that lands in innerHTML. It does NOT protect a
     value that is ASSIGNED to location.href or put on an <a href>, and this
     page does both with URLs it got back from the API: the signed report link
     from api/documents-download.mjs, and the hosted checkout link from
     api/paid-services.mjs.

     `javascript:` in either one runs script in this document's own origin,
     right next to the fh_token the header above calls the thing being
     protected. So does `data:` and `vbscript:`. An allowlist, not a denylist:
     only http, https and a same-site relative path are ever handed to the
     browser. Anything else returns null and the caller says the link could not
     be opened, which is the honest answer for a link we will not follow.

     Parsed with the URL constructor against this page's own origin so that
     "/x", "  javascript:…" (leading spaces), "JaVaScRiPt:…" and
     "java\tscript:…" all resolve the same way the browser would resolve them,
     rather than being pattern-matched by hand. */
  function safeUrl(u) {
    var raw = String(u == null ? "" : u).trim();
    if (!raw) return null;
    var parsed;
    try { parsed = new URL(raw, window.location.origin); } catch (e) { return null; }
    if (parsed.protocol !== "http:" && parsed.protocol !== "https:") return null;
    return parsed.href;
  }

  /** "3 March 2026", or null. Never today's date as a stand-in. */
  function longDate(iso) {
    var d = parseDate(iso);
    if (!d) return null;
    return d.getUTCDate() + " " + MONTHS[d.getUTCMonth()] + " " + d.getUTCFullYear();
  }

  /** "March" — used for "up 36 since January". Null-safe. */
  function monthName(iso) {
    var d = parseDate(iso);
    return d ? MONTHS[d.getUTCMonth()] : null;
  }

  /* ── ONE DATE PER TIMELINE ROW, AND `at` OWNS IT ──────────────────────────

     THE BUG THIS CLOSES. timeline[].text arrives with a date ALREADY ON THE
     FRONT of it. timelineLine() (src/repair/lens.mjs:206) returns
     `${when} · ${words}` — "Mar 3 · letters mailed to all three bureaus" — and
     it formats `when` in America/Los_Angeles. This page then printed
     longDate(e.at) beside it in UTC. Two dates on every row, and they disagree
     by a day whenever the event is stored near midnight: the endpoint lane
     watched `at` say 2026-03-04T00:00:00.000Z while the same row's text said
     "Mar 3" (contract-deviations.md, "KNOWN DRIFT IN AN EXISTING SHARED
     FUNCTION").

     WHO OWNS THE DATE: `at`. It is the authoritative field — the endpoint lane
     says so in the same handoff — and it is the one this whole page already
     formats everywhere else, so a client sees one date style, not two.

     HOW THE DUPLICATE GOES: the leading "Mon D · " is removed from the words.

     AND IF THE PREFIX IS NOT THERE in the shape we expect, we add NOTHING.
     The string keeps whatever date it carries and this returns no date of its
     own. Same the other way: a row with no usable `at` keeps its text intact.
     Either branch puts exactly one date on the row, which is the property that
     matters — a renderer that guesses wrong must not be able to print two. */
  var TL_DATE_PREFIX = /^[A-Za-z]{3,9}\.?\s+\d{1,2}\s*·\s*/;

  function timelineParts(e) {
    e = e || {};
    var raw = String(e.text == null ? "" : e.text);
    var when = longDate(e.at);
    if (when && TL_DATE_PREFIX.test(raw)) {
      var words = raw.replace(TL_DATE_PREFIX, "");
      if (words) return { when: when, words: words };
    }
    /* No prefix to remove, or removing it would leave nothing to say. The
       string stands alone and this renderer prints no date beside it. */
    return { when: TL_DATE_PREFIX.test(raw) ? null : when, words: raw };
  }

  /** Whole days from now until `iso`. Negative means it has passed. */
  function daysUntil(iso) {
    var d = parseDate(iso);
    if (!d) return null;
    return Math.round((d.getTime() - Date.now()) / 86400000);
  }

  /** Integer cents to "$100" or "$1,234.50". Money is integer cents
      (src/commissions/money.mjs) and is never floated through a division that
      loses a penny on the way to the screen. */
  function money(cents) {
    if (cents == null || isNaN(Number(cents))) return null;
    var n = Math.round(Number(cents));
    var neg = n < 0;
    n = Math.abs(n);
    var whole = String(Math.floor(n / 100)).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
    var part = n % 100;
    return (neg ? "-$" : "$") + whole + (part ? "." + (part < 10 ? "0" : "") + part : "");
  }

  var BUREAU_NAMES = {
    experian: "Experian",
    equifax: "Equifax",
    transunion: "TransUnion",
    experian_business: "Experian Business",
    dun_bradstreet: "Dun & Bradstreet",
    equifax_business: "Equifax Business"
  };
  function bureauName(key) {
    var k = String(key || "").toLowerCase();
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(BUREAU_NAMES, k)) return BUREAU_NAMES[k];
    return k.replace(/_/g, " ") || "Bureau";
  }

  /* ── THE STAGE COPY ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     Mirrors the keys in src/repair/pipeline.mjs REPAIR_STAGES. The words live
     here and not on the server, which is the rule api/read/portal-summary.mjs:20
     already states: the endpoint returns facts, the screen owns the sentence.
     An unknown key falls back rather than rendering the raw key at a client. */
  var STAGE_COPY = {
    intake:            { t: "Your file is being set up",              b: "b-info" },
    awaiting_documents:{ t: "We need a few documents from you",       b: "b-warn" },
    analysis:          { t: "We are reviewing your report",           b: "b-info" },
    letters_generated: { t: "Your next round is being prepared",      b: "b-info" },
    ready_to_send:     { t: "Your next round is ready to go out",     b: "b-info" },
    in_transit:        { t: "Your round is on its way",               b: "b-info" },
    awaiting_response: { t: "Waiting on the bureaus",                 b: "b-info" },
    response_received: { t: "Responses are coming back",              b: "b-ok" },
    round_complete:    { t: "This round is complete",                 b: "b-ok" },
    program_complete:  { t: "Your programme is complete",             b: "b-ok" },
    stalled:           { t: "We are looking into a delay on your file",b: "b-warn" },
    on_hold:           { t: "Your file is on hold",                   b: "b-warn" },
    cancelled:         { t: "This programme was cancelled",           b: "b-gray" }
  };

  /* ── THE ONE THING THIS PAGE MAY NEVER CLAIM ──────────────────────────────
     Rounds 4 and 5 escalate to a federal regulator and a state attorney
     general. src/metro2/letters/catalog.mjs:57-65 records that NOTHING in this
     system knows whether such a complaint was actually submitted — only that a
     letter was produced. So this page describes them as prepared and sent by
     us, and never as lodged, accepted or on record anywhere.

     AND IT MUST NOT IMPLY WORK IS HAPPENING WHEN IT IS NOT. The sentence below
     is written in the present tense — "we prepare them and send them for you" —
     which reads as a promise about this file, right now. On a file the stage
     says is cancelled or on hold, nothing is being prepared and nothing is
     being sent, so the present tense would be a claim the data contradicts.
     Those two stages get their own sentence instead.

     The stage key is the only fact available here. There is no "prepared" flag
     anywhere in the payload — an earlier draft of this page drew a green ticked
     PREPARED chip off `!!stage.key`, which was true for cancelled, on_hold,
     stalled, intake and awaiting_documents alike. That chip is gone and does
     not come back without a field that actually means prepared. */
  var ROUND_NOTE_STOPPED = { cancelled: "cancelled", on_hold: "on hold" };

  function roundNote(round, stageKey) {
    var n = Number(round);
    if (!(n >= 4)) return null;
    var stopped = ROUND_NOTE_STOPPED[String(stageKey || "")];
    if (stopped) {
      return "Rounds 4 and above are escalation letters. Your file is " + stopped
           + ", so none are being prepared or sent right now. "
           + "Nothing has been reported as received or accepted by anyone.";
    }
    return "Rounds 4 and above are escalation letters. We prepare them and send them for you. "
         + "We do not report them as received or accepted by anyone until we hear back.";
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     1. WHERE AM I
     ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function paintStage(stage) {
    var el = $("cStage");
    if (!stage) {
      el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">We do not have a stage on your file yet.</div>';
      return;
    }
    var copy = STAGE_COPY[String(stage.key || "")] || { t: "In progress", b: "b-gray" };
    var cur = stage.roundCurrent == null ? null : Number(stage.roundCurrent);
    var cap = stage.roundCap == null ? null : Number(stage.roundCap);

    var bits = [];
    if (cur != null && cap != null) bits.push("Round " + esc(cur) + " of " + esc(cap) + ".");
    else if (cur != null)           bits.push("Round " + esc(cur) + ".");

    var entered = longDate(stage.enteredAt);
    if (entered) bits.push("Started " + esc(entered) + ".");

    var due = longDate(stage.expectedResponseBy);
    if (due) {
      var left = daysUntil(stage.expectedResponseBy);
      if (left != null && left < 0) {
        bits.push("The bureaus had until " + esc(due) + ".");
      } else if (left != null) {
        bits.push("The bureaus have until " + esc(due) + ".");
      } else {
        bits.push("Expected by " + esc(due) + ".");
      }
    }

    var waiting = stage.waitingOn ? String(stage.waitingOn) : null;
    var waitLine = waiting
      ? (waiting === "client" ? "Waiting on you." : "Waiting on " + esc(waiting) + ".")
      : null;

    var html = '<span class="badge ' + copy.b + '">' + esc(String(stage.key || "in progress").replace(/_/g, " ")) + '</span>'
             + '<div class="stage-h">' + esc(copy.t) + '</div>'
             + '<div class="stage-l">' + (bits.length ? bits.join(" ") : "We will update this as your file moves.") + '</div>';

    if (cur != null && cap != null && cap > 0) {
      var pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((cur / cap) * 100)));
      html += '<div class="meter"><i style="width:' + pct + '%"></i></div>'
            + '<div class="stage-l mono" style="font-size:11px">' + esc(cur) + ' / ' + esc(cap) + ' rounds</div>';
    }
    if (waitLine) html += '<div class="stage-l" style="margin-top:10px">' + waitLine + '</div>';

    var note = roundNote(cur, stage.key);
    if (note) html += '<div class="note">' + esc(note) + '</div>';

    el.innerHTML = html;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     2A. THE SCORE PANELS
     Three personal bureaus, then business credit. Owner-set: business is an
     ARRAY and the panel TOGGLES between businesses, so a blended number is
     never rendered — there is no code path here that averages them.
     ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  var businessIndex = 0;   // which business the business panel is showing

  /** A score, or the honest absence of one. Never 0 for "no pull".
      A score off a sample report was never pulled, so its date says the sample
      was loaded, not pulled (live hole 23). */
  function scoreCell(score, pulledAt, sample) {
    if (score == null) {
      return { html: '<div class="val unk">Not pulled yet</div>', unknown: true };
    }
    var when = longDate(pulledAt);
    return {
      html: '<div class="val">' + esc(Number(score)) + '</div>'
          + (when ? '<div class="when">' + (sample ? "Sample report loaded " : "Pulled ") + esc(when) + '</div>' : ''),
      unknown: false
    };
  }

  function panelHtml(label, score, pulledAt, docId, extra, sample) {
    var cell = scoreCell(score, pulledAt, sample === true);
    var openable = !!docId;
    return '<button class="panel" type="button"'
         + (openable ? ' data-doc="' + esc(docId) + '"' : ' disabled')
         + '>'
         + '<div class="bu">' + esc(label) + '</div>'
         + cell.html
         + (extra || "")
         + '<div class="open">' + (openable
              ? "Tap to open this report"
              : (cell.unknown ? "No report on file yet" : "Report not saved yet")) + '</div>'
         + '</button>';
  }

  function paintScores(scores) {
    var el = $("cScores");
    scores = scores || {};
    var personal = Array.isArray(scores.personal) ? scores.personal : [];
    var business = Array.isArray(scores.business) ? scores.business : [];

    var html = "";

    if (personal.length) {
      html += '<div class="panels">';
      var anySample = false;
      for (var i = 0; i < personal.length; i++) {
        var p = personal[i] || {};
        if (p.sample === true && p.score != null) anySample = true;
        html += panelHtml(bureauName(p.bureau), p.score, p.pulledAt, p.reportDocumentId, "", p.sample);
      }
      html += '</div>';
      /* Sample scores say they are a sample (live hole 23). Only a true from
         the server shows it, so a real pull is never labelled. */
      if (anySample) html += '<div class="note">Sample scores. Not a real credit pull.</div>';
    } else {
      html += '<div class="card empty">Your personal report has not been pulled yet.</div>';
    }

    /* THE BUSINESS PANEL. One business at a time, chosen by the toggle. With a
       single business there is nothing to toggle and the row is left out. With
       none, the panel says so — an absent business file is not a zero. */
    html += '<h2 class="sec">Business credit</h2>';
    if (!business.length) {
      html += '<div class="card empty">No business file on record yet.</div>';
    } else {
      if (business.length > 1) {
        html += '<div class="toggle" id="bizToggle">';
        for (var b = 0; b < business.length; b++) {
          var nm = business[b] && business[b].name ? business[b].name : "Business " + (b + 1);
          html += '<button type="button" data-biz="' + b + '" aria-pressed="'
                + (b === businessIndex ? "true" : "false") + '">' + esc(nm) + '</button>';
        }
        html += '</div>';
      }
      if (businessIndex >= business.length) businessIndex = 0;
      var bz = business[businessIndex] || {};
      html += '<div class="panels">'
            + panelHtml(bureauName(bz.bureau) || "Business credit", bz.score, bz.pulledAt, bz.reportDocumentId,
                '<div class="when">' + esc(bz.name || "This business") + '</div>')
            + '</div>';
    }

    el.innerHTML = html;

    var tog = $("bizToggle");
    if (tog) {
      tog.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
        var btn = ev.target.closest("button[data-biz]");
        if (!btn) return;
        businessIndex = Number(btn.getAttribute("data-biz")) || 0;
        paintScores(scores);
      });
    }
    /* BOUND ONCE. paintScores() re-runs on every business toggle, so binding
       here unguarded stacked one more listener per tap and the third press on a
       panel fired three signed-link requests. */
    if (!el.dataset.bound) { el.addEventListener("click", onPanelClick); el.dataset.bound = "1"; }
  }

  /* TAPPING A PANEL OPENS THAT BUREAU'S REPORT — the deliverable already saved
     as a document. This mints a fresh signed link through the endpoint that
     exists for exactly this (api/documents-download.mjs), then opens it. It is
     NOT a second report renderer: nothing here reads or draws report content.
     A client principal is pinned to their own documents inside that endpoint
     (api/documents-download.mjs:133-139), so a wrong id gets a 404, not a
     stranger's credit report. */
  var panelBusy = false;
  function onPanelClick(ev) {
    var btn = ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest(".panel[data-doc]") : null;
    if (!btn || panelBusy) return;
    var id = btn.getAttribute("data-doc");
    if (!id) return;
    panelBusy = true;
    /* Opened synchronously, before the await, or the browser blocks it as a
       pop-up: a window.open that is not inside the click's own task is not a
       user gesture any more. */
    var w = window.open("", "_blank");
    api(DOWNLOAD_PATH + "?id=" + encodeURIComponent(id)).then(function (r) {
      panelBusy = false;
      var d = r.body && r.body.document;
      /* safeUrl(), not the raw reply. A link we will not follow is treated
         exactly like a link that is not there — see safeUrl() above. */
      var link = safeUrl(d && d.download && (d.download.url || d.download.path));
      if (r.status === 401) { if (w) w.close(); return toLogin(); }
      if (!link) {
        if (w) w.close();
        return dialog({
          title: "That report could not be opened",
          sub: r.status === 404
            ? "We do not have that report saved on your file yet."
            : "Something went wrong opening it. Please try again in a moment.",
          actions: [{ label: "Close", ghost: true }]
        });
      }
      if (w) w.location.href = link; else location.href = link;
    }, function () {
      panelBusy = false;
      if (w) w.close();
    });
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     2B. WHAT MOVED
     ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function paintMovement(movement) {
    var el = $("cMove");
    var m = movement || {};
    var lines = [];

    var removed = m.itemsRemoved == null ? null : Number(m.itemsRemoved);
    var disputed = m.itemsDisputed == null ? null : Number(m.itemsDisputed);

    if (removed != null) {
      lines.push(removed === 0
        ? "<b>Nothing has come off yet.</b> That is normal early on."
        : "<b>" + esc(removed) + (removed === 1 ? " item is gone" : " items are gone") + "</b> from your report.");
    }
    if (disputed != null && disputed > 0) {
      lines.push("We have challenged <b>" + esc(disputed) + (disputed === 1 ? " item" : " items") + "</b> so far.");
    }

    /* THE MIDDLE SCORE. Only stated as a change when BOTH ends are real
       numbers. A missing baseline is not treated as zero, which would print a
       600-point rise on somebody's first month. */
    var now = m.middleScoreNow == null ? null : Number(m.middleScoreNow);
    var base = m.middleScoreBaseline == null ? null : Number(m.middleScoreBaseline);
    if (now != null && base != null) {
      var delta = now - base;
      var since = monthName(m.baselineAt);
      if (delta > 0) {
        lines.push("Your middle score is <b>up " + esc(delta) + "</b>"
                 + (since ? " since " + esc(since) : "") + ", now <b>" + esc(now) + "</b>.");
      } else if (delta < 0) {
        lines.push("Your middle score is <b>down " + esc(Math.abs(delta)) + "</b>"
                 + (since ? " since " + esc(since) : "") + ", now <b>" + esc(now) + "</b>.");
      } else {
        lines.push("Your middle score is unchanged at <b>" + esc(now) + "</b>"
                 + (since ? " since " + esc(since) : "") + ".");
      }
    } else if (now != null) {
      lines.push("Your middle score is <b>" + esc(now) + "</b>. We do not have an earlier one to compare it with yet.");
    }

    var html = lines.length
      ? '<div class="moveline">' + lines.join("<br>") + '</div>'
      : '<div class="empty">Nothing has changed on your file yet. We will show movement here as soon as there is some.</div>';

    html += seriesChart(Array.isArray(m.series) ? m.series : []);
    el.innerHTML = html;
  }

  /* THE SCORE CHART. A hand-written SVG polyline per bureau, no library.
     A null in the series is a GAP, not a zero — the line breaks and resumes.
     src/retention/classes.mjs:147 tombstones stored results after a retention
     window, so the far end of the series is legitimately allowed to be empty
     and must not be drawn as a crash to the floor. */
  var SERIES_BUREAUS = [
    { key: "experian",   label: "Experian",   colour: "#A9C6E8" },
    { key: "equifax",    label: "Equifax",    colour: "#A8D8B0" },
    { key: "transunion", label: "TransUnion", colour: "#C4B3E5" }
  ];

  function seriesChart(series) {
    var points = series.filter(function (p) { return p && p.at; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return new Date(a.at) - new Date(b.at); });
    if (points.length < 2) return "";

    var vals = [];
    points.forEach(function (p) {
      SERIES_BUREAUS.forEach(function (b) {
        if (p[b.key] != null && !isNaN(Number(p[b.key]))) vals.push(Number(p[b.key]));
      });
    });
    if (vals.length < 2) return "";

    var lo = Math.min.apply(null, vals), hi = Math.max.apply(null, vals);
    if (hi === lo) { hi = lo + 1; }
    var pad = Math.max(8, Math.round((hi - lo) * 0.15));
    lo -= pad; hi += pad;

    var W = 100, H = 100;                       // viewBox units, scaled by CSS
    var x = function (i) { return points.length === 1 ? 0 : (i / (points.length - 1)) * W; };
    var y = function (v) { return H - ((v - lo) / (hi - lo)) * H; };

    var paths = "";
    SERIES_BUREAUS.forEach(function (b) {
      var run = [], segs = [];
      points.forEach(function (p, i) {
        var v = p[b.key];
        if (v == null || isNaN(Number(v))) { if (run.length > 1) segs.push(run); run = []; return; }
        run.push(x(i).toFixed(2) + "," + y(Number(v)).toFixed(2));
      });
      if (run.length > 1) segs.push(run);
      segs.forEach(function (s) {
        paths += '<polyline fill="none" stroke="' + b.colour + '" stroke-width="1.6"'
               + ' stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"'
               + ' points="' + s.join(" ") + '"></polyline>';
      });
      points.forEach(function (p, i) {
        var v = p[b.key];
        if (v == null || isNaN(Number(v))) return;
        paths += '<circle cx="' + x(i).toFixed(2) + '" cy="' + y(Number(v)).toFixed(2)
               + '" r="1.6" fill="' + b.colour + '" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"></circle>';
      });
    });

    var legend = SERIES_BUREAUS.map(function (b) {
      return '<span><i style="background:' + b.colour + '"></i>' + esc(b.label) + '</span>';
    }).join("");

    var first = longDate(points[0].at), last = longDate(points[points.length - 1].at);

    return '<div class="chart">'
         + '<svg viewBox="0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H + '" preserveAspectRatio="none" role="img"'
         + ' aria-label="Your scores over time">' + paths + '</svg>'
         + '<div class="lg">' + legend
         + (first && last ? '<span class="mono" style="margin-left:auto">' + esc(first) + ' → ' + esc(last) + '</span>' : '')
         + '</div></div>';
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     3. WHAT IS NEXT, AND WHOSE JOB IS IT
     Exactly one item. Never a list — the contract says nextStep names ONE
     waypoint, and a screen that shows three is a screen that answers nothing.
     ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function paintNext(next, waypoints) {
    var el = $("cNext");
    if (!next || !next.waypointId) {
      el.innerHTML = '<div class="who"><span class="badge b-gray">nothing due</span></div>'
                   + '<div class="t">There is nothing for you to do right now.</div>'
                   + '<div class="d">We will let you know the moment that changes.</div>';
      return;
    }
    var wp = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < waypoints.length; i++) {
      if (String(waypoints[i].id) === String(next.waypointId)) { wp = waypoints[i]; break; }
    }
    var mine = String(next.owner || (wp && wp.owner) || "") === "client";
    var title = wp && wp.title ? wp.title : (mine ? "One thing needs you" : "We are working on your file");

    var d = [];
    if (wp && wp.dueAt) {
      var days = daysUntil(wp.dueAt);
      if (wp.overdue || (days != null && days < 0)) {
        d.push("This was due " + esc(longDate(wp.dueAt)) + ".");
      } else if (days === 0) {
        d.push("Due today.");
      } else if (days != null) {
        d.push("Due " + esc(longDate(wp.dueAt)) + " — " + esc(days) + (days === 1 ? " day" : " days") + " from now.");
      }
    }
    if (mine) d.push("This one is yours. Nothing moves until it is done.");
    else d.push("This one is ours. You do not need to do anything.");

    var html = '<div class="who"><span class="badge ' + (mine ? "b-warn" : "b-info") + '">'
             + (mine ? "your move" : "our move") + '</span>'
             + (wp && wp.overdue ? ' <span class="badge b-alert">overdue</span>' : '')
             + '</div>'
             + '<div class="t">' + esc(title) + '</div>'
             + '<div class="d">' + d.join(" ") + '</div>';

    if (wp && wp.paidAlternative && wp.paidAlternative.priceCents != null) {
      html += '<div class="alt" style="margin-top:14px">' + paidAltButton(wp) + '</div>';
    }
    el.innerHTML = html;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     4. THE CHECKLIST AND ITS PAID ALTERNATIVES
     Each row says whose job it is and, where one exists, what it costs to hand
     it to us instead. That pairing is the product.
     ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function paidAltButton(wp) {
    var price = money(wp.paidAlternative.priceCents);
    if (price == null) return "";
    return '<button class="btn ghost sm" type="button" data-alt="' + esc(wp.id) + '">'
         + 'Have us do it — ' + esc(price) + '</button>';
  }

  var OWNER_BADGE = {
    client: { label: "you", cls: "b-warn" },
    fundhub: { label: "us", cls: "b-info" },
    staff:   { label: "us", cls: "b-info" },
    bureau:  { label: "the bureaus", cls: "b-gray" }
  };

  function waypointCard(wp) {
    var done = String(wp.state || "") === "done" || !!wp.completedAt;
    var ownerKey = String(wp.owner || "").toLowerCase();
    var badge = OWNER_BADGE[ownerKey] || { label: esc(ownerKey || "us"), cls: "b-gray" };

    var meta = ['<span class="badge ' + badge.cls + '">' + esc(badge.label) + '</span>'];
    if (done && wp.completedAt) meta.push('<span>Done ' + esc(longDate(wp.completedAt)) + '</span>');
    else if (wp.overdue && wp.dueAt) meta.push('<span class="badge b-alert">overdue</span><span>was due ' + esc(longDate(wp.dueAt)) + '</span>');
    else if (wp.dueAt) meta.push('<span>due ' + esc(longDate(wp.dueAt)) + '</span>');
    if (!done && String(wp.state || "") === "blocked") meta.push('<span class="badge b-gray">waiting on something else</span>');

    /* A null paidAlternative means there is NO paid option for this item. It is
       left out entirely. It must never render as "free" — that would be this
       page inventing a price of zero for something we do not sell. */
    var alt = (!done && wp.paidAlternative && wp.paidAlternative.priceCents != null)
      ? '<div class="alt">' + paidAltButton(wp) + '</div>' : '';

    /* HOW THE STEP CLOSES decides whether there is a box. The server sends
       `closedBy` and api/waypoint-tick.mjs enforces the same rule, so a box
       that is not drawn here would be refused there anyway.
         client        — a real checkbox; the client ticks it and can untick it.
         credit_report — no box. It closes itself on the next credit report,
                         and the row says so, so nobody wonders where it went.
         ongoing       — no box. A rule to keep, never a task to finish. */
    var how = String(wp.closedBy || "");
    var title = esc(wp.title || "Step " + esc(wp.order));
    var tick;
    if (how === "client") {
      tick = '<button type="button" class="tickbtn" role="checkbox" data-tick="' + esc(wp.id) + '"'
           + ' aria-checked="' + (done ? "true" : "false") + '"'
           + ' aria-label="' + (done ? "Mark not done: " : "Mark done: ") + esc(wp.title || "") + '">'
           + '<span class="tick">' + (done ? "✓" : "") + '</span></button>';
    } else {
      tick = '<div class="tick">' + (done ? "✓" : "") + '</div>';
    }
    var note = "";
    if (!done && how === "credit_report") {
      note = '<div class="how">This closes itself when your next credit report shows the new balance.</div>';
    } else if (how === "ongoing") {
      note = '<div class="how">A rule to keep while we work on your file. Nothing to tick.</div>';
    }

    /* Proof-to-clear (Capital Blueprint): an open step the server closes when a
       client_upload of subtype dispute_mail_receipt exists. Same upload call as
       the portal's doors (api/documents-upload.mjs). */
    var proof = (!done && String(wp.verifyKind || "") === "dispute_mail_receipt")
      ? '<div class="proof"><button type="button" class="pbtn" data-proof="' + esc(wp.id) + '">Upload your mailing proof</button>'
        + '<input type="file" data-proof-file="' + esc(wp.id) + '" hidden accept=".pdf,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.heic">'
        + '<div class="pmsg" data-proof-msg="' + esc(wp.id) + '" role="status">Photo or PDF of your post office receipt or the stamped envelopes.</div></div>'
      : '';

    return '<div class="wp' + (done ? " done" : "") + '" data-wp="' + esc(wp.id) + '">'
         + tick
         + '<div class="bd"><div class="ti">' + title + '</div>'
         + '<div class="mt">' + meta.join("") + '</div>' + note + proof + alt + '</div></div>';
  }

  /* The same choice src/progress/read.mjs nextStepOf() makes on the server:
     the client's first open step in list order, else the first open step. Run
     here after a tick so the "what is next" card does not keep naming a step
     the client just finished. */
  var OPEN_STATES = { not_started: 1, in_progress: 1, blocked: 1 };
  function nextFrom(waypoints) {
    var open = waypoints.filter(function (w) { return OPEN_STATES[String(w.state || "")]; });
    var mine = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < open.length; i++) if (open[i].owner === "client") { mine = open[i]; break; }
    var chosen = mine || open[0] || null;
    return chosen ? { waypointId: chosen.id, owner: chosen.owner } : null;
  }

  var TICK_PATH = "/api/waypoint-tick";

  function tickWaypoint(btn, waypoints) {
    if (btn.getAttribute("aria-busy") === "true") return;
    var id = btn.getAttribute("data-tick");
    var wp = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < waypoints.length; i++) if (String(waypoints[i].id) === String(id)) { wp = waypoints[i]; break; }
    if (!wp) return;
    var row = btn.closest(".wp");
    var old = row && row.querySelector(".terr");
    if (old) old.parentNode.removeChild(old);

    var want = String(wp.state || "") !== "done";
    btn.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
    api(TICK_PATH, { method: "POST", body: { waypoint_id: wp.id, done: want } }).then(function (r) {
      if (r.status === 401) return toLogin();
      if (!r.ok || !r.body || r.body.ok === false) {
        btn.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
        var msg = (r.body && r.body.message) ? r.body.message
                : "That did not save. Nothing changed. Please try again in a moment.";
        var bd = row && row.querySelector(".bd");
        if (bd) bd.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", '<div class="terr" role="alert">' + esc(msg) + '</div>');
        return;
      }
      var w = r.body.waypoint || {};
      wp.state = w.state || (want ? "done" : "not_started");
      wp.completedAt = w.completedAt || null;
      if (wp.state === "done") wp.overdue = false;
      if (row) {
        row.insertAdjacentHTML("afterend", waypointCard(wp));
        var fresh = row.nextElementSibling;
        row.parentNode.removeChild(row);
        var nb = fresh && fresh.querySelector("button[data-tick]");
        if (nb) nb.focus();
      }
      paintNext(nextFrom(waypoints), waypoints);
    }, function () {
      btn.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
      var bd = row && row.querySelector(".bd");
      if (bd) bd.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",
        '<div class="terr" role="alert">We could not reach the server. Nothing changed. Check your connection and try again.</div>');
    });
  }

  /* Sends the mailing-proof file. The server (api/documents-upload.mjs) pins a
     client to their own file; staff must name it, so client_id rides along from
     the URL the same way the read does. The step closes on the server, not here:
     we never tick it ourselves — the box only says the file was received. */
  function uploadProof(wpId, input) {
    var btn = document.querySelector('button[data-proof="' + wpId + '"]');
    var msg = document.querySelector('[data-proof-msg="' + wpId + '"]');
    var file = input.files[0];
    input.value = "";
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    if (msg) msg.textContent = "Sending…";
    var form = new FormData();
    var id = clientIdFromUrl();
    if (id) form.append("client_id", id);
    form.append("kind", "client_upload");
    form.append("subtype", "dispute_mail_receipt");
    form.append("file", file, file.name);
    var headers = { accept: "application/json" };
    var t = token();
    if (t) headers.authorization = "Bearer " + t;
    fetch("/api/documents-upload", { method: "POST", headers: headers, body: form, credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (r) {
        if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
        if (r.ok) {
          if (msg) msg.textContent = "Got it. Thank you. This step closes once we have looked at it.";
          if (btn) btn.textContent = "Send another file";
        } else if (msg) {
          msg.textContent = "That did not send. Try again, or tell us in the chat on your portal.";
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
        if (msg) msg.textContent = "That did not send. Check your connection and try again.";
      });
  }

  function paintWaypoints(waypoints) {
    var el = $("cWaypoints");
    if (!waypoints.length) {
      /* HOLE 19 (live, 2026-09-18). This used to promise a checklist once the
         file was looked over. Nothing builds one on review. Only
         two things do: buying the Capital Blueprint (src/waypoints/purchase.mjs)
         and enrolling in a program (src/repair/enroll.mjs). A Capital Academy
         buyer was promised a list that would never come. */
      el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">There is no checklist on your file right now. '
                   + 'Some of our services come with a list of steps for you to do. '
                   + 'If yours does, the steps show up here. '
                   + 'If you think you should have a list, say so in the chat on your portal.</div>';
      return;
    }
    var sorted = waypoints.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      return (Number(a.order) || 0) - (Number(b.order) || 0);
    });
    el.innerHTML = sorted.map(waypointCard).join("");
    el.addEventListener("change", function (ev) {
      var fi = ev.target && ev.target.getAttribute ? ev.target.getAttribute("data-proof-file") : null;
      if (fi && ev.target.files && ev.target.files.length) uploadProof(fi, ev.target);
    });
    el.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
      var pb = ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest("button[data-proof]") : null;
      if (pb) {
        var inp = el.querySelector('input[data-proof-file="' + pb.getAttribute("data-proof") + '"]');
        if (inp) inp.click();
        return;
      }
      var tb = ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest("button[data-tick]") : null;
      if (tb) return tickWaypoint(tb, waypoints);
      var btn = ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest("button[data-alt]") : null;
      if (!btn) return;
      var id = btn.getAttribute("data-alt");
      for (var i = 0; i < waypoints.length; i++) {
        if (String(waypoints[i].id) === String(id)) return openPaidFlow(waypoints[i]);
      }
    });
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     5. THE ROUND BUTTON
     Press → the price broken out → a second, explicit confirmation → a HOSTED
     CHECKOUT LINK.

     TWO INVARIANTS ARE VISIBLE ON THIS SCREEN, NOT JUST HONOURED BY IT:

     NO SILENT CARD CAPTURE. Nothing in this repo can charge a stored card
     (src/subscriptions/charger.mjs:25, :88). This flow therefore ends at a
     link the client opens and pays on. There is no code path here that submits
     a payment, and the confirm copy says so in plain words.

     PAYMENT STAGES THE MAIL. A HUMAN SENDS IT. src/metro2/delivery/send.mjs:3
     and api/repair/send.mjs:3 both forbid mailing from payment.received, in
     those words. So the confirm step promises staging, never posting, and the
     success copy repeats it. A screen that said "your letters are in the post"
     the second a payment cleared would be describing a thing this system
     deliberately does not do.
     ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  var PAID = null;          // paidServices entry for the round, if offered
  var chosen = {};          // component key → boolean
  /* Which checklist item this purchase came from, or null when it was pressed on
     the round card itself. Passed to the endpoint so the request is tied to the
     item it settles — without it a paid round and the waypoint it was bought to
     satisfy are two rows nothing joins. */
  var paidWaypointId = null;

  function paintPaidServices(paidServices, stage) {
    var el = $("cPaid");
    PAID = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < paidServices.length; i++) {
      if (String(paidServices[i].serviceKey || "") === "paid_round") { PAID = paidServices[i]; break; }
    }
    if (!PAID) { el.innerHTML = ""; return; }

    var comps = Array.isArray(PAID.components) ? PAID.components : [];
    comps.forEach(function (c) {
      if (chosen[c.key] === undefined) chosen[c.key] = !!c.required;
    });

    var html = '<h2 class="sec">Run a round now</h2><div class="card">';

    if (PAID.inFlight) {
      html += '<div class="stage-h">You already have one in progress</div>'
            + '<div class="stage-l">We are working on the round you asked for. '
            + 'When it is done this button comes back.</div>';
      el.innerHTML = html + '</div>';
      /* UNLESS SHE HAS NOT PAID FOR IT YET, in which case that sentence is a
         dead end and the round never comes — the work starts when the payment
         lands. GAP 11, live walk 2026-09-16. The read this page loaded with says
         only inFlight true/false, so the status and the link she already has are
         asked for separately, once, and only when there is something in flight.
         A failed ask, any other status, or a link that has lapsed all leave the
         wording above exactly as it is. */
      loadPaidResume(function (resume) {
        if (!resume) return;
        el.innerHTML = '<h2 class="sec">Run a round now</h2><div class="card">'
          + '<div class="stage-h">Your round is waiting on payment</div>'
          + '<div class="stage-l">We have your round ready to start. '
          + 'It begins as soon as the payment lands. '
          + 'Your payment page is still open — nothing new is set up and '
          + '<b>you are not charged until you do it there.</b></div>'
          + '<div style="margin-top:16px"><a class="btn" href="' + esc(resume.url)
          + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Take me to payment</a></div>'
          + '</div>';
      });
      return;
    }
    if (PAID.available === false) {
      html += '<div class="stage-h">Not available on your file right now</div>'
            + '<div class="stage-l">This opens up when your file is ready for the next round.</div>';
      el.innerHTML = html + '</div>';
      return;
    }

    html += '<div class="stage-l">Do not want to wait for the next scheduled round? '
          + 'You can run one now. Pick what you want included.</div>';

    comps.forEach(function (c) {
      var price = money(c.priceCents);
      html += '<div class="opt">'
            + '<input type="checkbox" id="opt-' + esc(c.key) + '" data-opt="' + esc(c.key) + '"'
            + (chosen[c.key] ? ' checked' : '') + (c.required ? ' disabled' : '') + '>'
            + '<label class="ol" for="opt-' + esc(c.key) + '">' + esc(c.label || c.key)
            + (c.required ? ' <span class="badge b-gray">always included</span>' : '') + '</label>'
            + '<div class="op">' + esc(price == null ? "price unavailable" : price) + '</div>'
            + '</div>';
    });

    html += '<div class="rows"><div class="row total"><span>Total today</span>'
          + '<span class="mono" id="paidTotal">' + esc(money(totalCents()) || "—") + '</span></div></div>'
          + '<div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn" type="button" id="paidGo">Continue</button></div>'
          + '<div class="note"><b>This does not use one of your included rounds.</b> '
          + 'The rounds in your programme stay exactly as they are.</div>'
          + '<div class="note">We take payment on a secure checkout page. '
          + '<b>We never store your card and we never charge you without you doing this again.</b></div>'
          + '</div>';

    el.innerHTML = html;

    el.addEventListener("change", function (ev) {
      var box = ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest("input[data-opt]") : null;
      if (!box) return;
      chosen[box.getAttribute("data-opt")] = !!box.checked;
      var t = $("paidTotal");
      if (t) t.textContent = money(totalCents()) || "—";
    });
    var go = $("paidGo");
    if (go) go.addEventListener("click", function () {
      paidWaypointId = null;   // pressed on the card, not on a checklist item
      confirmPaidRound();
    });
  }

  function selectedComponents() {
    if (!PAID) return [];
    return (PAID.components || []).filter(function (c) { return c.required || chosen[c.key]; });
  }
  function totalCents() {
    return selectedComponents().reduce(function (sum, c) {
      return sum + (c.priceCents == null ? 0 : Number(c.priceCents));
    }, 0);
  }

  /* ONE OPEN REQUEST AT A TIME, CHECKED AT EVERY DOOR INTO THIS FLOW.

     There are two doors: the "Continue" button on the round card, and the
     "Have us do it" button on a checklist item. The round card hides its
     button when PAID.inFlight is true; the checklist button does not know
     about PAID at all, so without this the second door walked straight past
     the first door's refusal.

     inFlightNow() is also set to true by this page once a request has actually
     been created — see startPaidRound(). The payload only describes the state
     the page LOADED in, and a press changes that state. Re-reading nothing and
     pressing again is how a client ends up with two quoted rounds. */
  function inFlightNow() {
    return !!(PAID && PAID.inFlight);
  }

  /* THE PAYMENT PAGE SHE ALREADY HAS, LOOKED UP ONCE.
     GAP 11, live walk 2026-09-16. A client with an unpaid round on file was told
     "we are working on it" and given nothing to press. Nobody was working on it:
     the round starts when the money lands, and the checkout link that would let
     her pay was sitting on her own request row.

     GET /api/paid-services is the read that carries it (paidServiceOffer in
     src/paid-services/round.mjs). This page loads with only the boolean, so the
     ask is made here, lazily, and only when something really is in flight.

     NOTHING IS CREATED AND NOTHING IS CHARGED. This is a GET, and what comes
     back is a link to the page that was minted when she asked for the round. A
     second request would be a second round she has to pay for.

     IT HANDS BACK null UNLESS ALL FOUR ARE TRUE: the read answered; the status
     is awaiting_payment, not quoted/paid/staged, which are states where there is
     genuinely nothing for her to do; the link is a real http(s) address
     (safeUrl); and it has not passed its seven-day expiry
     (src/paid-services/link-ttl.mjs). Anything else keeps the old wording,
     because offering a dead link is worse than offering none.

     IT ALWAYS CALLS BACK, AND IT CALLS BACK ONCE. A fetch that never settles is
     not a rejection — `.catch` never runs and the callback never fires. That is
     how a press turned into silence. So every caller gets an answer inside
     PAID_RESUME_TIMEOUT_MS whatever the network does: the timer hands back null,
     which is the same answer a failed read gives, and null is already the safe
     wording. The request itself is still cached and shared, so a slow answer
     that lands after the timer is not a second round trip — it is simply
     ignored for that press. */
  var PAID_RESUME_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;
  var paidResumePromise = null;
  function loadPaidResume(cb) {
    if (!paidResumePromise) {
      var id = clientIdFromUrl();
      paidResumePromise = api(PAID_REQUEST_PATH + (id ? "?client_id=" + encodeURIComponent(id) : ""))
        .then(function (r) {
          var list = (r.ok && r.body && r.body.services) || [];
          var offer = null;
          for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            if (String(list[i].serviceKey || "") === "paid_round") { offer = list[i]; break; }
          }
          if (!offer || String(offer.inFlightStatus || "") !== "awaiting_payment") return null;
          var url = safeUrl(offer.inFlightCheckoutUrl);
          if (!url) return null;
          var ends = parseDate(offer.inFlightCheckoutExpiresAt);
          if (ends && ends.getTime() <= Date.now()) return null;
          return { url: url, expiresAt: offer.inFlightCheckoutExpiresAt || null };
        })
        .catch(function () { return null; });
    }
    var done = false;
    var timer = setTimeout(function () {
      if (done) return;
      done = true;
      cb(null);
    }, PAID_RESUME_TIMEOUT_MS);
    paidResumePromise.then(
      function (v) { if (done) return; done = true; clearTimeout(timer); cb(v); },
      function () { if (done) return; done = true; clearTimeout(timer); cb(null); }
    );
  }

  /* THE DIALOG COMES UP ON THE PRESS, NOT ON THE ANSWER.
     Reviewer must-fix, 2026-09-17. This used to wait on loadPaidResume() before
     it painted anything, so a slow or dead GET turned a press that had ALWAYS
     produced a dialog into a press that produced nothing — the client clicks and
     the screen sits there. A control that sometimes does nothing is the same
     defect as a control that never does anything.

     So the order is inverted. The safe wording — the one that is true whether or
     not there is a payment page to resume — paints immediately, with a line
     saying the check is running. If the read comes back with a live checkout
     link the dialog is upgraded in place to the one that offers it; if it comes
     back empty, fails, or times out, the same safe wording stays and only the
     "checking" line goes. Every path ends at a dialog. */
  function refuseSecondRound() {
    /* The same door, the same answer. A client who reaches this through a
       checklist item rather than the round card must not be told something
       different from what the card says. */
    var waiting = {
      title: "You already have one in progress",
      sub: "We are working on the round you asked for. There is nothing more to do here — "
         + "reload this page in a little while and it will show where it has got to.",
      actions: [{ label: "Close", ghost: true }]
    };
    dialog({
      title: waiting.title,
      sub: waiting.sub,
      body: '<div class="note">Checking whether your payment page is still open…</div>',
      actions: waiting.actions
    });
    var mine = dialogSeq;
    loadPaidResume(function (resume) {
      /* She closed it, or pressed something else that opened another dialog.
         Either way this answer is stale and must not take the screen back. */
      if (!dialogIsMine(mine)) return;
      if (resume) {
        dialog({
          title: "Your round is waiting on payment",
          sub: "We have your round ready to start. It begins as soon as the payment lands. "
             + "Your payment page is still open — nothing new is set up and you are not "
             + "charged until you do it there.",
          actions: [
            { label: "Not now", ghost: true },
            { label: "Take me to payment", href: resume.url }
          ]
        });
        return;
      }
      dialog(waiting);
    });
  }

  /** Step one: the price, broken out, before anything is committed. */
  function confirmPaidRound() {
    if (inFlightNow()) return refuseSecondRound();
    var comps = selectedComponents();
    if (!comps.length) return;
    var rows = comps.map(function (c) {
      return '<div class="row"><span class="rl">' + esc(c.label || c.key) + '</span>'
           + '<span class="mono">' + esc(money(c.priceCents) || "—") + '</span></div>';
    }).join("");
    rows += '<div class="row total"><span>Total</span><span class="mono">'
          + esc(money(totalCents()) || "—") + '</span></div>';

    dialog({
      title: "Here is what you are buying",
      sub: "Check this over. Nothing is charged on this screen.",
      body: '<div class="rows" style="margin-top:14px">' + rows + '</div>'
          + '<div class="note">We pull your credit again first, so the round is built from '
          + 'today’s report and not an old one.</div>',
      actions: [
        { label: "Back", ghost: true },
        { label: "Yes, continue", onClick: confirmPaidRoundTwice }
      ]
    });
  }

  /** Step two: the double-confirm. Deliberately a separate press with the
      amount repeated, because the first press is the one people make by
      accident. */
  function confirmPaidRoundTwice() {
    var total = money(totalCents()) || "this amount";
    dialog({
      title: "Confirm " + total,
      sub: "This is the last step before the payment page.",
      body: '<div class="note"><b>What happens after you pay:</b> we pull your credit, '
          + 'build your round from what we find, and get it ready to go out. '
          + '<b>A member of our team sends it — it does not go out automatically.</b></div>'
          + '<div class="note">This does not use one of the rounds in your programme.</div>',
      actions: [
        { label: "Cancel", ghost: true },
        { label: "Take me to payment", onClick: startPaidRound }
      ]
    });
  }

  /** Step three: ask the server for a hosted checkout link and hand it over. */
  function startPaidRound() {
    if (inFlightNow()) return refuseSecondRound();
    var comps = selectedComponents().map(function (c) { return c.key; });
    dialog({
      title: "One moment",
      sub: "Setting up your secure payment page…",
      actions: []
    });
    /* THE BODY THE ENDPOINT ACTUALLY READS. api/paid-services.mjs takes one
       boolean per optional extra, not a list of component keys — it refuses any
       `service` but "paid_round", and the base is never optional so it is not
       sent. The component keys the read endpoint hands us (round_base,
       creditor, cfpb_and_ag — roundPriceList() in src/paid-services/round.mjs,
       and the same three the contract names at :108-110) are what the checkboxes
       are keyed on, so the two booleans are derived from them rather than from
       the order the boxes happen to be in. */
    var wants = function (k) { return comps.indexOf(k) !== -1; };
    api(PAID_REQUEST_PATH, {
      method: "POST",
      body: {
        service: "paid_round",
        creditor_letter: wants("creditor"),
        escalation_filings: wants("cfpb_and_ag"),
        /* Ties the purchase to the checklist item it was bought from, when the
           press came from one. Null is fine — the endpoint treats it as absent. */
        waypoint_id: paidWaypointId,
        /* One press per client, per selection, per day. A double press lands on
           the same row rather than buying two rounds. The server owns the real
           guard (events(org_id, idempotency_key) is unique) — this is the client
           half of it, not the whole of it. */
        idempotency_key: "paid_round:" + comps.slice().sort().join("+") + ":" + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
      }
    }).then(function (r) {
      if (r.status === 401) return toLogin();
      /* `checkout_url`, snake case — api/paid-services.mjs:186. The camelCase
         spellings are kept as a fallback and cost nothing; the snake one is what
         actually arrives. */
      /* safeUrl() — a checkout link that is not http(s) is not opened and is
         treated as no link at all, which falls through to the "not ready yet"
         branch below. See safeUrl(). */
      var url = safeUrl(r.body && (r.body.checkout_url || r.body.checkoutUrl
              || (r.body.request && (r.body.request.checkout_url || r.body.request.checkoutUrl))));
      /* A REQUEST NOW EXISTS. ok:true means the endpoint accepted it and a
         paid_service_requests row is open, whether or not a link came back
         with it. The payload this page loaded said inFlight:false and that is
         no longer true, so the page's own copy is corrected here rather than
         waiting for a reload. Every door into the flow reads it. */
      if (r.ok && PAID) PAID.inFlight = true;
      if (r.ok && url) {
        dialog({
          title: "Your payment page is ready",
          sub: "It opens in a new tab. Nothing is charged until you finish there.",
          actions: [
            { label: "Close", ghost: true },
            { label: "Open payment page", href: String(url) }
          ]
        });
        return;
      }
      /* ACCEPTED, BUT NO LINK YET — and this is NOT a failure, so it must not
         say one. api/paid-services.mjs answers ok:true with checkout_pending
         when there is no URL to hand over: either the losing side of a genuine
         race, where the winning press is minting the link this second and a
         second link would be a second charge, or a mint that could not complete.
         The page cannot tell those apart and does not pretend to. What it can
         say truthfully in both: no card was touched, and the link is not ready.
         Saying "that did not go through" here would be wrong in the race case —
         it went through fine and somebody else's press is finishing it. */
      if (r.ok && !url) {
        return dialog({
          title: "Your payment page is not ready yet",
          /* NO "press it again" HERE. Your request is already saved, and this
             page now refuses a second press for exactly that reason — telling
             a client to press a button that will decline them is worse than
             telling them nothing. Message us is the one route that works. */
          sub: "Nothing has been charged and no card has been touched. Your request is saved, "
             + "so there is no need to press again. Message us and we will send you the payment link.",
          actions: [{ label: "Close", ghost: true }]
        });
      }

      if (r.status === 404 || r.status === 405) {
        /* Wave 2 owns this endpoint. Until it lands this is the honest answer,
           and it is deliberately not a fake success. */
        return dialog({
          title: "Not switched on yet",
          sub: "Buying a round from this page is not live yet. Message us and we will set it up for you.",
          actions: [{ label: "Close", ghost: true }]
        });
      }
      /* THE ENDPOINT WRITES ITS OWN REFUSAL SENTENCE, for a client, and it knows
         things this page does not — a round already staged, the cap reached, no
         letters to send, not on the optimisation path. src/paid-services/refusals.mjs
         is where those words live. Showing ours over theirs would replace a
         specific true reason with a vague one, so theirs wins whenever it is
         there and this page's line is the fallback for when it is not. */
      var said = r.body && typeof r.body.message === "string" && r.body.message.trim();
      if (said) {
        /* THEIR SENTENCE, NOT OURS, and not both. src/paid-services/refusals.mjs
           already ends most refusals with "Nothing has been charged", so
           appending it unconditionally printed it twice in one dialog. Added
           only when their sentence does not already carry the reassurance —
           which it must, because it is the one thing a person needs to read
           after pressing a button that was about to take money. */
        var reassures = /nothing has been charged|no card/i.test(said);
        return dialog({
          title: r.status === 409 ? "We could not start that round" : "That did not go through",
          sub: esc(said) + (reassures ? "" : " Nothing has been charged."),
          actions: [{ label: "Close", ghost: true }]
        });
      }
      dialog({
        title: "That did not go through",
        sub: "Nothing has been charged. Please try again in a moment.",
        actions: [{ label: "Close", ghost: true }]
      });
    }, function () {
      dialog({
        title: "That did not go through",
        sub: "Nothing has been charged. Please check your connection and try again.",
        actions: [{ label: "Close", ghost: true }]
      });
    });
  }

  /** A waypoint's own paid alternative. The round is the one we price on this
      page today; anything else routes to the same request endpoint with its own
      service key rather than growing a second flow. */
  function openPaidFlow(wp) {
    var key = wp.paidAlternative && wp.paidAlternative.serviceKey;
    if (key === "paid_round" && PAID) {
      paidWaypointId = wp.id || null;
      return confirmPaidRound();
    }
    var price = money(wp.paidAlternative && wp.paidAlternative.priceCents);
    dialog({
      title: "Have us do this for you",
      sub: esc(wp.title || "This step") + (price ? " — " + esc(price) : ""),
      body: '<div class="note">Message us and we will set this up. '
          + 'Paying for it from this page is not switched on yet.</div>',
      actions: [{ label: "Close", ghost: true }]
    });
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     6. DOCUMENTS, TIMELINE, REFERRAL
     ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  /* OWNED BUT NOT BUILT YET (hole N13, 2026-09-18). Sim Twelve-Academy was
     granted a Funding Snapshot that had not been built, and this card said
     nothing at all because it listed only saved documents. `notReady` is the
     server's list of documents the client owns with nothing saved yet
     (ownedNotReady in src/progress/read.mjs); each one is named and marked Not
     ready yet. It is a row, not a link — there is nothing to open yet. */
  function paintDeliverables(list, notReady) {
    var el = $("cDocs");
    notReady = notReady || [];
    if (!list.length && !notReady.length) {
      el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Your documents appear here once they are ready.</div>';
      return;
    }
    el.innerHTML = list.map(function (d) {
      var when = longDate(d.generatedAt);
      return '<a href="#" data-doc="' + esc(d.documentId) + '">'
           + '<span class="dt">' + esc(d.title || d.subtype || "Document") + '</span>'
           + '<span class="dd">' + esc(when || "") + '</span></a>';
    }).join("") + notReady.map(function (d) {
      return '<div class="dp"><span><span class="dt">' + esc(d.name || d.subtype || "Document") + '</span>'
           + '<span class="dn">Part of your package. It is not built yet. It shows up here, '
           + 'ready to open, as soon as it is.</span></span>'
           + '<span class="badge b-gray">Not ready yet</span></div>';
    }).join("");
    el.addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
      var a = ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest("a[data-doc]") : null;
      if (!a) return;
      ev.preventDefault();
      onPanelClick({ target: { closest: function (sel) {
        return sel === ".panel[data-doc]" ? a : null;
      } } });
    });
  }

  function paintTimeline(list) {
    var el = $("cTimeline");
    if (!list.length) {
      el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Nothing has happened on your file yet.</div>';
      return;
    }
    /* The text comes from the server, already written for a client by
       timelineLine() (src/repair/lens.mjs:206). It is escaped here anyway —
       this page escapes everything it did not write itself, without asking
       where it came from. */
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="tl">' + list.map(function (e) {
      var row = timelineParts(e);
      return '<div class="ev">' + (row.when ? '<div class="d">' + esc(row.when) + '</div>' : '')
           + '<div class="x">' + esc(row.words) + '</div></div>';
    }).join("") + '</div>';
  }

  function paintReferral(ref) {
    var el = $("cReferral");
    ref = ref || {};
    if (ref.enrolled && ref.shareUrl) return paintReferralEnrolled(ref);

    el.innerHTML = '<div class="stage-h">Know someone who needs this?</div>'
      + '<div class="stage-l">Send them your own link. If they sign up, you earn on it — '
      + 'and you get your own dashboard to watch it.</div>'
      + '<div style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn" type="button" id="refGo">Refer a friend</button></div>';

    var go = $("refGo");
    if (go) go.addEventListener("click", function () {
      go.disabled = true;
      go.textContent = "Setting it up…";
      api(REFERRAL_PATH, { method: "POST", body: {} }).then(function (r) {
        if (r.status === 401) return toLogin();
        var b = r.body || {};
        if (r.ok && b.ok !== false && (b.shareUrl || b.code)) {
          if (window.FHClientIOS && window.FHClientIOS.refreshAffiliate) window.FHClientIOS.refreshAffiliate();
          return paintReferralEnrolled({ enrolled: true, shareUrl: b.shareUrl, code: b.code });
        }
        go.disabled = false;
        go.textContent = "Refer a friend";
        dialog({
          title: "That did not work",
          sub: "We could not set your link up just now. Please try again in a moment.",
          actions: [{ label: "Close", ghost: true }]
        });
      }, function () {
        go.disabled = false;
        go.textContent = "Refer a friend";
      });
    });
  }

  function paintReferralEnrolled(ref) {
    var el = $("cReferral");
    var url = ref.shareUrl || "";
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="stage-h">Your link is ready</div>'
      + '<div class="stage-l">Anyone who signs up through this link is counted as yours.</div>'
      + '<div class="share">'
      + '<input id="refUrl" aria-label="Your referral link" readonly value="' + esc(url) + '">'
      + '<button class="btn ghost" type="button" id="refCopy">Copy</button>'
      + '</div>'
      + (ref.code ? '<div class="stage-l mono" style="margin-top:10px;font-size:12px">Your code: '
          + esc(ref.code) + '</div>' : '')
      + '<div style="margin-top:16px"><a class="btn ghost" href="/app/affiliate.html">Open your referral dashboard</a></div>';

    var copy = $("refCopy");
    if (copy) copy.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var input = $("refUrl");
      try {
        input.select();
        input.setSelectionRange(0, 99999);
        document.execCommand("copy");
        copy.textContent = "Copied";
        setTimeout(function () { copy.textContent = "Copy"; }, 1800);
      } catch (e) { /* selection is enough — the value is on screen either way */ }
    });
  }

  /* ── THE DIALOG. One element, reused. ───────────────────────────────────

     dialogSeq COUNTS THE PAINTS. One element serves every dialog on this page,
     so "is my dialog still the one on screen?" cannot be answered by looking at
     the element. Anything that paints a dialog and then waits on an answer
     grabs the number, and only repaints if the number has not moved and the
     dialog has not been closed. Without it a slow read could rewrite whatever
     dialog the client had opened since. */
  var dialogSeq = 0;
  function dialogIsMine(seq) {
    var d = $("dlg");
    return dialogSeq === seq && !!(d && d.open);
  }
  function dialog(opts) {
    var d = $("dlg");
    dialogSeq++;
    $("dlgT").textContent = opts.title || "";
    $("dlgS").innerHTML = opts.sub || "";
    $("dlgB").innerHTML = opts.body || "";
    var acts = $("dlgA");
    acts.innerHTML = "";
    (opts.actions || []).forEach(function (a) {
      var node;
      if (a.href) {
        node = document.createElement("a");
        node.href = a.href;
        node.target = "_blank";
        node.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
      } else {
        node = document.createElement("button");
        node.type = "button";
      }
      node.className = "btn" + (a.ghost ? " ghost" : "");
      node.textContent = a.label;
      node.addEventListener("click", function () {
        try { d.close(); } catch (e) {}
        if (a.onClick) a.onClick();
      });
      acts.appendChild(node);
    });
    if (!d.open) { try { d.showModal(); } catch (e) { d.setAttribute("open", ""); } }
  }

  /* ── LOAD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function fatal(html) {
    $("hSub").textContent = "";
    $("progressLoading").hidden = true;
    var f = $("fatal");
    f.innerHTML = html;
    f.classList.remove("hidden");
    $("main").classList.add("hidden");
  }

  function boot() {
    /* NO LOCAL SIGN-IN CHECK HERE (live walk 2026-09-17, hole 4). Staff sign in
       with the httpOnly fundhub_session cookie, which page code cannot read, so
       a missing fh_token does not mean "signed out". The server decides: its
       401 below is the only thing that sends a visitor to sign in. */
    paintBackLink();

    api(progressPath()).then(function (r) {
      if (r.status === 401) return toLogin();
      if (r.status === 403) {
        return fatal("This page shows one person’s file and your sign-in does not open it. "
                   + "If you are staff, open the client from the CRM instead.");
      }
      if (r.status === 404) {
        /* WAVE 2 OWNS THIS ENDPOINT. Saying so plainly beats an empty page that
           a client would read as an empty file. */
        return fatal("<b>Your progress page is nearly ready.</b><br>"
                   + "We are switching this on now. Everything on your file is safe — "
                   + "nothing here is missing, it just is not connected yet.");
      }
      /* THE SECOND HALF OF WALK FINDING 15. A staff sign-in that names no
         client gets 400 client_id_required, and that is not a broken read — it
         is a question nobody answered. Telling somebody to refresh cannot
         supply a client id, so this says what actually reaches the file. It is
         a staff-only state: a client is pinned to their own file and can never
         land here. */
      if (r.status === 400 && r.body && r.body.error === "client_id_required") {
        return fatal("<b>This page shows one client's file, and no client is named.</b><br>"
                   + "You are signed in as staff. Open the client in the CRM and use the "
                   + "“See exactly where your file stands” link on their portal, "
                   + "which carries their file with it.");
      }
      if (!r.ok || !r.body || r.body.ok === false) {
        /* EVERY OTHER FAILURE. "Refresh in a moment" was the only instruction
           here and it was wrong for every cause the page could not name, so it
           now offers the two routes that do reach a person. */
        return fatal("<b>We could not load your file just now.</b><br>"
                   + "This page did not load — nothing has changed on your file. "
                   + "Go back to your portal and try again in a few minutes. "
                   + "If it still will not open, say so in chat and we will look at it.");
      }

      $("progressLoading").hidden = true;
      var d = r.body;
      var waypoints = Array.isArray(d.waypoints) ? d.waypoints : [];

      $("hSub").textContent = "Everything on your file, as it stands today.";
      $("main").classList.remove("hidden");

      paintStage(d.stage);
      paintScores(d.scores);
      paintMovement(d.movement);
      paintNext(d.nextStep, waypoints);
      paintWaypoints(waypoints);
      paintPaidServices(Array.isArray(d.paidServices) ? d.paidServices : [], d.stage);
      paintDeliverables(Array.isArray(d.deliverables) ? d.deliverables : [],
                        Array.isArray(d.ownedNotReady) ? d.ownedNotReady : []);
      paintTimeline(Array.isArray(d.timeline) ? d.timeline : []);
      paintReferral(d.referral);
    }, function () {
      fatal("We could not reach the server. Please check your connection and refresh.");
    });
  }

  boot();
})();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    /* ── Order reference, read once, kept in memory only ──────────────────────
       Commas' success redirect carries ?ref= (and sometimes &client_id=). Read
       it here so a later step of the pull work has it to hand — but this file
       never writes either value anywhere else on the page, in browser storage,
       or anywhere it could be read back later. If ref is missing the form
       still renders; nothing here invents one. */
    var qp = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    var orderRef = qp.get("ref") || null;
    var orderClientId = qp.get("client_id") || null;

    /* The price is the server's. If it cannot be read, say "diagnostic fee"
       rather than guess a number. */
    (function () {
      var slots = document.querySelectorAll("[data-price]");
      function paint(text) { for (var i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) slots[i].textContent = text; }
      fetch("/api/public/slo-checkout", { headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
        .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(String(r.status)); return r.json(); })
        .then(function (cfg) {
          if (!cfg || cfg.ok !== true || !cfg.priceDisplay) throw new Error("no price");
          paint(String(cfg.priceDisplay));
        })
        .catch(function () { paint("diagnostic fee"); });
    })();

    var form = document.getElementById("pull");
    var err = document.getElementById("formErr");
    var consent = document.getElementById("consent");
    var building = document.getElementById("building");
    var ssnInput = document.getElementById("ssn");

    var FIELDS = [
      ["first", "your legal first name"],
      ["last", "your legal last name"],
      ["dob", "your date of birth"],
      ["ssn", "your Social Security number"],
      ["addr", "your street address"],
      ["city", "your city"],
      ["state", "your state"],
      ["zip", "your ZIP code"]
    ];

    function showError(msg) {
      err.textContent = msg;
      err.hidden = false;
    }

    /* POST /api/public/slo-pull once. SSN is in the JSON body only, then the
       input is cleared. Nothing here puts SSN or DOB in the address bar. */
    form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      err.hidden = true;
      err.textContent = "";

      var missing = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < FIELDS.length; i++) {
        var id = FIELDS[i][0];
        var label = FIELDS[i][1];
        var val = document.getElementById(id).value.trim();
        if (!val) missing.push(label);
      }
      if (missing.length) {
        showError("Please fill in " + missing.join(", ") + ".");
        return;
      }

      if (!consent.checked) {
        showError("Please check the box to authorize the soft pull before we can continue.");
        consent.focus();
        return;
      }

      if (!orderRef || !orderClientId) {
        showError("Open this page from your order link so we can match your file.");
        return;
      }

      var ssn = ssnInput.value.trim();
      ssnInput.value = "";

      var payload = {
        ref: orderRef,
        client_id: orderClientId,
        first_name: document.getElementById("first").value.trim(),
        last_name: document.getElementById("last").value.trim(),
        dob: document.getElementById("dob").value.trim(),
        ssn: ssn,
        address: document.getElementById("addr").value.trim(),
        city: document.getElementById("city").value.trim(),
        state: document.getElementById("state").value.trim(),
        zip: document.getElementById("zip").value.trim(),
        consent: true
      };
      ssn = "";

      form.hidden = true;
      building.hidden = false;
      building.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });

      fetch("/api/public/slo-pull", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { accept: "application/json", "content-type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      }).then(function (r) {
        return r.json().then(function (body) {
          return { okHttp: r.ok, body: body };
        }).catch(function () {
          return { okHttp: r.ok, body: null };
        });
      }).then(function (out) {
        if (out && out.okHttp && out.body && out.body.ok === true) return;
        building.hidden = true;
        form.hidden = false;
        showError("We could not start the soft pull. Check your details and try again.");
      }).catch(function () {
        building.hidden = true;
        form.hidden = false;
        showError("We could not start the soft pull. Check your details and try again.");
      });
    });
  })();
</script>

<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head>
